world.title: Abyss Of Destruction
world.introText: The Abyss of Destruction is one of the highest tier Mysterious Lands in the Chaotic Origin Dimension, acknowledged as a place as mysterious as both Eternal Land and Hell Fire Prison Wall. It is considered an unfathomable zone of pure destruction, containing both known and unknown destructive forces, and remains a place where even the essence or origin of its power cannot be refined or grasped.
world.appearance:
The Abyss of Destruction is one of the highest tier Mysterious Lands in the Chaotic Origin Dimension, acknowledged as a place as mysterious as both Eternal Land and Hell Fire Prison Wall. It is considered an unfathomable zone of pure destruction, containing both known and unknown destructive forces, and remains a place where even the essence or origin of its power cannot be refined or grasped.

The Abyss is structured in layers, known as Destruction Worlds, each more dangerous than the last. To gain dominion over a layer, one must slaughter through all opposition within it and imprint their life mark on its core origin shadow, thus becoming the ruler of that specific destruction world. These positions are a de facto measure of real combat power across all ancient existences of the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Top-tier Overlords and Hunyuan Ancestors compete fiercely for these layers, as they serve as a ranking system based solely on lethality, not defense or survivability. Beings who specialize in defense or support often cannot claim even the first layer. (Example: The Original Ancestor).
world.personality: The Abyss of Destruction is one of the three supreme Fluctuation Vortexes, also known as Poles, alongside the Eternal Land and the Hell Fire Prison Wall. It absorbs negative fluctuation waves such as hatred, killing intent, unwillingness, and resentment produced by countless lifeforms. These fluctuations nurture the Will of the Abyss of Destruction. It does not emit power like the Hell Fire Prison Wall but absorbs everything instead.

world.title: Ancestral God Secret Region
world.introText: A Secret Region in the Original Universe, and home to the Ancestral God Sect. The Ancestral God Secret Region is one of the most dangerous Secret Regions in the universe. It’s the same size as a Universe Country and dangerous areas are everywhere. Even Universe Venerable can’t manage to survive in it. Its diameter is at 160 Million Light Years, and it took 200  Million Years to travel at sub-light-year speed. One might need to start the adventure from the birth of the universe to pay the entire region even a cursory inspection.

world.title: Ancient Chin Secret Region
world.introText: One of the many Secret Regions in the Original Universe. It has a diameter of 1.2 million light-years. The fifth and final board of the Nine Volume Manual was placed by Sitting Mountain Guest in Blood Cloud Palace in this Secret Region.
world.appearance:
One of the many Secret Regions in the Original Universe. It has a diameter of 1.2 million light-years. The fifth and final board of the Nine Volume Manual was placed by Sitting Mountain Guest in Blood Cloud Palace in this Secret Region.

This Secret Region had been born when the Original Universe first came into being. There had been several wars fought here for the valuables. Gradually, the number of valuables in the Secret Region had lessened, and because it was extremely dangerous, Supreme Beings stopped coming. However, some Immortal and Universe Venerable fighters would occasionally come here and try their luck. It was extremely dangerous, and most of the valuables had been taken. That made the region highly unattractive. Even many Special Lifeforms left, and it became desolate.

world.title: Ancient God Ruins
world.introText: Located on the Blood River Continent, the Ancient God Ruins are an ancient battlefield where the aboriginal Immortals fought against those of the Virtual Universe Company (VUC). The armors and weapons of the fallen from the VUC are still there, and the aura within the ruins can help warriors absorb Blood River Crystals more easily. Thus, while it is terrifying, it is also enticing to the strong!
world.appearance:
Located on the Blood River Continent, the Ancient God Ruins are an ancient battlefield where the aboriginal Immortals fought against those of the Virtual Universe Company (VUC). The armors and weapons of the fallen from the VUC are still there, and the aura within the ruins can help warriors absorb Blood River Crystals more easily. Thus, while it is terrifying, it is also enticing to the strong!

When looking below the clouds, Luo Feng saw an endless mountain range, wasteland, swamp, and other environments. The ground itself was peculiar. The mountain ranges looked as if an entire layer of them were cut off, but were still tens of thousands of meters tall, and the wastelands had huge pits all over, each a few hundred kilometers in diameter. It was filled with thick, red mist, so it was hard to clearly see far. It had a diameter of hundreds of billions of kilometers! It was filled with bandits, vagrants, and more reputable characters. When he landed, he felt something like a killing aura, except it affected the physical body in addition to the mental level!
world.personality:
Located within the Ancient God Ruins is the core region of the Immortal Temple. The building is an ancient shrine 1 million kilometers in area, completely black and red. The surface layer had incomparably complex statues, some of beasts roaring, some of Immortals battling, etc. It is majestic and tall, with over 9,000 levels.

The Immortal Temple is the governing body for the Blood River World. They don't interfere with daily matters of the continent, but they do provide Blood River Crystals so Domain Levels and World Levels can become eligible to run Territorial Cities and World Cities, respectively. They also provide the Black Blood River Medal to any human able to absorb 10 Blood River Crystals. If an outsider is discovered on Blood River World, the Immortal Temple handles locating and capturing that outsider.

As a governing body, they also have envoys (who are at least Domain Master level) who perform tasks for them. They provide Genetic Armor, Genetic Energy Weapons, and Spirit Weapons of higher quality than can be normally found on Blood River World, made by Immortals who broke down weapons used by the VUC and recreated them to their best abilities. They also have Spaceships, something the aboriginals generally do not have.

The Immortal Temple also trains geniuses that they discover; they send them outside to the ruins for life and death training. These geniuses are heavily nurtured, treated even better than the envoys, but are required to absorb 3 Blood River Crystals before they would be allowed to return to the temple.

They have a relationship with Blood God Ba Qi (he is a one in a trillion years level genius they trained), so they provide him with Blood River Medals upon request. They also provide awards to anyone who discovers an ancient treasure and brings it to them.

world.title: Ancient Kingdom
world.introText: The Ancient Kingdoms (Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom and Thunder Ancient Kingdom) are the two most powerful forces on the Continent of Origin. They have the longest histories and most unfathomable foundations of any God-Kingdom, and are extremely mysterious. They have access to more detailed inheritances, more valuable resources, and more powerful cultivators than anyone else. Since they make up the most important areas of the continent, they naturally breed a large number of treasures.

world.title: Australia
world.introText: Before the great Nirvana, Australia was a nation in the Pacific Ocean ...
world.appearance:
Before the great Nirvana, Australia was a nation in the Pacific Ocean ...

Before the Grand Nirvana period, most of the population was gathered on the eastern and south eastern side of the continent

Australia was devastated by the hordes of Mutant animals during the great Nirvana and during the war between the Humans and the Mutant beasts ...

for this, after the Great Nirvana, the human race was wiped out from Australia and the mutant Beasts conquered Australia, making it their territory, making the mutant beasts, the masters of Australia ...

in Australia, there is not only a high density of mutant beasts, but the mutant beasts of Australia are different from the mutant beasts of the rest of the world ...

Australia is one of the three most dangerous areas in the world, no one has ever returned alive from Australia, every human being who dared to enter Australia and ended up killed by mutant beasts and a hostile and lethal environment for ordinary humans. ..

only military expeditions of high-ranking warriors, of the most important martial organizations in the world, have managed to enter in Australia ...

the monsters in Australia are probably over 10 times more powerful than the ones in Asia, and there were way more horde leaders in comparison too

Luo Feng managed to resist for 28 days in Australia, allying himself and fighting against the Australian mutant beasts ...

“This is the current continent of Australia. It’s one of the areas with the highest monster population density. Since Australia is disconnected from the rest of the world, the monsters on this continent are quite different from the monsters on other continents”

“For example, many rat type and badger type monsters are quite different from the ones in Asia and Europe”

“Before the Grand Nirvana period, the continent of Australia was famous for its diverse and large amount of animals. So before the Grand Nirvana period, there were already all sorts of animals here. The mutations caused many horrifying monsters to appear. I believe you guys have looked through a lot of information before coming here”

“Diversity is just one portion”

“After that, the high number of monsters led to….. the birth of an emperor level monster! As of now, it’s virtually instant death for you if you encounter an emperor level monster. So keep in mind to avoid places with large monster population densities. If you see large amounts of horde leader level monsters, run as far away as you can”

“In places like Asia and Europe, the high population of people led to a smaller amount of monsters. But in Australia….. the large amounts of monsters led to the formation of many monster hordes! So while you’re here, pay attention to the monster hordes and horde leader level monsters” the middle-aged Chinese man pointed at the display, “These, are all sorts of monster hordes and horde leader level monsters that are commonly seen in the continent of Australia. Look carefully!”

world.title: Automaton Race Virtual World
world.introText: The Automaton Race Virtual World is a virtual space controlled by the Automaton Race. Generally, an Automaton Race Virtual World covers one Star Sector. Since the entire Automaton Race territory comprises hundreds of Star Sectors, they have hundreds of virtual worlds. Like the Human Race, the Automaton Race can communicate anywhere in the Original Universe, although their communication outside of their territory is worse than the Human Race's through the Virtual Universe. The Automaton Race and their allies are able to access their virtual worlds, and actions within the Automaton Race alliance are monitored through these virtual worlds.

world.title: Bai Lan Planet
world.introText: A Planet 11,800 light years from Earth. Its strongest cultivator is a Stellar Level 1 Warrior. Luo Feng bought a 98km long and 61km wide warehouse on the planet to store items that he buys from Virtual Universe. Hu Yan Bo used his space technique to hide Earth and its surrounding 1,000 light-years, making others unable to locate it. This meant that when Luo Feng began to interact with the universe, he needed a second base where goods could be sent, where he could meet with others, etc. After a discussion with Babata, in which he asked for a planet as close to Earth as possible, as cheap as possible, as small of a population as possible, and as large of a warehouse as possible, Babata suggested this planet.

world.introText: Beginning Universe (初始宇宙, Chūshǐ yǔzhòu, lit. Beginning/Initial Universe) is the headquarters of Virtual Universe Company, the Miniature Universe of Ancestor Yuan and the future Holy Land. The only city in Beginning Universe is Primal Chaos City.
world.appearance:
Beginning Universe (初始宇宙, Chūshǐ yǔzhòu, lit. Beginning/Initial Universe) is the headquarters of Virtual Universe Company, the Miniature Universe of Ancestor Yuan and the future Holy Land. The only city in Beginning Universe is Primal Chaos City.

During Ancestor Yuan's suppression, Primal Chaos City Leader was the leader of this Universe. When Ancestor Yuan transcended Reincarnation it became a Holy Land called Ancestor Yuan Holy Land Universe. As Ancestor Yuan was being suppressed by the Original Universe, the evolution of his Miniature Universe stopped. That was why the Beginning Universe was always in the beginning stage.

As Primal Chaos City Leader was left in charge of this universe, he could use his mastery of Law of Time  and Law of Space  to manipulate the time and space within and can check through the bodies of all who occupied Primal Chaos City, preventing spies from entering. As it is Ancestor Yuan's Miniature Universe, its occupants have access to the Virtual Universe, unlike other Miniature Universes such as Space Beast Ancestor's.

world.title: Billions of Worlds
world.introText: Billions of Worlds is a term used to refer to the Sacred Worlds created by the Overlords of the Cultivator Camp. The vast majority of God Emperors actually come from these worlds rather than Origin Worlds, and they have different names for that cultivation realm, such as Witch Ancestor Realm, Dao Lord Realm, and God Sovereign Realm.
world.appearance:
Billions of Worlds is a term used to refer to the Sacred Worlds created by the Overlords of the Cultivator Camp. The vast majority of God Emperors actually come from these worlds rather than Origin Worlds, and they have different names for that cultivation realm, such as Witch Ancestor Realm, Dao Lord Realm, and God Sovereign Realm.

Since these worlds are not Origin Worlds, they are incomplete in a sense; while Complete Great Daos are accepted in any Origin World, there can be incompatibilities in the Billions of Worlds, so a cultivator may have to reform their body accordingly. This can be considered another form of cultivation, and traveling through these worlds allows cultivators to study their Great Dao from other perspectives.

Beings from these worlds do not have cloning techniques, but many are born with Hunyuan Bloodlines, so cultivation is easier for them than for those from the Origin Worlds. They also receive far fewer resources than cultivators from the Origin Worlds, so they may attempt to kill Origin World cultivators when they have the chance. Due to not having clones, they tend to carry their accumulated treasures on their body, and they spend great amounts on life-saving treasures.

In Swallowed Star 2, no Overlord has been born from any of these worlds, which drove Overlord Yuan to successfully create an Origin World.

world.title: Black Dragon Mountain Empire
world.introText: The Black Dragon Mountain Empire is a decent medium-sized civilized nation in the universe, governing the Black Dragon Mountain Starfield, one of the roughly 13,000 starfields managed by the Ganwu Universe Country. Established and owned by Black Dragon Immortal, it has direct control of over 8,000 galaxies and over 500 low-level vassal nations, including the Silverblue Empire and the Kaluo Empire. Due to being under the Ganwu Universe Country, a citizen of the empire could join the Ganwu Dojo.
world.appearance:
The Black Dragon Mountain Empire is a decent medium-sized civilized nation in the universe, governing the Black Dragon Mountain Starfield, one of the roughly 13,000 starfields managed by the Ganwu Universe Country. Established and owned by Black Dragon Immortal, it has direct control of over 8,000 galaxies and over 500 low-level vassal nations, including the Silverblue Empire and the Kaluo Empire. Due to being under the Ganwu Universe Country, a citizen of the empire could join the Ganwu Dojo.

As a medium-sized civilized nation, it has an island within the Virtual Universe, Black Dragon Mountain Island, within which those under its jurisdiction dwell. Earth, as part of the Milky Way, a galaxy under the Silverblue Empire, fell under its jurisdiction until the Milky Way was granted to Luo Feng for his performance in the Pinnacle Genius Battle.

Despite its relative size, in terms of strength and talent it has been generally considered a lower-level nation under the Ganwu Universe Country.
world.history:
The Black Dragon Mountain Empire has two Immortals who dwell within; the leaders of the two holy lands, Black Dragon Immortal and the God Leader of Ice Sea God Country. As ordinary Immortals, neither are close to Immortal Marquis-level, which is why the entire empire had to show respect to Hu Yan Bo. Their World Masters were generally ordinary, some not even 3 star clients of one of the major banks, so some could not even join the Huge Axe Dojo.

There are close to 100 World Masters within the Black Dragon Mountain Starfield, and those pinnacle World Masters who were recognized by the Original Laws were rare, considered the elite of the empire. With this in mind, an organization possessing a Domain Master warrior was considered pretty good. Any Domain Master with any reputation would generally be recognized. A Universe Level Huge Axe Warrior like Nuolan Shan was a big deal within the empire, with only 12 living who had been awarded the title. A Domain Master Huge Axe Warrior had only been seen once in the last 10 million years, and a World Master Huge Axe Warrior was basically a myth!

The resources of the empire were not at the level of the Ganwu Universe Country, much less the Virtual Universe Company. It was impossible for Luo Feng to have the Yun Mo Spaceship repaired there, for instance; they simply lacked the resources. An Automaton Ship was a rare sight within the starfield, and even their royal family did not possess an E9 Grade Laser Gun. Even the Black Dragon Mountain Emperor could not immediately part with 600 Mixed Yuan Units! There was no F Grade spaceship in the entire empire!

Despite this relative lack of strength, this is still an empire that controls over 6,000 galaxies! The number of life planets is terrifying, and thus there was plenty of Stellar Level talent within. While the empire did not have any representatives within the top 10,000 of the Ganwu Universe Country selection portion of the Pinnacle Genius Battle prior to Luo Feng's Pinnacle Genius Battle, the Stellar Level 1 Luo Feng was very unpleasantly surprised in one of his battles within the Black Dragon Mountain Island Killing Fields!
world.trivia: In the donghua, the Ice Sea God Country does not exist, so there are only 5 largest powers in the empire

world.title: Black Dragon Mountain Starfield
world.introText: The Black Dragon Mountain Starfield is the starfield governed by the Black Dragon Mountain Empire, and is thus the property of Black Dragon Immortal. It contains more than 8,000 galaxies, over 6,000 of which are directly controlled by the empire, and over 500 low-level vassal nations, including the Silverblue Empire and Kaluo Empire. It is considered a very ordinary starfield, as it only has two Immortals. As there are over 8,000 galaxies within the starfield, there are hundreds of millions of planets containing life. Due to its galaxies being relatively close together and easy to govern, if Black Dragon Immortal decided to sell it, it would sell for 300,000-1,000,000 Mixed Yuan Units.

world.title: Black Hole
world.introText: A Black Hole (黑洞(Hēidòng)) is an ultra-high density spherical celestial body that has been compressed to the extreme. They derive from some super stars in the universe, and their density far surpasses that of a Neutron Star. Accurately speaking, Black Holes are located between the Original Universe Space and the Space Turbulence; due to their high mass and gravity, they are unaffected by the space turbulence, remaining unmoving. Black Holes swallow all light, Spaceships, Planets, Stars, etc. in their vicinity, strengthening the celestial body further, and even Immortals will die if swallowed by one.

A Black Hole (黑洞(Hēidòng)) is an ultra-high density spherical celestial body that has been compressed to the extreme. They derive from some super stars in the universe, and their density far surpasses that of a Neutron Star. Accurately speaking, Black Holes are located between the Original Universe Space and the Space Turbulence; due to their high mass and gravity, they are unaffected by the space turbulence, remaining unmoving. Black Holes swallow all light, Spaceships, Planets, Stars, etc. in their vicinity, strengthening the celestial body further, and even Immortals will die if swallowed by one.

Even the weakest of Black Holes require Universe Venerable strength for one to safely travel to their core; the strongest Black Holes are avoided even by Universe Venerables. The Black Holes in Universe Ocean can be even more powerful than the most powerful Black Holes in the Original Universe!

world.title: Black Hole Secret Realm
world.introText: The Black Hole Secret Realm is a Secret Region owned by the Universe Star River Bank. Similar to the Secret Realms owned by the Virtual Universe Company, it has been excavated and remodeled, used to train core geniuses of the Universe Star River Bank. Geniuses from the other 4 of the 5 Leviathans of Humanity are allowed to travel here for missions.

world.title: Black River World Cluster
world.introText: The Black River World Cluster is located in a remote corner of the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Though not exceptionally powerful or mysterious, it offers a relatively safe and stable environment. After losing the Blood Crane Territory to Luo Feng, the three Primogenitor level beings — Blood Lord, Crane Lord, and Shadow Lord flee with their clans and temporarily settle here. The area lacks the deep origin power and compatibility of places like Blood Crane Territory, but it is sufficient for basic survival and recovery.

world.title: Black Sky Realm
world.introText: Black Sky Realm is a vast territory in the Celestial Pole Ice Field, covering an area comparable to the entire God-Kingdom of second-rate kingdoms such as Yu Kingdom and Food Kingdom. Black Sky Realm appears to be owned by Black Cloud God King, as it is covered by black clouds. It is home to a large number of cultivators and Alien Beasts. Each time a Primal Chaos Sovereign alien beast is born, Black Cloud God King quietly enslaves it and sends it to the two Ancient Kingdoms to steal rare treasures.

world.title: Black Tiger Planet
world.introText: It is a home Planet of the Hundred Tigers Building Organization.
world.appearance: It is basically a huge planet fort! It’s entire body is black, on it were deep passages and alleys, connecting straight into the planet’s interior. And the surface of the planet is a thick and bulky cannon that is capable of blowing up a D Grade universe ship in one shot. The entire planet has several spots where there are occasional flashes of blue light.

world.title: Blood Cloud Palace
world.introText: A towering palace fully cloaked with a coat of blood red. The main doors seemed ordinary but exuded an overwhelming amount of power. Above the doors, there were three extremely complicated sets of secret engravings, the meanings combining to be: Blood Cloud Palace. Within the palace is a gigantic public square, from which you can see 3 palaces, the main palace in the middle. There are several other side palaces and many rear chambers. Within the main palace is a blood-red throne.

world.title: Blood Devil Palace
world.introText: Blood Devil Palace is the most majestic palace on Blood Devil Planet, and serves as King Blood Devil's base. The small palaces surrounding it are a few kilometers in area, and in front of the palace is a huge plaza measuring tens of kilometers.
world.appearance:
Blood Devil Palace is the most majestic palace on Blood Devil Planet, and serves as King Blood Devil's base. The small palaces surrounding it are a few kilometers in area, and in front of the palace is a huge plaza measuring tens of kilometers.

The main body of this palace is an ancient palace that King Blood Devil found a universe Secret Region in the past. With repairs and renovation costing over 10 million Mixed Yuan Units, including fusing it with a Metal Lifeform, the palace is a fortress with stronger defense and battle ability than F9 Grade Spaceships. It had a special energy that Luo Feng could not define.

King Blood Devil attempts to wine and dine Luo Feng here, but is unsuccessful. The executions of his 21 subordinates occurred in this palace.

world.title: Blood Devil Planet
world.introText: A completely blood red planet, seeing it up close was enough to make one shudder.
world.appearance: A completely blood red planet, seeing it up close was enough to make one shudder.

world.title: Blood River World
world.introText: Blood River World (also referred to as Blood River Continent) is a vast floating continent within the Virtual Universe Company's (VUC) Absolute Beginning Secret Realm. It has a diameter close to 1 light-year and has a depth of close to 100 billion kilometers! This continent was produced during the early stages of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm, thus its ancientness far exceeds the most ancient Universe Country.
world.appearance:
Blood River World (also referred to as Blood River Continent) is a vast floating continent within the Virtual Universe Company's (VUC) Absolute Beginning Secret Realm. It has a diameter close to 1 light-year and has a depth of close to 100 billion kilometers! This continent was produced during the early stages of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm, thus its ancientness far exceeds the most ancient Universe Country.

Relatively separated from the Human Race's universe civilization, Blood River World is lacking in technology and resources; the Cloud Vine and Yan Shen Armament cannot be found there. Their technology is primitive (they don't even have flying ships!) and they hate outsiders. The universe origin laws circulating within helped cultivate many strong inhabitants, who have formed their own language, culture, training methods, etc. Almost everyone on Blood River World is at least Planetary Level, and there are tens of millions of World Masters, and billions of Domain Masters. They heavily respect strength, even those from fairly important families can be killed. There are even Immortals here! Every inhabitant is unable to engage in Universe Travel due to the large amounts of cosmic dust making even Immortals unable to accelerate to light-speed.

The continent is managed by Tian Shi Palace Master and his subordinates. Within Tian Shi Palace are some of the absolute warriors of the VUC, who are tasked with handling aboriginals who attempt to escape the continent, working with those geniuses who take the Blood River World Mission, and other duties.

world.title: Blood Spirit Star
world.introText: Blood Spirit Star is a naturally formed celestial body situated on the border between the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom and the Thunder Ancient Kingdom, within the central core region of the Origin Continent. Resembling a colossal crimson fireball suspended in the high sky, it radiates an intense red light that illuminates vast tracts of land and rivers, fostering the growth of unique natural treasures in the surrounding environment. Positioned in one of the most resource-rich and strategically vital areas on the continent, the Blood Spirit Star lies in a neutral yet fiercely contested zone. By tacit agreement between the two Ancient Kingdoms, most of its resources are fought over exclusively by Primal Chaos Sovereign Realm cultivators, with rare occasions drawing the intervention of God Kings.
world.appearance:
Blood Spirit Star is a naturally formed celestial body situated on the border between the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom and the Thunder Ancient Kingdom, within the central core region of the Origin Continent. The Blood Spirit Star undergoes periodic eruptions two to three times per era, preceded by detectable signs. During these events, it expels streams of liquid-like crimson flames along with the rare and highly coveted Blood Spirit Golden Pearls powerful cultivation resources that draw large numbers of hidden powerhouses from across the Origin Continent. These pearls were the target of a Heaven-Level Task issued to First-Rank Marquises of the Emperors's lineage in the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, requiring the collection of all pearls within a single era.

world.title: Blood Tooth Planet
world.introText: Blood Tooth Planet is a planet located in the Original Universe, in Demon Race territory. A vast ocean comprises 90% of the planet. This planet was the meeting place for the United Forces Military Camp in preparation for its war against the Human Race and its allies.
world.appearance: Blood Tooth Planet is a planet located in the Original Universe, in Demon Race territory. A vast ocean comprises 90% of the planet. This planet was the meeting place for the United Forces Military Camp in preparation for its war against the Human Race and its allies.

world.title: Bo Mo Planet
world.introText: Bo Mo Planet was a very normal life planet, located in the Lan Hai Starfield in Taijin Universe Country. It had a diameter of 18,219 kilometers, and 36% of its atmosphere was oxygen. The planet's temperature fluctuated greatly; even in the same place on the same day, morning could be -30 degrees while afternoon could be 50 or 60 degrees. It had a population of about 22 billion. The Zerg Race destroyed it when they discovered that their spy was about to be captured by the Human Race.

world.title: Caged World
world.introText: The Caged World (樊笼世界(Fánlóng shìjiè), also referred to as the Origin World (源世界(Yuán shìjiè), lit. Source/Origin/Root World)) comprises the Continent of Origin and the 3,000 Original Universes and Universe Oceans. Thus, the entirety of Swallowed Star 1 takes place within the Caged World. The Caged World is governed by the Supreme Operation Laws, limiting various aspects, including the types of Great Daos present, the lifespans of lifeforms and cosmic entities, etc.
world.appearance:
The Caged World (樊笼世界(Fánlóng shìjiè), also referred to as the Origin World (源世界(Yuán shìjiè), lit. Source/Origin/Root World)) comprises the Continent of Origin and the 3,000 Original Universes and Universe Oceans. Thus, the entirety of Swallowed Star 1 takes place within the Caged World. The Caged World is governed by the Supreme Operation Laws, limiting various aspects, including the types of Great Daos present, the lifespans of lifeforms and cosmic entities, etc.

In Swallowed Star 2, it is revealed that there is a wider area outside of the Caged World, accessible only to those who have broken through the 'cage.' It is implied that Overlord Yuan and the founders of Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom and Thunder Ancient Kingdom are all existences who have broken through the cage and are exploring beyond the Caged World. God Kings appear to be able to leave the Caged World, however only the most exceptional among them are capable of contributing to the events in that area.
world.trivia:
From Lord Xue Ying, we learn that Luo Feng's original world is called Great Origin Land

Caged World equivalent: Megaverse is a collection of multiple different Multiverses, either a finite or infinite amount of them, usually each having different properties and inter-universal laws.

world.title: Cang Bird Planet
world.introText: Cang Bird Planet is one of the 8 great logistics bases of Human Race. It is also the transportation point for members of the Universe Army and independent warriors to get to the Extraterritorial Battlefield. Cang Bird Planet is a man-made Planet with a diameter of 1.028 million km that also serves as a fortress.
world.appearance:
Cang Bird Planet is one of the 8 great logistics bases of Human Race. It is also the transportation point for members of the Universe Army and independent warriors to get to the Extraterritorial Battlefield. Cang Bird Planet is a man-made Planet with a diameter of 1.028 million km that also serves as a fortress.

Universe Army soldiers and independent warriors use different gathering spots, since the army can easily meet the personnel quota and the independent warriors take a longer period of time to do so. After at least 100 World Masters have been gathered, they will go through an Authority Award Ceremony, a process through which their position in the army, level of the army, etc. are awarded. In the Authority Award Ceremony, every prospective soldier is judged by their current performance in the Virtual Universe, which serves as a gauge of their strength. After assignment, they are transferred to the appropriate battlefield.

world.title: Cang Lan Planet
world.introText: Cang Lan Planet is a beautiful planet ranked within the top-100 most important planets in the Black Dragon Mountain Empire. It has a diameter of around 32,000 kilometers, and its master is a World Master who does not currently live on the planet. The Universe Trainee Mercenary Exam takes place in a World Master World on this planet. The cities on the planet are mostly divided into ancient cities and new cities, with the ancient cities having a history of a million years or longer!

Thunder City (雷霆市(Léitíng shì), lit. Thunderclap City) is a flourishing city on Cang Lan Planet, one of the ancient cities of the planet. While it did not always have this name, the World Master World created by Kabu was discovered in this city, and since that world was famous for its thunder, the city was named Thunder City. After the World Master World was discovered, the Universe Mercenary Alliance built up an area near the city. It is likely that Kabu lived in seclusion in Thunder City, then purchased a villa and created his World Master World within. The World Master World is on the second floor of the villa.

The highest skyscraper in the city is about 8,600 meters tall, with a large hall on the top floor, over 1,000 square meters in area. Hargrave and Jiang Tian Chen met here to negotiate the exchange of the final password for the Inheritance Crystal Ball.
world.history:
World of Thunder Villa

Entrance to the World of Thunder

The World of Thunder (雷霆世界(Léitíng shìjiè), lit. Thunderclap World) is a World Master World hidden within a villa on Cang Lan Planet, used by the Universe Mercenary Alliance for its Universe Trainee Mercenary Exam. It has a surface area over 100 times that of Cang Lan Planet. This world was created by Kabu and was excavated by the Universe Mercenary Alliance for use for the trainee exams. After excavating the world and taking its treasures, they sent in a large number of ferocious beasts within for training purposes.

The World of Thunder has gravity 3,900 times that of Earth's, greatly limiting Spirit Masters' ability to spread their Spirit Energy. As the world's foundation is Universe Crystals, its soil, sand, rocks, etc. are all affected by universe energy, making the world heavy, dense, and durable. The sky has 9 sun-like balls during the day, and is pitch-black at night, with only a faint thread of light coming down.

Death Dust Storm

The Death Desert (死亡沙漠(Sǐwáng shāmò), lit. Death Desert) is one of the forbidden areas of the World of Thunder; even the ferocious beasts do not dare to live within. One of the three great dangers of the desert is the Death Dust Storm (死亡尘暴(Sǐwáng chénbào), lit. Death Dust Storm), a storm that appears suddenly, engulfing land and sky, easily killing even Stellar Level 9 cultivators. Drilling below or flying above the storm is impossible for Stellar Level cultivators.

The Long Suo Mountains (隆索山脉(lóng suǒ shānmài), lit. Long Suo Mountain Range) is a mountain range with danger concealed everywhere. In addition to the ferocious beasts, the other examinees target this area due to the presence of Demon Moon Lake.

Demon Moon Lake (妖月湖(yāo yuè hú), lit. Demon Moon Lake) is a large lake located within the Long Suo Mountains. Over 100 kilometers wide, it is a large source of water, drawing many ferocious beasts, including the One-Horned Iron Rhinoceros. It is located about 32,000 kilometers away from the Death Desert.

Canyon of Wind and Thunder

Lightning from canyon striking

The Canyon of Wind and Thunder (风雷峡谷(Fēngléi xiágǔ), lit. Wind Thunder Canyon) is the core and most dangerous place of the World of Thunder. The canyon lies between mountains covered with large amounts of rocks flying about. There are clouds above the mountains with lightning snakes flying about, as though lightning could strike at any time. One can only obtain Wind Horn Stones in this canyon. There are neither ferocious beasts nor plants in the canyon, just bare stone, dark and black with hints of silver. The winds on the periphery are so strong that lower level Stellar Level cultivators can't walk properly in it. The wind gets stronger the closer one gets to the center; even Universe Level cultivators would die if they flew into the center. Wind Horn Stones fly about in the wind. The most dangerous part of the canyon is the lightning; weaker Domain Masters would die if struck by the lightning, so Universe and Stellar Levels have no chance of survival.

The entrances to the World Within a World on Cang Lan Planet were located in the Canyon of Wind and Thunder.

world.title: Cang Lan Planet/World Within a World
world.introText: The World Within a World on Cang Lan Planet is a hidden world created by the World Master Kabu to hide his treasures. The world is about a million kilometers wide and long, giving it a surface area around 3 times that of the World of Thunder.
world.appearance:
The World Within a World on Cang Lan Planet is a hidden world created by the World Master Kabu to hide his treasures. The world is about a million kilometers wide and long, giving it a surface area around 3 times that of the World of Thunder.

To enter the World Within a World, one had to enter one of the black holes in the mountain range near the Canyon of Wind and Thunder. The Universe Trainee Mercenary Exam examinees in Luo Feng's attempt at the exam recognized the entrances and entered to seek the treasures within. As a world that had yet to be excavated, it had a large number of Universe Crystals, which all of the Stellar Level examinees desired.

In addition to the Universe Crystals, the true treasures of Kabu were hidden here as well, stored in a castle that was controlled by an Artificial Intelligence, Lord Wu.

world.title: Celestial Pole Ice Field
world.introText: Celestial Pole Ice Field is an incredibly vast and extremely cold ice field on the Continent of Origin. It has a harsh living environment and it is much more difficult to obtain cultivation resources there.
world.appearance:
Celestial Pole Ice Field is an incredibly vast and extremely cold ice field on the Continent of Origin. It has a harsh living environment and it is much more difficult to obtain cultivation resources there.

The size of its territory can be compared with the territory of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. However, due to the harsh environment of the ice field, the number of cultivators who dwell within is less than 1% that of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. There are no God-Kingdoms in the Celestial Pole Ice Field, only scattered forces. Outside of the cities, there are almost no tribes that can be seen. The deeper one goes into the ice field, the colder it gets, with the exception of Fire Ancestor Realm, which is kept warm by the existence of Fire Ancestor.

world.title: Chaos A No. 913
world.introText: Chaos A No. 913 is a cave residence in Hu Yang City, one of the thousands of caves in the city's circular belt of Chaos Ruins. The cave is 200,000 kilometers long and wide, with a hill 128,000 kilometers tall, some beautiful lakes and rivers, and more than 1,000 pavilions and halls. world.appearance:

The cave is 200,000 kilometers long and wide, with a hill 128,000 kilometers tall, some beautiful lakes and rivers, and more than 1,000 pavilions and halls. There is also an underground palace 100,000 kilometers long and wide, with numerous traps and formations, that serves as a place for seclusion and cultivation. Despite its relative lack of space, Luo Feng purchases this as his original residence in Hu Yang City, since his Perfect Divine Body can be whatever size he wants and only he and Morosa were to live there. After purchasing the residence, one receives a talisman that activates the cave's formations.

world.title: Chaos Layer
world.introText: The Chaos Layer (混沌层(Hùndùn céng)) is one of the many layers of space on the Continent of Origin. The Chaos Layer contains endless Chaos Energy. The Chaos Ruins connect the Chaos Layer to the normal living space of cultivators. By using special treasures, such as the Xu Yan Mother Tree Leaf, an Eternal True God can travel freely within the Chaos Layer, allowing them to cultivate there and get closer to understanding the Law of Chaos.
world.appearance:
The Chaos Layer (混沌层(Hùndùn céng)) is one of the many layers of space on the Continent of Origin. The Chaos Layer contains endless Chaos Energy. The Chaos Ruins connect the Chaos Layer to the normal living space of cultivators. By using special treasures, such as the Xu Yan Mother Tree Leaf, an Eternal True God can travel freely within the Chaos Layer, allowing them to cultivate there and get closer to understanding the Law of Chaos.

Most Primal Chaos Sovereigns cannot escape into the Chaos Layer on their own; the simplest way to enter the Chaos Layer is to go upstream through the Chaos Ruins. The Chaos Layer contains randomly manifested Laws of Chaos, such as Gold of Chaos or Fire of Chaos, as well as Chaos Layer Organisms, Special Lifeforms that feed on Chaos Energy. The strongest Chaos Layer Organisms have already been captured alive or use by greater powers. Eternal True Gods who are granted the ability to reach the Chaos Layer are elites cultivated by major forces, with profound accumulation in all aspects. Their strength generally reaches the level of General Yong or Blood Cloud, so they are safe from the remaining Chaos Layer Organisms within the Chaos Layer.

world.title: Chaotic Origin Palace
world.introText: Chaotic Origin Palace (also known as Hunyuan Palace) is an immense and enigmatic complex located within the Dark Holy Realm. It surpasses the size of an entire Yulan City, making it one of the largest structures in the realm. As the central hub for cultivation resources and research, the Chaotic Origin Palace attracts Enlightened Late Stage God Emperors and above, offering unparalleled opportunities for studying Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, exchanging rare bloodlines, and pursuing invincibility.
world.appearance:
Chaotic Origin Palace (also known as Hunyuan Palace) is an immense and enigmatic complex located within the Dark Holy Realm. It surpasses the size of an entire Yulan City, making it one of the largest structures in the realm. As the central hub for cultivation resources and research, the Chaotic Origin Palace attracts Enlightened Late Stage God Emperors and above, offering unparalleled opportunities for studying Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, exchanging rare bloodlines, and pursuing invincibility.

The palace serves as a repository for countless Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses and living prisoners. It houses seven complete World-Class Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses and numerous High-Level Chaotic Origin Lifeforms imprisoned under heavy suppression. These resources make the Chaotic Origin Palace a cornerstone for cultivators seeking to transcend the Caged World and enter the Infinite Chaotic Origin Dimension.

world.title: Chengfeng City

Although it is relatively famous among them, still fall behind Hunyuan City in terms of Treasures, Chaotic Origin Bloodlines, and cultivation caves. But Realm Source Pearls are still commonly circulating around the city, for those in need for replenishing their energy reserves.

There are many Primal Chaos Sovereign realm Alien Beasts imprisoned in the city. As the core of the Emperor Chu Family, there are few cities on the Continent of Origin that are more prosperous. world.appearance:

Chu Capital City contains the residences of the Imperial Family, as well as the family's Guest Officials. The mansions of the First-Class Lords are about 1 billion kilometers long and wide, housing many ethnic groups, personal guards, and servants of the resident lord. The cave residence of the Guest Officials covers over 100 million kilometers and its formation borrows a bit of the city's power, making it incredibly safe.

The city has 3 inspectors, who are all Primal Chaos Sovereign Guest Officials, as well as its own army. The army handles small problems within the city (generally those at the Eternal True God level), while big problems are personally handled by God Kings! Therefore, it is rare that the city inspectors have to actually take action.

The position of inspector can be held for 100 periods at most, at which point they will be replaced. Serving as an inspector pays 100,000 Merits, and is heavily desired. Inspectors must live in the city and ask for leave if they wish to leave the city. They cannot be away for more than 1,000 days in a period.

world.title: Continent of Origin
world.introText:
The Continent of Origin is the origin of the three-thousand-dimensional Universe Oceans. Each Ocean has an Original Universe and a Reincarnation Channel, and the three-thousand-dimensional Ocean is also the foundation of the prosperity of the Origin Continent.
The sky of the Continent of Origin is vast and deep, with stars shining brightly. These stars are actually the Miniature Universes of its residents, with the most terrifying stars being the Miniature Universes of the God Kings. The distance between the sky and ground on the continent is generally about 100 trillion kilometers. The Law of Chaos can be clearly sensed, unlike in the Original Universe, and its environment is suitable for the cultivation of True Gods and stronger beings.
world.appearance:
The Continent of Origin is the origin of the three-thousand-dimensional Universe Oceans. Each Ocean has an Original Universe and a Reincarnation Channel, and the three-thousand-dimensional Ocean is also the foundation of the prosperity of the Origin Continent.
The sky of the Continent of Origin is vast and deep, with stars shining brightly. These stars are actually the Miniature Universes of its residents, with the most terrifying stars being the Miniature Universes of the God Kings. The distance between the sky and ground on the continent is generally about 100 trillion kilometers. The Law of Chaos can be clearly sensed, unlike in the Original Universe, and its environment is suitable for the cultivation of True Gods and stronger beings.

Beings born on the Continent of Origin can usually become True Gods. There are also Alien Beasts that the God Kings allow to occupy most of the territory of the continent. Cultivators from all races kill these beasts and collect their body materials as resources for cultivation. While the beasts can become incredibly powerful due to their bloodline, they are less intelligent than the cultivators. Beasts who reach the God King level are generally kept in captivity by the other God Kings.

Those born on the Continent of Origin have various special bloodlines hiding in their blood, enabling them to follow the Bloodline Cultivation Method to reach the Primal Chaos Sovereign level. Like the Original Universe, the Continent of Origin experiences Reincarnation Eras (currently an undefined length of time, but exceeding billions of Periods), and thus will eventually come to an end and be reborn.
world.history:
The flow of time on the Continent of Origin as compared to the Original Universe or Universe Ocean is 1 to 10,081. One day on the Continent of Origin is equivalent to 1 Earth year, so for every day on the Continent of Origin, 10,081 Earth years (or one Era) pass in the Original Universe/Universe Ocean. The primary time measurement for long ranges is a Period (纪(jì), lit. Century or Period), which is 1 billion days on the continent. The term Reincarnation Era (轮回时代(Lúnhuí shídài)) is also used on the continent, but the actual length of time is unclear.

Space is very stable and the suppression is extremely powerful, limiting the size of Divine Bodies. While the largest body in the Original Universe is about 12 light-years, an Eternal True God with the 3rd level of Divine Body (following the Divine Power Path), who should have an unlimited Divine Body, can only reach a maximum height of 3.6 billion kilometers (over 3 light-hours)! Due to this suppression, True Gods are unable to fly on the continent; only after becoming a Void True God and mastering the void can one fly.
world.trivia: The term equivalent of Origin Continent is Main Multiverse of a Megaverse.

world.title: Corridor Of Records
world.introText: A place which is hidden in an independent and isolated Time-Space. When Luo Feng and Xing Mang travelled to this place, before them stretched a Time-Space corridor, its end marked by a majestic Altar. The Infinite Hunyuan Space transformed into a vastly shrunken "Absolute Sphere," and The Corridor Of Records occupied the exact center of this sphere. From this vantage point, one could observe every region of the Infinite Hunyuan Space.
world.appearance:
A place which is hidden in an independent and isolated Time-Space. When Luo Feng and Xing Mang travelled to this place, before them stretched a Time-Space corridor, its end marked by a majestic Altar. The Infinite Hunyuan Space transformed into a vastly shrunken "Absolute Sphere," and The Corridor Of Records occupied the exact center of this sphere. From this vantage point, one could observe every region of the Infinite Hunyuan Space.

On the wall of the Corridor, they were adorned with intricate carvings depicting scenes from the history of the Infinite Hunyuan Space. There were depictions of the birth of Mo Xu and Chu Shi Hunyuan Ancestor; the roar of the Giant God Emperor; the Infinite Serpent coiling around a World Cluster; Yuan emerging alone from the Origin World. At the end of the corridor, there is a carving of Luo Feng wielding the Blood Shadow Blade on the 34th Layer of the Abyss of Destruction, where the Realm Envoy of that level was paying respectful homage to him. At the end of the corridor stood a majestic altar, shrouded in layers of phantom images that made it difficult to see inside.

A majestic, dimly lit grand hall emanated an aura capable of making the entire Infinite Hunyuan Space tremble. Within the hall, a central throne stood flanked by 108 seats. Upon the central throne sat a towering figure: Luo Feng!  The 108 seats on either side were occupied by various figures, including Mo Xu, Lord Jin, Kafuxiu, the Endless Ancestor, and even Sha Zhou. (This is a possible future which Xing Mang had witnessed many times before)
world.history: ↑ SwS 2 - Volume 12, Chapter 24 - Chapter 449: The Corridor of Eternal Records

world.title: Universe Ocean
world.introText: Universe Ocean (宇宙海, Yǔzhòu Hǎi, lit. "Universe Sea"),  is one of the three-thousand-dimensional cosmic seas. It is connected to the Continent of Origin through the Reincarnation Channel. Boundless in nature, no True God, Supreme Universe Master has ever been able to discover its limits.
world.appearance:
Universe Ocean (宇宙海, Yǔzhòu Hǎi, lit. "Universe Sea"),  is one of the three-thousand-dimensional cosmic seas. It is connected to the Continent of Origin through the Reincarnation Channel. Boundless in nature, no True God, Supreme Universe Master has ever been able to discover its limits.

The Universe Ocean lies beyond the domain/control of the Original Universe, rendering teleportation via the God Country impossible. Flight through Dark Space is also unfeasible. To navigate, one must rely on natural wormholes or teleportation.

Teleportation within the Universe Ocean depends on space ripples:

In areas with stable space ripples, teleportation is freely available and highly effective.

In regions without space ripples, teleportation is completely blocked, forcing travelers to rely  natural wormholes for exploration.

The Universe Ocean is brimming/filled with countless dangers, but it is equally abundant with opportunities, treasures, and legacies waiting to be discovered.
world.trivia: The Lost Sea is a mysterious and unexplored region within the Universe Ocean. Beings who enter it without a known reference risk losing their way indefinitely and may never return.

world.title: Dark World Group
world.introText: The Dark World Group (黑暗世界群) is one of many vast world clusters scattered throughout the Chaotic Origin Dimension, managed under the banner of the Cultivator Camp. Located on the remote fringes of this immense territory, far from the prosperous heartlands of the other Three Thousand Six Hundred World Clusters," the Dark World Group has long been associated with chaos, scarcity, and hardship. Yet, against all odds, it has produced a remarkable 13,922 High Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, an unusually high number for a region considered so underdeveloped. Still, none had ever broken through to the status of World Chaotic Origin Lifeform—until the emergence of Luo Feng.
world.appearance:
The Dark World Group (黑暗世界群) is one of many vast world clusters scattered throughout the Chaotic Origin Dimension, managed under the banner of the Cultivator Camp. Located on the remote fringes of this immense territory, far from the prosperous heartlands of the other Three Thousand Six Hundred World Clusters," the Dark World Group has long been associated with chaos, scarcity, and hardship. Yet, against all odds, it has produced a remarkable 13,922 High Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, an unusually high number for a region considered so underdeveloped. Still, none had ever broken through to the status of World Chaotic Origin Lifeform—until the emergence of Luo Feng.

The group has historically been looked down upon by other regions. Its cultivators were typically assigned to the grueling backbone work of the Cultivator Camp: maintaining cosmic order, patrolling the vast and lawless Infinite Hunyuan Space, guarding sanctified realms, and overseeing legions of subordinate Hunyuan lifeforms. Most progressed slowly through traditional means—extracting strength from their bloodline over countless eras—rather than through the rare, efficient path of insight and comprehension. Only Tian Lang Ke stood out, a proud and aloof figure who shattered the cage (樊笼) not by relying on raw talent alone, but by penetrating over 70% of the mysteries within the High-Level Chaotic Origin Bloodline—a method that made him one of the few with real hope of reaching World-Class status.

Management of the Dark World Group ultimately falls under Overlord Yuan, one of the seven supreme rulers of the Cultivator Camp. Yuan oversees over a hundred such world groups, delegating operational authority to world-class Hunyuan commanders like Zhu Huo, who governs more than 60,000 High-level Hunyuan Lifeforms and 300 million innate Hunyuan beings. Zhuo Huo, known for his composed judgment and trust in merit, approved the unprecedented allegiance shift of 12,882 High-level Hunyuan cultivators to Luo Feng after they witnessed his battle against a powerful molten Hunyuan prisoner. At that time, Luo Feng had not even escaped the cage—yet his potential was undeniable.

Only Tian Lang Ke refused to submit. Convinced that he, not Luo Feng, was destined to lead the group into a new era, he isolated himself to focus on reaching the threshold of world-class transformation. Now, the Dark World Group—once marginalized and burdened with labor—is poised for resurgence. Its fate is entwined with the meteoric rise of Luo Feng and shaped by the silent power struggles between rising stars and ancient overseers, all under the watchful eye of Overlord Yuan.
world.trivia: After Luo Feng became an Overlord this world group became his Absolute territory. When Luo Feng took over this territory, The Dark World Group was then renamed the Milky Way World Group.

world.title: Disambiguation Temple
world.introText: The only birthplace of the Pinnacle Arcana in the Original Universe.
world.appearance: The only birthplace of the Pinnacle Arcana in the Original Universe.
world.history:
In the first 600 Years after the paths to the Original Stars appeared, Various Original Laws befell Original Star Number 02892. The combined power was so overwhelming that at one point in time, it felt as though the entire star had fallen into shackles, and every single one of the Universe Venerable had difficulty moving. At the same time, a temple started to emerge gradually from beneath the ground.

The entire process took close to 100 years, and during this time, various major Races of the Original Universe sent forth their supreme beings to this temple. At one point, this temple was surrounded by many Universe Masters, and only Top Tier Universe Overlords would dare to venture near it. After a period of 100 years, the Disambiguation Temple fully emerged. Before it was erected a Black Stone Tablet. The Stone Tablet had ancient engravings that were easily deciphered. Any great being would understand the moment they laid eyes on them. The content was very simple. It read:

The Birth of Disambiguation Temple. A Stone Tablet appears; the moment the stone tablet disintegrates, on the 10,081 Original Stars, during a certain time and place, a single or many Disambiguation Mirror Stones (歧镜石(qí jìng shí)) will appear at random, There are a total of 36 Disambiguation Mirror Stones and they all resemble Ordinary Stones. During birth, their dynamics are comparable to that of High Arcana. When all 36 have fully emerged, the Disambiguation Temple will open. Those possessing Disambiguation Mirror Stones may enter. Any great beings without stone will be considered trespassing and will be annihilated without exception.

One year later, the stone tablet disintegrated. That was when various rumors started circulating; there were sayings like the Disambiguation Mirror Stones had been born on a certain Original Star. The rumors gave rise to many disputes. However, no one knew the exact time and place where the stones could be. This required a touch of luck. Even if a great being had strong powers, it would still be a challenging feat to obtain a Disambiguation Mirror Stone.

world.introText: The Dong Ji Region is where the original aboriginals of the Continent of Origin survive. world.appearance:
The Dong Ji Region is where the original aboriginals of the Continent of Origin survive. While they lack wisdom and understanding, there are enough of them to form a First-Class Force on the continent, and have the protection of First Ancestor of the Dong Ji Region. It is considered the most remote and desolate region of the continent.

Originally, the aboriginals of the continent occupied the most of the continent, but as time passed, the cultivators from the two Ancient Kingdoms increased in strength and number, and more cultivators passed through the Reincarnation Channel and arrived on the continent. As this continued to happen, the aboriginals' territory was greatly reduced, and they eventually gathered in the Dong Ji Region.

The power of heaven and earth there is much thinner than other areas of the continent, and treasures of heaven and earth are also rare. Despite this, the environment is comfortable and has all kinds of fruits and vegetables. Its inhabitants are all relatively large and sturdy, and use stone sticks, wooden sticks, and other objects as weapons. The Divine Wood found in the Original Universe is an example of their weapons. They worship heaven and earth, and spend their time feeling and comprehending it. Rather than focusing on external things, they focus on themselves and the Great Daos.

Almost 90% of the dragons on the planet die during their youth, failing to reach maturity. Any mature dragon would be at least a Universe Level, and could control a territory.

world.title: Dream Realm
world.introText: Dream Realm is one of the Treasure Lands left behind by Overlord Yuan, and was formed from the corpse of a very special World-Class Chaotic Origin Lifeform. The two Ancient Kingdoms allow their Guest Officials and Imperial Family members enter this treasure land at a cost. Due to its properties, it is impossible to set up a stable formation to guard its entrance, so the ancient kingdoms send God Kings to form a mobile formation, and they work together to prevent others from entering. However, due to it being a mobile formation, other powerful God Kings can force their way in, provided they avoid the areas of the two Ancient Kingdoms. The rare treasures in the entrance area of the Dream Realm belong to the ancient kingdoms due to their collective blockade.
world.appearance:
Dream Realm is one of the Treasure Lands left behind by Overlord Yuan, and was formed from the corpse of a very special World-Class Chaotic Origin Lifeform. The two Ancient Kingdoms allow their Guest Officials and Imperial Family members enter this treasure land at a cost. Due to its properties, it is impossible to set up a stable formation to guard its entrance, so the ancient kingdoms send God Kings to form a mobile formation, and they work together to prevent others from entering. However, due to it being a mobile formation, other powerful God Kings can force their way in, provided they avoid the areas of the two Ancient Kingdoms. The rare treasures in the entrance area of the Dream Realm belong to the ancient kingdoms due to their collective blockade.

The Dream Realm breeds all kinds of strange treasures, however the deeper one travels within the realm, the greater the Willpower impact. If one goes too deep, they may fall into Deep Sleep and may never wake up. It appears to be a gathering of a large number of bubbles, each of which is an independent space with different operating rules, creatures, and treasures. The spaces within the Dream Realm change over time, making past map information useless; field exploration is required every time one visits. There are special creatures who are native to the Dream Realm and attack any lifeform dissimilar to their group. These creatures are unaffected by Willpower or Soul Attacks, making them quite difficult to deal with, and can range in strength from ordinary God King to the limit of power allowed on the Continent of Origin.

The Dream Realm is the most suitable Treasure Land for cultivating the Great Destruction Heart-Refining Method, so Luo Feng accepted the invitation of Gui Xu Emperor to join his team in exploring it. Its special environment has an extremely high amount of energy, which cultivators can absorb to fuel their Divine Body (albeit at a slower rate than that of a Miniature Universe).

world.title: Eternal Land
world.introText: Eternal Land is a very special place within the Infinite Hunyuan Space (无限浑源空间). Here, a landmass was born where time remains forever still relative to the outside world, and the stability of the void is the strongest. Even a single grain of soil in this land is unbearable for higher-level Hunyuan lifeforms. World-class Hunyuan beings who step foot here will be crushed into powder by the gravitational pressure.
world.appearance:
Eternal Land is a very special place within the Infinite Hunyuan Space (无限浑源空间). Here, a landmass was born where time remains forever still relative to the outside world, and the stability of the void is the strongest. Even a single grain of soil in this land is unbearable for higher-level Hunyuan lifeforms. World-class Hunyuan beings who step foot here will be crushed into powder by the gravitational pressure.

Eternal Land is described as one of the three poles of the Chaotic Origin Dimension, alongside Hell Fire Prison Wall and Abyss Of Destruction. Through the perspective of “wave,” Eternal Land plays a fundamental role in maintaining the balance of the entire Chaotic Origin Dimension. It harmonizes the burning heat emitted by the Hell Fire Prison Wall and the devouring negativity of the Abyss of Destruction. Its stabilizing force indirectly influences all Mysterious Lands and countless world clusters, ensuring the long-term survival of weaker lifeforms. Without Eternal Land’s presence, the chaotic energies within the Chaotic Origin Dimension would form frequent energy storms, making it impossible for ordinary life to exist.
world.trivia: In the Lord Xue Ying novel, it is stated that the Eternal Land was the first land to be born in the entire Chaotic Origin Dimension.

world.title: Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom
world.introText: Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom is one of the two Ancient Kingdoms (along with the Thunder Ancient Kingdom) on the Continent of Origin. As an Ancient Kingdom, it is recognized as one of the two kingdoms with the longest history, deepest foundation, and greatest strength.
world.appearance:
Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom is one of the two Ancient Kingdoms (along with the Thunder Ancient Kingdom) on the Continent of Origin. As an Ancient Kingdom, it is recognized as one of the two kingdoms with the longest history, deepest foundation, and greatest strength.

Upon arrival in the Continent of Origin, Ancestor Yuan met a tribe from this kingdom and stayed there. Luo Feng eventually became a guest official of this kingdom through Di Chu Yu.
world.history:
The founder of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom is First Ancestor Flame Wind, an Enlightened Late Stage God Emperor who has survived at least 1 reincarnation era of the Continent of Origin. He uses the Emperors of the kingdom to accumulate treasures that will aid him in his cultivation or increase his strength. He encourages competition among the First Level God Kings and First-Class Lords for precious resources, while he dispenses those resources to the Emperors and Second Level God Kings according to their status. However, despite this dispensing of resources, Emperors can fall into debt with the kingdom, requiring them to accumulate merits and treasures to repay him.

Emperor (帝君(Dìjūn)) is a title currently held by 13 cultivators in the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. All 13 emperors are Third Level God King lifeforms, but only Emperor Qing has comprehended a Complete Great Dao, with the others using external resources in addition to their comprehension to reach that level. The emperors rotate the position of Current Era Emperor (it has not been revealed how long an era is in this sense; the term used is 时代(Shídài), same as used in Reincarnation Era, rather than 纪元(Jìyuán), which is used in Era). It is implied that the other emperors must vote or otherwise give their approval to choose the Current Era Emperor.

Each emperor is incredibly powerful, and their families, direct disciples, and Guest Officials are considered part of their Imperial Family.

Luo Feng forced Emperor Yuan to reincarnate after the he was lured out by Luo Feng disguised in a black robe and golden mask, who was hunting down the top 10 sinners who devoured countless lifeforms for their personal cultivation. As Emperor Yuan's debts to the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom were too high, he is unable to regain his former status and has to lay low to avoid being hunted down by Luo Feng.

Emperor Wu and Emperor Xi were killed by First Ancestor Flame Wind due to their grudges with Luo Feng. The death of the 2 Emperors and the reincarnation of Emperor Yuan resulted in only 10 Emperors left within the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom.

Emperor Wu Second

The core of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom is the 13 branches of the imperial family, and include Guest Officials and direct disciples of the Emperors. There are other royal families led by God Kings, but they are much weaker than the 13 imperial families. Unless they have a Transcendent Chaos Realm, families led by a Primal Chaos Sovereign are considered very mediocre and cannot get involved with the circles of imperial and royal families. The Emperors control the resources available to their lineages, and they send 99% of the family into Miniature Universes, which they can only escape by cultivating to Eternal True God. In this way, they save resources and pressure the members of the imperial family so they do not dare to slack off.

Primal Chaos Sovereigns of the Imperial Families who have either become Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereigns or have an Infinite Divine Body are considered First-Class Lords. First-Class Lords receive a first-class official residence, a personal army, a first-class Large City as their fiefdom, and a quota to apply for two Guest Officials. Additionally, they directly compete with each other for incredibly valuable resources; they are considered absolute elites who are the focus of the imperial families.

Top Primal Chaos Sovereigns are considered Second-Class Lords and receive many more resources than Third-Class Lords, but cannot access the real core resources of the Continent of Origin.

Ordinary Primal Chaos Sovereigns are considered Third-Class Lords and receive a small city, a small cave residence, and a few personal guards.

Guest Officials (客卿(Kèqīng)) are Primal Chaos Sovereigns and God Kings who have been invited by high-ranking members of the Imperial Families of the Ancient Kingdoms. Cultivators can chosen to be Guest Officials for any number of reasons; Tian Kun was chosen due to his cooking skills, while Luo Feng was chosen due to his just heart and defense of the weak. Ordinary Primal Chaos Sovereigns and God Kings are not typically chosen to be Guest Officials.

Guest Officials are a primary resource used in the competition between First-Class Lords, and contribute to their lord's strength. While they are initially invited by one cultivator, if they are sought by a different cultivator, they can choose to defect, albeit with probable consequences. The Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom does not care about the conflicts between Guest Officials, and in fact seem to encourage them to a degree.

The direct disciples of Emperors of the ancient kingdom are highly-valued members of the Imperial Families, granted valuable resources and authority. They are even able to choose special missions before First-Class Lords have a chance to view them, and they have higher authority to receive Merits, being able to submit tasks to the spirit of the Emperor's palace. They receive preferential treatment from the Flame Wind Guild Hall, able to sell and purchase at fair prices.

Luo Feng, Hansen Kingdom Master, Silver Moon God King, Sea Devil God King, Tian Yi God King, and Honorable Master Dark Sky battled over the territory, with Luo Feng emerging victorious.

The entire territory of the Food Kingdom was annexed by Luo Feng and comprises the majority of the territory managed by the Blade River Sect.

world.title: Fu Zhen Chaos State
world.introText: Fu Zhen Chaos State is one of the Chaos States within the territory of the Yu Kingdom and serves as the domain governed by the Fu Zhen. Marquis. Centered around its capital, Fu Zhen City, the region has long enjoyed stability under the Marquis’s rule. During the Food Kingdom’s invasion, it became one of the front-line states and was directly targeted by enemy forces. Due to its strategic location along the shared border between the two kingdoms, the Chaos State was among the first to face a large-scale incursion, including the arrival of Eternal True Gods armies and multiple Primal Chaos Sovereign Realm experts. Its attempted defense and the Marquis’s determination to protect it despite overwhelming odds significantly illustrates the vulnerability of Yu Kingdom’s outer Chaos States during the early stage of the war.

world.title: Ganwu Dojo
world.introText: The Ganwu Dojo is the official school for Warriors and Spirit Masters from the Ganwu Universe Country, and thus absorbs an incredibly large number of warriors and spirit masters. It was founded by Lord of Ganwu. While they allow great beings to teach their own disciples on their own Planet, the Ganwu Universe Country restricts any other large-scale dojo (spreading across planets, star systems, galaxies, starfields, etc.) from existing within its territory. There are Ganwu Dojos in every galaxy in the Ganwu Universe Country, so joining one links you with a large community. As a member gets stronger, their background becomes stronger as well, since the Ganwu Universe Country's community will support them.
world.appearance:
The Ganwu Dojo is the official school for Warriors and Spirit Masters from the Ganwu Universe Country, and thus absorbs an incredibly large number of warriors and spirit masters. It was founded by Lord of Ganwu. While they allow great beings to teach their own disciples on their own Planet, the Ganwu Universe Country restricts any other large-scale dojo (spreading across planets, star systems, galaxies, starfields, etc.) from existing within its territory. There are Ganwu Dojos in every galaxy in the Ganwu Universe Country, so joining one links you with a large community. As a member gets stronger, their background becomes stronger as well, since the Ganwu Universe Country's community will support them.

Normally, there are 3 Universe Level teachers at a planet's Ganwu Dojo, and on more important planets, the teachers may be even stronger or more numerous. As an important pathway for attracting a large number of cultivators, as long as one is at least Planetary Level and a citizen of the Ganwu Universe Country, registration is easy, lacking any test, etc. It cost 800 Black Dragon Coins to register to join the dojo as a Black Dragon Mountain Empire citizen, and an annual fee of 10 Black Dragon Coins to continue receiving their services. It would be more troublesome for someone who is not a citizen of the Ganwu Universe Country to join the Ganwu Dojo. The Ganwu Dojo does not place many restrictions on its members; for examples, members can join the Virtual Universe Company.
world.history:
The Ganwu Dojo has a hierarchy for its members.

Planetary Levels are normal students.

Stellar Levels are elite students, eligible to be hired as instructors. On some ordinary Planets, they may run the dojo.

Universe Levels are deemed 1 Leaf Ganwu Warriors.

Domain Masters are deemed 2 Leaf Ganwu Warriors.

World Masters are deemed 3 Leaf Ganwu Warriors.

The number of Immortals within the Ganwu Universe Country exceeds 10,000, the number of World Masters exceeds 1 million, and the number of Universe Levels exceeds 1 billion! Just the number of Stellar Levels confident enough to compete in the Pinnacle Genius Battle exceeded 822.5 billion!

world.title: God Country
world.introText: When a World Master breaks through to Immortal, they fuse their Internal World with space fragments to transform it into a God Country, the lifeblood of an Immortal. It has a similar purpose to the Internal World of a World Master, but while World Masters will definitely die if their Internal World collapses, only the weaker Immortals would die if their God Country collapsed. However, even those that survive would have their powers greatly reduced, to the point here they would have no future; a God Country could be considered half of an Immortal's life! God Countries are integral to the strength of an Immortal, and as they get stronger, their God Countries also increase in strength. While within their God Country, an Immortal can exert even greater power, but it is dangerous to bring an enemy into one's God Country, as it gives them a chance to attack it.

God Countries are incredibly large; even the God Country of an ordinary Immortal like Black Dragon Immortal was capable of fitting a mountain range that exceeded 100,000 kilometers in height! Luo Feng's God Country was over 1 trillion kilometers in length, width, and height, rivaling many Universe Venerables!

God Countries also serve as the home of countless Humans. Most humans in the Original Universe actually live in God Countries, however, these humans have extremely limited potential due to the lack of Universe Energy within a God Country. Thus, the vast majority of humans within God Countries can only reach World Master. In the entire history of humanity, there have been 9,082 Immortals born in God Countries, but they all had miraculous encounters, without which they never would have broken through to Immortal.
world.history:
The location of a God Country is dependent on the owner of the God Country, owners can build their God Countries anywhere in the Original Universe. Most of the time creators build their God Countries in their home Universe Country so that they can easily teleport to their Universe Country through God Country from anywhere in the Original Universe. God Country is built in the Space Slit, these slits are divided into tens of thousands of layers:

The first layer is the fragments.

The second layer is the God Country layer.

The third layer is the Space Current/Space Flood.

The space layers are terrifying space. The fragment layer was very close to the Origin Space, and its threat was small, World Masters normally could withstand this layer, The God Country level is more steady, and Immortals could normally survive within. The fragments in the God Country layer are much bigger, some have diameters of tens of thousands of km, some have 100 million km, etc. Even the powerful Immortals could die within the Space Current Layer, the deeper one went, the higher the threat is.

Near Wu Qi Tower is a three-story silver ancient palace, also guarded by a group of True Gods, which is the power center of God King Valley. On the third floor of the palace were four gigantic thrones, one for each of the Four Commanders of God King Valley. The Four Commanders were entrusted with the task of finding a talent who could reach the top of Wu Qi Tower, and they have spent an immeasurably long time attempting to do so. Since the Four Commanders did not have many responsibilities, they would usually assign one commander to preside over God King Valley and oversee all general matters of God King Realm Continent. When unique circumstances arose, the other three commanders would be summoned.

The typical traffic in God King Valley was those soldiers attempting to take the title-sealing task.
