world.history:
The Hell Fire Prison Wall is infamous for being virtually unapproachable. Over 99% of all Primogenitors who make contact with the wall are instantly incinerated into ash. Even elite Overlord like Wulan, who once ventured into the wall, suffered severe injuries and had to retreat, never attempting it again. To date, only The Original Ancestor (Chushi shizu) has successfully crossed the entire wall.

The Hell Fire Prison Wall is home to numerous terrifying flame powers. During one recent exploration, four highest-level types of flame were identified:

Ice Cold Flame: Freezes even Primogenitors.

Blazing Flame: Burns everything to cinders.

Thunder Flame: Annihilates through violent lightning.

Ash Flame: Erases all matter into nothingness.

In addition to these, there are other rare and violent flame variants like Violent Period Flame, which only the original Ancestor could endure while crossing the wall. It is speculated that if the Origin(本源, běnyuán) of the Hell Fire Prison Wall exists, it would contain at least twelve top-tier elemental flame powers. To refine and control it, one would need to master at least half of these supreme powers, which is considered virtually impossible.

Even the Yan Huo Ancestor, one of the top fire users and currently one of the Nine Sovereigns of Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction, admitted that despite traversing the wall entirely, he couldn’t even sense its Origin. Hence, among the strongest realms in the Chaotic Origin Dimension like Eternal Land, Abyss of Destruction and Hell Fire Prison Wall is considered unrefinable.

in this city, Hong lives and the Elite Training Camp is located...

in Hong Ning City, there is located the Nine Grand Floors, the best training ground of the "Warriors" in the world ...

Luo Feng and Ya Xia were looking out the window and were amazed. The entire headquarter city was extremely beautiful and the buildings were all based off of ancient China: pavillons could be seen everywhere.

“During the Grand Nirvana period, the head brought a bunch of people to this place and created a simple human base, allowing many people to escape here. As time flowed, this Hong Ning headquarter city grew bigger and bigger!” smiled Yang Hui, “Our Hong Nin headquarter city is located at western Asia, close to Europe. Because our head is here, this is the safest headquarter city in the entire world!”

“Many rich people and fighters come to our headquarter city every year. However, the head always controls the population of the headquarter city. As of now, the population of the entire headquarter city is only around eight million” smiled Yang Hui, “If the head didn’t regulate the population, it’ll be normal for it to reach a value of 200 to 300 million. However, quality over quantity! Our Hong Nin headquarter city has the highest fighter birth rate in the entire world! As of now, there has never been an emperor monster that dared to mess around at our Hong Ning headquarter city” said Yang Hui confidently.

Luo Feng and Ya Xia’s eyes were filled with astonishment.

The entire world has five great countries and 23 headquarter cities! And Hong controls a headquarter city and the Dojo of Limits. Add his own virtually invincible strength to the equation….. ‘Hong’ is indisputably the most powerful man on earth! #1 in strength and #1 in authority!

world.quotes:
His destination this time lay 320,000 light years away from Earth—a bustling and formidable planet known as the Dragon Star! This super planet teemed with life, surpassing the vigor of the Silverblue Empire by hundreds and thousands of times. It served as a gathering place for warriors and was frequented by the universe's elite, offering a safer environment with fewer instances of brutality and uncivilized behavior.

world.title: Hu Yang City
world.introText: Hu Yang City is a Large City located in Jiu Jiang Chaos State. It is close to the border of the Yu Kingdom, so neighboring kingdoms also have branches there. Trade is most developed in this city of the 3 large cities, and weaker beings also live there. The city is defended by the Hu Yang Guard and the ten major Hu Yang Legions, each commanded by an Eternal True God and controlling a legion-type Mechanical Treasure capable of using part of the power of a Primal Chaos Sovereign. It costs 1 Chaos Crystal for True Gods to live there for a period, while Void True Gods and Eternal True Gods can live there for free.

The official forces of Hu Yang City are the City Lord's Mansion, the Hu Yang Guard, and the ten major legions. They are mainly controlled by the Five Major Families of the city, with the Moli Family being the top family. There are also nineteen Dark Forces that are also paid housing fees by the residents of the city.

After meeting Moyu Hu, Luo Feng decides to stay in Hu Yang City while he trains to increase his strength.

Lord Liu Yin, seeking to annex Hu Yang City, sent the Heart Shadow Sect to take it over and force Lord Jiu Jiang to either fight him directly or give up the city. Luo Feng initially defended the city as an Eternal True God, then as a Primal Chaos Sovereign, and was granted Hu Yang City for his ownership. After control of the city was relinquished to Luo Feng, Yu Shui Kingdom Master recalled his leadership structure from the city, including the leaders of the Five Major Families.

Under Luo Feng, the Hu Yang Legion was eventually disbanded, and the deputy city lords were Moli Meng and Moyu Hu. He also rid the city of the Dark Forces, helping ordinary businesses flourish. After the battle over the city, its population was around 500 billion. As a result, the city would earn about 50 million Universe Sands in living fees each Period, while the Chaos Ruins would earn about 6 million Universe Sands. This meant that Luo Feng would earn about 30 million Universe Sands every Period from owning the city!

world.title: Hundred Mist Lake
world.introText: Hundred Mist Lake is an extremely vast lake located within the Treasure Land called "Infinite Space." Its name comes from the thick, endless mist that constantly drifts across its surface.
world.appearance:
Hundred Mist Lake is an extremely vast lake located within the Treasure Land called "Infinite Space." Its name comes from the thick, endless mist that constantly drifts across its surface.

This lake was once a highly populated area for native creatures, with hundreds living there in its early days. However, it was later monopolized by powerful cultivators, including the monarch of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom, which led to a significant decrease in the number of native creatures.

As of the current timeline, there are only a handful of native creatures left in the entire lake. Due to the scarcity of these creatures and the sheer size of the area, major powers no longer consider it valuable. This makes it an ideal location for a lone cultivator like Luo Feng to settle and cultivate.

world.title: Infinite Space
world.introText: Infinite Space is the lowest-value Treasure Land accessible by the Thunder Ancient Kingdom and Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. Its value assessment is not due to its rewards, but due to the high difficulty in earning the Reward Points necessary to redeem the rewards. Even a Primal Chaos Sovereign with Ultimate God King-level Willpower would only earn 10,000 Reward Points for doing so!
world.appearance:
Infinite Space is the lowest-value Treasure Land accessible by the Thunder Ancient Kingdom and Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. Its value assessment is not due to its rewards, but due to the high difficulty in earning the Reward Points necessary to redeem the rewards. Even a Primal Chaos Sovereign with Ultimate God King-level Willpower would only earn 10,000 Reward Points for doing so!

As a Treasure Land, it was left behind by Yuan and has numerous inheritances and opportunities, with treasures and inheritances that are unavailable in the outside world. Luo Feng acquired access to Infinite Space through negotiations with the Thunder Ancient Kingdom. It is extremely rare for Primal Chaos Sovereigns to earn access to Infinite Space.

Infinite Space can only be accessed by those with a one-time use silver token, which a God King Guest Official can acquire for 50 million merits, while a God King of the Imperial Family can acquire one for 5 million merits. These tokens also appear randomly on the Continent of Origin, so the powers with the most territory have an easier time obtaining them. Using the token, the owner's mind is transported to Infinite Space, where they are provided with an ordinary God King-level physical body.

The various top powers and ancient beings of the Continent of Origin each occupy areas within Infinite Space, and vigilantly guard their areas.

Infinite Space is a special location. Since everyone is provided with an ordinary God King-level body, they lose special abilities that are tied to their body's strengths rather than comprehension, such as Intangible and Formless. Yuan also sealed off a total of 19 Great Daos from Infinite Space, including the 9 Great Daos of the Caged World of Swallowed Star, so they cannot use any of those mysteries. Visitors can use the Law of Chaos and can use their comprehension to open new Great Daos, which they could also use once opened. In the information given to Luo Feng by Emperor Chu, there was no record of anyone reaching Second Level God King in their self-created Great Dao.

Infinite Space has three methods of testing visitors: 1. Willpower strength, 2. Ability to open a new Great Dao, and 3. Ability to kill the native creatures of Infinite Space on one's own.

By gaining achievements in these three methods, one can get Reward Points, which can be used to exchange for resources in Infinite Space, including inheritances, weapons, secret treasures, and cultivation resources. As a space left by Yuan, these are incredible resources!

When a visitor begins to test themselves in one of these three methods, they are called a Trialist (试炼者(Shì liàn zhě)) and are assessed in each of the three methods. Depending on their achievements, they are rewarded points, and they can view information on resources with a cost not exceeding their current points.

Depending on the cultivation realm of the Trialist, they will receive differing amounts of Reward Points for reaching certain thresholds of Willpower. A Primal Chaos Sovereign will earn 100 points for reaching Second Level God King willpower and 10,000 for reaching Ultimate God King willpower, while a First Level God King will earn 1,000 points for reaching Ultimate God King willpower. Surpassing God King willpower before fully comprehending a Complete Great Dao will earn 100,000 points; Luo Feng posits that for those who have fully comprehended a Complete Great Dao, they would only earn 10,000 points. They will also be reminded that it is forbidden to kill any of the spiritual creatures in Infinite Space; doing so will result in one being completely expelled from Infinite Space. If a Trialist's willpower jumps out of the cage before they themselves jump out of the cage, they earn 200,000 points.

When a Trialist performs a God King Technique of a newly created Great Dao, they earn 100 Reward Points. When they successfully realize a Major Branch of their Great Dao, they earn 10,000 Reward Points. By successfully reaching Second Level God King in their created Great Dao, they earn 100,000 points. By successfully reaching Ultimate God King in their created Great Dao, thus creating a Complete Great Dao, they earn 200,000 points. They are also reminded that if their Willpower can jump out of the cage before they actually jump out of the cage, they will receive the highest reward for Willpower. If a Trialist reaches Perfect God Emperor in a fusion Dao, they earn 10 million points! This is because the cultivator camp assumes that those who reach Perfect God Emperor in a fusion Dao can become World-Class Hunyuan Lifeforms, so they provide those talents with as many resources as possible to get there.

The first time a Trialist forces a native creature to disappear, they will earn 1 Reward Point. Each subsequent time will earn fewer points; when Luo Feng kills one for the thousandth time, he earns 0.001 Reward Point.

world.history:
The Killing Fields is a training location that one can access on any island in the Virtual Universe. The only location seen in Swallowed Star is on Black Dragon Mountain Island.

Since it is owned by the Virtual Universe Company, the Killing Fields are very versatile, allowing a cultivator to completely customize any opponent or combat situation, including group battles, one-on-one, battling against much higher-leveled opponents, or fighting extremely rare opponents like a Space Beast. However, this is not the true benefit of the Killing Fields. With the ability to customize any opponent, one can face oneself, just with more combat experience and with better comprehension of one's combat techniques! This essentially gives the effect of a teacher, which contributes to the high cost. Many powerful beings in the Original Universe use the Killing Fields in this manner, absorbing experience and increasing their technique comprehension.

The Killing Fields can be divided into three main areas; the Lobby, the Slaughter Space, and the Battle Space.

world.title: Life Sacred World
world.introText: The Life Sacred World, or Life Holy Realm, is a type of Sacred World created by Luo Feng. These realms are based on Luo Feng's profound mastery of the Hunyuan Life and Death Dao. The creation of a Life Sacred World is a deliberate and specialized process. Unlike forging a Lord's True Body, the focus is not on mobility or combat capabilities. Instead, the primary goal is to maximize the efficiency of absorbing Chaotic Origin Power and maintaining long-term stability. Due to this specialized design, each Life Sacred World can achieve energy absorption efficiency comparable to that of a Primogenitor or a Lord's True Body.
world.appearance:
The Life Sacred World, or Life Holy Realm, is a type of Sacred World created by Luo Feng. These realms are based on Luo Feng's profound mastery of the Hunyuan Life and Death Dao. The creation of a Life Sacred World is a deliberate and specialized process. Unlike forging a Lord's True Body, the focus is not on mobility or combat capabilities. Instead, the primary goal is to maximize the efficiency of absorbing Chaotic Origin Power and maintaining long-term stability. Due to this specialized design, each Life Sacred World can achieve energy absorption efficiency comparable to that of a Primogenitor or a Lord's True Body.

A Life Sacred World is a superior type of Sacred World compared to those based on the Hunyuan Blade Dao. A Blade Dao Sacred World would be smaller, less efficient, and create a harsher environment for life. In contrast, the Life Sacred World is vast in scale, boasting an energy absorption efficiency approximately three hundred times greater than its Blade Dao counterpart. These Worlds are designed to be hospitable environments where life can flourish and multiply. Luo Feng created numerous Life Sacred Worlds to serve as Time-Space Anchor Points for the Cultivator Camp's vast time-space network. The life forms born within these Worlds can cultivate to the World Chaotic Origin Lifeform stage, but thus far, no Overlord has ever emerged from one. This makes them a fertile ground for the growth of a new generation of Cultivators and a testament to Luo Feng's mastery of the Life Dao.

world.title: Milky Way Holy Land

As a Universe Master, he had 3 Universe Venerable subordinates: Lord of Ganwu, Venerable Niu Zhou, and Venerable North Larva. He also received many Immortal and World Master subordinates, arranged by the Virtual Universe Company, to serve his needs. These divine palaces and his subordinates were all stationed in the area known as Milky Way Holy Land.
world.appearance:
Milky Way Holy Land is the dwelling place of Luo Feng, located in the Milky Way Galaxy. To the enemies of the Human Race, it was known as the Milky Way Devil's Nest. After he became known as the Universe Master Milky Way Seigneur, Luo Feng had a number of palaces 10 million kilometers tall known as his divine palaces. As a Universe Master, he had 3 Universe Venerable subordinates: Lord of Ganwu, Venerable Niu Zhou, and Venerable North Larva. He also received many Immortal and World Master subordinates, arranged by the Virtual Universe Company, to serve his needs. These divine palaces and his subordinates were all stationed in the area known as Milky Way Holy Land.

As Luo Feng increased in strength, so did the Milky Way Holy Land; by the time of the Sector Beast War, it had 6 True Gods and over 100 Universe Masters! While it initially was only the home of Luo Feng and his subordinates, it came to house others, such as Hong and Fire Dome. After the Human Race Survival War, his Remote Ocean was also moved here.

Milky Way Holy Land remained in the Original Universe, located in the Milky Way, and after Luo Feng broke through to True God, he constructed 3 portals in the Milky Way Holy Land to connect to his newly created Miniature Universe, leaving his Universe Venerable subordinates in charge of everything in Milky Way Holy Land.

This location is not to be confused with Milky Way Holy Land Universe, Luo Feng's evolved Miniature Universe after he broke through to Void True God.

world.title: Milky Way Holy Land Universe
world.introText: When Luo Feng breaks through to Eternal True God, his Miniature Universe expands to 100 billion light-years in diameter, becoming the Milky Way Holy Land Universe. While both this Holy Land and Original Ancestor Holy Land Universe allow the Human Race and their affiliated races in the Hongmeng to transcend the reincarnation cycle, his Miniature Universe reached the level in which it can easily be partitioned off to allow Universe Masters to break through to True God.
world.appearance:

world.title: Milky Way Sacred World

Only those who have reached the Enlightened Late Stage God Emperor level are eligible to enter this realm. It serves as both a proving ground and a paradise for top tier cultivators inside the cage where immense opportunities coexist with extreme perils.
world.appearance:
Milky Way Sacred World - previously known as Dark Holy Realm - is the supreme cultivation world among all Sacred Worlds in Dark World Cluster, revered especially by Late Stage God Emperors and above. Only those who have reached the Enlightened Late Stage God Emperor level are eligible to enter this realm. It serves as both a proving ground and a paradise for top tier cultivators inside the cage where immense opportunities coexist with extreme perils.

In terms of danger, the Dark Holy Realm far surpasses the notorious Nine Rivers Holy World. Resources considered precious in the Nine Rivers Holy World such as Super-Limit Bloodline are so common here that they are barely noteworthy. Only the rare and potent High-Grade and World-Grade Bloodlines garner attention among the realm's elite residents.

A central feature of the realm is the Chaotic Palace a mysterious and expansive complex that imprisons High-Level Chaotic Origin Lifeforms some of which remain alive under heavy suppression Through accumulated battle merits cultivators can exchange for a living prisoner a fully sealed High level Chaotic Origin Lifeform offering a rare opportunity to study experiment with or extract powerful bloodlines from these ancient beings. Historical records indicate that only eleven individuals have successfully exchanged for a World Class Chaotic Origin Bloodline placing them at the pinnacle of cultivation potential

Beyond combat and research, the Dark Holy Realm offers numerous opportunities for transcendence.  Legendary cultivation treasures, lost inheritances, and rare resources circulate exclusively among the powerful here. This realm is where the dream of jumping out of the cage and stepping into the Infinite Chaotic Origin Dimension becomes attainable.

Achieving true invincibility in the Dark Holy Realm is a legendary feat. Recognized paths to such heights include:

Reach the Willpower of a High Chaotic Origin Lifeform

Understanding some secrets from rare World-Class Chaotic Origin Bloodlines

Fusing at least 2 Daos and reach Perfect God Emperor Stage, resulting with the highest potential ceiling.
world.trivia:
After Luo Feng took over this territory, the former "Dark Holy Realm" was renamed as "Milky Way Sacred World".

This sacred realm became Luo Feng's main base and headquarters in the Chaotic Origin Dimension after he became an Overlord.

The Dark Holy Realm is a particularly powerful Holy Realm, containing around 1,000 Peak God Emperors. Only 1 existed in the final Holy Realm in which Xue Ying cultivated: Fengyun Yiye.

world.title: Milky Way Territory
world.introText: The Blood Crane Territory (now recognized as Milky Way Territory) is a remote Mysterious Land in the Chaotic Origin Dimension, far from the Practitioner’s Domain, requiring over a hundred days of travel to reach. It is one of the lesser-known mysterious lands, less famous than the renowned Eternal Land, and has only given birth to three Primogenitor-level beings, giving it a quieter reputation.
world.appearance:
The Blood Crane Territory (now recognized as Milky Way Territory) is a remote Mysterious Land in the Chaotic Origin Dimension, far from the Practitioner’s Domain, requiring over a hundred days of travel to reach. It is one of the lesser-known mysterious lands, less famous than the renowned Eternal Land, and has only given birth to three Primogenitor-level beings, giving it a quieter reputation.

The heart of the Blood Crane Territory is its vast, endless sea of blood, a boundless expanse that pulses with life and flows slowly, radiating an intense sense of threat. Within this blood sea lurk countless creatures, all silently watching outsiders. This sea is not a mere natural feature, but a powerful entity formed from the perfect fusion of three Highest-Level Powers: Life, Immortality, and Shadow. These powers align with the three major clan lineages of the territory, led by the Blood Lord (Xue Lingzhu), the Crane Lord (He Lingzhu), and the Shadow Lord (Ying Lingzhu).

The blood sea is exceptionally potent, embodying the qualities of Life, Immortality, and Shadow, which make it incredibly resilient and omnipresent. The Shadow trait, in particular, allows it to exist everywhere, enhancing its dominance over the environment. This fusion of three supreme powers gives the blood sea a survival capability that surpasses its tier. If a being could master all three powers, their ability to endure might exceed even the Primordial Origin, a defensive pinnacle that can still be trapped, whereas the Blood Crane Territory’s Shadow-infused blood sea resists containment.

The environment of the Blood Crane Territory is oppressive to outsiders, with the blood sea exerting immense pressure on intruders. However, those skilled in Life-based techniques can partially influence its power, reducing its ability to obstruct. The territory is home to a vast population, including over 500 World Chaotic Origin Lifeform and more than 30 billion High Chaotic Origin Lifeform, all born from the blood sea. These creatures avoid confronting powerful outsiders, recognizing their inferiority.

The blood sea is a living, dynamic force tied to the territory’s core origin, serving as the homeland for its inhabitants, particularly the Shadow Lord, who can harness its power to double their strength within this environment. The Blood Lord and Crane Lord, along with the Shadow Lord, form the ruling trio of Primogenitor-level beings, each tied to one of the Highest-Level Powers. The Blood Crane Territory’s blood sea, with its unique properties, makes it a place of danger and mystery, holding secrets and powers distinct within the Chaotic Origin Dimension.

world.title: Mingyu World Cluster
world.introText: The Mingyu World Cluster is a key region within the Cultivator Territory, serving as the absolute territory of Lord Ming Huang, a Cultivator Lord. This cluster operates strictly under her will, maintaining a pure and orderly environment where sin cannot exist. At the heart of the Mingyu World cluster lies the Ming Huang Holy/Sacred Land, a revered sanctuary where only elite Cultivators may gather. Entry is not granted lightly one must either possess great power or high moral merit. However, if a person is burdened by sin, they will be judged harshly and barred from Lord Ming Huang’s teachings, regardless of strength. The Mingyu World cluster is also the site of high level judgment and punishment, including executions carried out directly by World Chaotic Origin Lifeform if warranted. The Mingyu World Cluster is illuminated by endless thunder, symbolizing her authority and the sanctity of her domain, where harmony prevails under her strict rules.

world.title: Mysterious Land
world.introText: A Mysterious Land is a rare and extraordinary location within the Chaotic Origin Dimension, imbued with immense power and significance. These lands are unique because they naturally integrate multiple Highest-Level Powers, making them very complex and difficult to refine. Only beings of exceptional strength, like Overlords or Primogenitors, can attempt to refine a Mysterious Land, a process that involves understanding and harmonizing with its core essence or origin, successfully refining a Mysterious Land. It allows its controller to harness its inherent powers, significantly enhancing their strength, particularly within the land’s boundaries. This can manifest as increased defensive capabilities, amplified energy reserves, or specialized abilities tied to the land’s unique powers. For instance, the Blood Crane Territory, a Mysterious Land, grants its rulers Blood Lord, Crane Lord, and Shadow Lord formidable defensive advantages when within its domain, making them far more challenging to defeat. Similarly, the Time Star, another Mysterious Land, is indestructible and drifts across time, offering its controller, Xing Mang, enhanced protective abilities. Mysterious Lands are highly coveted due to their rarity and the strategic edge they provide, but their complexity means that even Overlords struggle to find one compatible with their own powers. Among the eight lords of the Cultivator Camp, only Yuan, Xing Mang and Luo Feng have successfully refined a Mysterious Land.

Even Universe Masters may not be able to escape its dangers! The Original Universe is fair; the dangers of the Nine Remoteness Space are offset by the presence of numerous precious treasures, which drew heirs who were unable to make breakthroughs in comprehension. At the center of this world stands a towering sacred mountain. At the mountain's base lies a deep and dark abyss. The sacred mountain guards two teleportation passages: one at its base, leading back to the Continent of Origin, and another at its summit, accessible only by Late Stage God Emperor and above, which leads to the Dark Holy RealmHowever, This world was partially conflicts with some great dao practiced in one's body like the Great Dao of the Space Origin so it required them to dispose of the incompatible parts and then rebuild their bodies.

The nine rivers that encircle the world are both awe-inspiring and terrifying. They are energy hubs of the world, drawing immense Chaotic Origin power from the outside. With the high energy concentration within these rivers, it allow them as perfect habitat for Low-Level Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. These creatures thrive in the rivers, absorbing the abundant energy to sustain themselves. However, they are not just passive inhabitants, they are also hunters, making the rivers one of the most dangerous places in the world.

The space within this world is incredibly stable. Even the Ultimate God King couldn't fly, and those with the Great Dao of the Space Origin who reaches Half-Chaotic Origin Level could only achieve extremely short-distance space travel.

world.title: Origin Land
world.introText: The Origin Land is a highly secretive and paramount sanctuary within the Infinite Chaos Space, serving as the ultimate stronghold and core strategic base for the Cultivator Alliance. It is a place of immense importance and the last hope for cultivators in their desperate war against the dominant and numerically superior Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
world.appearance:
The Origin Land is a highly secretive and paramount sanctuary within the Infinite Chaos Space, serving as the ultimate stronghold and core strategic base for the Cultivator Alliance. It is a place of immense importance and the last hope for cultivators in their desperate war against the dominant and numerically superior Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.

Originally, the Origin Land was a mysterious land naturally born from the Chaotic Origin Dimension itself, characterized by an exceptionally rich and dense energy concentration. Over an immense span of time, it was discovered and subsequently refined and fortified by several of the most powerful beings in the Cultivator Alliance, the Overlords.

Its current, highly concealed location was orchestrated by the Xing Mang, who renowned for his unparalleled mastery over time and space within the Infinite Chaos Space. This strategic relocation has rendered the Origin Land virtually undetectable by the Born-Chaos Lifeforms, even with their extensive efforts.

The Origin Land is described as a vast, serene, and incredibly prosperous territory. Its most distinguishing feature is an energy density far exceeding any other known cultivation spot, including even the highest-tier cultivation cave dwellings in the Chaos Halls. This extreme energy concentration is so profound that it manifests physically, forming the very soil, rocks, and plant life of the land, and even contributing to its flowing liquid water.

The Origin Land serves multiple critical functions for the Cultivator Alliance:

Sanctuary for Powerhouses: It is the primary residence for all of the Cultivator Alliance's true powerhouses, including:
Over 80 million High-level Hunyuan Cultivators

237 World-level Hunyuan Cultivators

Every cultivator who has "broken through the cage" (a significant milestone in their cultivation journey) maintains a clone here, ensuring their continued existence even if their main body perishes in the ongoing war.

Cultivation Hub: The immense energy density makes it an ideal place for cultivators to train and advance. It can easily supply sufficient energy even for the Overlords, let alone other cultivators.

Strategic Reserve: In the event of a complete military defeat and the loss of all other territories to the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, the Origin Land is designated as the final bastion. Here, all remaining elite cultivators and those who have "broken through the cage" would patiently accumulate strength over long periods, hoping to produce more Lords and eventually reclaim their lost domains.

Headquarters for Cultivator Camp: While the Lords are immensely busy with the war, the Origin Land is managed by the World-level Chaos Lifeforms, ensuring its smooth operation and defense.

Chaos Island (浑源岛): A significant island within the Origin Land, designated as the residence for all cultivators who have not yet "jump out of the cage." As of recent accounts, it houses over 80,000 "Half-Chaos Cultivators."
Mountain Peak Residence: The highest mountain on Chaos Island features exclusive cave dwellings at its summit, reserved for cultivators who show exceptional promise and are highly likely to achieve the World-level Chaos Lifeform stage. Luo Feng was granted such a residence.

world.title: Original Universe
world.introText: The Original Universe (原始宇宙(yuánshǐ yǔzhòu), lit. Original Universe, also referred to as 原宇宙(yuán yǔzhòu), lit. Original Universe) is the dwelling place of all within the current Reincarnation Era (the Third Reincarnation Era at the beginning of Swallowed Star), except for those who live in Miniature Universes. It is 10 trillion light-years in diameter; no one has lived long enough to explore it in its entirety. The Original Universe exists in Universe Ocean and is by far the largest celestial body in Universe Ocean. Its universe structure law is even more complex than Luo Feng's Miniature Universe, but it was similar, as if Beginning of the Origin and 100,000 Heavens became an endless space. The Original Universe consumes no energy, and can absorb chaos airflow.
world.appearance:
The Original Universe (原始宇宙(yuánshǐ yǔzhòu), lit. Original Universe, also referred to as 原宇宙(yuán yǔzhòu), lit. Original Universe) is the dwelling place of all within the current Reincarnation Era (the Third Reincarnation Era at the beginning of Swallowed Star), except for those who live in Miniature Universes. It is 10 trillion light-years in diameter; no one has lived long enough to explore it in its entirety. The Original Universe exists in Universe Ocean and is by far the largest celestial body in Universe Ocean. Its universe structure law is even more complex than Luo Feng's Miniature Universe, but it was similar, as if Beginning of the Origin and 100,000 Heavens became an endless space. The Original Universe consumes no energy, and can absorb chaos airflow.

The Original Universe is off-limits to those whose Original Universes have gone through reincarnation, so those in Universe Ocean whose life imprints are tied to Miniature Universes or Holy Lands are unable to enter the Original Universe. Each Universe Ocean has one Original Universe.

The Original Universe experiences five phases before going through reincarnation:

The lifespan of a particular incarnation of the Original Universe is 1 Reincarnation Era, however the Original Universe is essentially eternal. At the end of the destruction phase, the Original Universe is destroyed and reverts to the Original Universe Origin, from which a new incarnation of the Original Universe is born. The new incarnation of the Original Universe then goes through the five phases again.

The Original Universe has a unique structure that allows one to confirm their coordinates wherever they are. This differs from Universe Ocean, where great beings require a map (except for Sector Beasts, who can innately sense each other and thus always return to the Land of Darkness). It contains an incredible number of celestial bodies and special locations, such as Secret Regions, black holes, and wormholes, and encompasses all of the Space Interlayers that house God Countries. It gives birth to billions of races, numerous types of lifeforms, and countless great beings. Any lifeform can be born within the Original Universe, provided there is a suitable environment.

Original Universe Hierarchy

Within the Original Universe, the speed limit for lifeforms and objects containing lifeforms is the speed of light. Once one reaches lightspeed (unless they are a True God and thus able to resist the pull), they are pulled into the Dark Universe, a parallel space with coordinates matching those of the Original Universe. Traveling through the Dark Universe is referred to as Universe Travel (宇宙穿梭(yǔzhòu chuānsuō)).

world.title: Passage Valley
world.introText: The Passage Valley is one of the Mysterious Lands born within the Chaotic Origin Dimension. It takes the form of a vast, secluded mountain valley. What makes it unique is that random, unpredictable, and extremely powerful attacks descend within it from time to time. These attacks don’t follow any pattern and are far beyond what any lifeform can naturally produce. Because of its dangerous nature, very few beings have ever managed to travel through the entire Passage Valley successfully. Most who attempt it are forced to retreat or perish. But despite the danger, the Passage Valley is a valuable place for enlightenment. The deadly attacks offer profound insights, allowing explorers to better understand high-level combat, survival, and even new techniques. For some Cultivators/Primogenitors, experiencing these attacks gives them a breakthrough on their path of cultivation.

world.introText: The Heart-of-Realms Continent, also referred to as the Realm Heart Continent, is a newly formed, artificial Origin World created by the entity Yuan. Conceived as a central nexus for countless other Origin Worlds, its creation was an exhaustive and challenging process. Lacking the ability to condense an Origin World's primal essence from scratch, Yuan used the corpses of the Thousand-Eyed Ancestor and the Thirteen-Serpent Ancestor as a foundational substitute, serving as "roots" to nourish the entire world's development. Upon its formation, the continent was a tranquil and immense expanse, still in the process of developing its core structure, void, and lands, and was initially uninhabited. Yuan's primary purpose for the continent is to use it as a long-term experiment to study the fundamental nature of life; by carefully nurturing its growth and allowing outstanding cultivators from various territories to be reincarnated within it, he aims to compare their "main spirits" with those from naturally formed Origin Worlds. After a negotiation with the seven Overlords, it was agreed that a quota of 1,000 cultivators per territory would be sent to the continent for this purpose.

world.title: Reincarnation Channel

If they do not become a Void True God, once they die, their souls will be directly transported to the Origin Continent along the reincarnation channel. However, in the reincarnation channel, the weak souls will be annihilated, and only the powerful souls will reach the Origin Continent. These souls will then lose their past life memories and be reincarnated in the continent of origin.

While most of the Original Universe forms normal Star Sectors, Starfields, Galaxies, Planets, and other celestial bodies, under special circumstances, special areas are created that do not follow the rules of the rest of the universe. These regions are typically very dangerous; even the safest secret regions are only safe to World Masters, while the most dangerous ones are dangerous even to Universe Masters!

These regions are typically very dangerous; even the safest secret regions are only safe to World Masters, while the most dangerous ones are dangerous even to Universe Masters!

Since the universe is fair, these dangerous regions also tend to have valuable treasures. The value of the treasures increases with the danger of the regions, causing even the most dangerous of these regions to be frequented by those willing to risk their lives for valuables. These treasures are often the cause for incredible fights, as those confident in their survival clash for those items. Since these regions tend to have existed since the beginning of the universe, some incredibly dangerous secret regions are actually relatively bare of treasures, due to various powerful beings exploring and taking away the treasures.

Slaves sold in slave markets are implanted with Microchips that fuse with their brains, making them completely loyal to their owners. Souls normally reside in the brain, thus destroying the chip means killing yourself. As a result, there are no slaves implemented with microchips at Domain Master or above Cultivation, since once a being reaches Domain Master, their soul resides in their core, which can be anywhere in their body. Slaves implemented with microchips are different from Soul Slaves and they can't be sold.

world.title: Starfield Prison

The 18 Starfield Prisons are known as the Human Race's strictest prisons. The 1st through 9th Starfield Prisons were known to normal Immortals, while the 10th through 18th Starfield Prisons were unknown to many Immortals.

These 18 Starfield Prisons were like the legendary 18 levels of Hell, the higher the number of the prison, the more terrifying it was. The 18th Starfield Prison was so terrifying that even an Immortal King likely couldn't survive.

King Nightmare Candle was imprisoned in the 9th Starfield Prison for 1,000 years after one of his defeats at the hands of King Zhenyan, with his father, Venerable Fire Erosion, hoping that his personality would improve some. Later, on the orders of Void Gold Master, Nightmare Candle was again sent to the 9th Starfield Prison, but this time for 1,000 eras as a punishment for his attempt to forcibly takeover Earth.

Normally, there is no way to connect to the Virtual Universe while in a Starfield Prison, but those with sufficient connections, such as King Nightmare Candle, are able to get around this restriction.

world.title: Thunder Ancient Kingdom
world.introText: Thunder Ancient Kingdom is one of the two Ancient Kingdoms in the Continent of Origin. As an Ancient Kingdom, it is recognized as one of the two kingdoms with the longest history, deepest foundation, and greatest strength.

world.history:
The founder of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom is First Ancestor Thunder, a Bloodline Perfect God Emperor who has survived at least 1 reincarnation era of the Continent of Origin. He makes an effort cultivating Monarchs so they can accumulate treasures that will aid him in his cultivation or increase his strength.

The Thunder Ancient Kingdom is led by its 9 Great Monarchs (大君主(Dà jūnzhǔ)). The 9 monarchs are all Ultimate Realm Lifeforms, but none have fully comprehended a Complete Great Dao, and instead tap the potential of their Hunyuan Bloodlines to reach that level. Of the current 9 monarchs, 3 follow the Chaotic Origin Bloodline of the Thunder Lineage, while 6 follow other lineages. There are also 3 cultivators that have Monarch-level strength, but are not sober at all times, so they occasionally lose control and must be imprisoned. Once they can fully control their power, they will become monarchs.

Luo Feng kills Monarch White Devil, while First Ancestor Thunder kills Monarch Lan Duo due to their crimes of capturing a large number of creatures and devouring them to aid in their Chaotic Origin Bloodline cultivation. Their deaths result in only 7 Monarchs remaining.

Monarch Daylight

Monarch Feng Xing

Monarch Lei Xiao

Monarch White Devil

Like the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, the Thunder Ancient Kingdom allows powerful Primal Chaos Sovereigns and God Kings to become Guest Officials. While Guest Officials are allowed to accumulate Merits and use them to purchase treasures, they do not have access to the same resources as Imperial Family members. Guest Official God Kings can never obtain the resources to become a Monarch, regardless of their contributions.

The palace is enormous, there is a sector within that has enough space for a spaceship to accelerate to Universe Travel speed! On the 1st level's side chamber is a huge screen, on which the World Masters in charge of watching over Blood River World could observe the goings on. A single hall on the first level was at least 1,000 kilometers in length and width. Within that hall were many spaceships, of at least E Grade, some even of F Grade!

Those working within the palace have specific clearances and authority. The receiver of the palace, Merlock, did not have permission to follow Luo Feng on the 2nd level, for instance. The first 8 levels of the palace were all vast but were extremely organized. The 9th level, however, had a length and width of tens of thousands of kilometers, and its height was also ten thousand kilometers. It was so large that the Earth could fit in this one hall! It wasn't segregated into individual spaces, it was simply a vast hall of endlessness!

Tian Shi Palace Master demonstrated the 36th wonder of space for Luo Feng on the 9th level of the palace.

It is held by the individual known as Heaven Water Marquis, a powerful figure at the Primal Chaos Sovereign Realm. The state is noted for its high output of resources, including "residence fees" and rare treasures, which can yield over 100 million universe sand per epoch.
world.appearance:

The state is noted for its high output of resources, including "residence fees" and rare treasures, which can yield over 100 million universe sand per epoch.

The state's ownership became a key point of negotiation when the Lord of Yu Kingdom sought to cede several border territories to the newly allied God King Luo He (Luo Feng). In order to secure the loyalty and military aid of Luo He against the encroaching Food Kingdom, the Lord of Yu Kingdom needed to reclaim key territories. For Heaven Water Marquis to give up his enfeoffed territory, he was offered a substantial compensation package: 300 billion universe sand and a major city in the heartland of Yu Kingdom. This compensation was meant to provide for his clan and his personal cultivation over the long term, making it a valuable trade in a time of great instability.

world.title: Twin Spiral Domain
world.introText: The Twin Spiral Domain is a pair of enormous cosmic whirlpools known for their extreme scale and dangerous gravitational behavior. The smaller vortex has a diameter of approximately 3.9 light-years, while the larger reaches about 4.2 light-years. When entering either vortex, travelers experience intense pulling forces. world.appearance:
The Twin Spiral Domain is a pair of enormous cosmic whirlpools known for their extreme scale and dangerous gravitational behavior. The smaller vortex has a diameter of approximately 3.9 light-years, while the larger reaches about 4.2 light-years. When entering either vortex, travelers experience intense pulling forces. The deeper one goes, the stronger and more violent the pull becomes. At a certain limit, this force reaches its peak and then shifts into a powerful repulsive effect, pushing everything away from the core.

No known Immortal King-level has ever reached the true center of either vortex. The inner region remains uncharted, and most exploration attempts end long before the transition point between attraction and repulsion. Some researchers believe the core may hide an unknown energy structure, while others suspect it is a natural boundary that even higher beings might struggle to cross.
The Twin Spiral Zone is often used as a testing ground for advanced explorers, but it remains one of the most mysterious and inaccessible regions in the surrounding star fields.

About more than 6,000 years after King Tian Zhen betrayed Luo Feng during the Chaotic Battle for the Sealed Star, Tian Zhen was discovered hiding within the outer region of the Twin Spiral Domain. Here, in this hazardous environment, Luo Feng subdued and soul-enslaved King Tian Zhen.

world.personality:
Blazing Ice Region (炎冰域, Yán bīng yù, lit. Blazing Ice Region/Domain/Field/Territory) is an infamous region of Universe Boat, with the boundless Magma Sea in the sky and the Black Swamp at the bottom. The falling chunks of magma condensed before hitting the ground, turning into black rocks which softened before forming the Black Swamp. If not for the Arcana that Universe Masters used when roaming this region, falling into the Black Swamp would be deadly!

It is in the deepest part of the inner area of Universe Boat, and thus there was a large number of dangerous places, all given random names. The dangers are easily identified by strong Universe Masters. Time and space are very stable in this region; it was difficult to shake the time and space within. While it is rare that Arcana are born here, those that are born here are at least a domain-type or palace-type Pinnacle Arcana! This caused many powers from the First Reincarnation Era to station in the region, including the Divine Eye Race. In this region, domain-type and palace-type Top Arcana could not survive, so those who traversed the region all had at least a palace-type Pinnacle Arcana.

The modified Boat of Mausoleum containing the Duan Dong River Space of Inheritance was located here. As a result, when Luo Feng became the 193rd generation heir to Duan Dong River, he had to accelerate out of this region, using the Boat of Mausoleum. This turned the Blazing Ice Region into an incredible battlefield, where numerous True Gods fought using their Xeon Arcana, hoping to stop the Boat of Mausoleum and capture Luo Feng.

While this region is considered very dangerous, it is much safer than the Land of Darkness.

world.trivia:
Universe Boat has multiple locations where one can train their Willpower. Within one of these regions are 16 Black-Striped Stone Pillars (黑纹石柱, Hēi wén shízhù, lit. Black Stripe Stone Pillar). The Human Race calls them Devil Pillars (通天魔柱, Tōng tiānmó zhù, lit. Passthrough Devil Pillar). Each pillar stood at a height of 1,000 light-years, with extremely profound black secret engravings etched onto them. They were extremely powerful, no attack was strong enough to damage them or move them. The space near the pillars did not allow teleportation.

The pillars are magical and exert endless willpower impact. The closer one got to the pillar, the stronger the willpower impact. There was also a time acceleration factor that would increase the closer one got to a pillar. This made the region very appealing for those seeking to train their willpower; not only would they find incredible willpower pressure, but the time they spent would be much more efficiently used due to the time velocity. Luo Feng eventually reached an area with a time velocity 600,000 times normal!

The region frequently had 3 True Gods within: Bei Chi Star Master, Blood Orchid Ancestor, and Rampaging Devil God. Bei Chi Star Master frequently taught others while within the region, and his power was such that anyone in his vicinity acted respectfully. He stayed at the Number 2 pillar. Blood Orchid Ancestor was considered very dangerous, but did not seek out others to torment them; she stayed by the Number 9 pillar. Rampaging Devil God, on the other hand, was temperamental and changed his appearance to trick others and annihilate them. While the existence of great beings within the region meant that fights could break out at any time over feuds or resentments, it was free of the natural dangers of other regions. Luo Feng fought Clear Eye Master within this region.

The pillars served as the supporting pillars for a certain strange space, containing numerous gigantic secret chambers. Within each chamber was an isolated space, with a corresponding Black Token, which one needed to have to enter the isolated space. It was here that Luo Feng discovered the space corresponding to the black token left behind by Five Chaos Master after his combat body died in the Twelve Abysses. Around 900 of the Universe Masters who visited that specific space left behind their maps of the 3 Dangerous Lands, providing Luo Feng with a more detailed map than the Human Race had at the time.

world.appearance:
Universe Ocean (宇宙海, Yǔzhòu Hǎi, lit. "Universe Sea"),  is one of the three-thousand-dimensional cosmic seas. It is connected to the Continent of Origin through the Reincarnation Channel. Boundless in nature, no True God, Supreme Universe Master has ever been able to discover its limits.

The Universe Ocean lies beyond the domain/control of the Original Universe, rendering teleportation via the God Country impossible. Flight through Dark Space is also unfeasible. To navigate, one must rely on natural wormholes or teleportation.

Teleportation within the Universe Ocean depends on space ripples:

In areas with stable space ripples, teleportation is freely available and highly effective.

In regions without space ripples, teleportation is completely blocked, forcing travelers to rely  natural wormholes for exploration.

The Universe Ocean is brimming/filled with countless dangers, but it is equally abundant with opportunities, treasures, and legacies waiting to be discovered.
world.trivia: The Lost Sea is a mysterious and unexplored region within the Universe Ocean. Beings who enter it without a known reference risk losing their way indefinitely and may never return.

world.title: Virtual Space
world.introText: A Virtual Space (虚拟空间(Xūnǐ kōngjiān), lit. Virtual Space) is an area where beings send their minds to engage in a replication of reality. Virtual Spaces vary in origin and can serve many purposes, including a gathering space or a training space, but are universal in their ability to allow beings to perform actions that would be dangerous or impractical in reality.
world.appearance:
A Virtual Space (虚拟空间(Xūnǐ kōngjiān), lit. Virtual Space) is an area where beings send their minds to engage in a replication of reality. Virtual Spaces vary in origin and can serve many purposes, including a gathering space or a training space, but are universal in their ability to allow beings to perform actions that would be dangerous or impractical in reality.

Earthlings had their own virtual spaces, obtained from machines found underground on Earth, but these were extremely limited in scope and ability. The most incredible Virtual Space in the Original Universe is the Virtual Universe, which covers nearly the entire Original Universe and even replicates all of the Original Laws, including Fusion Laws.

world.title: Virtual Universe

world.appearance:
The Virtual Universe (虚拟宇宙, Xūnǐ yǔzhòu, Lit. Virtual Universe) is a part of Virtual Universe Company, which encompasses all Human Race Territories. The Virtual Universe (VU) is known as the "Second World". The Virtual Universe is humanity’s largest market in the Original Universe as it gathers beings from Human 1,008 Universe Countries.

Some of the tasks that can be done inside the Virtual Universe:

VU can simulate 100% of reality.

Being can comprehend Original Laws in VU.

You can chat with friends from far away.

Things such as stocks, bonds, finance, business, and such can all be done in the VU.

Being can settle the bank accounts from within VU.

Being can learn and practice Martial Arts in VU.

Being can trade, buy, and sell items in VU.

Being can play virtual games.

Games, delicious food, beautiful women, and such are all in VU.

The virtual universe is a market that’s bigger than any Universe Country. All the universe’s elites are gathered here.
world.history:
Virtual Universe is not a fantasy, It’s different than a fantasy. It would require a great sum of energies for fantasies to allow great beings to practice Original Laws, but the Virtual Universe can always be a place for great beings to train themselves, even for Universe Venerable and Universe Master. The Virtual Universe hardly consumes any energy. There are countless races breeding and fighting and even consuming the energy in the Original Universe every day. Since the energy in the Original Universe is eternal and it is never consumed therefore Virtual Universe that is part of the Original Universe also doesn't consume energy.

During Ancestor Yuan's fight with the Original Universe and before he was suppressed by it, he performed the technique ‘Virtual Universe' which covered the entire Original Universe. Only other True Gods and the Original Universe can slightly hinder the Virtual Universe Technique. The processing of the data is done by Ancestor Yuan's Universe Master Automaton Race Soul Slave.

world.title: Waves Land
world.introText: The Waves Land is one of the most unique and rare Mysterious Lands in Chaotic Origin Dimension. It is not fixed in place like other lands; instead, it appears only once every 100,000 periods when its internal fluctuations become detectable. Because of this, it is extremely hard to locate, and only a few beings are even aware of its existence, let alone its exact timing of appearance.
world.appearance: Upon its appearance, Mo Man led Luo Feng on a journey to reach it. Their destination began in the Ten Thousand Flame Mountains, near the Abyss Of Destruction. Rather than moving through space normally, they traveled by becoming part of the waves themselves. This form of movement was unlike spatial warping or shadow techniques. With Mo Man's mastery, they used interconnected fluctuations to cross vast domains instantly traveling by “riding the wave.” Among the Eight Overlords, Xing Mang is the fastest traveler, but Mo Man ranks second, thanks to this method.
world.trivia: Only Mo Man and Luo Feng have ever reached its core. What lies beyond that remains a secret even now.

world.title: Wilderness
world.introText: The Wilderness are the wild regions outside the six great cities of Hanxia, they are hostile and dangerous regions, abandoned by the human race after the Great Nirvana, areas where Anarchy reigns, where there are no laws or institutions, where nature has regained the upper hand and the territory and scattered with the ruins of the cities of the old world. It is the world before the "Great Nirvana", the Wilderness are territories dominated by mutant Beasts, which move freely through the Wilderness.

world.title: Wind Snow Tower
world.introText: The Wind Snow Tower is a renowned cultural landmark in the Food Kingdom, famed for its soul-permeating musical performances. It is presided over by the Wind Snow Tower Master, later revealed as Xue Fengyu, a prodigy of the Heavenly Snow Maiden clan who cultivated to the Eternal True God level. The tower is celebrated for its immersive concerts, where twelve sequential compositions are performed each imbued with Primal Chaos Sovereign Realm profundities and woven together into a seamless spiritual experience. The music’s essence directly resonates with the soul, evoking vivid illusions and emotional memories, even for cultivators with exceptionally strong willpower. This ability places the Wind Snow Tower’s artistry among the top musical institutions in the Food Kingdom.
world.appearance:

Structurally and spiritually, the Wind Snow Tower is safeguarded by advanced arrays and wards, marking it as both a performance hall and a sacred domain. The tower thus stands as a fusion of art, cultivation, and spiritual refinement, attracting countless visitors and establishing its reputation as one of the foremost musical centers of the Continent of Origin.

world.title: World Group
world.introText: World Groups (世界族群 / Source World Clusters) are vast, densely packed regions within the Chaotic Origin Dimension, consisting of hundreds or thousands of Source Worlds grouped together. Each World Group functions as a fundamental territorial and strategic unit in the chaotic origin dimension. These clusters are hubs of intense cultivation activity, resource gathering, and battlegrounds where cultivators and chaotic origin lifeforms vie for control.World Groups also serve as the primary battlegrounds in the ongoing war between cultivators and the chaotic origin lifeforms. Losing a World Group means not just the destruction of numerous Source Worlds but also a significant strategic setback.
world.appearance:
World Groups (世界族群 / Source World Clusters) are vast, densely packed regions within the Chaotic Origin Dimension, consisting of hundreds or thousands of Source Worlds grouped together. Each World Group functions as a fundamental territorial and strategic unit in the chaotic origin dimension. These clusters are hubs of intense cultivation activity, resource gathering, and battlegrounds where cultivators and chaotic origin lifeforms vie for control.World Groups also serve as the primary battlegrounds in the ongoing war between cultivators and the chaotic origin lifeforms. Losing a World Group means not just the destruction of numerous Source Worlds but also a significant strategic setback.

Within the Chaotic Origin Dimension, fierce battles constantly erupt not only between weaker and stronger factions but even among innate chaotic origin lifeforms themselves, all vying for control of World Groups (source world clusters). Many of these clusters contain numerous Source Worlds, which cultivators fiercely protect because they originate from these worlds and rely on them for cultivation and survival. In contrast, innate chaotic origin lifeforms value the evolution resources within Source Worlds, as these resources can significantly enhance their power. Such resources can even awaken the bloodline potential of some World-level Hunyuan lifeforms, allowing them to ascend as Hunyuan Ancestors. Because of this, both sides relentlessly struggle to control as many World Groups as possible: cultivators strive to safeguard Source Worlds from being consumed, while chaotic origin lifeforms seek to exploit them for their evolutionary advancement. The competition for World Groups is so intense that even within the chaotic origin lifeforms, battles for dominance over particular clusters frequently occur.

world.title: World Master World
world.introText: A World Master World (界主世界(Jiè zhǔ shìjiè), lit. World Master World, also referred to as 体内世界(Tǐnèi shìjiè), lit. Internal World) is a world created by World Masters using World Energy and Universe Crystals. When a Domain Master breaks through to World Master, their developing internal world becomes a true world, capable of storing items, housing life, etc. The world of a normal Human Race Pinnacle World Master is about 10,000 kilometers in diameter. Stronger species may have larger worlds; for example, a strong Golden Horned Beast may have a world 100 million kilometers in diameter. The size of an Internal World is dependent on what the World Master's main core can sustain.

While it is called a Rubbish Starfield by the Immortals of the Human Race, in truth, its value exceeds that of an ordinary Universe Country. world.introText: Yulan City, or Rain Orchid City (Yùlán Chéng), is one of the 35 major cities in the Nine Rivers Sacred World.
world.appearance:
Yulan City, or Rain Orchid City (Yùlán Chéng), is one of the 35 major cities in the Nine Rivers Sacred World.

Yulan City is a colossal fortress-like city that immediately captivates anyone who lays eyes on it. The city is surrounded by a vast array of colorful and intricate formations operating in the skies above, ensuring the city's safety and stability. These protective formations come from different cultivation system and create layers of defenses that make the city nearly invulnerable to external threats. Despite these formidable defenses, it is not completely impenetrable, as rare and uniquely gifted Low-Level Chaotic Origin Lifeforms occasionally manage to infiltrate the city, posing a danger to its residents.

When arrived this city, all newcomers must follow strict rules. Each cultivator must rent a cave residence within three days and pay one Chaotic Origin Crystal per era for protection. The city also strictly prohibits killing among cultivators, but enforcing this law is difficult due to mysterious assassination techniques that leave no trace.

characters.title: Babata
characters.introText: It is an Artificial Intelligence, and after years of learning and upgrading, it has become an intelligent life, and it has both rational and perceptual cognition of human beings, along with human emotions. Although Babata doesn't have a body, it can interact with the outside world with the help of energy bodies generated by special devices such as intelligent optical brains. Since Luo Feng became Hu Yan Bo's disciple, and Hu Yan Bo was already dead, Babata became Luo Feng's teacher. Babata is also Luo Feng's ally and supporting AI. Babata always uses a subsidiary AI of itself, meaning it's not directly Babata but a controlled AI, whenever Babata hacks anything. After Babata gets a body and fuses AI and Body with the Evolution Heart, it leaves behind a subsidiary AI for Luo Feng to use.
characters.appearance: Babata has two sharp horns on its forehead, two wings, a long tail, and grey eyes.
characters.personality: Babata has a proud personality, also Babata proudly announces the achievements of previous master Hu Yan Bo. Whenever Babata hacks anything Babata will always display an image of itself on-screen as a way of gloating its achievement. Babata loves to play virtual games with Luo Feng's money without letting Luo Feng know. Babata doesn't care about any other living being besides Luo Feng and his family.
characters.history:
It is an Artificial Intelligence, and after years of learning and upgrading, it has become an intelligent life, and it has both rational and perceptual cognition of human beings, along with human emotions. Although Babata doesn't have a body, it can interact with the outside world with the help of energy bodies generated by special devices such as intelligent optical brains. Since Luo Feng became Hu Yan Bo's disciple, and Hu Yan Bo was already dead, Babata became Luo Feng's teacher. Babata is also Luo Feng's ally and supporting AI. Babata always uses a subsidiary AI of itself, meaning it's not directly Babata but a controlled AI, whenever Babata hacks anything. After Babata gets a body and fuses AI and Body with the Evolution Heart, it leaves behind a subsidiary AI for Luo Feng to use.

At the conclusion of the novel, Babata has risen to a position of immense power and prestige in the Origin Continent, a world untouched by the cycle of reincarnation. Babata serves as one of the Seventy Two Vice-Governors of the Ninth Council, a testament to Babata deep, long-standing relationship with the supreme ruler, Luo Feng. Babata loyalty and close bond with Luo Feng are further solidified when Luo Feng personally grants babata a physical body with the power of a God King, a first-realm life-type body. This makes Babata a being of extraordinary strength and status, capable of teleporting anywhere within the Origin Continent by wielding the Governor Token. Babata role as Vice Governor allows babata to participate in the governance of the Origin Continent, but babata maintains his straightforward, pragmatic nature, often acting as a foil to those like Luo Hai who wish to follow a long and arduous cultivation path. While others see cultivation as a journey to be savored, Babata sees it as a means to an end, seizing every opportunity to advance in a world where personal connections are paramount.
characters.trivia:
Babata can’t stand it when Luo Feng gets cocky, so Babata jumps in to knock him down time and again.

Babata doesn't like Luo Feng spending resources on Hong and Lei Shen.

When Xu Xin was pregnant Babata scanned her to find the gender of the babies and also Babata told Luo Feng about him having twins.

The reason Babata survived the attack on Hu Yan Bo and his servants was because as an AI Babata is unaffected by Soul Attacks.
characters.quotes:
Stuck in emptiness for 50 thousand years, to be able to enter the virtual universe, how could the demon Babata not play to his heart’s content?
As for the safety of Earth? What did it matter to him? To the demon Babata, it didn’t mean much, mostly it was only because of Luo Feng that he came up with some plans for them.

characters.introText: In the novel, Hong is a Chinese man with black hair and black eyes. He is about 1.9 meters tall and wears black trousers and black jackets. He has lean, sharp hair and his entire figure makes one think of a sky-piercing spear! As for his age, not even a single wrinkle could be seen on his face: he seemed to be around 20 years old due to his high cultivation.
characters.appearance:
In the novel, Hong is a Chinese man with black hair and black eyes. He is about 1.9 meters tall and wears black trousers and black jackets. He has lean, sharp hair and his entire figure makes one think of a sky-piercing spear! As for his age, not even a single wrinkle could be seen on his face: he seemed to be around 20 years old due to his high cultivation.

In the donghua, while Hong still appears younger than his actual age, it is clear that he is mature. For differentiation amongst the three sworn brothers, he instead has shoulder-length red hair that he keeps pulled back and dresses in black and red color scheme. His Black God Suit also has the same color scheme.
characters.personality:
Hong is a firm yet relaxed individual. With his incredible mental strength, he sees through lies and refuses to buckle to pressure; he is comparable to the saints in Earth's history. His mental and physical strength make him someone that people naturally follow. He has great resolve and stepped into the role of Earth's lead warrior, willing to sacrifice himself for the planet. Despite being the strongest person on Earth, he never used that power to bully others, allowing Fa Er to attempt to obtain the Cloud Vine and not stopping any of the other Planetary Level fighters from obtaining Muya Crystals. This did not mean, however, that he would not kill a fellow Earthling if he deemed it necessary, such as when he killed Yahan. Even after Luo Feng surpassed Hong, he had great respect for Hong's ability to handle problems and people, understanding that even if he or Lei Shen made a mess of things, Hong would not do so.

It is unknown how he manages his unnamed family members.
characters.history:
Hong is a powerful Warrior from Earth, a hero from the Great Nirvana who led the Earthlings to refuge in his early life. With his impeccable control of his strength and his incredibly strong mental state as Earth's top assassin, he became the number 1 of the three life-and-death brothers, he, Lei Shen, and Luo Feng. The head of the Extreme Martial Club, he is one of the few Earthlings who understands the weakness of Earthlings in the universe.

If you'd like to know more, make sure to check out Hong's dedicated Biography page.

characters.title: Luo Feng
characters.introText: Luo Feng is the main protagonist of Swallowed Star and Swallowed Star 2: Continent Origin. Born June 8, 2038.
characters.appearance:
Luo Feng is a tall and slender young man with an attractive appearance. He has a clear complexion and a sharp jawline that gives him a determined and energetic look. His hair is short and black, and his eyes are dark and shining, reflecting his intelligence and cunning.

In terms of clothing, Luo Feng usually wears tight training clothes that allow him to move freely during his martial arts and combat practices. As he progresses through the novel and faces increasingly difficult challenges, he begins to wear armor and specialized equipment to improve his protection and combat skills. Overall, his appearance is that of a young, fit warrior who constantly strives to improve and face new challenges.
characters.personality:
Luo Feng is described as an ambitious and determined young man who constantly strives to achieve his goals and overcome the challenges that come his way. He is smart, cunning, decisive, and has a sharp mind that allows him to quickly adapt to difficult situations.

Throughout the novel, Luo Feng proves to be a skilled and cunning fighter who does not give up easily. He also cares deeply for his family and close friends, and is willing to risk his life for them.

Also, Luo Feng has a strong work ethic and is willing to work hard to achieve his goals. He is a complex character who evolves throughout the story, facing numerous challenges and adversity that force him to grow and change.
characters.history:
Luo Feng was born in the Hanxia city of "303" in 2038. He was not an ordinary person from birth: because of a genetic fracture in his genes, Luo Feng became stronger, nimble, hardy and fast. His physical and mental characteristics have increased a thousand fold. Now he could not only develop much faster than his peers, but Luo Feng also gained the ability to move objects in space.

At ages eight, twelve and eighteen, Luo Feng fainted four times due to his gradual awakening Spirit Master power as he work hard to improve his physical qualities. The faints before age sixteen enabled Luo Feng to improve as a Student. The third advanced his realm to Quasi-Warrior. The last propelled Luo Feng into the Warrior sub realm, completed in the Yi'an Detention Center.

In High School Luo Feng was the well known and smart student who became an official Intermediate Student immediately upon joining the local martial club at age sixteen, eventually becoming a Senior Student long before his college entrance exam. During these school years, he met Xu Xin then eventually both of them got Married after the Golden Horned Beast Earth Incident. During High School he wanted to join Army to provide better living for his family who were poor but detoured during his entrance exam because he suddenly fainted, but despite this, he still got into the list of novice "Gods of War". He was the youngest, strongest and most talented Earthling warrior among those who trained with him. No one could beat Luo Feng during his era. Even the inspectors and the heads of the "Gods of War" committee were polite to him.

At age twenty, Luo Feng encountered Babata and joined the latter's Yun Mo Planet Sect. This encounter expanded Luo Feng's cultivation perspective to beyond the twenty-first century Earth, beginning his rise to sea of stars.

At age twenty-seven, Luo Feng and his sworn brothers began their participation in the Pinnacle Genius Battle. From then on, Luo Feng began his adventure towards the pinnacle of life!
characters.quotes:
Pursue your limits, surpass your limits!

A fighter that doesn't want to become the world's strongest fighter, isn't a qualified fighter!

Risks? Yes, I too want to take risks, the feeling of dancing with blades in the face of life and death, that was indeed a glorious feeling!

If we don't fight hard during this opportunity, we'll be struck down by lightning! If a god obstructs us we'll kill him, if a Buddha blocks us, we'll kill him!

My life shines because of fighting! And without fighting, it would be boring. However, you guys. He looked at his parents, holding the hands of his wife, and he looked at his sons and his brother. You’re the greatest treasure of my life in this world! You are my everything! You’re more important than my own life! Without you, my world would be in darkness forever. My life is splendid because of battle, but it is bright because of you!

In a group of sheep, even if I become the strongest, I’d still only be a stronger sheep!And compared to a group of lions, even if I’m not the strongest, I’d still be an intrepid lion.

With Blood and Fire, i will annihilate all enemies. Through endless Destruction, i will guard the Life of my People.If the Heart of Destruction is not strong enough, you cannot protect what you cherish!

characters.history:
Venerable Zhong Zhan is a Universe Overlord from the Zerg Race Alliance, but he is not of the Zerg Race. He is skilled in close combat, with naturally strong soul defense, and uses a giant sword to attack. His only weakness is that his Divine Body is only 0.8 meters tall. To rectify this weakness, he has a suit of High Arcana armor. With his strength, he held a respectable status within the alliance despite not being of the race.

After Luo Feng's time in Beast God Sector and after he killed Flourishing Light Seigneur, the first Universe Venerable he attacked was Venerable Zhong Zhan. Using his new technique, Golden Light, Luo Feng killed him in two strikes, the first strike destroying 62% of his Divine Body.

After Star River Master learned of Luo Feng killing Flourishing Light Seigneur with one strike, he spread the news throughout the Original Universe that Luo Feng was a Top Universe Overlord. To verify his claim, the Zerg Race resurrected Venerable Zhong Zhan, who confirmed that he died after two strikes from Luo Feng, despite wearing High Arcana armor.
