characters.introText: A ponytailed girl in jeans and a light white polo shirt.
characters.appearance:
A ponytailed girl in jeans and a light white polo shirt.

During her first year of high school, Xu Xin and Luo Feng were in the same grade. The first time Luo Feng saw Xu Xin, he felt like there was something bright in front of him. That said, during class time, with Luo Feng sitting in the back, for some reason, cannot control himself: he unknowingly looks towards Xu Xin’s back.

In the donghua series, Xin appears to be of Eurasian descent and dressed in a standard academy uniform (white blouse and black skirt) along with her classmates. She's one of the most beautiful girls in school and Luo Feng reacts to her like seeing a goddess.
characters.history:
Xin is part of the Xu Family. An influential family in the upper ranks of society. Despite being financially powerful, Xin attended the local academy like a regular person. It was there that she met Luo Feng as classmates and developed mutual feelings for each other. After the Golden Horned Beast Incident Luo Feng and Xu Xin got Married.

After Luo Feng fought with Golden Horned Beast and possessed its body, the world thought that he had died. Since she was pregnant with Luo Hai and Luo Ping, even though her body was fine, mentally she was not doing too good (Sago Nehru's Mental Attack). Eventually two months after giving birth to her two children she committed suicide by taking pills in porcelain bottle. Babata tells Luo Feng of Xu Xin's suicide when he was nurturing his first Earth body clone.

Luo Feng, Luo Feng. Babata’s clear crisp voice sounded, he seemed extremely anxious.What’s the matter? Luo Feng asked.It’s Xu Xin, Xu Xin committed suicide! Babata shouted.

With the couple's necklace Eternal Love which Luo Feng gave her, she reawakened with an Eternal Body. Due to Eternal body restrictions she couldn't cultivate until she took control of a natural body.

The silver safety amulet slowly began to crack open, for a brief moment, the white light became extra thick, without a sound or trace, it completely vaporized into nothing, the thick white light seeped into Xu Xin’s body. Her skin suddenly became sparkling and translucent, more shiny and glossy than before, beautiful and alluring. It was an extremely beautiful, earth shaking beauty. All of the cascading white light slowly got absorbed by Xu Xin, the appearance of her body seemed to have a layer of light surrounding it.This scene lasted 26 minutes.The glowing light was all absorbed into her body and everything returned to normal!The entire room!Was extremely silent! Xu Xin remained quietly lying down in the bed, as though nothing had happened before.

Luo Feng was angry at first but later he was relaxed after Babata explained what Eternal Body is, the reason being, with Xu Xin's previous body it would have been impossible for her to achieve cultivation higher than Planetary Level.

That’s good too; it was some good from a misfortune. After all, Luo Feng was very clear… Xu Xin would never become a fighter, even with the spirits of nature, Muya Crystals, etc. Countless treasures could probably force her into the Star Traveler stage, but that was it. And now, even though she would be unable to train, she had an eternal body.

She created Ping Hai Company inside Virtual Universe, after Luo Feng provided her with the Awareness Helmet which he  bought when he first visited the Dragon Star planet, this helmet allowed her to access Virtual Universe Network. Since Luo Feng focuses on his Cultivation and doesn't have enough time for family business and matters, she is in-charge of the matters of Luo Family, Earth, and Ping Hai Company.

With Luo Feng's help, she had gotten out of the eternal body and transferred her soul to another body. And in a long period of time, Xu Xin had become Immortal. However, Xu Xin didn’t want to practice after becoming Immortal anymore. In fact, with the valuables provided by Luo Feng, Xu Xin could easily become a Universe Venerable if she put forth some effort. She was not, however, into Cultivation.

In the novel Swallowed Star 2 (Sws2), Xu Xin's strength is described as extraordinary. She can channel a trace of the Original Universe's primal power, earning her the status of an Emissary of the Origin world. Within the Origin Continent's Origin World, her power surpasses even that of a God Emperor, making her nearly unmatched. She can traverse vast space-time, effortlessly moving to regions like the Original Universe. Her remarkable abilities are significantly enhanced by her husband, Luo Feng, who has attained an unimaginable level of power as an overlord.
characters.trivia:
In front of others she calls her husband "Luo Feng" or "My Husband", in front of the immediate family she calls him "Luo Feng" or "Feng", when both are alone she calls him "Feng". And Luo Feng in front of others calls her "Xu Xin", alone he calls her "Xu Xin" or "My Wife", and sometimes "Honey".

According to Baidu her three measurements (三围) are 99/80/89cm

When Luo Feng was in the process of making Star Tower recognize him as his master for 6,000+ Years and everyone thought that something had happened because of the automatic mail he sent. Everyone contacted him through Virtual Universe to make sure, Luo Ping contacted him eighteen times, Luo Hai contacted him twenty-one times, Luo Hua contacted him three times, his Dad contacted him three times, and his Mom contacted him eighty-three times. As for Xu Xin, she had contacted him 38,192 times.

These were all sent when he began his six thousandth year of life or death inheritance. There was almost one every day, sometimes two. Within a couple of hundred of years, there were over 30,000 mails from her.He swiftly scanned through them.Feng, the family’s concealment plan is almost complete. I’m much more relaxed now and just awaiting your return. The Luo family will get even stronger now.Feng, I’m currently in North Birch star field. There is a beautiful planet, the scenery is really nice, only a little cold…Feng, I encountered some trouble today, I didn’t expect that after trusting her for so long, she’d dare go against me like that. I guess you never know what’s going on in someone’s heart. Seems right, I haven’t seen that underling in a few hundred years…The many mails were just like a diary, recording her life, joy, troubles and so on, over the hundreds of years.

characters.history:
Xu Zhong was a member of the Sleeping Dragon Army, a special corps of the East Army of the World of Jin. He introduced himself to Luo Feng as they gathered to begin the mission to receive a title of 'Jin' on God King Realm Continent. They exchanged pleasantries and Xu Zhong expressed shock that someone strong enough to attempt this mission was unknown to him, at which point Luo Feng revealed he was a new recruit.

When the first level of Wu Qi Tower began its elimination trial, Xu Zhong showed his true colors, immediately attacking Luo Feng. He justified it by essentially saying that if he had to kill someone, he'd kill the new (presumably weak) recruit, but discovered to his dismay that Luo Feng was more than capable of countering his attack, forcing Xu Zhong to rely on Chin Bird to escape. Due to the incredible escape ability of Chin Bird, he was able to escape from Luo Feng during the first level of Wu Qi Tower. After watching Luo Feng kill another soldier, he realized that he had made a mistake.

On the second level of Wu Qi Tower, Xu Zhong joined the others in avoiding Luo Feng. He successfully survived the multi-stage trial of the second level, but was left with only one-tenth of his original power. As a result, on the third level of Wu Qi Tower, he had to frantically avoid other combatants. Unfortunately, Luo Feng had no intention of letting him survive, since his character reminded him of Mo Luo, and he pursued him while the Divine Eye's mental attack increased in intensity. Eventually, sensing that he was losing consciousness, he begged for his life, but Luo Feng attacked him, after which the Divine Eye's mental attack knocked him unconscious. The follow-up purple light destroyed his body, leaving behind valuables that Luo Feng retrieved.

characters.introText: An absolutely beautiful young woman, dressed in white plumage, with two wings on her back and a crystal between her eyebrows. She looked like the legendary 'angels' from Earth.
characters.appearance: An absolutely beautiful young woman, dressed in white plumage, with two wings on her back and a crystal between her eyebrows. She looked like the legendary 'angels' from Earth.
characters.history:
Ai Chen is a Stellar Level genius of the Dream Spiral Wing Clan who participated in the same Pinnacle Genius Battle as Luo Feng. Her nickname is 'Lightsaber,' and she was thought to have the power to make the top-10. She had stepped through the gateways of the Law of Light  and Law of Time .

In the Pinnacle Genius Battle Arena Duels, she made the top-20, then won her battle to make the top-10. In the round of 10, she faced and defeated Jiang Mo, placing her in the top-5, however she lost to Bolan and Long Yun and was thus placed in the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm. In the Donghua, she was defeated by Luo Feng in the quarter-finals, leaving her final placement between fifth and eighth, depending on the outcome of the loser's bracket.

In Primal Chaos City, she was not one of the first 9 to pass the 2nd level of the Tong Tian Bridge, however she was still considered a genius capable of comprehending the 108 wonders of Law of Space  within the lifespan of a World Master. While in Primal Chaos City, she was closest to Jiang Mo and Qian Shui. In the journey to the physical Absolute Beginning Secret Realm, she was among those amazed at the clearing of the Secret Region and the ubiquitous presence of mist that could form Universe Crystals.

She was present with the other newbie members of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm for Luo Feng's battles with Mo Yi Lin and Ashi, and later against Sa Jin. As expected, she was demoted to the Heaven and Earth Secret Realm after her first Secret Realm Qualification Battle. She joined the others from the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm in sending off Luo Feng to the Primal Secret Realm.

characters.appearance: A petite woman whose body was covered in leaves.
characters.history:
Alaya is a Void True God of the Thousand Leaf Vine Grass Clan who performs at the Dream Flower Tower. She is exceptional at illusions, and satisfied Luo Feng with her play.

Due to her performance, she was asked by Moli Lian to be the musician of the Moli Family, but she refused, not wishing to become the plaything of a large family. When one of the waiters attempted to persuade her to reconsider, Luo Feng appeared and prevented any further imposition on Alaya, then asked her to follow him.

Thanks to Luo Feng's appreciation of her ability, her performance fee increased by 10 times, no one harassed her in the city, and her clan also led a better life. When the Heart Shadow Sect invaded Hu Yang City, she and her clan were personally rescued by Morosa, and Luo Feng encouraged her to continue working hard to try to reach Eternal True God.

characters.title: Alcohol Master
characters.introText: Alcohol Master was a Natural Beast God, the Beast God manifestation of the fusion laws of Law of Wind  and Law of Time . He was a Special Lifeform, unique in the universe; he was innately a Universe Master at the beginning of the Original Universe! He called himself Riding Wind and was obsessed with drinking, leading other great beings in the universe to give him the title 'Alcohol.' He was one of the first Beast Gods of the Ancestral God Sect.
characters.history:
Alcohol Master was a Natural Beast God, the Beast God manifestation of the fusion laws of Law of Wind  and Law of Time . He was a Special Lifeform, unique in the universe; he was innately a Universe Master at the beginning of the Original Universe! He called himself Riding Wind and was obsessed with drinking, leading other great beings in the universe to give him the title 'Alcohol.' He was one of the first Beast Gods of the Ancestral God Sect.

As he belonged to no race, he traveled the Original Universe alone. He had one friend, Venerable Dove Crane, but due to Dove Crane's luck, he didn't leave his treasures to him (ostensibly Dove Crane already had more valuable treasures). He left his Silver Dragon Phantom Ship to the Ancestral God Sect, in hopes that a future inheritor would meet his qualifications to receive it. Luo Feng had a favorable impression of him despite never meeting him.

Unfortunately for Alcohol Master, as a Natural Beast God, he was destined to be hunted, and was eventually killed.

He was chased into the Celestial Pole Ice Field by an army serving under Jiu Ye God King, and was saved by Luo Feng. Luo Feng accepted him as his 20th disciple-in-name and killed Jiu Ye God King.

characters.history:
An Meng Zi is a World Master from the Black Dragon Mountain Empire. He is known as the Flame World Master and was considered an absolute elite, even having been recognized by Law of Fire . While he was considered strong within the Black Dragon Mountain Starfield, he was much weaker than Jiang Tian Chen. He has three galaxies as his territory.

He arrived at the Universe Mercenary Alliance base in hopes of reaping the treasures of the World Within a World on Cang Lan Star, but was rebuffed by Chinia. Eventually, the 4 organizations and 2 sacred lands of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire held a meeting and he sent 10,000 Stellar Level 9 explorers to the world.

characters.title: An Yong Master

infobox.friends: Five Chaos Master Imperial Jewelry Master

characters.introText: Eternity is hard to find. Through endless killings, I seek the path to eternity. This is my only path now. Flint Master...meet your doom.
characters.appearance: Taking the form of a human, his entire body gave off a hazy, white light, and at the back of his head, there was a white halo. Amidst the halo was a vague form of a gigantic, single-eyed shadow, characteristic of a great being of the Divine Eye Race.
characters.personality:
An Yong Master was a top-tier Universe Master of the Divine Eye Race, with strength rivaling Ice Mountain Master. Shortly after Luo Feng entered the Universe Ocean for the first time, An Yong Master came across Flint Master and attacked him. With the pressure from his Reincarnation Era's approaching doomsday, he attacked fanatically in the hopes of transcending reincarnation. After Luo Feng rescued Flint Master, An Yong Master contacted Seventh True Master for information on Luo Feng.

When Imperial Jewelry Master was annihilated, An Yong Master, Supplementary Formation Master, and Time Banishing Master were sent to Tilted Peak Realm to investigate his death. During this investigation, he came across Luo Feng again, as he was searching for the next component to his Shi Wu Wings. He reached out to his race for assistance and Golden Surveyor Master left to help him kill Luo Feng. Unfortunately for him, Luo Feng released his Golden Horned Beast Body in the guise of Blood Cloud Palace Master and the two attacked him in concert before Golden Surveyor Master could arrive. After this, An Yong released information that Blood Cloud Palace Master was human.

In the past, he had made friends with Five Chaos Master, and later, since they both had feuds with Luo Feng, they grew closer. He worked together with him to chase down Luo Feng, but never found him again.

When the virtual consciousness of Zhen Kan Wu used the dangerous lands within the Boat of Mausoleum to kill Second True Master and Seventh True Master, he died, since his life origin was tied to Seventh True Master's Miniature Universe.

characters.introText: All across Universe Ocean...his name is always the most renowned. Invincible! No one is comparable to Teacher.
characters.appearance: He is a lanky man wearing white robes, with jade eyes and a smile on his face. Behind his smile is a perfection that could only be attained after fully comprehending everything, and his eyes vaguely seemed to contain all the universe's secrets.
characters.personality: Despite his reputation as the strongest being in Universe Ocean, he has a gentle disposition and gives off a relaxing aura. He is humble and genuinely expresses gratitude when meeting Luo Feng in-person. However, contrary to his appearance, he was ruthless in battle, and never backed down, even from the Original Universe!
characters.history:
Ancestor Yuan is the first True God of the Human Race, the creator of the Virtual Universe (and thus the Virtual Universe Company), and the reason the Human Race became a Pinnacle Race. He was known as the strongest being in Universe Ocean, capable of Top-Tier True God Level 10 attacks without Xeon Arcana, and specialized in Soul Attacks. He is the teacher of Primal Chaos City Leader, Darkness Master, and Ice Summit Master, and provided guidance to both Huge Axe Creator and Dragon Walk Master.

If you'd like to know more, make sure to check out Yuan's dedicated Biography page.

Ao Pa Te La is a Stellar Level genius who competed in the same Pinnacle Genius Battle as Luo Feng. He successfully made it through the Training Space Elimination portion of the Pinnacle Genius Battle, and made it to the top-20 of the Pinnacle Genius Battle Arena Duels. As one of the top-20, he had stepped into the gateway of two Original Laws, but they were not specified. By winning in the round of 20, he made the top-10, where he lost to Qian Shui. As a result, he entered the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm of the Virtual Universe Company.

In Primal Chaos City, he was not one of the first 9 to pass the 2nd level of the Tong Tian Bridge. He was closer to Lancelot than to the other members of his class. He was present for Luo Feng's victories over Mo Yi Lin and Ashi, and later against Sa Jin.

As expected, he was demoted to the Heaven and Earth Secret Realm after his first Secret Realm Qualification Battle. He joined the others from the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm in sending off Luo Feng to the Primal Secret Realm.

Apeman Guardian is the non-canon name given to the Apeman Controller on Primal Sky Mountain. It is not specified if this guardian also exists on the other Sky Mountains.

While the Apeman Guardian is a Virtual Universe construct, it has personality and seems to have memories. Its strength is determined by its location on Primal Sky Mountain (Foot, Middle, Peak) and the level of Primal Sky Mountain (Universe Level, Domain Master, World Master).

The Universe Level Apeman Guardian uses the Level 3 Spirit Weapon Arc Serpent.

characters.history:
Ashi is one of the senior Universe Level members of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm of the Virtual Universe Company. As a senior member, he had already spent thousands of years training as a core member, and had the strength necessary to pass the 6th level of the Tong Tian Bridge. As such, he was confident about beating the members of Luo Feng's class.

Ashi and Mo Yi Lin were contracted by Ni Nan to provoke Luo Feng and fight him, providing the seniors a chance to see Luo Feng's strength. The pair successfully provoked Luo Feng into battle by insulting Wu Ka, but were defeated in a 2 versus 1 battle by Luo Feng.

He later watched in shock as Luo Feng defeated Sa Jin.

characters.appearance:
Prior to the Golden Horned Beast incident, he pretended to be low key and reserved. However after Hong and Lei Shen were put in a coma, Mo Henderson, East, Sokolov, Tripathi Singh and Jia Yi deceased after their sacrifice and Luo Feng presumed dead, Atkin showed his true colors as he was the strongest warrior alive at that time.

He sent Yan Hai and 2 other War Gods to intimidate the relatives of the deceased warriors who sacrificed themselves, even robbing Luo Feng's family of Muya Crystals, earning Luo Feng's wrath.

When he learnt that Luo Feng was still alive, he publicly broadcasted Luo Feng's return and pretended to be welcoming, assuming he was safe in the public spotlight, however Luo Feng killed him in broad daylight in front of many people.

characters.title: Ba Fa Yu
characters.introText: Bafayu has a massive body with eight thick limbs and sixteen vibrant eyes, each eye a different color.
characters.appearance: Bafayu has a massive body with eight thick limbs and sixteen vibrant eyes, each eye a different color.
characters.personality: Bafayu is wise, measured, and realistic. While proud, he is not reckless. He prioritizes the survival and growth of his clan and uses the Abyss’s power to train his junior World Chaotic Origin Lifeform clansmen, guiding them toward a breakthrough into the Primogenitor Level.
characters.history:
Bafayu is the ruling Primogenitor lifeform of the First Layer of the Abyss Of Destruction and ranks among the top thirty beings in all of Chaotic Origin Dimension. He belongs to the Bafa Clan, which has produced only two Primogenitor to date, making them a relatively weak faction by high-tier standards. Despite this, Bafayu himself is extremely formidable and completely independent he has never joined any of the three major Factions.

His strength lies in mastering the "Multivariate Divine Light" a top-tier power that excels in both offense and escape. This power, characterized by sixteen color divine light, can bind and trap enemies or be used for rapid retreat. His ability to flee rivals even the Shadow Lord, and surpasses Luo Feng, who can only partially utilize shadow power. Bafayu’s evasion techniques are among the very best, and his confidence in self-preservation is absolute.

Bafayu remains neutral in the war between the three major camps, confident in his survival abilities. He once hosted Luo Feng in the first layer of the Abyss of Destruction and allowed him to be attacked by 3,000 undying World Envoys, the layer’s primary destructive carriers. Although wary of Luo Feng's power, Bafayu showed respect and caution rather than hostility, even offering to relinquish his control over the layer if Luo Feng desired it. Ultimately, Luo Feng declined, seeking only to understand the destruction power of that layer.
characters.trivia: Bafayu is the Ruler of 1st Layer/Destruction World of Abyss of Destruction.

characters.history:
Ba Qi is a once in a trillion years genius from the Immortal Temple on Blood River World. He possesses incomparably clear Willpower and incredible killing intent, to the point that even Luo Feng acknowledged it.

He spends his time training within a Huge Pit in the Ancient God Ruins, leaving management of the pit's matters to his 96 Blood God Guards. He tames warriors who fall to the killing aura found in the ruins, making them serve as his Blood Demons. He plans to eventually break through to Immortal after absorbing 10 Blood River Crystals and becoming a Black Warrior and rule Blood River World. Due to his relationship with the Immortal Temple, he can acquire Blood River Crystals upon request.

He lives luxuriously on the 5th floor of the Huge Pit Palace, he alternates between continuing his training and running the higher-level matters within the pit, including engaging with the Immortal Temple and their envoys as needed. It is forbidden to disturb his training. His trusted friend is the savage beast Qi Niu.

Eighty years after arriving on Blood River World, Luo Feng successfully absorbed his 3rd Blood River Crystal and met Ba Qi to request his Blood River Medal. He was happy to see his guard successfully absorbed 3 crystals, it was clear that he loved to see his subordinates get stronger. As he had no medals, he reached out to the Immortal Temple to provide him with more medals, which they sent with their envoy Yu Ke.

When the medals arrived, he called for Luo Feng, also taking the chance to show him the Beast God Statue that was uncovered by Kuyan's men. After seeing the statue, Luo Feng knew he had to have it for his Beast God cultivation, so he used his Earth Automaton Ship to attack Yu Ke's spaceship, killing him and Kuyan, and stealing the Beast God Statue. Ba Qi realized that Luo Feng had gone missing at the time of the attack, and he vowed that Luo Feng would have no place in Blood River World. Ba Qi suggested retaliation to the Immortal Temple, but they shot him down, knowing the strength of the Virtual Universe Company.

It is unknown if Ba Qi broke through to Immortal, but it was said he could have done so at any time. It is also unknown if Ba Qi saw Luo Feng when he returned to Blood River World to accept Na Ke as his disciple.

Bai Feng has a life-and-death friendship with Emperor Xuan, and encountered Luo Feng when the latter arrived to take the task of guarding the entrances of Heavenly Pillar Realm.

characters.title: Bai Kaluo
characters.introText: Dressed in a black robe, with green scales on his face, on his forehead there was a fine-curved little horn. His entire body is green and he carries two sabers crossed on his back.
characters.appearance: Dressed in a black robe, with green scales on his face, on his forehead there was a fine-curved little horn. His entire body is green and he carries two sabers crossed on his back.
characters.history:
Bai Kaluo is a Universe Level 8 Warrior and Spirit Master of considerable ability, and Nuolan Shan's favorite disciple. Cold and withdrawn, he focuses on improving his strength and does not make friends. He is the most exceptional of the heirs of the Nuolan Shan Family.

Born a member of the Iron Stone Mountain Lineage of the Sword Clan, Bai Kaluo left his grandfather in his youth to begin his long journey to have his name engraved on the legendary Sword Clan Holy Temple. His strength grew continuously during his adventures from galaxy to galaxy, and after witnessing Nuolan Shan's battle footage from the Huge Axe Dojo, he eventually became his disciple.

Nuolan Shan, who absolutely believed in the benefits of actual combat, made his disciples fight life-and-death battles from the very beginning. Bai Kaluo worked very hard, soon becoming the best among his many disciples. He eventually broke through to the Universe Level, and acquired his own domain. He created his own blade technique, and improved it to a level at which even his teacher was unable to guide him. His combat experience, skills, etc. are no worse than his teacher's, a Huge Axe Warrior!

With his strength, he became someone with a status second only to Nuolan Shan within the Nuolan Shan Family. Focused on improvement, he never enjoyed himself, and never made friends, instead devoting himself to studying his swordsmanship and researching his domain. He continued toward his goal of having his name engraved on the Sword Clan Holy Temple and becoming a legend of his Iron Stone Mountain lineage.

As the Sword Clan got stronger and stronger, the requirements for admission to the Holy Temple continued to become higher and higher; in Bai Kaluo's generation, only those who broke through to World Master were eligible.

Bai Kaluo and De Wen Nuolanshan were ordered by Nuolan Shan to head to Earth and retrieve the Earth Automaton Ship, with the secondary mission to acquire the Golden Horned Beast Body if the chance arose. The pair set off on their journey, with Bai Kaluo only exiting his cabin for updates on the travel time, irritating De Wen. He was very confident about their mission, commenting that since no one had taken the automaton ship, there was no way someone with strength sufficient to fight them could be on Earth.

While Bai Kaluo traveled to Earth, Nuolan Shan convinced a fellow member of the Hundred Tigers Building to assess Bai Kaluo's strength as he battled a Universe Level 9 Spirit Master in the Battle Space. Using his 100 Blades technique, Bai Kaluo defeated his opponent, and the observer agreed that placing him as one of their Special Elites shouldn't be a problem. After giving Bai Kaluo the good news, Nuolan Shan reminded him and De Wen of their goals on Earth, as they were about 3 days away.

Unfortunately, upon their arrival in the Solar System, they were attacked by Luo Feng with the D5 Grade Railgun, destroying their D3 Grade Spaceship and leaving them stranded in space. After noting that it would take them half a year to complete their journey to Earth without the ship, Bai Kaluo realized that a single enemy approached: Di Fan. Di Fan's initial attack killed De Wen, but Bai Kaluo was able to defend against it.

Using his 100 Blades technique, Bai Kaluo blocked Di Fan's Spirit Weapon attack, then with his Willpower he defended against his Soul Cutter technique, shocking Babata. Babata acknowledged Bai Kaluo's strength as both a Warrior and Spirit Master at Universe Level 8, and advised Luo Feng to use the Enslaving Soul Seal to make him his second Soul Slave. Bai Kaluo continued to resist, using his Blade Cycle technique, but after disarming Di Fan, he was counterattacked with the Hybrid Mother Copper shard, splitting his arms open and leaving him defenseless.

After Di Fan destroyed his AI, Bai Kaluo asked why he didn't just kill him, and was shocked to see that Di Fan's master was Luo Feng. Luo Feng gave him the choice to be his servant or die, to which Bai Kaluo laughed, acknowledging that he might serve Di Fan, but not Luo Feng, who he saw as a weak Stellar Level kid. Remembering his struggles from childhood, as well as his goal of having his name engraved on the Sword Clan Holy Temple, he agreed to be Luo Feng's soldier or bodyguard until Luo Feng could defeat him, at which point he would call him master.

Luo Feng laughed as he released his Golden Horned Beast Body, shocking Bai Kaluo, who realized that Luo Feng and the Golden Horned Beast were one and the same! He still did not believe that the Golden Horned Beast was strong enough to fight him at the moment, despite its potential to defeat him in the future, prompting Luo Feng to have Bai Kaluo healed so the pair could fight. With the Universe Level 6 Golden Horned Beast Body, Luo Feng easily defeated Bai Kaluo after using Strengthen and Deity of the World, multiplying his strength by 4. After healing Bai Kaluo, he then used the Engraving Soul Seal, making Bai Kaluo his second Soul Slave.

After becoming Luo Feng's Soul Slave, Bai Kaluo gave Luo Feng the information he had about Nuolan Shan and his designs on Earth, telling him of his desire to obtain the Earth Automaton Ship. After learning what armors the pair had, Luo Feng ordered Bai Kaluo to enter the ship and insert an AI chip to take control of it. Bai Kaluo succeeded, placing the Earth Automaton Ship under Luo Feng's control, and the trio marveled at the incredible ship. Bai Kaluo, with his greater understanding of the universe, understood its worth and value, while Luo Feng and Di Fan did not, prompting Babata to explain.

During his time with Luo Feng, he received the training techniques of the Yun Mo Planet Sect, breaking through to Universe Level 9. He and Di Fan helped train Luo Hai and Luo Ping, and before Luo Feng left for the Beginning Universe, he ordered the pair to protect his family in his absence. With Luo Feng's resources, Bai Kaluo easily broke through to Domain Master and with the Nutrition Cabin, he reached Domain Master Level 9 within a few short decades. He also had access to Luo Feng's Pinnacle World Master guards for guidance. Luo Feng told Bai Kaluo to keep up after Di Fan broke through to World Master.

Since Luo Feng had trained in the 10,000 Soul Control technique, he could control more Soul Slaves and no longer planned to bring Bai Kaluo along with him in battle. Instead, he continued to nurture Bai Kaluo and Di Fan and had them continue to protect his family. Bai Kaluo was among those who contacted Luo Feng when Bu Na came to Earth and kidnapped Xu Xin.

characters.title: Banff Master
characters.introText: His upper body resembled a human - fair-skinned with a shiny mass of long, golden hair, but his lower body took the form of a reptile. His look was heartwarming, just how the sun provided warmth, and his smile was as amiable as a loving mother. His eyes were a dazzling shade of sparkling cyan - beautiful enough to pull on one's heartstrings. He had the ability to make one unconsciously fall into a state of euphoria, and his voice was low and deep, shaking the ground like an earthquake.

After Luo Feng defeated Venerable Sky Flower and was being chased by him, Banff Master was ordered to either turn Luo Feng into a Soul Slave, kill him by soul attack, or destroy his Divine Body, if unsuccessful with the first two methods. He was unsuccessful in completing any of the objectives, and he couldn't prevent Luo Feng from killing 6,000 Universe Venerables with his I Am the Universe technique.

characters.title: BDME Government Official
characters.introText: This is the official working at the Black Dragon Mountain Empire government office on Jade Rock Star. When Luo Feng, Hong, and Lei Shen traveled to Jade Rock Star to purchase Earth, this official assisted them. Initially, he told Luo Feng that it would take 30 days at the most to complete the purchasing process. When Luo Feng offered 10 million Black Dragon Coins if he could resolve it in 7 days, 100 million if he could in 3 days, and 500 million if he could in 1 day, and 1 billion if he could settle it in an hour, he gave a guarantee of finishing within a day. Luo Feng gave him 200 million to start, and he successfully completed the purchase process in under 3.5 hours, earning the remaining 500 million.

characters.title: Bei Chuang
characters.introText: A 3 meters tall black-skinned youth with greenish gold armor. He carries the Yan Shen Armament.
characters.appearance: A 3 meters tall black-skinned youth with greenish gold armor. He carries the Yan Shen Armament.
characters.history:
Bei Chuang is one of the Domain Master geniuses of the Gold Horn Race. A student of Tu Ka Luo and the younger brother of Bei Qiu, he has very good origin law comprehension, having the strength to pass the 9th level of the Tong Tian Bridge.

When Luo Feng traveled to Laos World, Bei Chuang enabled him to get close to the captured Hui Suo Beast in exchange for accepting his battle challenge.

When Luo Feng finished his conversation with the captured beast (and took some fur), he and Bei Chuang flew to the arena outside of the Sacred City to battle. Despite having a stronger Blade World, he lost when Luo Feng combined his Spirit Energy amplification (over 3,200 due to the Devil's Voice God General Inheritance) with his Blood River Crystal augmentation and the natural ability of the Golden Horned Beast, Strengthen, surpassing Bei Chuang's strength.

After losing to Luo Feng in front of 1 billion residents of the Sacred City, he sulked with his brother, who then decided to challenge Luo Feng himself.
characters.trivia: In the donghua, Luo Feng befriends Bei Chuang after defeating him.

characters.title: Bei Di
characters.introText: You know me? It seems that Morosa told you about me, and you managed to sneak into the Land of Darkness without being noticed by any other Sector Beasts. You're indeed impressive...even I didn't notice you. Now, you show yourself. It seems you came here to target me.
characters.appearance: A huge, black beast with two hideous heads, each with a single eye.
characters.history:
Bei Di was one of the strongest Sector Beasts within their nest. Its battle with Morosa forced Morosa to flee the nest and enter Universe Ocean, with the plan to devour True Gods and the origins of their Miniature Universes, in the hopes of getting strong enough to kill Bei Di. Morosa considered Bei Di its greatest rival and most powerful opponent, and Bei Di was the only opponent to make it bleed after entering Stage 3, until Luo Feng.

While Morosa was combating the great beings of Universe Ocean, Bei Di continued to devour Sector Beasts within the nest. When Bei Di defeated Batur, Batur spread the news among the other Sector Beasts (excluding the ones it considered rivals, including Morosa) that Bei Di had reached Stage 4. When Morosa devoured an injured Stage 2 Sector Beast, it made sure that all Sector Beasts knew that Morosa was then only Stage 2, including Bei Di.

After learning that Morosa had been reduced to Stage 1 by its battle with Luo Feng, Bei Di understood that it needed to get stronger at a faster rate if it was to defeat Luo Feng. Initially, Bei Di, even at Stage 4, would focus on defeating and devouring Stage 3 Sector Beasts. After learning of Luo Feng's strength, Bei Di decided to target Stage 2 Sector Beasts as well, which would enable it to get stronger more quickly, but also meant that it would not know as much about those close to it in strength, so it could be surprised by the birth of Stage 5 Sector Beast before it reached Stage 5. Bei Di received the message from Morosa that it was about to be killed by Luo Feng, and that even a pinnacle Stage 4 Sector Beast would not be his match now that he was a True God. When Morosa was then enslaved by Luo Feng, Bei Di immediately knew, as did the other Sector Beasts.

After Luo Feng learned more about the Sector Beasts, their nest, and their strength from Morosa, he chose Bei Di as his first target, since Bei Di was the most powerful Sector Beast in the nest. At the same time, Bei Di was hunting and killing Ka Qiong, and about 4 months later, it reached Stage 5. Shortly after it reached Stage 5, Luo Feng arrived and sealed the space, initiating their battle.

Having just entered Stage 5, Bei Di was extremely confident and eager to begin hunting down the Stage 4 Sector Beasts, but realized that the silver-armored human who sealed the space and was staring at it was Luo Feng. The two immediately engaged, with Luo Feng executing the first 3 volumes of Duan Mie and using the One Thought Void Space ability of Shi Wu Wings to attempt to suppress Bei Di. Unfortunately, as a Stage 5 Sector Beast, Bei Di's Sector Light Domain ability was stronger than Luo Feng's ability, tipping Luo Feng off that Bei Di was Stage 5.

Fighting back against Bei Di's Sector Light Domain, Luo Feng combined Pearl of the Golden Ocean with One Thought Void Space, suppressing it to the point that it was merely a dense membrane that defended Bei Di against every attack. Bei Di taunted Luo Feng, saying the only reason he could stand up to the Sector Beasts was due to his valuables, then used its Black Mist Cocoon ability to attempt to consume Luo Feng's godly power. However, unbeknownst to Bei Di, Luo Feng's limitless Divine Body gave him the ability to match godly power with Bei Di, forcing it to use an ability it acquired after breaking through to Stage 5, Reincarnation Passageway.

After realizing that it could not simply consume Luo Feng's godly power, Bei Di decided to use strength to crush him, executing Reincarnation Passageway, but Luo Feng successfully countered by using the second stage of Wu Qi God, along with Blood Shadow Blade. Realizing it was losing, Bei Di elected to escape rather than continuing to fight, hoping to be able to get stronger and fight Luo Feng in the future, but also having a trace of fear toward Luo Feng. In response, Luo Feng executed Endless Golden Ocean and One Thought Void Space, along with utilizing Star Tower, hoping to trap Bei Di, but it wasn't enough. Luo Feng then used the combination of Qian Si Ze, Endless Golden Ocean, and One Thought Void Space, trapping Bei Di and preventing its escape. Left with no other options, Bei Di finally used its most powerful technique: Destruction.

Due to the cost of executing Destruction, Bei Di hoped to avoid using it until it had reached the top of Stage 5, but it had no other choice under its circumstances. Through executing Destruction, Bei Di was able to destroy the obstruction of Qian Si Ze, and continued to attack Luo Feng, who chose to hide within Star Tower rather than take the attack head-on. Observing Destruction, Luo Feng realized that he could understand some of the mysteries behind the technique, and rather than staying hidden in Star Tower and allowing Bei Di to escape, he exited Star Tower and confronted Bei Di, hoping to force it to execute Destruction again. Bei Di obliged, hoping to kill Luo Feng, but Luo Feng executed Light Wing, and with the power of Wu Qi God, Blood Shadow Blade, and Duan Mie, he was able to counter Destruction, and while it was somewhat weaker, Luo Feng was strong enough to survive the recoil.

Realizing that Luo Feng could withstand Destruction, Bei Di attempted to use 99 Bodies to escape, but was easily countered by Light Wing, and reduced to its original body, which had even been attacked. Pushed to its last resort, Bei Di executed Sector Light Passageway, despite the damage to its internal sector, but by executing Destruction twice, it had unwittingly helped Luo Feng comprehend the ability of the 4th pair of the Shi Wu Wings: One Thought Miniature Universe. The power of the origin of the Miniature Universe prevented Sector Light Passageway from taking form, despite Bei Di reverting itself from Stage 5 to Stage 3 through the burning of its internal sector. Reduced to a Stage 3 Sector Beast, Bei Di had no way to fight against the powers of Star Tower and Luo Feng's Miniature Universe, so rather than be enslaved, Bei Di chose to self-destruct, which Luo Feng was unable to prevent. Before self-destructing, Bei Di passed the message to all of the Sector Beasts of its loss to Luo Feng, despite being a Stage 5 Sector Beast. With this message, the Sector Beasts truly understood that if they hoped to prevail, they had to birth a Stage 6 Sector Beast as soon as possible.

characters.title: Bei Qiu
characters.introText: A black-skinned youth, looking similar to Bei Chuang. He wears purple armor and has a cold gaze and a prideful aura, similar to Bolan.
characters.appearance: A black-skinned youth, looking similar to Bei Chuang. He wears purple armor and has a cold gaze and a prideful aura, similar to Bolan.
characters.history:
Bei Qiu is the older brother of Bei Chuang and the strongest Domain Master genius of the Gold Horn Race. His strength is such that he could pass the 10th level of the Tong Tian Bridge, and he has the pride expected of one of that level.

Bei Qiu challenged Luo Feng after his brother's loss, but Luo Feng refused to fight him. Before fighting Bei Chuang, Luo Feng thought he would have no chance to beat Bei Qiu, but after his Golden Horned Beast broke through to World Master, his increase in comprehension gave him the ability to do so. However, to avoid arousing suspicion about his strength, he refused to fight Bei Qiu, leaving him and his teacher, Tu Ka Luo, very dissatisfied.
characters.trivia:
In the donghua, Bei Qiu is against the Human Race and surprise attacks Luo Feng while the latter is attempting to comprehend the Giant Sleeping Beast God Statue. In the novel, he seems to have a problem with the relationship between the two races, but he sticks to formally challenging Luo Feng to an honorable duel (and is repeatedly rejected)

In the donghua, Luo Feng states that Bei Qiu is a World Master Level 3, despite the datasheet stating that he is Domain Master Level 9. He does not use World Projection when attacking Luo Feng, making it unlikely that he is actually a World Master Level 3. It is possible that he is referring to Bei Qiu's Consciousness strength, given his overall strength

characters.appearance: A tall and sturdy man with short, gold-colored hair.
characters.history: Bendi was a Universe Level subordinate of Ming Yu, and was the head captain of Three Axe Mountain's second large team. He was one of the 6 who broke through from Stellar Level 9 to Universe Level throughout the battles on the World Within a World on Cang Lan Star. As a subordinate of Ming Yu, he met Luo Feng and the remaining members of his team toward the end of the excavation. Since he was one of the 12 important targets from Three Axe Mountain, he was killed by Brolin's forces in their ambush, and the treasure he obtained was stolen.

characters.title: Benedict
characters.introText: In the donghua, he has pale skin and long red hair that falls past his shoulders.
characters.appearance: In the donghua, he has pale skin and long red hair that falls past his shoulders.
characters.history: Benedict was one of the 18 executives of the Fire Phoenix Organization. He and the other 17 executives were the targets of Luo Feng's 1st Level of Highest Points Mission. He had hundreds of thousands of staff, tens of thousands of guards, heavenly power, and lived carefree within his palace. During the massacre on Fu Di Planet, Luo Feng killed a total of 36,237 people, including Benedict, who he punished harshly. Luo Feng used his Blood Shadow Blade to slash him over ten thousand times before letting him die.

characters.title: Bevin
characters.introText: He is a man dressed in a black star robe (he switched to a fiery-red robe after some years), with 4 ears and no nose. His entire being seemed friendly.
characters.appearance: He is a man dressed in a black star robe (he switched to a fiery-red robe after some years), with 4 ears and no nose. His entire being seemed friendly.
characters.personality: Watchman Bevin is dutiful and easygoing, with a full commitment to reporting the successes of the elite of the genius group who were allowed to enter Primal Chaos City.
characters.history: Watchman Bevin has been watching over the Tong Tian Bridge for over a trillion years. He reports the successes of the elite geniuses to the higher-ups in the Virtual Universe Company, as well as to the other geniuses, in order to stoke competition between them. As a result of his duty, he can observe everyone on every part of the bridge, in a way that even Invincible Immortal Kings like King Zhenyan cannot. He has seen countless geniuses attempt the Tong Tian Bridge and can see their strengths and weaknesses in doing so. Eventually, he looks forward to Luo Feng's attempts on the bridge, knowing that he tends to create shocking results.
characters.trivia:
It is unclear what his cultivation level is, beyond just Immortal...when King Zhenyan, King Longyu, and King Tong Nan arrive at the bridge, he bows, which is hard to imagine a Universe Venerable doing, but perhaps another Immortal King would.

In the Donghua Man Luo takes this role

characters.appearance: In the novel, he is described as cold as ice and steady as a mountain, wearing a golden mask. He only speaks when necessary. In the donghua, he is of average height and has silver hair and silver eyes.
characters.personality: As one of Hong's bodyguards, he is stronger than the 5 Investigators of the Extreme Martial Club. Having been taught by Hong directly, he has the Detection skill as well as a special forbidden move that damages his life essence but gives him incredible escaping speed. He has completed the mission at the No. 9 Ruin of Ancient Civilization, so he also has a Black God Suit.
characters.history:
Also known as Iceberg. One of the greatest ice controller on the planet. One of Hong's three main bodyguards, along with Yao Rao and Ye Shou, the character is cold and reserved. They were trained by Hong. After becoming a God of War, Bing Shan was given a special ability - Detection, which allows him to directly feel the energy of objects.

He accompanied Zhu Xi/Liu He to the Misty Island to assist Luo Feng and acquire the spirits of nature. Upon their arrival, he competed with Catalan and his associates in locating the spirits of nature, easily locating them through his ability. He eventually obtained 92 spirits of nature, but only made it back to the autojet by escaping the Cloud Vine. He informed Hong about the Cloud Vine, causing him to show up to tame it.

After Hong killed the Tentacle Beast, Bing Shan assisted Luo Feng and Yao Rao in excavating the lake surrounding the Misty Island for treasures. He received 2 Muya Crystals for his efforts.

He was present for Hong's awakening out of the coma.

He was seen bidding farewell to Hong after Hong decided to begin his training journey with Luo .
characters.trivia:
Like all other bodyguards of Hong, he wears a mask in the Novel.

It is assumed that this character has Law of Water  affinity due to his ice manipulation abilities.

In Episode 220 of the Donghua, he is still alive even after 120K+ years, which is more than the lifespan of the average Universe Level. Hence it can be speculated that he is at least at the Domain Master Level.

characters.title: Bird Spring
characters.introText: Bird Spring was the second recorded great being to travel to the secret space chamber to which Five Chaos Master had a token. They received the treasures that Nine Mortals Master left behind, and pledged to leave those treasures behind if they were unable to transcend reincarnation. They left behind diagrams of secret techniques that they comprehended.
characters.history: Bird Spring was the second recorded great being to travel to the secret space chamber to which Five Chaos Master had a token. They received the treasures that Nine Mortals Master left behind, and pledged to leave those treasures behind if they were unable to transcend reincarnation. They left behind diagrams of secret techniques that they comprehended.

characters.title: Bitter Wind Seigneur
characters.introText: Bitter Wind Seigneur was a Second Level God King (cultivating in the Great Dao of the Space Origin) Guest Official of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, and one of the top-10 sinners on the Continent of Origin. Bitter Wind ruled a huge island close to the ancient kingdom, which contained 39 Chaos States. Due to its good location, it had about half the number of living beings of the 155 Chaos States ruled by Hu Yang City, but they were all at the mercy of Bitter Wind.
characters.history:
Bitter Wind Seigneur was a Second Level God King (cultivating in the Great Dao of the Space Origin) Guest Official of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, and one of the top-10 sinners on the Continent of Origin. Bitter Wind ruled a huge island close to the ancient kingdom, which contained 39 Chaos States. Due to its good location, it had about half the number of living beings of the 155 Chaos States ruled by Hu Yang City, but they were all at the mercy of Bitter Wind.

As part of his plan to clean up the continent, Luo Feng killed Bitter Wind Seigneur with the Lie Yuan Technique and took his corpse.

characters.title: Black Butcher
characters.introText: A bearded fat man with hair like steel needles. He has fangs, scales all over his body, and a pair of flaming eyes that are like burning stars.
characters.appearance: A bearded fat man with hair like steel needles. He has fangs, scales all over his body, and a pair of flaming eyes that are like burning stars.
characters.history:
Black Butcher is a Void True God who reincarnated to the Continent of Origin. He followed the path of the Kitchen God to become a True God, then reincarnated after breaking through to the next level. After 50,000 periods of hard work as a butcher, he established the restaurant Fire World Restaurant and built up some fame in Hu Yang City.

His restaurant is a favorite of Morosa and was the first place he brought Luo Feng after he finished his cultivation in seclusion.

More than 27 periods after Luo Feng's arrival on the continent, while preparing a Fire World Feast for Luo Feng and Entropy Sky Flame, he broke through to Eternal True God. As a result of his relationship with Luo Feng, he eventually became Yu Shui Tianyu's cook, and later, when Yu Shui Kingdom Master sought Luo Feng's assistance, he brought Black Butcher along.

characters.title: Black Cloud God King
characters.introText: A winged figure, sometimes merged with endless black clouds.
characters.appearance: A winged figure, sometimes merged with endless black clouds.
characters.history:
Black Cloud God King is the non-canon name given to the God King who sent Gray Furry Alien Beast to steal Tianqu Stone Essence. A long time ago, he was a Primal Chaos Sovereign Guest Official of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, and was a Transcendent Chaos Realm. Later, he broke through to God King, and with his increase in strength, he chose to leave the ancient kingdom. He settled in the Celestial Pole Ice Field, controlling the Black Sky Realm, where he enslaves every new Primal Chaos realm Alien Beast and sends them to steal rare treasures from the two Ancient Kingdoms.

When Luo Feng captured Gray Furry Alien Beast while completing his task of determining who was stealing Tianqu Stone Essence, Black Cloud attempted to convince him to let his enslaved beast go. Luo Feng refused, so Black Cloud killed his slave, and later pondered about Luo Feng's actions. Since he used a secret method to cover up the causality between him and his slave, he figured that only a handful of people on the Continent of Origin could trace his actions, and Emperor Chu would not ask for their assistance.
characters.trivia: Black Cloud God King's cultivation realm is not explicitly stated. It is implied that he is at least a Second Level God King, since he believes that only a handful of beings on the Continent of Origin could investigate causality and determine his identity.

characters.title: Black Dragon Immortal
characters.introText: A tall and sturdy giant covered completely in black dragon scales, with a single black dragon horn on his forehead. He gave off a beast-like aura.
characters.appearance: A tall and sturdy giant covered completely in black dragon scales, with a single black dragon horn on his forehead. He gave off a beast-like aura.
characters.history:
Black Dragon Immortal is the Immortal who founded the Black Dragon Mountain Empire, fusing his internal world with the universe space, creating the God Country Sacred Land Black Dragon Mountain. Rather than being the emperor, he is the God Leader of the Sacred Land Black Dragon Mountain, the power behind the throne, so to speak. He is one of the two Immortals who live within the Black Dragon Mountain Empire. Despite his strength relative to the non-Immortals of his empire, his strength can be considered average as an Immortal, far from that of even an Immortal Marquis.

Due to his status as god leader of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire, he is one of the beings invited to Luo Feng's party to celebrate his being named the 4th tycoon of the Ganwu Department of the Virtual Universe Network Company.
characters.trivia: In the donghua, Black Dragon Immortal is described as both the founder and emperor of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire.

characters.title: Black Dragon Mountain Emperor
characters.introText: He is normally dressed in a dark-gold imperial robe.
characters.appearance: He is normally dressed in a dark-gold imperial robe.
characters.history:
The Black Dragon Mountain Emperor serves as the emperor of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire. Despite this title, he is not the founder of the empire; the founder is Black Dragon Immortal. The emperor, as well as the entire imperial family, is backed by Black Dragon Immortal and the forces of Black Dragon Mountain.

As the emperor, he rules the empire, despite not having incredible combat power. He is the royal father of the princes, including Brolin, and serves as the front-facing ruler of the empire. He is extremely passionate and many of his subordinates spend their time flattering him.

He is long-lived, but his cultivation level is not revealed. It is implied that he has witnessed multiple Pinnacle Genius Battles, so it is possible that he is a Universe Level or higher cultivator. He had knowledge of the Yan Shen Armament, but it is very clear that he has less knowledge than his World Master subordinates, needing to be reminded that there was no way they could have Luo Feng, a Stellar Level genius who stepped through the gateway of the Original Laws, join Sacred Land Black Dragon Mountain.

He showed great joy as Luo Feng progressed through the Pinnacle Genius Battle, eventually rewarding him with the Milky Way Galaxy when he reached the top 1,000 of the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Stage.
characters.trivia: In the donghua, Black Dragon Mountain Emperor and Black Dragon Immortal are merged into the Black Dragon Immortal identity.

characters.title: Black Dragon Mountain Royal Uncle
characters.introText: Black Dragon Mountain Royal Uncle is the non-canon name given to the royal uncle who advised the Black Dragon Mountain Emperor while they watched the Pinnacle Genius Battle. He is a World Master, and thus was aware that Luo Feng could have been hiding his power during the Ganwu Universe Country Elimination Stage.
characters.appearance: Dressed in a dark-gold imperial robe.
characters.history:
Black Dragon Mountain Royal Uncle is the non-canon name given to the royal uncle who advised the Black Dragon Mountain Emperor while they watched the Pinnacle Genius Battle. He is a World Master, and thus was aware that Luo Feng could have been hiding his power during the Ganwu Universe Country Elimination Stage.

When Luo Feng revealed the Yan Shen Armament, he knew its reputation and stated that Luo Feng was an elite genius even within the Ganwu Universe Country since he could use its first form, Phantom Sword Form. With his knowledge, he also knew that it was unlikely for geniuses who stepped through the gateway of the Original Laws to face each other in the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Stage, unless they did not show their true strength in the elimination stage.
characters.trivia: In the donghua, some of his observational purposes are performed by Hargrave

characters.title: Black Fire Devil Master
characters.introText: He is quite handsome, with flame-like secret patterns on his face, and has some of the charm of a Sector Beast's true appearance.
characters.appearance: He is quite handsome, with flame-like secret patterns on his face, and has some of the charm of a Sector Beast's true appearance.
characters.personality: Black Fire Devil Master is enthusiastic about making friends with free God Kings, especially those with great potential. In his opinion, no one on the Continent of Origin is more familiar than him with the Imperial Family God Kings of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom.
characters.history:
Black Fire Devil Master is a former Guest Official of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom. In the early days of the ancient kingdom, he was already a Second Level God King, and as a guest official, he made contributions exceeding those of the Imperial Family god kings! He was ambitious and wanted to become a Monarch, but due to being a guest official, he would never be allowed to obtain the necessary resources. Eventually, he tried to steal one portion of a Chaotic Origin Bloodline that could enable one to become a Monarch, but he failed and could only flee.

After being forced to flee the Thunder Ancient Kingdom, he established the Black Fire Sect to gather God Kings with grudges against the Thunder Ancient Kingdom, forming a powerful resistance force. Very good at making friends, he has many God Kings in the Thunder Ancient Kingdom who are still his friends, willing to continue their interactions with him despite the bounty on his head. He has also befriended many other God Kings, including Earth God King, with the support of his friends being part of why the Black Fire Sect has survived. His reputation on the Continent of Origin is quite good.

At some point in the past, he joined the Reincarnation Building, but only occasionally takes part in their missions. In this capacity, he befriended Luo Feng, working hard for over 30 periods to attain one-tenth of the corpse of a Twenty-Four Phase Form Chaotic Origin Bloodline creature at a price within Luo Feng's affordability. After agreeing on the price, he personally brought the corpse to Hu Yang City, receiving 300 million Merits in exchange. Later, when Luo Feng wanted a complete corpse of a Second Level God King Chaotic Origin Bloodline creature, Black Fire Devil Master suggests that he contacts the three alien forces.

characters.title: Black Lotus Master
characters.introText: The whole body is surrounded by circles of lotus leaves, with a head like a plant stamen. Representatives of the six major plant life groups in the Northern Territory Alliance
characters.appearance: The whole body is surrounded by circles of lotus leaves, with a head like a plant stamen. Representatives of the six major plant life groups in the Northern Territory Alliance

characters.title: Black Mist
characters.introText: One of the 12 Immortal Marquises of Misty Sand Island.
characters.history: One of the 12 Immortal Marquises of Misty Sand Island.

characters.title: Black Mist Commander
characters.introText: A huge cloud of black mist. He could condense to form a blurry human figure.
characters.appearance: A huge cloud of black mist. He could condense to form a blurry human figure.
characters.history:
Black Mist Commander is a Void True God who serves as one of the Four Commanders of God King Valley, given the order to find someone who could reach the top of Wu Qi Tower. As such, he has been sealed with the title 'Jin.' His throne in the silver palace was on the far-left.

Black Mist Commander observed the participants of the task to obtain the title 'Jin' while Luo Feng was undergoing the task, and noticed his incredible body technique. After checking to see why none of the four generals had submitted Luo Feng's name (and seeing he was a new recruit), he woke up the other 3 commanders to have them observe Luo Feng.

He and the other commanders observed Luo Feng as he made it through the levels of Wu Qi Tower until they could no longer see his actions (when he reached the 8th floor). He also joined the other 3 commanders in greeting Luo Feng when he passed Wu Qi Tower's 9th floor, expressing his joy and relief that they had finally completed the task given to them by Jin God King.

characters.title: Black Shadow Eternal True God
characters.introText: A simple old man. When attacking, he turned into a black shadow.
characters.appearance: A simple old man. When attacking, he turned into a black shadow.
characters.history: Black Shadow Eternal True God is the non-canon name given to the Eternal True God killed during the Heart Shadow Sect's looting of Hu Yang City due to fighting back against having his body searched. He could be considered an expert living in seclusion, forcing one of the sect's elders to take action with a super-large Mechanical Treasure. He killed thousands of sect disciples before being killed, and was satisfied to die in his hometown after killing those disciples.

characters.title: Black Sky Seigneur
characters.introText: A black crystal giant a million kilometers tall, he holds a huge red sledgehammer in each of his six thick arms.
characters.appearance: A black crystal giant a million kilometers tall, he holds a huge red sledgehammer in each of his six thick arms.
characters.history: Black Sky Seigneur is a renowned being in the universe, but he rarely showed himself, as he had been living in the Ancient Chin Secret Region. That area was known as his territory, but it was the home of Blood Cloud Palace Master! Black Sky Seigneur is one of the 3 Top Universe Overlords who were cultivated by Sitting Mountain Guest. As a Special Lifeform, Sitting Mountain Guest felt that he should defend them and give them a safe place to live and grow. Black Sky Seigneur is the strongest of those who follow Sitting Mountain Guest in his guise of Blood Cloud Palace Master. Those followers treat Blood Cloud Palace Master as their master, respecting and worshiping him from the bottom of their hearts.

characters.title: Black Tide Ancestor

infobox.friends: Giant God Emperor Chaotic Origin Beast Ancestor

characters.introText: Black Tide Ancestor manifests as a massive black mist bird. His entire body is made up of endless black fog, like a living catastrophe. When he descends, the surrounding area is swallowed by a disaster domain, with the black mist continuously exuding ominous, destructive energy. In battle, his form becomes indistinguishable from the calamity itself, shrouding enemies in a relentless, suffocating tide.
characters.appearance: Black Tide Ancestor manifests as a massive black mist bird. His entire body is made up of endless black fog, like a living catastrophe. When he descends, the surrounding area is swallowed by a disaster domain, with the black mist continuously exuding ominous, destructive energy. In battle, his form becomes indistinguishable from the calamity itself, shrouding enemies in a relentless, suffocating tide.
characters.personality: He is a quiet and aloof existence, rarely interfering in external conflicts. Though recognized as part of the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction, he acts independently, choosing its own stance and actions. Black Tide Ancestor doesn’t engage unless the situation is critical or when supporting close allies like Giant God Emperor and Chaotic Origin Beast Ancestor. He is cold, observant, and rarely speaks unless necessary.
characters.history:
Black Tide Ancestor is one of the Nine Sovereigns of the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction, but unlike most, he has no clan or followers. He is a unique lifeform, born directly from the depths of the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Despite his independence, he acknowledges the Giant God Emperor's leadership and has a strong cooperative bond with both Giant God Emperor and Hunyuan Beast Ancestor.
In the war against the Cultivator Camp, he joined forces with them to form an unbeatable trio, contributing his powerful disaster field to trap targets like Luo Feng.

characters.title: Black Universe Creator
characters.introText: A human form wearing black armor. The black armor was engulfed in fire, and a huge phantom stood behind it in the space. Its palm alone was a few million kilometers tall. There were stars in the phantom, as if it were a universe in itself. When he spoke, a fiery head showed up in the golden flame.
characters.appearance: A human form wearing black armor. The black armor was engulfed in fire, and a huge phantom stood behind it in the space. Its palm alone was a few million kilometers tall. There were stars in the phantom, as if it were a universe in itself. When he spoke, a fiery head showed up in the golden flame.
characters.history:
A lone True God who led no powers nor territories, he fought his way through extremely famous battles. Born as a Special Lifeform, he was considered one of most ancient beings in the Original Universe. His powers allowed him to be arrogant.

When Yuan Ao Master used the Divine Wood to hold off multiple Universe Masters, he showed up to assist them in suppressing him, in exchange for him obtaining the Divine Wood. However, fearing that he would be sealed, Yuan Ao Master offered to trade the Divine Wood to Black Universe Creator in exchange for his assistance escaping. Eventually, Yuan Ao Master was forced to self-destruct, and Black Universe Creator obtained the Divine Wood he sought and left the battle.

When the 5 other pinnacle races joined forces to attack the Human Race, he was one of the solo True Gods who joined the Allied Forces Military Camp.

characters.title: Black Wind
characters.introText: Black Wind is one of the 5 Invincible Immortal Kings trapped in Ice Prison. A Special Lifeform with a Life Gene Level of 60, they are considered by Si Bo Wa to be the 4th-strongest creature trapped in Ice Prison. Black Wind got their name based on their appearance.

↑ Volume 17, Chapter 35 - Chapter 923: Top 10 Kings

characters.title: Blade Edge God Marquis
characters.introText: An intrepid man wearing golden armor. His face is covered in gold scales and on his forehead is a golden horn, curved like a scimitar. His entire being was like a golden blade that created the world!
characters.appearance: An intrepid man wearing golden armor. His face is covered in gold scales and on his forehead is a golden horn, curved like a scimitar. His entire being was like a golden blade that created the world!
characters.history:
Blade Edge God Marquis is an Immortal Marquis of the Virtual Universe Company. He comes from the Sword Clan, and looks much like Bai Kaluo. He was made aware of Luo Feng at the conclusion of Luo Feng's 3 years of losers' circle battles during the Pinnacle Genius Battle, and was impressed that the improvements he had made between his loss to Rong Jun and the losers' circle battles.

He noted that Rong Jun had no chance to achieve the #1 spot in the Pinnacle Genius Battle due to an exceptional genius participating, but that he could make it to the top 10.

characters.title: Blazing Fire God King
characters.introText: Blazing Fire God King is the God King of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom, presiding over one of its sacred domains and holding significant authority within the kingdom’s hierarchy. He appears as a figure wreathed in flames and speaks from a throne enveloped in blazing fire. When (Zuo Shanjin|Sitting Mountain Guest) arrives at Thunder Mountain seeking to cultivate Chaotic Origin Bloodline, the Blazing Fire God King personally receives him and outlines the conditions for obtaining the bloodline inheritance. He makes it clear that simply becoming a permanent member of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom only grants eligibility, as mastering the Chaotic Origin Bloodline still requires great willpower and deep accumulation in the Dao. The Blazing Fire God King also warns that those who lose control over the bloodline will be imprisoned for ten thousand eras, and executed if they fail to regain their sanity.

characters.title: Blood Blade
characters.introText: Blood Blade was an Advanced God of War who had a grudge against Fang You, one of the members of the Extreme Martial Club. Since Fang You had long passed away in the wilderness, Blood Blade took his anger out on all of Fang You's family, killing all of them. This sparked public outrage, and Hong investigated the matter, determining that Blood Blade was the culprit. He used all of the world governments' information networks as well as the HR Alliance to locate Blood Blade, then sent an Inspector to hunt him down. This inspector brought 36 Gods of War with him to hunt down Blood Blade, causing Blood Blade to commit suicide rather than be caught and tortured.

characters.title: Blood Cloud
characters.introText: Blood Cloud is extremely cautious, never revealing his true strength in Hu Yang City, even in his battles with Moli Xiao and his Legion-type Mechanical Treasure. While he works for the Food Kingdom, his ultimate goal is not to fight for the kingdom, but to acquire the resources necessary to break through to Primal Chaos Sovereign. He stays low-key and has not built up a huge reputation on the Continent of Origin, despite his incredible strength. While risk-averse, he is also heartless, willing to do whatever is necessary to obtain greater power.
characters.appearance: A white-robed figure wearing a red mask.
characters.personality: Blood Cloud is extremely cautious, never revealing his true strength in Hu Yang City, even in his battles with Moli Xiao and his Legion-type Mechanical Treasure. While he works for the Food Kingdom, his ultimate goal is not to fight for the kingdom, but to acquire the resources necessary to break through to Primal Chaos Sovereign. He stays low-key and has not built up a huge reputation on the Continent of Origin, despite his incredible strength. While risk-averse, he is also heartless, willing to do whatever is necessary to obtain greater power.
characters.history:
Blood Cloud was an Eternal True God from the Food Kingdom, stationed in Hu Yang City in one of their branches, and was the leader of their stronger forces stationed in the city. Blood Cloud was associated with the Blood Python Guild, and was contacted by Mu Yang for assistance.

Blood Cloud and Moli Xiao have fought each other more than once, and despite Moli Xiao using a Legion-type Mechanical Treasure, he was unable to subdue him. The Flame Wind Guild Hall's Dark Hall had a bounty task to kill him, with a bounty of 1 million Universe Sands, the second-highest bounty offered for any resident of Hu Yang City.

His boss, Lord Liu Yin had given him the mission of learning the details behind the Hu Yang City Formation, and Blood Cloud took his time in doing so, refusing to undertake great risks. Desiring swift completion of this task, Liu Yin sent Yu Tian Yi and Yu Tian Hu of the Five Gods of Yu Tian to assist him. After he defeated Yu Tian Hu, Blood Cloud took charge of this team, but even with the increased support, he refused to take unnecessary risks. When capturing the Eternal True Gods who worked on the formation, he decided against capturing Entropy Sky Flame, since he was Luo Feng's best friend in the city (it is possible that his own friendship was a factor, but considering future events, this does not seem likely).

After reaching a bottleneck in practicing the Bloodline Cultivation Method, he began comprehending the Original Laws, increasing his ability to tap the potential of his bloodline. He had 9 Primal Chaos Sovereign Techniques, giving him great hope of breaking through to Primal Chaos Sovereign.

While his Divine Body was not as strong as that of Eternal True Gods with an Infinite Divine Body, his techniques and Realm enabled him to fight off General Yong, even when the latter used the Hu Yang City Formation.

Later, it was revealed that Blood Cloud has been living in Hu Yang City under the guise Sang Shui Yun. Entropy Sky Flame, as a close friend of his, realized who he was after his battle with General Yong, which resulted in the deaths of over 8 billion True Gods. Blood Cloud killed Entropy Sky Flame when he confronted him with his true identity, which had the consequence of his identity being shared with multiple Eternal True Gods of the city. Lord Jiu Jiang increased his bounty from 1 million Universe Sands to 10 million Universe Sands in hopes of enticing an extremely powerful Eternal True God to take up the bounty mission.

Blood Cloud was killed by Luo Feng (through the use of Lie Yuan Technique) in a one-sided battle while trying to escape to the Food Kingdom.

characters.title: Blood Cloud Palace Master
characters.introText: He's a ferocious being, wearing a fiery cape, blood-red armor, and a blood-red mask. He has two golden horns on his head and a scaled tail. He exudes endless ferocity.
characters.appearance: He's a ferocious being, wearing a fiery cape, blood-red armor, and a blood-red mask. He has two golden horns on his head and a scaled tail. He exudes endless ferocity.
characters.personality:
Over his years as Blood Cloud Palace Master, Sitting Mountain Guest saved a few thousand Special Lifeforms, allowing them to recognize him as their master. They comprise a substantial force, with 3 Top Universe Overlords (Black Sky Seigneur, Venerable Silver Dragon, and Thorn Crow Devil Master), 15 other Universe Venerables who were at least as strong as Advanced Universe Venerables, hundreds of Immortals, and thousands of World Masters.

Managing this force is another responsibility of the Blood Cloud Palace Master position.
characters.history:
Over his years as Blood Cloud Palace Master, Sitting Mountain Guest saved a few thousand Special Lifeforms, allowing them to recognize him as their master. They comprise a substantial force, with 3 Top Universe Overlords (Black Sky Seigneur, Venerable Silver Dragon, and Thorn Crow Devil Master), 15 other Universe Venerables who were at least as strong as Advanced Universe Venerables, hundreds of Immortals, and thousands of World Masters.

Managing this force is another responsibility of the Blood Cloud Palace Master position.
characters.trivia: Sitting Mountain Guest's Blood Cloud Palace Master body has somewhat unclear strength; he is explicitly described as a pinnacle Universe Master (Tier 3), but he has killed two other Universe Masters, something that would be difficult for an ordinary Tier 3 Universe Master, is explicitly stated to be superior to the Tier 3 Universe Master Sinking Fire Master, and is stated to be comparable to Primal Chaos City Leader. The latter two statements, coupled with the increase of his assessment after Luo Feng's fight with Star River Master, imply that he may have been Top-Tier Universe Master Level 3 in the past, but Luo Feng's Blood Cloud Palace Master is akin to Top-Tier Universe Master Level 4.

characters.title: Blood Devil
characters.introText: A messy-haired, 3 meters tall wild warrior. He had blood-red eyes and carried 2 large machetes on his back.
characters.appearance: A messy-haired, 3 meters tall wild warrior. He had blood-red eyes and carried 2 large machetes on his back.
characters.history: Blood Devil is the non-canon name given to the human, corrupted by the evil aura in the Huge Pit and tamed by Ba Qi and his Blood God Guards, who attacked Luo Feng. When Luo Feng entered the range of Ba Qi's forces, Blood Devil was released to kill him, but Luo Feng easily dispatched the mad creature.

characters.introText: Blood Dog is one of the 5 Invincible Immortal Kings trapped in Ice Prison. A Special Lifeform with a Life Gene Level of 200. Blood Dog was named thusly due to their appearance. Blood Dog was considered the strongest creature in Ice Prison by Si Bo Wa.

characters.introText: Blood Fire God-General is one of the 72 God Generals of the Ancestral God Sect. As such, his strength can rival common Universe Masters! He is the God General who reported Luo Feng's talent to Lightning Beast God and piqued his interest.
characters.appearance: Blood Fire God-General is one of the 72 God Generals of the Ancestral God Sect. As such, his strength can rival common Universe Masters! He is the God General who reported Luo Feng's talent to Lightning Beast God and piqued his interest.

characters.title: Blood Garment Marquis
characters.introText: Lian Luo, also known as Blood Garment Marquis, was the Number 1 genius of a previous Pinnacle Genius Battle. He studied the 9 Universe Primal Chaos Tablet during his time at Primal Chaos City and created the Floating Blood technique. After breaking through to Immortal, he was immediately given the title Blood Garment Marquis. He died in an expedition in a Secret Region, living fewer than 100,000 years.

He studied the 9 Universe Primal Chaos Tablet during his time at Primal Chaos City and created the Floating Blood technique. After breaking through to Immortal, he was immediately given the title Blood Garment Marquis. He died in an expedition in a Secret Region, living fewer than 100,000 years.
characters.trivia:
In the novel, Lian Luo's teacher is unnamed, but in the donghua, his teacher was King Zhenyan. Considering that Lian Luo chose the 9 Universe Primal Chaos Tablet and Zhenyan is the strongest sub-sect leader of that sect, it is possible that he was his teacher in the novel as well, but it was not specified.

He died in Devil Mountain

characters.title: Blood God Guard No. 1
characters.introText: Blood God Guard No. 1 is the non-canon name given to the captain of Ba Qi's Blood God Guards. Serving as Ba Qi's right-hand man, he is a World Master and was entrusted with showing Luo Feng the ropes when he joined the group.
