characters.title: Blood Lord

infobox.Aliases: The Blood Lord Lord of Blood
infobox.territory: Chaotic Origin Dimension Blood Crane Territory(former) Black River World Cluster
infobox.affiliation: Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction Blood Crane Clan

characters.introText: A slender figure with scaly wings and a body covered in delicate, blood-colored scales that look like beautiful crystal jade.
characters.appearance: A slender figure with scaly wings and a body covered in delicate, blood-colored scales that look like beautiful crystal jade.
characters.personality: The Blood Lord is calm, cautious, and strategic. Unlike the impulsive Shadow Lord or the evasive Crane Lord, he is measured in thought and speech. He understands the balance of power and doesn't let pride cloud judgment. When Luo Feng arrived, he quickly analyzed the threat and made a clear decision not to engage recklessly. He avoids unnecessary battles and prefers long-term stability and preservation of power over short-term victories. Despite being a powerful figure, he acknowledges Luo Feng’s superiority and chooses cooperation with his allies over solo action.
characters.history:
The Blood Lord is one of the three ancient rulers of the Blood Crane Territory. He has mastered life-based power surpassing even other Hunyuan Ancestors in this aspect. Alongside Crane Lord and Shadow Lord, he has tried and failed to refine the core origin of the Blood Crane Territory, showing that even top ancestors can struggle against the deeper laws of the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Though not the most physically powerful, the Blood Lord’s insight into life force makes him extremely hard to kill. His mastery of life makes him sensitive to other life fluctuations, allowing him to understand enemies like Luo Feng better than his peers.

When Luo Feng arrived and proved himself unstoppable, the Blood Lord did not panic. He calmly assessed Luo Feng's weakness in movement, instructed his allies to avoid confrontation, and watched Luo Feng’s actions carefully—especially when Luo Feng headed toward the origin of the blood sea.

characters.title: Blood Orchid Ancestor

infobox.friends: Firefly True Master Rampaging Devil God

characters.introText: Her true form is never seen, but she assumes the form of a woman whose entire body is surrounded by endless blood-colored flowers. She looks very finely adorned.
characters.appearance: Her true form is never seen, but she assumes the form of a woman whose entire body is surrounded by endless blood-colored flowers. She looks very finely adorned.
characters.personality: Blood Orchid Ancestor is an incredibly powerful True God, ranking just below the Eight Great Overlords of Universe Ocean. Since she is considered comparable to Rampaging Devil God, she is capable of True God Level 10 power, which she acquired by honing her skills in the World of Jin and acquiring Mechanical Treasures. During her time in Universe Ocean, she spent a long time training her Willpower at the Black-Striped Stone Pillars, so she was also very strong in that aspect. As a Plant Lifeform, she has an enormous Divine Body and thus a large reservoir of Divine Power. She is about as strong as a Pinnacle Stage 2 Sector Beast using their Blood Burning Method ability.
characters.history:
Blood Orchid Ancestor is a True God from the First Reincarnation Era, well-known for her evil personality and time spent cultivating her Willpower at the Black-Striped Stone Pillars. She stationed herself by the 9th of the 16 pillars. It was said that one must stay at least 1 million kilometers from where she was stationed, or else they risked being annihilated.

After the emergence of the World of Jin, Blood Orchid Ancestor eventually entered the world and honed her skills, becoming more powerful and acquiring Mechanical Treasures. Her strength was such that she was considered second only to the Eight Great Overlords of Universe Ocean.

When Firefly True Master's Miniature Universe was attacked by Morosa, Blood Orchid was the first to arrive to assist him, due to the relative proximity of their Miniature Universes and her friendship with he and his race. Despite her strength and their friendship, she wanted to wait for the other True Gods, as she felt that the Origin Will of the Original Universe would not have warned them about the Sector Beasts if the two of them together could defeat one.

When Nine-Headed Devil Master arrived, Blood Orchid followed his orders when the group of True Gods fought Morosa, shocking Morosa with her strength. When Morosa used Black Mist Cocoon on Firefly True Master, she did not hesitate to attack the cocoon with her Mechanical Treasure to attempt to break it, and when it changed to a column of black light, she tried to defend Firefly True Master, who was eventually killed. After Morosa fled, Blood Orchid and Nine-Headed Devil Master discussed the fight, eventually sharing their thoughts with Luo Feng, Nine Remoteness Master, Fire Dome, and Hong.

When Morosa showed up at Rampaging Devil God's Miniature Universe, she warned him that he would be the next Firefly True Master if he fought it. As part of Universe Ocean's strategy against Morosa, Blood Orchid was among the True Gods with large quantities of Divine Power who led groups of True Gods to attempt to consume Morosa's power.

After the Sector Beasts annihilated all of the Miniature Universes of the First and Second Reincarnation Eras, Blood Orchid was among the 6 True Gods from those eras to move to Luo Feng's Milky Way Holy Land Universe.

characters.title: Bloodstained Woman
characters.introText: Bloodstained Woman is the non-canon name given to the female Eternal True God of the Heart Shadow Sect who plundered the Cloud Treasure Tower branch in Hu Yang City. She ordered the owner, deputy owners, and all members present to hand over all of their treasures and allow her to personally search their entire bodies, including their True God's Heart. When a Void True God expressed their disagreement, she instantly killed them and the Void True Gods around them, then threatened the rest with death if they opposed. Facing the threat of death, all present gave up their treasures and allowed her to search them.
characters.appearance: A woman in bloodstained clothing.
characters.history:
Bloodstained Woman is the non-canon name given to the female Eternal True God of the Heart Shadow Sect who plundered the Cloud Treasure Tower branch in Hu Yang City. She ordered the owner, deputy owners, and all members present to hand over all of their treasures and allow her to personally search their entire bodies, including their True God's Heart. When a Void True God expressed their disagreement, she instantly killed them and the Void True Gods around them, then threatened the rest with death if they opposed. Facing the threat of death, all present gave up their treasures and allowed her to search them.

Considering Luo Feng's declaration at the conclusion of the battle between he and Lord Liu Yin, she was likely killed due to her actions at Cloud Treasure Tower.

characters.title: Bolan

infobox.cultivation: Stellar Level 9 Universe Level 9 Domain Master Level 9 World Master Level 9 Immortal King Universe Master
infobox.Aliases: Death God Reaper God of Death

characters.introText: A very handsome young man in white with two blood-red swords on his back. Lacking any expression on his face, his entire being was like a frozen mountain.
characters.appearance: A very handsome young man in white with two blood-red swords on his back. Lacking any expression on his face, his entire being was like a frozen mountain.
characters.personality: As befitting a once in every ten million years genius, Bolan is very prideful and determined. Once he made a decision, it was very difficult to get him to rethink it. Due to his upbringing and talent, he prefers solitude, but has a good character and eventually made friends with those he considered his peers.
characters.history:
Bolan is a Stellar Level genius hailing from the Noah Universe Country who participated in the same Pinnacle Genius Battle as Luo Feng. He is considered the most exceptional of the geniuses, to the point that the Immortals assumed he would win the competition.

Bolan grew up on an aboriginal planet, excluded from universe culture by the Immortal who lived there. There seemed to be no trace of technology on the planet at all, but the planet was still strong, with 10 Universe Level cultivators and many more Stellar Level ones.

On this planet, Bolan was trained by White-Robed Bald Old Man, who considered him the most impressive genius he had seen in his time wandering hundreds of millions of galaxies. As his final test, Bolan was surrounded by 100 Stellar Level 9 Warriors and Spirit Masters, then attacked. Bolan killed all of them in an instant, showcasing his skill and causing his teacher to note that he had nothing else to teach him. His teacher then ordered him to participate in the Pinnacle Genius Battle, where he can join the Virtual Universe Company and find a suitable teacher. Bolan was told to seek his teacher again when he broke through to Immortal.

Bolan in the Universe Country Elimination Stage

During the Noah Universe Country elimination and arena stages, Bolan showcased unbelievable talents in Law of Space , creating over 100 mirror images, meaning he had almost reached the 4th level of the 10,000 Thread Flow. Only 1 in 10,000 World Masters were capable of reaching the 4th level of the 10,000 Thread Flow technique, so for a Stellar Level warrior to be close was incredible! Every genius who saw him, including Luo Feng, wondered just how he had trained to reach this level. He was the undisputed number 1 of the competition, with the Immortals discussing his potential to become a Universe Venerable. When Venerable Nine Swords arrived to perform his role in the competition, the other Immortals noted that Nine Swords had shown a similar level of talent in his Pinnacle Genius Battle performance.

Bolan in the Training Space

During the Training Space Elimination, Bolan started off with incredible speed, ranking number 1 from the beginning. After starting the 2nd tower, he slowed down and was once overtaken for a bit, but he was one of the final 4 participants, along with Kandita, Yi Feng, and Luo Feng. The eliminated geniuses and the observing Immortals watched as he passed the 6th tower, becoming the first in that competition to do so. Those ranked 2 through 6 at the time had all died at the 1st level of the 6th tower, so his performance was indeed shocking! As Luo Feng fought through the 4th level of the 5th tower, he looked at the ranking on his wrist and saw that Bolan had indeed completed the 6th tower.

On the 1st level of the 7th tower, Bolan was injured, finally being forced to reveal his true strength. With his Law of Wind  domain and incredible speed, he killed 5,612 of the Blood Fur Mammoths, each of which was considered comparable to a top-100 genius of the competition! Despite his speed and power, he still failed on the 7th tower, but his display shocked all of the top-100 geniuses, who realized they had no chance against his power.

Bolan in the Arena Duels

As one of the top-100 from the Training Space Elimination, Bolan automatically qualified for direct entry into the core of the Virtual Universe Company (VUC). With his performance, the Immortals noted that if he had opposed how the VUC determined the 100 to fight the top-100, there was a chance his opposition would be considered, since he had been regarded as one to enter the Primal Secret Realm! Babata noted that with his talent, Bolan would indeed be highly valued, treated as a once in every 10 million years genius! If he became an Immortal, he would certainly be stronger than Hu Yan Bo! His strength was such that the VUC specially allowed the top-2 of the competition to join the Primal Secret Realm, as opposed to their normal practice of only allowing the top genius of the competition!

Bolan placing first

During the actual battles, Bolan easily made it to the top-20; his first opponent in the next set of battles was Tao. Everyone felt sorry for Tao, since they knew he had no chance, and he was indeed easily dispatched. When Luo Feng surprisingly defeated Jia Laixi, Bolan was one of the geniuses who observed in shock; Bolan was considered the only genius with a guarantee to defeat Jia Laixi, since his Consciousness was affected by the energy of the universe, enabling him to not be shaken by the illusions. He was also among those shocked at Rong Jun defeating Gu Si Luo.

In the final top-10 battles, Bolan defeated Long Yun, Rong Jun, Qian Shui, Ai Chen, and Wu Ka, placing number 1 in the competition, as expected.

Bolan's genius group sees the Primal Chaos Tablets

In his time on Yu Xiang Mountain, Bolan made friends with some of the other geniuses, who noticed that while he was a loner, he was still a good person. When their class of geniuses arrived in Primal Chaos City, the Immortals noted that he wasn't too bad of a talent. When the geniuses chose their Primal Chaos Tablets, Bolan chose the Universe Primal Chaos Tablet, seeking to master both Law of Space  and Law of Time  concurrently.

Bolan passes the 2nd level of the Tong Tian Bridge

In the batch's first attempt at the Tong Tian Bridge, Bolan was one of the two to pass the 1st level (along with Rong Jun), but he was the only one to pass the 2nd level. Thus, he received 2 extra chances to study the Universe Primal Chaos Tablet. Despite this display, no Universe Venerable sought him as a disciple, since the chance of him becoming one was so slim that picking him wasn't worth it to the Venerables.  Despite Rong Jun being chosen by a Universe Venerable as a disciple, Bolan still saw no one as his rival except himself.

Bolan passes the 5th level of the Tong Tian Bridge

Within his first year in Primal Chaos City, Bolan attempted and cleared the 3rd level of the Tong Tian Bridge, prompting over 100 other geniuses, including Luo Feng, to attempt the bridge. At some point, he made it to the 7th island of Fantasy Ocean, showing strong Willpower and Consciousness strength, but inferior to Luo Feng's. About nine and a half years into his time in Primal Chaos City, Bolan passed the 4th level of the bridge. In her observation of Bolan under Venerable Nine Swords' orders, King Longyu noted that his talent was exceptional, passing the 4th level of the bridge in half the time she expected him to take. When discussing his talents with King Zhenyan and King Tong Nan, Zhenyan noted that despite Bolan's talent, his movement was not as perfect and precise as Luo Feng's, who had decided to focus on space law. With Luo Feng's improvement, the Immortals began to note that if you excluded Bolan's initial lead, Luo Feng had essentially caught up with him. In his 19th year in Primal Chaos City, he passed the 5th level of the bridge on the same day that Luo Feng passed the 4th level.

Bolan challenging the 6th level of the Tong Tian Bridge

At the end of their 30 years in Primal Chaos City, he and Luo Feng attempted the bridge one last time, with Luo Feng passing the 5th level and Bolan passing the 6th level. As one who had passed the 6th level of the Tong Tian Bridge, Bolan again showed that he was indeed a once in every ten million years genius! By this time, Bolan had begun to see Luo Feng as his true rival. In discussing Bolan's talent, Kandeli noted that he preferred Luo Feng, as he had focused on a solid foundation in space law, rather than splitting his focus between space law and time law. In their departure to the physical Secret Realms of the Virtual Universe Company, it is implied that Bolan stared at Luo Feng, with the two of them confirming in their thoughts that they were rivals.

Luo Feng and Bolan, rivals

As a Primal Secret Realm member, Bolan lived relatively close to Long Yun, who informed him when Luo Feng passed the 6th level of the Tong Tian Bridge. Driven by Luo Feng's ascent to his level, Bolan attempted the 7th level, despite it having been only 2 years since he passed the 6th level. Bolan failed, as expected, since while his Law of Space  comprehension could reach the 9th level of the bridge, his Law of Time  comprehension only reached the 3rd or 4th level, holding him back. While observing Bolan's failure, Bevin noted that due to his talent, he was too prideful, causing him to not take the advice of the Immortals who told him to focus solely on space law and to instead choose the most difficult of the Primal Chaos Tablets, the Universe Primal Chaos Tablet.

Due to Bolan's pride, Tian Shi Palace Master actually chose Luo Feng and Rong Jun over him as talents, and favored Luo Feng above Rong Jun.

Bolan following Luo Feng's battle with Jia Laixi

After Luo Feng's 80 years spent in Blood River World, Wu Ka told him that Bolan had failed the 7th level of the Tong Tian Bridge two years prior and failed again on the day they spoke. After Luo Feng failed to pass Primal Sky Mountain, King Zhenyan informed him that geniuses stronger than he or Bolan by 10 to 100 times had appeared in the past, including Kedi. He also shared with Luo Feng that the Universe Venerables did not favor Bolan either, since they had seen many geniuses similar to him and thus knew their pitfalls.

With his acquisition of the Beast God Statue combined with his Golden Horned Beast Body and Mosha Body talents in Law of Space , Luo Feng dramatically improved in his space law comprehension, allowing him to pass the 7th level of the bridge about a half year after he had returned from Blood River World. Bolan learned of this and was shocked into dropping his blade on the floor, acknowledging that Luo Feng had surpassed him. Speaking with his Immortal teacher, he finally realized that he had been too proud in trying to comprehend both space law and time law concurrently, and decided to focus on space law. He then began to follow his teacher's training plan.

Bolan passes the 7th level of the Tong Tian Bridge

Two years prior to his batch's first Secret Realm Qualification Battle, he passed the 7th level of the bridge, about 4 years after Luo Feng. During the qualification battle, he defeated Long Yun, but lost to Mo Luo, Fei Tuo, and Simayan, placing him in the bottom 3 of the Primal Secret Realm. During his meeting with the top 3 of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm and the bottom 3 of the Primal Secret Realm, he witnessed Luo Feng's attack on Mo Luo and commented that it was vicious. He did not know of Mo Luo's treachery.

Bolan then had to fight against the top 3 of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm, including Luo Feng. In an exciting battle (due to Luo Feng holding back to show respect to his friend), he lost to Luo Feng. Luo Feng noted that without the Devil's Voice God General Inheritance, he would not have been able to defeat Bolan, which shocked him! Since Bolan also lost to Mo Luo, Ke Luo Fu, and Yu Feng, he was demoted to the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm.

Bolan sends off Luo Feng

Bolan met with the others from the top-10 of his genius class in sending off Luo Feng, who had decided to break through to Domain Master. At the time, he questioned Luo Feng on if he had a guarantee of passing the 10th level of the Tong Tian Bridge by the time of the next qualification battle. When Luo Feng passed the 13th level of the bridge, Bolan had recently passed the 8th level, still considered exceptional among Universe Level cultivators.

In the 800 years in Primal Chaos City since Luo Feng was accepted as a disciple in name to Primal Chaos City Leader, Bolan returned to the Primal Secret Realm as a Domain Master. He attempted to contact Luo Feng once during his 6,092 years spent undergoing the inheritance of Star Tower, having recently become a World Master himself.

When Luo Feng successfully passed the World Master Primal Sky Mountain, Bolan met with Wu Ka and Rong Jun to discuss their plans to surpass him. At this time, he was a Primal Secret Realm World Master, but would probably be demoted to the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm if there was an immediate Secret Realm Qualification Battle. He and Rong Jun aimed to become Universe Venerables, but were still somewhat discouraged after Luo Feng passed the 20th level of the bridge.

After Luo Feng became a Universe Venerable, it was noted that Bolan and Rong Jun had become Immortal Kings (around 110,000 years after their Pinnacle Genius Battle). By the end of the story, Bolan had become a Universe Master.

characters.introText: Boye Zhu, also an Immortal Army Lord, is a robust human warrior whose appearance is likened to being forged from bronze, with flames burning around him, signifying his powerful and fiery combat style. He leads alongside Shu Fan, commanding a human army on Misty Sand Island, a key fragment of the Yan Ji Continent. During a fierce battle against a Demon Race Army led by a Time-Space Nightmare Beast Immortal, Boye Zhu faces significant pressure, nearly facing defeat until Luo Feng’s intervention. He expresses deep gratitude to Luo Feng, whom he knows as "Yang," and values the potential of forming a connection with such a powerful figure. Boye Zhu is depicted as a hospitable leader, offering Luo Feng a warm reception with a feast and sharing details about the battlefield, including the dangers of Mist Sand Island and the presence of powerful entities like the 12 confirmed Immortal Marquis.

In the Donghua, she maintains the same ethereal appearance but as a young woman. Her attire features cosmic depictions, with galaxies adorning her bosom, near her knees, and her inner thighs.
characters.history:
Brolin is the 9th Prince of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire, and the grandson of the World Master Hargrave. Due to his status, he was accompanied by a team of Stellar Level 9 bodyguards during his Universe Trainee Mercenary Exam. When the World Within a World was revealed, he wanted to get all of the treasures left by Kabu for himself, and with Hargrave's assistance, out of the 500,000 sent by the empire, 220,000 followed his orders.

He was ruthless in his efforts; one of his bodyguards immediately killed a Hundred Tigers Building member who spoke against him obtaining all of the treasures. His forces used C2 Grade Laser Guns to kill trainees, and when he became aware of Luo Feng obtaining at least one treasure, he ordered his subordinates to track and attack him, resulting in the death of Tie Nan He.

At the conclusion of the excavation of the World Within a World, he ordered his forces to kill 12 important members of the Three Axe Mountain contingent, including Luo Feng. While he was unsuccessful in killing Luo Feng, the other 11 died and he obtained their treasures. Unfortunately, he was unable to get the final password to the inheritance crystal, resulting in Hargrave having to exchange most of his wealth with Jiang Tian Chen in exchange for the password. This resulted in Hargrave losing stature within the empire, which also impacted Brolin.

He visited Black Dragon Mountain and attempted to obtain information on Luo Feng, and ended up discussing the upcoming Pinnacle Genius Battle. He watched with disdain as Luo Feng finished as #3 in the training space component of the competition, realizing he no longer had any chance of harming him.
characters.trivia:
In the novel, Brolin's name is 布罗林(Bù luō lín), while in the donghua the name is 布洛琳(Bù luò lín)

In the novel, Brolin is explicitly a male (九皇子(jiǔ huángzǐ), lit. Nine Prince), while in the donghua Brolin is explicitly a female (九皇女(jiǔ huángnǚ), lit. Nine Princess)

Qiu Yi is an extremely powerful Eternal True God member of the Heart Shadow Sect who returned to the sect to assist it in establishing its foundation in Hu Yang City. He only provides his assistance to their efforts to take over the city due to his relationship with the sect master, Feng Yu Qi.

In the past, Qiu Yi was only a relatively outstanding Eternal True God, but by the time of the attack on Hu Yang City, he was almost as powerful as Heart Eye Elder. He served as part of the hidden power of the sect when they launched their attack. After Luo Feng began killing members of the sect, Qiu Yi controlled the Heart Shadow Devil General as part of the Great Destruction Matchless Formation to attempt to hold him off.

In the aftermath of the Battle of Hu Yang City, it is implied that Qiu Yi was allowed to survive with a lesser punishment since he did not needlessly slaughter the weak.

characters.introText: Bu Huan Master is a Universe Master member of the Hongmeng. Due to their True God-level Willpower, they did not pass out from the Willpower shock the spread from Luo Feng's Remote Ocean Body when he began practicing phase 3 of Na Yin Secret Technique.
characters.history: Bu Huan Master is a Universe Master member of the Hongmeng. Due to their True God-level Willpower, they did not pass out from the Willpower shock the spread from Luo Feng's Remote Ocean Body when he began practicing phase 3 of Na Yin Secret Technique.

characters.title: Bu Kang Duo
characters.introText: Bu Kang Duo was part of a group of Gold Horn Race youth who wanted to challenge Luo Feng as it was rare for Humans to show up on Laos World and few Humans would accept their challenge.
characters.history:
Bu Kang Duo was part of a group of Gold Horn Race youth who wanted to challenge Luo Feng as it was rare for Humans to show up on Laos World and few Humans would accept their challenge.

As the Gold Horn Race prided themselves on fairness, they would challenge cultivators of the same cultivation rank as them. Hence it can be inferred that Bu Kang Duo is at Domain Master Level 9 since he dared to challenge Luo Feng who was at the cultivation rank at that time. Unfortunately for him, Luo Feng turned down his request.

characters.title: Bu Luo Nuolanshan
characters.introText: He's a tall, handsome middle-aged looking man with the pointy ears and red eyes characteristic of the Nuolan Shan Family. He wears a silver battle uniform.
characters.appearance: He's a tall, handsome middle-aged looking man with the pointy ears and red eyes characteristic of the Nuolan Shan Family. He wears a silver battle uniform.
characters.personality:
Bu Luo Nuolanshan is an heir of the Nuolan Shan Family, and the grandson of the 2nd head patriarch, De Wen Nuolanshan. He has an antagonistic relationship with the other heirs of the family, including Pula Nuolanshan.

During his travels in the universe, he and his crew drove their scout ship into a wormhole, unexpectedly coming out in the Milky Way Galaxy, near Earth. Upon learning where they ended up, he obtained a map of the area and confirmed two life planets in the vicinity, deciding to head to Earth and see what treasures awaited.

After hacking into Earth's news networks, he learned of the Golden Horned Beast attack, and that the strongest fighters were only Planetary Level. Watching video of Luo Feng, Hong, and Lei Shen, he understood there was definitely treasure left behind by Hu Yan Bo, and excitedly looked forward to attaining it and increasing his position within the family.

Despite his work behind the scenes with his grandfather, getting a guarantee that he would be presented with the title of Eternal Elder, he met his end when he arrived on Earth and was surprised by the slave soldiers Luo Feng had purchased. After being subdued by the Black Meng slave soldiers, he attempted to buy time for himself by lying to Luo Feng and the others, but under spirit hypnosis, they learned of the existence of the Nuolan Shan family and Pula's ship en route to Earth.

characters.trivia:
In the novel, his death is not specified (it is implied that he died at the hands of one of the Black Meng Race slaves), while in the donghua, Luo Feng kills him in battle with his Golden Horned Beast Body.

In the novel, Bu Luo's actions are not illegal, as Earth was considered an ownerless planet, while in the donghua, Nuolan Shan states that Bu Luo was kicked out of the family before he took action on Earth. This implies that despite Earth being ownerless, it was still illegal for Bu Luo to do what he did (or that a sort of case could be built against the Nuolan Shan Family if both Bu Luo and Pula attacked Earth while representing the family)

characters.title: Bu Luo Subordinate
characters.introText: A fit, tall, and sturdy man, with some black facial hair. In the novel he described as looking almost like a chimpanzee. He is about 2.2 meters tall.
characters.appearance: A fit, tall, and sturdy man, with some black facial hair. In the novel he described as looking almost like a chimpanzee. He is about 2.2 meters tall.
characters.history: Bu Luo Subordinate is the non-canon name given to Bu Luo Nuolan Shan's top subordinate. When the team discovered Earth, he was concerned that there would be a battle within the Nuolan Shan Family over the rewards, resulting in Bu Luo and his team getting a small reward. He was excited when they discovered the treasures on Earth that were left by Hu Yan Bo. He immediately surrendered when confronted by the Black Meng Race slaves under Luo Feng's command, and was presumably killed with the rest of his team.

characters.title: Bu Na
characters.introText: Bu Na is an Immortal Marquis known as Burning Heart Marquis. Under the command of Nightmare Candle King, he captured Xu Xin to force Luo Feng to come to Earth, so that he could buy the rights to Earth.
characters.appearance: A tall and sturdy silver-armored bald man.
characters.history: Bu Na is an Immortal Marquis known as Burning Heart Marquis. Under the command of Nightmare Candle King, he captured Xu Xin to force Luo Feng to come to Earth, so that he could buy the rights to Earth.

characters.title: Bu She La
characters.introText: A black battle-armored woman about three meters tall, with a pair of black feathered wings and dozens of sharp horns of varying lengths growing from his forehead.
characters.appearance: A black battle-armored woman about three meters tall, with a pair of black feathered wings and dozens of sharp horns of varying lengths growing from his forehead.
characters.history: Bu She La is one of the disciples of Phantom Spirit King. She brought Luo Feng and Hong to her palace so Hong could attempt to pass the 18 Loves and Desires Dreamlands.

characters.title: Bu Te A Shen Ka
characters.introText: A very kind-looking old man with long silver hair and a white beard.
characters.appearance: A very kind-looking old man with long silver hair and a white beard.
characters.history: Bu Te A Shen Ka is a high-level influential figure in the Black Dragon Mountain Empire. After Luo Feng placed 51st in the Ganwu Universe Country Elimination Stage of the Pinnacle Genius Battle, Black Dragon Mountain Emperor sent him to congratulate Luo Feng. He is the one who suggested to the Emperor that if Luo Feng's placement is within the top 1,000 in Ganwu Universe Country, Luo Feng will get the Milky Way Galaxy as a Reward.

characters.title: Bu Ya
characters.introText: Bu Ya was one of the 3 Bu Han Race Universe Venerables who pursued Luo Feng per the orders of Dream Demon Ancestor. He knew they had to stay at least 50 million kilometers away from Luo Feng, as they were much weaker than him, but did not know that he could perform Domain Technique. Luo Feng easily killed him along with his clansmen with his Universe Master Ultimate Technique, Golden Light.
characters.appearance: A short, stocky, bearded man.

characters.title: Bubulu
characters.introText: A messy haired dwarf less than 1.6 meters tall. On his body one could smell alcohol.
characters.appearance: A messy haired dwarf less than 1.6 meters tall. On his body one could smell alcohol.
characters.personality: Bubulu is a bit eccentric, speaking loudly and smelling of alcohol, but he both gives and appreciates respect.
characters.history: Bubulu is a Pinnacle Immortal Marquis who specializes in Gold Law, Space Law, and fusing the two. At King Zhenyan's request, he helps guide Luo Feng in his comprehension of the three, as well as developing his claw techniques. He is the creator of the 3,000 Starry Sky technique, and seeks to pass it to Luo Feng after witnessing his Sky Tearing Claw technique.

characters.title: Buddy
characters.introText: Skinnier, with fur on his face, resembling a werewolf.
characters.appearance: Skinnier, with fur on his face, resembling a werewolf.
characters.history: Buddy is one of the first two Pinnacle World Masters that Luo Feng met when he arrived at Cang Bird Planet to join the Extraterritorial Battlefield. He is Clarisse's younger brother and together the two took 12 years to travel to the planet. He seemed more humble than his older brother, nodding at Luo Feng and greeting him. As he was recognized by the Original Laws, he was probably considered an Elite World Master Soldier.

characters.title: Bullman Guardian
characters.introText: A tall and sturdy Bullman with horns on his head, with a terrifying huge axe.
characters.appearance: A tall and sturdy Bullman with horns on his head, with a terrifying huge axe.

characters.history:
Bullman Guardian is the non-canon name given to the Bullman Warrior on Primal Sky Mountain. It is not specified if this guardian also exists on the other Sky Mountains.

While the Bullman Guardian is a Virtual Universe construct, it has personality and seems to have memories. Its strength is determined by its location on Primal Sky Mountain (Foot, Middle, Peak) and the level of Primal Sky Mountain (Universe Level, Domain Master, World Master).

characters.title: Burly Commander
characters.introText: A tall, sturdy man with blood-colored armor, exuding endless, domineering power. His helmet has 9 sharp silver horns resembling scimitars.
characters.appearance: A tall, sturdy man with blood-colored armor, exuding endless, domineering power. His helmet has 9 sharp silver horns resembling scimitars.
characters.history:
Burly Commander is an Eternal True God who serves as one of the Four Commanders of God King Valley, given the order to find someone who could reach the top of Wu Qi Tower. As such, he has been sealed with the title 'Jin.' His throne in the silver palace was the third to the left. When Jin God King left, he had been a Void True God, but in the time since his departure, this commander broke through to Eternal True God. Due to the commands given to him by Jin God King, he could not leave the World of Jin.

When Black Mist Commander was observing Luo Feng's performance in Wu Qi Tower, he woke up the other three commanders, including Burly Commander, and told them to observe Luo Feng. Upon witnessing Luo Feng's body techniques, Burly Commander was moved and felt that he might actually reach the top of Wu Qi Tower.

When Luo Feng finished the tasks of Wu Qi Tower, Burly Commander introduced himself and the other 3 commanders to Luo Feng, then invited him inside the palace to wait for the four generals of the Jin Military.

characters.title: Burning Asia
characters.introText: Wears fiery red battle armor and wields two polygonal sledgehammers.
characters.appearance: Wears fiery red battle armor and wields two polygonal sledgehammers.
characters.history: Burning Asia was one of the 12 Immortal Marquises of Misty Sand Island and a member of the Ka Wu Race. He was killed by Luo Feng's Golden Horned Beast Body wearing General Armor after he came to get revenge for Long Suo.

characters.title: Bushi Ka
characters.introText: A tall and skinny man with silver bumps on his head.
characters.appearance: A tall and skinny man with silver bumps on his head.
characters.history:
Bushi Ka is an Immortal friend of Time World Master Luo. Luo brought Hong along while he studied the Original Laws in hopes of breaking through to Immortal. When the Ji Family discovered Hong's relationship with Ji Qing, they sent people to Bushi Ka's family residence, and may have killed Hong if not for his presence. Bushi Ka attempted to visit Ji Tian Cang on Hong's behalf, but the Silver Snow Marquis did not meet with him, causing him to lose face.

Due to his relationship with Hong, Bushi Ka was invited to the celebration banquet for Luo Feng's appointment as Supervisor Envoy of the Ganwu Universe Country. During the banquet, he noted that while Ji Tian Cang could disrespect him, he wouldn't dare to disrespect Luo Feng, due to his position. Later, he and Luo were present as Luo Feng explained King Fantasy Spirit's involvement in deterring Hong's relationship with Ji Qing, and he advised Hong to give up rather than fight through it.

characters.title: Candice Paulinus
characters.introText: This guy was nearly 1.9 m tall, but was quite skinny. His eyes were extremely cold and he naturally had an aristocratic feeling to him. While looking at the guy in front of him, Luo Feng connected him to the legendary beings--vampires!
characters.appearance: This guy was nearly 1.9 m tall, but was quite skinny. His eyes were extremely cold and he naturally had an aristocratic feeling to him. While looking at the guy in front of him, Luo Feng connected him to the legendary beings--vampires!
characters.history:
First heir to the Paulinus Family. Currently studying at Elite Training Camp in his third year. Broke the record for highest ranking during his first month. Broke the ranking for highest ranking within three years. Extremely talented. Honors the Code of Warriors (as such will not abuse situations outsiders have tempered with.)

Is planning on marrying Xu Xin in order to secure his position as heir to the Paulinus Clan.

Physical Strength is similar to a primary God of War. Can easily defeat primary Beast Generals. Has mastered Perfect Body Movement.

At the time of Luo Feng's death, he had broken through to Planetary Level, and he is one of the many to watch Atkin as he revealed to the world that Luo Feng was still alive.
characters.trivia:
While his appearance is the same in the novel and the donghua, his personality is completely different in the novel

In the light novel, Candice looks down on Chinese people and has no trace of honoring the 'Code of Warriors'; in fact, after Luo Feng defeats William he has his flunkies disturb Luo Feng in various ways (such as stealing Luo Feng's prey in the wilderness)

In the light novel, Candice was essentially raised by Venina, and treats her more as a mother than an aunt; she also guided his training

In the light novel, Candice desires Janet due to her looks and ability, rather than Xu Xin; this makes him jealous of Luo Feng, who Janet pursues

characters.title: Cang Jiang Clan Life
characters.introText: A tall, transparent creature 80 meters tall. It is covered in transparent leaves and vines.
characters.appearance: A tall, transparent creature 80 meters tall. It is covered in transparent leaves and vines.
characters.history:
Cang Jiang Clan Life is a Pinnacle Immortal King trapped in Ice Prison. It is ranked 611th of the 860 captives by Si Bo Wa. Despite only being a Pinnacle Immortal King, it has a high survivability due to its relatively large Divine Body and ability to use Teleportation.

Cang Jiang was originally a creature of the Cang Jiang Clan, one of the many Plant Lifeforms, but in a mishap while adventuring in a Secret Region, it changed into its current form, after mutation.

After noticing Luo Feng, a Human, trapped in Ice Prison, it hoped to kill him and gain access to the Virtual Universe. Due to the incredible amount of time it had spent trapped in Ice Prison, it hoped to feel the outside world and the Virtual Universe. Despite its relative strength, it was easily defeated by World Master Luo Feng, using the Star Map, Sealed Stars, and Fei Mo Poison to destroy 50% of its Divine Body.

After defeating it, Luo Feng asked what type of creature it was and why it attacked him without knowing his strength. In the following conversation, Luo Feng learned the total number of remaining prisoners, the existence of the 5 Invincible Immortal Kings and 10 Limit Immortal Kings with strength close to Invincible Immortal King, and the current state of Ice Prison.

characters.title: Canthus Devil Master
characters.introText: Canthus Devil Master is a top-tier Universe Master of the Prison Race. He arrived in the Yuan Ao Secret Region and worked alongside numerous Universe Masters and Black Universe Creator to corner Yuan Ao Master. He worked alongside Golden Horn Master to restrain Black Universe Creator when he decided to help Yuan Ao Master.
characters.appearance: He is towering, yet pale-looking.
characters.history:
Canthus Devil Master is a top-tier Universe Master of the Prison Race. He arrived in the Yuan Ao Secret Region and worked alongside numerous Universe Masters and Black Universe Creator to corner Yuan Ao Master. He worked alongside Golden Horn Master to restrain Black Universe Creator when he decided to help Yuan Ao Master.

When Yuan Ao Master separated the Pulling Traces Diagram into pieces, he seized around 5 pieces of the diagram.

Later, when the Human Race fought against the Demon Race, he reported news of the battle to Devil Ancestor.

characters.introText: The strongest fighter of the Paulinus family. He has enough strength to qualify for the head of the Paulinus Clan, yet declined the opportunity three years ago. He is good at making use of darts, empowering him with psychic power. The High Impact Phantom Attack has super explosive power.
characters.appearance:
The strongest fighter of the Paulinus family. He has enough strength to qualify for the head of the Paulinus Clan, yet declined the opportunity three years ago. He is good at making use of darts, empowering him with psychic power. The High Impact Phantom Attack has super explosive power.

He is said to be an absolute mighty warrior over whom both the Extreme Martial Club and the Thunder Dojo fight. He's the main reason why the Paulinus Clan enjoys so much respect within the HR Alliance.

characters.title: Cha Er Ta Ma
characters.introText: Cha Er Ta Ma is a Stellar Level genius who participated in the Pinnacle Genius Battle. He/she was Pa Er's first opponent in the 1v1 battle portion of the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Stage.
characters.history:
Cha Er Ta Ma is a Stellar Level genius who participated in the Pinnacle Genius Battle. He/she was Pa Er's first opponent in the 1v1 battle portion of the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Stage.

It is unknown who won between the 2 of them, but the victor would have faced off against Luo Feng in the 2nd round and would then have lost the match and be sent to the losers bracket where their final standing would remain unknown.

characters.title: Chakra
characters.introText: Chakra was a member of Three Axe Mountain who got one of the three passwords for the Inheritance Crystal Ball. A subordinate of Jiang Tian Chen, he transmitted the password to him before destroying the quantum computer that contained it. During the treasure hunt on the World Within a World on Cang Lan Planet, he broke through from Stellar Level 9 to Universe Level 1, making him one of the most powerful in the World Within a World.
characters.history:
Chakra was a member of Three Axe Mountain who got one of the three passwords for the Inheritance Crystal Ball. A subordinate of Jiang Tian Chen, he transmitted the password to him before destroying the quantum computer that contained it. During the treasure hunt on the World Within a World on Cang Lan Planet, he broke through from Stellar Level 9 to Universe Level 1, making him one of the most powerful in the World Within a World.

Chakra was killed on Jiang Tian Chen's orders to prevent the password from being leaked.

characters.title: Chan Muhe
characters.introText: Chan Muhe is a True God member of a team exploring the wilderness outside of Hu Yang City. They wish to become an Eternal True God.
characters.history: Chan Muhe is a True God member of a team exploring the wilderness outside of Hu Yang City. They wish to become an Eternal True God.

characters.title: Chan Wu Qi
characters.introText: A purple robed figure whose Divine Body appears to be formed of condensed black liquid. He has an extremely cold look in his eyes.
characters.appearance: A purple robed figure whose Divine Body appears to be formed of condensed black liquid. He has an extremely cold look in his eyes.
characters.history:
Chan Wu Qi was an Eternal True God disciple of the Heart Shadow Sect. When the sect invaded Hu Yang City, he killed Moyu Liuxing and some other members of the Moyu Tool-Refining Shop, which he revealed when Luo Feng arrived to rescue the remaining members.

After learning of Chan Wu Qi's actions, Luo Feng killed him with a casual point, sending an invisible blade light which instantly annihilated his Divine Body. This sparked a direct conflict between Luo Feng (and Morosa) and the Heart Shadow Sect.

characters.title: Chang Jiu Master
characters.introText: The status is second only to the two Demon Ancestors.
characters.history: The status is second only to the two Demon Ancestors.

characters.title: Chaotic Origin Beast Ancestor

infobox.friends: Giant God Emperor Black Tide Ancestor

characters.introText: Chaotic Origin Beast Ancestor appears as a fat, giant beast covered in ever-shifting, multicolored fur. His fur isn’t just decorative—each strand holds the power of boundless void. His true form is a domain, so immense and dense that every inch of space he occupies is composed of his body and will. When he manifests, he becomes a radiant field of colorful light that completely seals off the void, preventing even top-tier spacetime users like Xing Mang from manipulating the surrounding environment.
characters.appearance: Chaotic Origin Beast Ancestor appears as a fat, giant beast covered in ever-shifting, multicolored fur. His fur isn’t just decorative—each strand holds the power of boundless void. His true form is a domain, so immense and dense that every inch of space he occupies is composed of his body and will. When he manifests, he becomes a radiant field of colorful light that completely seals off the void, preventing even top-tier spacetime users like Xing Mang from manipulating the surrounding environment.
characters.personality: Unlike his intimidating form, the Chaotic Origin Beast Ancestor carries a gentle and even smiling demeanor. He avoids battle unless truly necessary and tends to be detached from factional politics. Despite having no followers or race, he acknowledges its role in the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction, mainly due to his strong alliance with Giant God Emperor and Black Tide Ancestor. Calm and perceptive, he prefers stability and rarely speaks unless important.
characters.history: Chaotic Origin Beast Ancestor is one of the Nine Sovereigns. He belongs to no race and has no territory, but his existence is among the strongest. He usually remains dormant, observing the changes of the universe from afar. His relationship with Titan Emperor and Black Tide Ancestor led him to participate in the war against the Cultivator Camp when the situation became critical. During the major clash, he acted as one of the core forces trapping Luo Feng. His domain completely suppressed any use of void-based abilities, making escape nearly impossible. However, when Luo Feng unleashed his forbidden technique, "Ten Billion Eight Hundred Million Origin Destruction," even the Chaotic Origin Beast Ancestor suffered, losing nearly one-tenth of his massive body. Though injured, he survived thanks to the extreme resilience of his domain-form body and the joint support of his two allies.
characters.trivia: He is the Ruler of 2nd Layer/Destruction World of Abyss Of Destruction.

infobox.cultivation: Perfect Stage High Chaotic Origin Lifeform

characters.introText: Cheng is the 2nd strongest of the High Chaotic Origin Lifeforms of the Dark World Group living in the Origin Land. He leads the surviving High-Level Hunyuan Lifeforms of the Dark World Group (other than Tian Lang Ke) to meet Luo Feng shortly after his arrival on the Origin Land.
characters.appearance: A thin old man with an ugly and vulgar appearance.
characters.history:
Cheng is the 2nd strongest of the High Chaotic Origin Lifeforms of the Dark World Group living in the Origin Land. He leads the surviving High-Level Hunyuan Lifeforms of the Dark World Group (other than Tian Lang Ke) to meet Luo Feng shortly after his arrival on the Origin Land.

He originally refined the World-Class Chaotic Origin Bloodline and reached the Perfect Stage of the High Chaotic Origin Lifeform. When Cheng was already at the High Chaotic Origin Lifeform stage, Overlord Xing Mang was only an Invincible God Emperor.
characters.trivia: Cheng appears in Lord Xue Ying as the inspector of the fifth domain under Luo Feng. The Thunder World Community, where Lord Xue Ying spent some time, fell under his authority, so he arrived to pick Xue Ying up. Xue Ying had no wish to be picked up, so he used the mark on his wrist to teleport to the Sacred World.

characters.title: Cheng Mu Master
characters.introText: Two-faced and four-armed and wears a green battle armor.
characters.appearance: Two-faced and four-armed and wears a green battle armor.
characters.history:
Cheng Mu Master was a Universe Master of the Purple Moon Race, of their second-weakest bloodline. As part of Purple Moon Ancestor's plan, he entered the World of Jin in hopes of getting one of the powerful Void True Gods to kill Luo Feng via Soul Attack, thus permanently killing him.

Cheng Mu joined one of the Special Troops of the World of Jin's military, and made friends with one of the Python River Army, Qu Hua. After learning that Luo Feng had returned to the military camp, he sprung into action, flying to Hu Hou and informing her that Luo Feng was an outsider to the World of Jin, self-destructing his body to prove his loyalty.

Unfortunately for Purple Moon Ancestor, Luo Feng had already become a titled member of the World of Jin, with 4 Eternal True Gods under his command, and was able to suppress Hu Hou through the strength granted him by the World of Jin.

Like the other members of the Purple Moon Race (other than Purple Moon Ancestor), he died when Morosa devoured the origin of Purple Moon Ancestor's Miniature Universe.

characters.title: Chinia
characters.introText: A lady with short, silver hair, dressed in a bright silver battle uniform. She subtly emanated a cold aura, as though she was the master and deity of the surrounding area.
characters.appearance: A lady with short, silver hair, dressed in a bright silver battle uniform. She subtly emanated a cold aura, as though she was the master and deity of the surrounding area.
characters.history:
Chinia is a Universe Mercenary Alliance Ganwu Special Envoy sent by her teacher to patrol the Black Dragon Mountain Starfield. During her time there, she learned of the existence of the World Within a World on Cang Lan Planet and took measures to control the situation. She prevented anyone above Stellar Level from entering the testing location once World within a World was discovered. The leader of the Ganwu Universe Country's 3rd Army (presumably an Immortal Marquis) is her teacher.

With the backing of her teacher, she prevented the World Masters Jiang Tian Chen, Ba Si Ha, and An Meng Zi from entering the World Within a World, forcing the major entities of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire to abide by the rules of the Universe Mercenary Alliance and send groups of Stellar Level cultivators to the World Within a World.
characters.trivia: In the Donghua, her role is replaced by Ji Qing.

characters.title: Chu Qiang
characters.introText: Senior of the Elite Training Camp, he is ranked 2 of the Black Dragon Tower Ranking. Joined the army and is tasked with protecting the base city. When he graduates from the training camp, he will be a commander of a special division in the Army.
characters.history:
Senior of the Elite Training Camp, he is ranked 2 of the Black Dragon Tower Ranking. Joined the army and is tasked with protecting the base city. When he graduates from the training camp, he will be a commander of a special division in the Army.

He is rumored to be one of two students who are able to consistently stay in the top 5 for extended periods of time, and since he is ranked higher than Shi Jiang who is at Apprentice Level 8 (Intermediate Level War God) strength, Chu Qiang's true strength can be scaled to Apprentice Level 8 (Intermediate Level War God).

characters.title: Chu Yu's Wife
characters.introText: Chu Yu's Wife is the non-canon name given to Di Chu Yu's wife. The two have had 3 children, but do not seem close at all. As the daughter of Feng Ye City Lord, she felt that her father would be chosen as Chu Yu's first Guest Official, so she was initially annoyed when Luo Feng took that position instead.
characters.appearance: A graceful woman.
characters.history:
Chu Yu's Wife is the non-canon name given to Di Chu Yu's wife. The two have had 3 children, but do not seem close at all. As the daughter of Feng Ye City Lord, she felt that her father would be chosen as Chu Yu's first Guest Official, so she was initially annoyed when Luo Feng took that position instead.

Later the Marquis's wife's heart was fervent after knowing Luo Feng won against Chu Ji Marquis and Marquis Chuyuan. Even children were happily clamoring 'Uncle Uncle' to Luo Feng. She arranges a banquet for Luo Feng on this occasion.

characters.history: Chun Yu Tao was the family elder of the Chun Yu Family, the #1 business family in the Swallow Mound City of Blood River World. He investigated the death of Chun Yu Chong, then was shocked to see the battle between Rock Wind Xiong and Luo Feng. Arriving at Rock Wind Xiong's mansion to get more details, he saw Luo Feng take the spoils of his victory, then watched him cut down the envoys of the Immortal Temple. Unfortunately for him, Luo Feng also discovered his location, and he was unable to escape his attack, dying from a single slash from his Mosha Clan body.

characters.introText: Ci Wei Ka is a Pinnacle Immortal Marquis of the Automaton Race. In the past, he was a weak Intelligent Life that evolved from the Spaceship his future master used. In this capacity, he had life or death experiences with his master, leading to him being highly valued and treated better than Immortal Kings who serve his master. The weapons and equipment he possesses are of incredible value for an Immortal Marquis, having been crafted by a Universe Venerable.
characters.appearance: An automaton youth wearing jade green armor.
characters.history:
Ci Wei Ka is a Pinnacle Immortal Marquis of the Automaton Race. In the past, he was a weak Intelligent Life that evolved from the Spaceship his future master used. In this capacity, he had life or death experiences with his master, leading to him being highly valued and treated better than Immortal Kings who serve his master. The weapons and equipment he possesses are of incredible value for an Immortal Marquis, having been crafted by a Universe Venerable.

Ci Wei Ka battles on the Extraterritorial Battlefield, and, when he is about halfway through completing his master's mission, encounters Luo Feng on the Yan Ji Continent. With the Scanning Device given to him by his master, he was able to detect Luo Feng without being detected himself, and he attacked him in hopes of acquiring his treasures, wealth, and contribution points. In their battle, he first used his 9 million strong F9 Grade Automaton Puppet army, cornering Luo Feng and forcing him to use his Golden Horned Beast Body. Unable to subdue the Golden Horned Beast with the puppet army, Ci Wei Ka used the powerful Nine Absolute God Country, but was unable to kill or even trap the beast. In the ensuing battle between his puppet army, the Golden Horned Beast, and Luo Feng's Zerg Race army, Ci Wei Ka lost one of the 9 ships from the Nine Absolute God Country, plus 1.53 million of his F9 Grade puppets.

In hopes of retrieving the stolen ship, Ci Wei Ka enlisted King Shiryo and King Jiu Jian to aid him in defeating the Golden Horned Beast. With the assistance of King Graceful Black, the trio obtained Luo Feng's location, but even when using the Hexagon Prison and Lockdown, they were unable to prevent the Golden Horned Beast from escaping through his flying ability and King Star Fantasy's Teleportation. Having failed to capture Luo Feng, Ci Wei Ka paid Shiryo and Jiu Jian about 200 million Indigo Gems each for their contributions and set to constructing a new plan to kill the Golden Horned Beast.
characters.trivia: While in the novel, Ci Wei Ka survives his encounters with Luo Feng's multiple bodies, in the donghua, he takes Ice Blade's place in the Sacrificial Tower arc, so he dies when King Ye Chen self-destructs.

characters.title: Ci Wei Ka's Master
characters.introText: Ci Wei Ka's Master is the non-canon name given to Ci Wei Ka's master. As a Universe Venerable of the Automaton Race, the master has considerable authority, such that even Immortal Kings can only communicate with them if they had a special opportunity.
characters.history:
Ci Wei Ka's Master is the non-canon name given to Ci Wei Ka's master. As a Universe Venerable of the Automaton Race, the master has considerable authority, such that even Immortal Kings can only communicate with them if they had a special opportunity.

Ci Wei Ka served under his master in life or death situations as their Spaceship's Intelligent Life, and as such, his master treats him as a brother, crafting him powerful weapons and giving him powerful treasures.

characters.title: City Lord Feng Qiao
characters.introText: He is tall, like a rock giant, and has golden eyes.
characters.appearance: He is tall, like a rock giant, and has golden eyes.
characters.personality: Feng Qiao is cautious and focused on limiting risk while maximizing profit.
characters.history:
Feng Qiao is an Ultra Limit God Emperor and the City Lord of Chengfeng City, one of the five cities of the Dark Holy Realm. He commands 28 other Ultra Limit God Emperors, making him extremely famous and well-respected, with the highest individual status in the city. As Dao Lord Long Jiu's most trusted junior brother, he has a broader perspective than others, and has abundant resources in addition to his high position.

Upon Luo Feng's arrival with his spoils from the Battle for Yulan City, Feng Qiao won the bid for their purchase, paying 7.3 trillion Hunyuan Crystals. He also directed his organization to make as much profit off the Low-Level Hunyuan Lifeform corpses as possible before securing the Battle Merits that Luo Feng purchased. When one of his subordinates suggested robbing Luo Feng, Feng Qiao noted that whether Luo Feng planned the ambush of Yulan City to profit or if his talent was just so terrifying that he grew so exceptionally during the battle, robbing him was a terrible decision.

After Luo Feng easily defeated God Emperor Mi Xu and his forces, showing Invincible God Emperor-level strength, Feng Qiao immediately sent a clone to Hunyuan City to hear his guidance on cultivation, making sure to inform Long Jiu when he arrived. Following their discussion, Feng Qiao informed God Emperor Bo Xiu, God Emperor Bai Yin, and God Emperor Chi Zheng of Long Jiu's desire to meet Luo Feng.

characters.title: Clear Eye Master
characters.introText: Silver Wings Seigneur? How dare you show yourself here...how brave you are. Ultimate Arrow...he has another body. I am unable to totally annihilate him to avenge you, but I can destroy this body of his.
characters.appearance: Wearing a white robe with skin that was smooth and clear like white jade, he also had the characteristic halo and single-eyed shadow typical of those of the Divine Eye Race.
characters.personality:
A disciple of Divine Eye True Master, he is especially skilled in soul attacks and illusion techniques. In his hands, the illusion-type Arcana Clear Light Mirror made a name for itself comparable to the Crazy Devil Extermination Godly Armor.

Long before he became a Universe Master, his family and friends from his youth had all passed away from old age. Eventually, due to living for close to 3 Reincarnation Eras, he had associated with other Universe Masters and formed friendship and groups. He and Ultimate Arrow Master were extremely close friends, so when Luo Feng caused the death of Ultimate Arrow Master, he had in his mind that he would kill one of his bodies if he encountered him.

While training his Willpower at the Black-Striped Stone Pillars within Universe Boat, he became aware of Luo Feng's approach and attacked him. Due to the combination of the Crazy Demon Extermination Godly Armor and Star Tower, Luo Feng was able to withstand his Clear Extermination of Reincarnation and physically counterattack, causing him to use his Pinnacle Arcana Domain to escape. Over 20 Universe Masters witnessed this battle, so the news eventually spread.

He died when a Sector Beast devoured Divine Eye True Master, killing him, destroying his Miniature Universe, and killing all whose life origin was tied to it, including Clear Eye Master.

characters.title: Craftsman God Master
characters.introText: A giant mountain range, 10 million kilometers high, with gigantic glass arms. At first look, he appears to have at least 100 gigantic arms. The stone face of the mountain bore an enormous pair of eyes.
characters.appearance: A giant mountain range, 10 million kilometers high, with gigantic glass arms. At first look, he appears to have at least 100 gigantic arms. The stone face of the mountain bore an enormous pair of eyes.
characters.history:
Craftsman God Master is a solo Universe Master, the master of Craftsman God Planet in the Yin Fa Secret Region. He is known as generous and friendly, and isn't as aloof as most Universe Masters. Existing near the beginning of the Original Universe as a Universe Venerable, he has always been passionate about crafting weapons, and is now known as the best weapon-maker in the universe. He is a Special Lifeform and as such, favored Special Lifeforms and allowed them to live a peaceful life on Craftsman God Planet.

In the past, he created Craftsman God Planet as both a protective home for himself and a primary tool in creating Arcana. Hundreds of great beings await his returns to Craftsman God Planet in hopes of either becoming a disciple of his in treasure-making or to acquire Arcana from him. They wait for thousands or tens of thousands of years, signifying his importance! He had 182 disciples in total, none of whom were Universe Masters. Some were Universe Venerables, and some were merely Immortals.

During his time as a Universe Venerable, Sitting Mountain Guest sat by his side and watched him work. While he was upset at the idea of someone stealing his skills, he could not stop him, as Sitting Mountain Guest was already a True God. However, Sitting Mountain Guest used his time to give pointers in terms of creating weapons. These pointers helped Craftsman God Master's skills increase by leaps and bounds, eventually resulting in him becoming a Universe Master. At this time, Sitting Mountain Guest advised that he couldn't provide any additional guidance. While he had never made Craftsman God Master an official disciple, never gave him any Arcana, nor taught him any self-cultivation techniques, from that point on, Craftsman God Master always treated Sitting Mountain Guest as a teacher, using the term teacher, and never refusing his commands.

When Luo Feng was searching for the 4th tablet of the Nine Volume Manual, it was placed on Craftsman God Planet, resulting in him being engaged by Craftsman God Master, who sent him through one of the wormholes to the Dangerous Land controlled by Space Beast Ancestor.

As a Universe Master possessing a Top Arcana flying palace, he is at least Universe Master Level 3, but due to his large Divine Body and skill in making weapons, he could fend off True Gods while within the Original Universe, so his true ability may be Universe Master Level 4.

characters.personality: Crane Lord is proud and brave, but also careful. He helps Shadow Lord loot weaker factions, but never supports stealing from stronger ones like cultivator faction. He doesn’t like running away and prefers to fight, but he won’t take risks if the enemy is too strong. Even though he acts bold, he knows when to back off and listen. He cares about his allies and protects their territory, but he’s not reckless.
characters.history:
Crane Lord is an ancient and powerful being who has mastered the Power of Immortality, making him incredibly hard to kill. This ability allows his body to recover endlessly, even from devastating attacks, giving him unmatched endurance in battle. However, he is not the strongest in attack or energy control, which is why he relies on cooperation with the Blood Lord and  like shadow Lord.  He is deeply tied to the Blood Crane Territory, where his immortality is further strengthened by the surrounding environment and the life energy from Blood Lord. Because of this, he dares to face even powerful foes like Luo Feng—but only with backup.

When Luo Feng's "Great Destruction" move proved powerful enough to injure dozens of Primogenitors, Crane Lord realized that even his immortal power had its limits. Though he didn't want to avoid the battle, he accepted the strategy of retreating and waiting, trusting that teamwork and terrain would keep them safe.

characters.title: Dao Lord Long Jiu
characters.introText: Dao Lord Long Jiu is an Invincible God Emperor who is currently cultivating in the Dark Holy Realm. He was the strongest cultivator in the Dark Holy Realm before Luo Feng arrived. Long Jiu has mastered three Great Daos to the Perfect God Emperor level (Great Dao of the Flame Origin, Great Dao of the Thunder Origin, Great Dao of the Wind Origin), and has reached Second Level God King in the Great Dao of the Water Origin. He hopes to reach Second Level God King in 5 Great Daos to completely master a Origin World, which would help him jump out of the cage and become a World-Class Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
characters.appearance: A middle-aged man dressed in green.
characters.history:
Dao Lord Long Jiu is an Invincible God Emperor who is currently cultivating in the Dark Holy Realm. He was the strongest cultivator in the Dark Holy Realm before Luo Feng arrived. Long Jiu has mastered three Great Daos to the Perfect God Emperor level (Great Dao of the Flame Origin, Great Dao of the Thunder Origin, Great Dao of the Wind Origin), and has reached Second Level God King in the Great Dao of the Water Origin. He hopes to reach Second Level God King in 5 Great Daos to completely master a Origin World, which would help him jump out of the cage and become a World-Class Chaotic Origin Lifeform.

Through his relationship with Overlord Xing Mang, he has been able to explore multiple Origin Worlds, and he eventually reincarnated into the Dragon Blood Origin World, whose Supreme Operation Laws included the Great Daos of Wind, Fire, and Thunder. He has experienced more than 30 reincarnations into Origin Worlds and continues focusing on this path. He has received greater training and more valuable resources than Qiu Ge and Yi Fei Ya.

Long Jiu reaches out to Luo Feng after learning that he had Invincible God Emperor-level strength but had not been guided to the Origin Land. Soon after, he watches as God Emperor Ji Ke exchanges pointers with Luo Feng, and was amazed at Luo Feng's strength. When Luo Feng, Ji Ke, and Long Jiu preach to the Dark Holy Realm cultivators, Long Jiu answered questions about secret information like means of jumping out of the cage.

Dark Python Master is a Universe Master peripheral member of the Ancestral God Sect, under the Nine Remoteness branch. They arrived with Nine Remoteness Master and Outstanding Difficulty Master to kill Yuan Ao Master, as representatives of the Ancestral God Sect.

Since Nine Remoteness Master was unable to kill Yuan Ao Master, Anaconda Master knew they could not either, so they remained in the vicinity and observed rather than directly attacking. After Yuan Ao Master was forced to self-destruct, Anaconda Master and the others returned to the Ancestral God Sect.

characters.title: Dark Roc Ancestor
characters.introText: Dark Roc Ancestor (An Peng Hunyuan Ancestor) was a powerful Primogenitor who belonged to the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction. He was one of 89 primogenitors who participated in a Third major battle against the Cultivator Camp's Eight Lords.
characters.appearance:
Dark Roc Ancestor (An Peng Hunyuan Ancestor) was a powerful Primogenitor who belonged to the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction. He was one of 89 primogenitors who participated in a Third major battle against the Cultivator Camp's Eight Lords.

Dark Roc Ancestor became the first casualty in this conflict when he was killed by a coordinated attack from the Eight Lords. Despite being protected by the combined defensive formations of all 89 Primogenitors, he was struck down by Luo Feng's Blood Shadow Blade, which had been enhanced with the power of Destruction and channeled the combined might of seven of the Eight Lords.

His death reduced the Innate Hunyuan Lifeform Faction from 89 to 88 members who participated in the war and shocked both the combatants and observing factions. The fall of the Dark Roc Ancestor demonstrated the devastating effectiveness of the Cultivator Camp's Time Slaughter Formation and marked a significant turning point in the battle between the two powerful factions.

Darkness Master is a sworn brother of Primal Chaos City Leader, along with Ice Mountain Master, and is a student of Ancestor Yuan. While part of the Human Race, he mostly hides in the shadows and as such is not known by the other main races. He is more like a hidden combat reserve. He helps lead the Human Race during the Human Race Survival War, using the Xeon Arcana Black Prison Tower to great effect.

In the 1,910,000th era after the World of Jin arrived, he became the human race's second True God to be born since the arrival of the World of Jin.

characters.introText: Pointy-eared and red-eyed, he's an incredibly handsome mature-looking man who resembles Bu Luo Nuolanshan in many ways. He wears a blue robe.
characters.appearance: Pointy-eared and red-eyed, he's an incredibly handsome mature-looking man who resembles Bu Luo Nuolanshan in many ways. He wears a blue robe.
characters.history:
De Wen Nuolan Shan was the 2nd head of the Nuolan Shan Family. Tens of thousands of years ago, he reached Universe Level 1 and was named a patriarch of the family. As the 2nd head, he has great respect for the Head Patriarch, Nuolan Shan. He eventually reached Universe Level 6, and after this, he became aware of Earth through his grandson, Bu Luo Nuolanshan's excursion.

He fully believed in hard work and strength as what brings value to the family, but he also understood when to back down. When Luo Feng obtained the ownership rights to Earth, De Wen advised Pula and his team to retreat so as not to be branded a space pirate.

He felt dissatisfaction toward Bai Kaluo due to the latter's arrogance and strength, but he was sent with him to Earth on Nuolan Shan's orders. He was excited to get to Earth and retrieve the Earth Automaton Ship, but was intercepted by Luo Feng and Di Fan, dying at the latter's hands.

characters.history:
Demon Beast Ancestor is a lone True God of the Original Universe. He considers himself the true ancestor of both the Demon Race and the Space Beasts, which is why he took the name Demon Beast Ancestor. A Special Lifeform, he is one of the most ancient beings of the Original Universe, and he fought his way through incredible battles of fame. In the past, he lost to Space Beast Ancestor, and it is implied that this is how the Space Beasts broke free from his control. It is implied that he also lost to Dream Demon Ancestor and Shock Demon Ancestor, freeing the Demon Race from his control.

Unlike many other True Gods, he does not have a Xeon Arcana; this contributed to his loss to Space Beast Ancestor, and was why he returned to the Original Universe from Universe Ocean when Star Tower disappeared. He hoped to use Star Tower to defeat Dream Demon Ancestor, Shock Demon Ancestor, and Space Beast Ancestor.

During the Human Race Survival War, he remained neutral, but was pleased with the Human Race having a slight advantage. He took advantage of battle to travel to Flowing Overlapping Mountains, where he encountered the body of Jin God King. He attempted to seize the body for himself, but his strength was insufficient; eventually, he worked together with Divine Eye True Master to attempt to redirect it, but even together, they could not effectively change its direction. Eventually, thousands of great beings worked together with him to redirect the body to Universe Boat.

characters.history:
Desolation Master is the founder of the Universe Mercenary Alliance, one of the 5 Leviathans of Humanity. As such, his strength is well-known, with 4 total bodies that he can use in combat. He has no fear of expressing the interests of his organization or that of the Human Race if the occasion calls for it.

Desolation Master represented the Universe Mercenary Alliance when the Five Leviathans agreed to split ownership of Earth among themselves and Luo Feng. When Luo Feng obtained a Disambiguation Mirror Stone after killing Venerable Tian Yang, Desolation Master spoke up against exchanging the Five Leviathans' rights to Earth for the stone, noting the value of Earth and the Human Race's possession of Pinnacle Arcana Domain Treasures (what one hoped to obtain through the Disambiguation Temple). He also expressed his admiration for Sitting Mountain Guest's ability to create Earth and the Earthlings.

When Primal Chaos City Leader stated that Luo Feng had the strength of a Top Universe Overlord, he laughed that Luo Feng might be taking advantage of their relationship so he could keep Earth, causing Primal Chaos City Leader to retort that Luo Feng was not like his disciple. When Luo Feng took ownership of Star Tower, Desolation Master was one of the beings who discussed this with Huge Axe Creator.

When Luo Feng was accepted as the newest Universe Master of the Human Race, Desolation Master still vehemently disagreed with granting him full rights over Earth without contributing treasures of equivalent value, but Huge Axe Creator exchanged a Pinnacle Arcana in exchange for Luo Feng's acquisition of the full rights to Earth.

Desolation Master gathered with 7 other Universe Masters of the Human Race, plus Huge Axe Creator, and discussed what was occurring at the Boat of Mausoleum as Luo Feng took the Duan Dong River Inheritance Test.

After Luo Feng successfully became the heir to Duan Dong River, Desolation Master was one of the 8 Universe Masters gathered in the Virtual Universe by Huge Axe Creator to listen to Luo Feng explain the path of Universe Masters to break through to True God. He was excited with the others when Ancestor Yuan appeared to inquire about the Law of Chaos. When Luo Feng successfully returned to the Original Universe, Desolation Master was present to hear Huge Axe Creator's 'Rise in the Universe Ocean' plan for the Human Race.

Desolation Master was a key combatant for the Human Race during the Human Race Survival War. He used 3 of his 4 bodies to help ward off attacks from the Three-Clan Coalition Army. He was present for Primal Chaos City Leader's display of Palm Universe, as well as Luo Feng's display of the divine blood within the Boat of Mausoleum. He was present with the other Universe Masters and Primal Chaos City Leader as they awaited news from Luo Feng's battle with Great Thunder Star Master.

When the great beings of Universe Ocean successfully forced the body of the God King of Jin to crash into Universe Boat, Desolation Master was concerned about the consequences if the body didn't stop after that terrifying impact.

In the 100 millionth era after the appearance of the body of the God King of Jin, he became the 3rd of the Human Race to break through to True God since the body's appearance.

Devil Ancestor is the True God who leads the Prison Race, one of the 6 pinnacle races of the Original Universe. The cruelty for which the Prison Race is known is the product of his guiding strategies.

When Bar Lion Master discovered that Huge Axe Creator had been killed, he immediately informed Devil Ancestor, who then investigated the broken Miniature Universe. He decided to share the news, hoping to cause a conflict between the Human Race, Demon Race, Zerg Race, and Automaton Race.

characters.appearance:
