In the donghua, he resembles a powerfully-built elf, but with grey skin and hair and four ears. He has two arms and two eyes, like an Earthling, and a number of darker marks on the center of his forehead.
characters.history:
Devil Hammer rampaged throughout the East District of World #1 of the Ganwu Universe Country Elimination Stage for the Pinnacle Genius Battle. He could be considered a Stellar Level genius of the Anjialuo Clan. He was known as the district's Number 1, but when Luo Feng finally started his rampage as 'Madman,' that title began to be disputed.

Luo Feng met Devil Hammer and they had an intense battle, with his Soaring Shuttle's Swordfish Formation finally overwhelming Devil Hammer's 4 hammer defense and Law of Earth  Level 8 domain. Cutting off 1 arm, he was then able to break through the remaining defense and defeat Devil Hammer. He almost forced Luo Feng to use the Yan Shen Armament, but his defense wasn't quite strong enough. Luo Feng considered him stronger than Hong at the time.
characters.trivia:
In the donghua, he is stated to be from the Lacerta Galaxy, and is also known as the Lacerta Death God

In the donghua, he is one of the geniuses trained by the Ganwu Universe Country Imperial Family, while in the novel his background is unspecified

characters.title: Devil Shell Monkey
characters.introText: The Devil Shell Monkey is a creature belonging to the demon race. This specific individual is an "Marquis level" Immortal warrior. Physically, it is a small being, standing only 1.1 meters tall with a crooked posture. Its body is covered in black scales, and it possesses distinctive jade green eyes. In terms of personality, it displays an evil demeanor, often smiling wickedly, yet it maintains a cowardly but obedient nature in the presence of its masters. Despite its small stature, it is arrogant toward those it perceives as weaker, viewing World Master level enemies as "punks" that it could easily kill.
characters.appearance:
The Devil Shell Monkey is a creature belonging to the demon race. This specific individual is an "Marquis level" Immortal warrior. Physically, it is a small being, standing only 1.1 meters tall with a crooked posture. Its body is covered in black scales, and it possesses distinctive jade green eyes. In terms of personality, it displays an evil demeanor, often smiling wickedly, yet it maintains a cowardly but obedient nature in the presence of its masters. Despite its small stature, it is arrogant toward those it perceives as weaker, viewing World Master level enemies as "punks" that it could easily kill.

The Devil Shell Monkey is a soul slave bound to Tian Chen, who himself is a soul slave of Luo Feng. Because of the nature of soul slavery, the monkey has no free will. Its entire being is conditioned to obey, even if the order means self-destruction. When it’s transferred to Luo Feng’s control, it immediately accepts him as its “master’s master.” The monkey even shows excitement when given tasks, saying it had been lonely and bored for many years. It’s also intelligent enough to operate advanced equipment, including scanners and virtual-universe connection devices.

Luo Feng utilizes the Devil Shell Monkey as a scout to infiltrate the dangerous Ice Prison Planet. Equipped with a dual-function scanner and an anonymous virtual universe armband, the monkey travels through the dark universe and arrives 16 million kilometers away from the target planet. Utilizing a mini-scanner to hide its tracks, it successfully avoids detection by two patrolling World Master level Dokus. Upon landing on the frozen surface of the planet which has a diameter of over 8,000 kilometers the monkey navigates the extreme cold and travels 3,000 kilometers deep into the planet until it discovers a massive crystal palace standing over 1,000 kilometers tall.

While scouting the palace, the monkey acts as a live relay, sending visual data back to Luo Feng via the virtual universe. Under orders to find a specific black metal board, the monkey activates a large scanner to map the area. This action triggers a formless ripple that alerts the palace's inhabitant, a powerful purple Doku warrior. The Doku instantly attacks with a beam of purple light. The Devil Shell Monkey is struck and instantly frozen into a block of ice. The extreme cold destroys its soul imprints, killing it immediately. Its frozen corpse is then telekinetically moved to a corner of the palace to sit among tens of other frozen statues of Immortal intruders who met similar fates.

characters.introText: Di Chu Yu is confident and strong-minded, willing to pursue the law comprehension path to Primal Chaos Sovereign despite the increased difficulty compared to using the Bloodline Cultivation Method. He is also righteous, willing to befriend Luo Feng due to his protection of the weak and abhorrence of evil. He disdains those who take the easy way out.

characters.history:
Di Chu Yu is the master of the Flame Wind Guild Hall branch in Hu Yang City, and is also known as Flame Wind Pavilion Master. Thousands of periods before Luo Feng's arrival on the Continent of Origin, he left the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom to continue his training, with his second uncle (Flame Wind Guild Hall Deputy Master) accompanying him as a bodyguard. He is a member of the Emperor Chu Family, one of the thirteen branches of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom imperial family.

Unlike most residents on the continent, who solely use the Bloodline Cultivation Method to cultivate, he follows the law comprehension path, hoping to use it to break through to Primal Chaos Sovereign.

He looks down on his fellow clansmen who follow the Bloodline Cultivation Method then turn to law comprehension after hitting a bottleneck, stating that by following a simple road for so long, it's unlikely that they can succeed when switching onto a difficult road. He and his uncle began to show some interest in Luo Feng, who joined the Dark Hall under the alias 'Swordsman,' after he easily defeated Lai Mo and provoked Mu Yang.

The pair were aware of Ying Cang and his goal of assassinating Luo Feng, and knew that he died in the attempt. After Luo Feng killed Blood Cloud, Yu Tian Yi, and Yu Tian Hu, Di Chu Yu offered to invite him to be a Guest Official of the Emperor Chu Family in the future, noting his righteous actions and hatred of evil.

Shortly after the Heart Shadow Sect visited the Flame Wind Guild Hall, Chu Yu broke through to Primal Chaos Sovereign, having followed the detailed instructions of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, and became a First-Class Lord. Later, he confirms that he has reached Top Primal Chaos Sovereign, the same as Lord Jiu Jiang.

When Luo Feng subsequently revealed that he broke through to Primal Chaos Sovereign, Chu Yu brought him back to Chu Capital City and officially applied for him to be his first Guest Official. Chu Yu worked to help Luo Feng, making a deal with Lian Yu City Lord to obtain perfect-level Chaos Layer Organisms to aid in his Transformation Methods.

Later, when the First-Class Lords were given their first Heaven-level Task, due to ranking 1st in the Blood Spirit Gold Pearls sub-task and third and fourth in the other two sub-tasks, Chu Yu ranked 2nd overall in the task.

Diao Rong Qi is a Void True God member of an elite unit of the Hu Yang Legion. She is considered the junior of Moli Feiyun and Gao Wu Shui.

When returning to Hu Yang City she and her teammates became aware of Luo Feng, who was a new, unfamiliar Eternal True God in the city. Later, she learned that Luo Feng frequented the Fire World Restaurant and she went there to ask him to accept her as a disciple.

While her father, Diao Rong Yan, is also an Eternal True God, he specializes in medicine-refining rather than combat, so she seeks a powerful Eternal True God to be her teacher. Suo Yun serves as one of her guards.

As he was dying, Diao Rong Yan sent a message to her informing her that Mu Yang killed him. She took 40,000 Universe Sand from what was left to her and added it to Mu Yang's bounty.

characters.history:
Diao Rong Yan was an Eternal True God living in Hu Yang City, and Diao Rong Qi's father. While he was an Eternal True God, his specialization in medicine-refining instead of combat caused his daughter to seek a more powerful Eternal True God to be her teacher. He was ranked in the top 3 of Hu Yang City in medicine-refining, but all of his belongings together only added up to about 220,000 Universe Sand.

He was killed by Mu Yang, who sought more money to use for his cultivation. Before his death, he contacted his daughter and other trusted friends to inform them of his murderer.

characters.history:
Dong Lan is a personal assistant of Xu Xin at Ping Hai Company. When Xu Xin is not around she is the one who takes care of the matters related to the company.

“Hm, Ah Lan, thanks for your many years of support.” Xu Xin was filled with gratitude as she looked at this good sister of hers. The lady who was beside her was a good partner of hers when she started her own business on earth. These past many years, the two of them were considered a gold combination, and this sister of hers Dong Lan had enjoyed many benefits due to Xu Xin too. For example, over these 100 years, Dong Lan’s appearance had hardly changed too.

It is not stated in the Novel but when Luo Feng was going through the Star Tower Inheritance, Xu Xin used to write emails to Luo Feng, in one of the emails Xu Xin wrote that someone betrayed her, we think it might be her because prior to the mail Dong Lan was the only character that was mentioned for couple of chapters and she was the only one Xu Xin trusted outside of her family.

“Feng, I encountered some trouble today, I didn’t expect that after trusting her for so long, she’d dare go against me like that. I guess you never know what’s going on in someone’s heart. Seems right, I haven’t seen that underling in a few hundred years…” - Xu Xin

characters.introText: While Du Fang's exact cultivation base is unknown, he refers to Palace Master Yuan Xiang as his mentor and brother, so he should be at the very least a God Emperor.  He is a native of the same hometown as Yuan Xiang and shares a deep, long-standing friendship with him. When Yuan Xiang secluded himself in the Source World to battle the mental pollution from Innate High Chaotic Origin Lifeform, Du Fang stayed concerned for his well-being. Sensing something was wrong after receiving no responses to his communications and realizing that Yuan Xiang had lost control of his own cave mansion, Du Fang broke into the sealed dwelling. There, he found his old friend in a twisted and tormented state, lost in layers of illusions, consumed by memory pollution.

Duan Mo Yun is a Void True God Palace Master of the Blood Python Guild. While he is not an elite Void True God in terms of strength, thanks to his position within the guild, he is feared throughout Hu Yang City. He and Moli Lian visited Dream Flower Tower when Luo Feng was there to attend a Hundred Flowers Banquet, and experienced Alaya's performance.

Dylan is the disciple of King Bloodthirsty, one of King Zhenyan's disciples, and thus can be considered a junior brother of sorts to Luo Feng. Worried that Luo Feng would encounter dangers after breaking through to Domain Master and being sent out by the Virtual Universe Company, Zhenyan arranged for Dylan to lead his guard team.

In this role, he also regularly reported to Zhenyan about Luo Feng's achievements and dangerous situations, such as the conflict with King Nightmare Candle. He used his God Country Transmission to assist Luo Feng in traveling through humanity's territory, and stood by his side through his missions as a Domain Master.

characters.title: E Xu
characters.introText: E Xu was a woman whom Luo Feng's Chaos Realm Clone met in one of 3916 Origin World in the Innate Hunyuan Faction's territory that has been a cradle of resource of a World-Class Innate Hunyuan Lifeform for 'sustainable' exploitation to the absolute limit with utmost frugality. It orchestrated a series of calamities, absorbs the "fear" emotions of the inhabitants and integrates it into its Life Core. However, its life force ultimately severed by Luo Feng and leave its Life Core intact.
characters.appearance:

It orchestrated a series of calamities, absorbs the "fear" emotions of the inhabitants and integrates it into its Life Core. However, its life force ultimately severed by Luo Feng and leave its Life Core intact.

The Origin World has been deliberately destroyed, easily gave rise to over a million Primordial Universe with no central core. The inhabitants' cultivation limited to Eternal True God due to its energy being too dispersed.

Luo Feng himself found this origin world from the intense emotions absorbed into the Mountain of Destruction, indicated individuals with exceptionally strong spiritual power reside within it.
characters.history: She has a skeptical demeanor and cautious to anyone. First time meeting with Luo Feng, her gaze wary, inquiring the truth behind the Death Tribulation which was about fall upon her. After having risen from weakness step-by-step, enduring countless trials, she understood that what seemed like a pleasant surprise often concealed even greater despair, thus always assume the worst possible outcome of every situation. But when Luo Feng saw her entire life in a single glance, he found that she has developed a unique willpower cultivation method that slay her own soul, improve her willpower to the God King level. Because of her exceptional talent, Luo Feng decided to take her with a single universe she chose, and asked if she was willing to be his disciple-in-name, which she was willing.

He has outstanding and dazzling talent, and with his talent, he even received several resources left behind by Yuan, causing the Thunder Ancient Kingdom to scheme against him, but his strength was too strong, and under the siege of several monarchs, he could still escaped and fled away. Since then, the Earth God King and the Thunder Ancient Kingdom have turned against each other.

characters.title: East
characters.introText: According to Hong he acts like a gentlemen however in fact is quite ambitious.
characters.personality: According to Hong he acts like a gentlemen however in fact is quite ambitious.
characters.history:
The fourth Elder of Palace of Gods of War, meaning that he is the 4th strongest cultivator on Earth. He's esteemed by the HR Alliance and a very sophisticated person.

He also owns great Spirit Energy; prior to Luo Feng breaking through to Planetary Level, he was Earth's strongest Spirit Master, and the only spirit master at Planetary Level. He is the strongest warrior of the continent of Europe.

He later arrives in court to witness the trial of Li Yao and Venina Paulinus and is invited to a banquet where he watches Luo Feng kill Li Yao who had just stepped into the Planetary Level just before his execution. He realizes the power of the Soaring Shuttle and grows jealous of Luo Feng, even mentally attacking him until Hong and Lei Shen arrive and use pressure to intimidate the Planetary Level fighters in the room from having any killing intent towards Luo Feng.

He is one of the Eight Heroes of Earth who sacrificed his life for Luo Feng to kill the Golden Horned Beast. Prior to his sacrifice he simply locked himself inside his room and remained silent.

characters.title: East Emperor Ancestor

infobox.cultivation: Void True God Eternal True God

characters.introText:
The name is up for debate. 
东帝始祖(dōng dì shǐzǔ) translates directly into East/Eastern Emperor First Ancestor, but his name could just be Dong Di.
characters.appearance: He is dressed in a robe covered in countless green branches and leaves. He exudes endless hazy cyan light containing rich vitality that obscures him from a clear view. His aura even healed the injured Divine Bodies of his subordinates!
characters.personality: Unlike Purple Moon Ancestor, East Emperor Ancestor's ambition is tempered, and he understands that with life comes death. During the Sector Beast War, he placed his hopes in Luo Feng and acknowledged that even the most powerful kingdoms had to face destruction, so he was at peace.
characters.history:
East Emperor Ancestor is the Void True God leader and creator of East Emperor Holy Land Universe. He has lived for an extremely long time; when he made an appearance in the holy land during the Duan Dong River Inheritance Test, someone noted that they had last seen him 119 Reincarnation Eras ago!

By his own admission, he had never been the one with the most talent, but he worked his way to True God and eventually broke through to Void True God. His opportunities were inferior to those of Purple Moon Ancestor, but his Miniature Universe was superior.

During the Duan Dong River Inheritance Test, he appeared in East Emperor Holy Land Universe to confirm the existence of the inheritance and choose subordinates to undertake the test. With his knowledge of the ancient civilization, he understood that one with the title 'Wu' would be much more powerful than himself, and that the inheritance left behind could help him break through to Eternal True God. He sent Northern True Star Master and a team of 20 Universe Masters, 200 Universe Venerables, and 2,000 Immortals to the Boat of Mausoleum to undertake the test.

East Emperor Ancestor realized the different requirements for different stages of cultivation when Venerable Blue Blood reached the first threshold of the inheritance by solving 1,000 puzzles in the Rhinoceros Emperor Game, as Youzan Master had already solved 1,200 but had not reached the first threshold. With this realization, he ordered his subordinates to have the Immortals and Universe Venerables work harder so more of them could reach the requirements. He also personally met Blue Blood to give him words of encouragement, telling him that if he performed well enough, he would help him become a True God and even transcend reincarnation if he could. He even offered to use Time and Space Reversal to resurrect him if necessary and personally train him!

In the final round of the inheritance test, East Emperor Ancestor met with Blood Blood and Youzan, allowed them to use a space of time acceleration, and told them that the engravings on the ice mountains held the key to them creating more profound techniques. After Luo Feng succeeded in obtaining the inheritance, East Emperor Ancestor ordered Northern True Star Master to keep watch over the area and capture Luo Feng, sending 10 additional Universe Masters and giving them 7 Xeon Arcana to use in the effort. Due to the shocking power of the Boat of Mausoleum, none were successful in capturing Luo Feng, so East Emperor Ancestor ordered Northern True Star Master to attempt to make a deal with Luo Feng for the inheritance, offering hidden secrets of Universe Ocean, other inheritances, and even Xeon Arcana.

After some haggling between East Emperor Ancestor and Luo Feng, a deal was settled; Luo Feng would exchange 3 Memory Stones of the cultivation experience beyond True God for 10 Xeon Arcana. The first stone would be exchanged for 1 Xeon Arcana Palace and another Xeon Arcana, the second stone would be exchanged for 4 Xeon Arcana, and the third stone would be exchanged for the final 4 Xeon Arcana. Unfortunately for him, the more detailed cultivation experience was part of the core inheritance and could not be shared with outsiders, so the first memory stone did not even reach his own level of cultivation. Recognizing that Luo Feng would not be able to read information about surpassing True God, he personally contacted Luo Feng to explain that the training was inferior to his own, asking for another memory stone, guaranteeing by his reputation that he was not trying to trick him. Since he could not enter Universe Ocean, much less the Original Universe, there was nothing he could do when Luo Feng flatly refused to give him an additional stone without Xeon Arcana in exchange.

East Emperor Ancestor attempted to use the Human Race Survival War to get Luo Feng to agree to send another Memory Stone for free, but was unsuccessful in his efforts. He hoped for the Human Race to lose, to force Luo Feng into negotiating with him again, but understood that with the Duan Dong River Inheritance, it was not surprising for the Human Race to emerge victorious.

East Emperor Ancestor was anxious about emergence of the Sector Beasts, understanding that they could devour his Miniature Universe and cut off his path to Eternal True God. However, due to his long lifespan, he was at peace with the possibility that his journey could end, and understood that he could only rely on Luo Feng, the strongest in Universe Ocean to defeat them. He had faith that Luo Feng could become a True God, even on the Divine Power Path, due to his talent. When the final 900,000 Sector Beasts entered Universe Ocean, told his subordinates to await their final destiny (understanding that none of them were strong enough to fight even a single Sector Beast) and used his Willpower to defend his Miniature Universe Origin, slowing its consumption. He was shocked when the Sector Beasts stopped trying to devour his Miniature Universe Origin and moved on to the origins of the First and Second Reincarnation Era. He celebrated Luo Feng's victory over the Sector Beasts with his strongest subordinates, rejoicing that they survived the Sector Beast War.

In the sequel, he has reached the Eternal True God Cultivation Level with the help of Luo Feng. He is shocked by the rate of Luo Feng's growth into the Second Level God King stage as he recounts how difficult it was for him to reach the Eternal True God stage. He also laments the death of Purple Moon Ancestor, whose death was confirmed by Luo Feng through Cause and Effect.

Elder Jinyang was a powerful World Master Level 7 who was well-known within Nine Planet Sea due to his homosexuality. He routinely captured male cultivators who caught his eye, making them his servants or disciples. During Luo Feng's time on Devil Note Mountain, Jinyang saw him and sent his favorite disciple, Kamulu, to capture him. When Kamulu died at Luo Feng's hands, Jinyang was extremely upset and became depressed.

Later, after killing Pa Tuo and obtaining his E9 Grade Laser Gun, Luo Feng again encountered Jinyang, who saw him and attempted to avenge his disciple. After tricking Jinyang into pursuing him in his Mosha Body, Luo Feng eventually killed him with the laser gun.

characters.personality: Emperor Chu is protective of his disciples, willing to fight against other Emperors and kill their descendants. His nature has a great affinity with the Great Dao of the Destruction Origin.
characters.history:
Emperor Chu is one of the 13 Emperors of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, and the head of the Emperor Chu Family. He practices the Great Dao of the Origin of Destruction. His lineage is considered comparable to 11 of the other Emperors, with only Emperor Qing being truly superior. Like the other emperors, he has sent 99% of the ethnic groups in his lineage to a Miniature Universe, only allowing them to leave if they cultivate to Eternal True God under those circumstances.

He accepts disciples on the basis of talent and compatibility of temperament between himself and the prospective disciple, and thus had only had 2 disciples, the least among the emperors. After witnessing Luo Feng's feats in his early time as a Guest Official of his lineage, Emperor Chu offered to accept him as a direct disciple. He prepared three gifts for Luo Feng: the subsequent volumes of inheritance for 72 Blades of Annihilation and Eight Calamities Lifeform, up through Ultimate God King, for free; 10 pieces of Chaotic Origin Crystal Spirit Fruit, which nourishes the soul and improves affinity with the supreme laws; and increasing the potential of the Blood Shadow Blade so it could become an Ultimate God King weapon, along with a secret method for nurturing weapons.

He continues to cultivate on his own, hoping to be strong enough to help First Ancestor Flame Wind in their future efforts.

characters.history:
Emperor Fu is the current era's lead emperor of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. He thus currently manages the ancient kingdom's affairs. He is known for being good at investigating causality, implying that he has fully comprehended at least 1 Major Branch of the Great Dao of the Causality Origin. He is the second-oldest of the Emperors, only behind Emperor Yan.

In the past, Emperor Fu followed the Chaotic Origin Bloodline path of cultivation, ultimately reaching the level of Emperor within the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. Later, he gave up on that path and chose to use the Reincarnation Secret Method to get rid of the bloodline's influence on his body and soul. After reincarnating, Emperor Fu cultivated in the path of formations, used formations to refine his Divine Body, and re-achieved the position of Emperor. Emperor Chu believes that Emperor Fu may very well be the next Emperor Qing!

Since Emperor Fu was once part of the Chaotic Origin Bloodline faction of emperors, he has connections with that side, and since he gave up that path, he has a sober mind and was supported by the Chaotic Origin Material/Chaotic Origin Power faction in becoming the current lead Emperor.

Emperor Fu understands Luo Feng's potential, seeing that he is favored by the Supreme Operation Laws. He hopes that Luo Feng can become his companion when he leaves the Continent of Origin in the future.

Despite his strength on the Continent of Origin, he is very aware that his strength is unremarkable outside of the continent, and he cherishes every opportunity to get stronger.
characters.history:
Emperor Ming is one of the 13 Emperors of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. Born in a clan that was exiled in a Miniature Universe, he gradually increased his strength, first being allowed out of the miniature universe, then becoming a First-Class Lord, then a God King, and finally an Emperor. He has the humblest birth of the 13 Emperors, but is also worshiped by countless Imperial Family members.

He cultivates following the Chaotic Origin Bloodline path, and painted the Calamity Beast Diagram. Luo Feng encountered a trace of his Consciousness when exploring Infinite Space, and Emperor Ming directed him to where he could spend his time there. While he dislikes most of the other parts of the Imperial Family, he has a slight liking for Luo Feng as a non-Imperial Family member able to make it to Infinite Space.

Ming's dislike of the Imperial Family can be seen in the fact that he has attacked all of the other Emperors except Emperor Qing, forcibly seizing their treasures. Due to his strength, none of the Emperors he attacked dared to sever ties with him, but because of his actions, he has no true friends.

Due to his talent and his good relationship with Luo Feng, Emperor Ming was allowed to accompany Emperor Qing, Luo Feng, and Emperor Fu when they departed the Continent of Origin for Yulan City. As a Bloodline Early Stage God Emperor, was able to find a job in the city, but he was unwilling to simply accept a low level job. Eventually, he joined up with other bloodline cultivators to hunt Low-Level Hunyuan Lifeforms, but the hunt was a complete disaster, with 7 of the 32 members killed, 10 others severely injured, with the further shame that the lifeform even escaped. Later, after Luo Feng joined the Dan Building, Emperor Ming joined, along with Emperor Fu and Emperor Qing, becoming the Deputy Head of the Clear Heart Hall.

Following the Battle for Yulan City, Emperor Ming, as one of Luo Feng's confidants, was responsible for some of the trivial matters concerning Luo Feng, who served as the City Lord of Yulan City.
characters.trivia:
As an Emperor, Emperor Ming's strength is quite remarkable, reaching the Ultimate God King level. His Willpower is Above God King, and he was capable of painting the Calamity Beast Diagram! Despite following the Chaotic Origin Bloodline path, he seems completely sober and his willpower is calm like a vast and endless ocean. With his strength, he is the second-strongest Emperor, behind only Emperor Qing! In addition to his incredible willpower, his body is also the strongest among the 12 emperors under Emperor Qing. In Emperor Fu's opinion, more than half of the 12 emperors would be completely killed in a one-on-one battle with Emperor Ming.

As a Hunyuan Bloodline Cultivator, his body is very compatible with the Infinite Hunyuan Space, and naturally compatible with many of the Billions of Worlds.

characters.introText: Emperor Qing is the most powerful and famous of the 13 emperors of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. He is the only emperor to truly comprehend a Complete Great Dao, and has strength surpassing Ultimate God King. His Willpower has also surpassed the Ultimate God King level, having done so after fully comprehending the Complete Great Dao.
characters.history:
Emperor Qing is the most powerful and famous of the 13 emperors of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. He is the only emperor to truly comprehend a Complete Great Dao, and has strength surpassing Ultimate God King. His Willpower has also surpassed the Ultimate God King level, having done so after fully comprehending the Complete Great Dao.

According to the records of the Continent of Origin, he has never met an equal. With fifteen direct disciples, including 6 God Kings, 8 Transcendent Chaos Realms, and 1 Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign, the Emperor Qing lineage is also the most powerful of the 13 imperial lineages of the kingdom.

When the Milky Way Kingdom Master (Luo Feng) killed Emperor Yuan, the number of Continent of Origin Emperor dropped from thirteen to twelve. The remaining 11 emperors panicked, except for Emperor Qing, who was the strongest and in seclusion. Eight of the emperors went to Emperor Qing to report the situation and ask for help, but a puppet creature stopped them to avoid disturbing its master. Disappointed, the eight emperors left helplessly, lacking the courage to force their way in.

when Emperor Qing finally emerged from seclusion, the emperors approached him again. But to their surprise, Emperor Qing chose not to pursue the matter of Emperor Yuan's death. Instead, he advised them to make peace with Luo Feng. He explained that since Luo Feng had already become invincible on the Continent of Origin, it was wiser to befriend him rather than make him an enemy.

Later, Emperor Qing went to meet Luo Feng, the Milky Way Kingdom Master. He didn’t bring up the issue of Emperor Yuan and instead chose to befriend Luo Feng. Emperor Qing had always wanted a strong and trustworthy companion, so he invited Luo Feng to team up to venture outside the Caged World together.

Wu Second is one of the 13 Emperors of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, and cultivates in the Great Dao of the Life Origin. Wu Second arrived in the Deep Area of the Dream Realm with Emperor Jiufeng to fight for the Thousand Dreams Fruit
characters.trivia: This Emperor Wu (帝吴) is different from Emperor Chu's mortal enemy Emperor Wu (帝梧). The character 吴 here appears to be the simplified form of 吳(wú), which is unfortunately 'wu' in Pinyin, same as 梧(wú), which is the same in both traditional and simplified Chinese.

characters.title: Emperor Xi
characters.introText: Emperor Xi is an Emperor of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom and the wife of Emperor Yan. As a result, she is part of their three-emperor faction, along with Emperor Wu.
characters.history:
Emperor Xi is an Emperor of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom and the wife of Emperor Yan. As a result, she is part of their three-emperor faction, along with Emperor Wu.

As a result of her being an ally of Emperor Wu, First Ancestor Flame Wind killed her for offending Luo Feng.

characters.title: Emperor Xuan
characters.introText: His eyes are ice cold and he wears a black robe adorned with golden runes. He exudes a terrifying pressure.
characters.appearance: His eyes are ice cold and he wears a black robe adorned with golden runes. He exudes a terrifying pressure.
characters.personality: As expected of a being with his stature, Emperor Xuan is extremely arrogant and cares a great deal about hierarchy. However, precisely because of this arrogance, he also cares about his dignity. Among those who cultivate through the Chaotic Origin Bloodline, he can be considered good-tempered.
characters.history:
Emperor Xuan is one of the 13 Emperors of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, and the sworn brother of Bai Feng God King. He was the first of the 13 emperors to send the vast majority of their Imperial Family's ethnic groups into Miniature Universes to alleviate the strain of providing resources.

Xuan's disciple, Li He God King, was killed by the trio of Emperor Yan, Emperor Wu, and Emperor Xi after handing over a secret treasure, left behind by Overlord Yuan, that he had refined. As a result, Xuan holds a grudge against the three.

Xuan and Monarch Lan Duo are the only two from the Ancient Kingdoms who have the Chaotic Origin Bloodline of water.

Luo Feng meets Emperor Xuan when beginning to guard the entrance to the Heavenly Pillar Realm.

characters.title: Emperor Yan
characters.introText: A towering flaming figure with a humanoid body, huge flaming wings, and a long, scaly tail. The flames on his wings are so strong that even Great Sage Yan Su did not dare look at them directly.
characters.appearance: A towering flaming figure with a humanoid body, huge flaming wings, and a long, scaly tail. The flames on his wings are so strong that even Great Sage Yan Su did not dare look at them directly.
characters.history:
Emperor Yan was the first emperor of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, and thus once had a reputation that shocked the entire Continent of Origin. With the emergence of the other 12 emperors, especially Emperor Qing, his influence greatly declined. Emperor Yan is life-or-death siblings with Emperor Wu, and together with Emperor Xi, the trio are the second-strongest faction among the emperors. Due to this relationship, he is a fierce enemy of Emperor Chu, and is also opposed by Emperor Kong and Emperor Xuan.

He follows the Chaotic Origin Bloodline path of cultivation, and his bloodline is extremely powerful and extremely contaminating. He is thus part of the faction of 6 emperors who cultivate with the Chaotic Origin Bloodline.

Great Sage Yan Su informs him of his defeat at the hands of Luo Feng, to which Emperor Yan replied that he would take care of it after the Heaven-level mission was completed.

He escaped from the Continent of Origin and jumped out of the Caged World after finding out the Luo Feng was Galaxy lord the leader Milky Way God Kingdom

characters.title: Emperor You
characters.introText: Emperor You is one of the 13 Emperors of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, and is thus an Ultimate God King lifeform. His Family and Emperor Chu Family have a very good relationship, so their First-Class Lords often interact with each other.
characters.history: Emperor You is one of the 13 Emperors of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, and is thus an Ultimate God King lifeform. His Family and Emperor Chu Family have a very good relationship, so their First-Class Lords often interact with each other.

characters.title: Emperor Yuan
characters.introText: Emperor Yuan is one of the 13 Emperors of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. He expects Guest Officials to obediently listen to their superiors, and was one of the 5 Emperors who voted to strip Luo Feng of his Guest Official status.
characters.history:
Emperor Yuan is one of the 13 Emperors of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. He expects Guest Officials to obediently listen to their superiors, and was one of the 5 Emperors who voted to strip Luo Feng of his Guest Official status.

He cultivated the puppet lifeform Iron Roar Devil Ruler, who committed countless sins on the Continent of Origin. Emperor Yuan left his puppet as bait to lure the killer of Eating Fox God King and succeeded in luring Luo Feng, beginning a battle between the two.

Despite the use of treasures that surpass the God King level, and the assistance of 8 other Emperors, he was forced to use the Reincarnation Secret Method to escape death at the hands of Luo Feng.

characters.title: Empress of Wind City
characters.introText: Empress of Wind City is a Second Level God King and the founder of Reincarnation Building. She is indigenous to the Continent of Origin and thus resides in the Dong Ji Region, and is one of the original 12 God Emperors. She is considered the most unfathomable of the 12, having reached the second level of God King in both the Great Dao of the Time Origin and the Great Dao of the World Origin.
characters.appearance: A woman dressed in cyan garments.
characters.history:
Empress of Wind City is a Second Level God King and the founder of Reincarnation Building. She is indigenous to the Continent of Origin and thus resides in the Dong Ji Region, and is one of the original 12 God Emperors. She is considered the most unfathomable of the 12, having reached the second level of God King in both the Great Dao of the Time Origin and the Great Dao of the World Origin.

Seeking to survive the reincarnation era of the Continent of Origin, she founded Reincarnation Building, personally inviting those she felt were truly extraordinary and were not direct members of the Ancient Kingdoms. After learning that Luo Feng was responsible for the death of Wu Xiang Ancestor's body in Infinite Space and Mist Envoy, she saw that he was favored by the Supreme Operation Laws, and invited him to join Reincarnation Building.

characters.title: Endless Ancestor

infobox.affiliation: Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction Eternal Land

characters.introText: The Endless Ancestor is among the top three most powerful figures and one of the Nine Sovereigns of the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction, who participated in the war between Cultivator Camp and Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction. His form is a massive sphere of light, filled with endless radiance, and he holds immense strength and status among the Primogenitor Beings. Although he doesn't hold a seat in the Eternal Land due to the theoretical possibility of his complete death he is still deeply respected by others in his faction. Even so, none of the seven Lords from the Cultivator Camp are capable of killing him, and only two beings in the entire Chaotic Origin Dimension can restrain him, and even then, not destroy him without full coordination.
characters.appearance:
The Endless Ancestor is among the top three most powerful figures and one of the Nine Sovereigns of the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction, who participated in the war between Cultivator Camp and Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction. His form is a massive sphere of light, filled with endless radiance, and he holds immense strength and status among the Primogenitor Beings. Although he doesn't hold a seat in the Eternal Land due to the theoretical possibility of his complete death he is still deeply respected by others in his faction. Even so, none of the seven Lords from the Cultivator Camp are capable of killing him, and only two beings in the entire Chaotic Origin Dimension can restrain him, and even then, not destroy him without full coordination.

Endless Ancestor is a firm supporter of total war. He aims to devour more source world origins to grow stronger. He once saved Kui Mo Ancestor by absorbing him into his massive light body after Kui Mo was critically wounded. Endless Ancestor’s soul body cannot be fully sealed by space-time techniques, as it can transform into light and transcend space. Despite not being immortal like The Original Ancestor, his power is on the same level as Infinite Serpent Ancestor and Nirvana Ancestor, the other two strongest Ancestral Beings in the faction. Among them, only Infinite Serpent Ancestor has a seat in the Eternal Land.
characters.trivia: Endless Ancestor was the ruler of the 14th layer/Destruction World of the Abyss of Destruction and became the ruler of the 18th layer after achieving immortality and defeating Kafuxiu.

characters.title: Entropy Sky Flame

characters.introText: Entropy Sky Flame was a very friendly person who cared about the weak. He spared no efforts trying to pass down his knowledge, and could be considered an upright individual. His compassion for the weak and his straightforward nature made him Luo Feng's first true friend on the Continent of Origin. From beginning to end, he never asked Luo Feng for help for himself, only to help others.
characters.appearance: A burly figure, tall as a mountain.

characters.history:
Entropy Sky Flame was an Eternal True God and the Sect Master of the Sky Flame Sect. He was considered one of the best tool refiners in Hu Yang City, and was rare among Eternal True Gods for having more than 300 direct disciples.

Entropy Sky Flame grew up in Hu Yang City, but eventually left. He was married at some point, but his wife died. It is implied that he faced an enemy he could not defeat, but he was able to escape and survive. When he returned to Hu Yang City, he didn't plan on living, but in his compassion for some weak figures he met in the city, he sought to do something meaningful with the rest of his life. He established the Sky Flame Sect and lived his life teaching and making friends.

He was extremely friendly and immediately befriended Luo Feng upon meeting him at Dream Flower Tower, providing him with some information about the city. He and Sang Shui Yun were rivals in love for Dream Flower Tower Master. Due to his skill in tool refining, he became a valuable resource to Luo Feng as he worked on the body-refining technique Chaos Powerful Diagram, and he could be considered the one true friend Luo Feng had in Hu Yang City.

He was one of the 9 remaining Eternal True Gods who worked on the Hu Yang City Formation. Due to his relationship with Luo Feng, he was the only one who is not abducted by Blood Cloud, Yu Tian Hu, and Yu Tian Yi. The 8 others were good friends of his, and he sought Luo Feng's help in protecting the surviving family members of the 3 who were killed.

After the battle between Blood Cloud and General Yong, he visited the battlefield and realized that Blood Cloud might be his good friend Sang Shui Yun. He set up a Causality Tracking Order that could track Sang Shui Yun, then headed to his cave residence to confront him with his findings. Before confronting him, he met Dream Flower Tower Master one last time, seeking to see the figure, smile, and aura of his deceased wife. After Sang Shui Yun admitted to being Blood Cloud in their confrontation, he killed Entropy Sky Flame, eventually leading to his true identity being spread throughout Hu Yang City.

Following his death, his 5 secret letters were sent to designated recipients by his trusted servant, Uncle Qiu. The letter to Moli Meng explained that he set up a Causality Tracking Order to track Sang Shui Yun, who he had just revealed was Blood Cloud.

The letter to Dream Flower Tower Master revealed Blood Cloud's secret identity as Sang Shui Yun, but told her that he would never return to Dream Flower Tower. He further explained that the top forces of the city knew that information and that he asked the City Lord's Mansion to take care of her. He also told her that a truly dangerous situation occurred in the future, she could rely on Luo Feng, but that she shouldn't trouble him too much. Finally, he gave her an honest appraisal of her skills, telling her that she was among the bottom of those Eternal True Gods who specialized in Illusion Techniques, telling her to continue to work hard at cultivation so she could rely on her own strength.

He left 3 million Universe Sands, his treasures, and a letter behind to Luo Feng, saving them at the Dark Hall for him to claim. The letter explained some of his backstory and expressed his admiration of Luo Feng. It ended with the hope that Luo Feng achieves his wishes in the future and that he lives a life worth living.

Entropy Sky Flame died after exposing the true identity of the Sang Shui Yun, Entropy Sky Flame suddenly awakens in his old family cave on the Hu Yang City of Continent of Origin. Confused and emotional, he’s greeted by Luo Feng (formerly known to him as Luo He), who has now become a supreme being beyond the laws of heaven and earth. Luo Feng explains that he retrieved Entropy Sky Flame from the past using the River of Time and Space, fully resurrecting him—not through reincarnation, but by altering time itself. More incredibly, Luo Feng also brought back 125 of Entropy Sky Flame’s loved ones—his family, comrades, disciples—all restored to life.

Overwhelmed with emotion, Entropy Sky Flame fears it’s an illusion until the voice of his wife brings tears to his eyes. As Luo Feng departs quietly, he watches his old friend reunite joyfully with those he once lost. Admiring Entropy Sky Flame’s noble character and past sacrifice for the weak, Luo Feng later grants him a leadership role within the Continent of Origin faction—alongside figures like Sitting Mountain Guest, Emperor Chu, and others.

characters.title: Evil Wing Sect Master
characters.introText: A giant snake with two wings. Its abdomen is silver-white while its back is blue-black. The giant snake has nine horns on its forehead, which entwine and form a crown. It has golden eyes.
characters.appearance: A giant snake with two wings. Its abdomen is silver-white while its back is blue-black. The giant snake has nine horns on its forehead, which entwine and form a crown. It has golden eyes.

characters.title: Eye of Life and Death Beast
characters.introText: The Eye of Life and Death Beast was a World-Class Chaotic Origin Lifeform that existed solely in the form of an enormous eye. Its size reached nearly one-thousandth of a normal Origin World, making it an entity of unimaginable scale. After its death, the entire corpse of this lifeform was refined into a supreme secret treasure known as the Eye of Life and Death. The structure of this eye contained countless secret patterns, divided into two distinct systems: one of Life and one of Destruction. These two forces, though not fused, were intricately interwoven and interdependent, reflecting the beast’s unique nature as a being embodying both creation and annihilation.

characters.title: Fa Er

infobox.affiliation: Palace of Gods of War Europe Union

characters.introText: In the novel, Fa Er is a white man with curly brown hair. In the donghua, she is a white woman with white hair.
characters.appearance: In the novel, Fa Er is a white man with curly brown hair. In the donghua, she is a white woman with white hair.
characters.history:
Fa Er is an Elder of the Palace of Gods of War, a Planetary Level warrior capable of flight and possessing fire powers. The energy she unleashes has a radius of around 100 meters, allowing her to incinerate anything within that range. While much faster than most Apprentice Level cultivators, even in the air, she is not faster than a Level 9 Apprentice Spirit Master when flying on their Spirit Weapon.

She arrives on the Misty Island in hopes of acquiring the spirits of nature, but is foiled by the combined efforts of Luo Feng, Zhu Xi/Liu He, and Bing Shan. She later helps Li Yao, Keita, Ivan, and Catalan escape the Cloud Vine while it focused on Bing Shan. She greets Hong on his arrival, and after retrieving what she could from the Misty Island, she leaves.

During the excavation of the Misty Island, she and her team from the HR Alliance/Europe Union team kill one of the members of the Hindia/Indian contingent, Maha.

Has three people she addresses as teacher though their identities are currently unknown. However they are also Elder in the Palace of Gods of War and as such must have reached Outgunned God of War/Planetary Cultivation.
characters.trivia:
Fa Er is a male in the novel but a female in the Donghua. Why this change was made is unknown.

It is assumed that this character has Law of Fire  affinity due to their fire manipulation.

In the novel, the 3 people who arrived seem to include Catalan's teacher; none of them appear to be Farr's teacher

In the novel, Fa Er is not Catalan's teacher, but an acquaintance of his teacher

characters.title: False-Real Devil God
characters.introText: While acting incognito, he was a hunchbacked and green-skinned elderly human with antenna. When he attempted to attack Luo Feng, he was an entirely black lifeform with a black aura and a pair of black eyes.
characters.appearance: While acting incognito, he was a hunchbacked and green-skinned elderly human with antenna. When he attempted to attack Luo Feng, he was an entirely black lifeform with a black aura and a pair of black eyes.
characters.history:
False-Real Devil God is a lone True God of the Original Universe. Born as a Special Lifeform, he was incomparably ancient and his power gave him the right to be arrogant. He fought his way through extremely great battles of fame, showcasing his abilities. Along with Sitting Mountain Guest, he is hated by all powers in the Original Universe, but none of the powers could do anything to them due to their abilities. Like some other lone True Gods, he is known to have a weird temperament and might kill anyone at any time.

When it was determined that Luo Feng had the strength of a Top Universe Overlord, Father God called in a favor and enlisted False-Real Devil God to kill him, despite Luo Feng residing in the Ancestral God Sect's Bauhinia Island. He was countered by Two-Faced Ancestral God, and due to the suppression of the Original Universe, he was unable to defeat him and kill Luo Feng.

At the onset of the Human Race Survival War, False-Real Devil God met with the other neutral True Gods, including Shi Hua Island Leader, Northern Territory Alliance Master, E Zhou, Sitting Mountain Guest, and Space Beast Ancestor to discuss the result of the battle. Eventually, he chose the United Forces Alliance and fought against the Human Race. After the Human Race emerged victorious, he and the remaining True Gods of the United Forces Alliance agreed to maintain a loose alliance that would only deal with threats from the Human Race.

characters.title: Fang You
characters.introText: Fang You was a member of the Extreme Martial Club who died years ago in the wilderness. Blood Blade held a grudge against him and, since he was unable to take it out on the deceased Fang You, killed all of Fang You's family and relatives.
characters.history: Fang You was a member of the Extreme Martial Club who died years ago in the wilderness. Blood Blade held a grudge against him and, since he was unable to take it out on the deceased Fang You, killed all of Fang You's family and relatives.

characters.appearance: A giant black oval.
characters.history:
Father God is the True God who leads the Automaton Race. As the greatest being in the race, all beings of the race have a command in their core to obey its commands.

After Luo Feng begins showcasing power at the level of a Top Universe Overlord and begins cultivating on Bauhinia Island, Father God contacts Dream Demon Ancestor, Shock Demon Ancestor, and Zerg Empress to discuss plans on killing him to halt his future progress.

characters.title: Fear Gold Hou Demon Marquis
characters.introText: His puppet body was shaped like a human, but with a scaled wolf head. His actual body was a huge, gold-scaled beast with a one-horned wolf head. The scales on its head had incomparably complex engravings.
characters.appearance: His puppet body was shaped like a human, but with a scaled wolf head. His actual body was a huge, gold-scaled beast with a one-horned wolf head. The scales on its head had incomparably complex engravings.
characters.history:
Fear Gold Hou Demon Marquis is the non-canon name given to the Fear Gold Hou Race Immortal Marquis whose team was Luo Feng's first opponent on the Yan Ji Continent. As a pinnacle Immortal Marquis, he had reached the state of Immortal Body, making him a formidable opponent on the continent.

When Luo Feng purposefully turned off the blocking function of his Scanning Device, Fear Gold Hou Demon Marquis and his team detected him. Believing they had caught the Star-Eating World Master by surprise, he and his team attacked Luo Feng. Despite being a pinnacle Immortal Marquis, he slowly lost to Luo Feng's Earthling Body and its Bright Moon Policy techniques.

After completing his training through combat, Luo Feng summoned his Golden Horned Beast Body, which easily destroyed 50% of the marquis' Divine Body by using the Shi Wu Wings. This forced him to self-destruct to avoid being soul controlled.

characters.title: Feather Dark Seigneur
characters.introText: Feather Dark Seigneur is one of the three Universe Overlords (along with Venerable Drought Demon Blade and Venerable Ce Tian) who, while trapped the Dangerous Land of Space Beast Ancestor's Miniature Universe, encountered Luo Feng.
characters.appearance: Has a spine-chilling voice.
characters.history:
Feather Dark Seigneur is one of the three Universe Overlords (along with Venerable Drought Demon Blade and Venerable Ce Tian) who, while trapped the Dangerous Land of Space Beast Ancestor's Miniature Universe, encountered Luo Feng.

He attacked Luo Feng with a soul attack and noticed that his body was immune, then stayed back and watched Luo Feng fight Venerable Drought Demon Blade. He noted that his illusion attack could not affect Luo Feng due to his strong willpower and mind, and expressed amazement at the energy of his Divine Body.

After Luo Feng forced Venerable Drought Demon Blade to self-destruct, Feather Dark Seigneur gave Luo Feng information on the Dangerous Land within which they were trapped, then watched him fly away.

characters.title: Feather Emperor
characters.introText: A feathered creature. He had a calm face and warm white feathers covering his body. His aura was restrained and ordinary.
characters.appearance: A feathered creature. He had a calm face and warm white feathers covering his body. His aura was restrained and ordinary.
characters.history: Feather Emperor is an Immortal and indestructible existence, Top ten being in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Though his aura appears gentle and ordinary, he is one of the most powerful eternal beings, qualified to sit at the round table in the Eternal Land. He belongs to no faction but possesses descendants, unlike solitary beings such as Kafuxiu. He once faced a joint assault from Lord Jin, Lord Mo Man, and Lord Nai Gu. Although he could handle Lord Nai Gu one-on-one, he was overwhelmed when all three attacked together. In that battle, he was severely injured, most of his feathers were plucked off, and his body was covered in blood. This moment was captured and mocked by Kafuxiu, who displayed the image and laughed at his defeat, causing Feather Emperor to become enraged. Despite his fury, he tolerated the humiliation, choosing restraint over retaliation. Feather Emperor is recognized and respected among the eternal beings and was present during Luo Feng's arrival at the Eternal Land. His strength grants him a stable place among the strongest, and though quiet in demeanor, he has endured both combat and ridicule with dignity.
characters.trivia: Feather Emperor is the Ruler of 17th layer/Destruction World of the Abyss Of Destruction

characters.title: Fei Cang God General
characters.introText: An 8 meter tall being made of rock. He wears purple armor with swirling flames on its surface. His entire body glowing dark-green, at first glance he looked like dark-green jadeite.
characters.appearance: An 8 meter tall being made of rock. He wears purple armor with swirling flames on its surface. His entire body glowing dark-green, at first glance he looked like dark-green jadeite.
characters.history:
Fei Cang God General is the non-canon name given to the God General of the Fei Cang Race who first met Luo Feng and King Zhenyan when they reached the Ancestral God Secret Region. As a God General, he is a Top Universe Overlord, capable of surviving an encounter with a Universe Master.

He shocked the pair by teleporting to their location without them being able to sense him. Upon meeting the pair, he requested to see their token and gave them a tour of sorts, explaining to them the identity and power of the Five-Color Aurora Lake, accompanying them to Bauhinia Island, and explaining the structure and dwelling places of the Ancestral God Sect. After explaining the policies of the Ancestral God Sect and escorting them to the palace of the Guardian Beast God of Bauhinia Island, he left, expressing his hope that they could live on the island rather than die.

characters.title: Fei Tuo
characters.introText: Fei Tuo is the strongest of the Universe Level seniors in the Primal Secret Realm, the only one to pass the 8th level of the Tong Tian Bridge. Within the entire core of the Virtual Universe Company, Fei Tuo was the only Universe Level cultivator to pass the 8th level. In Luo Feng's first Secret Realm Qualification Battle, Fei Tuo easily obtained first place and remained in the Primal Secret Realm.
characters.history:
Fei Tuo is the strongest of the Universe Level seniors in the Primal Secret Realm, the only one to pass the 8th level of the Tong Tian Bridge. Within the entire core of the Virtual Universe Company, Fei Tuo was the only Universe Level cultivator to pass the 8th level. In Luo Feng's first Secret Realm Qualification Battle, Fei Tuo easily obtained first place and remained in the Primal Secret Realm.

Despite this strength, Fei Tuo elected to remain at Universe Level and take advantage of the opportunities there, since breaking through to Domain Master would likely result in a demotion to the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm.

characters.title: Feng Hao Master
characters.introText: Feng Hao Master was a Universe Master from the Purple Moon Race. They were informed by one of their Universe Venerable disciples that their wing treasure (the fifth pair of wings from the Chaotic Golden Wings) felt an attraction from another treasure. Feng Hao asked other Universe Masters within the race if they felt anything, but none had. This helped Purple Moon Ancestor figure out that Luo Feng sought to acquire the wings, so he did what he could to prevent that from happening.
characters.history:
Feng Hao Master was a Universe Master from the Purple Moon Race. They were informed by one of their Universe Venerable disciples that their wing treasure (the fifth pair of wings from the Chaotic Golden Wings) felt an attraction from another treasure. Feng Hao asked other Universe Masters within the race if they felt anything, but none had. This helped Purple Moon Ancestor figure out that Luo Feng sought to acquire the wings, so he did what he could to prevent that from happening.

Like the other members of the Purple Moon Race (other than Purple Moon Ancestor), Feng Hao Master died when Morosa devoured the origin of Purple Moon Ancestor's Miniature Universe.

characters.title: Feng Long Master
characters.introText: A human-looking being, but with 4 faces and 16 arms. He is 1,000 kilometers tall.
characters.appearance: A human-looking being, but with 4 faces and 16 arms. He is 1,000 kilometers tall.
characters.history:
Feng Long Master is a Universe Master of the Purple Moon Race, a member of its second-purest bloodline. He was ranked in the middle of the Universe Masters of the Purple Moon Race, with power comparable to Five Chaos Master and Star River Master. He was easier to talk to than great beings of the First Reincarnation Era, likely due to the fact that he did not have to worry about transcending reincarnation to avoid death.

Luo Feng encountered Feng Long Master when he reached Flame Water Lake when escaping the Magma Sea. Feng Long Master was stationed in the area above Flame Water Lake, due to the relatively high chance of Arcana appearing, and noticed Luo Feng's appearance in the area. Flying to meet him, he commented on the value of Luo Feng's Shi Wu Wings, then advised him to leave the area, as it was the territory of the Purple Moon Race. Inwardly delighted to have avoided combat, Luo Feng obliged and left as quickly as he could.

When news of Luo Feng's battle with Five Chaos Master, Yin Tuo, and Ultimate Arrow Master spread throughout Universe Ocean, Pan Ke Master told Feng Long Master about the perceived true value of the Shi Wu Wings, a treasure second only to Xeon Arcana. After learning of this, he agreed to join Pan Ke Master and You Ya Master in attacking Luo Feng and obtaining the Shi Wu Wings.

The three Universe Masters surrounded Luo Feng from 3 different directions, attempting to prevent his escape, but were unable to get closer than 1 light-year away. After unsuccessfully getting Luo Feng to agree to exchange the Shi Wu Wings for 3 Pinnacle Arcana, Feng Long Master's Domain-type Pinnacle Arcana, Nebula Lamp began to clash with the combination of Golden Country and Flame Sand Cup, creating a huge energy wave. The energy waves from Nebula Lamp attracted Five Chaos Master, who was in the vicinity.

Activating Core of Blade Sector, Five Chaos Master joined the battle, and when its domain clashed with Nebula Lamp, the two users became aware of each other's presence in the area. Feng Long Master then agreed to join forces with Five Chaos Master to corner Luo Feng, and they would settle who got the Shi Wu Wings after killing Luo Feng. Neither expected Luo Feng to make the decision he made: flying upward into Frozen Lake Thunderbolt Fire.

Flying within Frozen Lake Thunderbolt Fire, Luo Feng continued to fly to the top, approaching the Twelve Abysses. Fortunately for Feng Long Master, Luo Feng chose to use I Am the Universe to trap himself and Five Chaos Master in the Twelve Abysses, and not Feng Long Master.

Like the other members of the Purple Moon Race (other than Purple Moon Ancestor), he died when Morosa devoured the origin of Purple Moon Ancestor's Miniature Universe.

characters.title: Feng Tian Master
characters.introText: Feng Tian Master is a Guarding Godly Master of the Ancestral God Sect. As a Guarding Godly Master, Feng Tian Master has 3 Universe Masters under them. Feng Tian Master is considered a legendary existence in the Original Universe, and is confident that their strength is on par with Star River Master. They have multiple bodies, one of which was sent to assist the Human Race on behalf of the Ancestral God Sect in their battle with the Three-Clan Coalition Army. characters.history:
Feng Yu Qi is a powerful Eternal True God and the sect master of the remnants of the Heart Shadow Sect. He is tasked with leading the sect on a mission to take over Hu Yang City, and sent out a call to the disciples scattered throughout the Continent of Origin to gather for the mission. He is concerned about losing too many disciples in the mission, as he considering the fight with the other forces under the command of Lord Jiu Jiang.

At the beginning of their invasion, he visited the Flame Wind Guild Hall with gifts, making sure to not offend the powerful organization in their invasion. He also learned of the inability of Heart Eye Elder to defeat Luo Feng in their sparring match, but took from their meeting the good news that Luo Feng had not yet decided to work for Jiu Jiang. Content with the thought that Luo Feng would not directly oppose them, he gave the order to move to the next phase of their plan, locking down the city, taking over the cave residences of the Five Major Families, and seizing the three forbidden areas of the city.

Having secured the city, Feng Yu Qi gave the order for the sect to begin looting the city, thinking they would earn a profit off the city even if they lost the final battle over it. After Chan Wu Qi's actions caused Luo Feng to enter direct conflict with the sect, the sect leader attempted to contact him, but was greeted with the news of Luo Feng killing Pomfret and the two Eternal True Gods with him. Understanding that the elders' hearts were burning with anger, and the necessity of maintaining the sect's spirit, he reluctantly gave the order to attack Luo Feng.

Recognizing the strength of Luo Feng and Morosa, he sent out the Heart Devil Hawk, Six Shadow Killing Formation, and the Great Destruction Matchless Formation, believing that strength was sufficient to deal with them. He monitored the overall situation, watching the clash between Heart Eye Elder and Luo Feng, and was shocked when Luo Feng easily broke the Six Shadow Killing formation. While he was discouraged by Luo Feng's ability to avoid being trapped by the Great Destruction Matchless Formation, he understood that the sect's true enemy was Lord Jiu Jiang's army, rather than Luo Feng, and felt that Jiu Jiang probably wouldn't be willing to spend the funds necessary to hire him.

After the sect completed the looting of Hu Yang City, Feng Yu Qi gave the order to wait for Lord Jiu Jiang to send a formation master. Having locked down the City Lord's Mansion, they would intercept and kill that master, thus eliminating the threat of the three Large Cities. When Luo Feng appeared in Yue Wu's formation, Feng Yu Qi gave the order to Heart Eye Elder and Brother Qiu Yi to intercept him with their sect-guarding treasures, and while they were entangled with Luo Feng, he led the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom Military Warship to attack. To his shock, Yue Wu was able to navigate his formation around the warship, and Jiu Jiang's army made it to the City Lord's Mansion.

Despite the worsening situation, he still outwardly showed confidence in their eventual victory, noting that Jiu Jiang's army would have to leave the mansion to fight them eventually, otherwise they would be unable to rule Hu Yang City or the Jiu Jiang Chaos State. After most of the other elders left, he spoke to Heart Eye Elder and Qiu Yi on the side, understanding that Luo Feng likely hadn't used his full strength. Realizing that the two may not be able to entangle Luo Feng, he gave them the go-ahead to attack the Eternal True Gods in Jiu Jiang's army if they proved incapable of keeping Luo Feng occupied.

characters.title: Fire Dome
characters.introText: In the 330,000th era after the World of Jin appeared, Fire Dome arose as an extraordinary human talent, living within the former territory of the Prison Race. Due to his brilliance, many human Universe Masters vied for him as their disciple, but when Luo Feng stepped up to claim him, no one objected.  Fire Dome was himself very excited to have Luo Feng as his teacher.
characters.appearance: Looks very young, with long red hair.
characters.history:
In the 330,000th era after the World of Jin appeared, Fire Dome arose as an extraordinary human talent, living within the former territory of the Prison Race. Due to his brilliance, many human Universe Masters vied for him as their disciple, but when Luo Feng stepped up to claim him, no one objected.  Fire Dome was himself very excited to have Luo Feng as his teacher.

Luo Feng was only interested in taking in disciples because he liked Fire Dome's talent. Extremely skilled in Law of Water  and Law of Fire , he was seen as a good candidate as heir to the legacy of Jie Fanzi, which was hard to come by, so Luo Feng took him as his second disciple.

In the 701 millionth era, Fire Dome unexpectedly achieved a breakthrough to become the sixth True God of the human era. He also occupied a large piece of Milky Way Holy Land. Once he became a True God and went to the World of Jin to hone his skills, he believed he was in the top tier of True Gods. With his Divine Power burning technique, Mechanical Treasure, and confidence, he sparred with Luo Feng, however with a single look from Luo Feng, he lost consciousness and crashed to the ground.

While he was extremely gifted and had an incredible secret technique, his willpower was nowhere near the exceptional level of his teacher, which hindered his path to perfection.  With this in mind, he continued to work hard to train his willpower to the level of Void True God level, so he could learn Luo Feng's willpower technique.

When Morosa appeared outside of Firefly True Master's Miniature Universe, Fire Dome joined Hong and Luo Feng to stop the attack, but did not make it in time. He was present for their review of how Firefly True Master was killed, and he joined Hong on Luo Feng's Star Tower team. He and Hong were present when Purple Moon Ancestor went back on his word after Morosa stopped devouring the origin of his miniature universe. Fire Dome also joined Void Gold True God and Dragon Walk True God in defending Luo Feng's miniature universe from the Sector Beasts. Fire Dome was of the True Gods present to defend Ancestor Yuan's miniature universe from Morosa.

Since Fire Dome was neither an Earthling nor part of Luo Feng's Remote Ocean lineage, he did not have enough influence to lead Milky Way Kingdom, so Xi Mo became their leader after he became a True God.

About 700 periods after the establishment of the Milky Way God Kingdom, Fire Dome broke through to Void True God.

characters.title: Five Chaos Master

infobox.laws: space gold wood water fire earth

characters.introText: Silver Wings Seigneur, if you continue to fight, we will all perish. And I swear...I, Five Chaos, will come after you and hunt every single body of yours to death. Every body of yours that I see, I will hack to death!
characters.personality: As a Universe Master from the First Reincarnation Era, he can be quite daring, due to his impending doomsday. He's arrogant because of his strength, and he assumes opponents from the Original Universe won't be willing to risk everything to fight him. He respects the truly strong!
characters.history:
A Universe Master of the Divine Eye Race from the First Reincarnation Era, Five Chaos Master has an impressive reputation in Universe Ocean. Most would do everything they could to avoid facing him in combat. Despite not being one of the True Gods of the race, he is still very highly valued and respected within the race.

He only respects the strong; out of all of the Universe Masters of the Original Universe, only the best of the best had fought him. He respects Primal Chaos City Leader because he was able to handle his ultimate technique despite having a smaller Divine Body.

In the past, he obtained a Black Token and found the valuables left by Feng Gu Ling, including Extermination Godly Armor.

He and Ultimate Arrow Master came across Luo Feng when Luo Feng was fighting Yin Tuo in God-Destroying Mountain Stream, and they decided to confront the two to obtain the emerging Arcana from the lava whirlpool. After a skirmish with Luo Feng, he decided to use his Extermination Godly Armor to attack Luo Feng, but was interrupted by the emergence of the Lava Devil God. He was forced to take the creature's attacks along with the other combatants, and, together with Ultimate Arrow Master, stayed inside his Flying Palace Pinnacle Arcana, Forbidden Temple, to endure the 7 calamities.

While his palace was destroyed by the Magma Sea, he was able to survive by transforming his Extermination Godly Armor into Five Beast Gods, a technique that can rival the durability of palace-type Pinnacle Arcana. He then returned to the Flame Water Lake and again engaged with Luo Feng, along with Feng Long Master, You Ya Master, and Pan Ke Master. After forcing Luo Feng to escape toward the Deep Abyss to avoid their pincer attack, he was the only pursuer to follow Luo Feng into the Deep Abyss. His original body died within a black hole within the Deep Abyss.

His body in his Immortal Palace in the Divine Eye True Master Miniature Universe reported his losses to Divine Eye True Master. Due to his loss of the Black Token and Extermination Godly Armor, Third True Master and Sixth True Master took off, heading for Universe Boat to retrieve them, in addition to the Shi Wu Wings. He updated Divine Eye True Master when he felt someone discovering and becoming the owner of Extermination Godly Armor.

After his race was unsuccessful in retrieving his Arcana, he became friends with An Yong Master, who also had enmity with Luo Feng. They later began to search for him in Universe Boat, but never found him.

He died when a Sector Beast devoured Divine Eye True Master, killing him, destroying his Miniature Universe, and killing all whose life origin was tied to it, including Five Chaos Master.

characters.title: Flame Emperor

infobox.Aliases: Cáo Běnqí Emperor Yan His Majesty Flame Emperor

characters.introText: Just wait and see, Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest! He'll never catch up with me, even with your help! I'll always be his better! I'll be stronger--stronger even than you!
characters.appearance: A towering being, almost 10,000 kilometres tall. The air exhaled from his nose burned the space around him, his black horn seemed to pierce the sky, and he was densely covered in black scales. He was the very picture of the Flame God Race. He carried an overbearing arrogance and ignored the presence of all others. His power and arrogance naturally emanated from him, in his bones and in his soul.
characters.personality:
Flame Emperor has paranoid bias to the bad and is dismissal of the good, alongside pettiness and viciousness, being reluctant to give his junior brother Luo Feng the Force Armor and then blames his master for making him lose a treasure. He is viewed by Primal Chaos City Leader as too ambitious and selfish. He could never accept being subservient (inferior) to anyone else, and with his selfish nature and unwillingness to forgive others, he betrayed the Human Race and even dragged the Flame God Race to betray with him with personally renaming their race based off his 'name'. He also fully knew his race's next generation born in a secret region would only have the very low potential to reach the Universe Venerable level, but he still migrated them to the Flame God Secret Region with his betrayal and led his master to eventually abandon them. He held blind ambition to one day overthrow his master, Sitting Mountain Guest, and be as domineering as the Human Race's top powerhouse, Ancestor Yuan. He looked down upon his senior brother, as he was originally a slave of his teacher, and had inferior potential and true treasures compared to himself.

His pride also made him disdain owning any treasure less than the Top Arcana.
characters.history:
Flame Emperor was the product of the cultivation efforts of Sitting Mountain Guest, first with the creation of the Flame God Race, followed by his focused training on the most talented and strongest member. In Sitting Mountain Guest's theoretical plan, Flame Emperor would become the Flame God Race's leader and could potentially reach the Infinite Divine Body. Unique amongst his race, Flame Emperor reached a Life Gene Level of nearly 10,000 through cultivation. Like his third brother disciple representing the most talented of the Earthlings, Flame Emperor became the sole representative of his race in his master's heart: success means entering the Continent of Origin, failure means abandonment alongside his race.

Because of his personality, Flame Emperor even attacked Human Race Universe Masters! He attacked them for their valuables, and was sentenced to imprisonment by Huge Axe Creator.  However, because Flame Emperor's constant exhibitions of cultivation did not have the future potential to develop the Infinite Divine Body, his master finalized the abandonment of the Flame God Race, the Infinite Divine Body and his second-disciple.

During his betrayal, he was able to escape with his race to a remote territory far from the human territory and personally renamed his race the Flame God Race (Yàn Shén Zú). Over the eons, he made sure the Flame God Race would enter the outer region wars, joining other groups to fight against humans. He was also publicly assisted by Sitting Mountain Guest throughout his time in the universe.

As a Universe Master Level 3, he is a high-ranking member of the Nine Territory Alliance.

He is reluctant to give the Force Armor to his junior brother Luo Feng as instructed, and attempts to passively disobey Sitting Mountain Guest's orders. Luo Feng sees through that and essentially forces him to choose between actively disobeying his teacher or giving up the armor.

He is one of the great beings who shows up to seal Yuan Ao Master. He tries to convince the Nine Territory Alliance to join the United Forces Alliance for the Duan Dong River inheritance, but it seems he was unsuccessful.

The birth of the Fourth Reincarnation Era leads to Flame Emperor's demise and his race.

characters.history:
Flame Immortal Slave is the Immortal Soul Slave that Ke Si Er hid in his Internal World. In his past, he was enslaved by the Zerg Race.

After Ke Si Er failed in his assassination attempt on Luo Feng, he released this soul slave to kill him. The slave's first move was killing Ke Si Er, then it began to battle Luo Feng's Golden Horned Beast Body, utilizing his flame Law Domain against its World Projection. When the battle had lasted 50 seconds, he self-destructed in an attempt to kill the Golden Horned Beast and Luo Feng, but this failed.
characters.trivia: While in the novel, this character is a Soul Slave housed in Ke Si Er's World Master World, in the donghua, Ke Si Er is himself an Immortal and the two characters are consolidated in him.

characters.appearance: A giant beast engulfed in flames, standing over 10,000 kilometers tall. He exudes boundless power.
characters.history:
Flame Star Master is a Universe Master of the Space Beast Alliance. He is the most ancient and most powerful being of the Flame Star Beast race, one of the 12 pinnacle bloodlines of Space Beasts.

When Luo Feng successfully obtained the compass of Blade River Luo while in his Golden Horned Beast body, Flame Star Master appeared to defend him against Overflowing Devil Master. While the two Universe Masters confronted each other, Primal Chaos City Leader arrived, causing Overflowing Devil Master to back down. Primal Chaos City Leader then agreed to not interfere with Luo Feng having the component of Sword River Luo, and left.

After Primal Chaos City Leader left, Flame Star Master asked Luo Feng if he had ever been to the Space Beast Alliance, since he had never seen him before. He provided details, including the universe coordinates of the Space Beast Alliance, then gave Luo Feng some cautious advice, and left.

He and his nephew began to show some interest in Luo Feng, who joined the Dark Hall under the alias 'Swordsman,' after he easily defeated Lai Mo and provoked Mu Yang. The pair were aware of Ying Cang and his assassination attempt on Luo Feng, and knew that he died in the attempt.
