characters.appearance: A giant, two-headed being, about 10 meters tall, with skin that looked like purple crystals.
characters.history:
Flourishing Light Horde Leader is one of the 6 Universe Overlords who lead the Purple Smelting Race. Their race is one of the many that serve under the Northern Territory Alliance, and as such, he was a great being who knew about Luo Feng from the fight with King Bark Mirror. As the Purple Smelting race are energy beings, he is naturally immune to soul attacks.

While waiting at the Original Star for an opportunity, he noticed Luo Feng flying across the sky and took the opportunity to fight him and seize the treasures King Bark Mirror reported were in Luo Feng's possession to exchange for a High Arcana armor. Unfortunately for him, he encountered Luo Feng after his cultivation in Beast God Sector for 180 million years (including the time acceleration), and he was killed in one move by Luo Feng's new ultimate-level Universe Master technique. It smashed through his Flourishing Light World technique and half of its power reached his body through his Common Arcana armor.

Upon hearing of his demise, 3 of the remaining Universe Overlords of his race petitioned Northern Territory Alliance Master to resurrect him, which he did. Upon his resurrection, he used his memories to show Star River Master how Luo Feng killed him with one strike. This led Star River Master to order his subordinates to send out information to the entire Original Universe that Luo Feng had the power of a Top Universe Overlord, comparable to Tian Shi Palace Master.

characters.history: Forked Blood Palace Leader is a Universe Overlord from the Northern Territory Alliance. When Luo Feng obtained one of the divine swords of Sword River Luo, Forked Blood Palace Leader and Venerable Bei Feng were the first two to arrive and attack him. They worked together and attacked him with soul attacks, Spirit Weapons, and his special attacking technique, but they were unable to noticeably damage Luo Feng as he was wearing the Robbery Armor. After their failure, they met up with the other members of their alliance, who were beginning to arrive, and later, they retreated on Overflowing Demon Master's orders.

characters.title: Fu Tianyi

infobox.territory: Chaotic Origin Dimension Mingyu World Cluster

characters.introText: Fu Tianyi was a Quasi Chaotic Origin Life Form Dao Comprehender Cultivator operating within the Cultivator Territory, specifically in the Mingyu World Cluster under Lord Ming Huang’s rule. He sought to “jump out of the cage” of his limitations by cultivating through horrific means, using billions of souls as nourishment for his practice. Over 320 million epochs, he devoured over a hundred trillion beings, amassing grave sins that marked him as a criminal in Lord Ming Huang’s absolute territory, where sin is intolerable. His actions led to his trial by the eight High Chaotic Origin Lifeform Cultivator, resulting in a split verdict—three favored the endless Wind Punishment, three demanded death. Ultimately, he was sentenced to death, and a World Chaotic Origin Lifeform Cultivator traced his weapon’s karma, annihilating his soul with a glance via memory corruption.

characters.title: Fu Wei Sa
characters.introText: A ferocious-looking creature, completely covered in dark-red scales, with sharp claws and spikes on his elbows and knees.
characters.appearance: A ferocious-looking creature, completely covered in dark-red scales, with sharp claws and spikes on his elbows and knees.
characters.history:
Fu Wei Sa was the Immortal Army Lord leader of a group of Qiu Shi Race creatures who fought in the Extraterritorial Battlefield. His team fought with Tai Wo's team in the past, killing its second-strongest member and devouring him in front of the team.

More than 3,000 years later, his team encountered Tai Wo's team again, however Luo Feng and Rock were now part of it. With the increased strength of Poison and Luo Feng's strength, they killed the World Master members of Fu Wei Sa's team, as well as Tuo Lu, the Immortal who devoured their dead teammate. Fu Wei Sa detonated 10% of his Divine Body to escape.

Enraged due to the death of his team, he contacted Lei Ke Ya and used him to get in touch with Meng Wei Na, planning to use the combined strength of the Immortals to kill Tai Wo's team. Knowing the value that the Demon Race placed on killing Human Race geniuses, Fu Wei Sa was confident that he could convince Meng Wei Na to lead them in killing Luo Feng and the rest of Tai Wo's team. Unfortunately for him, he was unaware of Luo Feng's true strength, and was devoured by his Immortal Star Eating Plant.

characters.title: Fu Zhen Marquis
characters.introText: Fu Zhen Marquis is a Primal Chaos Sovereign Realm cultivator of the Yu Kingdom who governs the Fu Zhen Chaos State and resides in Fu Zhen City. Deeply rooted in his long-held enfeoffed territory, he remains unwilling to abandon it even as the Food Kingdom launches a large-scale invasion. Surrounded by an overwhelming Eternal True Gods army and confronted by three enemy Primal Chaos Sovereign Realm experts outside the city, he clearly understands the hopelessness of direct resistance. With no orders coming from the Kingdom Lord and the four God Kings remaining silent, he is forced to watch in anger and frustration as his territory is threatened. His dilemma highlights the emotional burden of a loyal Sovereign caught between duty and the harsh realities of war until Luo Feng’s sudden arrival instantly overturns the entire situation.

infobox.Aliases: Golson Veedy Uncle Gao Sheng by Luo Hai

characters.introText: A fat and stout, black-haired youth flew out, his face had two purple stripes, and his eyes were squinted, making his overall appearance adorable. His height was similar to Luo Feng’s.
characters.appearance: A fat and stout, black-haired youth flew out, his face had two purple stripes, and his eyes were squinted, making his overall appearance adorable. His height was similar to Luo Feng’s.
characters.history:
Gao Sheng Wei Di is the first alien friend that Luo Feng made when he first visited Horned Dragon Planet. He is part of the Wei Di Family, the second-strongest family of the Kaluo Empire.

His father is a businessman, and he taught Gao Sheng the value of making new friends and treating them well. He immediately warms to Luo Feng, and his straightforwardness and honorable behavior warmed him to Luo Feng. When they see a woman being bullied by a disciple of the Ganwu Dojo (Wei Lin), they come to her defense and prevent further harm.

A little later, when Luo Feng decides to sell his Black Dragon Mountain X81 Spaceship, Gao Sheng facilitates the sale, making sure Luo Feng got the ship's worth.

He pays a little attention to the Pinnacle Genius Battle, and calls Luo Feng to tell him that someone with his name made it into the top 1,001 of the Ganwu Universe elimination battle, not knowing that the combatant is actually Luo Feng.

Later, when Luo Feng is going through the life and death inheritance for Star Tower, Gao Sheng leaves him a message telling him he broke off from his family and explored the universe, finally striking it big after many years.
characters.trivia: In the donghua he pays full attention to the Pinnacle Battles, and even cheers and place a bet for Luo Feng.

characters.title: Gao Wu Quyi
characters.introText: Gao Wu Quyi is the father of Gao Wu Shui, who was produced from his affair with the Gao Wu Family maid.
characters.history:
Gao Wu Quyi is the father of Gao Wu Shui, who was produced from his affair with the Gao Wu Family maid.

When the family leader, Gao Wu Wei, colluded with the Food Kingdom forces in Hu Yang City, Gao Wu Quyi escaped his son's wrath due to his ignorance of the scheme and because he was his father, despite their poor relationship.

Gao Wu Shui imprisoned him and told him that he could stay there forever if he chose not to admit his mistakes.

characters.title: Gao Wu Shui
characters.introText: He is like a metal sculpture, but his appearance is ordinary.
characters.appearance: He is like a metal sculpture, but his appearance is ordinary.
characters.personality: As a result of his childhood, Gao Wu Shui despises evil and fights for justice. He is focused on increasing his strength, and has no time for love and romance. He and Luo Feng seem to have a destined connection.
characters.history: As a Void True God, Gao Wu Shui was quite powerful, capable of commanding one of the special Hu Yang Legion teams. He specializes in controlling Mechanical Treasures, and had peak Eternal True God-level Willpower as a Void True God. After breaking through to Eternal True God, he is considered weak overall for the realm, but his powerful Willpower and skill allowed him to quickly master all of the techniques of his Legion-type Mechanical Treasure.

characters.title: Gao Wu Wei
characters.introText: Gao Wu Wei was an Eternal True God and the leader of the Gao Wu Family. He was bribed by Blood Cloud and the Food Kingdom forces stationed in Hu Yang City, and attempted to involve Gao Wu Shui in the conspiracy. Gao Wu Shui, loyal to his master, Moli Xiao, dispatched the Hu Yang Guard to arrest Wu Wei and the senior members of his family, declaring them traitors.
characters.history:

characters.title: Ge

characters.appearance: He has messy blonde hair and 4 ears, with two small ears behind the normal-sized ones. Despite his droopy eyes and dispirited look, he still gives off the aura of a wild beast.
characters.history:
Ge is one of the top-5 strongest Universe Level seniors of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm, along with Ke Luo Fu, Sa Jin, Ni Nan, and Yu Feng. He was the last to pass the 7th level of the Tong Tian Bridge, having done so over 300 years before Luo Feng's first Secret Realm Qualification Battle.

Despite being the last of the 5 to pass the 7th level of the bridge, due to his battle ability, he felt that Sa Jin and Ni Nan were not a threat. He was only concerned with defeating Yu Feng and Ke Luo Fu. His improvement speed and battle talents were shocking, similar to Rong Jun.

In his battle with Ke Luo Fu, he used his ultimate technique, allowing Luo Feng to see it in action. When they battled, in Luo Feng's 35th match, he did not give Ge the chance to get close to use his technique, defeating him with the Yan Shen Armament.

After battling Bolan, Luo Feng stated that Bolan was much stronger than Sa Jin, Ni Nan, and Ge, despite only passing the 7th level of the bridge 2 years prior to their battle.

characters.appearance: A burly figure, wearing armor with black water flowing inside. Their eyes are dead silent and condensed from the black water.
characters.history:
General Xuan Jiao is one of the three personal guards of Emperor Chu, and is a powerful mysterious lifeform, not a cultivator. Xuan Jiao was sent to offer Luo Feng the chance to become Emperor Chu's direct disciple, and to bring him to the emperor if he accepted the offer. Both Luo Feng and Morosa, who could be considered Transcendent Chaos Realms, felt a huge gap in their strength, with Morosa commenting that he felt that he would be killed in one move!

When Luo Feng accepted the offer, Xuan Jiao diligently brought Luo Feng to the Emperor Chu Palace.

characters.history:
Genji was a Universe Level 6 Warrior with a Level 5 Domain who fought in the Huge Axe Dojo. He was born on Lu Xiu Planet and was a genius who quickly grew and reached Planetary Level and Stellar Level, becoming an elite soldier of one of the planet's leaders. Eventually he became a hero of his clan, but was enslaved after the planet's leader enslaved a large enemy and was attacked. Genji eventually broke through to Universe Level and sold himself to the Huge Axe Dojo; if he won 1,000 battles (becoming a Huge Axe Warrior), he would be granted his freedom.

Luo Feng, Hong, and Thunder God witnessed his battle with Hanks, and gambled on it, with Luo Feng and Thunder God betting on Genji while Hong bet on Hanks. Despite being stronger, he was killed after Hanks stepped into the gateway of the Law of Water . He had won 691 consecutive battles before his death.

Just sitting, he’s already far larger than most Source Worlds, ranking among the largest beings in the Chaotic Origin Dimension many times bigger than Wulan. In battle, he becomes surrounded by a vast colored halo and black mist when fighting alongside its allies.

characters.personality: The Giant God Emperor prefers peace and detachment. He enjoys watching the rise and fall of events across Chaotic Origin Dimension like a bystander. Unlike the Infinite Serpent Ancestor, he dislikes war and generally avoids conflict unless necessary. He is calm, steady, and careful in its decisions, only choosing to fight when the stakes are too high to ignore.
characters.history:
The Giant God Emperor is one of the Nine Sovereigns of the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction and the leader of the Giant God Clan, a Clan born in the Giant God World. All beings born there are naturally at the World Chaotic Origin Lifeform stage, and the Clan is second in size only to the Infinite Snake Clan. Despite being extremely powerful, the Giant God Emperor’s survival ability is lower than others in the same rank, which makes him vulnerable in solo combat.

He leads one of the two major clans within the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction, rivaling the Infinite Snake Ancestor’s clan. His closest allies are Chaotic Origin Beast Ancestor and Black Tide Ancestor, both unique entities without clans, who rarely act but fully support the Giant God Emperor. Though he initially chose not to participate in the war against the Cultivator Camp, it eventually agreed to lead a force of 35 Hunyuan-level beings to battle, recognizing the danger Luo Feng posed if left unchecked.

Ginelli was one of the geniuses that the Ganwu Universe Country imperial family specially nurtured. He competed in the Pinnacle Genius Battle and was ranked 21st in the 13th world of the Universe Country Elimination Stage.

In the Universe Country Arena Stage, he was in the 382nd group, along with Luo Feng and Pushkin. He and Pushkin came to an agreement to work together during the arena stage so they could both pass, since they were both from the universe country's specially nurtured geniuses.

Before the arena stage battle began, Ginelli provoked Luo Feng, who already saw Ginelli and Pushkin as the clearest threats. As the battle began, he ordered Ao Fei Xiu Si and Kazan to attack Luo Feng, however after witnessing his strength, they attempted to retreat.

After Luo Feng eliminated Ao Fei and Kazan, he turned to Ginelli, who asked Pushkin to help defend against Luo Feng's attacks. After Luo Feng refused to spare Ginelli, he attacked Pushkin, who then agreed to step aside, leaving Ginelli to face Luo Feng.

Despite Ginelli's light domain, he was immediately put on the defensive by Luo Feng's Phantom Sword Form strike, then immediately eliminated by his second strike.

characters.personality: Due in part to his refining of a World-Class Hunyuan Bloodline, he is prone to erratic behavior, having to routinely kill Low-Level Hunyuan Lifeforms to release its suppressed will. He remains clear-headed and never indiscriminately slaughters cultivators, but he otherwise does whatever he wants.
characters.history:
God Emperor Ji Ke is one of the two most powerful God Emperors in the Dark Holy Realm upon Luo Feng's arrival. He is one of only two cultivators of the Dark Holy Realm known to exchange for a World-Class Hunyuan Bloodline, which he has refined to a level making him stronger than an ordinary Ultra Limit God Emperor.

After learning of Luo Feng's strength, comparable to an Invincible God Emperor, he rushed to Hunyuan City in hopes of fighting him with his full strength and getting some guidance in his cultivation path. In their sparring match, despite his best efforts, he was casually suppressed, unable to damage Luo Feng in the slightest.

Following their sparring match, Ji Ke sought advice in how to further tap into the potential of his bloodline, to which Luo Feng gave multiple pointers, including improving his Willpower. Understanding that he simply could not do what Luo Feng suggested, he then spent the remainder of his visit to Luo Feng giving guidance on Hunyuan Bloodline Cultivation to the other gathered God Emperors.

When Qiu Ge and Yi Fei Ya released the Lava Prisoner for Luo Feng to fight, Ji Ke joined Dao Lord Long Jiu and over 10,000 God Emperors to form a super formation to defend against its rampage, but eventually fled when they could not harm it. Upon Luo Feng's arrival, Ji Ke was among those who observed their battle, showing awe and bewilderment at his strength.

characters.title: God Emperor Kumo
characters.introText:
Kumo was a formidable and infamous cultivator from the Guile Workshop, known for his mastery of the Great Dao of Poison. Born into a world where poison governed the laws of existence, he had to constantly push past life-threatening tribulations to advance his cultivation. Over the centuries, he honed his craft, developing a unique physique known as the Strange Poison Body, which allowed him to corrode and assimilate enemies upon contact. His ruthless nature and efficiency in battle made him a feared figure, responsible for the destruction of entire worlds and the deaths of countless experts.
Upon arriving in the Nine Rivers Sacred World, Kumo found that the inheritance of the Guile Workshop complemented his Dao, allowing him to rise rapidly in strength. He became one of its core members and developed a reputation for cunning ambushes and merciless killings. His ability to wield highly toxic rule-based substances made him a particularly deadly opponent, as even middle-stage God Emperors had to be wary of his attacks.
characters.history:
Kumo was a formidable and infamous cultivator from the Guile Workshop, known for his mastery of the Great Dao of Poison. Born into a world where poison governed the laws of existence, he had to constantly push past life-threatening tribulations to advance his cultivation. Over the centuries, he honed his craft, developing a unique physique known as the Strange Poison Body, which allowed him to corrode and assimilate enemies upon contact. His ruthless nature and efficiency in battle made him a feared figure, responsible for the destruction of entire worlds and the deaths of countless experts.
Upon arriving in the Nine Rivers Sacred World, Kumo found that the inheritance of the Guile Workshop complemented his Dao, allowing him to rise rapidly in strength. He became one of its core members and developed a reputation for cunning ambushes and merciless killings. His ability to wield highly toxic rule-based substances made him a particularly deadly opponent, as even middle-stage God Emperors had to be wary of his attacks.

Kumo's downfall began when he and his allies attempted to ambush Luo Feng and Di Qing in the Indestructible Blood Sea Body. Overconfident in their numerical superiority, they underestimated Luo Feng’s strength and strategy. During the battle, Kumo attempted to corrode Luo Feng’s body using his deadly Strange Poison Body but was countered and captured within the vast expanse of the Endless Blood Sea. Bound by the chains of the Life and Death Calamity Diagram, Kumo found himself unable to escape.
While his allies fled, leaving him behind, Kumo realized he had no means of salvation. As Luo Feng refined him, he tried to negotiate for his life, offering vast riches in exchange for mercy. However, Luo Feng remained unmoved, continuing the refinement process. In his final moments, Kumo reflected on his life of endless slaughter, acknowledging that he had long since been consumed by his violent nature. With his last thoughts directed toward his master, Yu Yong, he accepted his fate and perished completely, leaving only his secret treasures behind.
Kumo’s death was a pivotal moment, as it marked the first time Luo Feng had slain a God Emperor, solidifying his growing reputation as a powerful force in Yulan City.

God Emperor Yu He is an Ultra Limit God Emperor who is well-known for his brutality, which few beings in Chengfeng City can suppress. He cultivates in the Great Dao of the Death Origin and the Great Dao of the Destruction Origin and has reached Perfect God Emperor in both Great Daos.

Yu He sells a Realm Origin Pearl to Luo Feng when informed by God Emperor Bo Xiu, and made no profit from the sale, hoping to build some friendship with Luo Feng.

characters.title: God Emperor Yu Yong

infobox.cultivation: Bloodline Late Stage God Emperor Bloodline Perfect God Emperor

characters.introText:
Yu Yong was a towering figure who takes path of bloodline cultivation. As a Chaotic Origin Bloodline Cultivator, his strength was immense, nearly pushed his bloodline to the Half-Chaotic Origin level. However, he was still a step away from truly reaching that stage. His current strength almost met lowest threshold to enter the Dark Holy Realm, so he didn't want to take a risk and preferred staying in the Nine Rivers Sacred World to accumulate power until he reached Half-Chaotic Origin Level.
He and Kumo had risen from the bottom together, surviving countless hardships. While many companions perished along the way, only the two of them had made it to the Nine Rivers Sacred World. For cultivators from the Origin World, reaching the God Emperor level was nearly impossible, but they had defied the odds through hard effort.
Upon receiving news of Kumo’s death, Yu Yong remained calm. He harbored no hatred toward Luo Feng, the one responsible. In the world of cultivation, those who chose the path of plunder had to be prepared for the consequences. Yu Yong understood this deeply.
Although they were master and disciple, after countless years of growing together, they had long become life-and-death companions. However, Yu Yong had no intention of seeking revenge. He believed Kumo would not have wanted that. His goal remained clear, he sought to jump out of the cage. Only then can he fulfill his purpose and erase the regrets of his past.

characters.history:
Gold was the Primal Chaos Sovereign (or Holy One) who was best at enslavement under Jin God King. Before the Jin Kingdom was destroyed, he was the right-hand man of Jin God King! His enslaved army was a mysterious but powerful force in the Jin Kingdom.

He created the enslavement technique Three Stars Realm, which Luo Feng learned and used to enslave Morosa.

Since he was the right-hand man of Jin God King, he was likely resurrected by Luo Feng after he became an Overlord.

characters.introText: An extremely handsome man with long golden hair that shined as brightly as the sun. He has three golden feathers on the top of his head.
characters.appearance: An extremely handsome man with long golden hair that shined as brightly as the sun. He has three golden feathers on the top of his head.
characters.history:
Golden Feather Marquis (true name Ai Fu) is an Immortal Marquis of the Virtual Universe Company (VUC). He is one of the Three Tycoons of the VUC's Ganwu Universe Country Department, leading the Military Department.

When Luo Feng was announced as the new Supervisor Envoy, Ai Fu suggested assassinating him, prompting Zhen Qian to remark that if he truly meant to do so, he'd have to do it in a way that left absolutely no evidence, lest he incur the wrath of the ferocious King Zhenyan.
characters.trivia: In the donghua, he manages the Business Department instead of the Military Department, while the Military Department is run by Ji Tian Cang

characters.title: Golden Horn Master
characters.introText: A towering Golden Horned Beast with gigantic wings covered with scaled armor. His aura could be likened to an endless universe.
characters.appearance: A towering Golden Horned Beast with gigantic wings covered with scaled armor. His aura could be likened to an endless universe.
characters.history:
Golden Horn Master is the oldest and most powerful of the two Universe Masters of the Golden Horned Beast bloodline. He met Luo Feng when the latter was brought to Space God Mountain, and he suggested to Space Beast Ancestor that Luo Feng (in his Golden Horned Beast Body) be admitted to the Space Beast Alliance.

He was one of the great beings to arrive in the Yuan Ao Secret Region and worked alongside numerous universe masters and Black Universe Creator to corner Yuan Ao Master. He worked alongside Canthus Devil Master to restrain Black Universe Creator when he decided to help Yuan Ao Master.

He was one of the Universe Masters from the Space Beast Alliance who worked alongside the United Forces Alliance to attack the human race.

Some time after the arrival of the World of Jin, he became a True God and was the primary point of contact between the Space Beast Alliance and the Human Race during the war against the Sector Beasts.

characters.title: Golden Horned Beast Body
characters.introText: This is the main body of Luo Feng after he sacrificed his Earthling Body to take control of the Golden Horned Beast's (GHB) Soul using multiple techniques (Possession, Soul Seal, Six Blade Edges, and Tower of the Void), during the Earth Incident. Even though the Novel regards Luo Feng's Earthling Body as the main body, after the death of his Original Earthling body, all other bodies were created from the GHB's Clone therefore his GHB Body is the main body. Even though his main body is of a Space Beast Race this doesn't mean that he also belongs to Space Beast Race because body doesn't determine the Race it is the Soul of a being that determines the Race and Luo Feng's Soul is Human.

characters.introText: The Golden-Robed Woman (金衣女子) is one of the top three cultivators within the Dark World Group , alongside Cheng and Wu Yan. Known for her striking golden robes and the three purple scales on her brow, she is a seasoned High Chaotic Origin Lifeform who has reached the "Perfect Stage" through bloodline excavation and secondary refinement.
characters.appearance: The Golden-Robed Woman (金衣女子) is one of the top three cultivators within the Dark World Group , alongside Cheng and Wu Yan. Known for her striking golden robes and the three purple scales on her brow, she is a seasoned High Chaotic Origin Lifeform who has reached the "Perfect Stage" through bloodline excavation and secondary refinement.
characters.personality: The Golden-Robed Woman is sharp, outspoken, and fiercely loyal to those she respects. She holds strong opinions, especially when it comes to unity and hierarchy, and doesn’t shy away from criticizing those who act arrogantly—such as Tian Lang Ke. At the same time, she recognizes her limits and places great hope in Luo Feng as the future of their world group.
characters.history: She hails from the relatively remote and resource-scarce Dark World Group under the jurisdiction of the Cultivator Camp. Like most in her group, she relied on slow excavation of her High-Level Chaotic Origin Bloodline to break through the cage. Despite her achievements, her region was historically overlooked and tasked with difficult labor such as patrolling and guarding distant realms.

characters.appearance: Tall, golden-armored man of the Divine Eye Race.

characters.title: Golden Surveyor Master
characters.introText: A humanoid creature in golden armor, with a hazy white light all over its body, a halo behind its head, and a one-eyed phantom in the halo.
characters.appearance: A humanoid creature in golden armor, with a hazy white light all over its body, a halo behind its head, and a one-eyed phantom in the halo.
characters.history: Golden Surveyor Master was a Universe Master of high status within the Divine Eye Race. When An Yong Master sought to kill Luo Feng and seize his Shi Wu Wings, Golden Surveyor agreed to meet up with him. Unfortunately, Luo Feng and the Golden Horned Beast Body (in the guise of Blood Cloud Palace Master), forced An Yong into retreat before he could group with with Golden Surveyor. Golden Surveyor was annoyed when An Yong relayed this information.
characters.trivia: Golden Surveyor Master's death had to have occurred in the Third Reincarnation Era, but it is not known when. Depending on which Miniature Universe contained their life imprint, Golden Surveyor could have died when Zhen Kan Wu killed Second True Master and Seventh True Master, when the Sector Beasts killed Divine Eye True Master, or when the Sector Beasts ate the remaining Miniature Universes of the First and Second Reincarnation Eras.

He used 5 golden hoops to bind, seal, and suppress his opponents, however Luo Feng was able to break them with his Perfect Divine Body.

The beast was killed by Black Cloud God King when Luo Feng captured it and refused to agree to not report its identity to the ancient kingdom.

characters.title: Great Emperor of Time and Space
characters.introText: He presents himself in multiple forms, one of a child, one of a middle-aged man, and one of an old man.
characters.appearance: He presents himself in multiple forms, one of a child, one of a middle-aged man, and one of an old man.
characters.history:
Great Emperor of Time and Space, known by those of the Continent of Origin as the Old Devil of Time and Space, is a cultivator from a different Origin World than that of Swallowed Star. He built the Lonely Boat of Time and Space and is the organization's founder. Some time in the past, he recruited Boat Owner and allowed him to own the Lonely Boat of Time and Space treasure. Of the founders of the three forces led by the alien races, he is the one most feared by the Ancient Kingdoms, and is known for his unscrupulous, vicious, and cruel means.

His home Origin World has no transmission channel through which a cultivator can explore the area outside of their Origin World. Eventually, after 3 Reincarnation Eras in his Origin World, he comprehended a method of breaking the boundary, splitting himself to visit other Origin Worlds.

After Luo Feng revealed a clone with strength rivaling Honorable Master Dark Sky, Great Emperor of Time and Space took the initiative to meet him, inviting him to trade treasures with him. He shared with Luo Feng that he has had direct conflicts with First Ancestor Flame Wind and First Ancestor Thunder, and told him that with Luo Feng's potential, it is possible they will meet when he leaves the Continent of Origin.

characters.title: Great Sage Beiyu
characters.introText: Great Sage Beiyu was a Primal Chaos Sovereign who once fought Lord Jiu Jiang. While fleeing from Jiu Jiang, Beiyu swallowed all of the living beings of the Large City Yue Rong City in hopes of absorbing energy and restoring strength. He lived in the Celestial Pole Ice Field, where he built many Ordinary Cities so he could devour all of their occupants. He was worshipped to a degree in this region.
characters.appearance: Tall with a huge, hairy head.
characters.history:
Great Sage Beiyu was a Primal Chaos Sovereign who once fought Lord Jiu Jiang. While fleeing from Jiu Jiang, Beiyu swallowed all of the living beings of the Large City Yue Rong City in hopes of absorbing energy and restoring strength. He lived in the Celestial Pole Ice Field, where he built many Ordinary Cities so he could devour all of their occupants. He was worshipped to a degree in this region.

His hobby was devouring cultivators, which resulted in him being placed on the bounty list for Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, with the task killing him worth 100,000 merits. He also used the devouring of cultivators to help his own cultivation.

During his time in the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, Luo Feng picked up the bounty task for killing him and killed him through the Lie Yuan Technique. Luo Feng retrieved his intact corpse to feed to Morosa.

characters.title: Great Sage Biyun
characters.introText: Great Sage Biyun is a Transcendent Chaos Realm of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. She is the direct disciple of Emperor Qing, and is well known for her mysterious and unparalleled methods. She is considered one of the most exceptional of the Transcendent Chaos Realm existences.
characters.history:
Great Sage Biyun is a Transcendent Chaos Realm of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. She is the direct disciple of Emperor Qing, and is well known for her mysterious and unparalleled methods. She is considered one of the most exceptional of the Transcendent Chaos Realm existences.

When Emperor Qing declared that Lord Chu Ying was the First-Class Lord with the greatest potential, Biyun became affiliated with him, agreeing to assist him with tasks if necessary.

characters.title: Great Sage Black Mist
characters.introText: Great Sage Black Mist was a Top Primal Chaos Sovereign who cultivated in the Great Dao of the Causality Origin. He lived in a relatively remote area and, using the Causality Calamity, regularly exterminated cultivators within his territory, eliminating the causality relationship between himself and the cultivators. He comprehended the Great Dao of Causality by learning the causality of the living beings in his territory.
characters.history:
Great Sage Black Mist was a Top Primal Chaos Sovereign who cultivated in the Great Dao of the Causality Origin. He lived in a relatively remote area and, using the Causality Calamity, regularly exterminated cultivators within his territory, eliminating the causality relationship between himself and the cultivators. He comprehended the Great Dao of Causality by learning the causality of the living beings in his territory.

Luo Feng took up the bounty mission to kill him, then instantly killed him with the Lie Yuan Technique, earning 100,000 merits. Since he was killed with a Willpower technique, his Divine Body was left intact and fed to Morosa.

characters.title: Great Sage Jiu Yuan
characters.introText: Great Sage Jiu Yuan is a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign who was offended by the Heart Shadow Sect. In retaliation, he killed one of their three Primal Chaos Sovereigns and forced the other 2 to flee. This resulted in the decline of the sect. Jiu Yuan is known to be good-tempered, and he did not start a life-or-death battle with Lord Liu Yin when the latter protected the Heart Shadow Sect.

characters.title: Great Sage Juefeng
characters.introText: Great Sage Juefeng is a powerful Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign who inhabits Juefeng City, located in the Celestial Pole Ice Field. Juefeng was once a disciple-in-name under an Emperor of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, but due to the fierce competition among the many elites, he chose to leave the ancient kingdom and live in the Celestial Pole Ice Field. He lives freely, unwilling to join any God-Kingdom, commands hundreds of millions of cultivators, and cultivates at will.
characters.appearance: A burly figure with dark blue skin.
characters.history:
Great Sage Juefeng is a powerful Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign who inhabits Juefeng City, located in the Celestial Pole Ice Field. Juefeng was once a disciple-in-name under an Emperor of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, but due to the fierce competition among the many elites, he chose to leave the ancient kingdom and live in the Celestial Pole Ice Field. He lives freely, unwilling to join any God-Kingdom, commands hundreds of millions of cultivators, and cultivates at will.

Lord Jiu Jiang asked him to assist in his battle against Lord Liu Yin, but Jiu Jiang couldn't accept his terms, since he asked for two of the three Large Cities and 100 of the 189 Ordinary Cities of his fiefdom. Juefeng noted that no one would be willing to make Liu Yin their mortal enemy for what Jiu Jiang could pay.

characters.title: Great Sage Tian Yu
characters.introText: Great Sage Tian Yu is the sole Guest Official of Lord Chu Yuan, and is thus part of the Emperor Chu Family. He is a powerful Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign, and cultivates in the Great Dao of the World Origin, with great life-preservation and escape ability. When Di Chu Yu offends Chu Yuan by taking a King-level mission, Tian Yu suggests that their faction attacks Luo Feng, killing his body and taking its treasures.
characters.appearance: A man in a green robe.
characters.history:
Great Sage Tian Yu is the sole Guest Official of Lord Chu Yuan, and is thus part of the Emperor Chu Family. He is a powerful Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign, and cultivates in the Great Dao of the World Origin, with great life-preservation and escape ability. When Di Chu Yu offends Chu Yuan by taking a King-level mission, Tian Yu suggests that their faction attacks Luo Feng, killing his body and taking its treasures.

Tian Yu kidnapped Ancestor Yuan's Illusory Clone body, believing it to be his real body, to force Luo Feng to come to Thousand Stars Building. When Luo Feng refuses to abandon Di Chu Yu, Tian Yu annihilates the illusory clone and the group of Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereigns begin to attack Luo Feng. Tian Yu attacked with a formation of heaven and earth, condensing chains to attack him, but when they touched his clothing, they disappeared, causing him to realize that Luo Feng was actually a Transcendent Chaos Realm.

Tian Yu attempted to escape while warning the group of Luo Feng's true strength, but his body was instantly annihilated. Due to losing his true body, he lost his three formation diagrams, which were worth 30 billion Universe Sands. While he sought to purchase them back from Luo Feng, he was too poor to do so.

characters.title: Great Sage Yan Su
characters.introText: Great Sage Yan Su is a powerful Transcendent Chaos Realm existence, specializing in the Great Dao of the Space Origin. Due to his achievements in that Great Dao, he can even teleport in the heavily suppressed space on the Continent of Origin. He also has a clone technique, making him an extremely difficult opponent.
characters.history:

Great Sage Yan Su was the Guarding Master of Xiang Jie City

After the second confrontation were it was A battle between Luo feng vs 4 Transcendent Chaos Realm Luo feng's overwhelming victory .Luo Feng later visited Xiang Jie City to take his revenge, when Yan su offered Compensation, Luo feng demanded his pair of Void Divine Drills the which was First Level God King Treasure.Unwilling to give them he tried to fight but Luo feng Destroy his Clone and took The Treasure.

characters.title: Gu Si Luo
characters.introText: Gu Si Luo was one of the competitors in the Pinnacle Genius Battle, hailing from Yi Mu Universe Country. He was seen as a perfect Controller, without any weaknesses, the one with the best chance of beating Bolan. He placed 2nd in the Training Space portion of the competition, which means he made it to the 1st level of the 6th tower and killed more mammoths than Luo Feng. In the arena battle stage, he made it to the final 20, but lost in a long, thrilling battle with Rong Jun, resulting in him being placed in the Heaven and Earth Secret Realm. His strength was such that the group of Immortals observing felt he could have won previous competitions, and at the very least made the top 3.

characters.history:
Guang Yu is a Perfect Stage World Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Among all those serving under Luo Feng, Guang Yu is known as the second strongest, just below Chen Shi.

Although Guang Yu had never been an Inspector before, he was chosen by Luo Feng to become the Third Region Inspector. This appointment showed that Luo Feng trusted Guang Yu’s ability, strength, and potential to manage vast territories.

When Luo Feng divided his domain into three regions, he selected Guang Yu as one of the three top leaders.

characters.title: Guardian Beast God of Bauhinia Island
characters.introText: A being with a dragon-like body over 10,000 kilometers long. It had a pair of giant wings and wore strange armor with flames.
characters.appearance: A being with a dragon-like body over 10,000 kilometers long. It had a pair of giant wings and wore strange armor with flames.
characters.history:
Guardian Beast God of Bauhinia Island is the non-canon name given to the Guardian Beast God who received Luo Feng and King Zhenyan when they arrived on Bauhinia Island. It is a Special Lifeform resembling a dragon. As a Guardian Beast God, it is a Universe Master Beast God that serves the Ancestral God Sect, but not one of the official Eight Beast Gods. It follows the Beast God Path of Law of Space  and Law of Fire .

Due to its duties, it received Luo Feng and Zhenyan 12 days after they first arrived on Bauhinia Island. It shared all of the important information regarding the island, including: access to the World of Glory (with the receivers necessary), access to the Land of Inheritance, Land of Treasures, and the Ancestral God Secret Region. It also provided information on the important locations of the Ancestral God Sect.

When Venerable Mud Swallowing was killed by the Five-Color Aurora Lake after attempting to assassinate Luo Feng, this Guardian Beast God appeared on the island to admonish the heirs. Additionally, it warned them that attempts on Luo Feng's life would result in them being killed by the Ancestral God Sect, no matter how many times they were resurrected.

characters.title: Guest Official Xun
characters.introText: Guest Official Xun is a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign supporting Lord Chu Ji as a Guest Official of the Emperor Chu Family. She specializes in the Great Dao of the Causality Origin that she had obtained through the inheritance from Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, which allows her to have an extraordinary ability to escape.
characters.history:
Guest Official Xun is a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign supporting Lord Chu Ji as a Guest Official of the Emperor Chu Family. She specializes in the Great Dao of the Causality Origin that she had obtained through the inheritance from Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, which allows her to have an extraordinary ability to escape.

Xun, Chu Ji, Lord Chu Yuan, Golden Hoop Guest Official, and Great Sage Tian Yu attacked Luo Feng, but due to her comprehension of causality, she was more wary of him than the others. During the fight, she uses her causality techniques to uncover Luo Feng's origins and obscuring his mind. However, her abilities are ultimately insufficient to attack Luo Feng's Second Level God King Willpower. When she realized that the opposing side was a Transcendent Chaos Realm level existence and the situation has changed, she immediately used the Causality Escape Secret Method to flee the battlefield in panic with Lord Chu Ji.

characters.title: Gui Si
characters.introText: Relatively tall and handsome, with purple eyes and shoulder-length platinum-blonde hair that is trimmed on the sides.
characters.appearance: Relatively tall and handsome, with purple eyes and shoulder-length platinum-blonde hair that is trimmed on the sides.
characters.history:
Gui Si is a subordinate of Brolin, and thus affiliated with Black Dragon Mountain. He is warlike and ruthless, and leads other Black Dragon Mountain teams in robbing fellow examinees during the Universe Trainee Mercenary Exam.

He led his team in pursuit of Hook and Gaia's team, ultimately killing Hook in front of Luo Feng and his team.

He is heavily damaged by the combination of Luo Feng and Ao Gu using the Hybrid Mother Copper shard and Hong and Thunder God using their domains and the lightning from the World of Thunder. He is nearly killed by the Copper Shard, but is saved when Qiu Yu uses his Spirit Energy to divert the shard away from him. He then escapes with Qiu Yu and rendezvous with Brolin. He pleads with Brolin to give him more troops but she rebukes him citing that entering theWorld Within a World on Cang Lan Planet was more important than taking personal revenge on Luo Feng.

He is equipped with a C2 Grade Laser Gun and given the order to kill anyone who defies Brolin's orders. A member from North Dragon City argues that Brolin has no right to boss them around and is blasted by Gui Si as an example of what would happen should anyone defy Brolin. This act is noticed by an enraged Gaia Heruo.

Together with Nuolan Shan and Qiu Yu, Gui Si manages to convince Brolin to let them form a coalition and hunt down Luo Feng and his group. With Lord Wu's help in exposing Luo Feng's location, Gui Si and his coalition army is successful in tracking down Luo Feng's group and cornering them. At their wits end, Babata pulls out the Upgraded C9 Grade Spaceship which manages to block most of the attacks from the army. Luo Feng is targeted by Gui Si, but Tie Nan He sacrifices himself blocking the shot from the laser cannon. His sacrifice enrages Luo Feng who charges at Gui Si with Tie Nan He's blade but is pulled back by Hong and Thunder God. As Luo Feng's ship escapes, Brolin orders Gui Si to break the chase and focus on acquiring the first password of the Inheritance Crystal Ball which was discovered to be in the hands of North Dragon City.

After killing all the members of North Dragon City who was in proximity of the 1st password, Gaia is the sole survivor. As Gui Si mocks her with Hook's death, a Vine from Luo Feng's evolved Cloud Vine attacks soldiers of Black Dragon Mountain Empire. Gui Si orders the coalition army to chase the vine which they do, all the way to Luo Feng's location, but by the time they realize it was a trap, it was too late. The vines at Universe Level 2 whips aggressively at  the coalition army, Hong and Thunder God expand their combined domains to trap everyone, while Ao Gu uses the copper shard to kill them all. As Gui Si continues firing at the vines and evading its attacks, he is caught off-guard when a Vine piercing Qiu Yu's corpse slams into him. Gui Si has his bones shattered by the vines and a vengeful Luo Feng uses Tie Nan He's blade to slash Gui Si's mangled body killing him once and for all and avenging Tie Nan He's death.
characters.trivia: Gui Si vaguely plays the part that Ka Tu Luo played in the novel

characters.title: Hanks
characters.introText: Dressed in black armor, with long hair and a scar on his face. He has 2 blades on his waist and a long white dragon flying around his body.
characters.appearance: Dressed in black armor, with long hair and a scar on his face. He has 2 blades on his waist and a long white dragon flying around his body.
characters.history:
Hanks is a Universe Level 6 Controller (with a level 4 Domain) who fights in the Huge Axe Dojo. Born on a normal planet, he was captured and enslaved along with many youths on his planet. Being forced to endure hellish training, he became one of the elites. Eventually he reached Stellar Level, then broke through to Universe Level, but remained a slave due to not yet breaking through to Domain Master.

As Hanks grew in strength, the slave trader felt it wasn't worth just selling him, so he made a deal with him that if he could win 1,000 battles in the Huge Axe Dojo (becoming a Huge Axe Warrior), he would earn his freedom. While Hanks fought, the slave trader received appearance fees for the battles.

Luo Feng, Hong, and Thunder God witnessed his battle with Genji, and gambled on it, with Luo Feng and Thunder God betting on Genji while Hong bet on Hanks. During the battle, he stepped through the gateway of Law of Water  and killed Genji, marking his 822nd consecutive victory.

After every battle, he would apologize to his dead opponent.

characters.title: Hargrave
characters.introText: In the novel he is described as a bald old man with an aquiline nose and peculiar eyes. He wears a long black robe and sometimes emits icy energy. In the donghua, he has blue-gray hair and green eyes. He wears the battle armor of a member of Black Dragon Mountain.
characters.appearance:
In the novel he is described as a bald old man with an aquiline nose and peculiar eyes. He wears a long black robe and sometimes emits icy energy. In the donghua, he has blue-gray hair and green eyes. He wears the battle armor of a member of Black Dragon Mountain.

In the novel, he has a marking of snow and ice on his forehead, but this is not seen in the donghua.
characters.history:
Hargrave is a pinnacle World Master, one of the top 3 World Masters of the God Country Black Dragon Mountain. He is rare in the Black Dragon Mountain Starfield as a World Master acknowledged by an Origin Law, his being Law of Water . With his power and wealth, he is a 3 star client of the Universe First Bank. His power and status are the reason that his grandson, the 9th Prince of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire, Brolin, has more authority and power than other princes.

Brolin promised Hargrave and the other elders from Black Dragon Mountain that he would obtain the Inheritance Crystal Ball from Kabu's Treasures and deliver it to Hargrave. When Brolin failed to get all 3 passwords due to Chakra obtaining one, Hargrave gave the order for Brolin to attack the Three Axe Mountain subordinates and rob them to obtain the final password.

Hargrey ordered, “Make the move against the Three Axe Mountain people, kill their leading people and steal their AI computers. See if you can get the last passcode from them.” Since acquiring the passcodes from the thunder castle, they naturally stored them in the AI computers, and transferred them into the virtual universe, informing their sector lord Jiang Tian Chen.
“Understood!” Brolin’s eyes gleamed, with a sense of excitement and madness, “Grandfather, relax.” - Hargrey and Brolin

Despite this, Jiang Tian Chen was ahead of him and had already ordered Chakra to destroy the quantum computer containing the password and also sent people to kill Chakra to prevent Hargrave from acquiring the final password.

He eventually agreed to Jiang Tian Chen's 9 conditions in exchange for the final password, costing him almost all of his wealth. Unfortunately for him, Kabu essentially pranked anyone who sought the Inheritance Crystal Ball, as Hargrave discovered when he visited the Universe First Bank to obtain it and only received a recording laughing at whoever obtained the passwords.

Hargrey stood in front of the monitor. An audio file appeared on the display. Hargrey’s face was sullen as he tapped on the screen. In a moment, the audio file which has been stored for 10 million years started to play: “I’m extremely ecstatic to notify you, you’ve….. been duped! Hahaha, so how does it feel, you mad? Did you sacrifice a lot for the three passwords? HAHAHA, I definitely won’t give the three passwords to the same organization. I made you guys work like mad crazy for them and then ruined everything for you in the end. LOL~~”

Hargrey fiercely clenched his teeth.

“PA!” with a furious wave of his hand, Hargrey smashed the monitor in front of him into pieces. - Lord Wu

In order to gather the force of 220,000 warriors who fought under Brolin in the World Within a World, Hargrave counted on the support of a group of World Masters from Black Dragon Mountain. They lent their subordinates based on promises made from Hargrave and Brolin, but due to Kabu's deception (and Jiang Tian Chen's strict conditions), they were unable to fulfill those promises. The treasures that Brolin obtained had to be exchanged to attempt to make up for it, but still resulted in Hargrave losing his authority within Black Dragon Mountain.

While Hargrave was not particularly concerned with the loss of authority and power due to his own strength, he knew that his loss of authority negatively impacted Brolin, which caused him to feel guilty. To help Brolin obtain money, he searched the Black Dragon Mountain Empire information system for information on Luo Feng, who Brolin believed had multiple treasures and could be robbed, however each detail he obtained made him less agreeable to the plan. Luo Feng was from Earth, which Di Fan claimed was Three Axe Mountain territory. Due to Hu Yan Bo's techniques hiding Earth, it would take a long time to reach Earth (and they wouldn't know if Luo Feng was there in the first place). Next, due to Di Fan's presence, they would need at least a Domain Master to attack Earth, and he only had 3 Domain Masters under him. Finally, the treasure that he felt Luo Feng obtained, the Air Cutter Blade, had already been given away to a general of Three Axe Mountain, hence the new 100 life planets that Luo Feng obtained. With Three Axe Mountain's strength, there was no benefit for Black Dragon Mountain to attack them just to satisfy Brolin.

Presumably in part because of his decline in power and authority and in part because of his status as one of the 3 strongest World Masters in Black Dragon Mountain, Hargrave was ordered by Black Dragon Mountain to dedicate his time to training Stellar Level geniuses of the God Country in preparation for the Pinnacle Genius Battle. He angrily expressed to Brolin his embarrassment due to the performance of the representatives of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire in the previous Pinnacle Genius Battle, and noted the difficulty for their empire's top genius to rank in the top 10,000 of the Ganwu Universe Country.
characters.trivia:
Novel describes his law as an Ice Mark on the forehead. There is no Ice Law and he is the only one who has Ice Law in the Novel so it is safe to assume that it was a typo or poor translation in the English Version.

Among the two, the center of Jiang Tian Chen’s forehead had a thunder mark while Hargrey’s had an ice mark, even though the two hadn’t unleashed any power, the entire large hall was still under the pressure of the thunder energy and ice energy’s influence. - I Eat Tomatoes

The mark is described as '冰雪印记' in the novel, which is Bīngxuě yìnjì, which is literally 'ice and snow imprint'; there is also a World Master described later with the same Bīngxuě yìnjì, so it may be that the Law of Water is represented by this mark, rather than a drop or something

While the mark is described in his donghua datasheet, his appearances in Episode 114 do not show the ice and snow mark (unlike the conspicuous lightning mark on Jiang Tian Chen's forehead)

characters.title: Heart Eye Elder
characters.introText: Heart Eye Elder is the strongest Eternal True God of the Heart Shadow Sect. When the sect declined and split, he roamed the Continent of Origin on his own to hone himself. The other elders have some fear of him due to his strength.
characters.history:
Heart Eye Elder is the strongest Eternal True God of the Heart Shadow Sect. When the sect declined and split, he roamed the Continent of Origin on his own to hone himself. The other elders have some fear of him due to his strength.

He is first entrusted with convincing Luo Feng to look the other way during their attempt to seize Hu Yang City. In their discussion, he informed Luo Feng that the sect master, Feng Yu Qi, had already issued an order that the sect was not to offend him. After hearing him over, Luo Feng then gave him a price of 200 million Universe Sands for the sect to hire him, leading to Heart Eye Elder attempting to convince him with force. In the ensuing sparring match, he was shocked to find that in addition to having a superior Divine Body, Luo Feng had superior Realm, leaving his Willpower technique as his only means of possibly defeating him. Seeking to avoid an all-out battle, he admitted defeat and returned to the sect, informing Feng Yu Qi of his failure. Due to his misconceptions about Luo Feng's strength, he still felt that he could rival him by using Heart Devil Hawk.

characters.history:
Heavenly Wood Sector Beast King is the Sector Beast King who was enslaved by Purple Wood God King. This creature is the most powerful being in the Heavenly Wood Kingdom, and its existence is the reason that the Heavenly Wood Kingdom is a First-Class God-Kingdom. After being brought back to the Continent of Origin by its master, it annihilated all of his enemies. While it is looked down upon by the two Ancient Kingdoms due to its relative inability to cultivate independently, it is a huge deterrent to the other God-Kingdoms.

As a Sector Beast King that has reached maturity, it has comprehended the complete Great Dao of the Destruction Origin, and can be considered an Ultimate God King-level being. Through the sector within its body, it gave birth to the forces that comprise the Destruction Legion.

Since Sector Beasts are born from the Great Dao of Destruction, under the Supreme Operation Laws, none can survive the reincarnation of the Origin World unless they break through to God Emperor. This fact made him frustrated in his training, since he knew no way to improve and surpass God King.

characters.appearance:

Scaling from the walls of Hu Yang City (about 5 billion kilometers tall, scaled to Luo Feng's Perfect Divine Body), his true Divine Body is less than 500,000 kilometers tall on the Continent of Origin.
characters.history:
Hei Duo Mo was an Eternal True God of the Food Kingdom, one of 13 Eternal True Gods of the Food Kingdom's branch in Hu Yang City. He was considered very powerful among Eternal True Gods, having cultivated to the eighth level of eternal.

He mastered the Origin of Poison Law, giving him incredibly powerful poison techniques, capable of eroding even the Divine Body of an Eternal True God. He has also mastered a set of spear techniques, giving him incredibly powerful attacks.

Hei Duo Mo and Luo Feng fought over the wondrous treasure Blue-Purple Blood Crystal Flower, and while he completely outclassed Luo Feng in melee combat, he was easily defeated by Luo Feng's Willpower technique, Nightmare Technique. After his death, his body was devoured by Morosa. He left behind about 15,000 Universe Sands-worth of spoils.

Honorable Master Dark Sky is one of the 6 Honorable Masters of the Destruction Legion. Birthed from the sector of the Heavenly Wood Sector Beast King, he is a Second Level God King comparable to Gui Xu Emperor or Wu Xin God King, a feared existence among the God Kings.

Due to the relationship between Purple Wood God King and Hansen Kingdom Master, Dark Sky was sent to assist the latter in taking over the territory of the Food Kingdom. In the battle between the 6 God Kings, Dark Sky was the only opponent able to handle Luo Feng's Chaos Hole Indestructible Light.

Before the battle between Dark Sky and Luo Feng, Morosa revealed that Dark Sky is actually just one-sixth of the Destruction Emperor, the ultimate warrior bred by the Sector Beast King. After a fairly even battle, he retreated, understanding that since he was unable to kill Luo Feng's clone, there would be no way he could help Hansen Kingdom Master maintain control of the Food Kingdom's territory.

characters.appearance:
In the novel, Hu Yan Bo is described as about 3 meters tall, with two flexible antenna on his forehead. Other than the size of his body and the antennae, he looks exactly like an Earthling. He wore a black robe that shined dimly, and had long hair that spread out. In the donghua, he appears to be larger than 3 meters, and looks more like a dark knight or soldier. His face is obscured by his helmet and we do not see his hair.
characters.personality: Hu Yan Bo was very respectful of the universe and dangers within. He understood his strength and used it when he knew he had the advantage, but tried not to provoke those stronger than him. He seemed to have the wisdom one would expect of an Immortal, passing down many sayings to Babata, and did not show any arrogance to Luo Feng, despite being his (technical) teacher.
characters.history:
Hu Yan Bo was the master of Planet Yun Mo and the Sect Master of the Yun Mo Planet Sect. He lived for around 60 million years, cultivating to the level of Immortal Marquis, and built some reputation in the Ganwu Universe Country due to his skill. Through his travels, he acquired the AI Babata and provided him with a body, which Babata used to spread his name across many galaxies. They fought together in countless battles, establishing a very deep father/son or older/younger brother relationship. He died about 50,000 years before the start of the story, and his inheritance provides the catalyst for Luo Feng to grow into a powerful warrior.

Hu Yan Bo was a talented Spirit Master, with a focus on soul techniques. With his knowledge of the Possession technique, he eventually took over the body of a youth of the Longke Clan, one of the top-30 bloodlines of the Human Race, after which his training speed and thus his strength soared. With his talent, new body, and dedication to training, Hu Yan Bo eventually became an Immortal, and even reached the level of Immortal Marquis.

Hu Yan Bo created the Soul Seal technique, and used the Enslaving Soul Seal to obtain 9 soul slaves, one of whom, Iron Sword Marquis, got on many people's bad side, according to King Long Jue. With his skill, he also crafted Spirit Weapons, including the Soaring Shuttle, along with manuals detailing their usage. He used the money he earned throughout his life to supplement his strength, acquiring a Cloud Vine that he raised to Immortal-level, essentially doubling his strength, and building the Yun Mo Spaceship, paying a powerful warrior to add Original Law engravings, increasing its strength and defense. Knowing that he was still far from the truly strong, when he encountered a World Master Zerg Race mother nest in the Extraterritorial Battlefield, he used a soul attack technique to put it into a coma so that in the future he could enslave it and have an enormous Zerg Race army!

Due to the proximity of Earth to Planet Yun Mo, and the many races with good potential on the planet, he made Earth part of his territory. Since it belonged to the Silverblue Empire, he used strength to claim it, using a single spirit energy attack to destroy an enormous interstellar fleet and annihilate the souls of the soldiers, causing the spaceships to fall onto various planets in the area. This included the mothership containing the Black Dragon Mountain X81 Spaceship that crashed on Earth. As an Immortal Marquis, he had no reason to fear or respect the Silverblue Empire, or even the Black Dragon Mountain Empire, as neither had an Immortal strong enough to face him. Even within the Ganwu Universe Country, as a true Immortal Marquis, he was formidable, someone who would have required actual resources to kill.

He was talented in Law of Space  and used a flying technique called Space Control, which was rarely seen, but comparable in strength to the 10,000 Thread Flow technique. He used special space techniques to conceal Earth and the surrounding 1,000 light-years within the Dark Universe, effectively hiding it from universe locators and maps, making it very unlikely for someone weaker than him to locate Earth.

His territory established, he also worked to create the Yun Mo Planet Sect. Despite being a Spirit Master himself, most of his Immortal underlings were warriors. He created many manuals and acquired more from his 9 Immortal soul slaves. Knowing the gaps in his abilities, he trained in the techniques of others when necessary, such as the Tower of the Void soul defense technique. His best techniques could be considered normal level according to Primal Chaos City Leader.

Despite his abilities and respect for the strength of the universe, Hu Yan Bo fell in a large battle with Suo Luo Pu over a particular treasure that is never specified. Since Suo Luo Pu was a Pinnacle Immortal Marquis, close in strength to a Low Immortal King, and was also a Spirit Master, he was able to damage Hu Yan Bo with a soul attack through his spaceship's defenses, killing his World Master disciple.

Hu Yan Bo survived, fleeing into the Dark Universe, but eventually succumbed to the damage from the attack, with the Yun Mo Spaceship crashing onto Earth. However, before his death he established his inheritance to be passed down. While all of his remaining soul slaves died with him, Babata survived, albeit without a physical body. In this battle, Planet Yun Mo was also destroyed, and the entire Yun Mo Planet Sect was eradicated.

At the conclusion of the Human Race Survival War, Luo Feng, who had recently broke through to Universe Master, travelled to the rebuilt Planet Yun Mo. He resurrected Hu Yan Bo, his 9 soul slaves, and even brought back the original Yun Mo Spaceship, as a token of his gratitude toward both he and Babata, who heavily influenced the beginning of his journey as a warrior. Choosing to show respect and not accidentally antagonize Luo Feng, he exchanged universe numbers and learned Luo Feng's story through Babata. While curious how an Earthling became a Universe Master in only 200,000 years, he also understood that his future was bright as long as he did not act foolishly, due to his direct connection with such a great being.

After his resurrection, Hu Yan Bo continued to train and travel, and in the 39,000th era after the appearance of the body of the God King of Jin, he was admitted into the Virtual Universe Company, eventually becoming a Universe Venerable with the guidance of the Duan Dong River inheritance left to the Human Race. As he had no guidance from great beings in his original life, he was considered a talent for how much he learned on his own. Eight hundred eras later, Hu Yan Bo discovered that Suo Luo Pu was still alive, and after some twists, killed him after a hunt that lasted 3 eras.

Hu Yan Bo was one of those who gathered in front of the palace on the square in Milky Way Holy Land before Luo Feng left to fight Mo He.

characters.personality:
A true protector of the Human Race and its potential youngsters. Despite possessing an adventurous personality, he is willing to take human disciples during his life for the Human Race, he also has a deep love for Axe especially his Xeon Arcana Divine Axe.

“Huge Axe is obviously not as outstanding in his ability to deduce because he is too foolishly rigid, placing all his affections on his axe!” - Ancestor Yuan

This child has always been reckless and loved adventures. I have warned him umpteen times. - Ancestor Yuan
characters.history:
Early in his life, Huge Axe Creator was the first follower of Ancestor Yuan, listening to his teachings and receiving guidance in his cultivation. He was bestowed with great kindness and had great respect for Yuan, who was unrivaled in the Original Universe and Universe Ocean. With his wild character and non-conformist approach, he often explored the universe on his own, so he was never considered a true disciple, unlike Primal Chaos City Leader, who obediently followed Yuan. Huge Axe and Primal Chaos developed a very close friendship; they could be considered brothers who deeply trusted each other. In a way, Huge Axe could be considered a disciple of Ancestor Yuan, despite never officially taking him on as a teacher, and Yuan was like a father figure for Huge Axe.

Huge Axe witnessed the weak period of the Human Race and watched it rise to become a Pinnacle Race, fighting through countless wars with other races, even seeing the race almost go extinct. He was considered incredible in his own right, accomplishing feats that left beings in awe. Caring only for his axe, Huge Axe grew rapidly as a cultivator, becoming the second-strongest member of the race. When Huge Axe broke through to True God, Ancestor Yuan left the Human Race in his hands as he went on to challenge the Original Universe.

He was the main pillar of the human race after Ancestor Yuan got suppressed. Before then, Ancestor Yuan, Primal Chaos City Leader and himself adventured together throughout the universe.

He officiated his new disciple Hong once the Huge Axe Dojo youngster became an Immortal. He also discovered the infinite value of the Earth which brought it to public sight of the Virtual Universe Company and his Dojo.

Upon hearing Luo Feng's safe return from Universe Boat to the Original Universe after obtaining the Duan Dong River Inheritance, Huge Axe Creator began to make his return from Tilted Peak Realm. Following the fake Pulling Traces Diagram given to Yuan Ao Master by the three True Gods who ambushed him, Great Thunder Star Master, King Zhenjia, and Qiu Yan Ancestral God, Huge Axe successfully defended himself but unintentionally entered Land of Darkness in Tilted Peak Realm. It was later revealed that Huge Axe Creator was assassinated by the Sector Beast Mo He who lived in the Land of Darkness.

His Miniature Universe crumbled which was discovered by the Prison Race who subsequently informed the Automatons, Demon and Bug Clan, leading to war between the major powers of the universe against the Humans as they didn't have a large deterrent anymore and the major powers coveted the Duan Dong River Inheritance as they wanted to transcend reincarnation.

After Huge Axe Creator died completely, with his soul fully destroyed, making revival seemingly impossible even for the strongest beings in the universe.

However, after Luo Feng ascended to become a supreme existence known as a Overlord, he gained the ability to reshape worlds and revive the dead across the endless Continent of Origin and the Original Universe.

During the massive resurrection led by Luo Feng, billions of lives were brought back, especially from Earth and Luo Feng’s home universe. Luo Feng specifically created a new Original Universe near the Milky Way Holy Land Universe as a home for those being resurrected. Among them, Huge axe creator awakened.

Confused at first, he realized he had truly died before. But now, he found himself alive again in what looked like the Original Universe—though something was different. The universe was vastly changed, and many of the systems and beings he knew were no longer the same.

Soon after, Huge Axe Creator was reunited with his old comrades like Primal Chaos City Leader, Penggong Master, Darkness Master, Desolation Master, Dragon Walk Master, Hong, sensing that some were mere divine power avatars, yet even those were far stronger than him now.

They welcomed Huge Axe Creator with warmth :“Huge Axe Creator! Welcome to the New Era!”

Eventually, the battle between King Ye Chen and King Cang Jin caused King Ye Chen to self-destruct, which also killed Ice Blade, the weakest of the 6 present.

characters.title: Ice Peak Ancestor
characters.introText: A towering figure like a massive iceberg, his entire body made of deep blue icy crystals. Even just a projection of him reveals his terrifying power.
characters.appearance: A towering figure like a massive iceberg, his entire body made of deep blue icy crystals. Even just a projection of him reveals his terrifying power.
characters.personality: Ice Peak Ancestor is passionate and deeply values friendship, especially his close bond with Sha Zhou. Though he is one of the strongest beings, he remains calm and willing to compromise when dealing with old friends like Yuan. He is thoughtful and diplomatic, often trying to balance different interests within his Ice Peak Faction because he knows the Ice Peak Faction is loosely organized. However, when pushed too far, he becomes firm and fearless, showing the dignity and bottom line of a true powerhouse.
characters.history: Ice Peak Ancestor is an ancient Eternal  being who has lived far longer than Yuan in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. He founded the Ice Peak Faction, a powerful alliance of twelve Eternal  beings, including the mighty Shā zhōu, whom he convinced to join due to their deep friendship. In the past, when the Cultivator Camp had only Yuan as its lord, Ice Peak and Yuan shared a close bond forged through life-and-death struggles. He even invited Yuan  to join his faction, though Yuan declined, keeping their friendship intact. Over time, as the Cultivator Camp grew stronger, their relationship became strained, especially when Ice Peak’s faction seized over 100 world clusters from Practitioner territory during a war with the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction. Ice Peak tried to negotiate peace by offering to return half the World clusters, but his inability to fully control members like the Three Emperors of Wind, Thunder, and Sea led to tensions escalating toward war with Cultivator Camp.

characters.history:
Irina is a World Master Zerg Race Queen who Hu Yan Bo encountered on the Extraterritorial Battlefield. He planned to enslave her so he could use her and her soldiers as a powerful weapon, but his Soul Seal technique was inadequate due to the special nature of Zerg Race Queens. He instead put her in a Deep Sleep and left her nest on Earth until he could acquire the means to enslave her, but he died before he could accomplish that goal. Her nest became known as the No. 31 Ruin of Ancient Civilization.

After Luo Feng became a Primal Secret Realm member of the Virtual Universe Company, he learned of the 10,000 Soul Control technique, which could be used to enslave a Zerg Race Queen. Later, after breaking through to World Master, he trained in the technique and successfully enslaved Irina. With his resources and her ability, he eventually acquired a nearly 2 million strong Zerg Race army, which he used to great effect during his time on the Extraterritorial Battlefield.

characters.title: Iron Roar Devil Ruler
characters.introText: An armored figure, with only a pair of cold eyes exposed.
characters.appearance: An armored figure, with only a pair of cold eyes exposed.
characters.history:
Iron Roar Devil Ruler was, on the surface, the most terrifying sinful existence on the Continent of Origin. In actuality, he was a puppet existence cultivated by Emperor Yuan. He was a Second Level God King as famous as Pu Xin, Boat Owner, and Luo Feng in his guise as Luo He. He plundered almost the entire population of 12 surrounding God-Kingdoms in a single action, and stole an unimaginable number of lives over a long period of time.

Originally, he ruled a Second-Class Kingdom, and controlled more than 10 surrounding God-Kingdoms, having forced their God Kings to flee. The area he controlled included 3 Second-Class Kingdoms and 13 Third-Class Kingdoms, comprising a total of 359 Chaos States between the two Ancient Kingdoms.

When Luo Feng began executing his plan to clean up the continent, Iron Roar Devil Ruler was one of his targets. After Luo Feng killed Eating Fox God King, Emperor Yuan left Iron Roar Devil Ruler as bait to attract him, which succeeded. Luo Feng's Lie Yuan Technique annihilated the puppet's consciousness, but he realized that his opponent was just a puppet body. Emperor Yuan then arrived and the two began their battle.

With Emperor Yuan's forced reincarnation, Iron Roar Devil Ruler's territory became ownerless, and Luo Feng made plans to take it.

characters.history:
Jade Rock Planet BDME Official is the non-canon name given to the government official of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire who was stationed on Jade Rock Planet. This official confirmed that Earth belonged to the highest class of Life Planets, and thus it would cost 3 trillion Black Dragon Coins (BDC) to become its owner.

In the novel, this official initially gave Luo Feng excuses as to why it would take up to 30 days for Luo Feng to officially become Earth's owner. Luo Feng, realizing how these sorts of government officials tend to do business, offered bribes of 10 million, 100 million, 500 million, and 1 billion BDC, depending on the official's ability to complete the ownership process within 7 days, 3 days, 1 day, or 1 hour. With an initial 200 million BDC to help ease the process, this official completed the process in 3 hours, 29 minutes, so Luo Feng became the owner of Earth before the Nuolan Shan Family could.

In the donghua, this official also initially gave Luo Feng excuses as to why it would take up to 30 days for Luo Feng to officially become Earth's owner. However, this official was bribed by the Nuolan Shan Family with 100 million BDC to help them become the Earth's owner. First, Babata, using information obtained from the Universe Star River Bank archives, uncovered this official's illicit activity, then Lei Shen used a technique to conceal the group's conversation. Luo Feng then used Babata's information to threaten the official with prison. The official then stated that even if he returned the money, he was afraid for his life if he did not follow the Nuolan Shan Family's orders. In response, Luo Feng offered 200 million BDC if the official could finish the ownership process in under 12 hours, enough money for the official to purchase some Stellar Level slaves for protection and still live comfortably, or 1 billion BDC if he could do so in an hour. The official could not guarantee completion within 1 hour, but did complete the process in 3 hours, 29 minutes, so Luo Feng became the owner of Earth before the Nuolan Shan Family could.

characters.history:
Ji Lan Deng is Ji Qing's father and a Universe Level 9 member of the Ji Family. After breaking through to Universe Level, he was somewhat favored within the family, and owned over 1,000 Life Planets. While living a simple life at the relatively lower level of the family, he casually had an affair with a maid, who gave birth to Ji Qing. Due to Ji Qing's prodigious talent, she grew at an unbelievable rate, eventually becoming a core member of the Universe Mercenary Alliance. With this, Lan Deng's position in the family shot up exponentially and he was placed in charge of governing 10 galaxies within their home Snow Border Starfield.

During his time away from Jade Dome Planet, he discovered that Ji Qing fell in love with Hong, who he considered a desolate aboriginal punk, and he rushed to the planet to end their relationship. While on one hand he treated Ji Qing like his precious daughter, he was also quite selfish, seeing her as his ticket to power and prestige within the family, and was unwilling to see her leave him behind. He eventually met Hong and, behind a veil of courtesy, told Hong to give up on Ji Qing and leave Jade Dome Planet. Unbeknownst to him, Luo Feng was also present, and he began to do what he could to help Hong.

Ji Lan Deng was infuriated when Hong remained on Jade Dome Planet at Bushi Ka's residence, but made no further actions since he had not been given orders by the family patriarch, Ji Tian Cang.
