characters.history:
Member of the Ji Family, one of the three hundred noble families of Ganwu Universe Country. She is a peerless genius who has been rare in the Ji family for countless years and is a core member of the Universe Mercenary Alliance. She is the love interest of Hong, however, her family prevents the two from being together, because her teacher Phantom Spirit King doesn't want any of her disciples to be in a relationship because this will distract them from Cultivation. After Hong passed the Phantom Spirit King's 18 levels of Love Illusions and went to meet her along with Luo Feng, she broke up with him because Phantom Spirit King met her before Hong and Luo Feng and showed her something (Unknown what she showed her).

“Why have you suddenly decided to leave me?” Hong looked at Ji Qing.

“You told me before that there are certain things that we must do and others that we shouldn’t. When one makes a decision, it has to be firm, sacrificing whatever that needs to be sacrificed.” Ji Qing said softly, even though her voice was soft…however even Luo Feng who was standing behind Hong could feel the resolve within her voice. “Hence you are sacrificing our relationship?” Hong asked. Hong stared at her and said solemnly, “Why didn’t you say anything when your head ancestor stopped you, when your teacher stopped you, you even went against both of them. And now, after I got my brother to help me and finally met your teacher Fantasy spirit emperor, gambling with my life, attempting the 18 levels of love illusions. After successfully passing the 18 levels, I came over happy to meet you, yet you tell me this now?”
“Why?”
“Why the sudden change of heart?”

“Why didn’t you say anything before?” Hong stared at her. - Hong and Ji Qing

Ji Tian Cang is an Immortal Marquis known as Silver Snow Marquis, one of the longest-following Immortal Marquises of the Lord of Ganwu. He is the First Ancestor of the Ji Family, one of the 300 noble families of the Ganwu Universe Country. He is very well-favored by the Lord of Ganwu and has 15 Immortals under him.

When Ji Qing emerged as the most exceptional genius of the Ji family in hundreds of millions of years, becoming a core member of the Universe Mercenary Alliance, he was filled with pride and met her. From his conversation with Luo Feng, he would not oppose any relationship that she wanted, due to her strength and character.

He helps Luo Feng get in touch with Phantom Spirit King, resulting in Hong attempting and passing her 18 Desires for Love Fantasy Land.

Despite her dislike/unfavorable intention towards Luo feng, she seems to follow the orders from higher up properly including Luo feng, as seen in the battle against Dream Underworld Empire and tries to protect the army from attack of Zerg race.

characters.title: Jia Laixi
characters.introText: A skinny youth dressed in black, about 2.34 meters tall. In the donghua his body type resembles that of a Bestial Gene Human.
characters.appearance: A skinny youth dressed in black, about 2.34 meters tall. In the donghua his body type resembles that of a Bestial Gene Human.
characters.history:
Jia Laixi is one of the geniuses of the Pinnacle Genius Battle in which Luo Feng participated, a Stellar Level Illusionist from the Howling Gods Clan in the Peng Gu Universe Country. The Immortals who watched the Pinnacle Genius Battle felt that he could make the top 10. With his terrifying Illusion Techniques, he didn't move a finger in his battles until facing Luo Feng, however in the Training Space, there were opponents that his illusion techniques could not affect, resulting in him ranking 189th in that round. Luo Feng and Rong Jun observed his battles to qualify for the remaining 900 slots for the Arena Duels.

After the battles to determine the top 20, Jia Laixi was named one of the top 20, and it was announced that he would face Luo Feng. Recognizing Luo Feng's strength, he launched his illusion attack simultaneously with a Spirit Weapon attack, hoping to instantly defeat him. Unfortunately for him, Luo Feng trained in the Tower of the Void technique, which defended him against the illusion attack enough for him to defeat it with his Willpower, enabling him to counter the spirit weapon attack. Luo Feng then instantly defeated him with 6 Phantom Sword Forms.This result shocked the Immortals watching the battles, who thought that only Bolan had a guarantee of defeating him.

Due to his loss to Luo Feng, he was placed in the Heaven and Earth Secret Realm, which was considered bad luck, considering his strength. He was the 3rd of the geniuses to pass the 1st level of the Tong Tian Bridge, one of the first 7 to pass the 2nd level (passing it in his 8th year in Primal Chaos City), and passed the 3rd level in his 25th year.

Jiang Cheng Rong is a powerful Eternal True God, a general of the Vine Dragon Legion that defends Hu Yang City. He is a member of the Jiang Family, which is led by Lord Jiu Jiang, and thus has high status in addition to his strength. He admires and respects Moli Xiao since he is the strongest Eternal True God he has ever seen.

Jiang Cheng Rong was on duty when Luo Feng attacked the Blood Python Guild headquarters, and was ordered by Moli Xiao to prevent the battle from affecting any innocent residents in the surrounding area. He was curious who was battling Mu Yang, who he acknowledged as someone that his entire legion could not deal with.

After Luo Feng killed Mu Yang, Jiang Cheng Rong was among those who received the notification from the Dark Hall that the bounty mission to kill Mu Yang had been completed.

characters.history:
Jiang Fan is Luo Feng's direct instructor at the Elite Training Camp, and as such is a War God level warrior. Known as the Moon Witch, she is a world-famous Goddess of War. She is very proficient with her two-sword style and plays a very important role in starting the development of Luo Feng's swordsmanship; she could be considered his first teacher. She is very loyal to the Extreme Martial Club.

Born in a poor family during the most turbulent years of the Nirvana period, she could be considered ill-fated. Her husband died saving her during a hunt in the wilderness, which caused her to focus completely on her martial arts. Despite this focus, her power and beauty cause her to have quite a few War Gods chasing after her, including some students (who didn't mind their 10 or so years of difference in age).

Although she looks like she's around 20, she's in her 30s already and has been in the Elite Training Camp for nearly 10 years. She is incredibly dedicated to her training, having spent 20 years to get to her current state. Dressed in purple, she gives off an overall feeling of a blade, yet was also considered the flower of the Elite Training Camp.  She is known for generally accepting Chinese students only (as she is Chinese), but she would occasionally accept students from other countries or headquarter cities...as long as they were female!

She brings Luo Hong Guo and Gong Xin Lan the news that the Extreme Martial Club suspected that Luo Feng died (at the No. 9 Ruin of Ancient Civilization). She also participates in Luo Feng's Investigator ceremony. She is one of the many who watched Atkin announce that Luo Feng was still alive.
characters.trivia: In the donghua, in the year 2091, the minimum requirement to be an Elite Training Camp student was increased to Planetary Level. As she is still a teacher at the camp, it can be seen that her cultivation level should have reached at least the Planetary level as it would not make sense if she was an Apprentice Level teacher teaching Planetary Level Students.

characters.history:
Jiang Mo is one of the Stellar Level participants in the same Pinnacle Genius Battle as Luo Feng. He and his sister, Qian Shui, are from Augustus Planet, and have terrifying reputations, known as the genius siblings. He had stepped into the gateway of two Original Laws, but they are not specified.

He placed in the top-100 in the Training Space Elimination and thus automatically qualified to be a core member of the Virtual Universe Company. In his performance in the Pinnacle Genius Battle Arena Duels, he made the top-20, then was the 4th-fastest make the top-10. In the top-10 round, he lost to Ai Chen, ending his run in the tournament and resulting in him making it into the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm.

In Primal Chaos City, he marveled at the ability of the Immortals capable of passing the 18th level of the Tong Tian Bridge and becoming sub-sect masters. He's considered a level of genius capable of learning the 108 wonders of Law of Space  within millions of years. While in Primal Chaos City, he was closest to his sister and Ai Chen.

Like all members of his class except Bolan and Rong Jun, he failed his first attempt at passing the 1st level of the Tong Tian Bridge. When Bolan passed the 3rd level of the bridge, Jiang Mo was one of the geniuses who were inspired to attempt to pass the 1st level. When Luo Feng passed the 3rd level of the bridge, Jiang Mo noted that he still couldn't pass the 2nd level, despite being close to Luo Feng in strength when they arrived in Primal Chaos City.

Jiang Mo was the first of Luo Feng's genius class to appear at the arena to watch him fight Mo Yi Lin and Ashi, and informs the rest of the Absolute Beginning class to watch the fight. He advises Luo Feng to back out instead of fighting against Sa Jin and is present for Luo Feng's surprising victory. He treats the Absolute Beginning newbies to expensive food and drink after Luo Feng's victory over Sa Jin.

As expected, he was demoted to the Heaven and Earth Secret Realm after his first Secret Realm Qualification Battle. He joined the others from the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm in sending off Luo Feng to the Primal Secret Realm.

characters.history:
Jiang Tian Chen is a powerful World Master, considered top-five absolute strongest within the Black Dragon Mountain Starfield.  As one of the absolute warriors of Three Axe Mountain, he held an important position within the Virtual Universe Company's Black Dragon Mountain Military Department. He is heavily respected within the Black Dragon Mountain Empire, however is reputation is nothing compared to his head general, who had the respect of all of the World Masters of the Ganwu Universe Country.

He first appeared when the World Within a World on Cang Lan Planet was discovered, arriving on Cang Lan Planet in hopes of entering the World of Thunder and acquiring Kabu's treasures. After being rebuffed by Chinia, he acknowledged her strong character and pivoted to meeting with the other powerful forces of the empire to discuss the World Within a World. He suggested that the forces arrange for a large group of Stellar Level 9 explorers to take part in the Universe Trainee Mercenary Exam and enter the World of Thunder. His Three Axe Mountain sent 200,000 explorers.

One of his subordinates, Chakra, broke through to Universe Level during his time on the World Within a World and acquired one of the three passwords necessary to acquire Kabu's Inheritance Crystal Ball. First, he acquired the password from Chakra, then, recognizing its value, he ordered Chakra to destroy the computer that had the password.  He then sent people to kill Chakra to prevent him leaking it. Password in hand, he met with Hargrave, whose grandson, Brolin, had acquired the other two passwords. Knowing that he had all of the leverage, Tian Chen forced Hargrave to agree to nine conditions, ultimately costing Hargrave almost all of his wealth.

During the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Stage of the Pinnacle Genius Battle, Jiang Tian Chen observed Hong's battle alongside one of the Head Generals of Three Axe Mountain, Time World Master Luo. He provided information on Hong, Thunder God, and Luo Feng, and was surprised at how interested Luo was in Hong. Inwardly, he lamented that Luo had gotten stuck when attempting to fully comprehend the Law of Time  to break through to Immortal, resulting in him having only 20,000 years until the end of his lifespan.

After Hong was eliminated, Jiang Tian Chen, along with Luo and Ming Yu, appeared at Black Dragon Mountain Island so that Luo could meet with Hong. He coldly waited with Luo Feng and Thunder God while Luo shared his past with Hong, and left with Ming Yu and Luo at the end of their conversation.

characters.history:
Jiang Yu Eldest Brother is the non-canon name given to the leader of the Jiang Family branch in Hu Yang City. He is the elder brother of Jiang Yu You.

He was among the representatives of the Five Major Families who observed the Blood Python Guild's headquarters in the aftermath of Luo Feng's battle with Mu Yang. Watching the footage of the confrontation, he noted that since Luo Feng did not hide his entrance into the headquarters, it meant that Luo Feng had good intentions toward the City Lord's Mansion.

Later, he was disappointed when Luo Feng refused the position of Deputy Commander of the Hu Yang Legion, but he did not agree with City Lord Qu Meng, Wu Qu Lou, and Mei Wu Family Branch Leader that they should hire someone to kill Luo Feng. Earlier, he had purchased Luo Feng's information from the Flame Wind Guild Hall for 100 Universe Sands when Luo Feng attacked Qian Yu Chong and Mei Wu Qi, and was surprised that the price had increased to 5,000 Universe Sands. During the auction for the World Sword, he felt that Luo Feng was deliberately inflating the price when it hit 2 million Universe Sands, and was stunned when it was sold.

As the leader of one of the Five Major Families, he took part in the strategic planning of the city's defense during its invasion by Blood Cloud's forces, and he was surprised at the strength that Blood Cloud revealed in his battle with General Yong. Since he was a member of the Jiang Family, he personally received the orders from Lord Jiu Jiang, including the increase of the bounties of Blood Cloud, Yu Tian Hu, and Yu Tian Yi. He was also part of the group who met Luo Feng to hand him the Causality Tracking Order left behind by Entropy Sky Flame. He met the forces led by his younger brother who were sent to meet Luo Feng, and he had Moyu Hu contact Moyu Qingyan to set up the meeting.

characters.history:
Jiu Ye God King was an ordinary God King. Born in an Original Universe as a ferocious flying bird Special Lifeform, he loved to devour living creatures. He was a nightmare existence in his universe, destroying one tribe after another, eventually becoming the most terrifying existence in the territory surrounding his universe. He devoured all living beings in his original universe; only after he transcended reincarnation could newly born creatures in that universe get a chance to live.

After coming to the Continent of Origin, his strength continued to increase, and he eventually took control of his home original universe, with his Divine Power Avatars devouring living beings at will. He hoped to become invincible on the continent and to treat the entire continent as his hunting ground. Unfortunately, his son ran afoul of An Fengya while attempting to devour more creatures, and when the army under his command attacked An Fengya, he was protected by Luo Feng. After learning of An Fengya's dilemma, Luo Feng took him on as a disciple-in-name and killed Jiu Ye with his Grand Extermination Style technique.

With his death, the original universe he controlled regained its freedom.

characters.history:
Jue Yi Saint King is the 3rd generation Patriarch of the Duan Dong River line. He was truly amazing, even more than the 1st and 2nd generation Patriarchs. He spread the fame of Duan Dong River, and stood at the top of the pinnacle beings, reaching the God King level. As a God King, he had mastered the Law of Chaos, and his strength was enough to create a nation on his own. He perfected the Duan Dong River inheritance; no heir after him could reach his level, despite 9 of them becoming Saints.

He created the Duan Dong River inheritor imprint, allowing the heirs to be recognized as the master of the Duan Dong River Space of Inheritance, which then enables the heir to receive the true inheritance of the Duan Dong River line. With his ability, he could have enabled a secret technique to contain a spirit.

Together with the first- and second-generation Patriarchs, he created the Duan Dong River Space of Inheritance, as well as the 3 memory stones containing the root of the core inheritance of Duan Dong River. Together with the other Patriarchs, he left behind records of his Miniature Universe's structure laws for future heirs.

Despite his talents, even his Miniature Universe did not reach 10 billion light-years when he was a Void True God.

After Lord Luo revived him, he is granted a fiefdom and cultivation cave in Galaxy Capital, along with numerous precious resources.

characters.title: Kafuxiu
characters.introText: Kafuxiu is one of the top 10 immortal and indestructible beings in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. He has no race, no companions, and lives alone. He reached Primogenitor level entirely by himself. He is one of the few qualified to reside in the Eternal Land, where only the highest-level beings can enter. Despite his solitude, he is fearless and uninhibited, inserting himself into major events and battles across the Chaotic Origin Dimension for amusement. He enjoys provoking other eternal beings and mocking them, especially by collecting and replaying scenes of their defeats. characters.history:
Kafuxiu is one of the top 10 immortal and indestructible beings in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. He has no race, no companions, and lives alone. He reached Primogenitor level entirely by himself. He is one of the few qualified to reside in the Eternal Land, where only the highest-level beings can enter. Despite his solitude, he is fearless and uninhibited, inserting himself into major events and battles across the Chaotic Origin Dimension for amusement. He enjoys provoking other eternal beings and mocking them, especially by collecting and replaying scenes of their defeats. He once showed an image of the Feather Emperor heavily injured with most of his feathers plucked off and pretended it was a mistake, laughing as he did so.

He openly stated his disdain for Lord Jin, calling him despicable and shameless for ambushing him during a battle in the Abyss of Destruction. He mocked Mo Gu Si for being unable to resist Xing Mang, accusing him of only bullying the weak. He welcomed Luo Feng to the Eternal Land with a teasing tone, saying the seat had long been prepared. Though chaotic and sharp-tongued, his presence is fully acknowledged and tolerated by all other eternal beings due to his overwhelming strength.
characters.trivia:
Kafuxiu got his white battle armor in the 19th layer of Abyss of Destruction.

Kafuxiu used to run the 18th layer of the Abyss of Destruction, but Endless Ancestor pulled up, beat him, and kicked him out. After losing the 18th layer to Endless Ancestor, Kafuxiu took the opportunity and seized the 16th layer from the greatly weakened Mo Gu Si.

Kafuxiu is the first  Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform to become friends with Luo Feng. Their friendship was forged through a long, intense battle in the 16th layer of the Abyss Of Destruction, where they pushed each other to grow stronger. Unlike others, Kafuxiu values fair fights and respect over victory, which earned Luo Feng his friendship.

characters.trivia: While in the donghua we do not see a confirmed image of his character model, he is listed as the 9th ranked in the Training Space Elimination Stage, before he was pushed down to the 10th spot due to Luo Feng taking the 3rd spot in Episode 139.

characters.introText: A green-skinned intrepid youth wearing golden armor.
characters.appearance: A green-skinned intrepid youth wearing golden armor.
characters.history: Kashna is a World Master youth of the Gold Horn Race. As Si Fan Qi's student, he was allowed to participate in Luo Feng's Dream Underworld Mission. His actions during their opening conversation caused Luo Feng to want him to stay by his side, avoiding any mistakes during the mission.

characters.title: Katu Race King
characters.introText: A tall being covered in feathers, with vertical eyes.
characters.appearance: A tall being covered in feathers, with vertical eyes.
characters.history:
Katu Race King is the non-canon name given to the Katu Race Pinnacle Immortal King trapped in Ice Prison. With Law of Space  comprehension enabling him to perform Lockdown, he was ranked 732 of the 860 creatures still trapped in Ice Prison, according to Si Bo Wa.

Since he had been trapped in Ice Prison for hundreds of millions of eras, he hoped to die in a mad battle. When he met Luo Feng, he used Lockdown to prevent him from using Teleportation, not knowing that Luo Feng was incapable of it with his Earthling Body. Unfortunately, since he was a Pinnacle Immortal King burning his Divine Power, Luo Feng chose to use the Shi Wu Wings to avoid his attacks and did not directly engage in battle. Since he could neither catch Luo Feng nor endure further in Ice Prison, he self-destructed, bidding farewell to those with whom he had competed, including Soul-Swallowing Beast King

characters.title: Kaya Tu
characters.introText: Kaya Tu (卡亚屠) is an extremely rare and powerful Innate World-level Hunyuan Lifeform  who became one of the earliest World-level Hunyuan servants under the command of Overlord Xing Mang before Xing Mang broke through to Overlord Level. Renowned for his mastery over spacetime laws, Kaya Tu accompanied Xing Mang during long-term expeditions across the Infinite Hunyuan Space.
characters.appearance: Kaya Tu (卡亚屠) is an extremely rare and powerful Innate World-level Hunyuan Lifeform  who became one of the earliest World-level Hunyuan servants under the command of Overlord Xing Mang before Xing Mang broke through to Overlord Level. Renowned for his mastery over spacetime laws, Kaya Tu accompanied Xing Mang during long-term expeditions across the Infinite Hunyuan Space.
characters.history:
Kaya Tu was originally a captured and subdued innate World-level being. Upon full submission, he was granted the role of a personal servant after Xing Mang applied for a World-level servant, paying a cost of 500 million merit points—an extraordinarily high price, signifying the importance of this role.

Though most fusion-path cultivators rarely acquire such high-end servants before becoming Chaotic Origin Lifeform themselves, Xing Mang's journey of "breaking through with force"  required extensive exploration in obscure, dangerous realms of Infinite Hunyuan Space. Kaya Tu's capabilities made him an ideal companion for such tasks.Xing Mang explored the Chaotic Origin Dimension even before breaking out of the cage the only one known to have achieved this feat in the entire Cultivator Camp

characters.title: Kazan
characters.introText: Kazan is a Stellar Level genius cultivated by the Ganwu Universe Country's imperial family, sent to participate in the Pinnacle Genius Battle. In the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Stage, they participated in the 382nd group battle and were ordered by Ginelli, along with Ao Fei Xiu Si, to attack Luo Feng. Kazan wielded a giant axe, but was unable to withstand Luo Feng's attack with the first form of the Yan Shen Armament, Phantom Sword Form, thus he was easily eliminated.

They informed him of Luo Feng, Hong, and Lei Shen, who saved them during a conflict within the World of Thunder. When they invited Luo Feng's team to join their North Dragon City faction within the World Within a World on Cang Lan Star, they introduced the team to Kazan Lun, who thanked them for their help and then left.

characters.title: Ke Bu
characters.introText: A man wearing stone-grey armor, with eyes like red jewels.
characters.appearance: A man wearing stone-grey armor, with eyes like red jewels.
characters.history:
Ke Bu is an Immortal elder of the Tuo Yan tribe of the Gold Horn Race who was enslaved by the Zerg Race. At some time during his participation in wars while assisting the Human Race, someone from the Zerg Race enslaved him to use him as one of their pawns.

After Luo Feng defeated Bei Chuang, it was reported to the Zerg Race by another Gold Horn Immortal, which prompted them to order Ke Bu to assassinate him if possible. To keep Luo Feng on Laos World, he told him about Beast God Canyon, where Luo Feng studied the Giant Sleeping Beast God Statue for 182 years. Despite his best efforts to keep Luo Feng on Laos World to facilitate the assassination, the presence of Dylan and Si Fan Qi prevented him from having the opportunity.

characters.title: Ke La Qi
characters.introText: A powerfully built man, 3 meters tall, with purple eyes and a black beard. He exuded a powerful energy.
characters.appearance: A powerfully built man, 3 meters tall, with purple eyes and a black beard. He exuded a powerful energy.
characters.history:
Ke La Qi was one of the 18 executives of the Fire Phoenix Organization. He and the other 17 executives were the targets of Luo Feng's 1st Level of his Highest Points Mission. As an executive of the organization, he has 5% of its shares, and through the organization, he is connected to the 7th Prince of the Ganwu Universe Country.

Ke La Qi could be considered one of the most powerful people in the Cui Lang Starfield, much more powerful than the emperors of low-level Empires. The number of slaves he directly controlled had to be measured in trillions, and the number of slave planets he owned went up to the tens of thousands!

When confronted by Luo Feng, he attempted to bribe him and then ran away when Luo Feng began killing his subordinates. Luo Feng easily killed him on Bass Planet (using the 3,000 Starry Sky technique) while completing the 1st level of his Highest Points Mission.

characters.title: Ke Luo Fu

infobox.organisation_rank: Core Member Absolute Beginning Secret Realm

characters.introText: A skinny wolf-like man dressed in grey armor with yellow fur on his face, his brown eyes gleamed with green light. His fangs poked through the corners of his mouth, making people feel as if they were looking at a wolf!
characters.appearance: A skinny wolf-like man dressed in grey armor with yellow fur on his face, his brown eyes gleamed with green light. His fangs poked through the corners of his mouth, making people feel as if they were looking at a wolf!
characters.history:
Ke Luo Fu was one of the 5 strongest of the Universe Level seniors of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm, along with Ni Nan, Yu Feng, Ge, and Sa Jin. At the time he met Luo Feng, he had already passed the 7th level of the Tongtian Bridge and was considered the strongest of the seniors. At the conclusion of his performance in the Stellar Level Pinnacle Battle of his generation, he placed in the Absolute Beginning Region and was thus considered strong, but not the best of the generation. Mo Luo had little fear of fighting him in the Secret Realm Qualification Battle until watching his battle with Luo Feng.

Over 100 years prior to meeting Luo Feng, he went on a Dangerous-level mission and discovered the huge secret of that mission's world, granting him a miraculous encounter that substantially increased his basic foundation strength. After this, his strength exploded, with him being only the 2nd Universe Level currently expected to pass the 8th level of the Tongtian Bridge. In the past, he had tough battles with Yu Feng and encountered the true scheming nature of Mo Luo.

His first fight with Luo Feng was not close, he struck him down in 3 moves! His speed made it difficult for even Luo Feng to keep up, and his claw technique was stronger than Luo Feng's. During Luo Feng's qualification battle, Ke Luo Fu was the only one to defeat him. When they were supposed to have their rematch, Ke Luo Fu unexpectedly did not respond or appear in the Virtual Universe, resulting in a loss via forfeit. It was then revealed that he had been on an Impossible-level mission, with only about 70% of his consciousness available for the qualification battle. He is presumed dead as he never contacted anyone afterward.

When Luo Feng discussed his claw technique with Bubulu, comparing it to Ke Luo Fu's, Bubulu stated that while Ke Luo Fu's claw technique was powerful, it was heading toward an eventual dead end, whereas Luo Feng's had limitless possibilities.
characters.trivia: Ke Luo Fu does not physically appear in the donghua; Bolan replaces him as a Virtual Universe Company genius stuck in an Impossible-level Mission, and it is combined with the Devil Mountain arc. Despite this, his name is shown in the tournament bracket when the Secret Realm Qualification Battles resume.

characters.introText: A skinny man with green eyes and a head full of black scales. He wore a white uniform when searching for treasures in his work capacity.
characters.appearance: A skinny man with green eyes and a head full of black scales. He wore a white uniform when searching for treasures in his work capacity.
characters.history:
Ke Si Er was a member of the observation team within Wu Long Starfield. Unbeknownst to them, he was also a spy planted by the Zerg Race, given the title Agent 6. He was given the directive to kill Luo Feng, who was designated target Number 3 by the race. A Pinnacle World Master Spirit Master, he was ranked top among the spies hidden within the Wu Long Starfield due to having an Immortal hidden in his Internal World.

While he was initially confident in his preparations to kill Luo Feng, he was surprised by the strength of the World Master Level 6 Cloud Vine, his soul defense, and the E9 Laser Gun. Unable to destroy the Cloud Vine, he summoned the Flame Immortal soul slave who was in his Internal World. The Immortal promptly killed him to hide the Zerg Race's trail, and began to battle Luo Feng.
characters.trivia: In the donghua, Ke Si Er and Flame Immortal Slave are consolidated into one character.

characters.title: King Bark Mirror

infobox.affiliation: Northern Territory Alliance Ancestral God Sect

characters.introText: I'm here, firstly to congratulate you, and secondly… to challenge you! King Blade River, you're worth challenging. King Blade River, you're worth all my efforts. Do you dare have a life or death battle with me, King Blade River?
characters.appearance: He looks a bit like a werewolf, but is covered in scales full of engravings. His hands and feet are hooked claws, his hair and eyes are golden, and he has a piercing voice. His back is slightly bent, giving him the appearance of an aggressive beast.
characters.history:
King Bark Mirror is an Invincible Immortal King famous for his insanity, ruthlessness, and greed. As a Special Lifeform with a Life Gene Level of 2,000, he has a corresponding level of arrogance. A member of the Northern Territory Alliance, he can count on the support of Universe Masters due to his potential as an Immortal. In recognition of his talent and strength, he acquired a Beast God Inheritance Order and was one of the 100 million living on Bauhinia Island, taking advantage of the Ancestral God Sect to train.

He specializes in inspection, using an innate talent technique known as Universe Mirror, which allows him to inspect everything within 1 billion square kilometers. Unless it was a Universe Master (and thus able to completely manipulate time and space), King Bark Mirror could detect it.

He hunts Luo Feng down to Nine Remoteness Space to seize his Arcana, forcing Luo Feng to escape within Nine Remoteness Space. After Luo Feng successfully returned from Nine Remoteness Space, with his new Remote Ocean body and having broken through to Immortal, Bark Mirror approached him to challenge him in a battle to the death. With the combination of his incredible Divine Power from his additional bodies, the Star Map, the Sealed Stars, and his 10,000-Star Sermon Map techniques, Luo Feng easily defeated Bark Mirror, forcing him to self-destruct.

Later, Bark Mirror was resurrected by Qi Lan Master (Star River Master in the donghua), but lost his Heavy Treasures and Arcana. The Northern Territory Alliance also rejected his application for a new Beast God Inheritance Order, since he had not reached a higher level of comprehension of the Beast God Inheritance. Infuriated by his loss of status and his loss to Luo Feng, Bark Mirror spread the rumor that Luo Feng had 6 Arcana, 2 of which were Soul-type and Flying Palace-type, hoping to incite Universe Overlords to kill him.

Her expression was unclear and hard to discern, only her eyes were bright and resplendent, almost like the stars, like an entire galaxy was within, extremely enticing.
characters.history:
King Black Mist is, along with King Zhenyan, a 9 Universe Tablet Sect leader in Primal Chaos City, although she is a member of the Huge Axe Dojo. She is well-known due to her attempt to master Law of Space , currently studying the 7th picture of the 9 Universe Tablet. She built the 9 Universe Pagoda and declared that she would comprehend all 9 pictures of the 9 Universe Tablet, and would enter whichever level she was currently studying; hence, she currently stays on the 7th level.

She and Zhenyan are close friends despite being from different organizations and having different levels of power. The pair studied the 9 Universe Tablet together in the past, spending 18 eras discussing law comprehension, becoming a beautiful story in Primal Chaos City.

King Black Mist accompanied King Zhenyan to the Tong Tian Bridge to observe Luo Feng's batch of geniuses make their first attempt on the bridge.

characters.title: King Black Phoenix
characters.introText: King Black Phoenix was an Immortal King member of the Hongmeng who was acquainted with King Wood Jade. She owned the King Armor that Luo Feng eventually purchased from the Universe Treasure Hall.
characters.history:
King Black Phoenix was an Immortal King member of the Hongmeng who was acquainted with King Wood Jade. She owned the King Armor that Luo Feng eventually purchased from the Universe Treasure Hall.

She bought the King Armor due to its strengths, and attempted to address the weaknesses by changing her body and making an Alloy Armor mask to cover her face. Eventually, she died at the hands of a being of another race in a Secret Region after her opponent discovered the mask's weakness and attacked with a Soul Attack.

characters.title: King Black Razor

infobox.Aliases: Black Ti Hei Ti Black Ti Emperor Hei Ti Emperor

characters.introText: A giant man in black horny strange armor with a height of about twenty meters and three sharp knives on his forehead.
characters.appearance: A giant man in black horny strange armor with a height of about twenty meters and three sharp knives on his forehead.
characters.history:
King Black Razor is one of the terrifying beings in the 7th Battlefield of the Extraterritorial Battlefield. While a member of the Human Race camp there, he is not even a member of the Hongmeng, showing his lone wolf nature. Despite not participating in the battle over the fallen Sealed Star, his reputation was not affected as his strength had long been verified.

After Luo Feng finished the life-or-death inheritance of Star Tower, he returned to the battlefield and fought with the non-Hongmeng members who wanted to kill him and take his treasures. When he was about to kill one of them, King Black Razor interfered and they began to fight. While Luo Feng was too fast for King Black Razor to land any powerful blows, King Black Razor was too strong for Luo Feng's attacks with the Sealed Stars to affect him.

He was impressed with Luo Feng's power and speed, as he was able to fend off his attacks and evade him.
characters.trivia: In the Donghua this role is taken by King Seven Swords

characters.title: King Black Tomb
characters.introText: Carrying a huge blood-colored sword on his back, his whole body is covered with a layer of blood-colored scale armor, with a head similar to a unicorn wolf, with a green stripe and a blood stripe on his face, and with nine scaly tails, his feet step on the empty space, and his eyes seem to make the space tremble.
characters.appearance: Carrying a huge blood-colored sword on his back, his whole body is covered with a layer of blood-colored scale armor, with a head similar to a unicorn wolf, with a green stripe and a blood stripe on his face, and with nine scaly tails, his feet step on the empty space, and his eyes seem to make the space tremble.
characters.history:
King Black Tomb is considered one of the 9 terrifying beings in the 7th Battlefield who appeared at the Sealed Star. His strength was considered comparable to Nan Cheng, making him close to an Invincible Immortal King.

Proud in nature, he offended countless warriors by the time he became a Domain Master, forcing him to flee to the outer region wars. Embarking on a long journey of killing, he grew until he was almost an Invincible Immortal King, treated as a pillar of his race.

characters.title: King Blood Beast
characters.introText: A tall warrior, completely covered in fur and having a single eye. He was almost like an upright beast, and he gave off a wild energy.
characters.appearance: A tall warrior, completely covered in fur and having a single eye. He was almost like an upright beast, and he gave off a wild energy.
characters.history:
King Blood Beast is a Limit Immortal King of some renown on the Yan Ji Continent, fighting for the Automaton Race camp. He is one of the two Limit Immortal Kings that King Purple Bell contracted to assist him in killing Luo Feng. While engaging with Luo Feng, he was faced with Luo Feng's strongest Fire God Origin Crystal, generating an explosion equal to 10 times a Pinnacle Immortal King's self-destruction, and lost 42% of his Divine Body. Fortunately for him, he suffered less damage than King Heavy Arrow, so he was not chased by Luo Feng, and was able to fly away from the space-locked battlefield and teleport away.

News of him fleeing spread throughout the continent, so he escaped to his God Country to recover from his injuries, knowing that Luo Feng would be a dangerous opponent for him until he broke through to Universe Venerable. Within his God Country were countless single-eyed men and women, and 9 Immortal soul slaves, two of whom were of his race. He left his territory to one of them to manage while he recovered.

characters.title: King Blood Devil
characters.introText: In the novel, he is dressed in red armor and a helmet, making it hard to see his expressions. He emits incredible bloodthirst.
characters.appearance:
In the novel, he is dressed in red armor and a helmet, making it hard to see his expressions. He emits incredible bloodthirst.

In the donghua, he looks...like a devil, with red skin and pointed ears.
characters.history:
King Blood Devil, true name Du Tuo, is an arrogant and powerful Pinnacle Immortal King. He has been stationed in his territory, the Du Tuo Starfield, for many years, and he has 363 Immortals who have surrendered to his authority. He is an antisocial lone wolf, refusing to join any of the 5 Leviathans of Humanity. Despite this, he is a powerful member of the Hongmeng, and thus has absolute control over his territory, with even the parent Gu Lun Universe Country having no administrative authority there.

Under his rule, the Du Tuo Starfield is heavily suppressed, with its science and technology heavily restricted, resulting in some planets lacking Spaceships and other basic technology. His subordinates administer the Blood Devil Trials, which result in the deaths of billions of weaker cultivators. While Blood Devil is ruthless in his Blood Devil Trials, he otherwise does not commit slaughters on the Life Planets under his control, thus he has never breached the Human Race's killing limit, and they cannot punish him.

He created a technique through which he could control 999 Immortal Soul Slaves, and he teaches this technique to his Immortal disciples and slaves, along with his World Master disciples, who each control their own elite slaves. The slaves controlled through this technique become his Blood Devil Soldiers.

characters.title: King Bloodthirsty
characters.introText: So it's the King Heart Stabbing who is proficient in Space Lockdown. With you using that, indeed there's no way for me to teleport. However, that means that King Golden Waterfall cannot do so either. With everybody unable to teleport, and 1 against 6, who do you think will die when we truly engage?
characters.appearance: This was a huge man that could really be said to be tall and sturdy. He was over 3m tall and he had 2 blood red horns on his forehead. He also had some silver scales there, and his armor revealed his 2 arms that had silver scales about. He was covered in a black and blood colored armor, obviously an absolute being of the Nakamon race.
characters.history:
King Bloodthirsty is an absolute being of the Nakamon Clan. As the third disciple of King Zhenyan, he is Luo Feng's senior, and he is Zhenyan's strongest disciple until Luo Feng surpasses him. He is known as a strong and intrepid Pinnacle Immortal King with incredible ferocity, having massacred heavily to obtain his name. King Bloodthirsty has a higher reputation than his teacher among the younger generations due to Zhenyan's seclusion in Primal Chaos City.

During the Battle For Earth against Nightmare Candle King and Huge Axe Dojo, Dylan contacted King Bloodthirsty and he immediately teleported to Solar System through Universe Markers Dylan left around the Solar System on the orders of King Zhenyan, as a trump card. He fights the 6 Immortal Kings simultaneously, and his only concern was Dylan and Luo Feng being harmed in the battle.

characters.title: King Brilliant Sword
characters.introText: A man wearing purple armor with a golden sword on his back.
characters.appearance: A man wearing purple armor with a golden sword on his back.
characters.history:
King Brilliant Sword is one of the four 9 Universe Sub-sect leaders who belong to the Virtual Universe Company and lives in Primal Chaos City, along with King Zhenyan, King Flame Dragon, and King Thousand Illusions. As such, he has passed at least the 18th level of the 9 Universe Tong Tian Bridge.

He is confident that Luo Feng will choose him as a teacher due to his appearance being the most Earthling-like of the 4, and the fact that he uses a sword, matching Luo Feng's comprehension of the 1st blade form of Floating Blood. He notes that he is just as strong as King Flame Dragon, so even if that was the criteria, he'd still be chosen as teacher. He was disappointed when Luo Feng chose King Zhenyan as his teacher.

characters.appearance: A huge beast, with lightning engravings on his face. He glowed with electricity.
characters.history:
King Cang Jin was a well-renowned warrior of the Yan Ji main continent. As a Limit Immortal King, by using his body amplification technique, his Divine Body had the strength of 1,000,000 Pinnacle World Masters!

He was one of the two Immortal Kings that Ice Blade brought along to acquire the treasures from one of the Yan Ji continent's Sacrificial Towers. When the fighting began, he was ferocious, bullying King Ye Chen and King Piercing Tiger. He showed no fear when King Ye Chen self-destructed, resulting in the death of both himself and Ice Blade.

In the end, he was forced to self-destruct by King Purple Bell during one of the fights over the treasure in the Sacrificial Tower, hoping that he would be revived in the future.

characters.title: King Cang Qi

characters.appearance: A humanoid creature with 4 arms and 4 eyes, with a very cold invisible aura.
characters.history:
King Ceng Yu is an Immortal King and the sales manager of the Wu Long Starfield representing the Universe Star River Bank. Like the other sales managers, Ceng Yu typically defers to King Nightmare Candle, and does so when Nightmare Candle decides to interrogate Luo Feng.

When Luo Feng returns to Wu Long Starfield as a World Master direct disciple of Primal Chaos City Leader, Ceng Yu asks King Long Jue to ease Luo Feng's anger towards the managers who did not stick up for him.

characters.title: King Cha Man
characters.introText: In his natural state, he appears very elegant and graceful, and has an eerie voice. When he activates his Beast God Transformation, he turns into a brutal and mad human-shaped Beast God with thick shoulders covered in scale armor.
characters.appearance: In his natural state, he appears very elegant and graceful, and has an eerie voice. When he activates his Beast God Transformation, he turns into a brutal and mad human-shaped Beast God with thick shoulders covered in scale armor.
characters.history:
King Cha Man is one of the friends Luo Feng made in Ancestral God Sect. He is a low-key Immortal King of the Human Race. Although he isn't as mighty as the Invincible Immortal Kings who could rival Universe Venerable, he is very close. He is considered one of the upper-middle tier members of the third level of Beast God heirs on Bauhinia Island, and one of the top 5 of the Human Race. Due to his talent and ability, he was highly valued and specially trained by the Human Race. Unfortunately, he was stuck at the final step to becoming a Universe Venerable, which had robbed him of his pride and made him meek.

He is the first Beast God heir that Luo Feng battles after entering the Ancestral God Sect. He was surprised to see Luo Feng was a Spirit Master, as most who follow the Beast God path are Warriors. By defeating King Cha Man, Luo Feng learns how powerful he is compared to the other third level Beast God heirs. As they are both humans and members of Hongmeng, they remain friends and he gives Luo Feng information on the Ancestral God Secret Region and checks on him after the assassination attempt by Venerable Mud Swallowing. He reaches out to Luo Feng after King Bark Mirror chased him into Nine Remoteness Space, and he is present to watch their battle after Luo Feng breaks through to Immortal. He is one of the friends who reach out to Luo Feng after it was announced that he had entered Flame Emperor's territory.

characters.title: King Cha Wu
characters.introText: King Cha Wu is a Pinnacle Immortal King of Hongmeng capable of performing Teleportation. Luo Feng befriended him and relied on him (among others) to teleport him in times of need. Cha Wu teleported Luo Feng to his final battle with King Purple Bell and away from the battle that earned him the name 'King Blade River'.

Initially a member of the Demon Race camp at the 7th Battlefield, he fought multiple times with Tian Zhen in the past, but the third time they met, he fell victim to Tian Zhen's Soul Attack and became his soul slave. Since then, the pair worked discreetly to obtain treasures, also controlling King Wu La.

characters.history:
King Desire Devil is an Immortal King member of the Hongmeng, acquainted with King Zhenyan. When Luo Feng sought to sell the G Grade puppet and 1.53 million additional puppets that he obtained from his battle with Ci Wei Ka, King Zhenyan got him in contact with Desire Devil, who paid 1.8 billion Mixed Yuan Units for them.

As a member of a subservient race to the Human Race, he was interested in getting along with Luo Feng, the disciple of Primal Chaos City Leader, so they chatted and ate after the deal was settled. After the meal, he was made aware of a Hongmeng Blood River Crystal auction, and jokingly asked Zhenyan not to compete with he and King Black Heart. He and King Black Heart then left for the auction.

characters.title: King Desire Heart

characters.title: King Devil Hand
characters.introText: King Devil Hand was a Low Immortal King who killed Hu Yan Bo 50,000 years before the start of the series. He killed him over a certain treasure, and the fight spread across multiple worlds.
characters.appearance: A vicious eagle-headed man in gray armor.
characters.history:
King Devil Hand was a Low Immortal King who killed Hu Yan Bo 50,000 years before the start of the series. He killed him over a certain treasure, and the fight spread across multiple worlds.

He realized that Luo Feng was related to Hu Yan Bo, as he was an aboriginal Spirit Master, able to buy Earth, and performed as well as he did in the Pinnacle Genius Battle. He knew he was in danger due to Luo Feng's status as both a disciple of Hu Yan Bo and a resident in the Primal Secret Realm of the Virtual Universe Company, so he used God Body Separation to split his body into clones with 60% and 40% of his body. His plan was to wait 1 million years before showing himself. His 40% strength clone hid in Gu Lun Universe Country, and was killed by Luo Feng, so he was able to feign his death.

He was careful and hid in a remote location, slowly regaining his strength, however due to the strength of the human race, he was uncovered by a human great being who found him during an adventure.

In the 39,800th era after the appearance of the World of Jin, Hu Yan Bo killed him after a hunt that lasted 3 eras.

characters.title: King Dragon Pagoda
characters.introText: King Dragon Pagoda is one of the 9 absolute warriors of the 7th Battlefield of the Extraterritorial Battlefield. As such, they are a Limit Immortal King who is close to Invincible Immortal King, and through their trump cards, they could even kill a Limit Immortal King! They appeared at and participated in the battle for the Sealed Star, and after Luo Feng killed 40 Immortal Kings near Star Tower, King Dragon Pagoda was one of the great beings who sought to kill him and seize the spoils. In the past, King Dragon Pagoda fought King Black Razor in a long battle that resulted in the two calling a truce.

He is simple and honest, slow to rage, and hardly used power to pressure others. He was also known for exploring together with his life-or-death brother, King Nan Shi. He introduced himself and King Nan Shi to Luo Feng in Hongmeng City in the Virtual Universe, after Luo Feng passed the World Master-level Primal Sky Mountain.

characters.introText: In the novel she is described as a woman with long purple hair, purple eyes, and a long bushy tail. When her eyes looked down, the surrounding world seemed to be immersed in a lewd energy.
characters.appearance: In the novel she is described as a woman with long purple hair, purple eyes, and a long bushy tail. When her eyes looked down, the surrounding world seemed to be immersed in a lewd energy.
characters.history:
King Fantasy Spirit is an extremely terrifying Pinnacle Immortal King Spirit Master who focuses on illusions, and a member of the Universe Mercenary Alliance. She has 7 male disciples and 12 female disciples, however, she does not allow them to find a spouse, as she is afraid that will slow down their Cultivation due to being distracted by love and desire. As such, she stops her disciple Ji Qing from getting together with Hong. It is implied that she had a lover in the past who lacked the commitment and determination that Hong shows.

She gave Hong two choices. One was to wait until he reached Pinnacle World Master and go take part in the War in the Extraterritorial Battlefield. If his contributions are enough to get him a 1st class medal, She won’t stop him and Ji Qing, and she won’t expel her.

The second choice was for him to attempt her 18 levels of Love Illusions. If he successfully passed all 18 levels, She will not stop him and Ji Qing and she guaranteed that she won’t expel her. However, if he failed, she would order the Universe Mercenary Alliance to send powerful warriors to kill him immediately. Hong selected the second option and passed it easily.

Despite her promise to both Hong and Ji Qing that she would not stop them from being together, after Hong passed her test, she showed Ji Qing something that caused her to break off her relationship with Hong.

Hong's performance in passing her test led to him becoming a member of the Huge Axe Dojo's special elite training camp, a huge turning point in his path of cultivation.

It is unknown what her reaction was when she learned about Hong reaching the Immortal King level and becoming a disciple of Huge Axe Creator within a cultivation period shorter than her.

characters.title: King Fen Nong
characters.introText: King Fen Nong is a Pinnacle Immortal King of the Automaton Race camp at the Yan Ji Continent. Fen Nong received the communication from King Purple Bell that Yang had appeared, possessing the treasure from the Sacrificial Tower.
characters.appearance: A very short being of an alien race.
characters.history:
King Fen Nong is a Pinnacle Immortal King of the Automaton Race camp at the Yan Ji Continent. Fen Nong received the communication from King Purple Bell that Yang had appeared, possessing the treasure from the Sacrificial Tower.

After Luo Feng killed 13 Immortal Kings, Fen Nong declared that Luo Feng wasn't strong enough to deal with Pinnacle Immortal Kings, stating that the remaining group of over 200 Immortal Kings should attack him. To prevent this, Luo Feng revealed his trump card, the most powerful Fire God Origin Crystal, capable of killing a Limit Immortal King, giving him time to have King Cha Wu teleport him from the battlefield.

characters.title: King Feng Chen
characters.introText: King Feng Chen is one of the three Immortal King managers (along with King Jie Li and King Huang Shi) of the Human Race immigrants to Earth, representing the Virtual Universe Company. When King Jie Li tried to bully Luo Feng, Feng Chen advised against it, noting that Luo Feng was the disciple of Primal Chaos City Leader, and was capable of passing the World Master Primal Sky Mountain.

characters.history:
King Feng Chen is one of the three Immortal King managers (along with King Jie Li and King Huang Shi) of the Human Race immigrants to Earth, representing the Virtual Universe Company. When King Jie Li tried to bully Luo Feng, Feng Chen advised against it, noting that Luo Feng was the disciple of Primal Chaos City Leader, and was capable of passing the World Master Primal Sky Mountain.

When Primal Chaos City Leader gave the order that the immigrant families could not interfere with the Earthlings and vice versa, on punishment of death, he and the other managers met Luo Feng. Courteously greeting Luo Feng, Feng Chen later advised Jie Li not to react in anger, as he would be killed by the 1,000-vine Star Eating Plant that was left to protect the Earthlings.

characters.history:
King Flame Dragon is one of the four 9 Universe Sub-Sect leaders who belong to the Virtual Universe Company and lives in Primal Chaos City, along with King Zhenyan, King Brilliant Sword, and King Thousand Illusions. As such, he has passed at least the 18th level of the 9 Universe Tong Tian Bridge.

In the past, Hu Yan Bo and Babata saw him in action when exploring a universe secret area. While enduring a perilous journey through a planet engulfed in ice, they saw him transform into a star and immediately burn 10 Immortals who surrounded him to a crisp. Two of them were humans and the rest were automaton and other races. He could be considered an extremely terrifying being, as it is difficult to kill an Immortal in one move.

characters.introText: Tall and skinny, over 8m tall wearing a silver robe and a black mask with peculiar engravings. He had a piercing voice as he spoke.
characters.appearance: Tall and skinny, over 8m tall wearing a silver robe and a black mask with peculiar engravings. He had a piercing voice as he spoke.
characters.history:
King Heavy Arrow is a Limit Immortal King of some renown on the Yan Ji Continent, a member of the Automaton Race camp there. Despite this, he was not an Automaton, so he dreaded dying and being forced to work for the race to repay them for his resurrection.  As a Limit Immortal King warrior, he had no fear of other Immortal Kings. As his name implies, he uses a bow and arrow as his weapon.

He and King Blood Beast decided to help King Purple Bell against Luo Feng, in exchange for 1/3 of the spoils, plus 5 billion Indigo Gems. Despite his amplification techniques, he was heavily damaged by Luo Feng's Fire God Origin Crystal, losing 59% of his Divine Body and leaving him only a little stronger than a High Immortal King. Luo Feng then attacked him with his Poison Shadow Blade and the Cloud Vine, using the Fei Mo Poison, leaving him with only 12% of his Divine Body. This forced him into a Deep Sleep, after which Luo Feng enslaved him.

After spending over 120 billion Mixed Yuan Units to recover Heavy Arrow's Divine Body, Luo Feng gave him the Demon-Sound Fire God Bell to use, then had him accompany him to Star Tower. He gave Luo Feng intel on Star Tower and essentially served as both his bodyguard and as a warning of Luo Feng's strength. During his battles around Star Tower, Luo Feng directly controlled Heavy Arrow, eventually killing dozens of Immortal Kings and enslaving multiple Limit Immortal King warriors and Pinnacle Immortal King Spirit Masters.

characters.history:
King Huang Shi is one of the three Immortal King managers (along with King Jie Li and King Feng Chen) of the Human Race immigrants to Earth, representing the Universe First Bank, Universe Star River Bank, and the Universe Mercenary Alliance. As a pinnacle Immortal King, she is the strongest of the three, and often settles disputes between the other two, who often did not agree.

When Jie Li sought to challenge Luo Feng, Huang Shi reminded him that there were strict orders forbidding this, and she was shocked with the others when they saw the 1,000-vine Star Eating Plant on Earth. When meeting Luo Feng after the reveal of this plant, she agreed to meet him in the Hongmeng, and advised Jie Li not to lose his life over the disagreement he had with Luo Feng.

characters.introText: He is a leader of the Luo Si Family, and a disciple of the Venerable Gold Mist. When Luo Feng was going through his Life and Death inheritance of the Star Tower for 6,000+ years, news started to spread that Luo Feng had fallen. As a result others Race wanted to confirm this news so they gave Jian Ta 100 Million Mixed Units to confirm the news. Jian Ta ordered his underling to create an issue between Luo Si Family and Luo Royal Family. After Luo Feng's order, when he first came to visit for apology he was forced to sit in the lowest level of Guest Area. As a punishment he had to agree to Luo Feng's Three Orders or face death.

characters.title: King Jiu Jian
characters.introText: A short, skinny man wearing a silver mask, with hands similar to a wild beast's claws, almost like two blades.
characters.appearance: A short, skinny man wearing a silver mask, with hands similar to a wild beast's claws, almost like two blades.
characters.history:
King Jiu Jian is one of the Immortal Kings (along with King Shiryo) that Ci Wei Ka contacted to assist him in killing Luo Feng's Golden Horned Beast Body. A Pinnacle Immortal King specializing in Law of Space , he is capable of Teleportation. After the initial discussion between Jiu Jian, Ci Wei Ka, and King Shiryo, Luo Feng was teleported away by King Star Fantasy, causing Ci Wei Ka to send out a bounty on the beast.

When King Graceful Black obtained Luo Feng's location from the dying Na Shi Youth, he arrived at King Jiu Jian's palace to inform him and Ci Wei Ka of Luo Feng's location. Jiu Jian (along with Ci Wei Ka and Graceful Black) teleported to the location given and began searching for Luo Feng.

When they were initially unsuccessful in locating Luo Feng, Jiu Jian broke up the arguing Ci Wei Ka and Graceful Black, then volunteered to check the space slits for him, but was unsuccessful. He teleported Ci Wei Ka to 6 different spots, where Ci Wei Ka left one of his Automaton Ship components to Nine Absolute God Country, using his Hexagon Prison technique to continue searching. When they still could not locate Luo Feng, Jiu Jian suggested that Luo Feng may be hiding deep in the space slits, blocking the Hexagon Prison scan, or he may have learned Teleportation and teleported outside of the affected area.

When Ci Wei Ka used Hexagon Prison to obliterate regions where Luo Feng may have been hiding, he asked Jiu Jian to locate King Shiryo and bring him there. Shortly after he arrived with King Shiryo, Jiu Jian and Graceful Black both felt a space ripple that indicated a recent teleportation. Jiu Jian then directed Ci Wei Ka to stop Luo Feng with his Hexagon Prison, and Graceful Black performed Lockdown to prevent teleportation.

Unfortunately for them, Luo Feng was able to easily evade them using the Shi Wu Wings and his flying techniques, causing the group to give up. Ci Wei Ka compensated both Jiu Jian and King Shiryo about 200 million Indigo Gems for their efforts.

characters.title: King Ju Jue

characters.history: King Ju Jue is one of the Immortal Kings of the Automaton Race who is a Beast God heir, dwelling on Bauhinia Island. He guessed that Luo Feng was King Blade River, and hoped to have him confirm it so he could kill him and obtain the reward, but Luo Feng did not admit to it.

characters.title: King Li Shuo
characters.introText: King Li Shuo is one of the first friends Luo Feng made when he joined the Ancestral God Sect. He is a Human member of the Hongmeng, and can be considered part of the upper-middle tier of the third-level Beast God heirs on Bauhinia Island. During his earlier years, he was an incredible talent, earning a Beast God Inheritance Order and joining the Ancestral God Sect, but after millions of years, he became more low-key, as newer young talents supplanted his position.
characters.history:
King Li Shuo is one of the first friends Luo Feng made when he joined the Ancestral God Sect. He is a Human member of the Hongmeng, and can be considered part of the upper-middle tier of the third-level Beast God heirs on Bauhinia Island. During his earlier years, he was an incredible talent, earning a Beast God Inheritance Order and joining the Ancestral God Sect, but after millions of years, he became more low-key, as newer young talents supplanted his position.

After Luo Feng defeated King Cha Man, Li Shuo acknowledged both his talent and his strength, and he remained one of his closest companions within the sect.

characters.title: King Life Fall
characters.introText: King Life Fall is considered one of the 9 terrifying beings in the 7th Battlefield who appeared at the Sealed Star. His goal at the Sealed Star was to kill King Seven Swords (the Automaton Race's #3 Human Race genius assassination target) and then get the Sealed Star. When the Sealed Star emerged, he led more than 100 Automaton Race warriors with his Heavy Treasure Decomposition Tower to attack King Seven Swords but did not succeed in killing him.
characters.appearance: Wears golden armor, the skin is glowing black.
characters.history:
King Life Fall is considered one of the 9 terrifying beings in the 7th Battlefield who appeared at the Sealed Star. His goal at the Sealed Star was to kill King Seven Swords (the Automaton Race's #3 Human Race genius assassination target) and then get the Sealed Star. When the Sealed Star emerged, he led more than 100 Automaton Race warriors with his Heavy Treasure Decomposition Tower to attack King Seven Swords but did not succeed in killing him.

He regretted his failure to kill King Seven Swords, realizing that he didn't have any guarantee dealing with absolute warriors like him or King Dragon Pagoda. He had more confidence against the newly-emerged King Blade River, so after Luo Feng killed 40 Immortal Kings within Star Tower, he put a bounty on Luo Feng and told his automaton warriors that if they managed to confirm his location, he would reward one billion Indigo Gems.
