characters.appearance: He has a lion-shaped lower body with four claws, and a human upper body with 4 muscular arms. His body is dark blue, as if it was made of metal.
characters.history:
King Lightning-Racing is one of the 10 Limit Immortal Kings with power close to Invincible Immortal King trapped in Ice Prison, ranked 12th of all combatants by Si Bo Wa. He is the second of the top 15 of Ice Prison to fight Luo Feng, and the first after he spent 100 years training and developing Lightning-Fast Striking Star.

Luo Feng's ability to match him in battle shocked all of the creatures observing the battle, as 100 years prior, it was all he could do to flee from King White Bone. Luo Feng successfully damaged his body by using Lightning-Fast Striking Star, forcing him to burn his Divine Body in hopes of capturing Luo Feng. Unfortunately, as the fastest in Ice Prison, Luo Feng easily escaped, and with his spiritual force constantly detecting King Lightning-Racing's Divine Power, he was unable to use Time Stop on Luo Feng. Furious that he could not force Luo Feng to burn his (non-existent) Divine Body, he retreated.

One of Silver Eye's servants saw this battle and teleported him to the battlefield, leading to their first encounter.

characters.title: King Long Jue
characters.introText: In the novel he is described as a man with dark red skin, short, dark green hair, and a large mouth, wearing an exquisite long robe.
characters.appearance: In the novel he is described as a man with dark red skin, short, dark green hair, and a large mouth, wearing an exquisite long robe.
characters.history: King Long Jue is a weak Immortal King, barely reaching the threshold, and having just reached Immortal King tens of thousands of years before the start of the series.
characters.trivia: While in the novel, King Long Jue is good friends with Zhen Qian, in the donghua, he is friends with Golden Feather Marquis, due to the removal of Zhen Qian from the donghua.

characters.title: King Longyu
characters.introText: An extremely beautiful woman dressed in a dark-blue armor (or sometimes jade green), with long purple hair, her entire being was almost like a jade statue, giving off an illusory feeling as if she existed in a different time and space. In battle she wields two blades, with her cold energy spreading.
characters.appearance: An extremely beautiful woman dressed in a dark-blue armor (or sometimes jade green), with long purple hair, her entire being was almost like a jade statue, giving off an illusory feeling as if she existed in a different time and space. In battle she wields two blades, with her cold energy spreading.
characters.history:
She is the strongest Immortal under the command of Venerable Nine Swords, suzerain of Jiuyuliu, so she performed tasks for him, such as monitoring the geniuses from the Stellar-level genius battle. They were very close, often discussing problems together, and even though he gave the orders, she usually organized and led his armies, among other duties.

Since Immortals live for so long, their family members and loved ones will die before them if they do not become Immortals. Due to this, King Zhenyan and King Tong Nan are her life and death friends, and they used to be a team together. She and King Tong Nan even had a trace of romance, but they never acted upon it.

She dutifully performs her duties for Venerable Nine Swords, providing updates, particularly of Luo Feng and Bolan.

When Nightmare Candle King threatens Luo Feng and brings his forces to kill him, she arrives with 1000 Immortals from Venerable Nine Swords' army. After that confrontation, she arranges for Luo Feng to meet Venerable Nine Swords to discuss Earth.

She advises Venerable Nine Swords to make Luo Feng his underling immediately, when he passes the 13th level of the Heavenly Bridge.

characters.title: King Meng Cang
characters.introText: A figure with a square face and dark green hair, wearing a long, exquisite robe.
characters.appearance: A figure with a square face and dark green hair, wearing a long, exquisite robe.
characters.history:
King Meng Cang is an Immortal King who had the 32nd slot in the Hongmeng's most recent Devil's Voice God General Inheritance name list, but Luo Feng accidentally took his slot when he was kicked by Mo Luo into the Abyss. Shortly after his slot was taken, some people from the Mo Cha Planet unintentionally offended him, and in response he forced their entire planet into his God Country, allowing him to torture the planet's inhabitants to his heart's content.

One of Po Yu Marquis' disciples resided on the Mo Cha Planet, and he pled for her to save his planet, but she was unable to do so.

characters.title: King Meteorite
characters.introText: A tall and sturdy man with 18 horns on his head and scales all over his face. He exudes a ferocious aura.
characters.appearance: A tall and sturdy man with 18 horns on his head and scales all over his face. He exudes a ferocious aura.
characters.history: King Meteorite is an Immortal King member of the Virtual Universe Company. He protected the Pinnacle Genius Battle geniuses on their travel to Absolute Beginning Secret Realm and dropped them off at their living quarters. He spent the 3 months of travel giving the geniuses information on the region, on Secret Regions, and on the Beginning Universe in general.
characters.trivia: In the donghua, King Longyu performs this role

characters.title: King Mo Na
characters.appearance: An extraordinarily handsome man with a fox tail.

characters.title: King Morning Mixer
characters.introText: Taller, with a discus-like face and a big black mouth.
characters.appearance: Taller, with a discus-like face and a big black mouth.
characters.history: King Morning Mixer was a Pinnacle Immortal King of the Automaton Race camp who was part of their forces to battle over the Sealed Star. When Luo Feng arrived, Morning Mixer, a friend of the slain King Purple Bell, mocked him. This incurred the wrath of Luo Feng's Soul Slave King Heavy Arrow, who killed him.

characters.title: King Mountain Howl
characters.introText: A half-meter tall and adorable-looking.  His natural ability enables him to become a mountain-like giant.
characters.appearance: A half-meter tall and adorable-looking.  His natural ability enables him to become a mountain-like giant.
characters.history:
King Mountain Howl is one of the Soul Slaves that Luo Feng enslaved while fighting near Star Tower. He is the strongest of Luo Feng's Limit Immortal King soul slaves.

He was one of the three soul slaves who subdued King Tian Zhen, resulting in his enslavement at the hands of Luo Feng.
characters.trivia: In the donghua, King Mountain Howl is the alias King Heavy Arrow uses when acting in his true form

characters.title: King Nan Shi
characters.introText: King Nan Shi is the most exceptional Immortal King of the younger generation of the Tuo Ma Race (陀马族). He is life or death brothers with King Dream Fire and is ferocious, with a reputation built from massacre. Despite this reputation, he appears simple and showed humility when meeting Luo Feng for the first time.
characters.appearance: King Nan Shi is the most exceptional Immortal King of the younger generation of the Tuo Ma Race (陀马族). He is life or death brothers with King Dream Fire and is ferocious, with a reputation built from massacre. Despite this reputation, he appears simple and showed humility when meeting Luo Feng for the first time.

characters.title: King Nightmare Candle

infobox.Aliases: Meng Cha Luo (Real name) 勐茶络 Yan Zhu Emperor

characters.introText: Shut up, I'm speaking with King Long Jue, don't speak when I don't allow you to.
characters.appearance: An extremely handsome man with perfect facial features, wearing an exquisite white robe. He has long, silver hair, white, crystal-like skin, and a faint, mysterious engraving on his forehead. Even Irina and Phantom Spirit King could not compare to his beauty.
characters.personality: King Nightmare Candle is a petty, jealous, and spoiled individual. As the son of a powerful genius, he is used to being deferred to, and even his fellow managers tend to avoid him. He holds grudges and is extremely vindictive.
characters.history:
King Nightmare Candle is an Immortal King and the spoiled son of Venerable Fire Erosion. Thus, he is a figure of some import within the Huge Axe Dojo; he uses his power and status to bully others.

After Luo Feng was attacked by Ke Si Er, Nightmare Candle interrogated him, refused to believe his account, and attempted to subject him to a soul search. When Luo Feng maneuvered around his questions, Nightmare Candle attempted to frame him, and when that failed, he ordered him into the 1st Starfield Prison. He backed off from that order after Luo Feng mentioned that he would tell Venerable Nine Swords and Tian Shi Palace Master about his attempts to bully him. Though he was to be put in Jail for 1000 epoches by the order of Venerable Fire Erosion, his father but it turn out to be just a ruse as he was seen enjoying in Episode 176 and stated that he can enter VU every 100 years.

characters.title: King Overflowing Water
characters.introText: Overflowing Water King is a Limit Immortal King who explored the Star Tower region and was enslaved by Luo Feng. He is one of Luo Feng's three strongest Limit Immortal King Soul Slaves. Luo Feng gave him the Heavy Treasure Bing Hun Silk Screen, for him to use according to his style and strength. Luo Feng controlled him directly due to the importance of the treasure.
characters.appearance: Jade green-skinned.
characters.history:
Overflowing Water King is a Limit Immortal King who explored the Star Tower region and was enslaved by Luo Feng. He is one of Luo Feng's three strongest Limit Immortal King Soul Slaves. Luo Feng gave him the Heavy Treasure Bing Hun Silk Screen, for him to use according to his style and strength. Luo Feng controlled him directly due to the importance of the treasure.

He was one of the three soul slaves sent to subdue King Tian Zhen, along with King Mountain Howl and King Extreme Rainbow.

characters.title: King Piercing Tiger

infobox.killer: Forced to self-destruct by King Cang Jin

characters.introText: King Piercing Tiger was a Pinnacle Immortal King allied with the human camp on Yan Ji Continent, known for his strength and intrepid power. His specialties were in Lockdown and attacking. King Ye Chen chose him and Luo Feng to accompany him to get the treasures from the Sacrificial Tower.
characters.history:
King Piercing Tiger was a Pinnacle Immortal King allied with the human camp on Yan Ji Continent, known for his strength and intrepid power. His specialties were in Lockdown and attacking. King Ye Chen chose him and Luo Feng to accompany him to get the treasures from the Sacrificial Tower.

King Piercing Tiger was heavily injured by the self-destruction of Qiu Chi Ka, losing more than 50% of his Divine Body. After this, King Cang Jin attempted to force Luo Feng, King Piercing Tiger, and King Purple Bell to teleport out of the treasure room through their God Country, sparking a fight that resulted in King Piercing Tiger self-destructing in hopes of harming King Cang Jin. He was unsuccessful in harming Cang Jin or Purple Bell, dying in vain.
characters.trivia: In the Donghua, he was replaced by King Star Fantasy to accompany King Ye Chen and Luo Feng

characters.title: King Purple Bell

infobox.Aliases: Purple Bell King Purple Clock Emperor King Purple Clock
infobox.enemies: Luo Feng Human Race Zerg Race Demon Race

characters.introText: A malevolent-looking skinny man of the Qi Chang race, 1.6 meters tall and covered in scales, as characteristic of his race.
characters.appearance: A malevolent-looking skinny man of the Qi Chang race, 1.6 meters tall and covered in scales, as characteristic of his race.
characters.personality:
King Purple Bell was a Pinnacle Immortal King who, along with King Cang Jin, was invited by Ice Blade to loot the Sacrificial Tower. He presumably got his name from his ancient purple bell Heavy Treasure, Demon-Sound Fire God Bell. As a fellow member of the Qi Chang race, he and Ice Blade had explored the universe together and trusted one another, even though he didn't think too highly of Ice Blade.

When Ice Blade and King Ye Chen agreed to each pick two partners to bring with them in order to use the associated talismans to enter the Sacrificial Tower, King Purple Bell was one of the two chosen by Ice Blade, along with King Cang Jin. When they began the process of entering the tower, he was concerned with the possibility of a special attack being launched at them, prompting Ye Chen's side to mock him.

After entering the tower, he and Ice Blade went down a separate pathway from Cang Jin and were followed by King Piercing Tiger and Luo Feng, resulting in a chase. Unable to catch up to or stop Luo Feng, he arrived in the first treasure room after Luo Feng looted the treasure. To prevent Luo Feng from escaping, he called upon his Blood Devil Flower plant companion, which clashed with Luo Feng's Cloud Vine. Eventually, Piercing Tiger arrived to relieve Luo Feng, but Purple Bell held him off while Ice Blade and the Blood Devil Flower prevented Luo Feng from escaping before Cang Jin arrived.

Cang Jin immediately attacked Piercing Tiger upon arrival, sending him crashing into a distant wall, then used his body amplification technique and attacked Luo Feng. Thanks to the Shi Wu Wings, Luo Feng was unharmed, and Ye Chen rushed over to fight Cang Jin while Purple Bell fought with Piercing Tiger. Understanding that Luo Feng was the smallest threat to him, Cang Jin ordered Purple Bell to obtain the treasure from Luo Feng, even if it meant burning his Divine Body.

Using his control of Law of Space , Purple Bell launched an attack using his Spirit Weapon, Fire Bells. Utilizing Strikeout Through the Universe, Luo Feng avoided the attack, forcing Purple Bell to burn 3% of his Divine Body. The amplified attack was too fast for Luo Feng to avoid, but he was again unharmed due to the defense of the Shi Wu Wings. Unable to harm Luo Feng even after burning his Divine Body, Purple Bell communicated to Cang Jin, who burned his Divine Body and began to attack in earnest.

Using the power of his burning Limit Immortal King Divine Body, Cang Jin attacked Ye Chen so quickly that he could not dodge, reducing him to ashes. With only 50% of his Divine Body remaining, Ye Chen chose to self-destruct, since he could no longer escape. The self-destruction of 50% of a Pinnacle Immortal King killed Ice Blade and destroyed 6% of Piercing Tiger's Divine Body, but curiously, Purple Bell was unharmed. Purple Bell, enraged at the current predicament, yelled at Cang Jin, who told him to shut up and not let Piercing Tiger and Luo Feng escape. Purple Clock, along with Cang Jin, then chased Luo Feng, who had left down one of the pathways.

As King Cang Jin chased Luo Feng, slowing him at points but unable to capture him, Purple Bell mused that Cang Jin used King Ye Chen to kill Ice Blade, since as allies from the Automaton Race camp, he could not do it directly. Thinking that Cang Jin wanted all of the treasure for himself, he noted mentally that even if King Piercing Tiger self-destructed, he would not die.

When Luo Feng was close to the exit of the core area, the Yan Ji Race aboriginal Qiu Chi Ka blocked the 6 pathways, preventing his escape and allowing Piercing Tiger, Cang Jin, and Purple Bell to catch up. Qiu Chi Ka informed the group that he had been observing them from the beginning, hoping they would kill each other, but was forced to show himself when Luo Feng was about to escape. After Qiu Chi Ka informed them that only one of his race could open the chests present, and that the chests were empty, Purple Clock and Cang Jin told Luo Feng to hand him one of the chests to prove it. Qiu Chi Ka then proposed that they work together to get to the true treasure of the tower.

After talking it over with Cang Jin, Purple Bell agreed to trust Qiu Chi Ka, while angrily noting internally that Cang Jin decided upon himself to take Ice Blade's share, resulting in him getting 80% and Purple Bell only 20%. Purple Bell, along with Cang Jin, Piercing Tiger, and Luo Feng, then surrounded Qiu Chi Ka as they flew to the Heritage Tower Treasure Room. Upon arrival, Qiu Chi Ka informed the group that he would need a talisman to open the door, prompting Cang Jin to order Purple Bell to attempt to open the door with his talisman. When Purple Bell was unsuccessful, Cang Jin tossed him one talisman, then another, which Qiu Chi Ka used to open the door.

After entering the treasure room, Cang Jin attacked Qiu Chi Ka, but was still unable to open the treasure within. Qiu Chi Ka then locked the door to the room, trapping the group within and advising them that their only way out was through God Country Transmission. As the group thought of how to deal with the situation, Qiu Chi Ka self-destructed. As a Pinnacle Immortal King, his self-destruction destroyed over 50% of Piercing Tiger's Divine Body, but once again, Purple Bell was unharmed...

With Qiu Chi Ka's self-destruction, Purple Bell's terrifying defensive capabilities were fully exposed. King Cang Jin dryly noted that outside of burning his Divine Body to attack Luo Feng, Purple Bell had been unharmed from the incredible self-destruction of two Pinnacle Immortal Kings! Purple Bell then mocked Cang Jin, noting that he had no reason to reveal his trump cards for survival. He then told Cang Jin to attempt opening the chest in the room, but Cang Jin was unsuccessful in doing so. After the rest of the group failed to open the chest, Cang Jin ordered the others to use God Country Transmission to leave first, which caused Purple Bell to rebut that the strongest of them, Cang Jin, should leave first, as that was safest for all involved, getting King Piercing Tiger and Luo Feng's affirmation.

Faced with rebellion from the rest of the group, Cang Jin roared that those who disobeyed would die, then Purple Bell advised that he activated his Automaton Race Virtual World broadcast, sharing the occurrences with the Automaton Race camp. He thought that by doing so, Cang Jin would not attack an ally, but Cang Jin had already warped the light and sound to prevent recording. Cang Jin then mused that Purple Clock had some treasures on him, causing Purple Bell to note that Luo Feng also had treasures. After Cang Jin told the group that he would kill them one by one and obtain their wealth, Purple Bell, enraged, revealed his infamous trump card: an A812 Fire God Origin Crystal, akin to 3 times the power of a Pinnacle Immortal King's self-destruction!

After threatening Cang Jin, noting that within the small Heritage Tower Treasure Room, the crystal would definitely destroy 5-10% of Cang Jin's Divine Body, Purple Bell joined forces with Piercing Tiger and Luo Feng to battle Cang Jin, telling the others to hold nothing back. After Piercing Tiger self-destructed, Purple Bell told Luo Feng to go all out, not knowing that as a World Master, Luo Feng had no Divine Body to burn. When Cang Jin launched his attack, Purple Bell finally acted, activating his Heavy Treasure Demon-Sound Fire God Bell and placing the Fire God Origin Crystal within. Using the bell to channel the explosion, amplifying the attack by 10 times, he focused the attack on Cang Jin, hoping to kill him and obtain his wealth.

Using his Heavy Treasure to defend himself, Purple Bell's attack went out with full force, forcing Cang Jin to self-destruct in response. The power of a Limit Immortal King self-destructing had to be seen to be believed, forcing Purple Bell to use all of his strength and his Heavy Treasure to redirect the force downwards to lessen the damage he received. The explosion created a 6,000 kilometer deep cave before dispersing, destroying everything but the most valuable treasures. Despite having to burn his Divine Body to control the explosion, the combination of his consumption and the explosion's damage only resulted in Purple Bell losing 26% of his Divine Body, which meant he was still strong enough to collect all of the treasures in the area.

Thinking that everyone else had died, Purple Bell began collecting the treasures in the area, but was unable to locate the Yan Ji Race treasure chest that was in the room. Attempting to locate it, as well as Luo Feng's treasures, he gathered everything in his Space Ring, but was surprised when an apparent metal fragment was unable to enter it. He stared wide-eyed as the fragment landed in the hand of Luo Feng! After the two exchanged barbs, Purple Bell attacked Luo Feng, forcing him to use Strikeout Through the Universe to escape. Hoping to kill him and prevent him from exposing his Heavy Treasure, Purple Bell chased after Luo Feng, but encountered his Golden Horned Beast Body, wearing the King Armor. Realizing that Luo Feng may have called the legendary Silver Winged King to help him, and thus may have called others, Purple Bell teleported away. In an icy location, Purple Bell resolved to kill Luo Feng to take the treasure he thought he had earned, the treasure of the Sacrificial Tower, and prevent Luo Feng from spreading the news about the Purple Bell Heavy Treasure.

While Luo Feng was selling the treasures he obtained from the battle, Purple Bell spread the rumor that Luo Feng acquired treasure from the Sacrificial Tower, hoping to root him out and make others hunt him down. From Purple Bell's perspective, if Luo Feng was too weak, he'd spread news of the Heavy Treasure Demon-Sound Fire God Bell, so he should force him out early and kill him. On the other hand, if Luo Feng felt he was strong enough to kill him and obtain his Heavy Treasure, he would still spread news of it, so Purple Bell should try to kill him even sooner! As a result, he made the first move. After hearing the news from King Mo Na, Luo Feng began to make his plans.

Purple Bell, while trying to locate Luo Feng, was quite scared of him due to his incredible speed and defense. Furthermore, he was able to conceal himself while Purple Bell was collecting the treasures post-explosion, so he probably had terrifying techniques. Taking this into consideration, he began making his preparations. After hearing that Luo Feng was hiding in the 26th camp, Purple Bell, unlike others on the 7th Battlefield, understood that Luo Feng was feigning weakness. One year later, after Luo Feng finished his preparations, he asked his Immortal King friends to search for Purple Bell, but it was his turn to wait for him to reveal himself.

After waiting for some time, he placed a bounty on Purple Bell, 50 million Mixed Yuan Units to anyone who could provide his location! Purple Bell, who had completed his preparations, paying King Heavy Arrow and King Blood Beast, two Limit Immortal Kings, to assist him in dealing with Luo Feng, was relaxed in the Automaton Race Virtual World. He paid them 5 billion Indigo Gems upfront and agreed to give each of them 1/3 of Luo Feng's wealth after they killed him. Following his plan, he pretended to be afraid, hiding outside of the Yan Ji Continent until he would purposely allow the Human Race camp to discover him. At that point, he planned to inform his two allies to immediately teleport to his location.

Per his plan, Purple Bell revealed his location, prompting an Immortal Marquis to share his location with Luo Feng. Through the assistance of King Cha Wu, Luo Feng teleported to Purple Bell's relative location and had Irina launch two attacks. After sensing Luo Feng's arrival, he wondered why hadn't moved, but then the incredible attacks from the Zerg Race mother nest, consisting of almost two million king World Masters, shocked Purple Bell into teleporting away. Seeing Luo Feng in the resulting crater, he continued to remain cautious, immediately calling King Heavy Arrow and King Blood Beast to teleport to the rough location, deciding against exchanging blows with Luo Feng alone.

The two exchanged mocking trash talk, then Heavy Arrow and Blood Beast arrived, activating their body amplification techniques and attacking Luo Feng. Luo Feng used Strikeout Through the Universe to rush at Purple Bell, then used the Space Lock Band to perform Lockdown on the surrounding 10,000 kilometers, preventing anyone from using Teleportation. Realizing this was not from Law of Space  comprehension, but rather from a Yan Ji Race treasure, Purple Bell informed Heavy Arrow and Blood Beast, exciting the two Limit Immortal Kings. The three then formed a combined attack, at which point Luo Feng revealed two Fire God Origin Crystals, each akin to 10 times a Pinnacle Immortal King's self-destruction, capable of possibly killing a Limit Immortal King! When the three had begun to flee, Luo Feng detonated the crystals, creating an incredible explosion and forcing everyone to use their best survival techniques. Purple Bell lost over 50% of his Divine Body, thinking that Luo Feng would also be unable to attack him, and thus was shocked when Luo Feng attacked with his new Poison Shadow Blade!

With the Poison Shadow Blade applying .72 drops of deadly Fei Mo Poison to his reforming Divine Body, Purple Bell knew he would die, so before dying he sent a mass message in the Automaton Race Virtual World, sharing Luo Feng's location in hopes that others would avenge him. In his final moments he laughed, then howled that he would not let Luo Feng off easy.

Due to the fact that while a part of the Automaton Race camp, he was not a member of the race, and he was only a Pinnacle Immortal King, not even a Limit Immortal King, it was unlikely that he would be resurrected. Even if he was chosen for resurrection, his ownership of the Demon-Sound Fire God Bell made resurrecting him akin to resurrecting a Universe Venerable, which would probably prevent the race from resurrecting him. His death and his mass message resulted in a larger battle in which Luo Feng killed 13 Immortal Kings, after which he gained the king name King Blade River.

Luo Feng acquired about 120 billion Mixed Yuan Units of treasure from killing King Purple Bell, not including the Heavy Treasure, Devil Note Fire God Clock!

Using his Heavy Treasure to defend himself, Purple Bell's attack went out with full force, forcing Cang Jin to self-destruct in response. The power of a Limit Immortal King self-destructing had to be seen to be believed, forcing Purple Bell to use all of his strength and his Heavy Treasure to redirect the force downwards to lessen the damage he received. The explosion created a 6,000 kilometer deep cave before dispersing, destroying everything but the most valuable treasures. Despite having to burn his Divine Body to control the explosion, the combination of his consumption and the explosion's damage only resulted in Purple Bell losing 26% of his Divine Body, which meant he was still strong enough to collect all of the treasures in the area.

Thinking that everyone else had died, Purple Bell began collecting the treasures in the area, but was unable to locate the Yan Ji Race treasure chest that was in the room. Attempting to locate it, as well as Luo Feng's treasures, he gathered everything in his Space Ring, but was surprised when an apparent metal fragment was unable to enter it. He stared wide-eyed as the fragment landed in the hand of Luo Feng! After the two exchanged barbs, Purple Bell attacked Luo Feng, forcing him to use Strikeout Through the Universe to escape. Hoping to kill him and prevent him from exposing his Heavy Treasure, Purple Bell chased after Luo Feng, but encountered his Golden Horned Beast Body, wearing the King Armor. Realizing that Luo Feng may have called the legendary Silver Winged King to help him, and thus may have called others, Purple Bell teleported away. In an icy location, Purple Bell resolved to kill Luo Feng to take the treasure he thought he had earned, the treasure of the Sacrificial Tower, and prevent Luo Feng from spreading the news about the Purple Bell Heavy Treasure.

While Luo Feng was selling the treasures he obtained from the battle, Purple Bell spread the rumor that Luo Feng acquired treasure from the Sacrificial Tower, hoping to root him out and make others hunt him down. From Purple Bell's perspective, if Luo Feng was too weak, he'd spread news of the Heavy Treasure Demon-Sound Fire God Bell, so he should force him out early and kill him. On the other hand, if Luo Feng felt he was strong enough to kill him and obtain his Heavy Treasure, he would still spread news of it, so Purple Bell should try to kill him even sooner! As a result, he made the first move. After hearing the news from King Mo Na, Luo Feng began to make his plans.

Purple Bell, while trying to locate Luo Feng, was quite scared of him due to his incredible speed and defense. Furthermore, he was able to conceal himself while Purple Bell was collecting the treasures post-explosion, so he probably had terrifying techniques. Taking this into consideration, he began making his preparations. After hearing that Luo Feng was hiding in the 26th camp, Purple Bell, unlike others on the 7th Battlefield, understood that Luo Feng was feigning weakness. One year later, after Luo Feng finished his preparations, he asked his Immortal King friends to search for Purple Bell, but it was his turn to wait for him to reveal himself.

After waiting for some time, he placed a bounty on Purple Bell, 50 million Mixed Yuan Units to anyone who could provide his location! Purple Bell, who had completed his preparations, paying King Heavy Arrow and King Blood Beast, two Limit Immortal Kings, to assist him in dealing with Luo Feng, was relaxed in the Automaton Race Virtual World. He paid them 5 billion Indigo Gems upfront and agreed to give each of them 1/3 of Luo Feng's wealth after they killed him. Following his plan, he pretended to be afraid, hiding outside of the Yan Ji Continent until he would purposely allow the Human Race camp to discover him. At that point, he planned to inform his two allies to immediately teleport to his location.

Per his plan, Purple Bell revealed his location, prompting an Immortal Marquis to share his location with Luo Feng. Through the assistance of King Cha Wu, Luo Feng teleported to Purple Bell's relative location and had Irina launch two attacks. After sensing Luo Feng's arrival, he wondered why hadn't moved, but then the incredible attacks from the Zerg Race mother nest, consisting of almost two million king World Masters, shocked Purple Bell into teleporting away. Seeing Luo Feng in the resulting crater, he continued to remain cautious, immediately calling King Heavy Arrow and King Blood Beast to teleport to the rough location, deciding against exchanging blows with Luo Feng alone.

The two exchanged mocking trash talk, then Heavy Arrow and Blood Beast arrived, activating their body amplification techniques and attacking Luo Feng. Luo Feng used Strikeout Through the Universe to rush at Purple Bell, then used the Space Lock Band to perform Lockdown on the surrounding 10,000 kilometers, preventing anyone from using Teleportation. Realizing this was not from Law of Space  comprehension, but rather from a Yan Ji Race treasure, Purple Bell informed Heavy Arrow and Blood Beast, exciting the two Limit Immortal Kings. The three then formed a combined attack, at which point Luo Feng revealed two Fire God Origin Crystals, each akin to 10 times a Pinnacle Immortal King's self-destruction, capable of possibly killing a Limit Immortal King! When the three had begun to flee, Luo Feng detonated the crystals, creating an incredible explosion and forcing everyone to use their best survival techniques. Purple Bell lost over 50% of his Divine Body, thinking that Luo Feng would also be unable to attack him, and thus was shocked when Luo Feng attacked with his new Poison Shadow Blade!

With the Poison Shadow Blade applying .72 drops of deadly Fei Mo Poison to his reforming Divine Body, Purple Bell knew he would die, so before dying he sent a mass message in the Automaton Race Virtual World, sharing Luo Feng's location in hopes that others would avenge him. In his final moments he laughed, then howled that he would not let Luo Feng off easy.

Due to the fact that while a part of the Automaton Race camp, he was not a member of the race, and he was only a Pinnacle Immortal King, not even a Limit Immortal King, it was unlikely that he would be resurrected. Even if he was chosen for resurrection, his ownership of the Demon-Sound Fire God Bell made resurrecting him akin to resurrecting a Universe Venerable, which would probably prevent the race from resurrecting him. His death and his mass message resulted in a larger battle in which Luo Feng killed 13 Immortal Kings, after which he gained the king name King Blade River.

Luo Feng acquired about 120 billion Mixed Yuan Units of treasure from killing King Purple Bell, not including the Heavy Treasure, Devil Note Fire God Clock!

characters.appearance: Her puppet body is a human body with an incredibly beautiful fox head, with an incredibly alluring gaze. Her real body looks similar.
characters.history: King Purple Sky is an Immortal King capable of Teleportation who leads the Purple Sky Team of Yan Ji Continent. She is one of the two Immortal Kings of the Demon Race located on the continent. She was tasked with killing Luo Feng due to having the ability to teleport. The plan was for her to immediately teleport to his revealed location, but despite her initial joy in receiving the mission, his location was never revealed.

He teamed up with Luo Feng, King Cang Qi, and King Tian Zhen and fought against a Demon Race camp team. characters.appearance: A gigantic silver-grey, snake-shaped monster with a triangular head.
characters.history: King Serkaphinse is an average 3rd-level Beast God heir, dwelling on Bauhinia Island. It served as Luo Feng's first opponent in the World of Glory. Before battling Luo Feng, it stated its goal was to win all of his points so that no other heirs could fight the legendary King Blade River. Despite its confidence, it was defeated in seconds after a few dozen moves from Luo Feng.

characters.title: King Seven Swords

infobox.master: Unnamed Universe Master from Huge Axe Dojo
infobox.affiliation: Hongmeng Huge Axe Dojo Ancestral God Sect

characters.introText: During the fight for the Sealed Star in the Extraterritorial Battlefield, you were so insignificant that I barely noticed you...what a surprise that you are a World Master...For the first time, you have my full attention. I want to see your strength...
characters.appearance: Dressed in ancient purple armor, he wore special black gloves on his hands. He carried seven different swords on his back and had a mark of seven swords on his forehead. He gave off an incredible amount of energy.
characters.history:
King Seven Swords is a Spirit Master who rose up from the Huge Axe Dojo and was absorbed as a core genius. He was the number 1 genius of his generation! While his talent and improvement speed weren't at the level of Kedi or Luo Feng, he was still higher than even someone like Bolan.

After breaking through to Immortal, he was taken in as a disciple by one of the Universe Masters of the Huge Axe Dojo, and within a few eras, he was close to Invincible Immortal King level. Together with the nurturing of the Human Race, the guidance from his teacher, his ability, and his special encounters, he became a legendary figure at the Immortal King level, comparable to a normal Universe Venerable. The Automaton Race had him listed as their Number 3 assassination target.

He was attacked by King Life Fall and the Automaton Race camp during the battle over the Sealed Star, but easily defended himself from the Decomposition Tower attack. Due to his importance and the value of the Sealed Star, he barely noticed Luo Feng at that moment, but due to Sky Wolf Master revealing that Luo Feng was King Blade River, he became interested in him as a rival of sorts.

King Seven Swords also followed the path of the Beast God, and was one of the heirs on Bauhinia Island, even obtaining a treasure from the Land of Treasures. While he was considered mediocre within the battles in the World of Glory, his Seven Sword Inheritance, Beast God Inheritance, his treasures, and his ability to survive made him intimidating in the real world. When Luo Feng accepted his 620,000 battles in the World of Glory, King Seven Swords personally came to meet him.

King Seven Swords also arrived when Luo Feng's body was killed by Venerable Mud Swallowing, realizing Luo Feng was the victim by noticing the remaining Shi Wu Wings.
characters.trivia: He takes the role of King Black Razor in the Donghua

characters.title: King Shiryo

infobox.species: Thousand Eye Heart Clan (千眼心族)

characters.introText: A 2 meter tall, 1 meter wide fat lifeform covered in scales. Many scales on its body had eyes, making it appear terrifying, and on its head was a huge gold eye.
characters.appearance: A 2 meter tall, 1 meter wide fat lifeform covered in scales. Many scales on its body had eyes, making it appear terrifying, and on its head was a huge gold eye.
characters.history:
King Shiryo (real name Momobu) is a Pinnacle Immortal King Spirit Master fighting in the Automaton Race camp in the Star Tower battlefield. He and King Jiu Jian were contacted by Ci Wei Ka when the latter sought to kill Luo Feng in his Golden Horned Beast Body.

A member of the powerful Thousand Eye Heart Clan, he had to join one of the four camps to have the right to enter the Extraterritorial Battlefield, since while his race is strong, it is not a pinnacle race. Momobu built a strong reputation on the battlefield as an absolute warrior proficient in Soul Attack, killing multiple Immortal Kings.

Ci Wei Ka convinced him to assist him in killing Luo Feng by offering 3 billion Indigo Gems in payment, plus a lot of the treasures that Luo Feng would leave behind. He also convinced Momobu to use God Country Transmission, despite the risk, explaining that they are allies and he wouldn't betray him, and he'd be the only one who knew the coordinates of Momobu's God Country. With Momobu on board, Ci Wei Ka also convinced King Jiu Jian to join the effort, which Momobu appreciated as it would increase the odds of success, but was frustrated when Luo Feng was teleported away by King Star Fantasy.

After King Graceful Black provided Luo Feng's coordinates to Ci Wei Ka and Jiu Jian, Momobu teleported to the space near Yan Ji Continent through God Country Transmission. Ci Wei Ka asked Jiu Jian to meet him and bring him to their current location, at which point Momobu asked where Luo Feng was. Shortly after his arrival, both Jiu Jian and Graceful Black felt the space ripples of teleportation and worked with Ci Wei Ka to attempt to pin down Luo Feng and Star Fantasy. Unfortunately for them, Luo Feng was able to easily evade them using the Shi Wu Wings and his flying techniques, causing the group to give up.

Ci Wei Ka compensated both Jiu Jian and Momobu about 200 million Indigo Gems for their efforts.

characters.title: King Silkworm Rain
characters.introText: A short, white-bearded human man with snow-white hair.
characters.appearance: A short, white-bearded human man with snow-white hair.
characters.history: King Silkworm Rain is one of the Limit Immortal Kings of the Human Race who participated in the battle over the Sealed Star with Luo Feng.

characters.title: King Skeleton Needle
characters.introText: The face is ugly, about three meters tall, the whole body is covered with black cuticles, and there are eight soft black tentacles hanging from the edge of the face, and the pair of small eyes squeezed by the cuticles shoot out a cold light.
characters.appearance: The face is ugly, about three meters tall, the whole body is covered with black cuticles, and there are eight soft black tentacles hanging from the edge of the face, and the pair of small eyes squeezed by the cuticles shoot out a cold light.
characters.history: King Skeleton Needle is a Limit Immortal King of great renown on the 7th Battlefield. His fame comes not from his strength or his race, but because he is the Soul Slave of Nan Cheng, one of the 9 terrifying beings of the 7th Battlefield. He has the strongest defense of her soul slaves, so she normally uses him to move around, while she and her army stay hidden within a World Ring.

characters.title: King Sky Feather
characters.introText: He has long golden yellow hair, one pair of eyes that appear deep blue, and on his forehead a vertical golden eye. He has a high nose bridge, thin lips.
characters.appearance: He has long golden yellow hair, one pair of eyes that appear deep blue, and on his forehead a vertical golden eye. He has a high nose bridge, thin lips.
characters.history: An Invincible Immortal King at the Virtual Universe Company, he is stationed at the Sky Feather Palace near the Devil Mountain to look over the Nine Star Ocean and surrounding space. He practices the Universe Primal Chaos Tablet, the hardest tablet of the 52 to comprehend. His strength is on par with King Zhenyan.

characters.title: King Snow Horn
characters.introText: A monkey-like creature with snow-white fur and a pointed nose.
characters.appearance: A monkey-like creature with snow-white fur and a pointed nose.
characters.history:
King Snow Horn was a Limit Immortal King who was part of the Human Race camp at the 7th Battlefield. He was one of those who received King Tian Zhen's distress message as he was being attacked by Luo Feng and his Soul Slaves. As a Limit Immortal King, Snow Horn had the most expensive Scanning Device of the group that showed up, and he detected Luo Feng's device.

While a member of the Human Race camp, Snow Horn was not a member of Hongmeng, so when he learned that Luo Feng had retired from the army, he refused to disperse his Lockdown technique. Seeking to obtain Luo Feng's treasures, he shared with the gathered team that Luo Feng had retired, prompting those who were also not part of Hongmeng to attack Luo Feng.

The group was unsuccessful in their attack, and Luo Feng destroyed 35% of Snow Horn's Divine Body by using the Star Map, 6 Sealed Stars, and his Sky Tearing Claw technique. Before Luo Feng could kill him, however, King Black Razor interfered, seeking to test his strength. After Luo Feng escaped Black Razor, he once again attacked Snow Horn, forcing him to self-destruct to avoid being made a soul slave. As a Limit Immortal King, he knew that it was almost certain that he would be resurrected in the future with Time and Space Reversal, but that if he was forced into a Deep Sleep and taken away, there would be no such chance.

characters.title: King Sorrow Demon
characters.introText: King Sorrow Demon is one of the Pinnacle Immortal King Spirit Master Soul Slaves enslaved by Luo Feng during his battles around Star Tower. Along with King Honed Heart and Qu Can, they used their strength to forcibly subdue King Tian Zhen so Luo Feng could enslave him.
characters.appearance: Described simply as 'beautiful.'

characters.title: King Star Fantasy

infobox.family: King Ye Chen (Brother of the same Subspecies)

characters.introText: More than ten meters tall, with misty wings, a seductive figure, a translucent body, armor as thin as gauze, beautiful and crystal-clear long hair, and a pair of deep eyes like the sea.
characters.appearance: More than ten meters tall, with misty wings, a seductive figure, a translucent body, armor as thin as gauze, beautiful and crystal-clear long hair, and a pair of deep eyes like the sea.
characters.history: King Star Fantasy is a non-human Immortal King member of the human camp on the Extraterritorial Battlefield. Luo Feng befriended her with his Golden Horned Beast Body and would call her through the Virtual Universe if he got in trouble and needed to teleport. She would teleport him for 10 million Mixed Yuan Units, considering it an easy way to make money. She was very impressed with the beast's flying ability, not knowing that it was mostly due to the Shi Wu Wings.
characters.trivia: In the donghua, she is a Human and the sister of King Ye Chen

characters.title: King Thousand Illusions
characters.introText: A blurry man in a black robe, his appearance is illusory.
characters.appearance: A blurry man in a black robe, his appearance is illusory.
characters.history: King Thousand Illusions is one of the four 9 Universe Sub-sect leaders who belong to the Virtual Universe Company and lives in Primal Chaos City, along with King Zhenyan, King Flame Dragon, and King Brilliant Sword. As such, he has passed at least the 18th level of the 9 Universe Tong Tian Bridge. He acknowledged Luo Feng's talent when he beat the 3rd level of the bridge, confirming that he comprehended the 1st blade form of Floating Blood in 10 years. He also noted that Luo Feng's improvement speed matched Bolan's, despite Bolan having an initial lead. He hoped that Luo Feng would choose him as his teacher.

characters.title: King Thousand Rain

infobox.friends: Luo Feng King Cha Man King Li Shuo

characters.introText: He is handsome with a slightly translucent body, wearing turquoise armor.
characters.appearance: He is handsome with a slightly translucent body, wearing turquoise armor.
characters.history: King Thousand Rain is a friend that Luo Feng made while on Bauhinia Island. He is a Limit Immortal King and a member of the Hongmeng from the Dark Mist Race. He is slightly weaker than King Cha Man and King Li Shuo.

characters.title: King Tian Zhen

infobox.slave: King Chi Mang King Wu La King Roaring Heaven Devil Shell Monkey

characters.introText: A three-eyed man with long brown hair. He has very long eyebrows that make him look very serious all the time.
characters.appearance: A three-eyed man with long brown hair. He has very long eyebrows that make him look very serious all the time.
characters.personality: Tian Chen had a hard life and faced a lot of adversity, making him have a special view of the world.  Anyone who interacted with him would think he was not a bad person, he passionately made friends with a large group of people.  However, on the inside, he was a patient schemer!  He was very cautious and would not make his move until he was certain of success.
characters.history:
Tian Chen grew up around the same time as King Ye Chen, and they were both core members of the Huge Axe Dojo. While they had always been rivals, they had a deep and complicated relationship, resulting in Ye Chen contacting him when King Cang Jin killed him.  During Luo Feng's time in the human army, he and Tian Chen became friends.

Within Star Tower, when one of the Sealed Stars was about to fall, he called other Limit Immortal Kings in the vicinity and formed an alliance with over 1,000 allies to increase their chances of obtaining the Sealed Star.  Additionally, within this alliance, he gathered the other 8 humans and ensured their unity.

When the Sealed Star erupted, he used the chaotic battle to lure Luo Feng in so he could kill him and steal his treasures. However, Luo Feng broke free of his illusion. Fortunately for Tian Chen, Luo Feng's counterattack was interrupted by Star Tower sucking him through an exit.

Before the eruption of the Sealed Star, he had already obtained 3 powerful Soul Slaves: King Awn Mountain Demon, a Demon Race Pinnacle Immortal King proficient in soul attacks, King Mist Terapon Theraps, a Limit Immortal King, and another unnamed Limit Immortal King. He also has other Immortal Marquis-level Soul Slaves such as the demon race's Devil Shell Monkey.

About 6,000 years after he betrayed Luo Feng, with the help of King Yong Yan he was found and attacked by Luo Feng and his Soul Slaves, resulting in his soul enslavement directly at the hands of Luo Feng.
characters.trivia: This character, 天阵王, who was introduced before the Sealed Star mini-arc and was enslaved, may be different from 天尘王 who was introduced after the Sacrificial Tower mini-arc, but there is not quite enough context, so for now the two characters are merged.

characters.title: King Tie Bi
characters.introText: King Tie Bi is an Immortal King friend of King Bloodthirsty. King Bloodthirsty carried his coordinate marker and arranged for him to wait at the 9th Teleportation Point of the Primal Secret Realm to assist him rescuing Luo Feng and Dylan from King Nightmare Candle and his allies. Venerable Nine Swords' army, led by King Longyu,  met with Tie Bi before teleporting to Earth.
characters.history: King Tie Bi is an Immortal King friend of King Bloodthirsty. King Bloodthirsty carried his coordinate marker and arranged for him to wait at the 9th Teleportation Point of the Primal Secret Realm to assist him rescuing Luo Feng and Dylan from King Nightmare Candle and his allies. Venerable Nine Swords' army, led by King Longyu,  met with Tie Bi before teleporting to Earth.

characters.title: King Tong Nan
characters.introText: Skinny but with a powerful silhouette, he has a pale complexion. He wears white armor and has two black horns. The space around him seemed to be warping, and as he is blind, his eyes were closed.
characters.appearance: Skinny but with a powerful silhouette, he has a pale complexion. He wears white armor and has two black horns. The space around him seemed to be warping, and as he is blind, his eyes were closed.
characters.history:
A powerful Immortal King with high authority within the Virtual Universe Company, he used to be teammates with King Zhenyan and King Longyu. They are eternal life and death friends who have explored secret regions together! There was a trace of romance between he and King Longyu, but they never acted upon it. He appears to have even more money than King Zhenyan.

He complimented King Zhenyan on Luo Feng's growth within the Primal Chaos City.

characters.title: King White Bone
characters.introText: About 3 meters tall, he is fiery-red and covered with bony spurs. He wears a scarlet mask and has one giant eye. When he changes to his fighting form, his bony spurs contract and his body increases in height. His color changes from red to silvery-white, with armor made of twisted bones.
characters.appearance: About 3 meters tall, he is fiery-red and covered with bony spurs. He wears a scarlet mask and has one giant eye. When he changes to his fighting form, his bony spurs contract and his body increases in height. His color changes from red to silvery-white, with armor made of twisted bones.
characters.history:
King White Bone is one of the 10 Limit Immortal Kings with power close to Invincible Immortal King trapped in Ice Prison, ranked 11th of all combatants by Si Bo Wa. He is the first of the top 15 of Ice Prison to fight Luo Feng, and he was strong enough to force him to retreat, destroying his One Line Whip Shadow attack that used 8 Sealed Stars. Luo Feng considered his power the match of King Black Razor's, but even more terrifying.

Due to being trapped in Ice Prison for eternity, King White Bone was pleased to have strong and special combatants like Luo Feng to liven things up. He complimented Luo Feng, calling him the fastest in Ice Prison, resulting in Si Bo Wa ranking Luo Feng at 18 and noting his speed.

Luo Feng's fight with King White Bone showed him that he was underestimating those trapped in Ice Prison, thinking they would be weak due to lacking treasures.

He possesses a pair of gloves on his claws that serve as the only treasure he has.

characters.title: King Wood Jade
characters.introText: A dark-skinned human with long hair resembling a tree canopy. He has snow-white teeth.
characters.appearance: A dark-skinned human with long hair resembling a tree canopy. He has snow-white teeth.

characters.title: King Wu La
characters.introText: King Wu La is a Limit Immortal King Soul Slave of King Tian Zhen. Originally of the Demon Race camp at the 7th Battlefield, Mist Terapon Theraps was soul-controlled through the combined efforts of Tian Zhen and his soul slave, King Chi Mang.
characters.history:
King Wu La is a Limit Immortal King Soul Slave of King Tian Zhen. Originally of the Demon Race camp at the 7th Battlefield, Mist Terapon Theraps was soul-controlled through the combined efforts of Tian Zhen and his soul slave, King Chi Mang.

After Luo Feng made Tian Zhen his soul slave, King Wu La became one of his soul slaves as well.

characters.title: King Yan Long
characters.introText: An old man covered in green scales, with a long beard.
characters.appearance: An old man covered in green scales, with a long beard.
characters.history: King Yan Long is a Pinnacle Immortal King of the Virtual Universe Company, specializing in Law of Space  and Law of Gold . As a result, Luo Feng attended his classes when he started training in the Beast God 7 Kills. In terms of strength, he was close to King Zhenyan.

characters.title: King Ye Chen

infobox.family: King Star Fantasy (Sister of the same Subspecies)
infobox.enemies: Automaton Race Zerg Race Demon Race Ci Wei Ka King Purple Bell King Cang Jin

characters.introText: He wears a dark red armor and has gold eyes and wings.
characters.appearance: He wears a dark red armor and has gold eyes and wings.
characters.history:
King Ye Chen was a Human Pinnacle Immortal King who could use Teleportation. He was known to be intrepid and brutal, not easily recognizing others, but once he did, he was straightforward and easy to get along with. Luo Feng made friends with him after sparring with him several times, so he was called upon to assist in retrieving the treasures from the Sacrificial Tower.

After calling together Luo Feng and King Piercing Tiger, the three of them met with Ice Blade and his teammates, King Purple Bell and King Cang Jin. In the battles over the treasure, he was forced to self-destruct after King Cang Jin used his true power to instantly destroy 50% of his Divine Body.

characters.title: King Yin Ge
characters.introText: Similar to an Earthling, but with thicker body hair and eyes like blades.
characters.appearance: Similar to an Earthling, but with thicker body hair and eyes like blades.
characters.history:
King Yin Ge is an Immortal King and the sales manager of the Wu Long Starfield representing the Universe Mercenary Alliance. Like the other sales managers, Yin Ge typically defers to King Nightmare Candle, and does so when Nightmare Candle decides to interrogate Luo Feng.

When Luo Feng returns to Wu Long Starfield as a World Master direct disciple of Primal Chaos City Leader, Yin Ge asks King Long Jue to ease Luo Feng's anger towards the managers who did not stick up for him.

characters.title: King Yong Yan
characters.introText: Dressed in a purple armor with short purple hair, her eyes were glowing blue.
characters.appearance: Dressed in a purple armor with short purple hair, her eyes were glowing blue.
characters.history:
She is a High Immortal King, and a member of Hongmeng. She is one of the members of a powerful group within the Hongmeng. This group is proficient in Information and Investigation, and its unique quality was that all members are females. It is said that the leader of this group is one of the Palace Masters of the Hongmeng.

Luo Feng asked for her help in locating Tian Chen, in return she got 100 Million Mixed Units. She understood that with Luo Feng's strength, it was better to stay on good terms with him. She also warned him when she received messages from Tian Chen detailing his predicament, informing him of an approaching large group who sought the two Heavy Treasures.

characters.title: King Yu Liang
characters.introText: A skinny skeleton-like human with eyes like 2 balls of flames, his chin had a goat's beard and he wore a golden robe.  Holding 2 golden round balls that he fiddled with, his laughter was strange, piercing, and cold.
characters.appearance: A skinny skeleton-like human with eyes like 2 balls of flames, his chin had a goat's beard and he wore a golden robe.  Holding 2 golden round balls that he fiddled with, his laughter was strange, piercing, and cold.
characters.personality: Unlike King Zhenyan, who is direct and straightforward, intrepid in reputation, King Yu Liang is known for being evil and treacherous, even sinister.
characters.history:
He treats King Zhenyan as his rival, so he can't help but to poke and prod and provoke him whenever he has a chance. When his disciple Mo Luo backstabs Luo Feng at Devil Mountain, he brings him to King Zhenyan to tell his false story of how Luo Feng backstabbed him.

Mo Luo doesn't respect him because everyone knows he's treacherous, while Mo Luo wants his treachery to always be a surprise, as it was to Luo Feng.

characters.title: King Zhenjia
characters.introText: A towering steel being, with a pair of eyes like two burning fireballs more terrifying than billions of stars. Their voice sounded like the clashing of metal.
characters.appearance: A towering steel being, with a pair of eyes like two burning fireballs more terrifying than billions of stars. Their voice sounded like the clashing of metal.
characters.history:
King Zhenjia was the greatest leader and king of the Fire Source Race, a True God from the First Reincarnation Era. At some point in the past, King Zhenjia, Great Thunder Star Master, and Qiu Yan Ancestral God encountered a powerful Sector Beast, giving them the choice of surrendering or death. Choosing to surrender, they became slaves to the Sector Beasts, slowly manipulating events in Universe Ocean, eventually encountering Huge Axe Creator and causing his death.

Although not stated in the novel, it is implied that he was most likely killed by either Luo Feng or Morosa in order to prevent the Universe Ocean from finding out that Luo Feng hadn't killed all the sector beasts and had instead enslaved Morosa.

characters.introText: I've been in Primal Chaos City for hundreds of millions of years. I wonder if anyone remembers me.
characters.appearance: A tall and sturdy Apeman from the Ka Hun Si Clan, with golden fur on his face and dressed in golden armor. His eyes seemed like they could see through space itself.
characters.personality: King Zhenyan is very direct, with an explosive temper, and unafraid of anything. Due to his straightforward nature, natural strength, and brutal means of dealing with his opposition, he has made a number of enemies in the universe. However, despite this, his forthright actions, integrity, and willingness to do anything for those about whom he cared have placed multiple others in his debt and he could count many strong characters among his friends. He is very sincere and close to his disciples, treating them like his own children, and this character was well-known in Primal Chaos City.
characters.history:
As an Invincible Immortal King, King Zhenyan was able to escape from and even fight ordinary Universe Venerables! His Life Gene Level of 10, combined with his reaching the 4th level of the Way of the Beast God and his 3 Pinnacle Techniques made him nearly unbeatable among Immortal Kings. Following the Warrior path, he understood the importance of defending against Soul Attacks and illusions, and his most powerful Pinnacle Technique was a soul defense technique. His strength at the Immortal King level was such that he could find no challenge in the Extraterritorial Battlefield! Even if he was attacked with Fei Mo Poison, it would take 100 drops to kill him, and he'd detect the first couple of drops and prevent the others from touching his Divine Body, making the poison useless against him.

After completing the 4th level of the Way of the Beast God, he became a Universe Venerable capable of surviving battle with the Advanced Universe Venerable Wan Feng! By following the training guides of the ancient civilization, he eventually reached the limit Universe Venerable level, then broke through to Universe Master. Despite his talents, as an ordinary Universe Master, he was unable to assist in the Sector Beast War.

characters.introText: A bewitchingly handsome youth, with fox-like eyes. He had a shrill voice.
characters.appearance: A bewitchingly handsome youth, with fox-like eyes. He had a shrill voice.
characters.history:
Ku Yan was one of the geniuses trained at the Immortal Temple, a few generations after Ba Qi. During Luo Feng's time on Blood River World, 2 of Ku Yan's guards discovered historical remnants in a nearby river and alerted him. Ku Yan scanned the river and acquired the treasures, noting that while the Beast God Statue had no value to him, the Immortal Temple would award him greatly for giving it to them.

As a World Master who trained at the Immortal Temple, he looked up to Ba Qi somewhat and wanted to meet him, so he accompanied Yu Ke on his trip to give Ba Qi more Blood River Medals.

Bringing along the Beast God Statue that his guards found, he showed it to Ba Qi and Qi Niu, captivating everyone in attendance, including Luo Feng. Unfortunately for Ku Yan, Luo Feng determined that the statue was necessary for his Golden Horned Beast Body's training, so he used the Star Annihilator Cannon from his Earth Automaton Ship to kill Ku Yan and Yu Ke, then proceeded to retrieve the statue.

characters.title: Kui Mo Ancestor
characters.introText: Kui Mo Ancestor is one of the Primogenitors Beings from the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction who participated in the war between Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction and Cultivator Camp. In the battle against the cultivator Lords, Kui Mo Ancestor was one of the eleven severely injured Primogenitors Beings who barely survived after being struck by Ming Huang Lord’s lightning. While trying to retreat and seek protection, Kui Mo Ancestor was split in half by Luo Feng’s blade. Critically wounded, Kui Mo Ancestor attempted to take refuge within The Original Ancestor, who could shield others only in extreme cases during war. However, a giant time-space hand suddenly descended, grabbing both Kui Mo Ancestor and the surrounding space. In desperation, Kui Mo Ancestor merged into light and escaped the space seal, flying into the body of Endless Ancestor for shelter.

characters.title: Kun Sha Luo
characters.introText: A pale and expressionless man with purple eyes. He has an additional vertical eye on his forehead. His aura was similar to that of an extremely gentle lady, but his eye on his forehead occasionally gave off a bone-chilling, heart-palpitating feeling.
characters.appearance: A pale and expressionless man with purple eyes. He has an additional vertical eye on his forehead. His aura was similar to that of an extremely gentle lady, but his eye on his forehead occasionally gave off a bone-chilling, heart-palpitating feeling.
characters.history:
Kun Sha Luo is an Immortal serving under the Lord of Ganwu. He was personally sent by the Lord of Ganwu to tell Luo Feng that even if he did not make it into the top 1,000 of the Pinnacle Genius Battle, and thus did not make it into the Virtual Universe Company, he would still be able to enter the Ganwu Secret Region to receive the best nurturing and training they could offer. He advised Luo Feng not to get his hopes up about reaching the top 1,000 of the genius battle, then disappeared without a farewell. Babata noted that the offer was a good one, and that considering Luo Feng's ability at the time, it was the most realistic path for him.

Some time before the Pinnacle Genius Battle, Kun Sha Luo sold Meng Huo and his disciples a fake map to a Secret Region, resulting in Wo Te's eventual death and earning the eternal ire of Meng Huo. Meng Huo stated that he would definitely kill him if he did not hide under the Lord of Ganwu's protection for the rest of his life.

characters.appearance: A tall figure covered in black hair, with blood-colored eyes.
characters.history:
Lai Mo was an Eternal True God living in Hu Yang City, a Vice President of the Dark Force Blood Python Guild. He was especially angry when Luo Feng lost control during Dream Flower Tower Master's performance in the Hundred Flowers Banquet.

After Luo Feng stopped Moli Lian's pursuit of Alaya, Lai Mo confronted him, and after attempting to use the name of the Blood Python Guild to force Luo Feng to pay 10,000 Universe Sands, the two fought. Luo Feng easily defeated him, seizing his True God's Heart and threatening to kill him, prompting Mu Yang to arrive and settle the score by paying 20,000 Universe Sands.

His strength and skills were at a similar level to Hei Duo Mo.

Lai Mo was easily killed by Luo Feng when the latter attacked the Blood Python Guild headquarters. Despite attempting to escape at full speed, he was easily intercepted and his True God's Heart was destroyed.

As a Domain Master, he earned the Huge Axe Warrior title, which is exceptionally rare. Despite coming from a different Starfield than Luo and Molly, the three got along extremely well, becoming life-and-death comrades! Since all three were Huge Axe Warriors, they built the organization Three Axe Mountain. In the beginning, Lament and Molly assisted Luo, who was the leader. Later, he and Molly both became Immortal, while Luo remained a World Master, focused on his own goals.

characters.history:
Lan Ran is one of the over 10 Planetary Level cultivators of Chinese descent, called 'Ice Blade' due to his proficiency with ice. He peacefully lives in seclusion in Jiangnan City and in major events assists the military and the country.

He stopped the conflict in Jiangnan City between Luo Feng, Venina Paulinus, and Li Yao, reminding Luo Feng of the rules of the Palace of Gods of War. One of these rules is the prohibition of killing a fighter in a headquarter city, which Luo Feng was about to break, which would get him the death penalty. Additionally, due to the bombs set by Venina, it would result in the deaths of tens of thousands of Chinese citizens, including children and babies.

Lan Ran's interference reminded Luo Feng that there were legal channels he could use to kill Venina and Li Yao.

As one of the top-20, he had stepped into the gateway of two Original Laws, but they were not specified. By winning in the round of 20, he made the top-10, where he lost to Wu Ka. It is unknown who won between the 2 of them, but had Lei En won, he/she would have faced off against the victor of the "Bai Lin Duo Ke vs an unknown competitor match" in the 2nd round.

If Lei En had won the 2nd round once more, he/she would have to face off against Rong Jun but he/she would then have lost the match and be sent to the losers bracket where his/her final standing would remain unknown.

When Fu Wei Sa's team was killed by Tai Wo's team, he reached out to Lei Ke Ya for assistance, hoping he could contact Meng Wei Na. Knowing the value that the Demon Race placed on killing Human Race geniuses, Fu Wei Sa was confident that he could convince Meng Wei Na to lead them in killing Luo Feng and the rest of Tai Wo's team.

Lei Ke Ya contacted Meng Wei Na, and, as Fu Wei Sa thought, Meng Wei Na was convinced to lead them in battle against Tai Wo's team. Unfortunately for them, they were unaware of Luo Feng's true strength and were devoured by his Immortal Star Eating Plant.
