characters.introText:
Also known as Thor or Thunder God (in Donghua translation version).
雷神 léi shén: literally translated as God of Thunder. However, 雷 léi is also a common surname in China and personal names should not be translated.
characters.appearance:
In the novel, he is a bald monk dressed in white.

In the donghua, he has short brown hair, but otherwise looks similar to a monk. He has a blue crystal on his forehead.
characters.personality:
Thunder God is a relaxed individual, full of jokes. Despite having similar mental strength, he has a completely different personality from Hong. He is affable and shows more emotion than Hong, and his joking nature leads to many funny moments between he, Hong, and Luo Feng.

Despite being a jokester, when circumstances require seriousness, he shows incredible resolve and courage. During the battle with the Golden Horned Beast, he was willing to sacrifice himself for the planet, continuing to fight even after losing the lower half of his body. He had no problem killing an Earthling who was not working for the betterment of the species, and he holds grudges, as seen by his reaction to Luo Di's rudeness to the trio. For all of his differences with Hong, they share extremely high expectations of themselves, and a strict commitment to hard work.

Luo Feng does not consider him as reliable as Hong, but he thinks the same of himself.
characters.history:
Thunder God was born before the Great Nirvana to a Chinese father and an Indian mother. His father was a Yoga master who once went to India to study yoga, where he met Thunder God's mother and later returned to China. Training under his father from a young age, he had pretty good yoga, and due to the influence of movies and television, he grew to love Chinese martial arts. With the combination of his skills in yoga and Chinese martial arts, he built a reputation in martial arts circles as the 'Thunder Madman' (雷疯子(Léi fēngzi)), a powerful and competitive mixed-blood youngster.

The Great Nirvana was a period of great upheavals and turmoil on Earth. Many Earthlings died and many cities were destroyed by the attacks of Mutant Beasts. Thunder God fought to save humanity, and killed the most famous and horrifying monster of 2015, the Blood Demon Sky Wolf. While battling these monsters and protecting humanity, he combined his Chinese martial arts and Yoga to create the body and blade technique, Nine Stage Thunder Blade.

During this time, he met his future life-and-death brother, Hong. The two trained and fought together, challenging their limits and growing stronger at an incredibly rapid pace. They both broke through to Planetary Level during the Great Nirvana, with Thunder God progressing further due to his body's strength, speed, durability, and muscle usage, while Hong maintained a greater overall strength due to his perception and tactical acumen. Thunder God had great respect for Hong, exclaiming that even in the most dire situations, he always made the impossible possible. By the end of the Great Nirvana, Thunder God was the second-strongest Earthling, trailing only Hong.

As the second-strongest Earthling, Thunder God was more powerful than anyone on Earth other than Hong. Like Hong, he was more important than an entire country; his authority had surpassed the restrictions of the normal world. He could even kill a fellow Planetary Level fighter without consequence! With his power, he had more money than he could spend, and with one phrase, he could even shake the entire HR Alliance.

Rather than joining Hong in creating the Extreme Martial Club, he created a rival organization, the Thunder Dojo, with locations all around the world. While it was less powerful than the Extreme Martial Club, it competed with it on every level, fighting over talented prospects, resources, and prestige. Like Hong, he turned a blind eye to his subordinates competing with the Extreme Martial Club, recognizing the benefits of competition.

He worked with Hong and created the Palace of Gods of War, a virtual gathering place for the strongest Earthlings. Alongside Hong, Thunder God presided over affairs between the most powerful fighters on Earth. He sometimes went to the Elite Training Camp to teach young talents, and offered to take on the most talented as his disciple.

During this period, Thunder God had his daughter, Lei Lei. His partner died early in Lei Lei's life, so he raised her on his own, spoiling and pampering her. When she was 16, Thunder God killed her first love, with the implication being that he had harmed her in some way. His daughter, extremely angry with her father's actions, left home, leaving behind cruel words and not speaking to him for about 16 years. In the Donghua this was changed to him disagreeing with their marriage. Lei Lei and her boyfriend thus eloped and cut contact with Thunder God.

After presiding over the trial of Li Yao and Venina Paulinus, Thunder God and Hong discussed Luo Feng's efforts to kill Li Yao, who had broken through to Planetary Level, noting that he had high potential and could possibly help them in the future. He expressed concern with Luo Feng's courage in attacking someone that far ahead of him. He was shocked when he learned from his subordinate, Amuhan, that Luo Feng killed Li Yao, and joined Hong in reminding the representatives present that if any of them acted against humanity, they would have no problem killing them!

He then met Luo Feng for the first time, with the three discussing the Soaring Shuttle and how Luo Feng knew how to use it so well. Revealing that he and Hong had discovered the Soaring Shuttle and spent a lot of time trying to use it, he hoped for more details from Luo Feng. After Luo Feng left, Thunder God noted that he thought he was hiding something, prompting Hong to speak on their efforts to break through to the Stellar Level. The pair, unrivaled on Earth, understood how insignificant they were in the universe and were committed to improving their strength so they could protect their fellow Earthlings.

Immediately after their discussion, Thunder God and Hong were informed by Allure of a change at the Misty Island. Thunder God was shocked, remembering that that was where Hong acquired the Cloud Vine.

On the day Luo Feng would become an Inspector, Thunder God and Hong traveled to the Misty Island, spending the trip discussing the treasures on the island and the upcoming battle with the Beast Emperor, Tentacle Beast. The two agreed not to fight each other over the treasures, with Hong stating that it would be up to luck. After remarking on Hong's greed, Thunder God accompanied him to the Extreme Martial Club's World Headquarters for Luo Feng's Inspector Ceremony. The trio headed to the Misty Island after the ceremony.

Upon arriving at the island, Thunder God noted that the Tentacle Beast would be at its strongest in the water, and asked Hong if just having the Cloud Vine gave him the confidence to win in this second battle with the beast. After Hong stated he was three times more confident in his chances since he had the vine, he also noted that without killing the beast, there was no way for them to get the island's treasures. Thunder God laughed that Hong killing the beast would help the five countries, the HR Alliance, and himself, prompting Hong to again state that acquiring the treasures relies on luck, fate, and destiny. Thunder God then stayed behind and watched Hong defeat the Tentacle Beast, marveling at his strength. When Hong simply nodded after Thunder God acknowledged his strength, he joked that Hong wasn't even a little modest.

The assembled representatives and Gods of War then explored the island for treasure, with Luo Feng and Mo Henderson discovering a Muya Crystal. Thunder God later appeared, noting that Luo Feng was Hong's lucky star, then examined the split head of the Earth Dragon King with Hong. After the discussion determined that the treasure was a Muya Crystal, Thunder God noted that the identity of the treasure was stated intentionally, then began searching for crystals like the others. He obtained at least 2 Muya Crystals.

After America was attacked by the Golden Horned Beast, Thunder God joined Hong, Mo Henderson, and other representatives and country leaders to discuss the crisis. While initially he wasn't too fearful of the beast, once he saw that it was unharmed by the Laser Cannons, even he felt true fear. He and Hong discussed the chances of Hong defeating a Stellar Level 1 swallowing beast, with Hong expressing some hope due to his strength and the Cloud Vine. He watched with Hong and the others as the autojets launched the atomic and hydrogen bomb attack and failed to kill the beast.

With humanity's greatest weapons ineffective, Thunder God and Hong hid in the training room of the Extreme Martial Club's spaceship, with Hong helping Thunder God comprehend Domain. The two of them were pleased with Luo Feng's strength as he defeated the Eight-Clawed Beast Emperor. Noting that he and Hong had been life-and-death brothers for a few dozen years, Thunder God stated that it was unimaginable for the pair to retreat in the face of this disaster. The pair agreed to risk their lives to defeat the beast. Standing side-by-side, they announced to the most powerful people on Earth their intentions to fight to the death, but were interrupted when Luo Feng suggested that he had a guaranteed way to kill the beast: the Black Dragon Mountain X81 Laser Cannon.

Thunder God joined Hong, Jia Yi, and others on Luo Feng's balcony, watching as the Black Dragon Mountain Spaceship Guard fired the laser cannon at the beast, destroying its head. Thunder God poured wine for the assembled, and began to celebrate when the top half of the beast's head was blown off. He, like the others, were shocked when the beast rushed into the ocean, clearly still alive. Thunder God and Hong, noting that the beast should be a lot weaker now that it was damaged by the laser, once again agreed to risk it all to kill the beast.

Thunder God recorded a video for his daughter, Lei Lei, stating that he promised her mother that he would protect her, and that following that promise, he was going out to battle the Golden Horned Beast. He received an armor and blade forged by Babata from Luo Feng (through Hong's children), and was impressed with the blade's sturdiness and balance. He and Hong then flew above the sea, tracing the beast's life force to confront it, eventually fighting it above the Pacific Ocean. With the entire world watching, Thunder God jokingly wondered how many people were watching them, and Hong noted that even in a time like this, Thunder God maintained his mischievous face that he had had for decades.

Encountering the Golden Horned Beast, the pair began to use Soul Immolation and Domain, frantically attacking the beast. After Hong sealed the beast's swallowing ability by releasing tons of metal and hydrogen bombs, the pair used their strongest attacks, with Hong drilling a hole in the beast's abdomen. At that moment, the beast attacked Thunder God, reducing his body into minced meat from the waist down, but even in this state, he wrapped lightning around his lower half and entered the beast's abdomen with Hong, attacking the beast from the inside. The pair used their full remaining strength but were unable to kill the beast, falling through the hole in its stomach toward the ocean, but were protected by the Silverium Guards. Babata noted that the pair hadn't died, but due to their use of Soul Immolation, they fell into a Deep Sleep. After Luo Feng defeated the Golden Horned Beast, Thunder God was among the Eight Heroes memorialized for their sacrifice.

Thunder God and Hong remained in a Deep Sleep at the Extreme Martial Club headquarters after Luo Feng reappeared in his new Earthling Body. The pair finally woke up in Spring 2062, and met with Luo Feng shortly after awakening. Thanking Luo Feng for defeating the Golden Horned Beast and resolving the issues caused by Atkin, Sago Nehru, and Yan Hai, Thunder God and Hong acknowledged Luo Feng as their third brother. The trio decided to work harder to get stronger and break through to the Stellar Level. Luo Feng convinced Babata to accept Thunder God and Hong as Yun Mo Planet Sect disciples, allowing them to access better training methods.

In the summer of 2062, Thunder God, jealous of Luo Feng for killing the Thunder Dragon Emperor, sparred with him but was forced to submit under the attack of the Swordfish Formation. With his training in the Yun Mo Planet Sect's secret manuals, he had broken through to Planetary Level 9, with a one layer Domain. Thunder God noted that in addition to Hong, who had always been stronger than him, now there was Luo Feng, who was so much younger but also stronger than him.

Upon Luo Feng's return to Earth from Horned Dragon Planet, he, Hong, and Thunder God discussed plans to increase the Earth's strength. Thunder God and Hong were shocked to hear that in the universe, even Stellar Level fighters were enslaved. Agreeing to keep Luo Feng's slave army a secret, they decided to meet with the leaders of Earth and detailed the weakness of Earth and their plans for the future.

Two years after the Golden Horned Beast Earth Incident, Thunder God and Hong awoke from their Deep Sleep. Upon awakening, Hong contacted Luo Feng and the three met at the Extreme Martial Club headquarters. After commending Luo Feng's actions against Atkin, Sago Nehru, and Yan Hai, Hong shared with him he and Thunder God's decision to add Luo Feng to their life-and-death brotherhood. The three committed to train together and pursue true strength in order to defend Earth. After Luo Feng confirmed that he was the Yun Mo Planet Sect, he convinced Thunder God and Hong to join the sect. After doing so, Thunder God and Hong then received the Warrior training techniques from the Yun Mo Planet Sect, assisting them in their development. By the summer of 2062, Thunder God had become a Planetary Level 9 with a 1 level Domain. When Luo Feng left for Horned Dragon Planet, he did not explain his absence to Thunder God or Hong, instead asking Xu Xin to tell them he was training and could not be disturbed.

Hong discussed Luo Feng's 1-month absence with Thunder God, noting that everyone has their secrets, and when Luo Feng returned he began sharing his gains from his journey. The three discussed the purchase of the Black Meng Race slaves, and decided what to do with the purchased Purple Light Juice. Noting the importance of making Earth feel the danger of the universe, Hong advised Luo Feng to not share the existence of the Black Meng slaves. At the end of October 2062, Thunder God helped lead the discussion between the three brothers and Earth's leadership class.

When Bu Luo Nuolanshan and his team began analyzing Earth, they watched footage of Thunder God and Hong's battle with the Golden Horned Beast. Upon arrival on Earth, Bu Luo and his team attempted to capture the three brothers, but were stopped by the newly purchased slave guards. After learning from Meng 2 about the presence of the Nuolan Shan Family, Thunder God suggested that they kill Bu Luo and his team, but was stopped by Hong, who first wanted to acquire more information.

When Luo Feng told the two that he could access a bank account with the funds necessary to buy Earth, Thunder God and Hong agreed to work to help Luo Feng reach the Stellar Level so he could access it. The trio took the Black Dragon Mountain X81 Spaceship to Bai Lan Planet, where Thunder God was amazed during his first time leaving Earth. His relaxed state of mind shocked Luo Feng, who didn't know his mental strength. Thunder God, Luo Feng, and Hong eventually checked out Survival Bases, meeting the rude manager Luo Di. After Luo Feng sold the Black Dragon Mountain X81 Spaceship and earned enough money to buy the Survival Bases, Thunder God made sure Luo Feng lodged a complaint against Luo Di for his bad attitude, resulting in him getting fired. Thunder God's family, like Hong's and Luo Feng's, was allowed more space in the Survival Bases than other Earthlings.

During this time, Thunder God broke through to Stellar Level 1 with the assistance of the Yun Mo Planet Sect's secret manuals and assisting treasures purchased in their time on Jade Rock Planet. He was a bit anxious about Luo Feng's attempt to break through to Stellar Level 1, and was present to hear about Pula Nuolanshan and his group's arrival on Earth. After Luo Feng broke through to Stellar Level 1, Thunder God and Hong accompanied him to the Universe Star River Bank, where Luo Feng accessed the first of the three bank accounts that Hu Yan Bo left behind, acquiring 10 billion Ganwu Coins. Thunder God was incredibly impressed both by the bank's building and some of the clients, which included three 1-Star Universe Mercenaries. When the Nuolan Shan Family officially left Earth, footage of Thunder God, Hong, and Luo Feng celebrating was played for the Earthlings to see.

When Luo Feng successfully purchased the rights to Earth, the trio left to contact Earth. Along the way, they stopped in the Virtual Universe, where Thunder God noted that when they next visited, they should buy a house in the Virtual Universe. He was extremely excited when, on the surface, the Nuolan Shan Family left Earth, and he couldn't wait to return to Earth. While the trio were purchasing their house in the Virtual Universe, they received word that more aliens attacked the Luo Family home, but since he and Hong were only Stellar Level 1 and Planetary Level 9, respectively, they understood that they would be of no use in a battle with Stellar Level 9s.

While Tuo Lei Wu and his team were fighting Luo Feng's Stellar Level 9 slaves and his Golden Horned Beast Body, Thunder God and Hong lamented the fact that they were too weak to participate in the battle. Hong then suggested that they head to the Virtual Universe, where he eventually found a suitable place to train: the Killing Fields. In their time in the Killing Fields, they made some friends, including Gaia Heruo and Hook Brehm, and learned of Man Luo, the man in charge of the Black Dragon Mountain Island division of the Killing Fields.

After experiencing some time there, Thunder God and Hong, having noticeably changed somewhat, suggested to Luo Feng that he take advantage as well. During his time in the Killing Fields, Luo Feng realized that the only reason he could defeat Thunder God was because his Soaring Shuttle was superior to Thunder God's blade. Later, the trio purchased a plot of land within Black Dragon Mountain Island's Nine Star Bay, then subsequently purchased several houses. Afterwards, they also sent a large number of Awareness Helmets to Earth.

The trio continued to spend much time in the Killing Fields, with Thunder God spending 3 consecutive days without leaving. They later learned of the Universe Trainee Mercenary Exam from Heruo and Buleimu, two members of North Dragon City. While learning details about the exam from the pair, Thunder God and the others noticed Nuolan Shan, who was coincidentally also in the Killing Fields hall. The three battled with Nuolan Shan and lost without much effort from the Huge Axe Warrior, but proceeded to continue verbally provoking him. After the altercation, Nuolan Shan coerced Heruo into providing him with Luo Feng's Virtual Universe number, after which Heruo apologized and shared information on the Battle Space with the three brothers. After learning about the Battle Space, the three brothers jumped headfirst into battling other warriors within the space, with Thunder God reaching the 8 Star rank, with a record of 691 wins and 3 losses. He met the White-Robed Female Warrior (Ji Qing in the donghua) in the Battle Space, and, like Luo Feng, lost easily.

Unbeknownst to the three brothers, their battles in the Battle Space caught the attention of Man Luo, an Immortal of the Virtual Universe Company (VUC), who ordered Ming Yu to have them tested against some elites of the VUC. With Thunder God's strength as a Stellar Level 1 with a 1 layer Domain, he qualified as a Level 3 elite of the VUC. Ming Yu met the brothers and advised that rather fighting in the Battle Space, the three should participate in true life-or-death battles to increase their strength, at which point Hong reflected on his period of growth during the Great Nirvana and realized it was true. After the discussion with Ming Yu, the three brothers refused to join the VUC as internal members, but agreed to join as external members. They then used their privilege as members to purchase Bloodline Evolution Agents, which enabled Thunder God to breakthrough to Stellar Level 2.

After learning the importance of life-or-death battles through their encounter with Ming Yu, Thunder God, Hong, and Luo Feng decided to participate in the Universe Trainee Mercenary Exam. Since Hong was now a Stellar Level 1 warrior, they were all eligible to participate, and after adding the Stellar Level 9 Warrior Tie Nan He and the Stellar Level 9 Spirit Master Ao Gu to their group, they were comfortable participating in the exam.

The group of 5 traveled to Cang Lan Planet, where they learned that Nuolan Shan was part of Hundred Tigers Building, then entered the World of Thunder to complete their exam. Upon landing in the World of Thunder, they were shocked by the hardness of the sand and the world's gravity, and learned that both were affected by the Universe Crystals which made up the world. After escaping the Death Desert and its Death Dust Storm, they eventually made it to the Demon Moon Lake, where they waited for the One-Horned Iron Rhinoceros, one of their goals of the exam.

While waiting for an opportunity to obtain 5 horns from the rhinos, they watched Brolin's team easily deal with the herd of rhinos, leaving many horns behind. With the team's strength, Thunder God guessed that Brolin was from a family that controlled one or two low-level empires. Upon Luo Feng's warning that another team was chasing them, the group left, but were unable to escape Qiu Yu and his team, resulting in a skirmish that ended with Ao Gu killing most of the enemies. Thunder God got a new Space Ring as one of the spoils of this battle. In their time in the World of Thunder, the group were attacked by multiple monsters, with the Black-Ringed Snakes they met on the 36th day causing them great anguish and the Thunder Falcon they met on the 51st day heavily damaging Thunder God.

Finally reaching the Canyon of Wind and Thunder, the group began to acquire the Wind Horn Stones required to pass their exam, but learned that their friend Heruo was under distress. After successfully assisting Heruo and his group, Thunder God noticed some black holes in the distance, which were revealed to be entrances to the World Within a World on Cang Lan Planet. Babata shared the importance of the World Within a  World with the group, prompting them to enter the world and begin searching for treasure, eventually coming across Universe Crystals, which they dug up. Thunder God was thrilled at their gains, exclaiming that in terms of value, they had already dug up 100 Earths! Ming Yu reached out to the group, advising them to state that they were his subordinates, which they did. Having secured their status as part of the Three Axe Mountain faction, the group made their way to the center region of the World Within a World, accumulating 180,000 cubic meters of Universe Crystals along the way, leading to Luo Feng and Thunder God teasing each other in their joy.

In a discussion with Heruo, the group learned that Three Axe Mountain had very few people in the World Within a World, so they mixed with his North Dragon City faction. When Brolin and his team found the castle containing Lord Wu, everyone within the World Within a World became aware of the 68 distinct treasures (312 total treasures since there were multiples of some) and the need to acquire Thunder Stones to exchange for them. Using Babata's Scanning Device, they acquired enough Thunder Stones to buy one Life Fruit, an Ice Soul Blade, and the Suppressing Space Cauldron. Thanks to Lord Wu sharing with Brolin that someone else was exchanging for treasures when he attempted to do so, Brolin's forces learned that Luo Feng acquired treasures. This lead to Brolin's forces attacking the group, with Tie Nan He dying during the escape while Ao Gu carried Thunder God and Hong. After surving the ambush, Luo Feng used the Life Fruit to evolve his Cloud Vine to Universe Level 2 and with its strength, they acquired over 9 million more Thunder Stones, along with treasures from teams they killed. After acquiring these stones, Thunder God and Hong agreed to allow Luo Feng to choose their course of action, since his Cloud Vine had obtained the stones. Dutiful to his life-and-death brothers, Luo Feng acquired what treasures he could, one of them being five sets of technique guides from the Pinnacle World Master Kabu's Thunder Secret Method, which he gave to Thunder God. While he was excited to begin studying them, he followed Hong's advice and waited until it was safe to do so.

After selling their remaining Thunder Stones, which had no use outside of the World Within a World, the group prepared to leave, but were attacked by Brolin's forces, who were attempting to acquire the final password to the Inheritance Crystal Ball. Shocked by the attack, Thunder God and the others were filled with rage, but focused on making it back to Cang Lan Planet. Upon arrival, they noticed Nuolan Shan, who hoped to kill the group and thus acquire Earth and its treasures, but Luo Feng's quick thinking prompted others from Three Axe Mountain to prevent this from happening. While safe for the moment, Thunder God knew that they would have to kill Nuolan Shan to be truly safe, so he asked Luo Feng to have Ming Yu kill their tormentor in exchange for the treasure they would give him.

After selling the Air Cutter Blade to Ming Yu for 20 billion Universe Coins, Luo Feng followed the distribution of spoils established by Hong on Earth and sent 4 billion Universe Coins apiece to Thunder God and Hong. Luo Feng then proceeded to pass the five chips containing Kabu's techniques to Thunder God, who began studying them. While studying the manuals, Thunder God discovered that one of the chips contained the true inheritance of Kabu, including his Intelligent Life, Lord Wu! With this, Thunder God became Kabu's student, with Lord Wu as his instructor, similar to Luo Feng becoming Hu Yan Bo's student, with Babata as his instructor. After exchanging the acquired Universe Crystals, Luo Feng sent 1 billion Universe Coins to the pair, but Thunder God refused to accept any of the spoils from the sale of the remaining 48 treasures, since he had obtained Kabu's inheritance.

Through his Universe Star River Bank account, Luo Feng sold the remaining 48 treasures, earning over 11 trillion Universe Coins, making him a 3-Star member of the bank and giving him the right to attend the Ganwu Auction as well as watch the battles of the Huge Axe Dojo. Noticing a battle between two Universe Level 6 combatants, he contacted Thunder God and Hong to travel to the dojo to watch the battle with him (in the donghua, it was a battle between two Stellar Level combatants, Ao Gu and Genji). The three gambled 100 million Universe Coins on the battle, with Luo Feng and Thunder God gambling on Genji and Hong betting on Hanks. Hanks emerged victorious after stepping through the gateway of the Law of Water  and killing Genji.

After Thunder God acquired Lord Wu as a teacher, he trained hard, nearly catching up to Hong after 2 years of training. During this time, he reached Stellar Level 5, had a Level 4 Domain, and was capable of killing around 190 Stellar Level 5 opponents in a battle. While this brought him joy, Lord Wu was far from satisfied, noting additional flaws in his techniques and further advising him. When relaxing in the lobby of the Killing Fields after his most recent training session, Thunder God saw the declaration in the sky for the Pinnacle Genius Battle, and informed Luo Feng and Hong. After reading the information on the Virtual Universe Company (VUC) website, the three eagerly decided to participate, filled with confidence and courage. While signing up, Thunder God was shocked to see that over 2 billion participants signed up while he was training in the Killing Fields, and on April 16, 2066, he received his notification from the VUC that he would be one of over 800 billion participants in the Ganwu Universe Country Elimination Stage.

Thunder God was sent to World #88 in the elimination stage, where he immediately began killing opponents, quickly rushing into the top 100,000 of his world. He continued on successfully, making it to the top 3,000, until the 27th day, when he met Rong Jun and was quickly defeated. Xu Xin reached out to him, at which point he confirmed his complete loss, but positively remarked on Luo Feng and Hong's continued successes.

Following the end of the elimination stage, Thunder God celebrated with his two successful brothers, while remarking that he had poor luck running into Rong Jun. Thunder God was present for the Black Dragon Mountain Empire delegation's meeting with Luo Feng, where the delegation declared they would gift the Milky Way Galaxy to Luo Feng if he made the top 1,000 of the Ganwu Universe Country. Later, he helped Hong and Luo Feng prepare for the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Stage by researching their opponents, and he watched as Nabini was eliminated. When Hong commented that he probably wouldn't do much better, Thunder God responded by giving his full vote of confidence in him, but was quickly made nervous when Rong Jun was in the same arena as Hong. Thunder God watched as Hong was eliminated by the Valiant Female Warrior, then gave his support to Luo Feng before his battle.

After Hong was eliminated, Thunder God was present when he met with Jiang Tian Chen, Ming Yu, and Luo, and he learned of Luo's offer to be Hong's teacher. While looking at the structure of the Arena 1v1 battles, he remarked that due to Luo Feng's exceptional performance, it was arranged for him to fight Rong Jun in his 4th battle, placing two geniuses who stepped through the gateway of the Original Laws against each other. Following Luo Feng's loss to Rong Jun, he and Thunder God saw Hong off as he left to be Luo's disciple. Thunder God continued to train under Lord Wu's tutelage while Luo Feng progressed through the Pinnacle Genius Battle, using his performance as further motivation.

Thunder God and Hong met with Luo Feng before he left for Primal Chaos City. The pair continued to provide him with guidance in mental state training, helping him as he attempted to absorb Blood River Crystals. In the discussion between the three brothers, it was revealed that while Luo Feng was pushing through the limit of the first level of mental state training, Thunder God was at the second level, and Hong had begun to barely perceive the third level.

During this time, Thunder God was also exploring the universe, but stayed mostly within the Milky Way, living on Earth. He made efforts to bring Hong and Luo Feng together in the Virtual Universe, arranging a meeting between the brothers after the first round of the Secret Realm Qualification Battles. In his earlier conversation with Luo Feng, he learned that Luo Feng beat the odds and made it to the top 3 of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm in his first qualification battle. While sharing that information with Hong, it was revealed that Hong had become a member of the Huge Axe Dojo, having been accepted through the efforts of Time World Master Luo. Thunder God realized the gap between himself, Hong, and Luo Feng, remarking that he was confident that Hong could catch up to Luo Feng, while he himself would have to rely on luck to get there.

After Luo Feng's arrival, the trio discussed his battle with Ke Luo Fu, with Hong giving some guidance on how Luo Feng should continue on after his loss. Later, when Luo Feng became a Primal Secret Realm member due to Ke Luo Fu's presumed death, Thunder God joined those who celebrated his accomplishment.

While Luo Feng was completing the Lost Galaxy Impossible Mission, Thunder God sent a message asking him to meet in the Virtual Universe to discuss an urgent matter. Having been in relatively close contact with Hong, he knew of Hong's affairs within the Ganwu Universe Country, and he learned of Hong developing feelings for a woman while stationed on Jade Dome Planet. When her family forcefully kept the two apart, Thunder God tried to learn the reasons, but was unsuccessful in prying the information from Hong, so he called both Luo Feng and Hong together to discuss the situation.

With some reluctance, Hong shared what he knew about the woman, Ji Qing, and the Ji Family. Luo Feng, using his authority as a Primal Secret Realm member, shared additional details about Ji Qing with the pair, revealing that she was a core member of the Universe Mercenary Alliance. Thunder God was not present for Hong's attempt to pass the 18 Desires for Love Fantasy Land, but got updates on his attempt from Luo Feng. He was very confident in Hong's ability to pass the test, since he understood the strength of his mental state. He learned of Hong's success in passing the test and his subsequent sadness after Ji Qing broke things off with him.

After joining the Huge Axe Dojo at Hong's recommendation, Thunder God eventually broke through to Immortal, becoming one of the first 11 Immortals from Earth. He eventually broke through to Universe Venerable by the time Hong broke through to Universe Master, in the 13,000th era after the appearance of the World of Jin. He was one those who saw Luo Feng before his final fight with Mo He. By the end of the series, with great difficulty, he had become a Universe Master himself.

characters.title: Li He God King
characters.introText: Li He God king is a remarkable figure known for his deep commitment to the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom and once become a Guest Official. He has achieved the rank of a Second Level God King through hard work and dedication. Unlike many others, he is not driven by power struggles or ambition. Instead, he focuses on nurturing his family, which includes a loving wife and five children—three sons and two daughters.
characters.history:
Li He God king is a remarkable figure known for his deep commitment to the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom and once become a Guest Official. He has achieved the rank of a Second Level God King through hard work and dedication. Unlike many others, he is not driven by power struggles or ambition. Instead, he focuses on nurturing his family, which includes a loving wife and five children—three sons and two daughters.

Li He God King is grateful to his master, Emperor Xuan, who has guided him in his journey. Despite his significant talent and the creation of a powerful secret treasure left by Yuan, an extraordinary weapon that surpasses even the God King level, he prefers to live a peaceful life. He believes that through intense practice and dedication, he can reach even greater heights.

However, tragedy strikes when Emperor Yan, Emperor Wu and Emperor Xi from Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom demand the secret treasure. They threaten to destroy his family and tribe if he does not comply. True to his nature of enduring hardship, he hands over the treasure, hoping to protect those he loves. Sadly, this act of submission leads to disaster. The emperors betray him, slaughtering his wife, children, tribe, and all the inhabitants of his city.

In his final moments, he manages to use the Reincarnation Secret Method, allowing him to be reborn. However, his family and people do not share the same fate and are lost forever.

characters.history:
Li Wei is an intermediate senior warrior from the Paulinus Clan of HR Alliance. He is the son of the "Vulture" Li Yao and the "Scorpion" Venina Paulinus who are both Advanced Gods of War and extremely wealthy. Li Wei has a long, blonde wolf cut with bangs that part in the centre.

Wishing to remain unmatched in rank he killed any genius-leveled warrior who could challenge him. This underhanded strategy earned him plenty of legal reprimands but he always managed to elude any actual consequences due to his parents status as War Gods.

He encountered Luo Feng in the City No. 003, before fleeing with Pan Ya and his two bodyguards.

In the underground, he met with Luo Feng again and instantly desired his death, recognizing his superior power  (warlord at 18). Luo Feng eventually faced him by throwing three knives in his direction that Pan Ya deflected, but while, Pan Ya, leader of the Tiger Fang Squad, and his two Advanced War Lord bodyguards rushed him, Luo Feng used the opportunity to unleash his telekinesis and killed them instantly.

Alone and with no one else there to protect him, Luo Feng decides to leave him to fend for himself. However, Li Wei retaliates and in attempts of disabling Li Wei, Luo Feng uses his flycutters on Li Wei's knees which takes away his ability to run away. Li Wei is eaten by a beast shortly after Luo Feng's departure.  
After his death, his parents Li Yao and Venina Paulinus publicly declared on the news that anyone who discovered, and informed them, of the identity of Li Wei's killer, would receive 100 billion Hanxia Dollars.

characters.title: Li Yao

infobox.friends: Li Kan Wang Tong Yan Hai

characters.introText: Along with Venina, they let themselves be swallowed by vengeance and hatred and they led a wasted life until the very last moment.
characters.personality: In the novel, Li Yao is forced to give up his Black God Suit before he is taken to his execution spot. He breaks through to Planetary Level as Liu He is about to execute him, and due to his special ability of 'Light,' his speed is too high for Liu He and Amuhan to keep pace. Luo Feng's ability to fly using the Soaring Shuttle enables him to chase down Li Yao. Without his Black God Suit, he is easy prey for the Soaring Shuttle's 1st form, Mountain Drill.
characters.history:
Along with Venina, they let themselves be swallowed by vengeance and hatred and they led a wasted life until the very last moment.

After Luo Feng killed his son, Li Wei, he swore he would kill whoever killed his son. As a survivor of the Great Nirvana, he highly valued his family and spoiled his only son. For Li Wei, Li Yao would ignore morality to clean up his son's messes.

He made a move against Luo Feng’s family when Luo Feng was MIA for a year in the Earth Ruins, so he received the death penalty.

At first, he was an Advanced Level War God, but just before he was executed by representatives of the Thunder God Dojo and Limit Dojo, he broke through to Planetary Level. He did it by sacrificing the life force of his wife using a forbidden technique, Blood Sacrifice. This technique was known from his mentor, Yan Hai.

He was thus able to fight against two Planetary fighters, Zhu Xi and Lei Meng and injure both of them before fleeing. His special ability of 'Light' and the bombs he had set up enabled him to defeat 2 Warriors with Planetary strength at the same time. When fighting against Luo Feng he then proceeded to burn his own vitality in order to further enhance his strength.

But unfortunately, this was not enough for him to escape from his death. Luo Feng chased after him and critically injured Li Yao with the Soaring Shuttle first form, Mountain Drill. After he was critically injured, he self-destructed in an attempt to kill Luo Feng, but failed.
characters.trivia: It is assumed this character has Law of Light  affinity due to his displayed special ability

characters.title: Lightwalker Master
characters.introText: An eight-armed man with silver armor and a pair of silver horns. His eyes gleam with golden light.
characters.appearance: An eight-armed man with silver armor and a pair of silver horns. His eyes gleam with golden light.
characters.history: Lightwalker Master is a Universe Master of the Freedom Alliance. When disagreements began to arise among the alliance's Universe Masters as to whether they would help the Human Race or not, Jue Hua True God contacted Lightwalker Master with an offer from Purple Moon Ancestor. Purple Moon Ancestor was willing to provide information on how to breakthrough to True God and if the information he gave the Freedom Alliance was better than the information the humans gave them, the Freedom Alliance would join the Allied Force Military Camp and attack the humans, especially Luo Feng. Lightwalker Master individually contacted the members of the Freedom Alliance and gave them the inheritance information from Purple Moon Ancestor, so the Freedom Alliance decided he would represent them in their negotiations with the human race, much to the chagrin of Shi Hua Island Leader.

characters.appearance: A balding old man.

characters.title: Liu He
characters.introText: Extremely handsome, his appearance appeared to be otherworldly! He had long, flowing hair, with eyes that were as deep as the sea. He always had a smile on his face and seemed to be quite relaxed, appearing to be around 30 years old.
characters.appearance: Extremely handsome, his appearance appeared to be otherworldly! He had long, flowing hair, with eyes that were as deep as the sea. He always had a smile on his face and seemed to be quite relaxed, appearing to be around 30 years old.
characters.personality: Quite relaxed, flexible and confident. He has a clear understanding of his own strength and of those stronger than him, and is dedicated to the Extreme Martial Club. He never bothered with bossing the chiefs of Jiangnan city, preferring to devote himself to training. Despite his laid-back demeanor, he was filled with anger when he heard that Li Yao and Venina Paulinus plotted against a fighter's family.
characters.history:
As one of the five Inspectors of the Extreme Martial Club, he is highly respected and has significant authority. He was the Inspector in charge of Jiangnan HQ main city.

Toward the end of Luo Feng's time on the Fire Hammer Squad, Liu He was working to surpass the God of War level, despite already being one of the five big Inspectors of the Extreme Martial Club. It is confirmed that he was successful as during the investigation of the Misty Island, he is referred to as a 'Representative' by Fa Er.

He and Bing Shan were sent by Hong to investigate the Misty Island based on the information he received from Luo Feng. He was originally hopeful of receiving 30% of what was found on the island, but with Fa Er's interference, he could only rely on Bing Shan to retrieve the spirits of nature. With the additional emergence of the Cloud Vine, he only ended up receiving 5%.

He was amused at Luo Feng jokingly saying he'd return to the Elite Training Camp, despite being invincible at the God of War level. When Bing Shan was attacked by the Cloud Vine, he knew he wouldn't be able to assist him in his escape by fighting the vine, but he stayed close by in his jet, monitored the battle, and was able to retrieve Bing Shan when he escaped.

When he, Bing Shan, and Luo Feng were called to see Hong and receive their rewards, he gave Luo Feng advice on exchanging for treasures rather than accepting spirits of nature as a reward. He informed Hong that Luo Feng made it out of the Archaeological Ruin #9 alive, and he accompanied Hong and Yao Rao to meet Luo Feng. He also reached out to Luo Feng to inform him of the pending announcement of Luo Feng as a Representative and Inspector.

At Li Yao and Venina's trial, he introduced Luo Feng to other representatives and informed him of those like Yan Hai who might oppose him. At the conclusion of Li Yao and Venina's trial, he and Amuhan were responsible for administering the death penalty. He offered the opportunity of killing Li Yao to Luo Feng. When he moved in for the kill, Li Yao broke through to Planetary level, causing Liu He to contact Hong to notify him and get new orders. He saw and was shocked by Luo Feng's ability to kill the Planetary level Li Yao, and he notified Hong. He accompanied Luo Feng through his introduction ceremony.

He was one of the fighters who returned to the Misty Island to acquire Muya Crystals, and he contacted Luo Feng after his acceptance of Hu Yan Bo's inheritance.
characters.trivia:
Due to his use of a shield of wind to conceal his conversation with Luo Feng, and his confidence in flying faster than Fa Er, it is assumed he has Law of Wind  affinity.

Since he was training his spear techniques in City 003 to try to break through to Planetary Level, it can be inferred that he specializes in spear techniques

It appears that the donghua has combined his character with Zhu Xi's, consolidating it under Zhu Xi.

characters.title: Liu Yin Yan

characters.appearance: A young man in a blood-colored robe.
characters.history:
Liu Yin Yan was an incredible Eternal True God and the most outstanding child of Lord Liu Yin. Due to his ability, Lord Liu Yin was willing to send him to become a direct disciple of Snow Realm Ancestor, an ancient God King.

Liu Yin Yan commanded the powerful Mechanical Treasure Snow Realm Envoy, showing his strength. During the Heart Shadow Sect's attempted conquest of Hu Yang City, Yan was commanded by his father to assist the sect in breaking Yue Wu's formation.

Initially, he controls Snow Realm Envoy and clashes with Eternal True God Luo Feng, with the expression of the Great Dao of the Life Origin on the treasure helping Luo Feng to break through to Primal Chaos Sovereign. Later, he leads his subordinates to attack the Fengyi District, prompting Luo Feng to retaliate, killing him and the 36 Eternal True Gods that helped him control Snow Realm Envoy.

characters.title: Liu Yu God King
characters.introText: Liu Yu God King is of the two God Kings who accepted the invitation to join the Food Kingdom. She was once the ruler of a small marginal God-Kingdom, Liu Yu Kingdom, and took the initiative to surrender when the Food Kingdom invaded the surrounding areas. She is the most inconspicuous and of the lowest status of the 5 God Kings of the Food Kingdom, but she saved her people from sharing the fate of the Jin Kingdom.
characters.history:
Liu Yu God King is of the two God Kings who accepted the invitation to join the Food Kingdom. She was once the ruler of a small marginal God-Kingdom, Liu Yu Kingdom, and took the initiative to surrender when the Food Kingdom invaded the surrounding areas. She is the most inconspicuous and of the lowest status of the 5 God Kings of the Food Kingdom, but she saved her people from sharing the fate of the Jin Kingdom.

After Luo Feng killed the three founding God Kings of the Food Kingdom, Liu Yu had nowhere to escape with her people, so she remained in the Food Kingdom, anxiously awaiting Luo Feng's arrival. Luo Feng agreed to allow her to stay within the kingdom, but only granted her 5 Chaos States as territory. She, Yuan, Morosa, and Xin Yu have been tasked to manage the affairs of the Food Kingdom's territory. She was also accepted as a Guest Official of the Blade River Sect.

characters.title: Liuyue Ancestor
characters.introText: Liuyue Ancestor is a powerful being ranked among the top twenty in strength within the Chaotic Origin Dimension. She possesses a unique “three-body” form, meaning she is born with three separate bodies, each capable of housing her life core, which can freely transfer between them. Because of this rare trait, she has never achieved the level of Immortality, but at the same time, killing her completely is extremely difficult.
characters.appearance:
Liuyue Ancestor is a powerful being ranked among the top twenty in strength within the Chaotic Origin Dimension. She possesses a unique “three-body” form, meaning she is born with three separate bodies, each capable of housing her life core, which can freely transfer between them. Because of this rare trait, she has never achieved the level of Immortality, but at the same time, killing her completely is extremely difficult.

She is known for her neutrality rarely involving herself in conflicts or aligning with any major factions. She currently resides in the 9th layer of the Abyss Of Destruction and took control of it after the previous ruler, Lord Naigu, lost control during the chaos sparked by Endless Ancestor taking the 18th layer from Kafuxiu, and Luo Feng defeating Wugu Ancestor on the 8th layer.

Liuyue Ancestor is polite and easy to deal with if left undisturbed, but she retaliates fiercely if provoked. When Luo Feng reached her layer after staying one era in each previous level, she received him kindly and even arranged for five hundred World Envoys to help him train. She started paying close attention to Luo Feng’s journey, realizing that his ability to spend one era per layer and push forward steadily suggested great strength and potential.

As an Immortal Marquis with light origin law proficiency, he is naturally adept at purifying, and combined with the time laws, he can easily purify and kill a normal Immortal.

characters.title: Long Suo (Immortal)
characters.introText:
Member of the Ka Wu Race and an ally of the Zerg Race. He was killed by Luo Feng on Misty Sand Island.
Long Suo is a Ka Wu Race undying and is recognized as a brother figure to Boulder, who is one of the twelve officials of Misty Sand Island and also a powerful Ka Wu race undying. Although they are not blood brothers, they belong to the same tribe and share a close bond. They have explored together and received orders from their upper race to undertake missions. Long Suo was killed by Luo Feng, which enraged Boulder deeply, as Boulder considered Long Suo as his little brother. Boulder sought revenge against Luo Feng for killing Long Suo and was actively searching for him on Fog Island to avenge his death

characters.title: Long Yun
characters.introText: Muscular and about 2 meters tall, he looks strong. Wears a strange style of heavy armor, with a horned helmet. The side of his face had some yellow fur and his gaze was deep and unfathomable.
characters.appearance: Muscular and about 2 meters tall, he looks strong. Wears a strange style of heavy armor, with a horned helmet. The side of his face had some yellow fur and his gaze was deep and unfathomable.
characters.personality: Yeah, we do not see a resemblance either
characters.history:
An inhabitant of the Lan Ting Universe Country, he placed 2nd in the Pinnacle Genius Battle. While he stayed under everyone's radar until making the top 10, he was unique in the top 20 by being the only one who had shown comprehension of only one Original Law. Despite this, his Law of Earth  domain was considered even stronger than Bolan's! His ability, along with Luo Feng, Gu Si Luo, Jia Laixi, and Rong Jun, was considered enough to get number 1 in previous competitions, and at the very least making the top 3.

At the start of his battle with Luo Feng, Long Yun revealed that he had also comprehended Law of Space , and furthermore had fused it with his earth domain! With this, his defense, attack, and speed were significantly increased. As his fight with Luo Feng continued, the two could not significantly damage each other. While Luo Feng used the Sky Piercing Form and soul attacks, he could not pierce through Long Yun's defense. While Long Yun had a stronger domain, terrifying attack power, and explosive melee-range speed, he could not catch Luo Feng due to his movement on the Dark Cloud Shuttle after reaching the 100 Threads level of 10,000 Thread Flow! He eventually defeated Luo Feng due to the shrinking of the arena (set up so Controllers could not simply stay far away from their opponents) preventing Luo Feng from continuing to avoid his attacks.

After defeating Luo Feng, he only lost to Bolan out of the final 5, which led to him being accepted into the Primal Secret Realm of the Virtual Universe Company. While others were not satisfied with him making into the Primal Secret Realm, the same complaints would have been made if Jia Laixi, Luo Feng, or Rong Jun had made it.

While his personality was low-key entering the Pinnacle Genius Battle, he began to get arrogant after entering the Primal Secret Realm, due to his rise in position and the fact that even Immortals called him 'Your Majesty!' He was soon disappointed when not only Bolan, but Rong Jun passed at least 1 level of the Tong Tian Bridge, and once Jia Laixi did the same, his heart and mind began to collapse. Realizing that he needed to return to his roots and work hard, 3 months after Luo Feng passed the 1st level, he became the 6th of Luo Feng's batch to pass the 1st level of the bridge. In his 8th year in Primal Chaos City, he passed the 2nd level of the bridge, one of the first 6 to do so, and his steadiness was complimented by King Longyu. In his 25th year in Primal Chaos City, he passed the 3rd level, one of the first 6 to do so, but he was shocked at the gap between he and Luo Feng, who had passed the 5th level.

While training in the Primal Secret Realm, he told Bolan about Luo Feng's successful attempt at the 6th level of the Tong Tian Bridge. When Luo Feng passed the 7th level, Long Yun had recently passed the 5th level.

During the Secret Realm Qualification Battle, he was the weakest of the 5 from the Primal Secret Realm, easily losing to Bolan and the 3 seniors, placing him in the elimination section of the qualification battle. He had only passed the 5th level of the Tong Tian Bridge while the other seniors had all passed at least the 7th level. He was present when Luo Feng attacked Mo Luo in the Virtual Universe. In the final portion of the qualification battle, he lost to all of the others (Ke Luo Fu, Luo Feng, Mo Luo, Bolan, and Yu Feng), resulting in his demotion to the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm.

characters.title: Lord Chu Chang
characters.introText: Lord Chu Chang is a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign and First-Class Lord of the Emperor Chu Family, considered slightly below average in terms of talent among the First-Class Lords.
characters.history:
Lord Chu Chang is a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign and First-Class Lord of the Emperor Chu Family, considered slightly below average in terms of talent among the First-Class Lords.

When the First-Class Lords were given their first Heaven-level Task, Chu Chang was contacted by the Two Worlds Palace. They agreed to assist him in the Blood Spirit Gold Pearls sub-task in exchange for a portion of the rewards, depending on where he placed, as long as he placed in the top 3 overall. With their assistance, Chu Chang ranked 3rd in that sub-task, but due to ranking 4th and 5th in the other sub-tasks, he ranked 4th overall.

characters.title: Lord Chu Feng
characters.introText: Lord Chu Feng is a First-Class Lord of the Emperor Chu Family. Despite having an ordinary Divine Body, he is a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign. He is acquainted with Mansion Master Yuan Xiu, a Transcendent Chaos Realm, who worked on his behalf in the Blood Spirit Gold Pearls sub-task of the Heaven-level Task.
characters.appearance: A bold and unrestrained man.
characters.history:
Lord Chu Feng is a First-Class Lord of the Emperor Chu Family. Despite having an ordinary Divine Body, he is a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign. He is acquainted with Mansion Master Yuan Xiu, a Transcendent Chaos Realm, who worked on his behalf in the Blood Spirit Gold Pearls sub-task of the Heaven-level Task.

Due to ranking 4th in the Blood Spirit Gold Pearls sub-task and second and third in the other two sub-tasks, Chu Feng ranked 3rd overall in the Heaven-level Task.

characters.title: Lord Chu Ji
characters.introText: Lord Chu Ji is a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign and a First-Class Lord of the Emperor Chu Family. He has a similar temperament to Lord Chu Yuan, so the two are united, making them the most powerful faction of the First-Class Lords. Chu Ji has two Guest Officials, Guest Official Xun and Golden Hoop Guest Official.
characters.history:
Lord Chu Ji is a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign and a First-Class Lord of the Emperor Chu Family. He has a similar temperament to Lord Chu Yuan, so the two are united, making them the most powerful faction of the First-Class Lords. Chu Ji has two Guest Officials, Guest Official Xun and Golden Hoop Guest Official.

Chu Ji attempts to rein in Chu Yuan's aggression, reminding him of the consequences of breaking the family's rules. He is rational and understands to never underestimate his opponent.

After Di Chu Yu once again used his priority to assign a king-level task to himself, Chu Ji helped Chu Yuan lead their guest officials in attacking Luo Feng, believing him to be an ordinary Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign. When Luo Feng exploded with Transcendent Chaos Realm strength, Chu Ji only escaped due to Guest Official Xun's Causality Escape Secret Method.

Chu Ji ranked 5th overall in the first Heaven-level Task given to the 7 First-Class Lords.

characters.title: Lord Chu Le
characters.introText: Lord Chu Le is an ordinary Primal Chaos Sovereign of the Emperor Chu Family, and as such, is a Third-Class Lord. He has been a Primal Chaos Sovereign for over 3,000 Periods, and is still only an ordinary sovereign, which speaks to his lack of potential.
characters.history:
Lord Chu Le is an ordinary Primal Chaos Sovereign of the Emperor Chu Family, and as such, is a Third-Class Lord. He has been a Primal Chaos Sovereign for over 3,000 Periods, and is still only an ordinary sovereign, which speaks to his lack of potential.

Since he is only a Third-Class Lord, he does not receive many resources from the family. Despite this, he prefers to enjoy himself and make friends.

characters.title: Lord Chu Lin
characters.introText: Lord Chu Lin is a First-Class Lord of the Emperor Chu Family, and is thus either a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign or a Primal Chaos Sovereign with an Infinite Divine Body (or both). Chu Lin placed 6th in the first Heaven-level mission in which Di Chu Yu participated.
characters.history: Lord Chu Lin is a First-Class Lord of the Emperor Chu Family, and is thus either a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign or a Primal Chaos Sovereign with an Infinite Divine Body (or both). Chu Lin placed 6th in the first Heaven-level mission in which Di Chu Yu participated.

characters.title: Lord Chu Ying
characters.introText: Lord Chu Ying is a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign and First-Class Lord of the Emperor Chu Family. Like Luo Feng, Chu Ying cultivates in the path of the Great Dao, and does not use external assistance like the Chaotic Origin Bloodline. Due to his talents, Emperor Qing stated that he had the greatest potential of the First-Class Lords in the Emperor Chu Family, dramatically increasing his status and ability to receive resources. It also enabled him to befriend God Kings and Transcendent Chaos Realm existences, including Great Sage Biyun.
characters.history:
Lord Chu Ying is a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign and First-Class Lord of the Emperor Chu Family. Like Luo Feng, Chu Ying cultivates in the path of the Great Dao, and does not use external assistance like the Chaotic Origin Bloodline. Due to his talents, Emperor Qing stated that he had the greatest potential of the First-Class Lords in the Emperor Chu Family, dramatically increasing his status and ability to receive resources. It also enabled him to befriend God Kings and Transcendent Chaos Realm existences, including Great Sage Biyun.

When the First-Class Lords received their Heaven-level Task, Chu Ying enlisted Biyun's assistance in collecting the Blood Spirit Gold Pearls. Due to ranking 2nd in the Blood Spirit Gold Pearls sub-task and first in the other two sub-tasks, Chu Ying ranked 1st overall in the Heaven-level Task.

Around 100 periods after the completion of the Heaven-level task, Chu Ying left secluded cultivation and learned of Luo Feng's desire to obtain a Guest Official spot for Ancestor Yuan. After befriending Luo Feng and providing the guest official spot to Yuan in the capacity of a First-Class Lord, he officially broke through to God King.

characters.appearance: An ugly figure covered in black hair and tough black skin, with eyes flashing with lightning.
characters.history:
Lord Chu Yuan is considered the strongest of the 7 First-Class Lords of the Emperor Chu Family, and the Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign with the greatest hopes of reaching Transcendent Chaos Realm of the group. Having the bloodline of both the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom and Thunder Ancient Kingdom Imperial Families, he is a madman who experienced many hardships and torture when he was young. Due to his bloodlines, after he reached the Chaos Realm, Emperor Chu directly helped him in his cultivation, resulting in his swift progress.

His temperament is twisted and violent, and the only First-Class Lord with whom he has a good relationship is Lord Chu Ji, who has a similar temperament. He has one guest official, and due to his allyship with Chu Ji, their faction is the strongest at the Chaos Realm level.

He attacks Di Chu Yu when the latter takes on a task in hopes of getting resources for Luo Feng, but knows that he can't actually kill him. He kills Chu Yu's ordinary followers, then later gathers 4 other Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereigns to kill Luo Feng. Under his orders, Great Sage Tian Yu takes Ancestor Yuan hostage, forcing Luo Feng to meet them in battle, and kills Yuan's Illusory Clone body. Unfortunately for the group, Luo Feng's increased strength results in their swift defeat.

Despite being repeatedly attacked by Luo Feng, with his body reduced to liquid, he lost little power and easily recovered his Divine Power, forcing Luo Feng to take his weapon to properly punish him. With Chu Ji's assistance, Chu Yuan gathers the funds necessary to buy back his weapon when Luo Feng lists it for consignment.

Chu Yuan ranked last in the first Heaven-level Task given to the 7 First-Class Lords, due to finishing 7th in all three sub-tasks. The two individual sub-tasks tested his comprehension potential, which was lower than the other lords due to following the Chaotic Origin Bloodline cultivation path.

characters.title: Lord Jiu Jiang
characters.introText: A man with silver hair draped over his shoulders. Each strand of his hair could cause fluctuations in the void. He could be considered handsome.
characters.appearance: A man with silver hair draped over his shoulders. Each strand of his hair could cause fluctuations in the void. He could be considered handsome.
characters.personality: Lord Jiu Jiang is brave and kind, willing to fight Lord Liu Yin head-on to allow Luo Feng to escape. He pulled his army from the battlefield when he realized that the losses would be catastrophic, and he was very respectful to those powerful Eternal True Gods serving under him.
characters.history:
Lord Jiu Jiang is a Primal Chaos Sovereign affiliated with the Yu Kingdom. Jiu Jiang was granted the Jiu Jiang Chaos State as his fiefdom and dwells in Jiu Jiang City. Jiu Jiang is also the leader of the Jiang Family, granting them the status of a Primal Chaos Clan of the kingdom and allowing them to be one of the Five Major Families of Hu Yang City. He has some fame in the surrounding God-Kingdoms, having forced Great Sage Beiyu to flee for his life in their battle.

As Lord Liu Yin stepped up the Food Kingdom's invasion of the Jiu Jiang Chaos State, Jiu Jiang responded in kind, increasing the bounties on Blood Cloud, Yu Tian Hu, and Yu Tian Yi. When Luo Feng revealed his strength, Jiu Jiang informed Yu Shui Kingdom Master, and sent Jiang Yu You with a choice of rewards for Luo Feng: 8 Primal Chaos Realm inheritances, Secret Manual of the Nine Refinements of the Void, or 10 million Universe Sands.

When the Heart Shadow Sect began its invasion of Hu Yang City, Jiu Jiang initially balked at paying Luo Feng 100 million Universe Sands, but he did invite the most powerful Eternal True Gods of the kingdom's capital, and he was not afraid of fighting Lord Liu Yin. After witnessing Luo Feng's strength during his battle with the Heart Shadow Sect, he agreed to pay him 100 million Universe Sands, officially hiring him to join his army in the battle against Liu Yin's forces. The pair and Morosa then drank to their new partnership after agreeing to terms of employment. Jiu Jiang then explained to his son why hiring Luo Feng at that price was worth it; in addition to gaining an Eternal True God with Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign-level Willpower (in actuality, Luo Feng had God King-level willpower), he also got his servant, who also showed incredible strength.

With the arrival of Yue Wu and Yong Hu, Lord Jiu Jiang began his war council with the two generals, Luo Feng, Morosa, and Jiang Yu You. At his order, General Yue, General Yong, Luo Feng, and Morosa practiced their formation, assigning roles and building familiarity. In addition to hiring powerful generals of the kingdom and free Eternal True Gods like Luo Feng, Jiu Jiang mobilized over 95% of the Eternal True Gods of the entire chaos state in hopes of winning the battle with the Heart Shadow Sect.

He observed the battles between his army and the Heart Shadow Sect, rejoicing when his army retook Hu Yang City, and lamenting the arrival of the Snow Realm Envoy. Understanding that its appearance signified to some degree the assistance that Snow Realm Ancestor was willing to provide Lord Liu Yin, Jiu Jiang resolved to find more Primal Chaos Sovereigns and take the battlefield himself. He spent the next period reaching out to other Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereigns, including Yan Yu and Great Sage Juefeng, but they all declined to fight Liu Yin for the terms he offered.

Having failed to recruit assistance and understanding that his Eternal True God army was inferior to Lord Liu Yin's forces, Lord Jiu Jiang resolved to fight Liu Yin one-on-one. When Luo Feng stopped Liu Yin Yan's attempt to seize the inhabitants of the Fengyi District for blood food, Jiu Jiang attempted to persuade him to avoid antagonizing Lord Liu Yin, thinking him a newly promoted Primal Chaos Sovereign unable to defend himself against Liu Yin. While he had no confidence in defeating Liu Yin himself, he did not want Luo Feng to risk his life in their conflict. When Luo Feng killed Liu Yin Yan anyway, Jiu Jiang appeared and defended him from Lord Liu Yin's attack, beginning a battle between the two powerful Chaos Sovereigns, and advised Luo Feng to escape while he could. Pushed to his limits, he warned Luo Feng that he was unable to hold Liu Yin back any longer, and was surprised when Luo Feng told him to leave Liu Yin to him. Jiu Jiang was among those surprised at the power of Luo Feng's Blade River Slash and he observed his battle with Lord Liu Yin.

After Luo Feng successfully repelled Lord Liu Yin, Lord Jiu Jiang thanked him profusely for his help and gifted him Hu Yang City, telling him that other than the 20% of living fees that must be given to the God Kings, everything else would belong to him. The two discussed how to handle the Heart Shadow Sect, who were trapped in the city, and Jiu Jiang expressed some shock at Luo Feng's willingness to offend the remaining two Primal Chaos Sovereigns of the sect. Having agreed to Luo Feng's conditions, Jiu Jiang reported the matters regarding Hu Yang City to Yu Shui Kingdom Master so that the Five Major Families could be resettled.

characters.title: Lord Liu An
characters.introText: Lord Liu An is an Eternal True God, one of the six leaders of the Dark Force Six Lords Alliance. He suggested to Lord White Fog and Lord Qiu Feng that they attempt to bargain with Luo Feng when he demanded they pay 300,000 Universe Sand for Lord Thousand Eyes' actions, resulting in Luo Feng increasing the fine to 500,000 Universe Sand.

characters.title: Lord Liu Yin
characters.introText: When contacted through the summons, he appears to be a blood-colored flame. His Divine Power Avatar condensed this flame into a figure wearing dark red armor and exuding the aura of darkness and disaster.
characters.appearance: When contacted through the summons, he appears to be a blood-colored flame. His Divine Power Avatar condensed this flame into a figure wearing dark red armor and exuding the aura of darkness and disaster.
characters.personality: Lord Liu Yin is a fearsome existence, ruthless and calculating. He is decisive and sober-minded, immediately reincarnating when he learned that Luo Feng had become the continent's strongest Transcendent Chaos Realm.
characters.history:
Lord Liu Yin is a Primal Chaos Sovereign of the Food Kingdom, charged with managing their forces located in the Yu Kingdom. Zan Yun fearfully reports to Liu Yin, while Blood Cloud is considered the lord's trusted aide. Liu Yin is more powerful than Lord Jiu Jiang, despite the latter's fame, and is one of the 5 strongest Primal Chaos Sovereigns of the Food Kingdom.

After Luo Feng (and Morosa) killed Yu Tian Hu, Yu Tian Yi, and Blood Cloud, Liu Yin contacted him through a Divine Power Avatar, attempting to convince him to refrain from interfering in the upcoming battle between the Heart Shadow Sect and the forces of Hu Yang City. He explicitly told Luo Feng that he intended to make the city part of his fiefdom, while advising him not to risk his life for Lord Jiu Jiang. Liu Yin did not take the initiative to hire Luo Feng for 200 million Universe Sands.

After his son, Liu Yin Yan, and his team committed atrocities during the conflict between Liu Yin and Jiu Jiang, Lord Liu Yin appeared in hopes of preventing Luo Feng from killing his son. Eager to fight against Lord Liu Yin, Luo Feng instead killed his son, and the two battled, with Luo Feng getting the upper hand. Following this battle, Hu Yang City was gifted to Luo Feng, who then left an avatar there to defend it. Later, when it was revealed that Luo Feng was the strongest Transcendent Chaos Realm on the Continent of Origin, Liu Yin decided to prepare to use the Reincarnation Secret Method to cut the causality connection between he and Luo Feng.

Liu Yin eventually completed his preparations and reincarnated, avoiding being killed by Luo Feng.

characters.title: Lord Ming Huo
characters.introText: Lord Ming Huo is a Transcendent Chaos Realm from the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. He is the direct disciple of Emperor Chu. While he focuses on the cultivation of the Divine Body, he does not focus on the height of the Divine Body, unlike Luo Feng. He can fight with some ordinary God Kings and not lose the upper hand.

characters.title: Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress
characters.introText: He has a giant body, full of green vitality. His Vigorous Snow Vine body was full of white vines that shined with green light. When living incognito on a life planet within the Thorn Ring Alliance's territory, he has a 3 meter tall Divine Body.
characters.appearance: He has a giant body, full of green vitality. His Vigorous Snow Vine body was full of white vines that shined with green light. When living incognito on a life planet within the Thorn Ring Alliance's territory, he has a 3 meter tall Divine Body.
characters.history:
Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress is a Top Universe Overlord member of the Thorn Ring Alliance. He is considered comparable to Venerable Ancestral Tree in power. He is called 'Lord of a Fortress' because he has a flying palace-type High Arcana that could even protect him from Universe Masters. His High Arcana flying palace was only slightly worse than Sky Wolf Palace.

He has three bodies in total, and supposedly his original body is a Vigorous Snow Vine body, a Special Lifeform of which only 5 existed in the Original Universe. Its Life Gene Level was around 1,000 and it was extremely large - over 1 million cubic kilometers! Its inherited technique Transplantation allowed it to have two other bodies, each with similar Life Gene Levels, effectively making him the equivalent of 3 Top Universe Overlords!

He prefers the way that the ordinary and weaker lifeforms of his life planet live, so he spends time living there in disguise as an owner of a corporation. He sometimes gained new inspirations in law comprehension when feeling the corporate competition among the ordinary lifeforms.

He ordered Venerable Killing Fog to follow Venerable Tian Yang, and intended to arrive at their location as soon as possible, but did not expect him to be killed. After asking Retinue Master to resurrect him, Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress obtained details of the battle between Luo Feng and Venerable Tian Yang, as well as Luo Feng's killing of Venerable Killing Fog. Thinking that Luo Feng and the Golden Horned Beast were related, he sought to meet Luo Feng personally.

Encountering Luo Feng on the Original Star, he affably spoke with him and pretended to wish to exchange with Luo Feng for some precious metals to create an Arcana. His true objective, however, was to meet the Golden Horned Beast that he felt was Luo Feng's Top Universe Overlord assistant and acquire the Disambiguation Mirror Stone that Venerable Tian Yang had possessed.

After being unsuccessful in this negotiation, he started a battle with Luo Feng, fighting against his Earthling and Golden Horned Beast bodies. After a dynamic battle during which Common Arcana domains clashed and Luo Feng used Beast God Armor, the two-pair Shi Wu Wings, Cutting Pearl Sword, Robbery Armor, and his Universe Overlord technique Foggy Light, Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress retreated in his flying palace High Arcana.

After returning to his life planet, he thought about Luo Feng and the Golden Horned Beast and realized Luo Feng must be a body of the Golden Horned Beast, but he could not figure out how the Golden Horned Beast was able to perform Possession on Luo Feng when Luo Feng was able to kill Pinnacle Immortal Kings as a World Master, and King Bark Mirror as an Immortal. He knew Possession occurred, but never could figure it out.

characters.title: Lord of Ganwu

infobox.friends: Luo Feng (Superior) Venerable Mei Hua Venerable North Larva
infobox.affiliation: Virtual Universe Company Hongmeng Supreme Council

characters.introText: He's an invincible being that not only created a Universe Country, but also one that commanded that universe country for billions of years.
characters.appearance: When speaking to his subordinates during the Stellar-level genius battle, he was a giant whose appearance was unable to be made out due to the space warping around him.  His booming voice made it feel as if the surrounding space would crumble, and the 3 Immortals he addressed went pale and knelt simultaneously.
characters.history:
The only Universe Venerable within the Ganwu Universe Country. He had held his position for over hundreds of millions of years. He sent over 100 million elite Stellar Level geniuses to participate in the Pinnacle Genius Battle.  With their inside information, over 40,000 of them made it through the elimination stage.

He has 18 god generals (Immortals) working under him, with over 10,000 total Immortals under him.

Once Luo Feng became a disciple-in-name to the Primal Chaos City Leader, the Lord of Ganwu made a rare order to his subordinates to look after the Luo family. Later, he becomes Luo Hai's master, when he found his way to the Ganwu Dojo. He took very good care of the Luo family and he never asked Luo Feng for any help.  He even went to save Luo Hai in person when he encountered danger.

In the past, he died three times and was resurrected afterwards. This however, caused him to accumulate a lot of debt. Some had lent him treasures for his use, but when he died, he lost those treasures, causing him to owe debt not only to the Universe Venerables who lent him the treasures, but the race, who resurrected him multiple times. His total debt equaled about 3.8 Arcana Points. As a result of the goodwill he engendered with Luo Feng, when Luo Feng learned of the Lord of Ganwu's indebtedness, he took it upon himself to help him, lending him the Arcana Points necessary to repay the 6 Universe Venerables who had lent him 1.6 Arcana Points worth of treasures in the past. The other 2.2 Arcana Points worth of Treasures he owed to his clan.

He was one of the ones who received word that the enemies of humanity were planning to do everything they could to kill Luo Feng, due to his strength. When Luo Feng gained his godly palace, the Lord of Ganwu served as one of his 3 subordinate Universe Venerables, as they were close.

characters.title: Lord of the Insect Nest
characters.introText: Her true form is a colossal spherical creature, with faces presenting different emotions appearing on its surface, which is also covered with countless holes. The form she shows to others is that of a beautiful woman.
characters.appearance: Her true form is a colossal spherical creature, with faces presenting different emotions appearing on its surface, which is also covered with countless holes. The form she shows to others is that of a beautiful woman.
characters.personality: She is described as domineering, ruthless, and pragmatic. She values results and power above traditional values, which has allowed her faction to grow despite resistance from orthodox alchemists.
characters.history:
Lord of the Insect Nest is the mysterious and powerful leader of the Insect Nest, one of the leading pharmaceutical factions within Yulan City in the Nine Rivers Holy World. Known for her aggressive tactics and bloodline-based alchemy, she is a dominant force in the city’s underground medicinal trade. Along with Owner of Wanying Building and Master of Guifang, she is considered one of the most powerful members of Palace Master Weiyang's faction within the city.

Earlier in her cultivation journey, she suffered severe mental corruption, and after becoming an Enlightened Late Stage God Emperor, she found herself unable to break through to Perfect God Emperor, perhaps due to this corruption. This led her to switch to the Hunyuan Bloodline cultivation system, ultimately exchanging the resources she accumulated in the Dark Holy Realm for a High-Level Hunyuan Bloodline, the Endless Cicada Tomb.

Unlike traditional alchemists, the Lord of the Insect Nest specializes in extracting essence from living beings, transforming it into bloodline-based or parasitic medicines. This gruesome method has drawn disdain from figures such as Chang Qing, leader of the rival Dan Building. Due to the decline of Palace Master Yuan Xiang, she has grown increasingly bold, using intimidation and covert means to suppress or absorb other alchemical forces.

When Luo Feng joins the Dan Building as its Deputy Head, he enters their conflict, eventually battling with the Lord of the Insect Nest's mental clone and heavily damaging it with the Lie Yuan Technique. Following this defeat, she focused on recovering her strength and attempting to acquire a treasure that could counter Luo Feng's mental attack, but when Yulan City was invaded and attacked, she spared no effort in its defense. After Luo Feng successfully repelled the attack, killing its perpetrators, she willingly left to him her resources within Yulan City. She then self-destructed all of her clones within the Nine Rivers Sacred World, understanding that he would not allow her and her plundering forces to remain in Yulan City.
