characters.introText: Her restrained form is a woman in a red robe, while her true form is a huge, twisting creature with over 1,000 eyes.
characters.appearance: Her restrained form is a woman in a red robe, while her true form is a huge, twisting creature with over 1,000 eyes.
characters.history:
Lord Thousand Eyes was one of the leaders of the Six Lords Alliance. She kidnapped Divine Lord Qi Feng's children after he was killed by Blood Cloud and his partners, hoping to take all of the resources he left behind for his children.

Since Qi Feng was a friend of Entropy Sky Flame, Luo Feng broke into the Six Lords Alliance headquarters to save the children. He killed Thousand Eyes when it was revealed that she attacked Qi Feng's family.

characters.title: Lord Tian Shui
characters.introText: Lord Tian Shui is a Primal Chaos Sovereign serving the Yu Kingdom. Tian Shui accepted Yu Kingdom Master's offer of a Large City and 300 billion Universe Sands in exchange for ownership of Tian Shui Chaos State.

characters.introText: He has a blurry body condensed of fog, so it is difficult to clearly see his appearance. He has one eye.
characters.appearance: He has a blurry body condensed of fog, so it is difficult to clearly see his appearance. He has one eye.
characters.history: Lord White Fog is an Eternal True God living in Hu Yang City, a member of the Six Lords Alliance, one of the 19 dark forces of the city. He attended the same Hundred Flowers Banquet as Luo Feng, and observed Luo Feng's loss of control during Dream Flower Tower Master's performance.

characters.title: Lord Wu
characters.introText: Lord Wu is an Intelligent Life who serves as Lei Shen's teacher. Originally the personal Artificial Intelligence (AI) of the Pinnacle World Master Kabu, after years of learning and upgrading, he became an Intelligent Life, having both rational and perceptual cognition of human beings, along with human emotions, just like Babata. He controlled the castle in the World Within a World on Cang Lan Planet where Kabu's treasures were stored. He tricked people into believing that the Inheritance Crystal Ball was real when in fact it was fake, and the actual inheritance lied in the chip that Luo Feng got for Lei Shen. He then became Lei Shen's teacher and personal AI. Babata doesn't like him because of how he let others know when someone was making a transaction during World Within a World treasure hunt, this is also how Brolin knew Luo Feng exchanged treasures, so he sent people to kill him.
characters.appearance: A fat, white-bearded old man.
characters.history:
Lord Wu is an Intelligent Life who serves as Lei Shen's teacher. Originally the personal Artificial Intelligence (AI) of the Pinnacle World Master Kabu, after years of learning and upgrading, he became an Intelligent Life, having both rational and perceptual cognition of human beings, along with human emotions, just like Babata. He controlled the castle in the World Within a World on Cang Lan Planet where Kabu's treasures were stored. He tricked people into believing that the Inheritance Crystal Ball was real when in fact it was fake, and the actual inheritance lied in the chip that Luo Feng got for Lei Shen. He then became Lei Shen's teacher and personal AI. Babata doesn't like him because of how he let others know when someone was making a transaction during World Within a World treasure hunt, this is also how Brolin knew Luo Feng exchanged treasures, so he sent people to kill him.

“So yeah. This living AI sure is sinister. As a living AI, could he not predict the consequences of every word he says? His computation ability is extraordinary, so he wouldn’t make such a stupid mistake. Which means….. he’s doing this on purpose!”

“There is only one reason he has for doing this: to make you guys kill each other!”

“This living AI is seriously sinister.” Babata was extremely angry. - Babata

Thunder God mumbled: “Didn’t thirdie say that he received the inheritance of Yun Mo Planet. I seemed to have….. received the inheritance of sector lord Kabu”

“Hm?” Luo Feng and Hong widened their eyes.

Receiving an instruction manual versus receiving an inheritance are two completely different ideas.

“I just swiftly browsed through those five instruction manual sets and plugged in the five different chips” said Thunder God lowly, “Four of the instruction manual sets are actual instruction manuals. However, the chip of the fifth instruction manual actually contained an AI! And……. it, it, it……”

“An AI?” Luo Feng and Hong realized something.

“It’s that white bearded old man” Thunder God blinked twice, “He even congratulated me saying that I became sector lord Kabu’s student”

“Lord Wu?” Luo Feng froze. - Lei Shen
characters.trivia: In the novel, Lord Wu seems intent to cause as much death and chaos among the trainee examinees as possible, but does not seem to actively help or hinder any of them, while in the donghua he actively assists Qiu Yu in his search for Luo Feng and makes Brolin wait to exchange for the first password to the Inheritance Crystal Ball because she is rude

characters.introText: An ordinary-looking woman dressed in gold, with a restrained aura.
characters.appearance: An ordinary-looking woman dressed in gold, with a restrained aura.
characters.history:
Lord Xin Huo is a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, serving as the master of the Dark Hall. She is one of the extremely rare non-Imperial Family members to be given the title of 'Lord' in the ancient kingdom.

Luo Feng met her when he visits the Dark Hall in Chu Capital City to sell the spoils from his battle with Lord Chu Yuan, Lord Chu Ji, and their Guest Officials, along with those from his battles with Lord Liu Yin and Great Sage Beiyu. Xin Huo helped Luo Feng list the Chu Yuan Stick for consignment after purchasing the other Primal Chaos Sovereign-level Treasures.

characters.title: Lotus Prison Mountain Lord

infobox.territory: Chaotic Origin Dimension Lotus Prison Cluster (Former)

characters.introText: Lotus Prison Mountain Lord is a dominant and resilient figure who fiercely defends his domain. He is unyielding, capable of withstanding attacks from multiple Cultivator Lords, and deeply attached to his territory, the Lotus Prison Cluster. His persistence in returning to reclaim his territory despite being driven out Cultivator Camp shows a stubborn and territorial nature.
characters.personality: Lotus Prison Mountain Lord is a dominant and resilient figure who fiercely defends his domain. He is unyielding, capable of withstanding attacks from multiple Cultivator Lords, and deeply attached to his territory, the Lotus Prison Cluster. His persistence in returning to reclaim his territory despite being driven out Cultivator Camp shows a stubborn and territorial nature.
characters.history:
Lotus Prison Mountain Lord is a powerful Primogenitor-level being in the Chaotic Origin Dimension, ranking among the top thirty in strength among over 200 Primogenitors. Though not immortal like Mo Gu Si, he is a formidable entity, comparable to the "Endless Ancestor" or "Nirvana Ancestor."

He once ruled the Lotus Prison Cluster, a region within the 3600 World Clusters, where he and his kin freely consumed the origins of numerous Source Worlds for eons. The Cultivator Camp eventually drove him out and established a spacetime network to prevent Primogenitors from invading. Taking advantage of the war between the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform camp and Cultivator Camp, Lotus Prison Mountain Lord returned to reclaim his former domain. Overlord Moman attempted to suppress him but couldn’t defeat him, as Lotus Prison Mountain Lord entrenched himself in the Lotus Prison Cluster, resisting attacks from multiple Cultivator Lords. Only Overload Yuan’s formations, which limit Lotus Prison Mountain Lord’s ability to draw power from the Chaotic Origin Dimension, force him to flee. Despite repeated attempts by the seven Cultivator Lords to kill him, his resilience has made him nearly impossible to eliminate, solidifying his status as a persistent threat to the Cultivator Camp's territories.
characters.trivia: Lotus Prison Mountain Lord is the ruler of the 5th Layer/Destruction World of the Abyss Of Destruction.

characters.introText: Lu Gang is a God of War who belongs to the Extreme Martial Club, stationed in Jiangnan City. He has a son and a daughter, and is responsible for hunting and killing in City 003. He died in a Grade 3 monster tide of rat monsters.

characters.title: Luo
characters.introText: You idiot, that is Luo! The founder of Three Axe Mountain Luo! The one known as the Time World Master!
characters.appearance: He's a kind-looking old man with a head full of white hair.
characters.personality: In his old age he seems a little resigned to his fate, but you still get flashes of his unwillingness to give up. This was a man who hoped to master the Law of Time  before becoming an invincible Immortal! His talent and ability have earned him the respect of all of the World Masters in the Ganwu Universe Country. He wants to spend his remaining 20,000+ years roaming the universe and breakthrough to become an Immortal.
characters.history:
Luo is originally from the Black Dragon Mountain Starfield. In his youth, he earned the Domain Master 'Huge Axe Warrior' title, thousands of times rarer than the Universe Level 'Huge Axe Warrior' title received by Nuolan Shan. With two of his Domain Master 'Huge Axe Warrior' comrades, he founded Three Axe Mountain, which became one of the 4 large organizations within the Black Dragon Mountain Starfield. He was considered the most exceptional of the 3 founders, but also had the greatest ambition.

Luo sought to fully comprehend the Law of Time before breaking through to Immortal, which would result in him becoming an incredibly powerful Immortal. If he joined the Ganwu Universe Country, he would have been the top Immortal under the Lord of Ganwu! Due to his accomplishments in the Law of Time, he became known as the Time World Master.

Toward the end of his lifespan, he realized that he likely wouldn't fulfill his ambition, and instead decided to focus on comprehending the Law of Light  and becoming a normal Immortal. Unfortunately, he got stuck for over 800,000 years in his comprehension, resulting in him having only over 20,000 years of his lifespan remaining at the start of Swallowed Star. Despite failing in his ultimate ambition up to that point, Luo was still considered one of the 3 strongest World Masters in the Ganwu Universe Country, and could even escape alive from an ordinary Immortal.

While watching the elimination round of the Pinnacle Genius Battle, he picked Hong to be his disciple, noting his talent and character. Having come to terms with the possibility of his death, he wanted to pass on his knowledge and techniques, allowing them to live on beyond him. Warning Hong that he would have to spend the next 20,000+ years following him around the universe, he gave Hong 10 days to consider the decision.

After Luo Feng's battle with Rong Jun, Hong accepted Luo's offer. On July 27, 2066, Hong and Luo left on their journey. With his status as a Huge Axe Warrior, Luo was able to get Hong accepted into the Huge Axe Dojo, getting them to help nurture his disciple. Later, Luo joined Hong at Luo Feng's welcoming ceremony, along with his friend Bushi Ka.

It is left unclear whether Luo successfully broke through to Immortal and lived on.

characters.title: Luo Di
characters.introText: A large, brown-skinned man with 3 lines on each cheek.
characters.appearance: A large, brown-skinned man with 3 lines on each cheek.
characters.personality:
↑ Volume 5, Chapter 39 - Chapter 298: Survival Bases

↑ Volume 5, Chapter 40 - Chapter 299: Three Months
characters.history:
Luo Di was a 2nd level manager from the Black Dragon Mountain Empire division of the Tie Luo Company. He originally met with Luo Feng, Hong, and Lei Shen to discuss their interest in purchasing Survival Bases for Earth. In part due to their lack of funds and overall ignorance of the costs of Survival Bases and in part due to his arrogance from his position, he was rude and insulted them, leaving without making any sales.

After Luo Feng sold the Black Dragon Mountain X81 Spaceship for 12.8 billion Black Dragon coins, he purchased multiple Survival Bases, and at Babata's suggestion and Lei Shen's strong request, filed an official complaint with the Tie Luo Company, which resulted in Luo Di being fired.

characters.trivia:
Luo Feng helped him out with the finances needed to begin his journey in Investment.

Universe First Bank and Universe Star River Bank specialized investment departments had invited and consulted Luo Hua .

He refused offers from both the banks because he wanted to work for himself and didn't want to take orders.

He is so good at investing that both the Universe First Bank and Virtual Universe Company wanted him to join one of two of the 5 Leviathans of Humanity but he later joined the Ping Hai Company and is head of Investments.

After 200 years of investing, the Virtual Universe Company became very aware of him. They even sent people over to invite him to work with amounts reaching tens of millions of mixed elements. They were even willing to send a special guard team to guarantee his safety. But Luo Hua rejected them, He felt that he was not mature enough yet.

characters.history:
Mansion Master Yuan Xiu is a Transcendent Chaos Realm affiliated with the Emperor Chu Family, and the direct disciple of Wan Jie Kingdom Master. Due to his strength, he has a status equivalent to a newly-promoted God King.

He is the senior brother of Three-Eyed Guest Official, who informs Lord Chu Feng when Yuan Xiu arrives in Chu Capital City to visit a God King. After hearing that a new Transcendent Chaos Realm (Luo Feng) appeared in the capital, Yuan Xiu asked Chu Feng to arrange a meeting between them.

Seeking to learn the differences between himself and a Transcendent Chaos Realm cultivator who used Chaotic Origin Material or Chaotic Origin Bloodline, Luo Feng agreed to the meeting. The two sparred, showing mutual respect for each other's secret techniques and specialties. Despite his efforts, he was unable to harm even Luo Feng's clone.

Later, he participated in the Heaven-level task for the Blood Spirit Golden Pearls, fighting on behalf of Lord Chu Feng. Despite his confidence in his ability to seize the pearls with his Dark Mansion Prison technique, he quickly realized his inability to trap Luo Feng or Huang Feng City Lord, and he knew that both Great Sage Yan Su and Great Sage Biyun could escape. In the first eruption of pearls, he avoided the main fighting and obtained 3 pearls. In the second eruption, after witnessing Luo Feng's increased strength, he refused to join forces with the other Transcendent Chaos Realms against Luo Feng, taking the initiative to be released from his Black River World. He witnessed Biyun's escape from the world and realized that Luo Feng successfully defeated the three. He placed 4th in the sub-task of the Heaven-level task.

characters.title: Master of Guifang
characters.introText: A slightly overweight man with dark blue skin, a pair of soft antennae, and glasses.
characters.appearance: A slightly overweight man with dark blue skin, a pair of soft antennae, and glasses.
characters.personality: He is scheming and calculating, known to be fierce and terrifying. He has ambition and patience, and does not actively opposes those he feels may be dangerous.
characters.history:
Master of Guifang is a powerful Enlightened Late Stage God Emperor, and the founder and leader of the Guile Workshop, one of the three major looting forces of Yulan City. While his main energy is focused on his clone in the Dark Holy Realm, he also serves as an Elder in Yulan City. Guifang established the looting force Guile Workshop in Yulan City to more easily reap benefits, and thus mostly leads management of the organization to its 8 Deputy Leaders. In pursuit of jumping out of the cage, he decided to cultivate a Fusion Dao after reaching Late Stage God Emperor in two Daos. Due to his strength and status as a cultivator from an Origin World, even the three Palace Masters cannot force him to do anything.

After watching footage of Elder Tianhe's defeat at the hands of Luo Feng, Guifang ordered him to pay Luo Feng 100 million Hunyuan Crystals as an apology, recognizing his prodigious talent and incredible potential. Later, in discussing with his friend, Palace Master Weiyang, Guifang noted that Luo Feng may indeed rule Yulan City in the future, advising him to recruit him if possible. When watching the footage, his Heart of the Ghost Realm instinctively feared Luo Feng, recognizing some danger.

When Yulan City was attacked by an army of Low-Level Hunyuan Lifeforms, Guifang was among the Elders who attempted to save Weiyang from the initial attack, and later led a group of elders in defending the city. After Luo Feng successfully defended the city, Guifang was among those who willingly left the Nine Rivers Sacred World, recognizing that Luo Feng would not allow the looting forces to remain in Yulan City. He was the only one of the looting force leaders who Palace Master Yuan Xiang attempted to persuade Luo Feng to allow to remain in the city.

characters.title: Mei Wu Family Branch Leader
characters.introText: A black-haired old man with branches and leaves growing on his body.
characters.appearance: A black-haired old man with branches and leaves growing on his body.
characters.history:
Mei Wu Family Branch Leader is the non-canon name given to the leader of the Mei Wu Family branch who lived in Hu Yang City. As the leader of one of the Five Major Families, he held great power within Hu Yang City.

After Luo Feng killed Mei Wu Qi, the family leader knew not to report the situation to the higher authorities in his family, as they would have punished the entire Hu Yang City branch for their negligence. Nevertheless, he was deeply antagonistic toward Luo Feng and sought to hire a powerful outsider to assassinate him.

When Luo Feng refused the position of Deputy Commander of the Hu Yang Legion, the family leader discussed the situation with the other leaders of the Five Major Families, and reiterated his suggestion of hiring an outsider to kill Luo Feng. He, Wu Qu Lou, and City Lord Qu Meng agreed to do so, and he agreed to begin the preparations by purchasing information on Luo Feng from the Flame Wind Guild Hall. To his surprise, the information cost 5,000 Universe Sands, despite Moli Xiao's information only costing 500! Learning that Ying Cang had died in his assassination attempt on Luo Feng, the family leaders agreed to bow their heads and apologize to Luo Feng.

As one of the leaders of the Five Major Families, he helped manage the defense of the City Lord's Mansion during the battles between Blood Cloud's forces and the forces of Hu Yang City. At the conclusion of the battles between Lord Liu Yin's and Lord Jiu Jiang's forces, he was resettled in another city of the Yu Kingdom, since Luo Feng had full control of the city.

characters.history: Meng 6 is one of the three Stellar Level 5 Spirit Master Black Meng Race slaves that Luo Feng purchased from Wu La on Horned Dragon Planet. Luo Feng named her Meng 6 because her real name was very long. She was purchased for 240 million Black Dragon Coins.
characters.trivia: In Episode 220 of the Donghua, she is still alive even after 120K+ years, which is more than the lifespan of the average Universe Level. Hence it can be speculated that she is at least at the Domain Master Level.

characters.title: Meng Huo
characters.introText: A dark red-eyed man dressed in a dark-red long robe. His eyes seemed to be looking from another dimension, giving a terrifying, heart-palpitating chill. Black flames burned in his surroundings.
characters.appearance: A dark red-eyed man dressed in a dark-red long robe. His eyes seemed to be looking from another dimension, giving a terrifying, heart-palpitating chill. Black flames burned in his surroundings.
characters.history:
Meng Huo is the God Leader of an unnamed region in Human Race territory, and Wo Te's teacher.

During Luo Feng's Pinnacle Genius Battle, he and his disciples watched Luo Feng's performance. When Wo Te expressed his desire to make Luo Feng his disciple, Meng Huo reminded him that they could not compete with the Ganwu Universe Country for Luo Feng. He pledged to help Wo Te find an exceptional disciple to whom he could pass down his techniques.

After Wo Te departed for his homeland, Meng Huo declared that he would find Kun Sha Luo and kill him for his deception that led to Wo Te's eventual death.

characters.title: Meng Qu

His parents died when he was a child, and after he grew up, he joined Sky Flame Sect, working very hard and studying every step of tool-refinement very carefully. Eventually, he passed many test and became Entropy Sky Flame's direct disciple.

He was killed in the battle between Blood Cloud and General Yong.

characters.title: Meng Ta

Meng Ta was a pinnacle Stage 3 Sector Beast who was hunted by Luo Feng. In the past, it fought Morosa multiple times, so it could be considered one of the more talented Sector Beasts.

After Luo Feng forced Bei Di to self-destruct, 6 million Sector Beasts sought his location to attack him. Luo Feng approached Meng Ta and attacked, using Star Tower and Pearl of the Golden Ocean to restrain it, hoping to enslave it. Meng Ta self-destructed to avoid being enslaved, and it shared Luo Feng's location before self-destruction.

His true body is an enormous snake, about 200 meters thick and 12 kilometers long. He is completely covered in blue-green scales, each with thousands of dense, ring-like lines. He has 6 flesh wings and one eye with a black pupil.
characters.history:
Meng Wei Na is an Immortal of the 10,000 Hidden Snake Clan of the Demon Race. As a member of a Royal Clan, he is referred to as His Majesty. His normal state is that of a High Immortal Army Lord, but when he unleashes his talents, he reaches close to Immortal Marquis-level.
After Tai Wo, Luo Feng, and Poison fought Qiu Shi Race's 20 World Masters and 2 Immortals, one of the Immortals fled, he asked for Wei Na's help to kill Tai Wo Squad. Meng Wei Na decided to ambush Tai Wo Squad because of the Universe Markers left behind in the loot. He was killed by Luo Feng as a Warrior.

characters.appearance: A human dressed in silver armor, with 6 eyes and blue skin.

Merlock received Luo Feng after the latter completed the Blood River World Mission, and brought him to the Tian Shi Palace on Tian Shi Palace Master's orders.

At the conclusion of the initial battle, Mie Jin brought Xue Zan Master and Burnt Catfish Master and the three escaped in Mie Jin's Palace Treasure.

infobox.affiliation: Three Axe Mountain (TAM) Universe Mercenary Alliance (UMA) Virtual Universe Company (VUC)

characters.introText: In the novel he is described as a tall and sturdy man, his entire body greenish-black, almost like it was made of steel. On the left side of his chest, on his battle robe, is a Universe Mercenary Alliance 2 Star Mercenary medal.

In the novel he is described as a tall and sturdy man, his entire body greenish-black, almost like it was made of steel. On the left side of his chest, on his battle robe, is a Universe Mercenary Alliance 2 Star Mercenary medal.

In the donghua, he looks like a tall and sturdy Earthling with dark-grey hair, wearing a suit of full-body armor, including something of a helmet. He appears to have secret engraving lines on his face.
characters.history:
Ming Yu is a Domain Master from the Virtual Universe Company, stationed at the Black Dragon Mountain Empire department, one of the external departments. He is also a commander from Three Axe Mountain, as well as a two-star member of the Universe Mercenary Alliance. Initially when Luo Feng, Hong, and Shen were training at Killing Fields, he observed them for 1 month before calling them over for a meeting at a restaurant in Virtual Universe. He wanted to recruit them to VUC as Internal Members, but settled for recruiting them as External Members and selling them Bloodline Evolution Agents.

When the trio entered the World Within a World on Cang Lan Planet, Ming Yu contacted Luo Feng in hopes of getting one of Kabu's treasures from the team. Another of his subordinates, Bendi, broke through to Universe Level and acquired the Sky Fire Wheel, but was killed by Brolin's forces. He was delighted when Luo Feng presented him with the Air Cutter Blade, and ultimately gave Luo Feng 100 Life Planets, 20 billion Universe Coins, and a promise to kill Nuolan Shan in exchange for it.

He brought Jiang Tian Chen and Time World Master Luo and introduced them to Luo Feng, Hong, and Thunder God when Luo wanted to meet Hong.

characters.title: Mist Envoy
characters.introText: the Mist Envoy is a powerful God King-level antagonist who operates as an assassin for the mysterious Shadow Heaven Realm organization. This being is known for its ability to manipulate the fabric of the world, turning vibrant environments into a decaying, grey landscape capable of eroding all things.
characters.appearance:
the Mist Envoy is a powerful God King-level antagonist who operates as an assassin for the mysterious Shadow Heaven Realm organization. This being is known for its ability to manipulate the fabric of the world, turning vibrant environments into a decaying, grey landscape capable of eroding all things.

As an envoy of Shadow Heaven Realm, the Mist Envoy is a highly skilled combatant who specializes in direct confrontation. His immense body serves as a deep reserve of energy, making him capable of withstanding even the most destructive attacks. The Mist Envoy's true form is the grey mist himself, and his resilience allows him to regenerate even after being seemingly worn away. His main weakness, however, is his mental fortitude; the Mist Envoy's will is only at the First Level God King Realm.

The Mist Envoy was hired to attack Luo Feng's disciples Moyu Qingyan and servants Morosa, but his true objective was to kill them right in front of him. During the confrontation, the Mist Envoy used his domain to turn the world grey and attacked with his entire body. Although his physical might was formidable, he was ultimately defeated when Luo Feng targeted his weaker mental will using the Lie Yuan Technique, annihilating the Mist Envoy completely and leaving behind only his liquid-like grey mist body.

characters.title: Miya Master
characters.introText: Miya Master was one of the top-10 Tier 6 Universe Masters sent by East Emperor Ancestor to capture Luo Feng after he successfully obtained the Duan Dong River Inheritance. Miya Master used a binding-type Xeon Arcana, but was unable to stop the Boat of Mausoleum.
characters.history: Miya Master was one of the top-10 Tier 6 Universe Masters sent by East Emperor Ancestor to capture Luo Feng after he successfully obtained the Duan Dong River Inheritance. Miya Master used a binding-type Xeon Arcana, but was unable to stop the Boat of Mausoleum.

characters.title: Mo Gu Si
characters.introText: Mo Gu Si is a reckless and unrestrained being who acts as he pleases, ignoring most conflicts. His sole obsession is devouring vast quantities of souls, showing a ruthless and predatory nature. He avoids direct involvement in faction disputes unless it serves his hunger, making him a dangerous and self-serving entity.
characters.personality: Mo Gu Si is a reckless and unrestrained being who acts as he pleases, ignoring most conflicts. His sole obsession is devouring vast quantities of souls, showing a ruthless and predatory nature. He avoids direct involvement in faction disputes unless it serves his hunger, making him a dangerous and self-serving entity.
characters.history:
Mo Gu Si is one of the top Primogenitor-level beings in the Chaotic Origin Dimension who hold a seat in the Eternal Land. Even among more than 200 primogenitor existences, he ranks in the top 10. Known for his immortality and near-indestructibility, he is a formidable threat. His body is made of soul energy, allowing him to merge with countless weaker beings, making him hard to track and kill. The Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction, unable to defeat him, instead allies with him by supplying Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform for him to consume. Mo Gu Si craves the abundant souls in the Cultivator Camp's territories, where countless Source Worlds teem with life. The Cultivators strictly forbid him from devouring their souls, pursuing him relentlessly if he tries. During the war between the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Camp and Cultivator Camp, Mo Gu Si infiltrated the Cultivator territories, gleefully consuming entire Source Worlds. After the war, Overlord Xing Mang hunted him across all spacetime, destroying 89% of his power and aiming for 99% to force him into a long recovery period. Despite past negotiations with the Cultivators when they were weaker, Mo Gu Si now faces constant pursuit from Overlord Xing Mang, who can track his hidden traces across past and future. His immortality makes him nearly impossible to kill unless all life in the Source Worlds is eradicated, stripping him of vessels to inhabit.

With his hatred for the Practitioner Faction at its peak, Mo Gu Si forged an alliance with the Infinite Serpent Ancestor, devised a strategy to crush the Lords in the impending clash, and tasked the Serpent with recruiting 6 Hunyuan Ancestors — each famed for their extraordinary soul prowess — to help launch Illusion Attacks against Yuan.
characters.trivia: Mo Gu Si used to be the ruler of 16th layer of the Chaos Destruction Realm, but he lost control over it after being relentlessly hunted by Overlord Xing Mang. With less than 10% of his life force remaining, he was too weak to defend his position and Kafuxiu took the opportunity to seize the 16th layer from him.

characters.title: Mo He

infobox.cultivation: Tier 6 Top Sector Beast Tier 13 Attack
infobox.enemies: Morosa Bei Di You Luo Feng

characters.introText: I, Mo He! I will protect the last remnant of the glory of our noble Sector Beast race. I will not allow that Milky Way Seigneur to tarnish our race!
characters.appearance: A giant black beast with two heads, much larger than Morosa. Its bloody engraving picture was more complicated. Each head had a horn, and the white lights on the horns were filled with endless destructive force. It held an axe in its right hand.
characters.history:
Mo He was the final free Sector Beast in Universe Ocean, and the final opponent Luo Feng had to defeat to prevent the birth of a free Sector Beast King.

After the self-destruction of Yuan Ao Master, Huge Axe Creator received a map of Tilted Peak Realm, which he hoped to use to acquire more Arcana. However, to his misfortune, the map that was provided was a fake, intended to trick the recipient into falling into a trap. Huge Axe Creator was able to fight off the ambushers, but fell into the Land of Darkness, eventually entering the Sector Beast nest. There, Mo He discovered him and killed him with soul attacks, obtaining his Xeon Arcana, Divine Axe.

During its time in the Sector Beast nest, Mo He got stronger, and was considered one of the more dangerous Sector Beasts. Mo He was one of the first Sector Beasts who acknowledged that Morosa had been enslaved. When Bei Di was attempting to reach Stage 5, it knew that Mo He was one of the few who had already reached Stage 4, and was thus racing against it to reach Stage 5 first. When Bei Di finally reached Stage 5, Mo He was the first Sector Beast it sought to hunt and kill, but it was interrupted by Luo Feng.

After Luo Feng slaughtered over 8 million Sector Beasts, the remaining Sector Beasts did their best to distract him from preventing the birth of a Stage 6 Sector Beast. Mo He was one of the two Stage 6 Sector Beasts who were born in this period, along with You. Due to the iron rules of the Sector Beasts, Mo He battled You to the death, killing it with its axe technique, devouring You, and becoming a pinnacle Stage 6 Sector Beast. At this point, the remaining free Sector Beasts self-destructed, leaving their hopes to Mo He and forcing the battle between the final free Sector Beast and the final enslaved Sector Beast, Morosa, to begin.

Mo He awaited the arrival of Luo Feng and Morosa, as it knew the final battle had to begin. After exchanging taunts with Morosa, Mo He revealed that it killed Huge Axe Creator, which was why it held the Xeon Arcana Divine Axe. Despite being unable to truly utilize it due to the differences in cultivation, it still merged its comprehension with the axe and used it as a tool, with its sturdiness and sharpness. It hoped to attack Luo Feng's mind by revealing its murder of Huge Axe Creator, but Luo Feng was unstirred, reminding Mo He that he killed more than 8 million Sector Beasts at one time!

Hoping to simply kill Morosa and avoid Luo Feng, Mo He immediately attacked, moving a million times light-speed to attack it, but was warded off by Luo Feng and his Door of Life technique. Using its Destruction Axe technique, which was 10 times stronger than Destruction, it thought to cast Luo Feng aside or kill him, but by using the third level of Wu Qi God, along with Blood Shadow Blade, Luo Feng's Door of Life was stronger than Destruction Axe, forcing Mo He to focus its attacks on Luo Feng rather than Morosa.

The battle began in earnest, with Mo He using its 10 Million Bodies technique to form one distinct Stage 6 Sector Beast body alongside it, and performing Reincarnation Passageway and Destruction with each body, creating the technique Destruction of Reincarnation! Luo Feng countered with the top-tier Level 12 technique River of Stars, utilizing Star Tower, but it was blasted away. He was forced to burn his godly power to its maximum, use the third level of Wu Qi God, and Blood Shadow Blade to again perform his strongest blade technique: Door of Life! Despite his power, his attack was inferior and his Divine Body was largely consumed. After defending against Destruction of Reincarnation 30 times, he was left with only 10% of his godly power. Mo He was confident that it would win; with its energy reserves as a pinnacle Stage 6 Sector Beast, it could repeatedly perform its ultimate technique, and it knew that Luo Feng was weakening.

It was with his back against the wall that Luo Feng's Willpower finally reached the Saint level, enabling him to perform Lie Yuan Technique! At that moment, everything in Mo He's surroundings suddenly disappeared, and it could only see Luo Feng's eyes, transformed into gigantic planets and emitting endless power. An extremely acute willpower attack then pierced through Mo He's willpower, causing its bodies to lose consciousness. Its soul was then directly attacked by an illusory beast head, and in that unconscious state, it could not resist, so its soul was instantly annihilated! At the conclusion of the battle, Mo He's force was absorbed into Morosa, birthing the Sector Beast King: Morosa.

characters.title: Mo Henderson

infobox.killer: Voluntary Soul Sacrifice Revived in sws2 chapter 390
infobox.family: Wife William Henderson (son) another unnamed son

characters.introText: In the novel, he has a tall and sturdy body, described as almost like a male lion. His Donghua appearance is inspired by Dwayne Johnson.
characters.appearance: In the novel, he has a tall and sturdy body, described as almost like a male lion. His Donghua appearance is inspired by Dwayne Johnson.
characters.personality: He is known for his peremptoriness. Will take a tough stance even with other Planetary fighters. The Palace of Gods of War received multiple complaints about him fighting other warriors.
characters.history:
He is the third elder of the Palace of Gods of War, the third-strongest human after Hong and Lei Shen, and the strongest hero from the United States of America, representing the American Continent. He defeated East, officially making him the third elder and the third-strongest human until Luo Feng's rise.

He first appears during the promotion ceremony where Luo Feng is promoted to representative level. Shortly afterwards, he followed many peak Planetary warriors to Mist Island upon discovery of a newly evolved emperor level Monster, Tentacle Beast. He helps defend the American Base established in Mist Island and joins the several Planetary fighters in looking for treasures. During the Hunt for Muya Crystals, he bumps into Luo Feng and they both get into a skirmish, where he is disadvantaged at first as his speed is barely able to catch up with the speed of Luo Feng's Soaring Shuttle Drill Formation, but eventually with the help of the Black God Suit, he is able to match the soaring shuttle. As he is about to retrieve the Muya Crystal, Luo Feng dismantles the soaring shuttle into multiple flying knife blades and toys with Mo Henderson by bouncing the crystal between the flying blades which enrages him. The crystal however is eaten by an Earth Dragon, which evolves from Beast Seigneur to Beast King.

He is also one of the Eight Heroes of the Earth who sacrificed his life for Luo Feng to kill Golden Horned Beast.
characters.trivia: It is assumed that this character has Law of Water  affinity due to his ice manipulation

characters.introText: Mo Dao is a legendary cultivator of the Dark Holy Realm renowned for achieving Invincible God Emperor status and transcending the Caged World. He was among the elite few who successfully exchanged a World-Class Chaotic Origin Bloodline at the Chaotic Palace - a feat accomplished by only 11 individuals in the realm's history. Through deep exploration of his bloodline powers Mo Dao unlocked unparalleled strength.
characters.history: Unlike most invincible cultivators who rely on spiritual will transcendence Mo Dao is one of the few known to succeed through bloodline power. This path is notably rare with only one recorded success in the Dark Holy Realm history. His cultivation also involved mastery of Great Daos to the Half Chaotic Origin Level though his ultimate breakthrough came from bloodline enhancement rather than dao fusion

characters.title: Mo Li Marquis
characters.introText: Every Zerg brood nest has an Zerg Queen presiding over it. She is like the queen bee in a beehive, manufacturing large numbers of Zerg warriors. Queens are few in number and are the only intelligent beings among the Zerg. Their bodies are fragile, but their psychic power is immense. A Queen who reaches the Immortal realm becomes the most terrifying existence under the Universe Venerable, capable of controlling Immortal-class Zerg legions to launch coordinated attacks.
characters.history:
An Immortal Zerg Queen lurking in Human Territory. She enslaved Yao Hai and his family.
After Luo Feng obtained the task to kill Yao Hai and succeeded, she used God Country Teleportation to attempt to kill Luo Feng using her Zerg Nest.
She was responsible for killing most of Luo Fengs fleet
characters.trivia: She managed to escape unscathed from Venerable Nine Swords, a Universe Venerable. As such she either possesses immense luck or Venerable Nine Swords was lacking.

characters.title: Mo Luo

infobox.affiliation_rank: Primal Secret Realm Genius (Previously) Absolute Beginning Secret Realm Genius

characters.introText: Initially he was a Primal Secret Realm Universe Level member. Because of the upcoming Secret Realm Qualification Battle, the universe level primal region members and their specific information had been collected by Luo Feng. Amongst the 3 seniors in Primal Secret Realm, Luo Feng actually had the most respect for Mo Luo.
characters.appearance:
Initially he was a Primal Secret Realm Universe Level member. Because of the upcoming Secret Realm Qualification Battle, the universe level primal region members and their specific information had been collected by Luo Feng. Amongst the 3 seniors in Primal Secret Realm, Luo Feng actually had the most respect for Mo Luo.

In private, he would secretly harm those who threaten his genius position and his ambition to be the top of cultivation. He does not like to be compared with other Virtual Universe Company human geniuses and would harbor jealousy to which he would act when the opportunity arose. His actions did not harm the Human Race, therefore, a blind eye was held, but upon aiming at Luo Feng, Mo Luo faced an inevitable doom.
characters.history:
Mo Luo came from the distant South Fox Universe Country. Originally an orphan of a barren planet that was the remains of war, alone without a name or identity, later the Mo family owned over a 1,000 life planets in territory and found a barracks to nurture its own death army. However during the process, Mo Luo displayed unbelievable talent hence he was quickly absorbed by the family and given the family name Mo.

Since then, his name became Mo Luo. After receiving the family’s full nurturing, his improvement grew even more absurd, even the elder of the family, a Universe Level 9 warrior had nothing left to teach him. Not long after, Mo Luo was discovered by members of the Virtual Universe Company (VUC) stationed within his region, and was immediately absorbed in as a special elite by the VUC.

The absorbed elites of the VUC had to compete amongst themselves too. Very quickly, he was absorbed as an Internal Member. During that same year, he passed the Sky Mountain and entered the Heaven and Earth Secret Realm. After two qualification battles, he made his way into the primal region! Becoming one of the high and mighty primal region members.

Luo Feng and the others were accepted as core members through the genius battles. Mo Luo however was one that gradually rose through the ranks after being absorbed as an elite. Hence he had respect for this Mo Luo. The first reason was because of his hardship and history. The second reason was because of his battle techniques, his self-created Beast fist. His Beast Fist, even King Zhenyan had complimented it. Luo Feng had seen footage of him using the beast fist, he was filled with respect.

characters.title: Mo Xu

lifeform: Chaotic Origin Lifeform#Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform

characters.introText: Mo Xu manifests as a colossal black cube with sharp edges and corners. His entire body is a single entity rather than a humanoid form. The cube constantly radiates a destructive energy flow that distorts its surrounding space.
characters.appearance: Mo Xu manifests as a colossal black cube with sharp edges and corners. His entire body is a single entity rather than a humanoid form. The cube constantly radiates a destructive energy flow that distorts its surrounding space.
characters.personality: Mo Xu is straightforward and enjoys direct confrontation. Unlike many other beings who avoid close combat, Mo Xu relishes fighting head-on, especially against opponents who can withstand his devastating strikes. He bears no personal grudges and treats powerful opponents like Luo Feng with a sense of respect and excitement.
characters.history:
Moxu is one of the five independent, immortal existences in the Eternal Land. His strength ranks among the top ten in the Chaotic Origin Dimension just below Sha Zhou and Xing Mang, showcasing his formidable power. Unaffiliated with any faction, Moxu sustains his influence through sheer strength and autonomy, appearing in the Eternal Land to observe the escalating conflicts without aligning with any side.

He was born imbued with the Power of Extremity and Power of Destruction. This gave him the nature of destructive force, while the extreme power endowed him Immortality.
characters.trivia: His Extreme Point strike is said to surpass the combined power of dozens of Primogenitors, though its narrow range of effect remains a fatal flaw.

characters.title: Mo Yi Lin
characters.introText: Mo Yi Lin is one of the senior Universe Level members of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm of the Virtual Universe Company. As a senior member, he had already spent thousands of years training as a core member, and had the strength necessary to pass the 6th level of the Tong Tian Bridge. As such, he was confident about beating the members of Luo Feng's class, and had beaten Wu Ka 8 consecutive times before Luo Feng had passed the 7th level of the bridge.
characters.appearance: A young man with silver-white scales on his face.
characters.history:
Mo Yi Lin is one of the senior Universe Level members of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm of the Virtual Universe Company. As a senior member, he had already spent thousands of years training as a core member, and had the strength necessary to pass the 6th level of the Tong Tian Bridge. As such, he was confident about beating the members of Luo Feng's class, and had beaten Wu Ka 8 consecutive times before Luo Feng had passed the 7th level of the bridge.

Mo Yi Lin and Ashi were contracted by Ni Nan to provoke Luo Feng and fight him, providing the seniors a chance to see Luo Feng's strength. The pair successfully provoked Luo Feng into battle by insulting Wu Ka, but were defeated in a 2 versus 1 battle by Luo Feng.

He later watched shock as Luo Feng defeated Sa Jin.

characters.title: Mo You Shang
characters.introText: Mo You Shang was a senior member of the Sky Flame Sect, and thus was a disciple of Entropy Sky Flame. She met Moyu Liuxing during his time at the sect, and eventually the pair got married. She was devastated when her master was killed by Blood Cloud, and after the sect disbanded, she and her husband established the Moyu Tool-Refining Shop.
characters.history:
Mo You Shang was a senior member of the Sky Flame Sect, and thus was a disciple of Entropy Sky Flame. She met Moyu Liuxing during his time at the sect, and eventually the pair got married. She was devastated when her master was killed by Blood Cloud, and after the sect disbanded, she and her husband established the Moyu Tool-Refining Shop.

The happily married couple conceived a child, Moyu Fengqiu, but Mo You Shang was still pregnant when her husband was murdered by the Heart Shadow Sect.

characters.title: Moli Feiyun
characters.introText: A well-built, armored woman. She has four purple horns that look like a crown on her head, and purple eyes, with purple flames burning within.
characters.appearance: A well-built, armored woman. She has four purple horns that look like a crown on her head, and purple eyes, with purple flames burning within.
characters.history:
Moli Feiyun is a Void True God of the Moli Family, and thus spends a lot of her time in Hu Yang City. As a member of one of the elite units of the Hu Yang Legion, she helps control the legion-type Mechanical Treasure Chi Yi Long. She has great respect for Gao Wu Shui, who leads their unit.

When returning to Hu Yang City, her team discovered Luo Feng, an Eternal True God who they did not know. She reported to her father, Moli Meng, who informed her that he was aware and had his information.

characters.title: Moli Lian
characters.introText: He has the typical appearance of a member of the Moli Family, with four purple horns on his head like a crown and eyes burning with purple flames.
characters.appearance: He has the typical appearance of a member of the Moli Family, with four purple horns on his head like a crown and eyes burning with purple flames.
characters.history:
Moli Lian is a genius of the younger generation of the Moli Family, a Void True God with great hope of breaking through to Eternal True God. He receives personal guidance from the Supreme Commander of the Hu Yang Legion, Moli Xiao.

As a talented member of the top family in Hu Yang City, he is spoiled and used to having his way. On a visit to Dream Flower Tower, he attempted to take Alaya to have as the personal musician of the family. When she refused, one of the waiters attempted to persuade her to reconsider, at which time Luo Feng arrived and explicitly told Moli Lian and Duan Mo Yun that they were no longer allowed in Dream Flower Tower.

His envy and jealousy toward Gao Wu Shui led him to manipulate him into confronting Mei Wu Qi. By informing him of the heinous crimes Mei Wu Qi committed, he knew that he could stir up trouble by getting Gao Wu Shui to attempt to arrest him. His fellow clan member, Moli Feiyun, tried to stop this from happening, and informed her father, but it did not prevent the confrontation.

characters.title: Moli Meng
characters.introText: A middle-aged man with four purple horns on his head.
characters.appearance: A middle-aged man with four purple horns on his head.
characters.history:
Moli Meng is an Eternal True God, current leader of the Moli Family, son of Moli Xiao, and Deputy City Lord of Hu Yang City.

Moli Meng reviewed the information that was sent by the City Lord's Mansion about Luo Feng after he purchased Chaos A No. 913. He also warned his daughter, Moli Feiyun, that even though Luo Feng was given the weakest strength rating, that was due to his true power being unknown.
As the Deputy City Lord, he kept himself updated on the City Lord's Mansion's intelligence, learning that Luo Feng suppressed the Blood Python Guild, and that the mansion upgraded his rating to the highest level, 'A'. In this capacity, he also visited Mu Yang to collect the territory fees that the Blood Python Guild owed. While collecting the fees, he warned Mu Yang that his organization had gone too far in some matters, and that there was no way that they would be allocated a higher killing quota.

Due to his daughter's relationship with Diao Rong Qi, he was very familiar with her, offering her 20,000 Universe Sands to take over the businesses left behind after Diao Rong Yan was murdered. He also shared his thoughts on the murder and the possibility that it truly was Mu Yang. Later, he visited the Blood Python Guild headquarters and admonished Mu Yang, warning him that he may not be able to bear the consequences of his actions.
With his stature, he was one of those who received Mu Yang's dying message that Luo Feng killed him, along with some details on the Mechanical Treasures that Luo Feng now possessed after the battle. Moli Meng remarked that while the treasures were tempting, Luo Feng was too mysterious to take on in battle. He also decided not to inform his father, not wishing for him to take such a big risk. Overhearing Feiyun and Rong Qi discussing Mu Yang's death, he expressed his surprise that Luo Feng helped her after hearing her plight. Understanding her excitement, as well as the attention now being paid to Luo Feng, he told her to wait before visiting to thank him, and that he would take her to visit him discreetly.

During this time, Moyu Hu was recruited by the City Lord's Mansion, and he worked for them as an official. Leveraging this relationship, Moli Meng sent Luo Feng a message through Moyu Qingyan, stating that he wanted to visit. After Luo Feng agreed, he brought Rong Qi, as promised, to meet her father's avenger. Sharing his admiration for Luo Feng's strength, he detailed the struggles of the City Lord's Mansion in maintaining the city's order. He then attempted to recruit Luo Feng to kill the leader of the Food Kingdom's forces in the city, Blood Cloud, but declined to go forward with it after Luo Feng named his price. Telling Luo Feng he would work on increasing the bounty for Blood Cloud, as well as figuring out a way to find him, he brought up Mu Yang's dying message, warning him that the alleged Mechanical Treasures he had might attract terrifying figures from outside the city to attack him.
True to his warning, Ying Cang unsuccessfully attempted to assassinate Luo Feng. Seeking to persuade Luo Feng that despite the recent conflict between the Five Major Families and Luo Feng, they were not responsible for the attempt on his life, Moli Meng personally visited Luo Feng. Due to him souring on the Five Major Families, Luo Feng was terse with Moli Meng, startling him and prompting him to explain that while some of the Five Major Families were in the city just to enjoy themselves his Moli Family was there to do hard work. He further explained that while the Moli Family did not wish to be his enemy, he knew the other families would not give up, so he would try his best to mediate the conflict.

Due to the direct intervention of Moli Xiao and City Lord Qu Meng, tensions eased between the Five Major Families and Luo Feng. When Luo Feng sought to sell the World Sword he obtained by killing Ying Cang, he reached out to Moli Meng as the representative of the City Lord's Mansion. Shortly after the sale of the World Sword, Moli Meng contacted Luo Feng, warning him that the Food Kingdom's forces might be attempting to capture Entropy Sky Flame as part of their effort to capture multiple formation masters. After Luo Feng finished his seclusion to complete his third body-refinement, Moli Meng accompanied Moli Xiao as he hired Luo Feng to help defend one of the core areas of the city in exchange for a bottle of Black Pool Venom. He directly delivered the venom to Luo Feng and warned him of the dangers of taking it.

As the Deputy City Lord, Moli Meng was among those who dealt with the aftermath of the battle between Blood Cloud and General Yong. Due to his status, he received a direct message from Entropy Sky Flame and a secret letter from Uncle Qiu after the former was killed by Blood Cloud. Surprised that Sang Shui Yun was the heavily pursued Blood Cloud, as he thought about how to locate him, he was overjoyed to see that Entropy Sky Flame had a Causality Tracking Order containing Blood Cloud's causality. Continuing to read the letter, he saw that the tracking order was in the Flame Wind Guild Hall, and he immediately reported the information to his father, the only one who could go to retrieve the tracking order.

In the ensuing battle between Luo Feng and Blood Cloud's forces, Moli Meng realized that it was likely Luo Feng who killed Yu Tian Hu and Yu Tian Yi. Remembering the connection between Luo Feng and Entropy Sky Flame, he directly contacted Luo Feng for details, then told him he would provide information on Blood Cloud's location as soon as he could. After discussing with the gathered forces in the City Lord's Mansion, Moli Meng, at General Yong's order, contacted Luo Feng so they could pass him the tracking order. Watching Luo Feng leave with Morosa, he was surprised that a Void True God was being brought to what would be a battle between absolutely elite Eternal True Gods, and was informed by General Yong that it was likely that Morosa was actually Luo Feng's assigned protector. After Luo Feng killed Blood Cloud, Moli Meng, General Yong, and the heads of the Five Major Families met him and expressed their gratitude for his efforts.

characters.title: Moli Xiao
characters.introText: Typical of a member of the Moli Family, he has 4 purple horns and eyes that burn with purple flames. His face looks a bit old.
characters.appearance: Typical of a member of the Moli Family, he has 4 purple horns and eyes that burn with purple flames. His face looks a bit old.
characters.history:
Moli Xiao is the supreme commander of the Hu Yang Legion, and a member of the Moli Family. His favorite disciple is Gao Wu Shui. A powerful Eternal True God, Moli Xiao was sent by Yu Shui Kingdom Master to take charge of Hu Yang City, and he is the most powerful person on the side of the Five Major Families of the City Lord's Mansion. He has the best Legion-type Mechanical Treasure in the city, the Six-Armed Divine Owl, and his personal guard corps is also extremely elite.

The Flame Wind Guild Hall's Dark Hall has a bounty task to kill him, with a bounty of 1.2 million Universe Sands, the highest bounty offered for anyone in Hu Yang City. It costs 500 Universe Sands to purchase all information about him from the Flame Wind Guild Hall. He has battled Blood Cloud many times in the past, and despite using the Six-Armed Divine Owl and the Hu Yang City Formation, he has never been able to capture or kill him.

When Luo Feng began his attack on the Blood Python Guild headquarters, Moli Xiao ordered the Vine Dragon Legion to ensure that no innocent people were affected by the battle. After the battle, he and Jiang Cheng Rong discussed the result, and he understood that the culprit was incredibly strong, but also someone unfamiliar. Later, he watched the footage at the City Lord's Mansion and determined that Luo Feng had no ill intentions toward them.

Moli Xiao ensured that his disciple, Gao Wu Shui, became one of the top-10 commanders of the Hu Yang Guard after he broke through to Eternal True God, and entrusted him with the Three Swords Sky-Splitting Beast. He expressed his satisfaction with Wu Shui's talent when his disciple visited him after mastering the moves of the treasure, and told him of his plans to eventually name him a commander of a Hu Yang Legion. Due to his position, he refused to take action when Luo Feng captured Qian Yu Chong and Mei Wu Qi, forcing the City Lord's Mansion to send the Hei Ming Legion instead. At some point, he also issued an order prohibiting the Moli Family from becoming Luo Feng's enemy, understanding his strength.

When the Five Major Families discussed hiring someone to attack Luo Feng after he refused the position of Hu Yang Legion Deputy Commander, Moli Xiao voted against that action. He knew of Ying Cang's strength, and after the group learned that Ying Cang died in his assassination attempt on Luo Feng, Moli Xiao joined City Lord Qu Meng and his son, Moli Meng in visiting Luo Feng. During that meeting, he expressed support for Luo Feng's killing of Mei Wu Qi, and stated that the City Lord's Mansion would work harder to punish and deter the Eternal True Gods of the Five Major Families. He directly told Luo Feng that they had to respect his strength due to the cost of acquiring information about him from the Flame Wind Guild Hall.

Since he was the leader of the forces representing the City Lord's Mansion, Moli Xiao took charge of their forces in the initial battles with the Food Kingdom's forces. He was aware of the Food Kingdom's capture of 8 Eternal True God formation masters, and learned of their efforts to acquire information about the Hu Yang City Formation. He and the others agreed to report the actions to Lord Jiu Jiang. As the conflict began to escalate, Moli Xiao and Moli Meng, representing the City Lord's Mansion, visited Luo Feng in hopes of getting his assistance. After discussing with City Lord Qu Meng, they agreed to give Luo Feng a bottle of Black Pool Venom, and Moli Xiao took Luo Feng to the location he'd be defending.

When Blood Cloud, Yu Tian Hu, Yu Tian Yi, and their subordinates launched their attacks on the forbidden areas of Hu Yang City, Moli Xiao piloted the Six-Armed Divine Owl and clashed directly with Yu Tian Hu. Despite his use of the Hu Yang City Formation to suppress his opponent, he was shocked to find that he was only able to lightly injure him. At the conclusion of the battle, he messaged Luo Feng to inform him that he had completed his mission. Moli Xiao was the only person who could collect the Causality Tracking Order that Entropy Sky Flame left in the Flame Wind Guild Hall, and he was concerned that it would be difficult to find someone strong enough to come to the city and defeat Blood Cloud. After Luo Feng killed Yu Tian Hu and Yu Tian Yi, Moli Xiao was among those who met Luo Feng to give him the Causality Tracking Order so he could find and kill Blood Cloud.

Moli Xiao and City Lord Qu Meng met with Feng Yu Qi of the Heart Shadow Sect, hoping to persuade him not to affect Hu Yang City, but he could only watch as the sect claimed one cave residence in Chaos Zone A after another. At his suggestion, the ordinary members of the Five Major Families were allowed to stay in the cave residence secret treasure during the sect's invasion. He was amazed at the strength Luo Feng displayed in his attacks against the sect, and he understood that due to Luo Feng's Willpower, neither the Heart Devil Hawk nor the Six Shadow Killing Formation could exert their full strength against him.

After the resolution of the War over Hu Yang City, Moli Xiao (due to his value as a subordinate) was resettled elsewhere within the Yu Kingdom, taking most of the Moli Family with him. He left 3 Eternal True Gods behind to assist Moli Meng, who continued to serve as the Deputy City Lord.

characters.title: Molly
characters.introText: Molly is one of the three founders of Three Axe Mountain, along with Luo and Lament. As such, she holds the title of Head General. As a Domain Master, she earned the Huge Axe Warrior title, which is exceptionally rare. Despite coming from a different Starfield than Luo and Lament, the three got along extremely well, becoming life-and-death comrades! Since all three were Huge Axe Warriors, they built the organization Three Axe Mountain. In the beginning, Lament and Molly assisted Luo, who was the leader. Later, she and Lament both became Immortal, while Luo remained a World Master, focused on his own goals.

characters.title: Monarch Feng Xing

infobox.Aliases: Wind Punishment Monarch Feng Xing Lord

characters.introText: Monarch Feng Xing was one of the nine Monarchs of Thunder Ancient Kingdom, all of whom had reached the Ultimate God King cultivation realm through Chaotic Origin Bloodline and served directly under the authority of the First Ancestor Thunder. Though a Monarch of considerable power and prestige, Feng Xing’s status, like that of his peers, was entirely dependent on the Ancestor, who cultivated and used such subordinates across different Source World eras as tools to secure treasure lands and resources.
characters.appearance:
Monarch Feng Xing was one of the nine Monarchs of Thunder Ancient Kingdom, all of whom had reached the Ultimate God King cultivation realm through Chaotic Origin Bloodline and served directly under the authority of the First Ancestor Thunder. Though a Monarch of considerable power and prestige, Feng Xing’s status, like that of his peers, was entirely dependent on the Ancestor, who cultivated and used such subordinates across different Source World eras as tools to secure treasure lands and resources.

When the Milky Way Kingdom Lord (Luo Feng) rose with strength surpassing the God King level and slew Emperor Yuan, the Monarchs grew restless. During a council in the ancient hall of Thunder Mountain, Feng Xing openly questioned whether they must endure such dominance forever. This breach of submission displeased the Thunder Ancestor, who immediately decreed punishment: Feng Xing was ordered to venture into Wind Valley of the Heavenly Pillar Realm. There, he was to either obtain a secret treasure as atonement or perish within.

Monarch Feng Xing’s case epitomizes the harsh order of Thunder Mountain. Despite their realm as Ultimate God Kings, Monarchs like Feng Xing remained expendable in the eyes of the Ancestor cherished at the beginning of an era but disposable by its end. His fate underscores the Ancestor’s doctrine that only strength determines order, and that even Monarchs at the Ultimate God King realm could be cast aside when they faltered in loyalty or usefulness.

characters.title: Monarch Lan Duo
characters.introText: He has a body covered with blue and white scales, and three scaly tails, as well as a holy face and cold eyes.
characters.appearance: He has a body covered with blue and white scales, and three scaly tails, as well as a holy face and cold eyes.
characters.history:
Monarch Lan Duo was one of the 9 Monarchs of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom, and was thus an Ultimate God King lifeform. He and Emperor Xuan were the only two from the Ancient Kingdoms who have the Chaotic Origin Bloodline of water.

Lan Duo patrolled the Heavenly River Treasure Land and killed the bodies of all God Kings who were neither a Guest Official of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom nor a member of the Imperial Families of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom or the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom.

Monarch Lei Xiao is one of the 9 Great Monarchs of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom, and the current ruling Monarch. It is implied that he follows the Chaotic Origin Bloodline of the Thunder Lineage.

Jia Yin God King is the subordinate that he values the most.

characters.title: Monarch White Devil
characters.introText: Monarch White Devil is a Monarch of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom. He and Monarch Lan Duo captured a large number of creatures within the Thunder Ancient Kingdom over 70 periods. This activity was eventually uncovered by Wu Xin God King, leading to Luo Feng learning this from Morosa.
characters.appearance: A white-skinned old man.
characters.history:
Monarch White Devil is a Monarch of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom. He and Monarch Lan Duo captured a large number of creatures within the Thunder Ancient Kingdom over 70 periods. This activity was eventually uncovered by Wu Xin God King, leading to Luo Feng learning this from Morosa.

When Luo Feng informed First Ancestor Thunder of the atrocities, the ancestor ordered White Devil and Lan Duo to go to Heavenly Pillar Realm to find either a natural secret treasure or the remains of a special lifeform, otherwise they would die.

Luo Feng killed White Devil when the latter arrived at the Heavenly Pillar Realm at First Ancestor Thunder's orders, using the combination of the Lie Yuan Technique and an Ultimate God King Technique executed through Star Tower, Meteor.

infobox.cultivation: True God-equivalent Void True God-equivalent Eternal True God-equivalent Primal Chaos Sovereign-equivalent God King Category:God King Second Level God King Category:Second Level God King Ultimate God King Category:Ultimate God King
infobox.affiliation: Blade River Sect Milky Way God Kingdom

characters.introText: Number One Master of Universe Ocean. Is that so? I, Morosa, shall not confront you head-on. I shall first feed myself with delicious food, and when my powers are stronger, I will come and see for myself just how powerful you are. See if you are more powerful than Bei Di.
characters.appearance:
A giant monster emitting black light from every inch of its body. It had two ferocious heads, and on each head was a single eye, a nose, and a mouth. It had one pair of arms and one pair of legs and was completely naked. Its tongue could sweep its entire body.

After becoming the Sector Beast King, it is incomparably beautiful, even more beautiful than a Zerg Race empress. It is a giant, fair-skinned, flawless lifeform with two arms and two legs, a mouth, a nose, and two eyes, but no ears. It has two horns on its forehead that point forward, and its skin condenses into armor. It looked holy, beautiful, and natural, containing supreme mysteries, and without its horns, it would have looked like a lovable child. With those two horns, however, it had supreme royal power.
characters.history:
As a Stage 3 Sector Beast upon its arrival in Universe Ocean, Morosa was slightly stronger than Blood Orchid Ancestor and slightly weaker than Nine-Headed Devil Master. However, due to its special abilities, such as devouring Divine Power, Black Mist Cocoon, 99 Bodies, Silent Scream, Blood Burning Method, and Sector Light Passageway, Morosa was extremely difficult to fight and even more difficult to capture or kill. Its soul attacks in particular were incredibly powerful; even as a Stage 3 Sector Beast, its Willpower and soul attacks were on the level of an Eternal True God! As a rival to Bei Di, Morosa could be considered one of the Sector Beasts with the strongest foundation, Willpower, and techniques.

After its battle with Nine-Headed Devil Master's team, Morosa had devoured some origins of Miniature Universes, increasing its strength to the level of Nine-Headed Devil Master. However, when escaping Luo Feng at the conclusion of their 3rd battle, Morosa was forced to use Sector Light Passageway, reverting it to the pinnacle of Stage 1.

When Morosa returned to the Sector Beast nest and devoured an injured Stage 2 Sector Beast, it returned to Stage 2, and after converting and absorbing more energies from Miniature Universe origins, it reached pinnacle Stage 2 again.

Morosa reached limit Stage 5 after devouring the 8 other enslaved Sector Beasts under Luo Feng's control, and due to the influence of the supreme laws, it faced no obstacles, as a Sector Beast King had to be born. As a Stage 5 Sector Beast, it innately learned Destruction, and retained its previous abilities, including Sector Light Passageway and Sector Light Domain. When a Stage 5 Sector Beast performed Destruction, it was strong enough to destroy a Miniature Universe, so you could consider it comparable to the attack power of a Limit Void True God.

At the conclusion of the battle between Luo Feng and Mo He, Morosa absorbed the energies of all of the Sector Beasts, becoming the Sector Beast King. Morosa confirmed that it was the equivalent to a Void True God at this point, but with the special ability to not be forced into transcending reincarnation. The promotion to king was truly transcendent, as it retained the ability 10 Million Bodies, and it could breed many powerful warriors, each much stronger than a Stage 6 Sector Beast! It also obtained the ability Intangible and Formless, and could continue to comprehend the origin of destruction to get stronger. It only took Morosa one day to devour the Purple Moon Holy Land Universe, something that would have required 100,000 years for a Stage 2 or Stage 3 Sector Beast!

After six trillion eras of continued growth, Morosa reached the level of an Eternal True God. If allowed to fully mature as the Sector Beast King, Morosa could even surpass a God King.

On the Continent of Origin, Morosa initially had the strength of an extremely powerful Eternal True God, and with his special abilities, he was able to even kill great beings like Ying Cang in one move. Luo Feng considered Morosa's Realm to be higher than his, despite him knowing multiple Primal Chaos Sovereign Techniques himself. With his Perfect Divine Body, he had a height of 18 billion kilometers (in the Continent of Origin environment) when at the Eternal True God realm, and his height limit at the Primal Chaos Sovereign realm exceeded 1 trillion kilometers.

As a perfect lifeform, at every realm, Morosa's strength can be considered the ultimate level, perfect in every aspect. With his unique skills, he can hide his true strength while still suppressing the vast majority of those in the same cultivation realm. His strength grows comprehensively, with his body evolution, soul growth, willpower, and comprehension of the Origin of Destruction all increasing at the same time. As a Second Level God King, his willpower reached the bottleneck of the Limit God King! After reaching Ultimate God King, he naturally comprehended 36 Ultimate God King Techniques!
characters.trivia: In Swallowed Star, Morosa is always referred to with the gender-neutral pronoun 'it' (它(Tā)), but in Swallowed Star 2, Morosa is explicitly referred to as 'he' (他(Tā))

infobox.affiliation: Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction Eternal Land

characters.introText: Mother of Space-Time is one of the Nine Sovereigns of the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction and one of the four primogenitor of the faction who hold a seat in the Eternal Land. She is not known for overwhelming offensive power in fact, in terms of combat ability, she ranks in the mid-to-lower tier among the many Primogenitors/Ancestors. What makes her place among the Nine Sovereigns secure is her Immortality and indestructible nature, a trait shared with only a few other beings like The Original Ancestor.
characters.appearance:
Mother of Space-Time is one of the Nine Sovereigns of the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction and one of the four primogenitor of the faction who hold a seat in the Eternal Land. She is not known for overwhelming offensive power in fact, in terms of combat ability, she ranks in the mid-to-lower tier among the many Primogenitors/Ancestors. What makes her place among the Nine Sovereigns secure is her Immortality and indestructible nature, a trait shared with only a few other beings like The Original Ancestor.

During the war between Cultivator Camp and Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction, Mother of Space-Time often plays a supportive role, helping to rescue severely wounded allies. During the all out assault on the cultivator camp, she worked in together with The Original Ancestor to extract and protect injured Primogenitors/Ancestors, allowing the main force to continue attacking without hesitation.

She is known for her deep comprehension of time, although it is explicitly stated that her mastery over time and Space is inferior to two others:

Her Space mastery is not as high as Infinite Serpent Ancestor.

Her Time mastery falls short of Overlord Xing Mang.

Because of these limitations, her direct impact on large-scale time-space techniques (like Xing Mang’s “Time-Space Maze”) is limited. However, her strategic presence is still significant, especially in terms of survival and battlefield control.

As the only child of Liuxing, he is favored by the Moyu Family and is a powerful figure in Hu Yang City. Due to his mediocre character, Luo Feng did not choose to cultivate him.
