characters.title: Moyu Hu
characters.introText: A tall man with a sharp tail, wearing dark green armor.
characters.appearance: A tall man with a sharp tail, wearing dark green armor.
characters.personality: Moyu Hu is different from many on the Continent of Origin in that he truly cares about the lives of his children. He's a polite and trustworthy man, completely earning Luo Feng's trust, and he reminds Moyu Qingyan not to become arrogant or make Luo Feng dislike him.
characters.history:
Moyu Hu is a Void True God who lives in Hu Yang City. His residence is a small cave residence that he purchased for 1,000 Chaos Crystals. Earlier in his life, he met his true love, married her, and raised 3 children together with her. Other than his own cultivation and growth, his three children are the only things he cares about.

In an exploration outside of the city, he found the Moyu Hammer, which he hoped to use to get his children an Eternal True God as a teacher. He was captured by Luo Feng, who sought knowledge about his whereabouts and directions to Hu Yang City. Luo Feng kept Moyu Hu with him as he traveled to the city, protecting him from the repercussions of his battle with Hei Duo Mo.

After arriving in Hu Yang City, Luo Feng offered Moyu Hu a favor, which he cashed in later to ask for Luo Feng to take one of his children as a servant. He was overjoyed when Moyu Qingyan became Luo Feng's servant, but wasn't surprised that his other children (Moyu Liuxing and Moyu Liefeng) declined the offer.

Moyu Hu also worked hard on the behalf of Liuxing and Liefeng, sending the former to the Sky Flame Sect and sending the latter to the Zhu Family. Due to his relationship with Luo Feng and Luo Feng's increase in prestige after killing Mu Yang, Moyu Hu was recruited by the City Lord's Mansion as a way to get closer to him. In this capacity, he ended up becoming an assistant to Moli Meng, the acting leader of the Moli Family and the deputy city lord. With this, his family established a relationship with two of the most powerful families in city.

Moyu Hu's youngest son, Moyu Liuxing, died During the Heart Shadow Sect invasion of Hu Yang City, bringing him great anguish. He understood that despite his anger, he was far too weak to take revenge, and he hoped that Luo Feng would be able to rescue the rest of his family and help them escape the city. He was among the group who watched the clash between Yue Wu's formation and the Heart Shadow Sect's two formation. When Yue Wu's formation successfully made it to the City Lord's Mansion, Moyu Hu took Luo Feng up on his offer and joined his family in Luo Feng's space treasure. During the ceasefire between Lord Liu Yin and Lord Jiu Jiang's forces, Moyu Qingyan broke through to Void True God and Luo Feng accepted him as his disciple. Moyu Hu attended the acceptance ceremony and was very excited for his son.

After the battle, Luo Feng became the owner of Hu Yang City and named Moyu Hu a deputy city lord, ordering him to serve in this position alongside Moli Meng. With his familiarity with the city's administrative affairs, he was qualified, but he was excited for the opportunity. Following Luo Feng's orders, he worked to streamline the management of the city. Due to his relationship with the Zhu Family, Moyu Hu also served as a counterbalance against Moli Meng and his Moli Family.

Moyu Hu saw his son, Moyu Qingyan, after the latter was protected from Mist Envoy by Luo Feng. When talking with him in the City Lord's Mansion, he expressed his pleasure with his son and reminded him to never grow arrogant and make Luo Feng dislike him. He was exceptionally happy for his son's opportunity and his increasingly bright future.

Later, Moyu Hu and Moli Meng informed Luo Feng of the Food Kingdom's invasion of the border cities, with even Primal Chaos Sovereigns taking part. He was shocked to hear that Yu Shui Kingdom Master could not immediately return to give orders, but Luo Feng told the pair that the king would return fairly soon.

After Luo Feng's first battle with Tian Kun, the territory he controlled reached 20 Chaos States. Moyu Hu and Moli Meng were no longer capable of managing such a large territory, so the duties were mainly passed to Morosa and Ancestor Yuan.

characters.title: Moyu Liefeng
characters.introText: The strongest-looking of his three siblings, with eyes like knives.
characters.appearance: The strongest-looking of his three siblings, with eyes like knives.
characters.history:
Moyu Liefeng is the eldest son of Moyu Hu. A True God Level 9, he would be considered exceptionally powerful in the Original Universe, but on the Continent of Origin he is fairly weak.

When brought to Luo Feng to be his servant in hopes of becoming his disciple, Liefeng declined being his servant due to the difficulty of understanding the 10 Original Laws. After this, Moyu Hu worked to send him to the Zhu Family. Later, in an effort to establish a friendship with Luo Feng, Zhu You accepted Liefeng as his disciple. Over 20 periods after declining Luo Feng's offer, he had broken through to Void True God.

After the Heart Shadow Sect killed Moyu Liuxing, Liefeng swore to avenge him. He gathered members of the family to be rescued from the invasion by Luo Feng, and was present for Moyu Qingyan's acceptance ceremony for becoming Luo Feng's disciple. Through his status as Zhu You's direct disciple, he established a connection between the Moyu Family and the Zhu Family, giving his father adequate backing to counterbalance Moli Meng and the Moli Family.

Later, despite his talent and resources, he was still a Void True God. However, due to his love for his brother, he was not jealous that Qingyan broke through to Eternal True God, only telling him to have some children.

characters.title: Moyu Liuxing
characters.introText: Moyu Liuxing was the youngest of Moyu Hu's three sons. He was considered more talented than his older brother, Moyu Qingyan. As a True God Level 6, he was considered weak on the Continent of Origin. His growth period was the most comfortable of the three brothers.
characters.history:
Moyu Liuxing was the youngest of Moyu Hu's three sons. He was considered more talented than his older brother, Moyu Qingyan. As a True God Level 6, he was considered weak on the Continent of Origin. His growth period was the most comfortable of the three brothers.

When brought to Luo Feng to be his servant in hopes of becoming his disciple, Liuxing declined being his servant due to the possibility of danger. His father worked to send him to the Sky Flame Sect, and he was successful due to his relationship with Luo Feng.

By the 27th period after Luo Feng's arrival on the Continent of Origin, Liuxing had become a Void True God and was a teacher within the Sky Flame Sect. During his time within the sect, he met his wife, Mo You Shang.

When the Heart Shadow Sect invaded Hu Yang City, Liuxing was among those of the Sky Flame Sect who were killed. His unborn child, Moyu Fengqiu, was still within Mo You Shang at the time of his death.

characters.introText: Moyu Qingyan is the middle son of Moyu Hu. He is considered the least talented of his brothers, and, as a True God Level 6, is considered weak on the Continent of Origin.
characters.history:
Moyu Qingyan is the middle son of Moyu Hu. He is considered the least talented of his brothers, and, as a True God Level 6, is considered weak on the Continent of Origin.

When Moyu Hu brings his sons for Luo Feng to choose one as a servant, Qingyan is the only one who accepts the opportunity, despite Luo Feng's upcoming conflicts with the Eternal True Gods of Hu Yang City (which caused Moyu Liuxing to decline) and the difficulty of comprehending the Original Laws when one follows the Bloodline Cultivation Method path (which caused Moyu Liefeng to decline).

Eventually, after over 30 periods of cultivation and learning under Morosa, he breaks through to Void True God by mastering the 10 basic origin laws. As a result, Luo Feng accepted him as his disciple.

Around 90 periods into Luo Feng's time guarding Xiang Jie City, Moyu Qingyan broke through to Eternal True God through the bloodline cultivation method, and served as the Inspector General of the city. During this period, he met Zhang Yun Ge, who he later married. But now they are separated because Zhang Yun Ge wanted to focus on cultivation and didn't want to get distracted by emotions.

After getting advice from Ancestor Yuan, Morosa and Luo Feng and repeatedly studying their advice, he finally broke through to Primal Chaos Sovereign, becoming the second under Luo Feng's tutelage to do so.

In the later era Mo Yu Qingyan became the Dao Companion of Yu Shui Tianxin, princess of Yu Kingdom. Together they have a son, Mo Yu Xiu, noted for his well-behaved nature. Both Mo Yu Qingyan and Yu Shui Tianxin attained the Primal Chaos Sovereign Realm through the Bloodline path, and their union further solidified the alliance between Blade River Sect and Yu Kingdom. Their child, Mo Yu Xiu, received early recognition and guidance from Morosa and was even bestowed a rare cultivation treasure worth of 8 millions Merits by Luo Feng.

characters.title: Moyu Xiu
characters.introText: He is the son of Moyu Qingyan and Yu Shui Tianxin. Since Morosa likes Moyu Qingyan, he decides to teach Moyu Xiu.
characters.appearance: He is the son of Moyu Qingyan and Yu Shui Tianxin. Since Morosa likes Moyu Qingyan, he decides to teach Moyu Xiu.

characters.title: Mr. Zheng
characters.introText: Mr. Zheng is Di Chu Yu's old servant. He was left behind by Chu Yu's mother, and took care of him when he was at his weakest. While he is called a servant, he is Di Chu Yu's close relative. Chu Yu is quite close to him, unlike his relationship with his wife.
characters.history: Mr. Zheng is Di Chu Yu's old servant. He was left behind by Chu Yu's mother, and took care of him when he was at his weakest. While he is called a servant, he is Di Chu Yu's close relative. Chu Yu is quite close to him, unlike his relationship with his wife.

characters.title: Mu Lin
characters.introText: A thin figure. When using his ability, his body breaks down into countless poisonous insects.
characters.appearance: A thin figure. When using his ability, his body breaks down into countless poisonous insects.
characters.history:
Mu Lin is an Eternal True God living in Hu Yang City, a Vice President of the Dark Force Blood Python Guild. He was completely shocked that a foreign Eternal True God (Luo Feng) could seize Lai Mo's True God's Heart in one move. He was concerned with the reputation of the guild after the confrontation, and was surprised that his clansman and president, Mu Yang, elected not to attack Luo Feng at the time.

He was seemingly killed during Luo Feng's attack on the Blood Python Guild headquarters, his insect body easily destroyed by his Reincarnation Blade, however, he escaped and fled to Xu Yin City upon learning of Mu Yang's demise at the hands of Luo Feng.

characters.title: Mu Yang
characters.introText: A black-scaled figure. His true body was as majestic as a mountain, and covered with dense black scales. He had a large scaly tail.
characters.appearance: A black-scaled figure. His true body was as majestic as a mountain, and covered with dense black scales. He had a large scaly tail.
characters.history: Mu Yang was an extremely powerful Eternal True God, capable of leading a Dark Force. While controlling Life Blood River, Mu Yang was able to preserve his life even in the face of an entire Hu Yang Legion (other than the one led by Moli Xiao), and his strength was equal to an entire top-10 Hu Yang Guard unit! According to Moli Xiao, only a handful of residents of Hu Yang City were able to kill Mu Yang.

characters.title: Mud Frog Sage
characters.introText: Leader of the Mud Frog Clan (泥蛙族), he enjoys living among the lowest class of his race. He relishes the peaceful life and provides guidance to the others as they train. He is proficient in soul attack techniques, and was one of the 3 Universe Overlords that Emperor Yan directed to attack Luo Feng and prevent him from arriving to ask for the Robbery Armor. He was unaware that Venerable Ma Sha and Evil Wing Sect Master would also be present. Due to the Mosha clan technique 'Domain,' he and the others were unable to prevent Luo Feng from making it to Emperor Yan.
characters.appearance: One green eye, holding a black scepter.

characters.title: Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother

infobox.Aliases: Ten-Thousand-Tentacled Dragon Matriarch Mother-Dragon of Ten Thousand Touches

characters.introText: The Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother is a Primogenitor ranked among the six most skilled in soul-related within the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Known for her command over countless spiritual tentacles and her ability to weave large-scale illusions, she holds a reputation for being able to restrain even Immortal-level opponents through purely mental means.
characters.appearance:
The Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother is a Primogenitor ranked among the six most skilled in soul-related within the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Known for her command over countless spiritual tentacles and her ability to weave large-scale illusions, she holds a reputation for being able to restrain even Immortal-level opponents through purely mental means.

Prior to the conflict between the major factions, she maintained a neutral position and had even negotiated with the Cultivator Camp. However, during the strategic preparations led by Mogusi, she was persuaded through political pressure and the promise of significant resources to align with the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction.

In the planned assault on Yuan, the Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother’s role was to contribute her tentacle-based mental restraint techniques to the combined “unprecedented illusion,” designed to entrap Yuan’s consciousness indefinitely. Her decision to abandon her earlier agreements marked a shift in allegiance that significantly strengthened Mogusi’s coalition against the Eight Lords of the Cultivator Camp.

After the battle ,It was implied that Lords later retaliated for her betrayal of agreement and almost wiped out her tribe with only few survival captured to be Primordial Prisoners used as tools to temper younger generation of Cultivator,one of them is imprisoned in Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron located in Overlord Xue Ying 's hometown Origin World "Primal Chaos Void".
characters.trivia: In Lord Xue Ying, Overlord Yuan grants a drop of the Ten Thousand Touches Dragon Mother's blood to Xue Ying, transforming and strengthening his soul.

characters.title: Na Bu
characters.introText: A middle-aged man with silver hair, dressed in a beautiful black robe.
characters.appearance: A middle-aged man with silver hair, dressed in a beautiful black robe.
characters.history: Na Bu is Na Ke's father, and the head of the Na Family. He's a careful and meticulous merchant. After saving Na Ke, Luo Feng befriended him and by extension, Na Bu. Due to his relationship with Luo Feng, he agreed to having his mind wiped, preventing him from providing any information on Luo Feng or Na Ke after they left Swallow Mound City. He and Lei Dong were eventually captured and tortured by Si Yong's forces. Later, he was rescued by Na Ke, but it was a trap to lure Luo Feng. Na Bu received an extraordinary amount of wealth from Luo Feng on his departure, and was shocked to hear the news that Luo Feng killed Si Yong.

characters.title: Na Ke

characters.introText: A youth dressed in silver armor, with a purple engraving on his forehead. He casually carried a black bow, and on his back was a quiver with arrows. When he got older, he became tall and his hair turned silver, typical of the Na Family bloodline.
characters.appearance: A youth dressed in silver armor, with a purple engraving on his forehead. He casually carried a black bow, and on his back was a quiver with arrows. When he got older, he became tall and his hair turned silver, typical of the Na Family bloodline.
characters.history:
Na Ke is the son of Na Bu, head of one of the higher merchant families in Swallow Mound City, a Territorial City on Blood River World. His family is considered a mid-tier power within the city. Na Ke was different from others in Blood River World in that he's kindhearted and straightforward. He still respects the strong, but wishes to be one of them.

Na Ke met Luo Feng by 'saving' him from a wild beast in a forest on Blood River World.  During Luo Feng's time on Blood River World, he met Na Ke and his father multiple times, including once to discuss Na Ke's pursuit of a girl he liked. Due to his mission, he ended up placing them in danger. As a result, Na Bu asked Luo Feng to take his son with him as he left Swallow Mound City.

Luo Feng brought Na Ke to Meng Na city, a city in Yu Rong World, about 16 billion kilometers from Swallow Mound City, and gave him a training guide crafted by Babata, containing Hu Yan Bo's techniques. Leaving him with the Cloud Level leader of the Rain Blade Sect, he hoped to see Na Ke again at the conclusion of his mission.

During the 80 years between Luo Feng leaving and returning, Na Ke trained to Universe Level and used that strength to avenge the Rain Blade Sect, then to save his father from his imprisonment. While resting with his father, he was approached by Luo Feng, who arrived with the dead body of Si Yong's 3rd disciple and told them that they were being tracked. Extracting the tracking chip from his father, Na Ke received a space ring containing 100 times the wealth of a city leader on Blood River World, then escaped with his father per Luo Feng's orders. He later heard of Si Yong's death at the hands of Luo Feng.

Na Ke became an Immortal King billions of years after Luo Feng left. Luo Feng traveled to Blood River World personally to admit him as his disciple after this breakthrough. Luo Feng provided some guidance occasionally, but left the job of training him up to Xi Mo.

Six trillion eras after the Sector Beast crisis was resolved, Luo Feng was informed by Xi Mo that Na Ke had reached the limit of Universe Venerable, but might not become a Universe Master before the end of the current Universe Era.

Na Ke broke through to Universe Master while Luo Feng was cultivating after the destruction of the Original Universe.

characters.introText: A tall black armored youth. His appearance was like a stone statue, and he was completely hairless. The most eye catching thing about his look was his eyes, they were like red gems, they gave off a mysterious glow. His entire being emanated a powerful demonic black energy.
characters.appearance: A tall black armored youth. His appearance was like a stone statue, and he was completely hairless. The most eye catching thing about his look was his eyes, they were like red gems, they gave off a mysterious glow. His entire being emanated a powerful demonic black energy.
characters.history:
Na Shi Youth was a genius Low Immortal King of the Na Shi Race who fought in the Extraterritorial Battlefield. His true name is not given in the novel; he is either called Na Shi Race Youth (拿识族青年) or Black Armor Youth (黑甲青年). His Immortal Marquis subordinates refer to him as 'Your Majesty,' so he is possibly royalty. Due to his race's presence in the Demon Race camp, he posed as a member of their camp while in the battlefield.

Luo Feng's connection with the Nine Calamities Secret Tome allowed Luo Feng to discover that the Na Shi Youth possessed one of its boards. After deciding to follow his ship, he was discovered, since Luo Feng's Scanning Device wasn't powerful enough he decided to back off.

Later Luo Feng found him again in the Yan Ji Continent's Main Continent and killed him using a High Level Immortal King Fire God Origin Crystal.

characters.title: Nabini
characters.introText: Considered quite handsome, he has a braid and seemed like a leopard. He carried two long and narrow blades on his back.
characters.appearance: Considered quite handsome, he has a braid and seemed like a leopard. He carried two long and narrow blades on his back.
characters.history:
Nabini is the most exceptional Stellar Level genius of Sacred Land Black Dragon Mountain. He was originally from an aboriginal planet owned by the Palace Family, which used the planet as a livestock planet, cultivating beasts for training and battle. Growing up on this planet, Nabini led a life of eat or be eaten, battling against wild beasts from a young age.

While monitoring the planet, the Palace Family discovered him, a child with shocking power, and took him from the planet, making him a citizen of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire and something of a young master within the Palace Family. Unfortunately, the Palace Family made enemies, and a few large and powerful families attacked them, sending Universe Level warriors, who began to attack the family. A wandering World Master came across the planet, noticed Nabini's talent, and intervened, ensuring the survival of the Palace Family.

Nabini was taken in as the disciple to that World Master and was brought to Sacred Land Black Dragon Mountain, where he lived and trained, eventually becoming their most exceptional genius.

During the Pinnacle Genius Battle, Nabini survived the Ganwu Universe Country Elimination Stage, ranking 860 in the 21st world. He was the 86th participant in the 32nd group of the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Stage, and was one of the first 70 or so to be eliminated, as he was one of the weakest of his group. Hong realized that Nabini survived the elimination stage due to his cleverness, but was too weak to survive the arena stage. Hong felt that he would not do much better when it was his turn.

The Black Dragon Mountain Empire citizens cheered loudly for Nabini during his arena battle, and loudly complained about the way in which he was eliminated (although it was a normal occurrence).

characters.title: Nan Cheng
characters.introText: Nan Cheng is one of the 9 terrifying beings in the 7th Battlefield who appeared at the Sealed Star. A Zerg Race queen, she is close in strength to an Invincible Immortal King! She controls quite a few Limit Immortal Kings and Pinnacle Immortal Kings, typically staying hidden with her Zerg army within a World Ring held by King Skeleton Needle.

characters.title: Ni Nan
characters.introText: Ni Nan is one of the 5 strongest of the Universe Level seniors of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm, along with Ke Luo Fu, Yu Feng, Ge, and Sa Jin. He passed the 7th level of the Tong Tian Bridge at least 300 years ago, as Ge passed it latest and he passed it over 300 years prior.
characters.appearance: A young man wearing silver-grey battle robes.
characters.history:
Ni Nan is one of the 5 strongest of the Universe Level seniors of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm, along with Ke Luo Fu, Yu Feng, Ge, and Sa Jin. He passed the 7th level of the Tong Tian Bridge at least 300 years ago, as Ge passed it latest and he passed it over 300 years prior.

Ni Nan was one of the seniors who bullied and taunted Wu Ka, and when he learned that Luo Feng had passed the 7th level of the bridge, he sent Mo Yi Lin and Ashi to provoke him and cause a fight. After observing their 2 on 1 fight, he determined that he would need his trump card to defeat him, but after watching Luo Feng defeat Sa Jin, he realized that he also might lose in the end.

Ni Nan appeared to be the most easy-going of the 5 strongest seniors, but he was also treacherous, attempting to manipulate Sa Jin into explaining why he lost, and using others to gather intel on Luo Feng. When he finally fought Luo Feng, he was easily defeated, as his speed was no match for Luo Feng's. As a Warrior, he thus had no chance to land an attack and could only be attacked.

Despite being a senior who had passed the 7th level of the bridge hundreds of years before Bolan, he was confirmed to be much weaker than Bolan by Luo Feng.

characters.title: Night Flame Master
characters.introText: Night Flame Master is a Universe Master who joined the Freedom Alliance. During the debate over whether the Freedom Alliance would join forces with the Human Race or not, they noted that since they had been stuck as Universe Masters for so long, their objective was to become a True God. They realized that Shi Hua Island Leader desired the information for becoming a limit True God, but stated that the conditions the humans offered were already satisfactory to the Universe Masters.

characters.introText: Nightmare is one of the 12 Immortal Marquises of Misty Sand Island.
characters.history: Nightmare is one of the 12 Immortal Marquises of Misty Sand Island.

characters.title: Nightmare Ancestor
characters.introText: Nightmare Ancestor is Primogenitor of the Ice Peak Faction. He is one of the six primogenitors selected by Mogusi to help create a powerful illusion aimed at Yuan, which could weaken or limit his effectiveness in battle. His soul-based abilities are extremely advanced, second only to Mogusi in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. His recruitment is managed by Ice Peak Ancestor, reflecting the cooperation between the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction and the Ice Peak Faction’s opposing forces.
characters.appearance:
Nightmare Ancestor is Primogenitor of the Ice Peak Faction. He is one of the six primogenitors selected by Mogusi to help create a powerful illusion aimed at Yuan, which could weaken or limit his effectiveness in battle. His soul-based abilities are extremely advanced, second only to Mogusi in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. His recruitment is managed by Ice Peak Ancestor, reflecting the cooperation between the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction and the Ice Peak Faction’s opposing forces.

The Nightmare Hunyuan Ancestor met his demise during the large-scale confrontation between the Eight Lords and the Primogenitors of Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction and Ice Peak Faction. Despite being deeply protected within several layers of defensive formations, he became the primary target of the Eight Lords’ Curse Killing Calamity Formation an intricate combination of four lethal techniques orchestrated by Yuan. Due to his inherently weak physical body and reliance on soul manipulation, the Nightmare Hunyuan Ancestor was unable to resist the formation’s temporal and causal attacks. The calamity struck directly at his Life Core, shattering his massive eye and erasing his existence across timelines. His death caused immediate turmoil among the Primogenitors and marked the first critical turning point in the battle.

characters.introText: Nine Flames Country Master is a Universe Venerable, the founder and leader of Nine Flames Universe Country.
characters.history: Nine Flames Country Master is a Universe Venerable, the founder and leader of Nine Flames Universe Country.

characters.title: Nine Mortals Master

characters.title: Nine Remoteness Master
characters.introText: I admit that you're incredible and have a boundless Divine Body...I'd rather deal with Primal Chaos City Leader and Star River Master than you.
characters.appearance: He is a gigantic ocean, his true body is the Nine Remoteness Ocean, with a diameter of over 10 light-years. His human avatar is a middle-aged man dressed in a magnificent black robe. There were black engravings on his fair and pale face, and he exuded a devilish charm. His existence is one that is terribly self-conceited and overweening with arrogance.
characters.history:
Nine Remoteness Master is a legendary Universe Master of the Original Universe, a unique Special Lifeform with the largest Divine Body known in the universe! As a Guardian God Master of the Ancestral God Sect, he deals with problems that the sect and the Beast Gods are unable to handle due to their limitations.

He is the ruler of the Nine Remoteness Space and as such, creatures who live there (such as Venerable Ancestral Tree) serve him. Nothing that happens there can be hidden from him. Other Universe Masters are reluctant to travel to Nine Remoteness Space due to his ability to kill them within it. Those weaker may venture there to acquire some valuables.

In the past, he gained fame by killing a Universe Master. Due to appearance of a certain Arcana, he was chased by two Universe Masters to his Nine Remoteness Ocean. Burning his Divine Body, he killed Cang Yang Master of the Demon Race; Sky Wolf Master escaped the destruction by using his flying palace-type High Arcana Sky Wolf Palace.

He also worked diligently to create lifeforms, and he eventually created 108 lifeforms who serve as his princes, in addition to the Nine Remoteness Indigenous Race, which inhabits Nine Remoteness World.

When Luo Feng traveled to Nine Remoteness Space in hopes of creating his third body, Nine Remoteness Master discovered him. Due to Luo Feng's relationship with the Ancestral God Sect, Nine Remoteness Master let him leave with the bit of Bloody Sea blood he obtained, under the condition that he served under him in his sub-organization.

When Luo Feng discovered Yuan Ao Master and his Divine Wood, the Ancestral God Sect sent Nine Remoteness Master, Outstanding Difficulty Master, and Anaconda Master to assist him in dealing with Yuan Ao Master.

During the battle against the United Forces Alliance, the Ancestral God Sect joined the human side, sending Nine Remoteness Master, among others.

After the World of Jin appeared, he became a True God, and when the Sector Beasts appeared, he was one of the Eight Great Overlords of Universe Ocean, alongside Divine Eye True Master, Skeleton Master, Bei Chi Star Master, Jue He True God, Nine-Headed Devil Master, Primal Chaos City Leader, and Luo Feng. Three years after Morosa fought Luo Feng, he fought Morosa.

When the True God Palace was created in the Virtual Universe, he sat one level below Luo Feng and Primal Chaos City Leader, due to the status of the human race.
characters.trivia: The Nine Remoteness (九幽 jiǔ yōu) is based off a Chinese Concept 九幽. Basically there are Nine Layers of Heaven above the Earth and Nine Layers of Hell below it. Depending on the Karma attained during ones life one either ascends to the corresponding level or falls into Hell. Nine Remoteness (九幽 jiǔ yōu) corresponds to the lowest level/point in this ideology.

characters.title: Nine Universe Master
characters.introText: Nine Universe Master is the creator of the 9 Universe Primal Chaos Tablet in Primal Chaos City, as well as the writer of the Time Space Scribbles. He is very likely a Universe Master, since the 9 Universe Tablet has 27 levels, and they likely have incredible achievements in Law of Space , since that is the focus of the tablet.
characters.appearance: Nine Universe Master is the creator of the 9 Universe Primal Chaos Tablet in Primal Chaos City, as well as the writer of the Time Space Scribbles. He is very likely a Universe Master, since the 9 Universe Tablet has 27 levels, and they likely have incredible achievements in Law of Space , since that is the focus of the tablet.

characters.title: Nine-Headed Devil Master
characters.introText: Let's attack together! All True Gods, act together. Don't be reckless, help each other out. Let's kill this Sector Beast together.
characters.appearance: His original form was that of a strange beast with four hooves and nine heads. However, after entering the World of Jin, he took a humanoid form with 9 heads, the middle head being larger than the others.
characters.history:
Before the Sector Beast War, he had been a low-key True God from the Second Reincarnation Era, striving to transcend reincarnation during the final period of the Third Reincarnation Era. When the crisis began, he gradually showed his strength and was ranked as one of the Eight Great Overlords of Universe Ocean.

Before Hong and Pupil Devil God encountered the Sector Beasts, he had sent some of the Universe Masters under his command to the Sector Beasts' nest to investigate. He knew the numbers and the danger involved, but still chose to fight. When Morosa appeared in Universe Ocean, Nine-Headed Devil Master was the first of the 8 Overlords to fight Morosa. He held back from using his full power so he could gather information and to avoid pushing Morosa to the brink. Morosa escaped using one of his inherited techniques and Nine-Headed Devil Master shared the information with Luo Feng and the others.

Eventually, he felt the pressure and decided to pledge his allegiance to the Sector Beasts, hoping to save himself, his miniature universe, and those who dwelt within. Luo Feng discovered his betrayal after enslaving Morosa, and traveled to his miniature universe and killed him.

characters.title: Ninth Brother
characters.introText: Ninth Brother is a Universe Overlord disciple of Craftsman God Master. An Energy Lifeform of the fire category, he is able to go deep into the center of Craftsman God Planet to forge weapons, and is considered the best of his disciples.
characters.history:
Ninth Brother is a Universe Overlord disciple of Craftsman God Master. An Energy Lifeform of the fire category, he is able to go deep into the center of Craftsman God Planet to forge weapons, and is considered the best of his disciples.

Luo Feng observed him while formulating a plan to retrieve the 4th board of the Nine Volume Manual and waited for him to depart before attempting his plan.

characters.title: Nirvana Ancestor
characters.introText: The Nirvana Ancestor is one of the top powerhouses of the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction, serving as one of the core figures among the Nine Sovereigns. Ranked among the top three, Nirvana Ancestor plays a critical strategic and combat role in the war against the Cultivator Camp. He is deeply involved in the front lines of the battle and often leads high-level coordinated attacks.
characters.appearance:
The Nirvana Ancestor is one of the top powerhouses of the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction, serving as one of the core figures among the Nine Sovereigns. Ranked among the top three, Nirvana Ancestor plays a critical strategic and combat role in the war against the Cultivator Camp. He is deeply involved in the front lines of the battle and often leads high-level coordinated attacks.

Nirvana Ancestor is the one who notices the key role of Luo Feng and identifies him as the turning point of the battlefield due to his unique ability to instantly restore his allies to full strength. Realizing the threat Luo Feng poses, Nirvana Ancestor personally organizes a joint mental and physical strike against him, coordinating with six other Ancestors like Thousand Eye Ancestor and Starweb Ancestor for a soul based killing technique.

Despite their full-force mental assault bypassing most defensive barriers, the attack fails due to Luo Feng’s terrifying resilience and soul strength. This failure prompts Nirvana Ancestor to calmly suggest retreating, recognizing the shifting balance of power after the sudden rise of this new Lord. His strategic thinking and leadership reflect a calm, rational, and experienced warrior who prioritizes results over pride.

In the face of overwhelming odds, Nirvana Ancestor remains composed and respectful of strength. He acknowledges the cultivator camp’s new advantage, yet also firmly believes in the doctrine of survival of the fittest "the weak die, the strong live." Even when defeated, he expresses no bitterness, only resolve to continue the pursuit of ultimate strength, even at the cost of complete annihilation.

He excelled in the Highest-Level "Darkness Power" and "Death Power". The combined Power of these two is known as "Annihilation Power", capable of targeting both physical bodies and souls, making it an exceptionally dangerous power.

characters.title: North Army General
characters.introText: A tall alien beast with six ugly and ferocious heads.

characters.title: Northern True Star Master
characters.introText: An old man with vines and green leaves surrounding his body, wearing a white robe.
characters.appearance: An old man with vines and green leaves surrounding his body, wearing a white robe.
characters.history:
Northern True Star Master is an extremely ancient being, a True God of the East Emperor Holy Land Universe. He existed in the same Reincarnation Era as East Emperor Ancestor, but did not break through to Void True God, thus his Miniature Universe decayed long ago. He resides in a cluster of palaces constructed atop the mountains of the holy land, and teaches servants and disciples.

On East Emperor Ancestor's orders, he led a force of 20 Universe Masters, 200 Universe Venerables, and 2,000 Immortals to seize the Duan Dong River Inheritance, the first time he had set foot in Universe Ocean in more than 10 reincarnation eras. He was granted Xeon Arcana from other True Gods in the East Emperor Holy Land, altogether bringing 4 with him: a Palace Treasure, a Domain Treasure, a close-combat attack treasure, and a long-range attack treasure. With these, he blocked the entrance to the Boat of Mausoleum, preventing other factions from entering until Second True Master and Seventh True Master worked together to blast him away.

When the final candidates for the inheritance were determined, Northern True left the Boat of Mausoleum along with everyone else in the area who were not candidates. Later, after Luo Feng successfully became the next heir of Duan Dong River, Northern True led a force of 10 Universe Masters, each wielding a Xeon Arcana, to capture Luo Feng. Despite the group's best efforts, they failed, and East Emperor Ancestor eventually ordered Northern True Star Master to negotiate with Luo Feng. Northern True served as the go-between during the negotiations between East Emperor Ancestor and Luo Feng, and eventually gave Luo Feng the Black Prison Tower and the Yan Jun Rod in exchange for one memory stone.

Northern True personally passed the memory stone to East Emperor Ancestor, and was present for his disappointment at the level of experience it contained.

characters.title: Nuo Si Wu
characters.introText: A fat-headed man with two dead fish-like eyes, wearing a luxurious green robe.
characters.appearance: A fat-headed man with two dead fish-like eyes, wearing a luxurious green robe.
characters.history: Nuo Si Wu is one of the main managers of the purchasing department of the Virtual Universe Company. As a main manager, he typically dealt with Immortal Kings. He appraised the goods that Luo Feng acquired in his battle with Ci Wei Ka, ultimately giving him a price of 4.6 billion Mixed Yuan Units. He noted that he's not normally that generous with ordinary Immortal Kings, and it's implied that he treated Luo Feng the way he did due to his status as a direct disciple of Primal Chaos City Leader.

infobox.organisation: Huge Axe Dojo Hundred Tigers Building

characters.introText: In the novel, he's an incredibly skinny man, wearing a dark green battle uniform. His eyes gleamed red and were extremely vicious, and he had pointy ears. On his chest was a peculiar axe medal.
characters.appearance:

In the donghua, he has an athletic build, wearing a long white-silver overcoat. He has white eyes and engravings on his face.
characters.history:
Nuolan Shan was the head of the Nuolan Shan Family from Ice Mist Star of the Kaluo Empire. Using his strength, he founded the Nuolan Shan Family about 81,066 years prior to the encounter between Luo Feng and Bu Luo Nuolan Shan. He acquired his fame by becoming a Universe-level Huge Axe Warrior, which he earned by killing 1000 Universe Level warriors in the Huge Axe Dojo. More than half of those that he killed were Universe Level 9! With his strength and the large armies under him, he brought the Nuolan Shan family to the status of the 3rd-strongest family of the Kaluo Empire.

He sent multiple warriors to Earth in order to take the treasures that were on the planet, these treasures included the Earth Automaton Ship. After finding out that Golden Horned Beast died on Earth, Nuolan Shan wanted to take its body to sell. Therefore he tried to take over the Earth. Due to the pressure of Earth falling into Nuolan Shan's hand Luo Feng quickly leveled up to the Stellar Level and bought Earth with the Bank Accounts Inheritance that was left by Hu Yan Bo for him.

Later, Nuolan Shan arrived on Cang Lan Planet, bringing his Stellar Level warriors to obtain treasures from the World within a World on Cang Lan Planet. When Luo Feng, Hong, and Lei Shen completed their mission in the World within a World on Cang Lan Planet, Nuolan Shan fled the planet before Ming Yu could kill him. 

Donghua adaptation:
When Luo Feng, Hong, and Lei Shen completed their mission in the World within a World on Cang Lan Planet, Nuolan Shan chased after them in his spaceship firing his Laser Cannon hoping to forever get rid of them, however, was retaliated against by Ming Yu. His death is prevented by negotiations from a Hundred Tigers Building general.

Nuolan Shan sent over 1,000 Stellar Level fighters to participate in the Pinnacle Genius Battle, telling them that whoever made the top-10,000 of their world in the Ganwu Universe Country Elimination Stage would be named the next head of the family.

characters.title: Old Ancestral God
characters.introText: He has a ferocious beast head, and his hair has strands thick as fingers. His eyes are green. He wore a white cape when performing his duties.
characters.appearance: He has a ferocious beast head, and his hair has strands thick as fingers. His eyes are green. He wore a white cape when performing his duties.
characters.history:
Old Ancestral God is the non-canon name given to the Ancestral God who appears the oldest.

Old Ancestral God appears to be the leader of the Ancestral Gods, and thus the leader of the Ancestral God Sect. Whenever the three Ancestral Gods appear, whether in Universe Ocean or on their thrones in the Ancestral God Palace, he appears in the middle of the three.

He is highly gifted, which is why he was selected as one of the Ancestral Gods, and as one of the Ancestral Gods, he was favored by the Origin Will, allowed to wield True God-level power while within the Original Universe, despite being a Universe Master. As an Ancestral God, he may live in the Ancestral God Palace within the Five-Color Aurora Lake.

During the Human Race Survival War, the Ancestral God Sect requested the guides on how to become True Gods and how to reach the limit of True Gods and transcend reincarnation. Old Ancestral God reported to the Ancestral Gods, Eight Beast Gods, Guardian Beast Gods, and Guardian God Masters that the Human Race only agreed to provide the guide to become True Gods, then asked the group to decide whether they would join the Human Race or not.

After agreeing to join the Human Race, he led the forces of the Ancestral God Sect, most of whom stayed in Ancestral God Altar. He was terrified with the rest of the sect at the attacks from the Three-Clan Coalition Army and the Freedom Alliance, ordering the sect to remain within Ancestral God Altar to defend themselves. When Luo Feng successfully withstood the combined attacks from the enemy, he, along with the others from the sect, launched attacks at the enemy.

As the body of the Jin God King appeared in Universe Ocean, the Origin Will of the Original Universe contacted the Ancestral Gods, informing them of the arrival of the 4th Most Dangerous Land and giving them an order to leave the Original Universe and enter Universe Ocean for the first time.

Many powerful beings lost a body when trying to enter the body of the Jin God King, including Luo Feng. No one in Universe Ocean was able to enter the World of Jin within the body; there was a 100% death rate! When the powers of Universe Ocean began to feel there was no way to enter, they received news that the Ancestral Gods were summoning the great powers of Universe Ocean and would pass on a message from the Origin Will. Glowing with power stronger than any True God, Old Ancestral God and the other Ancestral Gods passed on information on the World of Jin, including how to enter it, what it contained, what could be gained from entering it, and its level of danger.

In the third era after great beings began entering the World of Jin, the Origin Will of the Original Universe contacted the Ancestral Gods, informing them of the appearance of the Sector Beasts. Old Ancestral God explained that the appearance of the World of Jin was orchestrated by the Origin Will to provide the powers of Universe Ocean the ability to defeat the Sector Beasts. Through the Origin Will, they also explained the benefits from killing the Sector Beasts. After impressing upon the powers of Universe Ocean the danger of the Sector Beasts and the importance of killing them all, the Ancestral Gods flew away.

Despite the Ancestral Gods telling the powers of Universe Ocean that only True Gods could fight the Sector Beasts, Young Ancestral God informed Luo Feng that he was the exception, due to being the strongest being in Universe Ocean. Old Ancestral God noted that due to only being a Universe Master, Luo Feng still had multiple bodies, which he could easily recreate with the Divine Power of the Remote Ocean Body, making him the best suited to fight the Sector Beasts. He also enticed Luo Feng and Primal Chaos City Leader by stating that if they made enough contributions, it was even possible to have the Origin Will release Ancestor Yuan.

After Luo Feng spoke with Sitting Mountain Guest and got clearer details on what he should ask from the Origin Will, he submitted his requirement to the Ancestral Gods. Old Ancestral God informed him that although his requirement was very demanding, he would indeed be able to combine his consciousness with the origin of the Original Universe and personally experience the destruction and rebirth of the Original Universe at the conclusion of the current Reincarnation Era, provided he killed all of the Sector Beasts.

When some of the great beings thought to join the Sector Beasts, Old Ancestral God and the other Ancestral Gods spread the message from the Origin Will that joining the Sector Beasts was foolish and would not work to their benefit. After Luo Feng defeated Morosa and forced him to flee, Old Ancestral God remarked that according to the Origin Will, the Sector Beasts within the nest would quicken their evolution and the final battle with the Sector Beasts would likely be earlier than expected. When Luo Feng reached the Ultimate Life Gene Level, Old Ancestral God was one of the great beings who noted that they were forced to kneel, despite always having been favored by the Origin Will.

When the remaining Sector Beasts began to move into Universe Ocean, Old Ancestral God contacted the Origin Will (at the request of Luo Feng and Primal Chaos City Leader) to see if it would release Ancestor Yuan so he could protect his Miniature Universe. With a sigh, he told the two that due to Ancestor Yuan breaking the Supreme Operation Laws, the Origin Will did not have the right to release him until the Sector Beasts were all killed.

After Luo Feng defeated Mo He, thus ending the Sector Beast War, he ordered Morosa to begin absorbing the origin of Purple Moon Holy Land Universe, prompting concerns that the Sector Beast War was not yet resolved. Old Ancestral God spoke up and informed everyone that the Sector Beast War was certainly over, providing comfort to the great beings of Universe Ocean. When Luo Feng and Primal Chaos City Leader arrived at Ancestral God Palace to request the release of Ancestor Yuan, he assuaged their concerns and informed him that the Origin Will would keep its promise. After the release of Ancestor Yuan, he noted that with Ancestor Yuan (who provoked the Origin Will) and Luo Feng (who the Origin Will dared not provoke) working together, the Human Race would be incredibly powerful in the future.

He and the other Ancestral Gods waited in Ancestral God Palace for the arrival of Luo Feng at the end of the current Reincarnation Era, and left after he arrived.

characters.history: Jin is an ancient Overlord from the Chaotic Origin Dimension. He made a promise to help resurrect the fallen comrades of those who manage to leap beyond the cage of their world. He values growth, and cultivators who fight for freedom to break free from the cage. He is respected by other Overlords.
characters.trivia:
He is the creator of Dark Holy Realm.

Jin appears in Lord Xue Ying, where he is Emperor Jun's senior, advising him to destroy as much as possible.

Jin is the ruler of the 12th Layer/Destruction World of the Abyss Of Destruction. After Endless Ancestor took the 18th layer from Kafuxiu, chaos spread across the 9th to 18th layers, giving Jin the chance to rise and seize the 13th layer.

Jin and Luo Feng were supposed to venture into the Abyss of Destruction together, but due to their differing temperaments, Jin didn’t bother contacting Luo Feng and entered the Abyss of Destruction earlier than Luo Feng.

characters.history:
Overlord Wulan is one of the 7 Overlords who exist at the beginning of Swallowed Star 2. Having mastered the Hunyuan Dao of Matter, his body is terrifyingly large, similar in size to a Source World, although he has less energy than Luo Feng's Overlord body. On the other hand, his killing methods are not as good as others at the Overlord/Ancestor level, and many of his attacks cannot hit that level of enemy.

In cultivating the Hunyuan Dao of Matter, Wulan created it as a combination of 9 parts Matter and 1 part Unlimited, hoping to integrate more mysteries of the Unlimited to create much more flexible methods. The use of the Unlimited also allows him to transform the energy from Matter.

characters.history:
Xing Mang is one of the 7 Overlords leading the cultivator camp in Infinite Hunyuan Space. Among the Practitioner Faction, he was the first Lord to have completely comprehending the Great Daos to the Chaotic Origin Level and broke the law by force, then jumping out of the cage. He skipped the High and World Levels, breakthrough from Invincible God Emperor stage directly to Overlord.

Lord Xing Mang was only at the Invincible God Emperor stage when Daoist Cheng was already at the High Chaotic Origin Lifeform stage. After 12 trillion eras of comprehending 512 kinds of World-Class Hunyuan Lifeform material, he finally achieved breakthrough.
characters.trivia:
Xing Mang is considered the fastest existence in the entire Chaotic Origin Dimension no overlord or being can approach his level of speed. When he travels space turns into 2D, the Infinite Hunyuan Space is reduced to a two-dimensional map beneath his feet, allowing him to stride across territories that would take others countless years to traverse. His speed is not physical movement but a pure expression of his mastery over time and space: he folds distances, compresses timelines, and walks directly through layered dimensions, turning impossible gaps into effortless steps. To Luo Feng and all who witness it, Xing Mang doesn’t truly “move”—he simply appears, as if reality itself rearranges its structure to place him at any point he chooses.

The Overlord Xing Mang has many forms appearing as a child, teenager, young adult, middle-aged man, and even as an old man. He has reincarnated across numerous source worlds, and with each reincarnation, his appearance and race are different. Among the Seven Lords, the Star Lord has the greatest number of techniques and methods, making him unmatched in versatility.

Overlord Xing Mang is the ruler of the 26th Layer/Destruction World of the Abyss Of Destruction

Although Xing Mang possesses the ability to observe the most favorable future across the entire Chaotic Origin Dimension, his foresight is not absolute and can be disrupted by unique circumstances. For example, he is unable to clearly foresee the future of Luo Feng during the Lords’ attempt to seize territory from the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction. In that situation, Xing Mang could only deduce that Luo Feng would play a highly significant role. This wasn't because Luo Feng was stronger than him, but because Luo Feng’s fate had become hidden—shielded by the higher-tier power of the Abyss of Destruction. Unbeknownst to Luo Feng himself, his deep immersion in the Abyss and partial mastery of its core power caused all his future timelines to vanish from Xing Mang’s view. This concealment is similar to that of Yin Zhe, the Hermit, whose future is also obscured despite possibly being weaker than Xing Mang.

characters.introText: He is only mentioned in the Swallowed Star 1, he makes his appearance in Lord Xue Ying Novel. He is the Creator of the Lie Yuan Technique. Yuan is the one who has comprehended the greatest number of Great Daos among all cultivators and Overlords.. And he is considered The Overlord with the most comprehensive means.
characters.appearance: Overlord Yuan is described as a towering figure, his body like an infinite pillar of space, unshakable.Embodying an unshakeable presence akin to a pillar supporting the boundless primal chaos. Great Daos visibly manifest around him, taking on substantial forms. Some transform into winding divine dragons coiled around his arms, while firebirds gracefully circle within his hair. Radiant mist flows through his nose and mouth, and billions of universes appear to be born upon the surface his skin. When he opens his eyes, they reveal the creation and destruction of time and space, along with surging thunder and fire..
characters.personality:
Before his spiritual/consciousness breakthrough, Yuan’s personality was defined by restraint, composure, and calculated control. As a leader among the Overlords and a pillar of the practitioner faction, he consistently maintained a calm, steady demeanor, rarely revealing strong emotions or impulsive thoughts. His speech was measured, his movements deliberate, and his appearance dignified, reflecting the authority and discipline expected of someone in his position. Internally, however, he carried six powerful subconscious aspects—fragments of his true nature such as freedom, dominance, cunning, and fairness—which he kept tightly suppressed to maintain balance and avoid instability. This constant internal control came at a cost, consuming part of his spiritual energy and limiting his ability to fight at his true peak. To allies and enemies alike, Yuan appeared as the dependable strategist and stabilizing force, more inclined toward order, cooperation, and discipline than personal indulgence, but beneath that surface lay the unexpressed extremes of his character

After his spiritual/consciousness breakthrough, Yuan’s personality shifted dramatically, shedding the rigid restraint that had defined him for countless ages. With his six subconscious aspects fully merged into his main consciousness, he became openly expressive, confident, and unafraid to display the full range of his emotions. His once measured and formal demeanor gave way to a more vibrant, unpredictable presence—playful at times, yet still capable of sharp decisiveness.
Overlord Yuan has a casual personality, he wears a flowery robe and wears sandals that show his toes. He likes to remind beings that he helped them with cultivation or resources because he loves to take complete credit for things he did and things he didnt fully do. He likes to help weak mortals because he wants to see more cultivators becoming Overlords to fight against Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms who are enemies of the cultivators. He, Luo Feng, and Dong Bo Xue Ying are on the same side when it comes to benevolence toward weak cultivators or mortals.

“Dong Bo Xue Ying greets Senior Yuan. Many thanks Senior Yuan for your previous guidance.” Xue Ying immediately thanked the other party.

“Haha, there is no need for you brat to be too politeful! Even though I might have helped you a lot, helping you compile the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>, the Realm Heart Order is refined by me too, I have also given you a droplet of Core Blood from the Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother… and many other things which I shall not elaborate upon! These aren’t worth mentioning! It is you yourself who cultivated your level! I have helped so many other cultivators but how many of them could reach the Chaotic Origin Level?” Yuan grinned.

Xue Ying was speechless.

That was totally not humble at all! Who would actually list out everything that he did to help another party.

So it seemed ‘Yuan’ had this personality.

Yuan is the first Overlord, and he played a key role in helping every other Overlord reach their current level, which is why he is naturally regarded as the leader of all other Overlords and entire Cultivation Camp. He has a talent for coordinating, planning, and strengthening the entire group during critical battles. His strategies—especially the battle formations he designs—greatly boost their combined combat power, allowing them to stand against the overwhelming attacks of the seventy-two Ancestral Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. 
Yuan is the one who makes the battle plans and gives orders to the other Overlords. This is clearly shown in Swallowed Star 2, Chapter 379, where he creates a coordinated attack strategy and assigns roles—such as ordering Overlord Xing Mang to take Luo Feng to the battlefield..
characters.trivia:
Overlord Yuan was originally the ruler of the 19th Layer of the Abyss of Destruction and became the ruler of the 25th Layer after his breakthrough.

He is the only person to have created an Origin World among all the overlords

characters.title: Owner of Mother River
characters.introText: When he met Luo Feng, he was a man in a black robe, with a smile full of endless charm, life spirit, and mystery. When he competed for the Thousand Dreams Fruit, he was a figure in a gray robe.
characters.appearance: When he met Luo Feng, he was a man in a black robe, with a smile full of endless charm, life spirit, and mystery. When he competed for the Thousand Dreams Fruit, he was a figure in a gray robe.
characters.history:
The Owner of Mother River, also known as Zong Fu God King, is an extremely powerful Second Level God King, capable of rivaling Emperors and Monarchs. He and Yu Fu God King are life-and-death friends and the core of Life Mother River.

In the early days of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, Zong Fu was their most powerful minister, already a powerful Second Level God King. At that time, he was relied upon by Emperor Yan, the first emperor, and he chose to go from being a Guest Official to completely joining the ancient kingdom. During this time, he acquired a powerful treasure and Emperor Yan mobilized the forces of the ancient kingdom to surround and kill him.

After reincarnating, he created Life Mother River to oppose the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, gathering many God Kings with grudges against them. Over the years, he has fought many times with the ancient kingdom, and the number of Imperial Family God Kings he has killed is in the double digits. He can be considered the number one enemy of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom.

Life Mother River came into conflict with Luo Feng while recruiting Eternal True Gods in the territory he controlled. Upon learning that Luo Feng opposed the recruitment, he visited him personally, agreeing to withdraw from the territory and telling him that he believed they may join forces in the future.
characters.trivia: Currently translating '之主' as 'Owner of' rather than 'Master of' or 'Lord of' to avoid confusion with Universe Masters and Primal Chaos Sovereigns (who are referred to as lords/marquises)

characters.introText: The Owner of Wanfa Tower is a robed figure with three faces: one on the front, one on the left, and one on the right, each constantly observing the surroundings. This unique appearance enhances his ability to process and analyze information during battles and exploration.
characters.appearance: The Owner of Wanfa Tower is a robed figure with three faces: one on the front, one on the left, and one on the right, each constantly observing the surroundings. This unique appearance enhances his ability to process and analyze information during battles and exploration.
characters.history:
The Owner of Wanfa Tower, also known as the Master of Wanfa, is the founder of Wan Fa Tower, one of the three alien-led factions on the Continent of Origin. Renowned for his mastery over "Wanfa" (countless secret techniques), he is feared for his strategic brilliance and ability to elevate his team’s collective strength.

Within the Dream Realm, he leads a team of eight elite members, six of whom are at the second level of God King and two at the first level. Their synergy, guided by his secret techniques, makes them the most formidable team in the Dream Realm. Even powerful figures such as Gui Xu Emperor and Wu Xin God King avoid direct confrontation with him whenever possible.

The Owner of Wanfa Tower is highly respected by his followers, having personally trained many of them. He has taken 15 disciples, and his teaching abilities are considered superior to even the ancestors of the Ancient Kingdoms.

In the expedition in the Dream Realm, his team encountered the Samsara Building team by Gui Xu Emperor, Wu Xin God King, Yun Tian God King and Luo Feng. Recognizing the danger posed by the Wanfa Tower team, Luo Feng and his companions chose to retreat, highlighting the intimidating reputation of the Owner.

characters.introText: His most common appearance is that of a middle-aged man, but he has numerous forms, so no one knows his true appearance.
characters.appearance: His most common appearance is that of a middle-aged man, but he has numerous forms, so no one knows his true appearance.
characters.personality: He is fierce and terrifying, while being scheming and calculating.
characters.history:
Owner of Wanying Building is a powerful Enlightened Late Stage God Emperor who leads Wanying Building, one of the plundering forces of Yulan City. While he leads such a force, he also serves as one of the City Elders, showing his strength. Along with Lord of the Insect Nest and Master of Guifang, he is considered one of the most powerful members of Palace Master Weiyang's faction within the city. Due to his affiliation with Weiyang, he was made the Commander of Xuntian Palace, and he used his post to accumulate income for both himself and Weiyang through repeated screenings of suspected Low-Level Hunyuan Lifeform spies.

When Luo Feng showcased his ability to easily detect Low-Level Hunyuan Lifeforms hiding within the city, Palace Master Yuan Xiang assigned him the position of Commander of Xuntian Palace, replacing Owner of Wanying Building. While Wanying was displeased, he followed Weiyang's orders and told Luo Feng of Weiyang's invitation for a chat. He attempted to block Luo Feng's path when he chose to continue screening suspected cultivators rather than immediately seeing Weiyang, but relented when Luo Feng remarked about him wanting to fight the Commander of Xuntian Palace while within the Xuntian Palace.

During the battle for Yulan City, Wanying was among those who attempted to save Weiyang when he was attacked by a Super Limit Low-Level Hunyuan Lifeform. Later, when Luo Feng showcased Ultra Limit God Emperor strength, Wanying was also among those who asked Yuan Xiang to have Luo Feng inscribe the city formation to save the city. While watching Luo Feng have the advantage against 4 Super Limit beings at once, Wanying regretted his conflict with him, and at the conclusion of the battle, he willingly offered all of his resources in the city to Luo Feng, then annihilated his clones within the Nine Rivers Holy World.

characters.title: Pa Er
characters.introText: Pa Er is a Stellar Level genius who participated in the Pinnacle Genius Battle. He/she was Cha Er Ta Ma's first opponent in the 1v1 battle portion of the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Stage.
characters.history:
Pa Er is a Stellar Level genius who participated in the Pinnacle Genius Battle. He/she was Cha Er Ta Ma's first opponent in the 1v1 battle portion of the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Stage.

It is unknown who won between the 2 of them, but the victor would have faced off against Luo Feng in the 2nd round and would then have lost the match and be sent to the losers bracket where their final standing would remain unknown.

He was killed by Luo Feng on Wei Feng Planet, along with 10,000 of his guards. He was not as dirty as the other 17 executives, even though he never dealt in the dark dealings, he allowed them to happen and still gained large amounts of profits from them. He relied on these businesses to gain endless wealth, hence Luo Feng Killed him.

As a Domain Master Level 9, he was given an E9 Grade Laser Gun to use to kill Luo Feng. When he encountered Luo Feng, he initially fought him in melee combat, but attempted to flee after a few clashes with his Hidden Shadow 7 Blades techniques. When Luo Feng used the Cloud Vine in his attempt to catch him, he realized that Luo Feng might have been his target, and attempted to kill him with the laser gun. Unfortunately for him, Luo Feng defended himself with the Earth Automaton Ship, then cut him down with the Mosha Body.

characters.title: Palace Master Gai Tao
characters.introText: Gai Tao is known to be extremely selfish at heart; unlike Palace Master Weiyang, who saw Yulan City as his future territory (and thus important), Gai Tao fled the city when his clone was endangered. Furthermore, unlike Weiyang, who focused on consolidating power, placing his allies in powerful positions, Gai Tao did not object to Luo Feng being named the Commander of Xuntian Palace.
characters.personality: Gai Tao is known to be extremely selfish at heart; unlike Palace Master Weiyang, who saw Yulan City as his future territory (and thus important), Gai Tao fled the city when his clone was endangered. Furthermore, unlike Weiyang, who focused on consolidating power, placing his allies in powerful positions, Gai Tao did not object to Luo Feng being named the Commander of Xuntian Palace.
characters.history:
Palace Master Gai Tao is a powerful Perfect God Emperor from an Origin World, ranking in the top 3 of the entire Nine Rivers Sacred World in tool-refining. Rather than focusing on fighting like other powerful cultivators, he leads a group of over 30 Elders interested in tool-refining to focus on that instead. The various weapons and treasures he crafts are sold in multiple cities in the sacred world. He serves as one of the three Palace Masters of Yulan City, and as the most powerful in the weapons and treasure industry in the city, his family alone holds over half the city's market share in the industry.

When Yulan City was invaded by a powerful force of Low-Level Hunyuan Lifeforms, Gai Tao was one of those who attempted to defend Palace Master Weiyang from the initial attack. After Weiyang was killed, Gai Tao led the 92 Elders of the Galaxy Formation to hunt the invading lifeforms, but after launching his second wave of attacks, he abandoned the city to its fate. In the end, he felt that since he had not sought any resources or benefits within the city, simply focusing on tool-refining, he did not need to risk his life for the city. As the Super Limit Bewitching Heart Worm and his team of 20 Perfect God Emperors approached his cave residence, he piloted a flying boat with a large number of his weapons and treasures, and escaped the city.

After the Battle for Yulan City, Luo Feng erased the portions of the city's formation belonging to Gai Tao, stripping him of his position of Palace Master.

characters.title: Palace Master Weiyang
characters.introText: His figure is like a statue, his eyes deep, expressionless, and seemingly boundless.
characters.appearance: His figure is like a statue, his eyes deep, expressionless, and seemingly boundless.
characters.personality: Weiyang is vicious, extremely selfish, greedy, and arrogant, yet also patient and respectful of those he considers his equals and superiors. He keeps a close eye on the important matters within Yulan City, understanding that he may become the City Lord due to Palace Master Yuan Xiang's condition.
characters.history:
Palace Master Weiyang is an Enlightened Perfect God Emperor who was considered the strongest cultivator in Yulan City upon Luo Feng's arrival in the city. A powerful being from an Origin World, he has multiple clones within the Nine Rivers Sacred World, where he established a foothold after spending countless years honing his skills in the Dark Sacred World.

After his arrival in Yulan City, Weiyang surpassed the city's founder, Palace Master Yuan Xiang and became its most powerful Palace Master, receiving the most resources and benefits among the group. Using his strength, he also built influence, proactively reaching out to newly promoted Elders and winning them over to his group. Out of the 327 Elders within the city, it is confirmed that nearly 100 have pledged allegiance to him, comprising the largest force in the city, and controlling half of the city's trade. Due to his strength with formations, he is also the most important part of the city's defense. Despite serving in this role, he is also the backer of the three most powerful looting forces within the city: Guile Workshop, Insect Nest, and Wanying Building.

After Luo Feng defeated Elder Tianhe, Weiyang spoke with Master of Guifang, who told him Luo Feng might rule Yulan City in the future, but Weiyang did not attempt to recruit him. Later, when Yuan Xiang passed the position of Commander of the Xuntian Palace to Luo Feng, Weiyang unsuccessfully attempted to dissuade him. He then passed an invitation to Luo Feng to meet him through the former commander, Owner of Wanying Building, hoping to get Luo Feng to voluntarily relinquish the position.

Since Luo Feng refused to meet him immediately, Weiyang decided to teach him a lesson, attacking him with a portion of his Black Sun Flame technique, but was unable to harm Luo Feng's powerful body, supported by the Indestructible Heart.

During Luo Feng's investigation of the infiltration of the city by Low-Level Hunyuan Lifeforms, Weiyang was targeted by the invasion group, due to his strength and importance. Despite his strength, he was easily defeated by the Super Limit Bewitching Worm Clan member and his 12 accompanying Perfect God Emperors, even with the support of the city formation and multiple Elders. His five clones within the city all perished, and the Super Limit worm possessed his body.

After Luo Feng successfully defended the city, Weiyang secretly transferred some of his resources out of the city through some elders allied with him. Later, he personally visited Luo Feng, hoping to buy back his 2 treasures he lost at the hands of the Super Limit worm, but was left with two choices: self-annihilate his clone or have Luo Feng annihilate it. Understanding that his greed and cruelty left him with no way to retrieve his treasures, he annihilated his clone himself and withdrew from Yulan City.

characters.title: Palace Master Yuan Xiang

infobox.affiliation: Yulan City Nine Rivers Holy World Dark Holy Realm Dark World Group

characters.introText: Palace Master Yuan Xiang is known as a Second God Emperor in Yulan City and highly respected figure . He is a Half-Chaotic Origin level enlightenment cultivator and an Origin World expert, playing a crucial role in the city's founding. His contributions were immense, especially during the city's construction when he led many elders in fierce battles against Low-grade Chaotic Origin Lifeforms race.
characters.appearance:
After entrusting Yulan City to Luo Feng, Palace Master Yuan Xiang dispersed all of his external avatars and returned to his homeland in the Source World to fight a powerful inner battle: resisting the memory pollution caused by High Chaotic Origin Lifeform. He committed himself fully to this fight, sealing himself away in a closed cave dwelling in the Dark World Group, living in total isolation. At first, his willpower allowed him to endure. But over time, the memory pollution became more intense, and he could no longer wake up from the illusions that consumed him.

Yuan Xiang’s mind fell into layer upon layer of illusions, each more consuming than the last. He struggled constantly to determine what was real and what was hallucination. The illusions were so deep that even when he questioned his own sanity screaming that he could no longer tell real from fake he took some hope in the fact that he still knew he was lost. That meant a part of him hadn’t surrendered. Despite being overwhelmed, Yuan Xiang’s will to live remained unbroken. He endured endless pain, his consciousness distorted and invaded, and yet he continued to resist. He was alone, powerless, and cut off from the outside world, having lost even control over his own cave dwelling.

Eventually, Du Fang, a fellow cultivator and old friend, broke into the sealed cave after receiving no replies to his messages and realizing Yuan Xiang was in critical condition. What he found was heartbreaking: a trembling, twisted Yuan Xiang, deeply immersed in spiritual torment and stripped of all awareness of the external world. But Du Fang came prepared. Acting on Luo Feng’s orders, he brought a single drop of Life Dew a rare, potent essence capable of purifying and strengthening the soul. This droplet fused into Yuan Xiang’s soul, instantly washing away the filth of the memory pollution and give new energy to his spirit. His soul was not only cleansed but became significantly stronger, enough to suppress the pollution entirely.

Yuan Xiang was shocked and grateful. He asked how it was possible why his soul felt stronger than ever and how he had recovered so suddenly. Du Fang explained that this was a gift from Lord Luo Feng, who had risen to become one of the eternal lords of Chaotic Origin Dimension. Luo Feng had not forgotten the 5 billion Hunyuan crystals Yuan Xiang had once gifted him when he was weak a favor that had meant everything to the struggling young cultivator at the time. Du Fang told Yuan Xiang that if he wanted to completely erase the pollution, he could personally visit Luo Feng in the Dark Sacred Land, where Luo Feng resided. Luo Feng would erase the memory fragment personally. He also said that Luo Feng viewed the pollution not as a curse, but—after the soul became strong enough as a form of tempering.

Yuanxiang was stunned. The once-young junior he had helped now stood at the peak of the Chaotic Origin Dimension as a lord immortal, unerasable, and one of the few eternal beings of Chaotic Origin Dimension. What had once been a simple act of kindness had brought him a reward beyond measure.

characters.introText: In the novel he is described as a beautiful robot wearing dark red armor. In the donghua, he is a silver robot with blue highlights, looking similar to a robotic werewolf.
characters.appearance: In the novel he is described as a beautiful robot wearing dark red armor. In the donghua, he is a silver robot with blue highlights, looking similar to a robotic werewolf.
characters.history: Palati is an Immortal from Automaton Race. He is the first being that Luo Feng fought in the Extraterritorial Battlefield. Together with 2 other Immortals from his race, he ambushed and killed an Immortal Marquis before detecting Luo Feng's team ship and ambushing them. He ended up fleeing after close to 2,000 of his F8 Grade Automaton Puppets were destroyed by Luo Feng and Tai Wo.

characters.title: Pan Ke Master
characters.introText: A man of the Purple Moon Race, with short-cropped golden hair, two arms, and one face.
characters.appearance: A man of the Purple Moon Race, with short-cropped golden hair, two arms, and one face.
characters.history:
Pan Ke Master is a Universe Master Level 4 of the Purple Moon Race. He is a friend of Feng Long Master, so when he heard that Luo Feng, whom Feng Long Master had encountered in his region of Flame Water Lake, had an Arcana capable of suppressing a domain-type Pinnacle Arcana, he let him know so they could work together to obtain it.

After telling Feng Long Master about the Shi Wu Wings, he worked with Feng Long Master and You Ya Master to trap Luo Feng and force him to give them up. Five Chaos Master arrived during the chase, further pressuring Luo Feng, forcing him to resort to flee into the Twelve Abysses. The three Universe Masters of the Purple Moon Race then gave up their pursuit.

Like the other members of the Purple Moon Race (other than Purple Moon Ancestor), he died when Morosa devoured the origin of Purple Moon Ancestor's Miniature Universe.

characters.title: Pan Xi
characters.introText: Leader of the Fire Phoenix Organization. He along with 17 other executives was the target of Luo Feng's 1st Level of Highest Points Mission.
characters.appearance: Leader of the Fire Phoenix Organization. He along with 17 other executives was the target of Luo Feng's 1st Level of Highest Points Mission.
characters.history:
Pan Xi was born a Slave. However, on the day before he was about to be implanted with the Microchip, he rose up and took over a life Planet. After this, he commanded a large number of underlings to take a ship and left the slave planet. After fleeing the slave planet, he first dispersed his underlings and obtained a universe civilian identity within Cui Lang Starfield alone. Living on a normal life planet in the Starfield and training for hundreds of years, he waited to show himself again. When he did though, he was already a Universe Level warrior. With his strength, he began to take revenge on the slave traders from back then, they had some strength too but were later destroyed by Pan Xi.

Pan Xi took control of his own slave-trading ring and became a new slave trader. With resources in hand, his power rose quickly and he later reached the Domain Master level. At this time, he contacted the other 17 Domain Masters and created an alliance. With the 18 of them together they naturally took a greater control of the market. With the Fire Phoenix Organization behind him, Pan Xi got a large amount of resources and established his power before training seriously. He bought techniques and had begun training and became the only one to reach World Master Level 3. Through his power, he even got to know the 7th prince of Ganwu Universe Country, and along with the prince’s support, his network got even more terrifying.

Luo Feng and Dylan respected him for he came from nothing, but the only thing he didn’t have was a bottom line to his methods. His brutality and ruthlessness had caused trillions to suffer. The Fire Phoenix Organization controls tens of thousands of slave planets, and many universe civilians leading peaceful lives have had their families broken because of him. Trillions of them being enslaved and sold about, such dark methods finally made the Virtual Universe Company send Luo Feng to deal with him.
