characters.title: Pei Xing Master
characters.introText: As a great being from the Purple Moon Race, he has 4 faces and 16 arms, signifying his 2nd-purest bloodline heritage. He had 2 pairs of black wings and a suit of black armor.
characters.appearance: As a great being from the Purple Moon Race, he has 4 faces and 16 arms, signifying his 2nd-purest bloodline heritage. He had 2 pairs of black wings and a suit of black armor.
characters.history:
Pei Xing Master had been cultivating within Purple Moon Holy Land Universe for 18 Reincarnation Eras, and was informed on the events in Universe Ocean. He was jealous of those who could travel to Universe Ocean and he especially wanted to surpass Luo Feng. When Deer Bug Master and other Universe Masters from the Purple Moon Holy Land Universe died, spots were opened for he and some other Universe Masters-to-be to become Universe Masters.

Pei Xing was allowed to travel to Universe Ocean once he reached Universe Master Level 5. He had combat, defense, and divine power at the level of Universe Master Level 4, but his restraining and escaping abilities were Universe Master Level 5. He was ambitious and wanted to make a name for himself, immediately fighting against the top-tier Universe Master Level 5 Eight Ruins Master of the First Reincarnation Era. Their fight produced detailed information that was passed to the powers in Universe Ocean.

While exploring the Tilted Peak Realm, he felt the calling from Luo Feng's 3 pairs of Shi Wu Wings and rushed out to kill him and take the wings. Unfortunately for him, he came up against Luo Feng and his Star Tower, and was immediately suppressed by its suction power before being annihilated by the 4th layer of secret engravings technique, Smashing.

characters.history:
The highest authority in the Universe Star River Bank. Despite him being low-key, his power ranked at the top of humanity. Even Void Gold Master was not his match; he was comparable to Primal Chaos City Leader. This made him an incredibly important part of humanity's strength.

He is one of the Universe Masters who welcomes Luo Feng to Universe Ocean. He has connections to some Universe Masters from Purple Moon Holy Land, so he can gather information on the goings on in Universe Ocean.

He makes it to the Duan Dong River Boat of Mausoleum and takes part in the Rhinoceros Emperor Game to attempt to obtain the Duan Dong River Inheritance. He met the first basic requirement to obtain the inheritance, but gave up when it was announced that once one gets in contact with the inheritance, failure would mean true death.

When Luo Feng obtains the Duan Dong River Inheritance and trades some of the memory stones for Xeon treasures, Penggong Master receives the Yan Jun Rod. During the battle with the Demon Race, he formed the 4 pillars of humanity, alongside Primal Chaos City Leader, Darkness Master, and Luo Feng. He led the troop with Void Gold Master and fought against Dream Demon Ancestor.

In the 1003rd era after the World of Jin appeared, he became a True God.

Po Yu Marquis is one of the subordinates of King Sky Feather. An Immortal Marquis, she sends 3 Domain Masters and 3 World Masters to kill Luo Feng in Devil Mountain because she has a grudge with King Zhenyan. The Thousand Star Sect works under her command. After the incident of Devil Mountain she tries to cover her tracks but to no avail and her cover identity is revealed, which results in her being subdued by King Zhenyan.

After Luo Feng and Ancestor Yuan transcended reincarnation, Po Yu moved into Ancestor Yuan Holy Land Universe, due to the intervention of King Zhenyan, who pled for her.

characters.title: Polu God King
characters.introText: A man in white and has holy face, making it difficult to discern his gender.
characters.appearance: A man in white and has holy face, making it difficult to discern his gender.
characters.history:
Polu God King is one of the six God King direct disciples of Emperor Qing. He has the best communication skills among Emperor Qing's disciples and has many friends all over the Continent of Origin. His mastery over the Chaotic Origin Bloodline has elevated him to the Invincible First Level God King. Thanks to his exceptional sociability, he has good relationships with many influential figures, including God Kings of the Wan Jie Kingdom. He even became a disciple of the Wan Jie Kingdom Master, which made him admired by the outside world.

His establishment of the Tianxin Alliance proves his commitment to fostering community among cultivators, providing a platform for mutual support and connection without rigid constraints, due to this reason is why Luo Feng was willing to join it after being invited by Polu God King. He is also known for his kindness to help other God Kings and weak cultivators, frequently sharing his knowledge through public preaching which is attended by numerous Eternal True Gods.

Later on one occasion in his public preaching at Polu City, which was also attended by Zhang Yun Ge and Moyu Qingyan, he invited both of them to show their skills, after seeing and realizing that the two of them had average talent, while Moyu Qingyan already has Luo Feng as his master, he finally took Zhang Yun Ge as his disciple.

characters.introText: He has been the guardian of Humanity's Sacred Land for countless ages, his contribution to humanity is immeasurable.
characters.appearance:
Before breaking through to True God, Primal Chaos City Leader had 3 unique bodies.

Primal Chaos City Leader's original body wears a golden robe, has cyan-colored scales on his head, and a face that looks like an Earthling's. His eyes are as calm as the endless starry sky. Even just standing in place, he exudes an overwhelming power, as if the surrounding space and time could be violently shattered at any time. It has an intensely aggressive aura. His original body traverses Universe Ocean, and is the form that often appears within the Virtual Universe.

After breaking through to True God, this was his only body, and his aura was more conservative and reserved.

The body that manages Primal Chaos City is a burly man about 3 meters tall, wearing an incredibly complex, ancient, dark red armor and combat boots. He has two fiery red horns on his forehead, with peculiar engravings, and a scaly tail that stretches out from his armor. While he looks very ferocious, his eyes are calm like the vast ocean or endless space, calming one down from within. This body is responsible for killing and punishing, so those in the city are told to be respectful and not offend him.

This body is a Special Lifeform over 10,000 kilometers tall and is well-known due to wielding the Top Arcana Domain Treasure, Thousand Treasures River. His skin is silvery-white, and he has over 1,000 antennas on his head, as well as a pair of eyes that were very peaceful, like a large lake. He walks barefoot, holds an ancient, rugged stone staff, and wears a seemingly ordinary shirt. This shirt has a thousand tools on it, making sounds that penetrate the soul, and is actually a form of the Thousand Treasures River. This body stays in the Original Universe and is in charge of the Virtual Universe Company.
characters.personality: Primal Chaos City Leader is an extremely responsible character, taking to heart his duty of managing the Virtual Universe Company and leading the Human Race. He always keeps the race's best interests in mind, and is known for being a most impartial and authoritative leader. While many Universe Masters could not be bothered with the trivialities required to manage the race, he has incredible patience and as such has always been much respected. Among the other races, he is famous for his slaughtering of enemies and incredible strength.
characters.history:
Primal Chaos City Leader is the first disciple of Ancestor Yuan, and is the acting leader of the Virtual Universe Company while Yuan is suppressed. Additionally, he protects and manages the Beginning Universe in Yuan's stead.

If you'd like to know more, make sure to check out PCCL's dedicated Biography page.

characters.history:
When the Original Universe was first formed, there were numerous life forms born in Prison. However, a black throne had also been born, emanating endless evil energy.  Due to their weakness, the Prison Race thought only a True God was qualified to sit on the throne, not suspecting that it was a living being. When it became Immortal, it could change its shape!

Oddly, the throne had the natural characteristics of a Arcana, as it could form an illusion and a true treasure domain! With its strength, it swiftly became a Universe Master, eventually becoming the most powerful creature of the race. However, when it reached the top-tier of the fifth level, it couldn't break through any further. Despite other great beings being born after, they all still respected Prison King, even Devil Ancestor.

After the humans defeated the Demon Race in their first battle, Devil Ancestor ordered Prison King to lead a team to go to the human territory and watch the fight, notifying him if the humans were losing.

characters.appearance: A slender figure, yet possessed unyielding spirit.
characters.history:
Pu Cheng is one of the Twelve Eternal Being of the Ice Peak Faction, and among its top three strongest figures, alongside Ice Peak Ancestor and Sha Zhou. Though immensely powerful his strength can rival that of a Cultivator Lord. Pu Cheng is well-known for being the most unruly and independent among the twelve. Even the Ice Peak Ancestor finds him hard to control.

Unlike the more aggressive and warlike figures in the Ice Peak Faction, Pu Cheng often takes a neutral or anti-war stance. During a tense meeting where most were preparing to launch a war against the Cultivator Camp, Pu Cheng was the first to leave the hall outright, refusing to participate in the war. His sudden exit shocked the other eternal beings and even enraged the hot-headed Three Emperor of wind, thunder and sea. However, no one dared to stop him, as his strength and status allowed him to act without fear of backlash.

Pu Cheng shares this peace-seeking mindset with Xiusaiwei and Sha Zhou, both of whom also declined to join the war. The absence of these three top-level existences caused Ice Peak Ancestor to rethink the military campaign, eventually forcing a retreat and full return of seized territory and resources to the Cultivator Camp.

He and Xiusaiwei had the closest ties to the Practitioner Faction. The primary reason stemmed from the intense rivalry between his and Ice Peak Ancestor's Clan for resources as the two most powerful clan in their faction.

characters.title: Pu Xin God King
characters.introText: Pu Xin God King is a highly enigmatic and low-key existence within the Continent of Origin, belonging to the God King Second Realm. Unlike other powerhouses who frequently intervene in conflicts or seek to expand their dominion, Pu Xin is characterized by his withdrawn nature and preference for obscurity. He rarely appears in public struggles and is primarily known for occasionally accepting disciples within illusory environments. Despite this reserved approach, his legacy is significant, as two of his disciples reached the God King Second Realm themselves, including the notable Wu Xin God King.
characters.appearance:
Pu Xin God King is a highly enigmatic and low-key existence within the Continent of Origin, belonging to the God King Second Realm. Unlike other powerhouses who frequently intervene in conflicts or seek to expand their dominion, Pu Xin is characterized by his withdrawn nature and preference for obscurity. He rarely appears in public struggles and is primarily known for occasionally accepting disciples within illusory environments. Despite this reserved approach, his legacy is significant, as two of his disciples reached the God King Second Realm themselves, including the notable Wu Xin God King.

Among investigators of Tian Kun’s sudden death, Pu Xin became one of the prime suspects due to his mastery in soul-type and will-based methods, which were believed capable of slaying Tiankun silently without even allowing reincarnation. His reputation as a cultivator of profound, concealed strength led Emperors such as Emperor Fu to question whether Pu Xin had finally emerged from his long seclusion to influence the balance of power. Although no direct evidence tied him to the mysterious black-robed, golden-masked figure (who was, in fact, Luo Feng) sighted in Food Kingdom, his unique skillset, coupled with his patient and secretive nature, made him a credible candidate in the eyes of the Two Great Ancient Kingdoms.

Ultimately, Pu Xin God King stands out as a symbol of latent power concealed beneath restraint — an ancient being whose silence has endured across countless eras — made him both overlooked and feared. His potential involvement in pivotal events underscores the possibility that he has long awaited the perfect moment to act, making him one of the most enigmatic figures in the Continent of Origin.

characters.title: Pula Nuolanshan
characters.introText: A handsome youth, with the pointy ears and red eyes characteristic of the Nuolan Shan family.
characters.appearance: A handsome youth, with the pointy ears and red eyes characteristic of the Nuolan Shan family.
characters.personality:
Pula Nuolanshan is one of the heirs of the Nuolan Shan Family and has an antagonistic relationship with Bu Luo Nuolanshan. He is the grandson and student of the current head patriarch, Yu Ke Nuolanshan and was the captain of first fleet that attacked Earth. Ever since his youth, he was the brightest within the family; as a Stellar Level 9 with his own domain, he was considered a genius and the family's next hope for a Universe Level heir. His journey to Earth was an arduous one, unlike any journey he had taken before, as a high-ranking heir.

He was ordered by his grandfather to collect Earth's data and apply to purchase it as soon as possible. He and his crew discovered the Earth Automaton Ship and informed his grandfather of its presence before hacking every television, computer, etc. to broadcast his team's strength and attempt to get Earth's upper echelon to leave the Survival Bases that Luo Feng purchased. His team also discovered the sleeping Zerg Race nest, and that the Golden Horned Beast was still alive.

Despite his efforts, he did not finish his tasks before Luo Feng became the owner of Earth. He received the order from De Wen Nuolanshan to retreat, and the subsequent order from Nuolan Shan to leave a small team behind to recover the Automaton Ship and avoid the bug clan nest. He learned alongside the three patriarchs that the team he left behind on Earth all died in battle with the Golden Horned Beast Body.

characters.trivia:
In the novel, Pula does not participate in the secret operation to retrieve the Golden Horned Beast corpse. This makes sense, as the Nuolan Shan Family wants to avoid being seen as space pirates. In the donghua, Pula participates in the operation, with the final explanation being that since he was dead, there was no proof that he was operating as a Nuolan Shan Family member.

In the novel, Pula is not killed by Nuolan Shan, which makes sense as he's a talented Stellar Level 9 warrior with a Domain. The leaders of the family are Universe Level and there are only 7 Universe Level members in the entire family, so it would make sense to leave alive someone else who could break through to Universe Level. In the donghua, Pula is killed by Nuolan Shan for his failure, probably to cement the ruthless nature of Nuolan Shan.

characters.introText: Purple Moon Ancestor was a Void True God, the creator of the Purple Moon Holy Land Universe and the leader of the Purple Moon Race. Due to his power, and the many reincarnation eras he had survived, he was very arrogant and openly antagonized the Human Race during their rise. Competition for the Duan Dong River inheritance led him to target Luo Feng in particular.
characters.history:
Purple Moon Ancestor was a Void True God, the creator of the Purple Moon Holy Land Universe and the leader of the Purple Moon Race. Due to his power, and the many reincarnation eras he had survived, he was very arrogant and openly antagonized the Human Race during their rise. Competition for the Duan Dong River inheritance led him to target Luo Feng in particular.

During the Sector Beast War, he destroyed any hope of reconciliation with Luo Feng by rejecting to exchange the last pair of the Chaotic Golden Wings for his protection.

Under Luo Feng's command, Morosa later destroyed his Miniature Universe/Holy Land by devouring its origin. In the final moments of his race, Purple Moon Ancestor was still contemplating the eventual destruction of the human race to console himself.

Sitting Mountain Guest speculated that he might have received an opportunity and was planning to accumulate strength in order to seize the Original Universe, thus targeting Luo Feng and the Human Race, worrying that another supreme being who could surpass him would emerge to refine the Will of The Original Universe before he could do so.

characters.history:
Purple Moon Phantom is the non-canon name given to the Purple Moon Race Universe Master who fights Primal Chaos City Leader. Purple Moon Phantom was the first member of the race to be seen in the story, and their battle with the city leader was their first time entering Universe Ocean. After hearing about the city leader's strength from Purple Moon Ancestor, Phantom sought him out for battle, but was defeated in one move.

Phantom died with the rest of the Purple Moon Race when the Sector Beast King Morosa devoured the origin of the Purple Moon Holy Land.

characters.history:
Purple-Clothed Lady is the non-canon name given to Si Yong's third disciple. A powerful Domain Master Level 8 Spirit Master, she was his favorite disciple. After Luo Feng killed Rock Wind Xiong, a fellow disciple, she was tasked with uncovering information on him.

After learning that the Na Family was in some way involved with Luo Feng, she used soul techniques to interrogate Lei Dong and Na Bu. Eventually, she hid a communication device within Na Bu so she could track his location, which came in handy when Na Ke rescued his father. She then hid and waited for Luo Feng's arrival, but he had been following her, hoping to meet Na Ke. Luo Feng then easily killed her with his Mosha Body.

In Donghua, It was shown that Luo Feng killed her by extracting and crushing her life core in Earthling Body.

characters.history:
Pushkin was one of the geniuses that the Ganwu Universe Country Imperial Family specially nurtured. He competed in the Pinnacle Genius Battle and was ranked 9th in the 89th world of the Universe Country Elimination Stage. With his strength, he had the ability to break into the Ganwu Universe Country's top 1,000.

In the Universe Country Arena Stage, he was in the 382nd group, along with Luo Feng and Ginelli. Over a million Apemen cheered for him when his name was announced, so his cheers were the loudest in the group. He and Ginelli came to an agreement to work together during the arena stage so they could both pass, since they were both from the universe country's specially nurtured geniuses.

Before the arena stage battle began, Ginelli provoked Luo Feng, who already saw Ginelli and Pushkin as the clearest threats. At the start of the battle, Pushkin killed multiple geniuses, however he was inferior to Luo Feng. Recognizing Luo Feng's strength, Ginelli asked Pushkin to assist him in defending against Luo Feng's attacks, but even Pushkin was barely able to defend against one attack. When Luo Feng told him to get out of his way or be eliminated, he left and fought other geniuses, thus surviving to make the final 10.

Luo Feng's ability to easily handle Pushkin greatly increased his stature among the Ganwu Universe Country geniuses.

characters.history:
Qi Niu is a Category 4 Wild Beast from the Blood River World, born with a gold domain! He can be considered an exceptional wild beast with a strong bloodline. Despite the position of most wild beasts on Blood River World (they are suppressed by humans), he rose to a high position within the Immortal Temple. A Pinnacle World Master who has absorbed 12 Blood River Crystals, he's even stronger than Blood God Ba Qi, his sworn brother! One can imagine that his Life Gene level has been increased, and that it was already higher than the standard human.

When he met Luo Feng, he imposed pressure onto him. Sensing that he could handle strong killing aura, he also gave him two Blood River Crystals as a reward for joining the Blood God Guards. It seems he's in charge of distributing crystals to new guards.

He is known to have a bad temper; the Blood God Guards know to never disrespect him and to always call him Lord Qi Niu. When he snorts, steaming hot air shoots out of his nostrils. He has a throne on the 5th floor of Huge Pit Palace, below Ba Qi's throne. He was present to see the Beast God Statue brought by Kuyan to the palace, staring at it with a complex look. He went with Ba Qi to investigate the crater left from Luo Feng's Earth Automaton Ship attack.

Qian Shui is one of the Stellar Level participants in the same Pinnacle Genius Battle as Luo Feng. She and her brother, Jiang Mo, are from Augustus Planet, and have terrifying reputations, known as the genius siblings. She had stepped into the gateway of two Original Laws, but they are not specified.

She placed in the top-100 in the Training Space Elimination and thus automatically qualified to be a core member of the Virtual Universe Company. In her performance in the Pinnacle Genius Battle Arena Duels, she made the top-20 and was the second-fastest to complete her battle in the round of 20. In the top-10 battles, she faced and defeated Ao Pa Te La, making the top-5, but lost to Bolan and Long Yun in the top-5 round-robin duel, placing her in the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm. She was the only Controller to make the top-5, but her strength was inferior to Luo Feng's.

In Primal Chaos City, she noted that the profundity of the Primal Chaos Tablets relative to each other did not necessarily matter, since if one could not pass level 21, for example, what would be the point of following the Huge Axe Primal Chaos Tablet, with its 32 levels. While in Primal Chaos City, she was closest to her brother and Ai Chen.

Like all members of her class except Bolan and Rong Jun, she failed her first attempt at passing the 1st level of the Tong Tian Bridge. She kept a solid pace with her class, passing the 1st level less than a year after Luo Feng, and being one of the first 8 to pass the 2nd level, doing so in her 9th year. In her 28th year in Primal Chaos City, she passed the 3rd level, making her the 7th to do so.

She was present with the other newbie members of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm for Luo Feng's battles with Mo Yi Lin and Ashi, and later against Sa Jin. As expected, she was demoted to the Heaven and Earth Secret Realm after her first Secret Realm Qualification Battle. She joined the others from the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm in sending off Luo Feng to the Primal Secret Realm.
characters.trivia: In the Donghua, her character model is reused multiple times

characters.title: Qiu Chi Ka
characters.introText: A fat warrior with six arms, rock-like skin, and a bald head. He wore purple armor.
characters.appearance: A fat warrior with six arms, rock-like skin, and a bald head. He wore purple armor.
characters.history:
Qiu Chi Ka was a Pinnacle Immortal King and the leader of one group of survivors of the Yan Ji Race.

When the four Pinnacle Races together created the 7th Battlefield, they drove out the Yan Ji Race, the aboriginal race that lived there. There were 100 Sacrificial Towers that contained inheritances of the race, and Qiu Chi Ka was one of the Immortals on one team entrusted with a tower. During the attack from the four Pinnacle Races, Qiu Chi Ka left markers and saved some of his race by teleporting them to his God Country through God Country Transmission.

When Luo Feng, King Ye Chen, King Piercing Tiger, King Purple Bell, King Cang Jin, and Ice Blade entered his team's Sacrificial Tower, Qiu Chi Ka was made aware of it by Pu Ai, then devised a plan to trick the group into helping him acquire the inheritance for his race. Despite Qiu Chi Ka's manipulations, Luo Feng was eventually forced to flee Cang Jin, and was close to exiting the tower without having unlocked the inheritance room. Furthermore, upon the deaths of Ye Chen and Ice Blade, Cang Jin had retrieved their talismans, meaning that there were no talismans left behind for Qiu Chi Ka to use to enter the inheritance room.

As a result, Qiu Chi Ka revealed himself, led the remaining warriors into a treasure room containing one chest (which held the Space Lock Band, among other treasures), trapping them all in the room and leaving the talismans behind for Men Bu and La Di Mo to retrieve and use to access the inheritance room. Qiu Chi Ka then self-destructed, calling to his dead wife Marsha, and hoping to kill Luo Feng and the others. His sacrifice enabled the remaining Immortal Kings of his team to acquire the race's inheritance and also heavily damaged Piercing Tiger, leaving him with less than 50% of his Divine Body.

characters.history:
Qiu Yan Ancestral God was one of the 3 Ancestral Gods of the First Reincarnation Era. He is a Special Lifeform, but also had a race under his leadership, the Qiu Yan Race, with an estimated population of a few thousand. With the destruction of the Original Universe of his era, he was banished from his homeland and the Ancestral God Sect of that era dispersed.

In the past, he, Great Thunder Star Master, and King Zhenjia encountered a powerful Sector Beast, forcing them to choose between surrendering or death. They chose to surrender, becoming slaves to the Sector Beasts, destined for death regardless of the future outcome.

When Luo Feng called out Great Thunder Star Master, Qiu Yan Ancestral God and King Zhenjia informed their followers to leave Universe Boat and avoid Luo Feng. After Luo Feng killed Great Thunder Star Master, Qiu Yan Ancestral God and King Zhenjia hid within the 10,000 Waves Water Region of Universe Ocean.

When Morosa decided to enter Universe Ocean, Qiu Yan Ancestral God and King Zhenjia gave it detailed information about Universe Ocean and the beings within, including Luo Feng.

After he killed 8.3 million Sector Beasts at once, Luo Feng imprisoned Qiu Yan Ancestral God and King Zhenjia in Star Tower. It is implied that he was killed before Skeleton Master, since Skeleton Master was killed to prevent anyone from learning about Morosa's existence as the Sector Beast King.

characters.title: Qiu Yu
characters.introText: In the novel, he has a face like a blade, with sparkling and translucent skin like a gem, even his veins were visible. He wore a fur-like genetic energy battle uniform and carried on his back a large battle blade almost as big as him.
characters.appearance:
In the novel, he has a face like a blade, with sparkling and translucent skin like a gem, even his veins were visible. He wore a fur-like genetic energy battle uniform and carried on his back a large battle blade almost as big as him.

In the donghua, he wears golden battle armor and has the typical appearance of a Nakamon Clan male, with grey skin, white hair, yellow eyes, and grey horns. He is tall and sturdy.
characters.history: Qiu Yu was a young elite of the Hundred Tigers Building organization who was sent to the World of Thunder on Cang Lan Star, the highest ranked elite of the eighth team. He ordered his team to surround Luo Feng's team to rob them of their One-Horned Iron Rhino horns, and tried to use intimidation rather than force. Unlike his companion, he was concerned about possibly losing team members in battling other Stellar Level 9 fighters. When Luo Feng refused to hand over the horns, his team attacked, but most of them were killed by Ao Gu's counterattack using the Hybrid Mother Copper shard.. He escaped with one of his Stellar Level 9 bodyguards, who sacrificed his companion, and was later present to watch Brolin enter the castle to exchange for treasures.
characters.trivia:
In the novel, his race is not revealed, but in the donghua, he is described as a member of the Nakamon Clan.

In the novel, he and his companion do not appear to have a flirtatious relationship. However, he does sacrifice her in a similar manner in the novel and donghua.

In the novel, he does not align himself with Brolin and Nuolan Shan.

In his debut in Episode 110, he is stated to be a Stellar Level 3, but in Episode 116, Nuolan Shan refers to him as a Stellar Level 9.

It is not explicitly stated in the novel that he died in the World Within a World on Cang Lan Planet; the last we hear of him is when he is observing Brolin exchange for treasures.

characters.history:
Qiu Yu's Companion is the non-canon name given to the Stellar Level 2 member of Qiu Yu's team in the World of Thunder. She was also an elite of the Hundred Tigers Building organization, but had a lower position than Qiu Yu. In the novel, her personality was impatient and abrasive, wanting to fight Luo Feng's team for their One-Horned Iron Rhinoceros horns simply because she appeared to have the stronger team. In the donghua, she seems more like a spoiled member of the organization, infatuated with Qiu Yu.

In both the novel and donghua, she dies at the hands of Ao Gu, through the use of the Hybrid Mother Copper shard.
characters.trivia: In the donghua, she and Qiu Yu seem to have a flirtatious relationship, while in the novel they do not.

characters.introText: A strange beast with an extremely hard, golden outer shell. When meeting those who have never seen him before, he likes to change his appearance. He emitted a golden light when flying through the universe.
characters.appearance: A strange beast with an extremely hard, golden outer shell. When meeting those who have never seen him before, he likes to change his appearance. He emitted a golden light when flying through the universe.
characters.history:
Rampaging Devil God is a lone True God from the Second Reincarnation Era, known for his capricious nature and savagery. While he was respectful around those he considered his betters (such as Bei Chi Star Master), he was unruly with those he felt were below his level. He is a Special Lifeform, one who consumes rocks, metals, and other hard materials, and the essence of those substances condensed on his outer shell, making it incredibly hard. As a True God, he had a Miniature Universe, and it had multiple Special Lifeform Universe Masters within. Swallow Hawk Master warns Luo Feng of Rampaging Devil God's nature when he decides to train his Willpower at the Black-Striped Stone Pillars. He did not fix himself to a specific pillar, choosing instead to wander around in disguise, attacking those who did not recognize him.

When Luo Feng killed Great Thunder Star Master and thus broke his Miniature Universe, Rampaging Devil God was the first non-human to arrive, hoping to plunder it, but it had already been scoured by Darkness Master and the others.

When the body of Jin God King arrived in Universe Ocean, Rampaging Devil God was the fifth great being to join to attempt to redirect it. Once the Ancestral Gods provided the details on the World of Jin, Rampaging Devil God was one of the first to explore, using his palace treasure to navigate and expressing his joy at the lack of restrictions on his power within it. He almost immediately clashed with a True God beast creature and used his fight with it to learn its language. Eventually, the beast called over 11 other True Gods, forcing him to retreat.

After escaping the encirclement, Rampaging Devil God wandered the World of Jin, eventually passing the selection process and joining the regular army. Upon being bestowed a standard True God armor, he exchanged his Blood Sea Devil Armor for 300,000 Military Credits, and used those to trade for a Xeon Arcana palace and four sets of Xeon Arcana attack treasures. His plan was to fully comprehend the Xeon Arcana he obtained, gain as many military credits as possible, then exchange for more Xeon Arcana before those of Universe Ocean learned of the different levels of Xeon Arcana. He bragged to Bei Chi Star Master about his spoils obtained from the World of Jin.

During the Sector Beast War, Rampaging Devil God's Miniature Universe was attacked multiple times by Morosa. Multiple times, Morosa escaped before any True God could engage it in battle, but the 3rd time it attempted to do so, Luo Feng was close enough to fight it with his Star Tower team, forcing it to harm its foundation to escape. When Morosa attempted to devour the origin of Original Ancestor's Miniature Universe, Luo Feng was guarding Rampaging Devil God's Miniature Universe, and rushed over to join Primal Chaos City Leader and the others.

When the final 900,000 Sector Beasts invaded Universe Ocean, Rampaging Devil God's Miniature Universe was attacked and devoured, resulting in the deaths of all who resided within.

After Luo Feng defeated Mo He, ending the Sector Beast War, he invited Rampaging Devil God, Blood Orchid Ancestor, and Jue He True God to live in his Miniature Universe, allowing them to become truly immortal by living within his Holy Land Universe. Filled with gratitude, Rampaging Devil God rediscovered the joy of living and kept up the spirits of those anxious about the destruction of the Original Universe.

While he was hunting for a World Tree Twig in Ancestral God Sect Secret Region's, Nine Remoteness Space, he got attacked by King Bark Mirror during their fight Luo Feng jumped into Nine Remoteness Whirlpool resulting in him going to the land where Nine Remoteness Master and his Race lived. When Luo Feng found out that he couldn't nurture World Tree Body, he decided to make Nine Remoteness his 3rd body after discussing it with his teacher Primal Chaos City Leader. He moved to the location where the Remoteness Oceans were, he then took a lump of bloody water from the World Master Royal Sea. When he was about to leave he was caught by Nine Remoteness Master, Nine Remoteness Master let Luo Feng go after he agreed to be under the Nine Remoteness Master's sub-sect in the Ancestral God Sect.

characters.personality: Rock Wind Xiong was a Level 2 Domain Master with a Level 9 Domain; he had even entered the gateway of the Law of Lightning ! characters.history:
Rock Wind Xiong was the city leader of Swallow Mound City. Despite being weaker than Chun Yu Tao, he was able to become the city leader due to his ability to absorb a Blood River Crystal and his being the student of the World City leader, Si Yong. He had been a Domain Master for over 100 years by the time Luo Feng arrived in Swallow Mound City, and was known for having a selfish personality.

As Luo Feng hunted for Blood River Crystals, he became aware of Rock Wind Xiong, who likely had an extra crystal, despite absorbing one. After killing his younger brother, Rock Wind Zhan, Luo Feng made his plans to kill him.

While entertaining Special Envoy Mo and Special Envoy You from the Immortal Temple, he sought information on his brother's whereabouts, as it was rare to meet envoys from the Immortal Temple. While expressing his frustration with his brother, he was attacked by Luo Feng, who eventually killed him after faking his death.

characters.introText: As for Rong Jun, if you manage to surpass him in this lifetime, it would indeed be an accomplishment.
characters.appearance:
Barefoot, with messy, golden hair, he's a young, sturdy-looking 3 meter tall youth, who looks very similar to an Earthling, only sturdier and taller. He also has tiger-like eyes and a golden scale on his forehead. He gives off a formless energy and strength, and his voice is thick and powerful.

In the Donghua, he has lime green hair and appears more civilized. His appearance does not yet look unique; he wears armor like everyone else.
characters.personality:
Savage loves to kill the strong. Only geniuses with true strength could attract his attention. During the Stellar-level Pinnacle Genius Battle, he showcased his confidence, by stating his goal was to be number one in the universe. He was planning to forfeit after his fight with Luo Feng, just so he could go through the losers' circle of 9,374 matches afterward for additional training. Luo Feng's strength made him consider defeating Luo Feng more important than the training in the loser's circle, which indicates the respect he has for worthy opponents.

Despite how he initially came off during the genius competition, Rong Jun is actually an earnest and passionate guy who easily makes friends with those able to compete with him.  When Luo Feng matches up against Long Yun, Rong Jun gives him a warning to be careful of his Law of Earth  comprehension, with the hopes that Luo Feng can win.
characters.history:
The death of Rong Jun's dad

Not much is known about Rong Jun's early life. He was adopted by someone whom he has great respect for, however, that being was killed by an Immortal who founded an empire. It is implied that this Immortal is not ordinary, fueling Rong Jun's desire for strength.

While his background isn't as exceptional as someone like Wu Ka, it is enough that he knew much more about the inner workings of the Virtual Universe Company than Babata, and by extension, Luo Feng.

Rong Jun and Nabini entering the Pinnacle Genius Battle

Rong Jun is one of the 822.5 billion Stellar Level participants in the Ganwu Universe Country selection portion of the Pinnacle Genius Battle in which Luo Feng participated. He represented the Golden Sword Empire.

Rong Jun facing off with Thunder God

Rong Jun was placed in the 88th world for the Ganwu Universe Country Elimination Stage, same as Thunder God. On the 27th day of this stage, he encountered Thunder God, easily defeating him with one blade slash. Thunder God, when reflecting on this battle with Hong and Luo Feng, noted that Rong Jun had definitely stepped through the gateway of the Original Laws. When observing Rong Jun's footage, provided by Bu Te A Shen Ka, both Hong and Luo Feng acknowledged his strength.

Rong Jun faces Hong (donghua-only)

With his performance in the 88th world (finishing ranked 3), Rong Jun made it to the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Stage, where he fought in Group 161, along with Hong. His strength caused others to group up and attack him, but he easily slaughtered 5 of the 10 who initially attempted to surround him. His path was a path of slaughter, and he was clearly the most outstanding genius in that group.

As a result, he made it to the 1v1 battles, where he planned to win the first 3, then lose the last battle so he could participate in the loser's circle matches. He was interested in fighting the 9,374 battles for his training. Before his 4th 1v1 battle, he looked at a picture of his adopted father, promising to enter the Virtual Universe Company (VUC), become the strongest within his generation in the VUC. He also promised to then kill the Immortal responsible for his death, and reclaim his true name, Tu Man.

Rong Jun vs. Luo Feng!

His battle with Luo Feng was preceded with images of his performances up to that point of the Pinnacle Genius Battle. This battle was the most eagerly anticipated of the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Duels, with tickets being extremely expensive. The two finally had their battle on July 26, 2066. When the two finally met face-to-face, Rong Jun shared his plan to lose to Luo Feng, and felt his fighting spirit when he promised to directly defeat Rong Jun.

The two engaged in a heated battle, with Rong Jun advancing toward Luo Feng, who retreated using the Soaring Shuttle. He then attacked Rong Jun with the Yan Shen Armament, using the Phantom Sword Form to form one golden blade, but Rong Jun deflected it with one slash. The dance continued, with Luo Feng dodging time and again, while Rong Jun chased him down with peculiar movements. After exchanging about 10 attacks, Rong Jun realized that he couldn't continue directly clash with Luo Feng's attacks, since his body bore the brunt of the attacks, while Luo Feng used a Spirit Weapon. Those who observed the battle felt that the pair had decent strength, but nothing special compared to previous years.

Rong Jun and Luo Feng's final clash

Luo Feng, understanding that he had already used half of his Spirit Energy, revealed his secret weapon, a second Phantom Sword! However, to his surprise, Rong Jun was able to defend against both blades, prompting Luo Feng to acknowledge his strength. Before Luo Feng launched his next attack, Rong Jun threw his blade aside, shocking both Luo Feng and the spectators. Rong Jun then declared that his true aim was to be number 1 in the entire universe, and his basic expectation was to make the top 1,000. He then revealed a new battle blade, the Earth-Splitting Blade, and told Luo Feng to use whatever skills he had. As Luo Feng launched his two blades, Rong Jun produced a phantom image, his Law of Space  comprehension having reached a level comparable to Arc of Light. Due to the phantom image, Luo Feng was unable to determine the real body, prompting him to separate the two phantom blades into their 18 small golden blades, attacking Rong Jun from all directions and impeding his movement. He also used two Soaring Shuttles to form two Swordfish Formations, then reformed the 2 phantom blades, attempting to defeat Rong Jun before he could attack. However, with the strength of his Law of Earth  Domain and the speed and power of his blade attack, Rong Jun rushed forward, being pierced through the chest by one of the phantom blades, while slashing through Luo Feng, leaving him the one man standing.

Rong Jun holding the defeated Luo Feng

Despite defeating Luo Feng, Rong Jun acknowledged his absolute calmness and ability to think in the short time frame after he unleashed his true strength. He stated that despite intending to commit suicide in the match after defeating Luo Feng, Luo Feng's reactions made that impossible, forcing him to defeat him and win the battle. The battle between the two caused the other Ganwu Universe Country geniuses to acknowledge that Rong Jun was indeed the strongest of the group. The spectators erupted in cheers, having been completely surprised by the strength shown by the pair.

Having defeated Luo Feng in the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Stage, Rong Jun automatically qualified for the top 1,000 of the Ganwu Universe Country, and was considered their strongest genius. While the Immortals who watched him thought he had no chance at reaching number one, they thought he might make the top 10. Before arriving for the next stage, he was discussed by Wu Ka and his World Master aides. Lord of Ganwu was very disappointed that none of the geniuses trained in the Ganwu Secret Region were able to match with Rong Jun, and he admonished his Immortal subordinates for their uselessness. In the meantime, Luo Feng used a simulated Rong Jun as his training partner in the Slaughter Space, working to strengthen his combat ability.

Rong Jun and Luo Feng arrive at the next stage

When the Ganwu Universe Country group gathered for the Training Space Elimination, Rong Jun met Luo Feng, acknowledging his improved strength. Thirteen noted that Rong Jun was the only one with a guarantee of not being eliminated, and told him that Lord of Ganwu had high expectations of him. The other Universe Country groups spoke only of Rong Jun when they discussed the Ganwu Universe Country.

Rong Jun advancing in the Training Space

Rong Jun performed well from the beginning of the Training Space Elimination stage, ranking 12th early on and exciting the fans from the Ganwu Universe Country. As the stage continued, he fell to 16th, still considered incredible considering there were over a million geniuses competing. He ranked 13th after dying in the 5th tower of the training space, and ultimately finished 14th after Luo Feng moved past him. After he was eliminated, he observed Bolan and Luo Feng's performances, noting that he might lose in one move versus Bolan, while declaring that despite Luo Feng's improvement, he wouldn't be able to stop him.

Rong Jun continuing through the Training Space

After this stage concluded, Rong Jun and Luo Feng were lectured by Thirteen, who made sure they weren't too arrogant after their success, and prepared them for the arena duels. He informed them that Controllers had a large advantage in the Training Space, while Illusionists had a large disadvantage, making the arena duels a different beast from the Training Space. He also told them that the Immortals concluded that Luo Feng was among the top 10 in strength while Rong Jun was in the top 20, but that everyone in the top 20 could make the top 10.

Since he placed 14th in the Training Space Elimination, Rong Jun was one of the top 100 who were automatically accepted as core members of the Virtual Universe Company (VUC). These 100 were the first 100 selected to participate in the final battle. He acknowledged Luo Feng's strength and told him he hoped to defeat him again in the Arena Duels. The pair sat together and observed the battles between the 7,200 who competed for the remaining 100 spots in the final battle, having made good impressions on each other. They focused on tens of screens at a time, and eventually both watched Jia Laixi's 3 battles.

When the 200 participants had been determined, Rong Jun shed some light on the 4 Secret Realms of the VUC for Luo Feng. He explained the value the company placed on the Primal Secret Realm and some of the perks of being a member, revealing the bodyguard team led by an Immortal. This stunned Luo Feng, who also realized that Rong Jun must have more of a background than he initially thought, since he knew so much.

Rong Jun after winning a 1v1 battle

Eventually, Rong Jun was among the 20 selected from the 100 winners in the first battle. He was placed against Gu Si Luo, a Controller who was considered the only genius who might have a chance against Bolan. Despite others commenting that Rong Jun had no chance of winning, he eventually did, in the longest battle of the 10. His blade work shocked Luo Feng, and even made Bolan crease his eyebrows. His and Luo Feng's performances greatly pleased Thirteen.

Rong Jun vs. Bolan

Due to how the VUC determined the next combatants, he was placed against Bolan, and lost, as expected. Some of the Immortals present felt that if he hadn't been selected to face Bolan, he could have possibly made it to number 2 in the group. Before losing to Bolan, Rong Jun warned Luo Feng not to underestimate Long Yun, noting his incredible Law of Earth  Domain and the probability that he wasn't as simple of an opponent as he seemed. After he and Luo Feng lost, they watched the remaining battles, each commenting that the other could have possibly made it to number 2.

By placing in the top 10 of the Pinnacle Genius Battle, Rong Jun was one of the 8 to be placed in the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm, along with Luo Feng, Wu Ka, Qian Shui, Ai Chen, Jiang Mo, Lancelot, and Ao Pa Te La. He was permitted to spend 30 years in Primal Chaos City, taking advantage of the resources there to deepen his foundation and increase his strength.

Rong Jun and Wu Ka choose the Huge Axe tablet

Early on, he and Luo Feng were shocked at the resources available, including Nutrition Cabins. With his eyes on the Immortal who caused his adoptive father's death, there was no way he could be satisfied with becoming a normal Immortal. When presented with the 52 Primal Chaos Tablets, he chose the Huge Axe Primal Chaos Tablet, not knowing that it was left behind by Huge Axe Creator until Wu Ka revealed the fact.

Rong Jun celebrated after he passed the 1st level of the Tong Tian Bridge

When the group of 1,000 geniuses began testing their strength and comprehension at the Tong Tian Bridge, he was the only person to pass the first level other than Bolan, who passed the first two. After showcasing his comprehension and strength through that performance, he was accepted as a disciple by Yuan Chen Country Master, making him the only genius of his group accepted by a Universe Venerable. In addition to Yuan Chen, Gu Lun also attempted to make him his disciple, shocking Venerable Nine Swords. Rong Jun's performance inspired Luo Feng and Wu Ka to work harder, and shocked those like Long Yun and Gu Si Luo.

Rong Jun's talent was acknowledged by King Zhenyan, King Wu Ni, and King Longyu, who continued to watch monitor him under orders from her boss, Venerable Nine Swords. With Yuan Chen as his teacher, he was able to see the first form of the Huge Axe Primal Chaos Tablet performed in front of him by a Universe Venerable! Later, when the group began to take advantage of the third treasure of Primal Chaos City, the Primal Chaos Beasts, he warned Luo Feng that some had already died when hunting the beasts.

In his 4th year in Primal Chaos City, he passed the 2nd level of the Tong Tian Bridge, making him the second to do so after Bolan. In his 10th year, he received a notification from Bevin, and, as he wondered who broke through, was shocked to learn that Luo Feng passed the 2nd and 3rd levels consecutively. He and Wu Ka, among others, arrived at the bridge to learn if Luo Feng passed the 4th level, and were relieved to hear that he had not. In his 13th year, Rong Jun passed the 3rd level, in his 19th he failed to pass the 4th, and in his final 10 days of his initial 30 year period, he passed the 4th level, causing Venerable Nine Swords and Kandeli to acknowledge him as an extremely rare talent. Shortly after Rong Jun passed the 4th level, Luo Feng passed the 5th, stunning him. Yuan Chen remarked that it was good that he knew that he was falling behind, then demonstrated the 2nd form of the Huge Axe Tablet once more.

As the genius group prepared to leave Primal Chaos City for the physical Secret Realms of the Virtual Universe Company, he and Luo Feng joked that Wu Ka needed to work harder to catch up.

After his 30 years in Primal Chaos City, Rong Jun and the 7 other members of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm traveled to the physical Absolute Beginning Realm, protected during the journey by King Meteorite. He was the first of the 8 to be sent to be dropped off at his living space, Star Fragment 80389092. Having a diameter of 5,800 kilometers (similar to that of a planet), the fragment had a huge mansion at its center, which served as his living quarters.

During his time in the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm, Rong Jun, Luo Feng, and Wu Ka formed one of the group's cliques, often meeting in Wu Ka's villa, and being called the Absolute Beginning's Three Heroes. After Yi Ke's death, Rong Jun took on his first training mission, deciding to select a Difficult-level mission due to his lack of experience. He smiled with admiration at Luo Feng's selection of a Dangerous-level Mission as his first. The two often teased Wu Ka about his great wealth, frequently enjoying luxurious items like God Drunk that neither of them could afford. At some point he attempted Fantasy Ocean, failing on the 6th island, which was considered terrifying Willpower for a Universe Level.

Luo Feng was still undertaking the mission on Blood River World by the time Rong Jun had received his 5th mission, prompting both Rong Jun and Wu Ka to comment that spending too much time on one mission would be a waste of time. In response, Luo Feng went to the Tong Tian Bridge, proving to the pair that he could now pass the 6th level. Rong Jun and Wu Ka were shocked, since it had only been 2 years since they left Primal Chaos City, and Luo Feng was able to pass the 6th level, which he couldn't do 2 years prior.

When Luo Feng completed his mission on Blood River World, he met with Tian Shi Palace Master, who noted that Luo Feng and Rong Jun had the best chances of becoming absolute warriors of the Human Race. He commented that if Luo Feng could surpass Rong Jun in his lifetime, that would be a great accomplishment, causing Luo Feng to think that Rong Jun indeed had some secret that made him different.

During his first 80 years in the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm, Rong Jun passed the 6th level of the Tong Tian Bridge, making him the third of his genius class to do so, after Bolan and Luo Feng.

Luo Feng vs. Rong Jun 2!

During his second century after the Pinnacle Genius Battle, Rong Jun participated in his first Secret Realm Qualification Battle. He and Wu Ka met with Luo Feng after learning he passed the 7th level of the Tong Tian Bridge, celebrating with some Thunderstorm Wine. As he had already finished his 10 missions for his first 100 years out of the Beginning Universe, he helped Luo Feng decide which missions to undertake. Later, he accompanied the rest of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm Universe Level rookies in watching Luo Feng defeat Ashi and Mo Yi Lin, complimenting him on his performance. He was uncertain if Luo Feng could defeat Sa Jin, and was impressed when he did. He and Wu Ka were shocked that Luo Feng completed 4 Dangerous-level missions so quickly, and he was confident that Luo Feng hadn't died on the mission at Devil Mountain.

Rong Jun loses to Luo Feng

By the time of the qualification battle, he was filled with confidence in his ability to remain in the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm. In the battle, he ranked 19th, placing him in the top 20 and meaning that he did not have to compete with the strongest members of the Heaven and Earth Secret Realm to keep his spot. He and Luo Feng teased Wu Ka when he was demoted to the Heaven and Earth Secret Realm, and the trio watched Long Yun and Bolan's performances in the Primal Secret Realm qualification battles. As a melee fighter, he was quite impressed with Mo Luo's performance vs. Bolan, and he was equally impressed with Simayan's victory over Mo Luo.

Celebrating Luo Feng passing the 13th level of the bridge

When Ke Luo Fu died, thus forfeiting his match with Luo Feng, Rong Jun joined the other rookies of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm in sending him off to the Primal Secret Realm. He was also there to send Luo Feng off after he broke through to Domain Master, expressing his shock that Luo Feng chose to break through and compete with the Domain Master geniuses instead of staying at the Universe Level. Later, he was among those who messaged Luo Feng after he passed the 13th level of the Tong Tian Bridge.

In the 800 years in Primal Chaos City since Luo Feng was accepted as a disciple-in-name to Primal Chaos City Leader, Rong Jun broke through to Domain Master. Through his performances in the Secret Realm Qualification Battles, he became an Absolute Beginning Secret Realm Domain Master. Later, he attempted to contact Luo Feng twice during his 6,092 years spent undergoing the inheritance of Star Tower, having recently become a World Master himself. He was still considered an incredible genius, a special talent with a bright future, with some of the upper echelon of the Human Race still believing that he would be stronger than Luo Feng.

It wasn't until Luo Feng passed the World Master Level Primal Sky Mountain that they began to admit defeat. By this time, Rong Jun was a Primal Secret Realm World Master, along with Bolan. The two became closer during this period, with both of them seeking to surpass Luo Feng. Rong Jun, who had already surpassed Bolan, was so strong that even if there was a Secret Realm Qualification Battle, he would remain in the Primal Secret Realm. Due to this, he thought he had closed the distance between he and Luo Feng, but he realized the gap had widened when Luo Feng passed Primal Sky Mountain. He and Bolan aimed to become Universe Venerables, but were somewhat discouraged after Luo Feng passed the 20th level of the Tong Tian Bridge.

After Luo Feng became a Universe Venerable, it was noted that Rong Jun and Bolan had become Immortal Kings (around 110,000 years after their Pinnacle Genius Battle). By the end of the story, Rong Jun had become a Universe Master.

characters.title: Rong Zhi
characters.introText: Undescribed in the novel, but in the donghua, he has a proud bearing and a head like an orc's, bald with wrinkles around his eyes. His eyes glow purple when he uses his hypnosis.
characters.appearance: Undescribed in the novel, but in the donghua, he has a proud bearing and a head like an orc's, bald with wrinkles around his eyes. His eyes glow purple when he uses his hypnosis.
characters.history:
Rong Zhi was one of the 4 team captains (along with Tuo Lei Wu, Aer Man, and Abu Luo Te) of the small group sent by Pula Nuolan Shan to search for the corpse of the Golden Horned Beast. A Spirit Master, Rong Zhi was tasked with hypnotizing Xu Xin, Luo Hua, and the leaders of the 5 great countries to learn the location of the corpse.

After Tuo Lei Wu negotiated with Luo Feng, Rong Zhi and his team were sent to the coordinates specified by Luo Feng to obtain the corpse. This meant that he avoided the battle that resulted in the death of the other teams. His status after this battle is unknown, but Luo Feng purchased and installed planet defense and security surveillance systems to be aware of the arrival of any other members of the Nuolan Shan Family (or any other invaders), so it is unlikely he appeared on Earth again.
characters.trivia: In the novel, Rong Zhi is sent to the coordinates specified by Luo Feng to obtain the Golden Horned Beast corpse, so he avoids the battle with Luo Feng in his Golden Horned Beast Body (GHB body). In the donghua, someone else is sent to the false coordinates, so Rong Zhi fights alongside Tuo Lei Wu and Pula Nuolan Shan against the GHB body.

characters.introText: Over 6 meters tall, covered in sleeveless black armor. His neck was red, almost like a red metal, and his face was red and clear, with two curved red horns. There was a rhombus crystal embedded in the middle of his forehead, and he had a long dragon tail.
characters.appearance: Over 6 meters tall, covered in sleeveless black armor. His neck was red, almost like a red metal, and his face was red and clear, with two curved red horns. There was a rhombus crystal embedded in the middle of his forehead, and he had a long dragon tail.
characters.history:
Sa Jin is one of the Universe Level seniors of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm of the Virtual Universe Company. Witnessing Luo Feng's victory over Mo Yi Lin and Ashi, he decided to punish him for his arrogance.

Sa Jin practices the Black Hole Evolution training techniques, comparable to the Time Space Scribbles. He passed the 7th level of the Tong Tian Bridge about 1,500 years prior to Luo Feng's cohorts' qualification battles, and was able to reach 90 at the Immortal Altar.

With his strength, he was able to defend himself against Luo Feng's Blade World and counter his 10,000 Thread Flow movement. However, his willpower was relatively weak, so he lost to Luo Feng's World Master Level 3 consciousness attack.

During the qualification battles, he faced Ke Luo Fu and was struck down by one of his claw attacks. When he faced Luo Feng again, he was easily defeated, as at this point Luo Feng had begun the Devil's Voice God General Inheritance. After defeating Bolan in the qualification battles, Luo Feng noted that he was much stronger than Sa Jin.
characters.trivia: While Sa Jin is not shown on screen, his name is shown when the Secret Realm Qualification Battle resumes

characters.history:
Sa La Ta is a Stellar Level genius who participated in the Pinnacle Genius Battle. He/she was Lei En's first opponent in the 1v1 battle portion of the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Stage.

It is unknown who won between the 2 of them, but had Sa La Ta won, he/she would have faced off against the victor of the "Bai Lin Duo Ke vs an unknown competitor match" in the 2nd round.

If Sa La Ta had won the 2nd round once more, he/she would have to face off against Rong Jun but he/she would then have lost the match and be sent to the losers bracket where his/her final standing would remain unknown.

Sago Nehru is a Planetary Level Spirit Master who has aligned himself with Atkin and Yan Hai. Born in the Yinfan Kingdom (印梵国), he is a new Inspector of the Thunder Dojo. Since aligning with Atkin and Yan Hai, he has contributed to the ostracization of Lei Meng.

He joins Atkin and Yan Hai when they travel to Luo Feng's house and robs his family of their treasures. Upon being threatened with their actions being exposed to the world, he attacks Xu Xin, causing her death.
characters.trivia: While Ni Helu and Nehru can both be spelled Ni He Lu in pinyin, the actual characters used for this character are different (倪壑虏 vs. 尼赫鲁). Due to Nehru being the last name of India's first prime minister, it is possible that the name was altered to avoid insulting him and his family. The donghua character's name is not seen in the Chinese novel.

Knowing the strength of the Yan Shen Armament, but also that it focused on attack and not defense, he split his attack into 9 silver arrows, believing that Luo Feng would not be able to defend against them all. Unfortunately, Luo Feng's Spirit Weapon for mobility was the Soaring Shuttle, so he easily defended against the attack, using the 2nd defensive formation, Sword Matrix.

characters.appearance: A winged man with a somewhat dispirited air around him.
characters.history:
Sang Shui Yun is an Eternal True God from Hu Yang City. He and Entropy Sky Flame are love rivals for Dream Flower Tower Master. In the past, he was accompanied in life by his true love, but after losing them, he was willing to sacrifice everything just to become stronger. It is presumed that he saw his true love whenever he saw Dream Flower Tower Master.

It is later revealed by Entropy Sky Flame that Sang Shui Yun is the true identity of Blood Cloud.

characters.appearance: The clone sent to battle over the Food Kingdom territory was a figure condensed from endless water.
characters.history: Sea Devil God King is a Second Level God King friend of Silver Moon God King. Due to him having a clone, Silver Moon invited him to assist in taking over the Food Kingdom territory left behind after Luo Feng killed Tian Kun and his companions. In the battle over the territory, 20% of his clone's Divine Power was destroyed in one strike from Luo Feng's Chaos Hole Indestructible Light. After further attacks, his clone was annihilated and he suggested to Silver Moon that the group retreat.

characters.title: Sea Emperor
characters.introText: The Three Emperors of Wind, Thunder, and Sea are a closely allied trio of Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform who belong to the Ice Peak Faction. Known for their similar appearances and personalities, they often act as one unit and are widely regarded with disdain by higher-tier beings due to their relatively weak strength. Despite this, they are extremely troublesome due to their shared trait of immortality, which makes it nearly impossible to permanently eliminate them. Within the hierarchy of Ice Peak Faction, they rank among the lowest of the twelve Eternal beings, yet they are some of the most aggressive in expanding territory. Nearly half of the over one hundred World Clusters occupied by Ice Peak Camp were seized by them during a period when the Cultivator Camp was preoccupied with war against the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction. They have a reputation for instigating conflict and exploiting the power of the Ice Peak alliance to act with impunity.

characters.introText: Second True Master was one of the seven True Gods of the Divine Eye Race. He and Seventh True Master, who were skilled in concerted techniques, were sent by Divine Eye True Master to seize the Duan Dong River Inheritance. Upon their arrival, they obeyed Zhen Kan Wu and did not directly attack any of the candidates.
characters.history:
Second True Master was one of the seven True Gods of the Divine Eye Race. He and Seventh True Master, who were skilled in concerted techniques, were sent by Divine Eye True Master to seize the Duan Dong River Inheritance. Upon their arrival, they obeyed Zhen Kan Wu and did not directly attack any of the candidates.

He and Seventh True Master were among the 299 candidates who made it through the first stage of the Rhinoceros Emperor Game, but since they were True Gods, they had to meet the Duan Dong River Miniature Universe requirements. Since he failed to meet those requirements, he was ineligible to continue the inheritance test, but to his surprise, not only would he be unable to seize the inheritance, he and the other candidates from his race were to be killed.

In the past, the seven True Masters attacked Thunder-Clad Devil God and his best friend Kong Luo over a Xeon Arcana, killing Kong Luo and establishing great enmity between the Divine Eye Race and Thunder-Clad Devil God. Later, Thunder-Clad Devil God established a relationship with Zhen Kan Wu, who agreed to kill all candidates of the Divine Eye Race. Despite hiding in Ice Cliff Fortress, Second True Master died at the hands of Zhen Kan Wu, through the Boat of Mausoleum.

Before dying, Second True Master asked the members of the race who were in Ice Cliff Fortress to self-destruct to survive, if they had additional bodies.

characters.title: Sha Sha
characters.introText: In the novel, she is described as a beautiful, alluring woman with jade-colored hair. In the donghua, she looks similar to a mermaid, but with a large shell (with a bluish pearl) covering her head. She also has a rhombus-shaped crystal-like object on her forehead.
characters.appearance: In the novel, she is described as a beautiful, alluring woman with jade-colored hair. In the donghua, she looks similar to a mermaid, but with a large shell (with a bluish pearl) covering her head. She also has a rhombus-shaped crystal-like object on her forehead.
characters.history: Sha Sha was a servant working at the One Hundred Flavors restaurant on Horned Dragon Planet. When Wei Lin was showing off his spirit weapon, he startled her, causing her to spill food on it. When he attempted to attack her, Luo Feng defended her, and at the end of the altercation, Gao Sheng Wei Di took her as a servant, as he knew the restaurant would send her to the Slave Market.

characters.title: Sha Shu
characters.introText: Similar in appearance to Earthlings. He is a skinny old man with an aquiline nose, short silver hair, and an ice mark on his forehead. He dressed in dark armor but smiled and laughed easily.
characters.appearance: Similar in appearance to Earthlings. He is a skinny old man with an aquiline nose, short silver hair, and an ice mark on his forehead. He dressed in dark armor but smiled and laughed easily.
characters.history:
Sha Shu is a World Master recognized by the Law of Water , working for the Virtual Universe Company (VUC) as a Last Phase Secret Realm Member. He meets Luo Feng after the Pinnacle Genius Battle and brings him to the entrance of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm. Along the way, he gives him a high level overview of the VUC, explaining the different regions and their amenities/treatment, the status of Core members (including Luo Feng), and the selective nature of the VUC.

He is affable and respectful, and never shows resentment at serving someone so far below his cultivation level. Due to the rules of the VUC, he could not enter the Virtual Universe's Absolute Beginning Secret Realm.

characters.title: Sha Zhou
characters.introText: Sha Zhou is one of the most mysterious and top 3 powerful Primogenitors across the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Feared and respected alike, her name stands alongside the most legendary figures, including Lord Xing Mang, Infinite Snake Ancestor, Mo Xu, and Kafuxiu. Known for her unmatched destructive talent, she has mastered both "Flame Power" and "Destruction Power" at their peak, making her the foremost expert in raw destructive force. Though she rarely appears and keeps few allies, her presence alone carries immense weight. Sha Zhou prefers to remain detached from politics, acting independently and only lending her support to those she truly cares for most notably, her lifelong friend, Ice Peak Ancestor.

characters.personality: Sha Zhou is a legendary figure known for her solitary and cold temperament, as well as her unwavering pursuit of ultimate strength. Having lived for an unimaginably long time, she once explored Mysterious Lands alongside the Ice Peak Ancestor, serving as his protector before he achieved Immortality. Though she is part of the Ice Peak Faction, her connection to it was never about power or resources, but rather a deep, personal bond with the Ice Peak Ancestor one strong enough that she would do anything for him. Over time, she has grown distant from factional affairs, preferring to walk her own path, guided by a personal code rather than political loyalty. She avoids worldly conflicts and rarely reveals her true power, yet many still regard her as one of the most formidable beings in the entire Chaotic Origin Dimension.

characters.title: Shadow Heaven Realm Lord
characters.introText: The Shadow Heaven Realm Lord is the immensely powerful master of the Shadow Heaven Realm, a vast and hidden world. His influence extends throughout the entire realm and even to many parts of the Continent of Origin. The Shadow Heaven Realm Lord is capable of cultivating powerful individuals, known as emissaries, through secret arts, though he acknowledges this method has flaws, particularly a lack of strong mental will in his creations. He views these emissaries as experimental subjects who are loyal to him and serve to earn resources.

characters.title: Shadow Lord
characters.introText: A shadowy figure. A huge, twisted phantom with blood-red eyes.
characters.appearance: A shadowy figure. A huge, twisted phantom with blood-red eyes.
characters.personality:
The Shadow Lord is arrogant, domineering, and aggressive. Unlike the other two leaders of Blood Crane Territory—Blood Lord (血领主), who is low-key, and Crane Lord (鹤领主), who is relatively peaceful—the Shadow Lord is known for being forceful and overbearing. He often bullies weaker forces and isn’t afraid to provoke powerful ones if he believes he has the upper hand. He enjoys seizing territory and resources, often justifying it with twisted logic.

Despite his overconfidence, he’s cunning and cautious when needed. He relies heavily on survival methods like hiding his life core in unknown locations, making him hard to kill permanently.
characters.history:
The Shadow Lord was born in a mysterious land within the Chaotic Origin Dimension. This region gave rise to the Blood Crane Territory and its unique race. Among the countless beings it produced, the Shadow Lord was one of the top three, reaching a level close to the Primogenitor (始祖), but still not fully immortal.

After a major war between Cultivator Camp and the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Camp, the Shadow Lord took advantage of the chaos to invade and occupy 16 clusters of origin worlds—territory that belonged to the cultivators. After the war, Luo Feng have Chen Shi to bring his order only to have his clone dispersed. When confronted by Luo Feng, the Shadow Lord refused to retreat and instead threatened to expand his control to 32 clusters.

Luo Feng tracked him down using life force sensing and launched a fierce solo attack. Despite the Shadow Lord's ability to merge with space and avoid normal attacks, Luo Feng’s blade technique locked onto his life essence and destroyed his entire physical form.

However, the Shadow Lord had not carried his life core with him. This allowed him to survive by recreating a new avatar from afar. He appeared through a projection afterward, demanding Luo Feng return his stolen treasures and vowing a relentless revenge to Practitioner territory. Luo Feng, unfazed, challenged him directly, stating that he might go to Blood Crane Territory itself to hunt for their life cores.

characters.title: Shadow Monarch
characters.introText: Shadow Monarch is a Universe Overlord who serves as the Intelligence Department Head of both the Virtual Universe Company and Hongmeng. He reports important information to Primal Chaos City Leader.
characters.appearance: A blurry phantom.
characters.history:
Shadow Monarch is a Universe Overlord who serves as the Intelligence Department Head of both the Virtual Universe Company and Hongmeng. He reports important information to Primal Chaos City Leader.

He became the head of the Intelligence Department of Hongmeng due to his performance in the same role for the Virtual Universe Company. The Virtual Universe Company's ability to crack the classified communication methods of those of other races who attempted to implant spies was so well-regarded that Shadow Monarch was placed in charge of the Intelligence Department of Hongmeng. His power was so great that it could rival some of the Hongmeng palace masters.

characters.title: Shao Dong Lai
characters.introText: An extremely handsome man, wearing a silver white cape, with a 2 star Universe Mercenary Medal on his chest. He has long purple hair, eyes piercing like blades, and a very carefree aura.
characters.appearance: An extremely handsome man, wearing a silver white cape, with a 2 star Universe Mercenary Medal on his chest. He has long purple hair, eyes piercing like blades, and a very carefree aura.
characters.history:
Shao Dong Lai is an elite Domain Master, a member of multiple organizations. He is a Commander of Three Axe Mountain, a 2 Star Universe Mercenary of the Universe Mercenary Alliance, and Military Department External Member of the Virtual Universe Company. He is friends with Ming Yu.

Since he and Ming Yu were stationed fairly close to Cang Lan Planet, they were hopeful of obtaining treasures from the recently revealed World Within a World on Cang Lan Planet. He agreed with Ming Yu that the Stellar Level explorers there should be satisfied with the Universe Crystals that they acquired. The two were shocked that Chinia was blocking everyone stronger than Stellar Level from entering the World Within a World.

After the powers of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire agreed on the number of Stellar Level explorers they were allowed to send, both he and Ming Yu sent 1,000 in hopes of obtaining treasures.

Human Race gives half of the knowledge to reach Tier 10 True God in exchange for his Freedom Alliance to join the Human Camp in Human Race Survival War, he would have got the other half after the war but Freedom Alliance decided to betray Human Race.

He is one of the top 5 students, currently ranked number 4, in the current training and has the strength of a God of War, but does not yet have the title as that would mean having to leave the Elite Training Camp and the corresponding resources.
characters.history:
He came from the main urban area of the base city of Jiang-nan, passed the Basic Training Camp to enter the Elite Training Camp. He is one of the top 5 students, currently ranked number 4, in the current training and has the strength of a God of War, but does not yet have the title as that would mean having to leave the Elite Training Camp and the corresponding resources.

When he was first introduced he was at Apprentice Level 6 (Advanced Warlord)  on paper,  but his true strength was Apprentice Level 8 (Intermediate Level War God), as even Yang Hui a Apprentice Level 8 (Intermediate Level War God) said he wasn't confident in defeating Shi Jiang, implying that Shi Jiang is as strong as he was. Yang Hui even claimed that after Shi Jiang graduates, he could have the potential to be the president of the Jiang Nan Base  City's Extreme Martial Club Headquarters.

characters.introText: Shu Fan is an Immortal Army Lord within the human forces operating on Misty Sand Island, a massive land fragment of the Yan Ji Continent in the Extraterritorial Battlefield. Described as having a seemingly delicate appearance with water flowing around him, Shu Fan is one of two Immortal leaders of a human army engaged in combat against alien races, specifically a Demon Race led by a Time-Space Nightmare Beast Immortal. His combat style and abilities reflect his status as an Immortal, though he struggles against stronger opponents like the demon clan’s Immortal leader. Shu Fan is grateful and respectful toward Luo Feng (referred to as "Yang" in their interaction) after Luo Feng intervenes to defeat the demon race's Immortal, saving his team from potential defeat. His demeanor suggests a pragmatic and cooperative nature, as he warmly invites Luo Feng to join their team and shares information about Mist Sand Island, indicating his experience in the region.

characters.title: Shui Yu Ancestor
characters.introText: Shui Yu Ancestor is a low-profile and relatively weak Hunyuan Ancestor-level being within the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Known for his pacifist nature, he avoids all major conflicts and instead dedicates himself to protecting his own race as well as numerous weaker groups. Due to his insufficient strength to stand alone among the Primogenitors, he chose to submit to the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction for protection, specifically aligning with the Giant-God Emperor's Clan, which shares his preference for non-intervention. Though not a warrior, Shui Yu Ancestor maintains his status by offering loyalty and support to his chosen faction, ensuring the safety and stability of his people. Despite his caution, He is aware of stronger beings like Luo Feng and deeply respects Luo Feng’s power shown in the Abyss Of Destruction.
