characters.title: Si Bo Wa
characters.introText: A demon more than 10 kilometers in length, as if he was a mountain range. He is covered with snowy hair tipped with gold, giving the appearance of a halo around him. He has three strange, scar-shaped engravings on his forehead.
characters.appearance: A demon more than 10 kilometers in length, as if he was a mountain range. He is covered with snowy hair tipped with gold, giving the appearance of a halo around him. He has three strange, scar-shaped engravings on his forehead.
characters.history:
Si Bo Wa is an Invincible Immortal King of the Sky Wolf Race who was trapped in Ice Prison by Venerable Blue Dou Kou. Before being trapped in Ice Prison, he was the 3rd student of Sky Wolf Venerable. Upon his capture, he was presumed dead, and had qualified to be resurrected by Sky Wolf Master due to his potential, however he couldn't be resurrected as he hadn't died.

Trapped in Ice Prison, he cultivated and killed others, becoming one of the 5 Invincible Immortal Kings in Ice Prison, and taking it upon himself to rank all of the prisoners by their strength, providing some entertainment to those trapped. He ruled the Southern region of the Ice Prison from a spectacular palace. He was known as even-tempered and peaceful, but there were times that he showed his true, ruthless, cunning nature.

Through his time in Ice Prison, he constantly thought about escaping, and finally found his chance when Luo Feng was imprisoned. He made a deal with Luo Feng, exchanging an Ancestral God Sect inheritance token for a scanner that would allow him to connect to the Virtual Universe, informing his teacher that he was alive and trapped in Ice Prison. His teacher reached out to Sky Wolf Master, who arrived at Ice Prison and forced Venerable Purple Dou Kou and Blue Dou Kou to release Si Bo Wa. He escaped the region with Sky Wolf Master in his Sky Wolf Palace.

characters.title: Si Fan Qi
characters.introText: A green-skinned old-looking man. He wears gold armor and has a gold marking on his forehead.
characters.appearance: A green-skinned old-looking man. He wears gold armor and has a gold marking on his forehead.
characters.history:
Si Fan Qi is an elder of the Gold Horn Race, leader of the Pagoda Squadron who was enlisted to assist Luo Feng in his Virtual Universe Company mission on the Dream Underworld Planet of the Ganwu Universe Country.

During the mission, he killed the Immortal Marquis Yao Hai and protected the team as they dealt with the Zerg Race attacks. His combat powers and experience are on the upper side of his realm compared to others as he was able to not only teleport and escape from several thousand Immortal of Zerg race and stall enough time for the reinforcement to come . After completing their mission, he brought Luo Feng to Laos World and helped Dylan watch over him during his time there. He appreciated Luo Feng's words of friendship upon his departure.

characters.title: Si Yong
characters.introText: He had long blue hair and his eyes seemed vast and boundless. He wore black armor.
characters.appearance: He had long blue hair and his eyes seemed vast and boundless. He wore black armor.
characters.history:
Si Yong is one of the World City Leaders on Blood River World. As such, he is a World Master (Level 5) who has absorbed at least one Blood River Crystal. During Luo Feng's mission on Blood River World, he killed Si Yong's disciple Rock Wind Xiong and the two envoys from the Immortal Temple, one of whom had the 10 crystals he had requested.

This caused Si Yong to have his subordinates investigate the murder, and during their investigation they discovered his connections to Na Ke and the Na Family. After Luo Feng left with Na Ke, Si Yong's subordinates captured Na Bu and Lei Dong, torturing them for information on Luo Feng's whereabouts. On his orders, his subordinates kept Na Bu prisoner and killed Lei Dong and the rest of their family.

Eighty years later, after Na Ke rescued his father, Luo Feng remained behind to fight Si Yong and buy them time to escape. Luo Feng killed Si Yong with his Mosha Clan Domain Master Level 9 body, despite Si Yong being a World Master. After word spread, the surrounding World City Leaders began to attack and snatch his territory, eroding his power.

characters.title: Silver Eye
characters.introText: About 30 meters tall, he wears snow-white battle armor. He has a giant pair of slanted eyes that were closed most of the time, and a crack on his forehead, which would reveal an eye when he used his strongest technique. His entire body vibrated, emanating invisible waves that affected time. His body is transparent.
characters.appearance: About 30 meters tall, he wears snow-white battle armor. He has a giant pair of slanted eyes that were closed most of the time, and a crack on his forehead, which would reveal an eye when he used his strongest technique. His entire body vibrated, emanating invisible waves that affected time. His body is transparent.
characters.history:
Silver Eye is one of the 5 Invincible Immortal Kings trapped in Ice Prison. A Special Lifeform with a Life Gene Level of 100, he has a powerful Divine Body and special talent techniques. He was ranked 2nd in strength among the prisoners in Ice Prison by Si Bo Wa, and made the Northern portion his domain. His specialties lie in Law of Time  and soul attacks, but he could also attack using Law of Space .

Due to his extensive time in Ice Prison, he became more nonchalant than he had been in the past, sometimes not moving for tens of thousands of years. He knew he had no hope of acquiring 10,000 tags to leave because the other Invincible Immortal Kings had so many of them.

When Luo Feng was trapped in Ice Prison, Silver Eye sought to meet him in order to acquire a scanner; he hoped to access the Virtual Universe. Upon meeting him, the two fought, and Luo Feng survived three of his attacks, even launching his own counterattack. After escaping, Luo Feng agreed to exchange a scanner for a treasure.

The last we see of Silver Eye is him entering the Virtual Universe and beginning to play virtual games.
characters.trivia: He has two unnamed Immortal King soul slaves who he enslaved while trapped in Ice Prison.

characters.title: Silver Moon God King
characters.introText: A figure comparable in size to Tian Kun, covered in silvery-white hair and with a furry tail.
characters.appearance: A figure comparable in size to Tian Kun, covered in silvery-white hair and with a furry tail.
characters.history:
Silver Moon God King is a Second Level God King who is also a Guest Official of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom. His tenure there, however, was marked by tribulations, as he was frequently subjected to dangerous assignments under the half-out-of-control monarchs of the nation. These "half-out-of-control" monarchs, while immensely powerful, were prone to losing their sanity due to the overwhelming influence of their Chaotic Source bloodlines. When they went berserk, they would indiscriminately devour all living beings around them, including their subordinates.

As a guest godking, Yin Yue was often sacrificed in these scenarios. Despite his impressive combat prowess and survival skills, his real body was devoured multiple times, forcing him to rely on resurrection carriers to continue his existence.

After Luo Feng killed Tian Kun, Dao Mo Ancestor, and Wu Xiang Ancestor, Silver Moon asked Sea Devil God King and Tian Yi God King to join him in taking ownership of the Food Kingdom territory. Unfortunately for him, Luo Feng also desired this territory, leading to a battle between the Second Level God Kings who had assembled there. Silver Moon was forced to retreat under Luo Feng's attack.

characters.title: Silver-Armored Woman Commander
characters.introText: A beautiful woman wearing a suit of silver armor. Her gaze seemed to be the origin of all light, and it felt like bathing under the warmest lights.
characters.appearance: A beautiful woman wearing a suit of silver armor. Her gaze seemed to be the origin of all light, and it felt like bathing under the warmest lights.
characters.history:
Silver-Armored Woman Commander is a Void True God who serves as one of the Four Commanders of God King Valley, given the order to find someone who could reach the top of Wu Qi Tower. As such, she has been sealed with the title 'Jin.' Her throne in the silver palace was second to the left.

When Black Mist Commander was observing Luo Feng's performance in Wu Qi Tower, he woke up the other three commanders, including her, and told them to observe Luo Feng. Upon witnessing Luo Feng's body techniques, she felt that he would easily make it past the 6th level of Wu Qi Tower.

She and the other commanders observed Luo Feng as he made it through the levels of Wu Qi Tower until they could no longer see his actions (when he reached the 8th floor). She also joined the other 3 commanders in greeting Luo Feng when he passed Wu Qi Tower's 9th floor, shedding a tear while noting how long it had been since they were assigned the task by Jin God King.

characters.title: Simayan
characters.introText: A purple-haired and purple-eyed young man, wearing a gorgeous black robe and using a flying-wing Spirit Weapon. His forehead has a complex purple engraving, and his eyes had a strange magical energy.
characters.appearance: A purple-haired and purple-eyed young man, wearing a gorgeous black robe and using a flying-wing Spirit Weapon. His forehead has a complex purple engraving, and his eyes had a strange magical energy.
characters.history:
Simayan is one of the Universe Level seniors of the Primal Secret Realm who competed in Luo Feng's first Secret Realm Qualification Battle. Like Mo Luo, he had passed the 7th level of the Tong Tian Bridge long before this qualification battle. In the previous qualification battle, Simayan lost to Mo Luo, but defeated Ke Luo Fu, allowing him to remain in the Primal Secret Realm. He and Mo Luo were close in strength.

As an Illusionist, he is very strong against Warriors, enabling him to defeat Ke Luo Fu in the past, but with Ke Luo Fu's recent improvement, Simayan felt he had a small chance of defeating him. Therefore, to remain in the Primal Secret Realm, he focused his efforts on defeating Mo Luo.

Using his illusions, which incorporated Law of Fire  and Law of Space , Simayan was able to defeat Mo Luo, despite taking heavy damage himself. This pushed Mo Luo into the bottom 3 of the Primal Secret Realm, forcing him to fight for his spot in the Primal Secret Realm.

characters.title: Sinking Fire Master
characters.introText: His Jiu Huo body is more than 1,000 kilometers tall, with a strong and burly build. He looks quite human except that he has 9 fiery-red tentacles on his head, each entwined with flame. His eyes resembled flaming red rubies.
characters.appearance:
His Jiu Huo body is more than 1,000 kilometers tall, with a strong and burly build. He looks quite human except that he has 9 fiery-red tentacles on his head, each entwined with flame. His eyes resembled flaming red rubies.

His Li Volcano body is more than 100 million kilometers long and has at least 1 eye.
characters.history:
Sinking Fire Master is a Universe Master working with the Demon Race alliance, having existed for an eternity. The leader of the powerful Jiu Huo Race, he belongs to the ranks of pinnacle Universe Masters, Universe Master Level 3. His entire race depended on him for its strength, so he was hesitant to take undue risks. He had a lucky encounter while adventuring the universe and was bestowed with a second body. Thinking of the size of his Divine Body and increasing his ability to survive, he chose the Li Volcano, a body over 100 million kilometers in length.

He discovered Luo Feng in the guise of Blood Cloud Palace Master, and per the orders he received from Dream Demon Ancestor, he chased him down to hold him up in one location. First relying on words, he then tried to use force, resulting in a fight between the two. Luo Feng eventually forced him to self-destruct after activating the 2nd level of the engravings on Star Tower. Since he has multiple bodies, he didn't hesitate to self-destruct when he only had 29% of his Divine Body left.

characters.title: Sixth Squad Captain

infobox.ChineseName: 第六小队的队长 队长
infobox.affiliation: World of Jin Python River Army
infobox.occupation: Captain of the Sixth Squadron of the First Battalion

characters.introText: A tall, burly man with grey eyes and a gigantic pair of curved horns.
characters.appearance: A tall, burly man with grey eyes and a gigantic pair of curved horns.
characters.history:
Sixth Squad Captain is the captain of the Sixth Squad of the First Battalion of the Python River Army, a Special Legion of the East Army. He was indisputably the strongest member of the Sixth Squad, and even owned a Mechanical Treasure, Black Cloud Wings. He has survived Incarnation-level tasks and is respected by the majority of his fellow members of the Sixth Squad for his ability, but some, such as Yu Luo and Ku Fa, detest him due to his willingness to sacrifice members to ensure his survival.

When Luo Feng and Wu He joined the Sixth Squad, he was not willing to recruit them to join him; this was due to the Disaster/Catastrophe-level task that the team had been assigned. He knew that most new recruits simply were not powerful enough to survive that level of task, but he did not know Luo Feng's strength. During their mission, Sixth Squad Captain successfully seized a True God corpse from the Nine Smoke Marsh battlefield, but he forbade his subordinates from attempting to do the same, knowing that they were too weak to succeed.

He observed Luo Feng stealing a True God corpse from the same battlefield, and determined that he should befriend him so they could work together on future tasks. When his subordinates decided to scour the battlefield for Universe Master weapons to complete their task, he agreed to allow them to do it, but on the condition that if he contacted them for assistance, they would come immediately.

The captain also observed Luo Feng kill a True God with the combination of Duan Mie, Blood Shadow Blade, and Light of Water and Fire, and was astounded at his strength. In his attempt to force Luo Feng to share the True God corpses he obtained from that kill, he contacted his 17 subordinates and had them locate Luo Feng so they could either fight him for the corpses or threaten to expose his possession of them.

After meeting with Luo Feng, he offered to give up his position as captain and work under Luo Feng in exchange for him sharing the True God corpses, but Luo Feng rejected him. After Luo Feng rejected him, the captain attempted to capture him with the Black Cloud Wings, but he used the Boat of Mausoleum to drag the captain along with him, toward a beast True God. Knowing that he had also stolen a True God corpse, the captain released the ship and Luo Feng escaped.

Several months later, the captain and his subordinates had not found Luo Feng, so he reached out to Yu Luo, Ku Fa, and the other soldiers, informing them of Luo Feng's spoils. His message caused Wu He to reach out to Luo Feng, with whom he later successfully exchanged for a True God corpse, completing his task.

About half an era after the beginning of their mission, the captain returned with the other soldiers, having completed the task and even gained other benefits. When Luo Feng returned before his task to obtain the title 'Jin,' he advised the 9 new recruits to follow Ku Fa rather than the captain, unless they wanted to die. The captain knew that he could not defeat Luo Feng, so he didn't attempt to fight him.

characters.title: Sixth True Master
characters.introText: As is typical of great beings of the Divine Eye Race, he had a one-eyed phantom behind his human-shaped body. He has green eyes.
characters.appearance: As is typical of great beings of the Divine Eye Race, he had a one-eyed phantom behind his human-shaped body. He has green eyes.
characters.history:
Sixth True Master is a disciple of Divine Eye True Master who worked to reach the level of True God. As such, he is one of the 7 most important members of the Divine Eye Race.

When Five Chaos Master lost his treasures in the Deep Abyss, Sixth True Master and Third True Master traveled there to defeat whatever great beings were there to obtain them, then retrieve them and bring them back to their race. After arriving at the Universe Boat, they encountered Golden Brilliant Devil God and attacked him, hoping to retrieve Five Chaos Master's armor and Luo Feng's Shi Wu Wings.

As Luo Feng and Sitting Mountain Guest arrived and observed the battle, Huge Axe Creator arrived and fought alongside Brilliant Gold Devil God, utilizing his Xeon treasure to fight off the two True Masters. After being defeated by Huge Axe Creator's new technique, he and Third True Master agreed to give him 3 pinnacle arcana treasures in exchange for the enmity to be erased.

After two of the True Masters were killed while trying to obtain the Duan Dong River inheritance, he laid low with the remaining True Masters. After one of Luo Feng's battles with Morosa, he advised Divine Eye True Master that Third True Master's suggestion of joining forces with the Sector Beasts held a degree of reason.

characters.title: Skeleton Master

infobox.affiliation: Eight Great Overlords of Universe Ocean

affiliation: Eight Great Overlords of Universe Ocean

characters.introText: Supreme master of the Skeleton Race, Skeleton Master led his race in battles against the Divine Eye Race for close to 3 Reincarnation Eras.  After the arrival of the World of Jin, he became one of the 8 supreme beings of Universe Ocean, alongside Divine Eye True Master, Bei Chi Star Master, Jue He True God, Nine-Headed Devil Master, Luo Feng, Primal Chaos City Leader, and Nine Remoteness True Master. He worked together with the others to combat the Sector Beast threat.
characters.appearance: As his name implies, he is a skeletal life form.
characters.history:
Supreme master of the Skeleton Race, Skeleton Master led his race in battles against the Divine Eye Race for close to 3 Reincarnation Eras.  After the arrival of the World of Jin, he became one of the 8 supreme beings of Universe Ocean, alongside Divine Eye True Master, Bei Chi Star Master, Jue He True God, Nine-Headed Devil Master, Luo Feng, Primal Chaos City Leader, and Nine Remoteness True Master. He worked together with the others to combat the Sector Beast threat.

When the remaining 900,000 Sector Beasts began attacking the miniature universes of the First Reincarnation Era, Skeleton Master appeared in front of them to pledge his allegiance and save his race. He was enslaved and his miniature universe survived. After Morosa became the King of the Sector Beasts, he killed Skeleton Master with a single thought, destroying his miniature universe and concealing the existence of the King of the Sector Beasts.

characters.title: Sky Formation King
characters.introText: A three-eyed human man with long brown hair and a black battle suit. Proficient in illusion and soul attack.
characters.appearance: A three-eyed human man with long brown hair and a black battle suit. Proficient in illusion and soul attack.

characters.title: Sky Wolf Master
characters.introText: He's a black Sky Wolf with green eyes who emanates force. Sky wolves are ruthless and fierce creatures, and Sky Wolf Master embodies that.
characters.appearance: He's a black Sky Wolf with green eyes who emanates force. Sky wolves are ruthless and fierce creatures, and Sky Wolf Master embodies that.
characters.history:
In the past, he and another Universe Master chased Nine Remoteness Master into Nine Remoteness Ocean, and was attacked by Nine Remoteness Master's ultimate technique. He survived due to his High Arcana flying palace-type treasure, Sky Wolf Palace.

He arrived at Ice Prison Planet to retrieve Si Bo Wa when Si Bo Wa was able to make contact with his teacher by connecting to the Virtual Universe. He was prevented from killing Luo Feng and taking his Beast God Inheritance Token by the arrival of Primal Chaos City Leader. After Luo Feng successfully made it to the Ancestral God Sect, Sky Wolf Master ordered Venerable Mud Swallowing to kill him.

He was one of the Universe Masters who came together to kill or seal Yuan Ao Master.

During the battle between the Human Race and the Demon Race, he was one of the Universe Masters who was trapped in the Xeon treasure Black Prison Tower.

characters.title: Sky Wolf Venerable
characters.introText: A Sky Wolf covered in cyan feathers. His true form is about 10 kilometers long.
characters.appearance: A Sky Wolf covered in cyan feathers. His true form is about 10 kilometers long.
characters.history: Sky Wolf Venerable is the non-canon name given to the Universe Venerable of the Sky Wolf Clan who served as Si Bo Wa's teacher. Shortly after becoming a Universe Venerable, Sky Wolf Venerable took on Si Bo Wa as his third student, considering him his most valuable student until he disappeared. When he learned that Si Bo Wa was still alive, albeit trapped in Ice Prison, he contacted Sky Wolf Master in hopes of getting Venerable Sky Flower to retrieve him from Ice Prison. He was thrilled when Sky Wolf Master stated that he would personally retrieve Si Bo Wa.

Snakewoman Guardian is the non-canon name given to the Snakeman Illusionist on Primal Sky Mountain. It is not specified if this guardian also exists on the other Sky Mountains.

While the Snakewoman Guardian is a Virtual Universe construct, it has personality and seems to have memories. Its strength is determined by its location on Primal Sky Mountain (Foot, Middle, Peak) and the level of Primal Sky Mountain (Universe Level, Domain Master, World Master).

characters.introText: Snow Devil God King is a God King of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom. He has strength equal to that of a Monarch, but cannot fully control his power, so he is sometimes imprisoned to prevent him from inflicting more damage.
characters.history:
Snow Devil God King is a God King of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom. He has strength equal to that of a Monarch, but cannot fully control his power, so he is sometimes imprisoned to prevent him from inflicting more damage.

During Luo Feng's time in Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, Snow Devil devoured the true body of Thunder Sand God King and his Ultimate God King-level weapon.

When seeking a way to acquire the equivalent of 300 billion Universe Sands, Huang Feng City Lord is offered a term guarding the prison containing Snow Devil God King, but he refuses it due to the danger.

characters.title: Snow Realm Ancestor
characters.introText: Snow Realm Ancestor was an ancient God King and a legendary existence on the Continent of Origin. He cultivated the Great Dao of the Origin of Life, ranked in the top 10 on the entire Continent of Origin in terms of the number of beings he has killed.
characters.history:
Snow Realm Ancestor was an ancient God King and a legendary existence on the Continent of Origin. He cultivated the Great Dao of the Origin of Life, ranked in the top 10 on the entire Continent of Origin in terms of the number of beings he has killed.

He specially refined the Mechanical Treasure Snow Realm Envoy, allowing his direct disciples to control the 36 treasures.

According to Sitting Mountain Guest's records, the two had similar levels of strength. He followed the Dripping Blood Meridian inheritance.

In the effort to get rid of the top ten sinners in the Origin Continent, Luo Feng infiltrated the Snow Realm Territory undetected and used the Lie Yuan Technique to annihilate the Snow Realm Ancestor’s true body and spiritual will in an instant..

characters.introText: Sokolov is the strongest warrior from Russia. He based of Vladimir Sokolov (USSR / Russia General). He is also one of the Eight Heroes of the Earth who sacrificed his life for Luo Feng to kill Golden Horned Beast.
characters.personality: He's grumpy. Vodka is his favorite drink. He doesn't get along with Mo Henderson. He likes both alcohol and women though was never married. Yelena is the result of this habit, though few people know it.

The body wielded enormous claws mounted on nine toes. Luo Feng speculated that he was tens of thousands of kilometers long. His Divine Power Avatar takes the form of an elderly human wearing a white robe and nine sharp horns on its head.

characters.history:
Space Beast Ancestor is the True God leader of the Space Beast Alliance. He is an existence that every Space Beast worships! He is acquainted with Sitting Mountain Guest, and was trusted with the information that he was teaching Luo Feng. He gives him the Top Arcana set Beast God Armor to reward him for winning the bet between he and Sitting Mountain Guest. He also allows Luo Feng to join the Space Beast Alliance, through his Golden Horned Beast Body, and grants him the attack type High Arcana Cutting Pearl Sword.

When the 5 other pinnacle races create the United Forces Alliance, he has the Space Beast Alliance join the fight against the Human Race. He negotiated with the Human Race after the war, hoping to compensate them and vow to help neither side if they fought again. Due to their prior relationship, Luo Feng forgives him after the Human Race wins the war.

He fights the Sector Beast threat alongside the other great beings of Universe Ocean.

characters.title: Special Envoy Mo
characters.introText: Special Envoy Mo was a Special Envoy from the Immortal Temple who accompanied Special Envoy You to Swallow Mound City. After being entertained by Rock Wind Xiong, he and You detected the battle between Xiong and Luo Feng, but were too late to save their junior. Initially, Envoy Mo did not interfere in the battle between Luo Feng and Envoy You, but he attempted to save him from Luo Feng's final attack. Luo Feng immediately killed Envoy Mo after killing Envoy You.

characters.title: Star River Master
characters.introText: Blood Cloud Palace Master, you and I...for the first time, we meet face-to-face. Twice previously, I hunted you, but each time I got to you, you escaped. This time, I have had better luck...I actually ran into you.
characters.appearance: His avatar looks like a dark void or a black hole. His true body looks like a crystal.
characters.history:
Star River Master is one of the 3 Universe Master vice-leaders of the Northern Territory Alliance. As their leader, Northern Territory Alliance Master, abstains from making any real decisions for the alliance, Star River Master is one of the most important members of the Alliance. He is relied on to help make important decisions, resurrect cultivators, and gain respect from other races and alliances. He is as important to his alliance as Primal Chaos City Leader is to the Human Race.

Earlier, when Sitting Mountain Guest, acting as Blood Cloud Palace Master, made his rampage throughout the universe, Star River Master twice hunted him down, but was unsuccessful in forcing him to battle. Later, when Luo Feng was acting as Blood Cloud Palace Master, he survived Star River Master's ultimate attack and was thus allowed to escape.

When the Northern Territory Alliance joined the United Forces Alliance to fight against the Human Race, he joined as well, and as a result, he was killed when Luo Feng ordered the 4 Eternal True God Generals from the World of Jin to kill all 443 Universe Masters who were present in the World of Jin who came from the United Forces Alliance and Purple Moon Holy Land Universe.
characters.trivia: In the Donghua, he replaces Qi Lan Master's role of resurrecting King Bark Mirror. His appearance in the donghua also resembles how Qi Lan Master was described as in the novel, with four hooves.

characters.title: Starweb Ancestor
characters.introText: The Starweb Ancestor is a Primogenitor of the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction, serving as one of the powerful Ancestors who participated in the coordinated soul-attack against Luo Feng. He was one of the seven primogenitor who used a joint mental and physical strike specifically targeting Luo Feng's soul and body hoping to eliminate the threat he posed as a new Lord in the war between Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction and Cultivator Camp. Despite his power, Starweb Ancestor’s attack, like the others’, failed to impact Luo Feng due to Luo Feng's immense soul strength and regeneration ability. After the failed assault, he joined the strategic retreat into the body of The Original Ancestor, showing his alignment with the tactical decisions led by Nirvana Ancestor.

characters.title: Strange Beast Commander
characters.introText: A scaly-armored beast that is black all-over. He has two faces, each with one eye. One eye was open and was entirely black, seeming to absorb everything. He exudes an immeasurably intense, murderous aura.
characters.appearance: A scaly-armored beast that is black all-over. He has two faces, each with one eye. One eye was open and was entirely black, seeming to absorb everything. He exudes an immeasurably intense, murderous aura.
characters.history:
Strange Beast Commander is a Void True God who serves as one of the Four Commanders of God King Valley, given the order to find someone who could reach the top of Wu Qi Tower. As such, he has been sealed with the title 'Jin.' His throne in the silver palace was on the far-right.

When Black Mist Commander was observing Luo Feng's performance in Wu Qi Tower, he woke up the other three commanders, including Strange Beast Commander. He felt that Luo Feng would lose to Thousand Eyes' technique Thousand Eyes Heart Light and thus fail on the 6th level of Wu Qi Tower. He was surprised at Luo Feng's ability to incorporate Ninth Heaven Path into his body technique to continue repelling Thousand Eyes' attacks.

He and the other commanders observed Luo Feng as he made it through the levels of Wu Qi Tower until they could no longer see his actions (when he reached the 8th floor). He also joined the other 3 commanders in greeting Luo Feng when he passed Wu Qi Tower's 9th floor.

characters.title: Su Ya
characters.introText: Su Ya is a Void True God Illusionist who performs at Dream Flower Tower. A direct disciple of Dream Flower Tower Master, she performs her illusions through music. When Luo Feng first visited Dream Flower Tower, she is the first musician to perform for him.
characters.appearance: A woman dressed in black.
characters.history: Su Ya is a Void True God Illusionist who performs at Dream Flower Tower. A direct disciple of Dream Flower Tower Master, she performs her illusions through music. When Luo Feng first visited Dream Flower Tower, she is the first musician to perform for him.

characters.title: Suo Family Patriarch
characters.introText: Suo Family Patriarch is the non-canon name given to the leader of the Suo Family. He was the only Void True God in the clan until Suo Yun's breakthrough. In the past, he lived in Hu Yang City, but after the death of his beloved and close friend, he left for the wilderness and settled down in a weak tribe. Eventually, he became the tribe leader, attracting many weak True Gods to join him.
characters.appearance: A man with long, untied hair.
characters.history:
Suo Family Patriarch is the non-canon name given to the leader of the Suo Family. He was the only Void True God in the clan until Suo Yun's breakthrough. In the past, he lived in Hu Yang City, but after the death of his beloved and close friend, he left for the wilderness and settled down in a weak tribe. Eventually, he became the tribe leader, attracting many weak True Gods to join him.

He attempted to bring Suo Zi and Suo Yun to settle in Hu Yang City, but was attacked by Hei Duo Mo's subordinates. Luo Feng rescued him and his clan members before killing Hei Duo Mo, then brought them safely to Hu Yang City.

characters.title: Suo Long
characters.introText: An ugly man with 6 bumps on his face and black hair on his face.
characters.appearance: An ugly man with 6 bumps on his face and black hair on his face.
characters.history:
Suo Long is a Domain Master member of the Virtual Universe Company, who was in the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm. He met Luo Feng after the latter passed the 7th level of the Tong Tian Bridge, acknowledging that Luo Feng had a real chance to make it into the Primal Secret Realm.

Suo Long felt that he would be lucky to remain in the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm in the next Secret Realm Qualification Battle.

characters.title: Suo Yun
characters.introText: Suo Yun is a young True God whose family patriarch intended to bring to Hu Yang City for his further growth. After arriving in the city, he became a guard for Diao Rong Qi. Diao Rong Qi provided him with resources to improve his cultivation, resulting in him breaking through to Void True God over a period after his arrival in the city.
characters.history:
Suo Yun is a young True God whose family patriarch intended to bring to Hu Yang City for his further growth. After arriving in the city, he became a guard for Diao Rong Qi. Diao Rong Qi provided him with resources to improve his cultivation, resulting in him breaking through to Void True God over a period after his arrival in the city.

Through conversations with his brother, Suo Zi, he learned that Luo Feng frequented the Fire World Restaurant, allowing his master to meet with him. Due to his relationship to Luo Feng, he was recruited by Thousand Mountain Tower, one of the Dark Forces of the city, and was made one of their 39 Hall Masters.

Later, when the Heart Shadow Sect invaded Hu Yang City, Suo Yun was one of the members of Thousand Mountain Tower who were casually killed when a member showed defiance.

characters.introText: Suo Zi is a young True God who Suo Family Patriarch intended to bring to Hu Yang City for his further growth. After arriving in the city, he became a waiter at the Fire World Restaurant, studying under Black Butcher. He served Morosa multiple times and was acknowledged for his skill in cooking.
characters.history:
Suo Zi is a young True God who Suo Family Patriarch intended to bring to Hu Yang City for his further growth. After arriving in the city, he became a waiter at the Fire World Restaurant, studying under Black Butcher. He served Morosa multiple times and was acknowledged for his skill in cooking.

Suo Zi was one of the 9 disciples that Black Butcher brought with him to the Yu Kingdom capital when he left to serve Yu Shui Tianyu. Due to being an acquaintance of Luo Feng, Suo Zi was chosen to accompany Yu Shui Kingdom Master on his visit to Luo Feng.

characters.history:
Ta La is a Stellar Level genius who participated in the Pinnacle Genius Battle. He/she was Fu Li Ke Lu's first opponent in the 1v1 battle portion of the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Stage.

It is unknown who won between the 2 of them, but the victor would have faced off against Rong Jun in the 2nd round and would then have lost the match and be sent to the losers bracket where their final standing would remain unknown.

characters.title: Talasha
characters.introText: Talasha is an Invincible Immortal King of the Dou Kou Race and the teacher of Bei Fa and Ya Wu. Luo Feng used his Mosha Body to clone Bei Fa for 3rd Board of Nine Volume Manual that Talasha was protecting.
characters.appearance: A purple figure.
characters.history:
Talasha is an Invincible Immortal King of the Dou Kou Race and the teacher of Bei Fa and Ya Wu. Luo Feng used his Mosha Body to clone Bei Fa for 3rd Board of Nine Volume Manual that Talasha was protecting.

Talasha is one of the first 9 of the race to be produced, and was also in the top-10 in terms of strength. She was responsible for mentoring the weaker members of the race.

Eventually, Talasha figured out that Luo Feng was in disguise, prompting her to teleport and attempt to capture him, leading to Luo Feng eventually being captured by Venerable Purple Dou Kou. Talasha was one of the clansmen who chained Luo Feng and sent him to Ice Prison.
characters.trivia: Like Venerable Purple Dou Kou, despite being of the Dou Kou Race, who are Special Lifeforms that cannot reproduce and have no gender, Talasha is explicitly referred to with the pronoun '她' (Tā, lit. She).

Luo Feng gave him two choices one to fight him and if he cannot kill him he will survive and the second one was he will die. He was captured by the 9th Army and later killed on Red Dawn Planet by Luo Feng.

characters.history:
Tao is one of the Stellar Level geniuses who participated in the Pinnacle Genius Battle, ultimately reaching the top 20 before losing to Bolan. Te Luo Fu, the Immortal representing his universe country, stated that Tao had a character very similar to Thirteen's.

Due to losing in the top 20, he became a Heaven and Earth Secret Realm member of the Virtual Universe Company, however his talent was still acknowledged. He was the third of his batch to pass the 2nd level of the Tong Tian Bridge, passing it in his 7th year in Primal Chaos City.

He was shocked when Luo Feng passed the 2nd and 3rd levels of the bridge in one visit, having not attempted the bridge in 10 years.

He was responsible for capturing the Hui Suo Beast imprisoned on Laos World and has been attempting to resolve the conflicts between his race and the Human Race. He gives Luo Feng the opportunity to prove himself by comprehending the Sacred Tablet.

characters.title: Ten Thousand Stars Ancestor
characters.introText: The Ten Thousand Stars Ancestor was one of the most powerful beings among the Hunyuan Ancestors, a peak existence of unmatched might. He played a pivotal role in the ancient wars between the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction and the Cultivator Camp. During the second great war between these two factions, the Ten Thousand Stars Ancestor fell in battle, leaving behind three fragments of his blood scales, collectively called the "Immortal Scales." These scales are indestructible and contain unfathomable mysteries, with even the most advanced powers of the Infinite Chaotic Origin Space unable to fully analyze them—only about 80% of their intricate secret patterns can be observed through the abilities of the Origin Land. His legacy remains a symbol of the terrifying strength of the innate Chaotic Origin beings, and his blood scales are regarded as supreme relics, containing insights beyond even World-Class Chaotic Origin Bloodline.

characters.title: The Original Ancestor

infobox.Aliases: Beginning Ancestor Primordial Ancestor Chushi Hunyuan Ancestor
infobox.affiliation: Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction Eternal Land

characters.introText: A perfect sphere, a flawless round body with no imperfections. No matter how much it's magnified, it remains absolutely spherical.
characters.appearance: A perfect sphere, a flawless round body with no imperfections. No matter how much it's magnified, it remains absolutely spherical.
characters.history:
The Original Ancestor is one of the top Primogenitor beings and one of the Nine Sovereigns of the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction and one of only four who hold a seat in the Eternal Land. He is known as the strongest defensive being in the entire Chaotic Origin Dimension. Even when Lords like Moman unleash destructive spatial attacks, The Original Ancestor remains unaffected at a distance, although he can only protect a limited area around himself.

When fellow Primogenitor Being Kui Mo Ancestor was severely wounded, The Original Ancestor offered to shelter him inside his body, only those severely wounded were allowed to take refuge. After all, losing even one Primogenitor from the battlefield could collapse the entire defensive line against the Lords. The Original Ancestor represents the defensive pillar of his faction, not the strongest in raw power, but unmatched in defense and durability.

characters.title: Thirteen
characters.introText: An eight meter tall giant, wearing scaled armor complete with a helmet.
characters.appearance: An eight meter tall giant, wearing scaled armor complete with a helmet.
characters.history:
One of the eighteen generals under the command of the Lord of Ganwu. His reputation is widespread, he is a being known for a hundreds of millions of years.

He rouses the spirits of the 1000 geniuses from the Ganwu Universe Country by telling them that only Rong Jun has a guarantee of not being eliminated in the next round. He was initially frustrated with Luo Feng's speed in the 7 tower training space, but was pleasantly surprised as Luo Feng advanced. He bragged about Rong Jun and Luo Feng to the other Immortals who were watching. Before the final set of 1-on-1 battles in the Pinnacle Genius Battle, he advised them to never be careless and gave them some pointers regarding the competition itself.

characters.title: Thirteen Axes Leader
characters.introText: A golden-armored man huge in stature with blood red eyes gazing through his helmet.
characters.appearance: A golden-armored man huge in stature with blood red eyes gazing through his helmet.
characters.history: Thirteen Axes Leader was the leader of the Thirteen Axes and was well-known in Swallow Mound City as a powerful Universe Level warrior. He led his organization in hunting down the You Family team, who had acquired Genetic Armor from the Ancient God Ruins. In the process, he and his organization killed every member of the team, but did not recover the armor. Since You Yan Ta had fled to Na Ke's team, Thirteen Axes Leader gave the order to kill Na Ke's team, but unfortunately for them, Luo Feng was present. Luo Feng killed every member of the Thirteen Axes, including the leader, with his Hidden Shadow 7 Blades techniques and improved Law of Space  comprehension.

infobox.Aliases: Thirteenth Ancestor of Infinite Serpent Clan Thirteenth Great Serpent Hunyuan Ancestor Old Thirteen
infobox.affiliation: Infinite Serpent Clan Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction
infobox.killer: Luo Feng, Overlord Xing Mang and Overlord Yuan

characters.introText: The Thirteenth Infinite Serpent Ancestor was a Primogenitor-level being from the Infinite Serpent Clan. His reckless and arrogant nature led him to defy the established order of the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Despite the era of peace governed by the Overlords, he chose to become the first Primogenitor since the devastating "War between the Ancestors and the Eight Lords" to forcibly devour a source world. This act was a grave violation of the Lords' unspoken truce and a direct challenge to their authority. His particular target, a remote source world, was under the protection of Lord Luo Feng, an action that was seen as a personal affront.
characters.appearance:
The Thirteenth Infinite Serpent Ancestor was a Primogenitor-level being from the Infinite Serpent Clan. His reckless and arrogant nature led him to defy the established order of the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Despite the era of peace governed by the Overlords, he chose to become the first Primogenitor since the devastating "War between the Ancestors and the Eight Lords" to forcibly devour a source world. This act was a grave violation of the Lords' unspoken truce and a direct challenge to their authority. His particular target, a remote source world, was under the protection of Lord Luo Feng, an action that was seen as a personal affront.

The primogenitor was killed as a direct consequence of his hubris. The act of devouring the source world incurred the wrath of all eight Lords, who unanimously agreed on the need for a decisive and immediate response to serve as a deterrent to other restless primogenitors. The Thirteenth Serpent Ancestor, overconfident in his ability to evade the Lords, believed he was safe by returning to the mysterious land "Infinite World". This realm was his clan's sanctuary, a place where his power was significantly amplified, making him nearly invincible to outside threats. However, the Lords understood this would be his plan, and they acted with a level of speed and coordination he never anticipated.

The Thirteenth Infinite Serpent Ancestor met his end not through a prolonged battle, but a single, lethal strike. The Lords Yuan and Xingmang joined forces with Luo Feng's main combat clone. Yuan's immense power concealed their movements, while Xingmang’s mastery of the void made all of the Infinite World's spatial defenses useless. The trio bypassed all detection and appeared directly in the Infinite World. Lord Luo Feng, enraged by the destruction of the source world, executed the ancestor with his Blood Shadow Blade Technique. The attack was so swift and powerful that it cut through the ancestor's enhanced body as if it were nothing. The Thirteenth Infinite Serpent Ancestor was instantly annihilated, his life extinguished in a terrifying flash of light. His death served as an unambiguous warning: no primogenitor, no matter how powerful or well-hidden, could defy the will of the eight Lords without facing dire consequences.

characters.title: Thousand Eye Ancestor
characters.introText: Thousand Eye Ancestor is one of the seventy-three Primogenitor Beings in the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction, who participated in the Cultivator-Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform War. It takes the form of a massive, strange beast covered in countless eyes over a thousand spread densely across its body. These eyes grant it extraordinary observational power, allowing it to instantly detect any movement or fluctuation from the cultivator side, including hidden attacks like Moman’s secret infiltration. Its role on the battlefield is critical for early warning and detection, making it an essential support figure during large-scale confrontations.
characters.appearance:
Thousand Eye Ancestor is one of the seventy-three Primogenitor Beings in the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction, who participated in the Cultivator-Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform War. It takes the form of a massive, strange beast covered in countless eyes over a thousand spread densely across its body. These eyes grant it extraordinary observational power, allowing it to instantly detect any movement or fluctuation from the cultivator side, including hidden attacks like Moman’s secret infiltration. Its role on the battlefield is critical for early warning and detection, making it an essential support figure during large-scale confrontations.

After the fall of the Nightmare Ancestor, the Eight Lords unleashed the Curse Killing Calamity Formation for the second time. This time, the Thousand Eye Ancestor was struck. As one of the seven Primogenitors who specialized in soul-path techniques, he possessed the second most fragile physical body and was extremely vulnerable to defense-piercing attacks. The combined assault surpassed the limits of his defensive capabilities, tearing apart his Life Core in an instant. His corpse disappeared immediately seized by Lord Xingmang.
characters.trivia: In Lord Xue Ying, Xue Ying uses the eyes of the Thousand Eye Ancestor's corpse to guide him in the creation of his ultimate killing moves in the Great Dao of the Virtual Realm. He also obtains a Thousand-Eye Water Drop, leading to his cooperation with Great Emperor North River, but is shortly betrayed by the Great Emperor, who annihilated all of Xue Ying's clones and stole the water drop.

characters.title: Thousand Eyes
characters.introText: A massive green creature, looking a bit like a dark-green toad. Every inch of its skin contained an eye, with its surface covered in 1,000 eyes in total. Every eye can emit a golden ray of light.
characters.appearance: A massive green creature, looking a bit like a dark-green toad. Every inch of its skin contained an eye, with its surface covered in 1,000 eyes in total. Every eye can emit a golden ray of light.
characters.history:
Thousand Eyes is a creature that assesses those who reach the 6th floor of Wu Qi Tower during the sealing task. He is a Controller who uses a Spirit Weapon comprising 1,000 black blades, each around 300,000 kilometers long, to attack the candidate.

When he struggles with the opponent, he uses the technique Thousand Eyes Heart Light. After failing to kill them, he will concede and disappear within the ground.

After experiencing his attacks, Luo Feng hypothesized that Thousand Eyes could actually be a Void True God who restricted his strength to test him.

characters.title: Thunder Emperor
characters.introText: The Three Emperors of Wind, Thunder, and Sea are a closely allied trio of Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform who belong to the Ice Peak Faction. Known for their similar appearances and personalities, they often act as one unit and are widely regarded with disdain by higher-tier beings due to their relatively weak strength. Despite this, they are extremely troublesome due to their shared trait of immortality, which makes it nearly impossible to permanently eliminate them. Within the hierarchy of Ice Peak Faction, they rank among the lowest of the twelve Eternal beings, yet they are some of the most aggressive in expanding territory. Nearly half of the over one hundred World Clusters occupied by Ice Peak Camp were seized by them during a period when the Cultivator Camp was preoccupied with war against the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction. They have a reputation for instigating conflict and exploiting the power of the Ice Peak alliance to act with impunity.

This was in one part because of the backing he had from the Thunder Ancient Kingdom, and on another part due to his incredible life-preserving abilities he had from cultivating in the Great Dao of the Unlimited Origin.

characters.history:
Tian Kun was the leader of the 5 God Kings of the Food Kingdom, and a powerful Second Level God King. Tian Kun is much stronger than Jin God King and forced him to use his secret treasure to escape.

Due in part to his cooking ability, he is a Guest Official of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. Emperor Yan likes him very much due to his food being very much in line with his taste. During his time directly serving Emperor Yan, Tian Kun requests his assistance in invading the Hansen Kingdom.

After returning to the capitol of the Food Kingdom, Tian Kun was killed by Luo Feng through the Lie Yuan Technique.

characters.title: Tian Lang Ke
characters.introText: Tian Lang Ke is a silver-haired man with three eyes, giving him a striking and distinctive look. After breaking through to the World Chaotic Origin Lifeform stage, he can transform into a colossal beast covered in countless white hairs, though he typically reverts to his human form for convenience.
characters.appearance: Tian Lang Ke is a silver-haired man with three eyes, giving him a striking and distinctive look. After breaking through to the World Chaotic Origin Lifeform stage, he can transform into a colossal beast covered in countless white hairs, though he typically reverts to his human form for convenience.
characters.personality: Tian Lang Ke is highly ambitious, confident, and prideful. He respects only those stronger than him and often disregards peers or those he considers weaker. His aloof nature has strained his relationships with other High Chaotic Origin Lifeform from the Dark World Group.Despite his talent, his lack of compassion and poor interpersonal skills make him unsuitable for leadership roles like territorial overseer.
characters.history:
Tian Lang Ke hails from the Dark World Group, a world cluster that was under Overlord Yuan. Unlike most High Chaotic Origin Lifeform who break through the "cage" via bloodline potential, Tian Lang Ke achieved this through exceptional comprehension, mastering over 70% of the high-level Chaotic Origin Bloodline. His talent and willpower earned him guidance from a senior, granting him access to Hunyuan Island’s resources.

Driven by his desire to rule the Dark World Group, Tian Lang Ke focused on comprehending the world-level Chaotic Origin Bloodline, reaching 68% before using an auxiliary treasure to hit 70%. This allowed him to safely fuse the bloodline and become a World Chaotic Origin Lifeform, a significant milestone. However, his breakthrough was overshadowed by Luo Feng’s rapid rise to Overlord status, making the Dark World Group Luo Feng’s Absolute Territory.

Tian Lang Ke’s refusal to join over 12,000 High Chaotic Origin Lifeform in greeting Luo Feng when he was still a Perfect High Chaotic Origin Lifeform cultivator reflected his pride and belief that only World Chaotic Origin Lifeform deserved his respect. After Luo Feng became a Overlord, Tian Lang Ke was appointed a garrison general, a lower-ranking role, due to his weaker strength and aloof personality, which disqualified him from becoming an territorial overseer.
characters.trivia:
Tian Lang Ke is the only High Chaotic Origin Lifeform from the Dark World Group who did not greet Luo Feng upon his arrival in the Origin Land.

His name, meaning "Heavenly Wolf Guest," reflects his solitary and ambitious nature.

Despite his talent, his personality hinders his rise to prominence in the Cultivator Camp.

In Lord Xue Ying, Tian Lang Ke has become a Perfect Stage World Chaotic Origin Lifeform, and a famous general under the command of the 8 Overlords

infobox.Aliases: Tian Shi Palace Leader Heaven Erosion Palace Master Heavenly Erosion Palace Master
infobox.occupation: Guardian of the Blood River World

characters.introText: Dressed in a silver long robe, the robe itself seems to produce countless images. On it were gold engravings, however, within a blink of an eye, the robe was simply a silver robe. He has reddish-brown long hair, sparkling skin, black eyes, and an engraving on his forehead. His resemblance to an Earth human was uncanny, and even though he was taller than normal, even giants would feel as though they were facing an endless space, feeling subdued and inferior.

characters.history:
Tian Shi Palace Master is the master of the Tian Shi Palace. A few of the Virtual Universe Company absolute warriors study within, and the palace is in charge of watching over the Blood River World.  The palace itself is located in space, and is larger than a planet.

World Masters serving within the palace may never see Tian Shi Palace Master, it is an incredible honor to meet him.  Even within the Virtual Universe Company, he is considered an absolute being in the upper echelon. His power alone is capable of intimidating all of the beings of the Blood River World for trillions of years. He isn't quite at the level of a Universe Master, but as a Top Universe Overlord, his strength is close. With his unique experiences and clone techniques, he stands at the top among the Universe Overlords.

When the Virtual Universe Company's management level had a contest between Luo Feng and Bolan, he favored Luo Feng. He also thought that Luo Feng and Rong Jun would have more hopes than Bolan of becoming true absolute warriors for humanity. Despite his respect for Luo Feng's talent, he thought it would be an accomplishment if he was able to exceed Rong Jun in his lifetime...yet he still bet on Luo Feng over him.

To assist Luo Feng's comprehension of the 36 wonders of space, he completely demonstrated the 36th wonder that Luo Feng had yet to comprehend at the time they met face-to-face., saving him at least 2-3 years of work.

He's a 7-stars member of the Hong Alliance, placing under just the palace master level.

Due to his bet on Luo Feng, he was very happy when Luo Feng passed the World Master Primal Sky Mountain, since that signified that Luo Feng was an absolute genius of ten million eras.

As one of the great beings of humanity, he naturally possessed a throne within the Pantheon Sanctuary, on the 2nd-highest level, the 650 feet wide thrones. He is one of the great beings who received news of the enemies of humanity's plans to eliminate Luo Feng as soon as they could.
characters.trivia:
It is implied that he has some relation to the 9 Universe Primal Chaos Tablet, as he personally recreated the Drizzle picture from it for Luo Feng's benefit.

His laws are not specifically mentioned in the novel. It was implied through the way he showed his technique to Luo Feng. Since Fire Law is a Lower Law of Space, we can assume that his Upper Original Law is Space. Also, he teleported Luo Feng into the ship with a wave of his hand, and Teleportation is part of Space Law.

To avoid danger, he pretended that he could not identify the illegal miner; later he saw Luo Feng take action against the culprit, a Primal Chaos Realm Alien Beast.

characters.introText: Chang Qing (苌青) is the Tower Master and leader of the prestigious Dan Building (丹楼), a top-tier alchemy faction based in Yulan City, within the realm of the Nine Rivers Holy World. A veteran alchemist and powerful cultivator, he holds the cultivation level of Late Stage God Emperor, making him one of the oldest and most respected figures in the city.
characters.appearance:
Chang Qing (苌青) is the Tower Master and leader of the prestigious Dan Building (丹楼), a top-tier alchemy faction based in Yulan City, within the realm of the Nine Rivers Holy World. A veteran alchemist and powerful cultivator, he holds the cultivation level of Late Stage God Emperor, making him one of the oldest and most respected figures in the city.

As one of the original members who helped establish Yulan City alongside the legendary Palace Master Yuan Xiang, Chang Qing has deep roots in the city’s history. Despite recent struggles due to the rising threat of the Insect Nest, his leadership has helped keep Dan Building afloat amidst hostile conditions.

Chang Qing personally invited Luo Feng to join the Dan Building as a Deputy Leader, recognizing his immense strength and potential. As part of the recruitment, Chang Qing offered an exceptionally generous joining bonus of five billion Hunyuan Crystals, paid all at once — a rare gesture even among elite factions. Luo Feng, in return, chose to invest the entire amount into purchasing auxiliary elixirs from Dan Building, solidifying his support and trust in the faction.

Chang Qing values loyalty and legacy. To strengthen ties with Luo Feng, he also offered positions to three of Luo Feng’s close allies — Emperor Qing, Emperor Ming, and Emperor Fu — demonstrating his political tact and long-term vision.
characters.personality: Chang Qing is pragmatic, respectful toward strength, and deeply loyal to those who stand with him. Despite his advanced age and cultivation, he remains humble and enthusiastic, especially when interacting with younger talents like Luo Feng. He harbors disdain for unethical methods, particularly those used by rival factions such as the Insect Nest.

characters.history:
Transforming Mist Master is a powerful Universe Master from the East Emperor Holy Land Universe. A Special Lifeform composed of mist, he has spent innumerable Reincarnation Eras cultivating his secret techniques, and could roam Universe Ocean without restraint. Even True Gods found him to be extremely difficult to kill completely.

During the Duan Dong River Inheritance Test, he was among those Universe Masters who attacked Luo Feng, and when one of his attacks killed two Immortals, the stone pillars within the Boat of Mausoleum killed his clone that was present. Since he had another clone, he survived.

The attack on him from the Boat of Mausoleum informed the groups present within the boat that as long as they did not implicate any weaker beings who were taking the test, they could attack Luo Feng at will.

characters.history:
Treasure Shop Salesman is the non-canon name given to the old man who works in the Odd Treasures Shop and purchases the Arc Blade from Luo Feng. In the novel, he is called upon as the price of a Level 3 Spirit Weapon is too high for a normal assistant to handle. He initially tries to purchase it for 16 billion Black Dragon Coins, but eventually buys it from Luo Feng for 18 billion Black Dragon Coins.

After writing up the contract, he provided Luo Feng with a Universe Star River Bank Card to use to access the funds and a Treasure Shop Member Card to use for discounted rates within the Odd Treasures Shop. He also sold Luo Feng 30 kilograms of Jade Marrow, but was slightly disappointed that Luo Feng bought nothing else from the shop.

characters.history:
Tuo Ka is a Primal Secret Realm Domain Master of the Virtual Universe Company. He was one of the 10 other Primal Secret Realm Domain Masters when Luo Feng joined their ranks. While his teacher told him that Luo Feng was an absolute genius, he was sure that Luo Feng would be sent back to the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm after his first Secret Realm Qualification Battle.

Despite training for 30,000 years, he was proven to be far from Luo Feng's match, since Luo Feng passed the 13th level of the Tong Tian Bridge while even the strongest of the 10 seniors had only passed the 11th.

characters.title: Tuo Lei Wu
characters.introText: A strong and sturdy black-skinned man, with hair a peculiar mix of black and green. He wore a black uniform.
characters.appearance: A strong and sturdy black-skinned man, with hair a peculiar mix of black and green. He wore a black uniform.
characters.history:
Tuo Lei Wu was one of the 4 team captains (along with Rong Zhi, Aer Man, and Abu Luo Te) of the small group sent by Pula Nuolan Shan to search for the corpse of the Golden Horned Beast. He was among the top 10 of the Nuolan Shan Guard, so he could hold off up to 10 normal Stellar Level 9 cultivators. Due to this strength, he was the lead captain of the entire group.

Tuo Lei Wu and the others parked their scout ship deep in the Amazon River. Using this as their base, the group searched Earth's oceans for the corpse of the Golden Horned Beast, and since they were unable to find it, they presumed the Earthlings possessed the body. To determine its location, Tuo Lei Wu used one of his subordinates to hypnotize Boris Brent and interrogate him. When Boris mentioned that Luo Feng would likely have the most accurate information related to the Golden Horned Beast, Tuo Lei Wu led a group to capture Luo Feng's loved ones, while ordering the remaining captains to use their teams to capture the heads of the 5 great countries.

He led his team to attack Luo Feng's castle, but it was too sturdy to be destroyed, so they were unable to capture Luo Feng's parents and children. As a result, they instead captured Xu Xin and Luo Hua and took them to their base in Brasilia Headquarter City. Ordering Rong Zhi to hypnotize them all and interrogate them, they learned that none of the captives knew the location of the corpse, so they forced Xu Xin to contact Luo Feng. Refusing to acknowledge he was working for the Nuolan Shan Family, he negotiated with Luo Feng a location at which he would receive the Golden Horned Beast's corpse.

In the time between this contact and their meeting, Luo Feng purchased multiple Stellar Level 9 slaves and had them sent to Bai Lan Planet, from where he then took them to Earth. In the meantime, Tuo Lei Wu updated Nuolan Shan on the status of his mission, and was told that he would be promoted to commander and awarded with a family medal if he successfully obtained the Golden Horned Beast corpse. While he was conversing with Nuolan Shan, Luo Feng's group, using Babata's hacking abilities, ambushed Tuo Lei Wu's group, rescuing the 7 hostages. They then lured Tuo Lei Wu's group toward the Pacific Ocean where Luo Feng's Golden Horned Beast body was hiding.

Angered by the rescue of the hostages after he assured Nuolan Shan that there would be no problems, he chased down the slave warriors with 14 Stellar Level 9 warriors, 18 Stellar Level 8 warriors, and 26 Stellar Level 7 warriors. Reaching the Pacific Ocean, they encountered Luo Feng in his Golden Horned Beast body. Excited about the opportunity to capture the live beast, he called back his Stellar Level 9 warriors and had the Stellar Level 7 and 8 warriors engage the beast. Remembering to first contact Pula to inform him of the living beast, he ordered Aer Man and Abu Luo Te to chase the beast with their teams, then he joined them. By the time they arrived, the 44 Stellar Level 7 and 8 warriors were all dead. Tuo Lei Wu and the other captains attempted to capture the beast alive, so they did not start out using their strongest attacks, but eventually they were forced to use more powerful attacks to penetrate the beast's scales.

Unfortunately for him, he and the other captains were killed by Luo Feng in his Golden Horned Beast Body, using the Hybrid Mother Copper shard after using Strengthen.

characters.title: Two-Faced Ancestral God

infobox.cultivation: Top-Tier Universe Master Level 6 (Originally) True God

characters.introText: He was tens of meters tall and had six arms. He had a human form with thick legs, but had a face on each side of his head; the face on the front looked amiable with a smile and the one on the back was dark and fierce. He wore a white cape when performing his duties.

characters.history:
Two-Faced Ancestral God is one of the three Ancestral Gods of the Ancestral God Sect, along with Young Ancestral God and Old Ancestral God. He is highly gifted, which is why he was selected as one of the Ancestral Gods, and as one of the Ancestral Gods, he was favored by the Origin Will, allowed to wield True God-level power while within the Original Universe, despite being a Universe Master. As an Ancestral God, he may live in the Ancestral God Palace within the Five-Color Aurora Lake.

When the Three-Race Alliance contracted False-Real Devil God to kill Luo Feng, Two-Faced Ancestral God defended against the attack. It was revealed after False-Real Devil God retreated from Bauhinia Island that Two-Faced Ancestral God had been watching over Luo Feng for the 62 years prior to the attack, because he knew he was at risk, and felt that Luo Feng was an exceptional talent.

After Luo Feng took on the title of Milky Way Seigneur, Two-Faced Ancestral God brought him to Ancestral God Palace and gave him the task to investigate the Yuan Ao Secret Region and kill anyone who made the eyes of the golden token he was given turn red. When Luo Feng succeeded in killing them all except Yuan Ao Master, he informed Two-Faced Ancestral God, who sent Nine Remoteness Master, Dark Python Master, and Outstanding Difficulty Master to assist in killing him and destroying his Divine Wood weapon.

When the Three-Clan Coalition Army fought the Human Race alliance, Two-Faced Ancestral God and the rest of the Ancestral God Sect joined the side of the humans, hoping for the secret to breakthrough to True God. With their assistance, the Human Race alliance emerged victorious, and the sides were in constant communication afterward.

Two-Faced Ancestral God called Luo Feng over to Bauhinia Island to inform him of the conspirators who ambushed Huge Axe Creator, leading to his death: King Zhen Jia, Qiu Yan Ancestral God, and Great Thunder Star Master. After revealing that the Origin Will wanted the three dead, he showed Luo Feng out.

After the body of Jin God King arrived in Universe Ocean, the three Ancestral Gods, including Two-Faced Ancestral God, made their way to Universe Ocean for the first time, with a message from the Origin Will. Referencing the body of the Godly King of Jin, they informed Universe Ocean of the World of Jin contained within, and shared how the beings of Universe Ocean could enter it and benefit from it. Two-Faced Ancestral God traveled to Luo Feng to inform him of the upcoming Sector Beast War (although he did not name it as such) and advised him to get stronger, utilizing the World of Jin to acquire the best benefits possible. Later, the Ancestral Gods received the details of the Sector Beast War, and were all terrified, as they understood the power of the Sector Beasts.

The Ancestral Gods waited for the great beings to gather during the third era of entering the World of Jin, and took the opportunity to give further information both on the World of Jin and the Sector Beasts, through their role as the voice of the Origin Will. After providing as much information about the Sector Beasts as they were permitted to, they gave the same advice to the remaining great beings that they gave to Luo Feng: use the World of Jin to increase your powers and collect powerful treasures, then exterminate the Sector Beasts before the end of the current Reincarnation Era. Hoping to help them succeed, they detailed the requirements to fight a Sector Beast, their total numbers, how they grow, and other vital information. Speaking to Luo Feng and Primal Chaos City Leader separately, they named Luo Feng the strongest in Universe Ocean, and advised that it may be possible to free Ancestor Yuan from his suppression if they were able to kill the Sector Beasts, since that would be an incredibly large contribution to the Origin Will. They also gave an open invitation for Luo Feng to go to the Ancestral God Secret Region and ask any questions he had.

A trillion years after the appearance of the World of Jin, the three Ancestral Gods had become True Gods. Two-Faced Ancestral God and the others received Luo Feng's request to personally experience the destruction and rebirth of the Original Universe at the conclusion of the current Reincarnation Era. As the crisis continued, they also received information from the Origin Will related to the consequences of joining the side of the Sector Beasts, which they shared with the great beings of Universe Ocean. Two-Faced Ancestral God was one of those concerned with Luo Feng's failure to become a True God, and he was one of those who knelt when Luo Feng finally did become a True God. He, along with the other two Ancestral Gods, received Luo Feng and Primal Chaos City Leader's request to allow Ancestor Yuan to defend his Miniature Universe, rather than allow it to be devoured by the Sector Beasts. The Origin Will ceased suppressing his Willpower, allowing him to defend his Miniature Universe, but still refused to release him.

After Luo Feng killed Mo He and ended the Sector Beast War, the three Ancestral Gods shared the message from the Origin Will that the Sector Beast War was over, putting the minds of Universe Ocean at ease (except for those of Purple Moon Holy Land, who were currently under attack from one). They also confirmed the release of Ancestor Yuan, and congratulated him on his freedom, as they also admired his strength. After his release, Two-Faced Ancestral God noted that the Human Race would continue to thrive gloriously, and would likely have two Holy Land Universes.

The three Ancestral Gods sent an unnamed Beast God to inform Luo Feng of the impending destruction of the Original Universe in 3 years, and when he arrived at the Ancestral God Palace, they took their leave, exiting the Original Universe.

characters.title: Ultimate Arrow Master
characters.introText: As he was from the First Reincarnation Era, the pending doomsday made him a little crazy. He was arrogant when moving alongside great beings of the Divine Eye Race, but quickly resorted to pleading when his life was truly in danger.
characters.personality: As he was from the First Reincarnation Era, the pending doomsday made him a little crazy. He was arrogant when moving alongside great beings of the Divine Eye Race, but quickly resorted to pleading when his life was truly in danger.
characters.history:
During the nearly 3 Reincarnation Eras through which he lived, Ultimate Arrow Master became extremely close friends with Clear Eye Master. He was proficient in arrows, rare even in Universe Ocean.

While roaming with Five Chaos Master, he came across Luo Feng fighting with Yin Tuo. Seeing an opportunity to get an Arcana for free, and laugh at a rival great being from the First Reincarnation Era to boot, they pressured Luo Feng to give up his Shi Wu Wings and the blue planet ship arcana he had just found in the God-Destroying Mountain Stream. Unfortunately for him, Luo Feng chose to fight, and was willing to die alongside the others within the God-Destroying Mountain Stream.

Under the pressure of traveling through the Magma Sea, with his imminent death on his mind, he was unable to fully utilize his Domain Treasure Pinnacle Arcana Core of Blade Sector, and was annihilated.

characters.history:
Uncle Qiu is the person Entropy Sky Flame trusted the most, and his former servant. When Entropy Sky Flame returned to Hu Yang City and established the Sky Flame Sect, he had Uncle Qiu handle the big and small matters of the sect.

Before heading off to confront Sang Shui Yun, Entropy Sky Flame gave Qiu a secret letter to pass to five people if his causality disappeared. After Entropy Sky Flame was killed, Uncle Qiu gathered the remaining disciples and disbanded the Sky Flame Sect per his instructions. He continued to explain the cause of their master's death, and the strength of his murderer, Blood Cloud. Later, he rejoiced with the rest of the sect members when Luo Feng avenged him.

During the Heart Shadow Sect's invasion of the city, Qiu asked Luo Feng to save the sect's disciples of the Nine Great Tool-Refining Shops.

characters.title: Venerable Ancestor Black Vulture
characters.introText: Venerable Ancestor Black Vulture, was ranked as the second greatest sinner of the Continent of Origin. His true form manifested as an endless, dense black mist, and he resided within Black Vulture Palace. Highly feared and arrogant, he remained confident in his survival because of his powerful backing he was closely allied with the Three Monarchs of Thunder Ancient Kingdom, who provided him with security through their influence and the protection of the sacred land Thunder Mountain.
characters.history:
Venerable Ancestor Black Vulture, was ranked as the second greatest sinner of the Continent of Origin. His true form manifested as an endless, dense black mist, and he resided within Black Vulture Palace. Highly feared and arrogant, he remained confident in his survival because of his powerful backing he was closely allied with the Three Monarchs of Thunder Ancient Kingdom, who provided him with security through their influence and the protection of the sacred land Thunder Mountain.

Despite this confidence, Venerable Ancestor Black Vulture became the target of Luo Feng, who sought to eliminate the major sinners of the Continent of Origin after confronting Emperor Yuan’s schemes. When Luo Feng unleashed his devastating mental will attack, Venerable Ancestor Black Vulture’s scattered avatars across the continent were annihilated instantly, leaving behind only one surviving body entrenched within Thunder Mountain. The sacred land weakened Luo Feng’s attack by nearly eighty percent, sparing Black Vulture from immediate death but leaving him severely wounded and terrified. Recognizing his vulnerability, he urgently sought aid from the Three Monarchs, unwilling to step beyond the sanctuary of Thunder Mountain.

characters.title: Venerable Ancestral Tree
characters.introText: About 590 million kilometers tall, with a canopy of over 1 billion kilometers and a glowing, jade-like trunk that was 12 million kilometers wide, it was truly a sight to behold!
characters.appearance: About 590 million kilometers tall, with a canopy of over 1 billion kilometers and a glowing, jade-like trunk that was 12 million kilometers wide, it was truly a sight to behold!
characters.personality: ↑ Volume 18, Chapter 23 - Chapter 966: World Tree
characters.history:
Dwelling in Nine Remoteness Space, he is one of the three Top Universe Overlords of the Human Race, and serves Nine Remoteness Master. As a Plant Life Special Life Form (World Tree), he has incredible power, but initially felt incredibly lonely. To combat this loneliness, he grew 8 saplings around it, and gave each sapling a portion of his life origin, growing 8 other World Trees!

Since World Trees innately do not like to move, these 9 World Trees had spent millions of years together, with Venerable Ancestral Tree caring for the others like a father, even more caring than fathers from other universal races. He would kill anyone who tried to harm his children's trunks or tried to steal a twig.

When Huge Axe Creator's Miniature Universe was collapsing after his death, Venerable Ancestral Tree was one of the great beings who worked to save those who lived within that miniature universe.
characters.trivia: For now, the presumption is that Venerable Ancestral Tree is the strongest World Tree, but it is possible that they are two different characters. The World Tree, as a resident of Tree Island within Nine Remoteness Space, should in theory be subordinate to Nine Remoteness Master rather than part of Huge Axe Dojo. It is possible that Venerable Ancestral Tree is a human who used Possession on an Ancestral Star Tree lifeform.

characters.introText: Venerable Bei Shan is a Universe Venerable belonging to the Barbarian race, specifically the Fang Chui clan. He is a sub-member of the Ancestral God Sect and a long-time resident of Bauhinia Island. Known for his aggressive and reckless temperament, Bei Shan possesses a deep-seated hatred for Human Race. Within the hierarchy of the Ancestral God Sect, he represents the powerful class of Universe Venerables, who vastly outnumber and outrank the "King" level warriors. He frequently visits the Land of Treasures, where he has established a reputation for bullying weaker Immortal Kings, expecting them to flee or show absolute submission in his presence.
characters.appearance:
Venerable Bei Shan is a Universe Venerable belonging to the Barbarian race, specifically the Fang Chui clan. He is a sub-member of the Ancestral God Sect and a long-time resident of Bauhinia Island. Known for his aggressive and reckless temperament, Bei Shan possesses a deep-seated hatred for Human Race. Within the hierarchy of the Ancestral God Sect, he represents the powerful class of Universe Venerables, who vastly outnumber and outrank the "King" level warriors. He frequently visits the Land of Treasures, where he has established a reputation for bullying weaker Immortal Kings, expecting them to flee or show absolute submission in his presence.

During a notable incident in the Land of Treasures, Bei Shan attempted to humiliate a human newcomer, Luo Feng, and his companion, King Thousand Rain. Unlike most Immortal Kings who submit to Universe Venerables to avoid trouble, Luo Feng openly defied Bei Shan’s aggression. Despite being in the Five-Color Aurora Lake (a safe zone where killing is forbidden), Bei Shan used his superior pressure to demand that Luo Feng kneel and destroy half of his own "godly body" as an apology for his disrespect. Bei Shan was particularly incensed that a "mere immortal king" would dare to threaten him with a Fire God Origin Crystal (a self-destruct weapon) rather than beg for mercy.

Bei Shan's confrontation with the human drew the attention of other Universe Venerables, who mocked him for failing to intimidate a newcomer. His attempt to assert dominance was ultimately thwarted by the arrival of King Zhu Chong, a unique lifeform and one of the most powerful beings on Bauhinia Island. Zhu Chong, who aligns himself with human race, intervened and verbally reprimanded Bei Shan for his cruelty toward weaker warriors. Faced with a superior opponent who despite being an Immortal King was stronger than an ordinary Universe Venerable, Bei Shan was forced to retreat to save face, leaving the scene in frustration.

characters.title: Venerable Bi Fa
