characters.appearance: A gigantic wolf with a silver head, around 10 kilometers long.
characters.history: Venerable Bi Fa is a Universe Overlord of the Demon Race, and thus has a decent number of Arcana and support from his race. He countered Luo Feng after Luo Feng killed Venerable Zhong Zhan, and was enraged because he believed Luo Feng was hiding a Top Universe Overlord who used Luo Feng as bait to attract Universe Venerables to be slaughtered. He escaped when Luo Feng chased him, so they didn't fight; he had no respect for Luo Feng's ability, but was afraid of the restraint from Nine Roars River and the (fictional) Top Universe Overlord's attack.

characters.history: Venerable Black Crow is one of the 100 million heirs on Bauhinia Island, and a rival of King Bark Mirror. Using his teleportation, he brought King Bark Mirror and 5 Immortal heirs to Nine Remoteness Space in hopes of finding treasures. When King Bark Mirror discovered Luo Feng in the vicinity, Venerable Black Crow agreed to not interfere by warning him. He also watched the fight between the two. When Luo Feng escaped by jumping into a Nine Remoteness Whirlpool, Venerable Black Crow elected not to follow him to acquire the Arcana that he presumed would be left behind. King Bark Mirror believes Venerable Black Crow spread the information that he chased down Luo Feng into Nine Remoteness Whirlpool.

With his strong Willpower and law comprehension, he was the second to reach the 1st bottleneck of the test, and the only candidate other than Luo Feng to break through the 3rd bottleneck.
characters.appearance: A handsome man surrounded by vine and leaves.
characters.history:
Venerable Blue Blood is a Quasi-Universe Master from the East Emperor Holy Land Universe who participated in the Duan Dong River Inheritance Test. With his strong Willpower and law comprehension, he was the second to reach the 1st bottleneck of the test, and the only candidate other than Luo Feng to break through the 3rd bottleneck.

Due to the weakness of the Holy Land Universe Origin compared to the Original Universe Origin, East Emperor Holy Land could only birth a finite number of Universe Masters. Those Universe Venerables who reached the Original Law comprehension necessary to become a Universe Master were destined to be Quasi-Universe Masters until some Universe Masters died, giving them a chance to be chosen to break through to Universe Master.

Venerable Blue Blood was in this awkward position, a Quasi-Universe Master awaiting the death of actual Universe Masters. Since he was not qualified to enter Universe Ocean, he stayed insignificant and passive, waiting for an opportunity to break through. When the inheritance test brought this opportunity, his passion was ignited and he tried his best, battling Luo Feng to the best of his ability.

Due to his performance during the inheritance test, his status grew tremendously within East Emperor Holy Land, with East Emperor Ancestor personally meeting him, providing guidance, promising to use Time and Space Reversal to resurrect him if he died, and vowing to help him become a True God or even beyond if possible. Blue Blood eventually created a Universe Master Fusion Masterstroke Technique after 20 years of effort (in a time accelerated space, so 200,000 years), but died before creating a True God Technique, once Luo Feng created Nirvana Rebirth.

characters.introText: A blue figure about the same height as the blue members of the Dou Kou Race, but emitting a much more powerful pressure.
characters.appearance: A blue figure about the same height as the blue members of the Dou Kou Race, but emitting a much more powerful pressure.
characters.history:
Venerable Blue Dou Kou is a powerful Universe Overlord, one of the two leaders of the Dou Kou Race from Ice Prison Planet, along with Venerable Purple Dou Kou. When Luo Feng's Mosha Body stole the 3rd board of the Nine Calamities Secret Tome, Blue Dou Kou chased him and was forced to burn .1% of his Divine Body to use Lockdown. Despite his efforts, he was tricked by Luo Feng, which truly angered him.

Ice Prison is his Seal-type Treasure, which he has used to trap thousands of Immortal Kings. Following Sitting Mountain Guest's orders, he also trapped the captured Luo Feng within Ice Prison, instead of killing his Earthling Body.

He was spared by Luo Feng after giving him information about the Dangerous Land.

He encountered Luo Feng's Mosha Clan body and was cut down by his Top Arcana Blood Shadow Blade. The attack caused him to think that Luo Feng might truly be a Universe Master.

characters.title: Venerable Fire Erosion

infobox.Aliases: Lee Shi Huo Knight Shi Huo Venerable Venerable Fire Erosion

characters.introText: He is a true absolute genius, not even weaker than the Kedi I mentioned before. As a Pinnacle World Master, he could kill Immortal Marquises. After he broke through...he immediately became an Immortal King, and hundreds of thousands of years later, he became a Universe Venerable.
characters.appearance: A majestic being, his body was a blur, surrounded by black flames that spread over a million km about. He felt like the dictator of space to Luo Feng, who was much weaker than him.
characters.history:
Venerable Fire Erosion is a powerful Universe Venerable, considered a peerless genius of the Huge Axe Dojo. As a Pinnacle World Master, he was able to kill Immortal Marquis and pass the World Master level Primal Sky Mountain. It took him less than 10,000 years to break through to Immortal, at which point he immediately became an Immortal King. He became a Universe Venerable hundreds of thousands of years later, further showing his genius. He's even stronger than Venerable Nine Swords. He has one son, on whom he spent countless resources and energy, Nightmare Candle King.  He forced his son to stay at World Master level for 9 million years and gave him treasures that Universe Venerables would fight over, including the engraving on his son's forehead. To try to tamp down his son's spoiled nature, he threw him into the 9th Starfield Hell for a total of 1,000 Years. In the Donghua it's revealed that after King Nightmare Candle unsuccessfully tried killing King Zhenyan, he was thrown into the Starfield Hell for 1,000 years . Furthermore King Nightmare Candle states that his father was unwilling to kill King Zhenyan. It's presumed this is the case as Zhenyan was part of a different force, the Virtual Universe Company and followed the Beast God Cultivation way making him a slight genius.

When Nightmare Candle King attempted to bully Luo Feng, he appeared and admonished King Longyu and Venerable Nine Swords' army, forcing them to lower their heads and grimace in pain. However, to the surprise of everyone present, he then sentenced his son to the 9th Starfield Hell again, this time for 1,000 Eras. This was under the order of his teacher, Void Gold Master (at Hong's request).

characters.title: Venerable Gold Mist
characters.introText: Leader of the Gold Mist Universe Country, and a teacher of King Jian Ta. He is a Universe Venerable of ordinary strength.
characters.appearance:
Leader of the Gold Mist Universe Country, and a teacher of King Jian Ta. He is a Universe Venerable of ordinary strength.

“Ah, I remember, his luck is not bad, he went under Gold Mist knight.” True Yan shook his head. “Gold Mist knight is an average knight amongst many others. He has quite a few disciples, even Jian Ta managed to get in.”
“He actually dares to pick a fight with your family?” True Yan was shocked. “Who’s supporting him, he sure has some guts. Even his teacher Gold Mist…would treat you courteously, he wouldn’t offend you. You are after all the disciple of the Primal chaos city leader. Even if the city leader didn’t appear for you, just your group of seniors, anyone of them would be able to completely scare the shit out of Gold Mist.” - King Zhenyan

characters.title: Venerable Golden Axe
characters.introText: A huge man, nearly nine meters tall, with six arms, six eyes, and a giant golden ax almost as tall as his back.
characters.appearance: A huge man, nearly nine meters tall, with six arms, six eyes, and a giant golden ax almost as tall as his back.
characters.history:
Venerable Golden Axe is the 9th disciple of the Primal Chaos City Leader. As he had trained in the Beast God 7 Kills in the past, the Primal Chaos City Leader allowed Luo Feng to visit him for guidance once every decade for 3,000 years.

It was too hard for him to master all 7 forms, but he did reach the 4th level, enabling him to provide some guidance. After trillions of years of practicing, despite his body being very strong, the gains didn't make up for the losses, so he focused on studying Law of Time  itself.  He was accomplished in Law of Space , so he was hoping to reach the same level in time law, at which point he would become a Universe Master.

As one of the early disciples of the Primal Chaos City Leader, he was incredibly strong, perhaps stronger than Venerable Fire Erosion. He happily reported Luo Feng's progress in training to the city leader.
characters.trivia: In the fan translation, he is sometimes called Huge Axe Knight, but his name is always 金斧尊者 (Gold Axe Venerable)

characters.appearance: A being with four hooves and a human body, over 300 meters tall. He has three golden eyes.
characters.history: Venerable Golden Eye is one of the over 500 Universe Venerables who waited outside of Craftsman God Mountain in hopes of being chosen to be a disciple of Craftsman God Master. He was called a master of weapon refining while in the Ancestral God Secret Region, but realized how much more he had to improve when he arrived at Craftsman God Planet. He prevented Luo Feng from absentmindedly walking into Craftsman God Mountain and possibly incurring the wrath of Craftsman God Master. He discussed the abilities of some of the others who hoped to become disciples.

characters.title: Venerable Gui Yi
characters.introText: The second disciple of the Primal Chaos City Leader, a man wearing a fiery red war robe, barefoot and bald.
characters.appearance: The second disciple of the Primal Chaos City Leader, a man wearing a fiery red war robe, barefoot and bald.
characters.history:
As the second disciple of Primal Chaos City Leader, he had always served him.  One of the closest to the City Leader, his power was legendary. He was the mouth and tongue of the City Leader, who relied on him to deliver messages and execute orders.

Although he is a Universe Overlord, and is always by the City Leader's side, he does not own a soul-type Arcana. As a result, when the Original Star was about to open, he showed up to ask Luo Feng to borrow his soul-type Arcana. He offered to compensate Luo Feng with 3 Arcana.

Venerable Gui Yi is an ordinary Universe Overlord with greater Arcana, and is proficient in illusion and close combat. He is one of the Universe Venerables who receive news that the enemies of humanity are prepared to use any means to eliminate Luo Feng as soon as possible.
characters.trivia: In the donghua, Fei Ke is just an identity used by Venerable Gui Yi.

Venerable Ice Deuterium is a Universe Venerable of the Flame God Race. He met Luo Feng upon the former's arrival at the home of the Flame God Race. While he acted with calm indifference on the outside to Luo Feng's pointed criticism, on the inside he was angry and would have fought Luo Feng if not for Flame Emperor's orders.

In the Donghua, he did not appear when Luo Feng first met Flame Emperor. However, the Silver-armored Immortal racial Warrior did and was repressed alongside other Flame God Race members by Luo Feng's pressure.

characters.introText: A woman in ancient red armor, wearing a veil over her face which only revealed her jade-green eyes. Her voice was like 100 bird calls, and made one feel comfortable.
characters.appearance: A woman in ancient red armor, wearing a veil over her face which only revealed her jade-green eyes. Her voice was like 100 bird calls, and made one feel comfortable.
characters.history:
Venerable Jade Eye is the non-canon name given to the Universe Venerable who presented to Luo Feng the Virtual Universe Company's (VUC) terms for purchasing Earth and signed the contract when he agreed. She indifferently mentioned that the VUC could have just taken away his rights to Earth, but is instead acting according to the rules.

She was surprised when Luo Feng chose the option paying the lower amount of money (but more freedom for Earthlings), and reminded him to carefully consider the differences between the rewards. She and Venerable Nine Swords showed a sense of appreciation when Luo Feng stood firm and took the lower-paying option.
characters.trivia:
In the donghua, her role is played by King Longyu

She is a Universe Venerable, but casually spoke with Venerable Nine Swords and represented the Virtual Universe Company, so she is probably an Advanced Universe Venerable

characters.title: Venerable Ji Qi
characters.introText: Venerable Ji Qi is a Advanced Universe Venerable of the Thorn Ring Alliance. He was one of the three Advanced Universe Venerables (Venerable Chu Ka and Venerable Xun Fou) of the Thorn Ring Alliance who encountered Luo Feng after he killed Flourishing Light Seigneur. Luo Feng baited Ji Qi and the other 11 Universe Venerables (plus one Universe Overlord) into chasing him into the Nine Roars River, and then, having released his true power to augment the domain, killed them one-by-one.
characters.history:
Venerable Ji Qi is a Advanced Universe Venerable of the Thorn Ring Alliance. He was one of the three Advanced Universe Venerables (Venerable Chu Ka and Venerable Xun Fou) of the Thorn Ring Alliance who encountered Luo Feng after he killed Flourishing Light Seigneur. Luo Feng baited Ji Qi and the other 11 Universe Venerables (plus one Universe Overlord) into chasing him into the Nine Roars River, and then, having released his true power to augment the domain, killed them one-by-one.

Venerable Ji Qi was killed by a single horn attack from Luo Feng's Golden Horned Beast Body, which was wearing the Beast God Armor. Since he has a clone, he survived to tell Piercing Heart Master what transpired.

characters.title: Venerable Jiu Feng
characters.introText: Wearing purple armor, he's a powerful-looking human with a wolf's head.
characters.appearance: Wearing purple armor, he's a powerful-looking human with a wolf's head.
characters.history: Venerable Jiu Feng is one of the 7-star overlords of the Human Race, an equal of Tian Shi Palace Master. As such, he sits on a 650 foot throne in the Pantheon Sanctuary. He has also received the complete inheritance of one of the God Generals, and is a Universe Overlord. He welcomed Luo Feng and King Zhenyan to the Land of Inheritance of the Ancestral God Sect and brought them to receive their first inheritance. After Luo Feng self-destructed his Remote Ocean Body during his clash with Venerable Pei Feng, Jiu Feng arrived to defend Luo Feng, de-escalating the conflict. He possesses 4 Arcana, which when combined with his power makes him superior to Pei Feng, despite the two of them being God General Candidates of the same God General. He takes his position within the Human Race seriously and will defend and inform other Humans.
characters.trivia: In the Donghua, Venerable Jiu Feng replaces Venerable Ye Zheng's role of introducing Luo Feng joining the Hong Alliance as a World Master

Venerable Killing Fog is a member of the Thorn Ring Alliance, known to be skilled in Illusion Attacks, sent by Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress to track the location of Venerable Tian Yang. In exchange for tracking Tian Yang, who had a Disambiguation Mirror Stone, Killing Fog was given a Common Arcana.

He was caught in the battle between Luo Feng and Tian Yang, and was eventually forced to self-destruct by Luo Feng's I Am the Universe technique. After his death, he was revived by Retinue Master at the behest of Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress, who hadn't thought that he would be killed, but he lost his treasures.

characters.title: Venerable Nine Swords
characters.introText: Primal Chaos City is the safest place we've arranged for you all, and 1/5th of the 1,000 of you died, it's very disappointing!
characters.appearance: A man in a green robe with a handsome face and a head covered with purple scales.
characters.history:
Venerable Nine Swords is a powerful Universe Venerable of the Virtual Universe Company (VUC) who hosted Luo Feng's Pinnacle Genius Battle, eventually bringing the qualified geniuses from the competition to Primal Chaos City. As a result, all of the geniuses were considered under him. Hundreds of thousands of eras before the start of the series, Venerable Nine Swords took part in the genius battle as a Stellar Level.  He was the number one of that time and shook the entire competition, with a showing that didn't seem any less than Bolan's.

He pondered why Yuan Chen and Gu Lun, Universe Country leaders, fought over Rong Jun as a disciple. His subordinates include King Longyu, who he had monitor the geniuses for future subordinates.

He was angry that nearly 200 of the original 1000 geniuses perished within the Primal Chaos City, considered the safest place arranged for them. His rage at the time reminded them just how weak they were.

He personally reached out to Kandeli to investigate a new Universe Secret Region due both his respect for his skill and Kandeli's clone technique, which even he did not possess.

Despite his anger at the death rate of the geniuses, he was very pleased with the abilities of Bolan, Luo Feng, and Rong Jun. He hoped to bring on Luo Feng as his disciple, but had to give way when Luo Feng decided to follow the Primal Chaos City Leader.

As a Universe Venerable, he has his own army, led by King Longyu, with over 50 Immortal Kings and close to 1,000 Immortal Marquises. This army protected Luo Feng during his dispute with King Nightmare Candle, and discussed the status of the Earth with Luo Feng to try to ascertain the secret.

When Primal Chaos City Leader instructed Luo Feng to build his palace on the mountainside of Thunder Island, where the Universe Venerables of the VUC live, he was discontented as he didn't know that Luo Feng already had the strength of a Universe Venerable.  Later, when Luo Feng was planning on going to the Original Star, Venerable Nine Swords asked to borrow Arcana from him for his own trip, under the assumption that Luo Feng would not be going.

After Luo Feng killed Flourishing Light Seigneur, Nine Swords was one of those to receive news that the enemies of the human race planned to eliminate Luo Feng as soon as possible due to his strength and potential.
characters.trivia:
Venerable Nine Swords, an Advanced Universe Venerable, was shown to be unable to stop an Immortal Marquis, Mo Li Marquis, in the Donghua .
This begs the question whether he is befitting of the Advanced Universe Venerable title or whether Mo Li happens to be the strongest Immortal Marquis.

infobox.organisation: Northern Territory Alliance Ancestral God Sect

characters.introText: He is a gigantic blue figure, more than 300 meters tall, with fire burning in his six eyes.
characters.appearance: He is a gigantic blue figure, more than 300 meters tall, with fire burning in his six eyes.
characters.history:
Venerable Pei Feng is a Universe Overlord from the Northern Territory Alliance and a God General candidate of the Ancestral God Sect. He arrived in the aftermath of Luo Feng forcing King Bark Mirror to self-destruct, and attempted to retrieve the Arcana and Heavy Treasures he left behind. Luo Feng refused to allow him to do so, so the two fought, with Luo Feng being eventually forced to self-destruct his Remote Ocean body to do any real damage. Venerable Jiu Feng then arrived to defend Luo Feng, causing Pei Feng to retreat.

After the fight, he was worried about Luo Feng sharing footage of their fight, but he only showed footage of his fight with King Bark Mirror. He was present to watch his teacher, Qi Lan Master, resurrect King Bark Mirror, and he advised the latter to not fight Luo Feng until he became a Universe Venerable.

characters.title: Venerable Purple Dou Kou
characters.introText: Venerable Purple Dou Kou displays a playful personality, showing amusement at Luo Feng escaping from Venerable Blue Dou Kou and jokingly conversing with him.
characters.appearance: A beautiful, purple-robed demon-looking creature.
characters.personality: Venerable Purple Dou Kou displays a playful personality, showing amusement at Luo Feng escaping from Venerable Blue Dou Kou and jokingly conversing with him.
characters.history:
Venerable Purple Dou Kou is the strongest member of the Dou Kou Race, a powerful Top Universe Overlord with power matching an ordinary Universe Master. She is one of the 72 God Generals of the Ancestral God Sect, and is thus far stronger than God General candidates like Venerable Jiu Feng and Venerable Pei Feng. She has a past relationship with Sky Wolf Master, with the two chatting amicably but with clear grudges under the surface.

When Luo Feng attempted to escape Ice Prison Planet after obtaining the 3rd black metal board of the Nine Volume Manual, he was caught by Venerable Purple Dou Kou, who placed a small imprint on the board, allowing her to track its location as Luo Feng teleported about. It is revealed in her conversation with Venerable Blue Dou Kou that they were acting on the orders of Sitting Mountain Guest, who advised them to send any Flesh And Blood Lifeform who stole the board to Ice Prison.

When Sky Wolf Master heard that the Invincible Immortal King Si Bo Wa was trapped in Ice Prison, he took the opportunity to see Venerable Purple Dou Kou, who he had not seen in a long time. Upon his arrival the two chatted and she confirmed Si Bo Wa's strength, then had Venerable Blue Dou Kou release Si Bo Wa. Due to her relationship with Sky Wolf Master, he did not truly harm Venerable Blue Dou Kou when the latter spoke out of line. Acting on Sitting Mountain Guest's orders, she had him also release Luo Feng at Sky Wolf Master's insistence.

She is amazed at the arrival of Primal Chaos City Leader and his Thousand Treasures River, and she knows the true nature of that Arcana. It is implied that she has some awareness of his abilities.
characters.trivia: Despite the Dou Kou Race not having true genders and no reproduction, Venerable Purple Dou Kou is explicitly referred to with the character '她' (she).

characters.title: Venerable Purple Rain
characters.introText: A gloomy teenage-looking androgynous creature in translucent purple armor.
characters.appearance: A gloomy teenage-looking androgynous creature in translucent purple armor.
characters.history: Venerable Purple Rain is an incredible Top Universe Overlord Special Lifeform who is a powerful combatant of the Ancestral God Sect. As an Immortal, he was the strongest Immortal on Bauhinia Island, and he killed quite a few Universe Venerables! His Life Gene Level exceeds that of King Zhu Chong, and he is seen as on the same level as Venerable Ancestral Tree and Tian Shi Palace Master.
characters.trivia: While it's said that it is difficult to determine if Venerable Purple Rain is a male or female (and as a Special Lifeform, it is possible to have no gender), the initial description uses 少年 (Shàonián, lit. Young Year, but used to refer to young boys, and also directly taken into Japanese as Shōnen, versus 少女, which is used for young girls)

characters.title: Venerable Sky Flower

infobox.master: Sky Wolf Master Dream Demon Ancestor

characters.introText: While originally a Sky Wolf, he performed a soul transfer with a Special Lifeform. Now he is a being with a huge, blood-red eye vertically in the middle of his face, with a body covered in snow-white hair, walking with a crooked back.
characters.appearance: While originally a Sky Wolf, he performed a soul transfer with a Special Lifeform. Now he is a being with a huge, blood-red eye vertically in the middle of his face, with a body covered in snow-white hair, walking with a crooked back.
characters.history:
Venerable Sky Flower is the special disciple of Sky Wolf Master, and also a disciple of Dream Demon Ancestor. He is the second-most powerful Sky Wolf behind his master. As such, he had the strength and confidence to traverse the Original Stars.

When Luo Feng attempted to convince the Three-Race Alliance that he was a Universe Master, he chose Sky Flower as his first victim, eventually learning from Venerable Niu Zhou that he was at Original Star 02933. As the High Arcana weapon High Divine Hammer emerged, Sky Flower battled Venerable Thousand Shadow and Zha Wei Seigneur, but was interrupted by Luo Feng before he could retrieve the treasure. While initially he and Luo Feng were roughly evenly matched, Luo Feng's Golden Light technique instantly destroyed 11% of his Divine Body, greatly alarming him.

Before he could be killed, Sky Flower escaped in his High Arcana Flying Palace, White Needle, then reported his strength to his teacher, Dream Demon Ancestor and the leaders of the Demon Race. While the strength Luo Feng showed was that of a Universe Master, it was not enough to convince Dream Demon Ancestor, who worked with Father God and Zerg Empress to gather 9 Universe Master and thousands of Universe Venerables to kill Luo Feng.

Eventually, Sky Flower was tricked into thinking Luo Feng escaped, through clever use of his Golden Horned Beast Body.
characters.trivia: While in the novel, Venerable Sky Flower escapes from Luo Feng and then follows him, reporting his location to the Three-Race Alliance, in the donghua he is killed by Luo Feng. Both scenarios eventually led to Luo Feng battling Banff Master and killing over 6,000 Universe Venerables

With a large Divine Body and a Life Gene Level of 100, he was a formidable opponent. When the High Divine Hammer emerged on Original Star 02933, he joined forces with Zha Wei Seigneur to battle Venerable Sky Flower for it.

characters.appearance: A man about 8 meters tall, with strong, massive arms and black armor. He has a huge iron hammer.
characters.history: Venerable Thunder is a powerful Universe Venerable of the Virtual Universe Company. As a Universe Venerable, he has a virtual palace on the mountainside of Thunderclap Island. He was discontented when Primal Chaos City Leader allowed the newly Immortal Luo Feng to also create a palace on the mountainside, which was reserved for Universe Venerables. He and Venerable Bloody Wing discussed this with Venerable Zhenyan, advising him to have Luo Feng move his palace from the mountainside to avoid making himself the enemy of many Universe Venerables.
characters.trivia: He and Venerable Bloody Wing were the most powerful Universe Venerables in the group of 8 who discussed Luo Feng's palace on Thunderclap Island. As a result, it is probable that he is an Advanced Universe Venerable, but it is not specified.

characters.title: Venerable Tian Yang
characters.introText: He was around 8 meters tall with thick legs and eight arms. He had no hair on his body, none on his head, and looked as if he was made entirely of metal, appearing to be a being of the Automaton Race. He wore black armor and there were a pair of black wings on his back. His head could turn 360 degrees, providing a high level of alertness.
characters.appearance: He was around 8 meters tall with thick legs and eight arms. He had no hair on his body, none on his head, and looked as if he was made entirely of metal, appearing to be a being of the Automaton Race. He wore black armor and there were a pair of black wings on his back. His head could turn 360 degrees, providing a high level of alertness.
characters.history:
For hundreds of thousands of years, he had been using his two-wing Common Arcana. He had come to the original stars 8 times in the past, and worked his way to becoming a Universe Overlord. He is the God General Candidate for Criminal Light God General.

During Luo Feng's time on the Original Stars, his Shi Wu Wings sensed Venerable Tian Yang's two-wing High Arcana and the two clashed. Upon clashing with Luo Feng, he realized that Luo Feng's large Divine Body would make it close to impossible for him to defeat Luo Feng, so he escaped.

Later, after Luo Feng had gotten stronger, he got Venerable Tian Yang's location from Venerable Niu Zhou and tracked him down, forced him to fight, and killed him, obtaining the second component of the Shi Wu Wings.

characters.title: Venerable Undying
characters.introText: Wearing a strange battle armor with tens of thousands of vines hanging on it, his face is covered by some vines, and he has a pair of green and evil eyes. His voice is squeaky and bizarre.
characters.appearance: Wearing a strange battle armor with tens of thousands of vines hanging on it, his face is covered by some vines, and he has a pair of green and evil eyes. His voice is squeaky and bizarre.
characters.history:
Venerable Undying is a disciple of Huge Axe Creator and a true member of the upper echelon of the Huge Axe Dojo. His title, Undying, refers to his incredible ability to survive, he has never died (and thus never had to be resurrected). His strength and position are comparable to Tian Shi Palace Master.

He is oddly temperamental and seems mad. He is proud and moody, enjoying exploration of dangerous universe secret regions, the more dangerous, the more he enjoyed them. Despite his strength, he never opened a Universe Country, he never built his own sect or army, and he didn't fight for power or status! He enjoyed taking risks, no matter how powerful the opponent, he would still challenge them. He scolded other Universe Venerables and is extremely arrogant.

With his strength, he is considered an ordinary Universe Overlord, and as such has a 650 feet-wide throne on the second-level of the Pantheon Sanctuary.

He is one of the great beings who learned that the enemies of humanity planned to use any means to eliminate Luo Feng as soon as possible.

As a Peripheral Member of the Ancestral God Sect, he has completed the 5th level of the Beast God Inheritance, making him close to the level of a Universe Overlord.
characters.history:
Venerable Wan Feng is an Advanced Universe Venerable of the Northern Territory Alliance, as well as a Peripheral Member of the Ancestral God Sect. As a Peripheral Member of the Ancestral God Sect, he has completed the 5th level of the Beast God Inheritance, making him close to the level of a Universe Overlord.

When Venerable Zhenyan defeated King Bark Mirror to avenge Luo Feng, Bark Mirror called upon Wan Feng to save him from death. Despite destroying 54% of Zhenyan's Divine Body, Wan Feng was unable to prevent his escape.

characters.trivia:
In the Donghua, this character was not named. However in Episode 214, he is briefly shown together with Venerable Bei Feng and Forked Blood Palace Leader.

In Episode 215 of the Donghua, when Venerable Bei Feng and Forked Blood Palace Leader are shown chasing after Luo Feng, Venerable Wang Jia is no longer present, which lines up according to what happened in the novel, where he is stationed at the entrance/exit of that particular Original Star, and did not join them in chasing after Luo Feng

Based on the context clues above, although not confirmed officially, we can infer that the unnamed character is meant to be Venerable Wang Jia

characters.title: Venerable Wu Tang
characters.introText: Venerable Wu Tang is one of 100 million Beast God Inheritance heirs living on Bauhinia Island, and an old life-and-death friend of King Zhenyan. They have known each other for an incredibly long time, and remained close even after Venerable Wu Tang became a Universe Venerable, despite King Zhenyan being stuck at the Invincible Immortal King level. With his knowledge of the talents of the Human Race, he believed in King Zhenyan's bright future and felt that once King Zhenyan broke through to Universe Venerable, he would be extraordinary.
characters.history:
Venerable Wu Tang is one of 100 million Beast God Inheritance heirs living on Bauhinia Island, and an old life-and-death friend of King Zhenyan. They have known each other for an incredibly long time, and remained close even after Venerable Wu Tang became a Universe Venerable, despite King Zhenyan being stuck at the Invincible Immortal King level. With his knowledge of the talents of the Human Race, he believed in King Zhenyan's bright future and felt that once King Zhenyan broke through to Universe Venerable, he would be extraordinary.

When King Zhenyan broke through to Universe Venerable, Venerable Wu Tang stayed behind after the celebration and brought him up-to-date on everything that happened to King Blade River while King Zhenyan was in seclusion working toward his breakthrough. After making him aware of King Bark Mirror's attack, he provided King Zhenyan with information on the dangerous places in the Ancestral God Secret Region, particularly the Nine Remoteness Space. He nodded with joy at the return of the old, ferocious, Zhenyan, when he announced that he would go to Nine Remoteness Space in hopes of fighting King Bark Mirror.

She is the younger sister of the head of the Paulinus Clan and the chief executive officer of the HR Alliance in the Hanxia District. She is infamously known as The Scorpion Queen.

When Li Yao achieves his breakthrough to Planetary-level, Hong sends Vladimir and Allure to take him down and protect Luo Feng.
characters.trivia:
When Li Yao achieves his breakthrough to Planetary-level, Hong sends Vladimir and Allure, despite knowing that Li Yao 's special ability is probably 'light,' which implies either that Vladimir and Allure have similar speeds, or a technique that neutralizes that speed in some way.

In the novel, his abilities are never seen

In the novel, there is a different Inspector who is in charge of the No. 9 Ruin of Ancient Civilization

Void Gold Master is one of the Universe Masters of the Huge Axe Dojo and is the creator of the Sky Ruins Primal Chaos Tablet. He serves as Hong's teacher until he becomes an Immortal King, and he ordered Venerable Fire Erosion to imprison his son, Nightmare Candle King, for threatening Luo Feng. He has True God-level will even as a Universe Master.

He reaches the level of True God after the appearance of the World of Jin. He joined Dragon Walk Master and Fire Dome in defending Luo Feng's miniature universe during his breakthrough to True God.

White-Browed Winged Old Man is the non-canon name given to the Virtual Universe Company (VUC) employee who assisted Luo Feng in the 2nd and 3rd levels of his Highest Points Mission. His cultivation level is also not given in the novel, but since he was sent to execute Immortal Army Lords, yet remarked that he couldn't afford the delicacies served by King Blood Devil, he is likely an Immortal Marquis.

During the meeting with King Blood Devil, he consistently attempted to make Luo Feng's job more difficult by partaking in the feast and directly remarking on Luo Feng's power over the 21 targets.

He personally executed the 21 targets that Luo Feng sentenced to death in the 3rd level of his mission. He also placed the 10 billion Planetary Level humans in his God Country that Luo Feng saved from the 2nd Level of his mission.
characters.trivia: In the donghua, Fei Ke is just an identity used by Venerable Gui Yi.

characters.title: White-Robed Bald Old Man
characters.introText: White-Robed Bald Old Man is the non-canon name given to Bolan's teacher. An Immortal who wandered hundreds of millions of galaxies, he specifically cultivated Bolan's planet, preventing it from joining the universe culture. The planet he managed had no trace of technology.
characters.appearance: A bald old man wearing a white robe.
characters.history:
White-Robed Bald Old Man is the non-canon name given to Bolan's teacher. An Immortal who wandered hundreds of millions of galaxies, he specifically cultivated Bolan's planet, preventing it from joining the universe culture. The planet he managed had no trace of technology.

In his final test for Bolan, he had 100 Stellar Level 9 Warriors and Spirit Masters surround Bolan and attack him. When Bolan easily killed all 100, he stated that Bolan had made progress in his training and was the most amazing genius he had ever seen in his travels. After stating there was nothing else he could teach Bolan, he then ordered him to take part in the Pinnacle Genius Battle, declaring that he should easily make the universe's top-1,000. By doing so, he would join the Virtual Universe Company and find a suitable teacher. He ordered Bolan to look for him again when he broke through to Immortal, then vanished.

Bolan noted that his teacher had never given him a blatant complement, merely offering small words of encouragement in the past.

characters.history: The White-Robed Female Warrior is a Special Elite of the Virtual Universe Company, ordered by Ming Yu to battle Luo Feng and Thunder God 1-on-1 in the Battle Space of the Killing Fields. In the Killing Fields, she was considered a 6-star ranked Warrior. In her battles with the pair, she toyed with and beat each of them, shocking them and revealing the depths of talent within the universe. It is implied that she has a Domain, however she did not use it in either battle. As Hong, a Planetary Level Warrior with a 3-layer Domain, was only considered a Level 1 Elite, the White-Robed Female Warrior's talent must have been truly extraordinary to qualify as a Special Elite.
characters.trivia: In the donghua, it appears that this character is being combined with Ji Qing

characters.appearance: A man with a handsome face and a red mole between his eyebrows. He has slightly pointy ears and wears a white robe.
characters.history:
White-Robed Man is the non-canon name given to the being on the fifth floor of Wu Qi Tower. This man can perform 360 separate Top-Tier Level 6 True God Techniques based on one of the Original Laws (so 36 techniques for each law) and 90 total Level 7 True God Techniques based on one of the Fusion Laws (implied to be 10 different techniques for each fusion law, the 8 Ways of the Beast God plus time/space fusion).

After agreeing to match the candidate's energy, he assesses the candidate's technique, choosing to challenge them in their specialized technique. After performing his 450 total strikes, he admits defeat and disappears. It is implied that the White-Robed Man can execute 450 techniques not only of blades, but other melee or ranged weapons, and even illusions or treasure-crafting.

His cultivation tier is not revealed, but with the ability to use True God techniques of every Original Law, including fusion laws, and the implication of being able to do so through multiple technique types, one can infer that he is at least a Void True God.

characters.title: White-Robed Young Swordsman
characters.introText: The White-Robed Young Swordsman is a Level 2 Elite of the Virtual Universe Company, ordered by Ming Yu to battle Hong in the Battle Space of the Killing Fields. His rank in the Killing Fields was not revealed. He wielded a long sword with clean and precise swordsmanship, combined with his Law of Lightning  Domain, which constantly expanded. After clashing over 1,000 times, he agreed to call the battle a draw, but Hong revealed his newly-acquired power, using the third level of his Domain and his strongest skill, Endless Hatred, to defeat him.

characters.title: Wind Emperor
characters.introText: The Three Emperors of Wind, Thunder, and Sea are a closely allied trio of Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform who belong to the Ice Peak Faction. Known for their similar appearances and personalities, they often act as one unit and are widely regarded with disdain by higher-tier beings due to their relatively weak strength. Despite this, they are extremely troublesome due to their shared trait of immortality, which makes it nearly impossible to permanently eliminate them. Within the hierarchy of Ice Peak Faction, they rank among the lowest of the twelve Eternal beings, yet they are some of the most aggressive in expanding territory. Nearly half of the over one hundred World Clusters occupied by Ice Peak Camp were seized by them during a period when the Cultivator Camp was preoccupied with war against the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction. They have a reputation for instigating conflict and exploiting the power of the Ice Peak alliance to act with impunity.

characters.introText: Wind-Devouring Ancestor was a prominent Primogenitor belonging to the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction during the decisive war against the Cultivator Camp's Eight Lords in Chaotic Origin Dimension. He was one of the 89 Primogenitors deployed by the faction in their major confrontation with the Eight Lords, categorized among the 50 who excelled in lethal combat techniques but relied heavily on their companions for survival, rather than the 39 who specialized in self-preservation.
characters.appearance:
Wind-Devouring Ancestor was a prominent Primogenitor belonging to the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction during the decisive war against the Cultivator Camp's Eight Lords in Chaotic Origin Dimension. He was one of the 89 Primogenitors deployed by the faction in their major confrontation with the Eight Lords, categorized among the 50 who excelled in lethal combat techniques but relied heavily on their companions for survival, rather than the 39 who specialized in self-preservation.

Wind-Devouring Ancestor possessed unique wind-based abilities that defined his combat style and survival mechanisms. His signature technique involved splitting his power into countless individual strands, with each strand representing a "wind" that could potentially escape to ensure his survival through dispersal. Despite his formidable offensive capabilities, his survival abilities were assessed as relatively weak compared to other Primogenitors, making him vulnerable to coordinated attacks.

During the climactic battle, Wind-Devouring Ancestor became the second target of Luo Feng and the other Lords' systematic assault. When struck by Luo Feng's blade light, he immediately deployed his signature survival technique, scattering his power into countless wind strands in all directions. However, the combined might of the Eight Lords proved overwhelming - an invisible wave of destructive force instantly annihilated ninety-nine percent of his dispersed power, while multiple devastating forces including thunder, annihilation, space-time manipulation, and life-severing energies targeted every escaping wind strand. Not a single strand managed to endure, resulting in his complete annihilation before other Primogenitors could provide assistance.

His death marked the second casualty in the opening engagement, demonstrating the Eight Lords' devastating coordinated power and highlighting the vulnerability of combat-focused primogenitors when faced with the Lords' ability to bypass defensive formations and directly target individuals.

characters.introText: Dressed in green battle robes, with long green hair and a handsome face, he's a very handsome youth.
characters.appearance: Dressed in green battle robes, with long green hair and a handsome face, he's a very handsome youth.
characters.personality: In the Donghua she has a very sadistic personality.
characters.history:
Windmill is a participant in the same Pinnacle Genius Battle as Luo Feng, stationed on the same world as Luo Feng during the Ganwu Universe Country Elimination Stage. Until he fought Luo Feng, he was considered a warrior close to invincible within the city in which they landed.

A Spirit Master who had stepped through the gateway of the Law of Wind , his speed and ferocity were legendary within the city. His green wheel Spirit Weapon could split into two semi-discs, and his attacks were fast and hard to predict, forcing Luo Feng to use the Yan Shen Armament for the first time in the tournament. In the end, he lost to Luo Feng, but he still qualified as one of the top 1001 of Ganwu Universe Country.

Friendly by nature, he quickly made friends with Luo Feng due to his strength and friendliness. Within the skyscraper test portion of the genius battle, he was eliminated on the 7th floor of the 3rd tower. He congratulated Luo Feng on reaching rank 3 within the Training Space Elimination round, but was not able to move to the next level. He was offered a spot in the Ganwu Secret Region.

characters.title: Wo Te
characters.introText: A warrior clad in gold armor, his body emanated a heart-shaking ripple of gold origin law energy.
characters.appearance: A warrior clad in gold armor, his body emanated a heart-shaking ripple of gold origin law energy.
characters.history:
Wo Te was an Immortal disciple of Meng Huo who became Immortal through Law of Gold . As a result of Kun Sha Luo selling Meng Huo and his disciples a fake map to a Secret Region, Wo Te received injuries from which he could not recover, and could only await death.

In his hundreds of millions of years, his proudest achievements were his techniques, which he treated as though they were treasures, neither teaching them to his disciples nor displaying them in public. With his impending demise, his mind changed and he sought an extremely talented disciple, to whom he could pass on his techniques. Watching Luo Feng's performance in the Ganwu Universe Country Arena Stage of the Pinnacle Genius Battle, he sought Luo Feng as a disciple, but was reminded by Meng Huo that someone like Luo Feng would either train under the Ganwu Universe Country or the Virtual Universe Company, neither of which they were strong enough to oppose.

After that discussion, he returned to his homeland, wanting to take a good look at it before dying. Meng Huo pledged to help him with his search for a disciple and to avenge his death by killing Kun Sha Luo.

characters.introText: A strange beast with two wings on his neck. He has a hideous head and cold eyes, with a face covered in scales. His Divine Body is over 1 million kilometers long.
characters.appearance: A strange beast with two wings on his neck. He has a hideous head and cold eyes, with a face covered in scales. His Divine Body is over 1 million kilometers long.
characters.history:
Wu He is a Universe Master from the World of Jin. As the son of Northern True Sea Master, he is very powerful for a Universe Master, and has an assortment of Arcana, Mechanical Treasures, and techniques. He is very knowledgeable about the World of Jin and seeks to surpass his father.

In the selection battle for the East Army, Wu He originally fights with Bei Feng, using his Divine Power-burning technique to suppress him. Seeing that Bei Feng could not defeat Wu He, Luo Feng offered to fight him. The two had a ferocious fight that lasted the remainder of the selection battle, with Luo Feng attacking him repeatedly, reducing his Divine Body to less than 50% of its original strength. The strength that Wu He and Luo Feng showed in their battle resulted in them being selected to join the Python River Army.

After being selected to join the Python River Army, Wu He and Luo Feng became companions for a time, during which Wu He explained the purpose of the Python River Army and what the two of them could expect. He shared information on the Military Exchange stations, Military Credits, the types of missions they would be sent on, and what valuables they could obtain. When the pair received their Python River Armor, Wu He noted that that armor was worse than the armor he already had.

After officially joining the Python River Army, Wu He introduced himself as the son of Northern True Sea Master and noted that his Divine Body was more than 1 million kilometers in length. Wu He and Luo Feng then learned that they would be taking part in a Disaster/Catastrophe level mission, which caused Wu He great anguish, as he knew the difficulty of passing such a mission as a new recruit. The two stuck together as they met the other 37 soldiers in their troop before heading off to Nine Smoke Marsh to begin their mission.

Wu He and Luo Feng received their mission: head to Nine Smoke Marsh and acquire 10,000 Military Credits (MC), either by killing a True God (worth 10,000 MC) or killing Universe Masters (worth 1 MC each). The proof of killing a True God would be its body, while the proof of killing a Universe Master was the weapons stolen after killing them. This had to be done within 1 era, or 10,081 years. Wu He, who knew how powerful Nine Smoke Marsh was, was very concerned, and since he and Luo Feng were new recruits, they could not count on the assistance of the other 37 soldiers. Understanding the difficulty of their mission, Wu He initially agreed to follow Luo Feng's plans, but when he learned that Luo Feng planned to enter the True God battlefield and acquire corpses that way, he decided to part with him.

Wu He fought on the Universe Master battlefield, gaining 1,200 MC in 3 months, but knew it would be difficult to reach 10,000. After learning from Captain that Luo Feng had acquired 30 True God corpses, Wu He contacted him in hopes of exchanging for one so he could pass the mission. After some haggling, Wu He gave him an Armor Xeon Arcana, a large number of Universe Master-level weapons and armors, and the Mechanical Treasure Qi Wen Flying Armor in exchange for one True God corpse.

In the 5,600th year since Luo Feng arrived in the World of Jin, Wu He informed him that the Captain and Ku Fa had returned, along with their remaining subordinates. As new recruits, neither he nor Luo Feng had any sympathy for the veteran soldiers. When the next mission was assigned, he reached out to Luo Feng to inform him that 9 new members had joined the troop. After learning of Luo Feng's ability, he was willing to join Luo Feng for the next mission, but since Luo Feng was leaving to undertake a mission to receive the title of 'Jin,' Wu He instead joined Ku Fa's team and departed.

characters.introText: He has the traditionally good looks of the Manka people, with black hair and eyes that burned with a mad battle spirit. He wears silver armor.
characters.appearance: He has the traditionally good looks of the Manka people, with black hair and eyes that burned with a mad battle spirit. He wears silver armor.
characters.personality: He's very hot-blooded! Passionate about battle, passionate about friendship! He has the good qualities of the Manka people's tradition, in that he loved to eat, he was loud, and boorish, but very intelligent. While he could be casually arrogant, his intelligence kept him from overlooking those who had showcased their strength. He's spoiled, but also has a higher perspective of the universe.
characters.history:
As a prince of the Manka Clan, as well as the most exceptional genius of his generation, Wu Ka was raised to become an absolute warrior, like his father. As royalty, he had resources lavished on him and his understanding of the universe was raised to a level suitable of his position. As such, he was able to qualify for the Stellar Level Pinnacle Genius Battle.

In the Pinnacle Battles, he battled his way into the top 5, finally losing to Long Yun.  As such, he was placed in the Absolute Beginning Region of Primal Chaos City, along with Rong Jun and Luo Feng. With his forthright personality, love of battle and unwillingness to admit defeat, he easily made friends with the two, with the trio getting the nickname of 'The Absolute Beginning's Three Heroes.'

When he arrived in Primal Chaos City, he selected the Huge Axe Tablet, due to it being left behind by Huge Axe Creator; he was unable to pass the first level of the Heavenly Bridge on his first attempt. As he loves competition, he often attempted the bridge after someone passed a new level, and he shared information that could help his friends' cultivation. He was one of the first 8 to pass the 2nd level of the bridge, and he was the 4th to pass the 3rd level. After Luo Feng passed the World Master-level Primal Sky Mountain, Wu Ka met with Rong Jun and Bolan and vowed to become an Immortal King. By the end of the story, he had surpassed that goal, becoming a Universe Venerable.

characters.history:
Wu Xiang Ancestor is the second-strongest of the five God Kings of the Food Kingdom, and one of the 3 responsible for the destruction of the Jin Kingdom. As a limit First Level God King, he is even stronger than Snow Realm Ancestor.

He is the first God King of the Food Kingdom who battles Luo Feng, meeting him in the mental space of Infinite Space. While he has not comprehended a complete Major Branch of a new Great Dao, he has opened a new path, and has comprehended 2 God King Techniques. His new path, Flame of Sinful Karma, is based on the Great Dao of the Infinite Origin, and burns both the Divine Body and the Consciousness.

Despite also creating a body of flame through the Fire of Sin path, he was unable to defend against Luo Feng's newly created God King Techniques. Luo Feng killed his body that was in Infinite Space, rejecting his offers to pay a compensation price, thus establishing himself as a true enemy of the Food Kingdom.

Luo Feng killed Wu Xiang Ancestor with the Lie Yuan Technique immediately after killing Tian Kun.

characters.title: Wu Xin God King
characters.introText: Wu Xin God King is a member of Reincarnation Building, he chose to reincarnate to escape the entanglement of karma and get some freedom. After his reincarnation, he connected with the Empress of Wind City and joined the Reincarnation Building, a place he trusts completely, the members there have never betrayed him.
characters.history:
Wu Xin God King is a member of Reincarnation Building, he chose to reincarnate to escape the entanglement of karma and get some freedom. After his reincarnation, he connected with the Empress of Wind City and joined the Reincarnation Building, a place he trusts completely, the members there have never betrayed him.

Once, Wu Xin was a guest official God King in the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. He didn't fully commit to the kingdom but became stronger over time, eventually reaching the rank of Second Level God King. This led him to compete for valuable resources, But because it is too valuable making him a target for besieges by the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, and after many battles he finally being killed.

Wu Xin understands that the only way to escape the relentless pursuit of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom was to reincarnate. He warns others, like Luo Feng, that he is safe for now but must be careful when he grows stronger. He knows firsthand how ruthless the emperors can be. Among his current companions, he and Emperor Gui Xu share a deep grudge against the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, uniting them in their struggles.

characters.title: Wu Xiu God King
characters.introText: Wu Xiu God King is an extremely powerful First Level God King of the Emperor Wu Family. As a member of the Emperor Wu Family, he is antagonistic toward members of the Emperor Chu Family.
characters.appearance: An old man in a loose white robe.
characters.history:
Wu Xiu God King is an extremely powerful First Level God King of the Emperor Wu Family. As a member of the Emperor Wu Family, he is antagonistic toward members of the Emperor Chu Family.

Luo Feng encounters him while searching for a space to make his own within Infinite Space. Wu Xiu interrogated Luo Feng about how he got access to Infinite Space, slandering Emperor Chu and sparking Luo Feng's ire. However, before the two could go any further, Yan Qiong God King arrived, forcing Luo Feng to leave the area.

Wu Xiu expressed to Yan Qiong his suspicions of how Luo Feng acquired a token to Infinite Space, leading to him bringing them to Emperor Yan, who attempted to punish Emperor Chu and Luo Feng.

characters.introText: Wu Yan (乌炎) is one of the three most powerful High Chaotic Origin Lifeform within the Dark World Group, alongside Cheng and the Golden Robed Woman. Though considered elite among his regional peers, Wu Yan is ultimately limited by the method through which he jumped out of the cage—through gradual bloodline excavation rather than comprehension.
characters.appearance: Wu Yan (乌炎) is one of the three most powerful High Chaotic Origin Lifeform within the Dark World Group, alongside Cheng and the Golden Robed Woman. Though considered elite among his regional peers, Wu Yan is ultimately limited by the method through which he jumped out of the cage—through gradual bloodline excavation rather than comprehension.
characters.history:
Wu Yan emerged in a remote, resource-poor region of the Infinite Hunyuan Space governed by the Cultivator Camp. Like most cultivators in the Dark World Group, he advanced by refining and strengthening his Hunyuan Bloodline over a long period. Eventually, he reached the Perfect Stage High-level Hunyuan Chaotic Origin Lifeform.

Unlike Tian Lang Ke, who achieved his breakthrough by comprehending over 70% of his bloodline, Wu Yan’s cultivation relied on brute-force excavation. Later, he attempted to go further by refining a second bloodline—a world-class Hunyuan Bloodline—but this added conflicting memories and willpower into his body. As a result, his chances of ever reaching the World-Class are considered extremely slim.

After Luo Feng’s battle footage with a Hunyuan prisoner spread, Wu Yan, like most Dark World Group cultivators, became an early and enthusiastic supporter. He was among the 12,882 out of 12,883 living High-level Hunyuan Lifeforms in the Dark World Group to personally came to see to Luo Feng, showing deep respect for his potential.

He is familiar with Yuan, indicating past interactions when the Cultivator Faction and Ice Peak Faction were closer allies. During the conflict over the 100+ world clusters seized by his faction, Wugu Ancestor was present at the high council meeting, supporting Ice Peak Ancestor’s attempt to negotiate peace by offering to return half the clusters, showing his role as a mediator within the faction’s chaotic structure.

characters.history:
Xi Mo was one of the first life forms that Luo Feng created; his race was combined with Remote Ocean, so he was technically his son! More than 10 billion eras after the Sector Beast crisis was resolved, he became the first True God born from the Remote Ocean line.

Due to the power struggles within the Human Race after it gained hegemonic status within the Original Universe, he informed Luo Feng that the Earthlings and Remote Ocean line did not have a big enough say in the high-level meetings within the Human Race. To rectify this, after becoming a True God, he gathered many Universe Masters under him, and with Luo Feng's permission, established the Milky Way Kingdom.

He served as the de facto leader of the Milky Way Kingdom, as Luo Feng dealt with even higher-level issues and had too high of a status. Xi Mo informed Luo Feng of the breakthroughs made by Universe Masters and those reaching the limit of Universe Venerable.

After Na Ke broke through to Immortal King and was officially admitted as Luo Feng's disciple, Xi Mo handled the majority of Na Ke's cultivation. Following Luo Feng's orders, he also observed the Original Universe and informed him when the end of the Original Universe was imminent. Alongside Morosa, for 360,000 eras he made sure that no one interrupted Luo Feng's cultivation, and he noticed that Na Ke broke through to Universe Master. When Luo Feng awoke from his cultivation, he ordered Xi Mo to inform everyone that he had finished, so he could meet them.

He was awestruck at the size of Luo Feng's Holy Land Universe of 100 billion light-years.

Xin Yu is a powerful and talented Eternal True God from the Chaos States surrounding Luo Feng's territory. After joining the Blade River Sect and showcasing his talents, he was made Luo Feng's second personal disciple.

Born in a weak tribe, he was able to cultivate an Infinite Divine Body and has almost finished taking the Law Route to breakthrough to Primal Chaos Sovereign.

Shortly after his introduction, Xin Yu broke through to Primal Chaos Sovereign, and received a congratulations gift from Luo Feng. This gift comprised a complete set of Primal Chaos Sovereign Ultimate realm weapons and secret treasures (valued at around 20-30 billion Universe Sands), 10 billion Universe Sands, and 10 treasures to assist in cultivation.

About 200 periods after his breakthrough, he has reached Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign level in two of the Major Branches of the Great Dao of the Destruction Origin.

characters.title: Xiusaiwei
characters.introText: Xiusaiwei is one of the twelve Eternal beings within the Ice Peak Faction, a faction composed of powerful and immortal entities. Despite being part of this elite group, Xiusaiwei displays an independent and resolute mindset. He outright refuses to participate in the looming war against the Cultivator Camp, stating that he has not occupied any world clusters within the Cultivator’s Territory, nor has he taken any resources. For him, war is unnecessary, and his stance is clear and unwavering: “I will absolutely not participate.”
characters.appearance: A massive figure with a yellow, rock-like body.
characters.history:
Xiusaiwei is one of the twelve Eternal beings within the Ice Peak Faction, a faction composed of powerful and immortal entities. Despite being part of this elite group, Xiusaiwei displays an independent and resolute mindset. He outright refuses to participate in the looming war against the Cultivator Camp, stating that he has not occupied any world clusters within the Cultivator’s Territory, nor has he taken any resources. For him, war is unnecessary, and his stance is clear and unwavering: “I will absolutely not participate.”

His refusal provokes outrage from other members of the Ice Peak Faction, particularly the Three Emperors of Wind, Thunder, and Sea, who emphasize that all twelve beings must act as a unified front. However, Xiusaiwei is unbothered by their protests, openly challenging them by asking, “What can you do to me if I don’t fight?” His words reveal not only his strength but also his autonomy he acts according to his own will, not peer pressure.

Xiusaiwei’s attitude reflects a deep strategic understanding. Unlike other more aggressive members of the Ice Peak Faction, he recognizes that the Cultivator’s Camp is no longer weak. He cautions against underestimating them, especially since Cultivator Camp are capable of battling even the powerful Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction. His refusal to join the conflict seems not only principled but also wise, hinting that Xiusaiwei values long-term survival.

He and Pu Zhi both share deep friendships with Practitioner Faction for his ascension to immortality status was even linked to Yuan's influence, a debt that forged an extraordinary bond between them!

characters.introText: Xue Ying is the protagonist of the novel Lord Xue Ying.
characters.appearance: Xue Ying is the protagonist of the novel Lord Xue Ying.
characters.personality:
He is very protective of his loved ones whereas very ruthless towards his enemies. His will power and determination is very strong and likes mostly to stay low-key.

Xue Ying appears reserved, also gives the impression of a mountain, sturdy and hard to shake.

He cares a lot about his family, especially his smaller brother Dong Bo Qing Shi. During the period when their parents were absent, both brothers only had each other to lean-to. Also, to protect his family is the main reason Xue Ying starves for power.

He is also very cool minded while facing any situation, no matter how complicated the situation he thinks his way through. His calmness came from the time when he had to train continuously in his younger years.

Xue Ying isn't hot-blooded and won't easily get angered or provoked unless the situation is related to his loved ones. He also isn't arrogant just because he is stronger than others.

Xue Ying doesn't cultivate to be the strongest but to achieve perfection on his spear techniques. Ever since he was young, he had only pursued perfection, not strength.
characters.history:
Dong Bo Xue Ying was born in Water Rites Town's Snow Eagle Territory. His father, Dong Bo Lie, was a commoner who bought the Snow Eagle Territory to become a baron. His mother, Mo Yang Yu, was a noble who had fled from her family due to certain circumstances.

At first, Xue Ying and the small family was very happy and peaceful, but peace cannot last forever. Xue Ying’s peaceful life was shattered, for the sake of protecting his loved ones and to reclaim the happiness that he longed for, he started his journey of strength. He married Yu Jing Qiu after getting poisoned with the Six Ghosts Poison. She conceived their first child after he got rid of the poison with a technique from Crimson Rock Mountain

Yan Hai is a mentor figure to Li Yao. He is the 7th strongest warrior on Earth. Since Jia Yi defeated him and Yan Hai is stated to be the most qualified candidate for the Fifth Elder position, it can be inferred that he has similar strength to Jia Yi and Atkin.

During the era of the Great Nirvana, he alongside Li Yao and others as his henchmen bullied others. He was later banished from Hanxia by Jia Yi. He was sent to Europa and never dared to enter Hanxia in decades. He's now a highly esteemed figure in the HR Alliance, the 3rd strongest member after East and Atkin.

When Luo Feng was looking for voluntary sacrifices for the technique Six Blade Edges in order to defeat the Golden Horned Beast, Yan Hai replied to his email with "How certain are you?". This could indicate his willingness to sacrifice himself to save the Earth.

After the Golden Horned Beast incident, he broke through to Planetary Level 3 and was briefly the 2nd strongest fighter in the world as  Hong and Lei Shen were in a coma, Mo Henderson, East and Jia Yi were deceased and Luo Feng was presumed dead. Yan Hai was eventually killed by a Planetary Level 6 Luo Feng after he possessed the Golden Horned Beast Body and made a clone of his human body.

infobox.Aliases: Flame Evolution Ancestor Flame Origin Ancestor
infobox.affiliation: Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction Eternal Land

characters.introText: Yan Huo Ancestor is one of the Nine Sovereigns of the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction and one of the four Primogenitors from that faction who hold a seat in the Eternal Land. He ranks among the top combatants in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. His combat strength is slightly below Infinite Serpent Ancestor, but still enough to dominate most other Primogenitors. He is particularly skilled in fire-based abilities, and is known for his terrifying binding and containment powers. During the battle against the Cultivator Camp, he joined forces with Infinite Serpent Ancestor and Nirvana Ancestor to restrain Wulan - one of the physically strongest Lords. Although Wu Lan had once escaped after being devoured and trapped for a breath of time by the Yan Huo Ancestor alone, this time, the three of them worked together and successfully held him down during the war, showing Yan Huo Ancestor’s high tactical value in group combat.
characters.history:
In the distant past, long before any factional divisions, Yan Huo Ancestor maintained friendships with fellow Primogenitors/Ancestors like The Original Ancestor and Sha Zhou, suggesting he has existed since the earliest days of the Chaotic Origin era. He was also part of an expedition with The Original Ancestor and others to explore the Hell Fire Prison Wall, one of the most mysterious and dangerous land in all of Chaotic Origin Dimension.

During that expedition, Yan Huo Ancestor, together with The First Ancestor and several other Ancestors, crossed the entire Hell Fire Prison Wall. They encountered twelve distinct peak-level fire powers, yet were unable to sense, let alone refine, the Wall's Origin. Based on their conclusions, refining the Hell Fire Prison Wall would require mastering at least half of those twelve peak-level fire powers, a feat no lifeform in the Infinite Chaotic Origin Dimension has ever achieved. As one of the Nine Emperors and an Ancestor specializing in flames, Yan Huo Ancestor has long coveted the Hell Fire Prison Wall, believing that mastering it could elevate him to the strongest being in the Infinite Chaotic Origin Dimension.

characters.history:
Yan Yu is a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign who Lord Jiu Jiang approached for assistance in his future battle with Lord Liu Yin. He has incredible formation skills, and in Jiu Jiang's opinion, only a handful of Chaos Sovereigns could compare with him in that aspect.

Early in his life he was accepted as the direct disciple of one of the Emperors of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. At that time, he was full of life and thought that he would break through to God King in the future, but as time passed, he became less and less noticeable, having hit a bottleneck in his cultivation. He chose to leave the ancient kingdom, build a city on a remote lake in the Yu Kingdom, and live alone.

When Jiu Jiang asked for his assistance, he declined, unsure if he could defeat Liu Yin in a direct confrontation, and concerned with the loss of face that would result from Liu Yin not standing down at his request. When Jiu Jiang challenged him to fight Liu Yin to hone himself and become stronger, he forcefully sent Jiu Jiang back to Jiu Jiang Chaos State and returned to his work, engraving the model of the city in which he lived.

He hopes to complete engraving that model, which will be when he breaks through to God King.

One of Hong's three bodyguards. Called the one with the greatest might worldwide. Uses as whip as a weapon. She is a notch better than the five Inspectors of the Extreme Martial Club. She is a mixed blood of Chinese and European ancestry.

She led Luo Feng's group to the No. 9 Ruin of Ancient Civilization, and was ordered, along with Vladimir, to assist Luo Feng in killing Li Yao when he broke through to Planetary Level.

In the novel, she is the first to respond to Luo Feng's call for 5 Planetary Level sacrifices to fight against the Golden Horned Beast.

She was seen bidding farewell to Hong after Hong decided to begin his training journey with Luo .

Her Epithet means Enchanting

characters.title: Yi Feng
characters.introText: A handsome, purple-haired, small and skinny young man. His eyes are very pure and filled with joy.
characters.appearance: A handsome, purple-haired, small and skinny young man. His eyes are very pure and filled with joy.
characters.history:
Yi Feng is a Stellar Level genius, born in the Gu Lun Universe Country Imperial Family. He participated in the same Pinnacle Genius Battle as Luo Feng and was one of the final four of the Training Space Elimination Stage, along with Luo Feng, Bolan, and Kandita. Despite his appearance, he is actually a powerful Warrior who uses incredible sword skills.

While he was born into the imperial family, due to the large number of members, he still had to rely on himself. In his early years, he had mental problems that resulted in him having an unresponsive lower body, so he sat in a wheelchair. Rather than feeling sorry for himself, he strove to train as hard as he could in hopes of his body eventually curing itself. Eventually, his sword skills gained him recognition within the imperial family, and he was sent to an Immortal who personally helped him, enabling him to use the lower half of his body.

With the joy he gained from finally being able to run, his movement and sword skilled led to him stepping through the gateways of two Original Laws. His position rose greatly within the imperial family, and he became known as the Sword of Life from his incredible sword skills and burning passion for life.

During the Pinnacle Genius Battle, he eventually made it to the 6th level of the 5th tower, finally ranking 17th after Luo Feng was eliminated. Later, he was selected as one of the final 20 participants, losing in that round and becoming a Heaven and Earth Secret Realm member.

His death helped Luo Feng to focus before attempting the Fantasy Ocean.

They massacred humans and stepped on them for fun, they didn’t even treat them as lives. High and mighty, they treated other humans as ants, almost like they were from another Race. After Luo Feng sentenced him to death, he tried to attack Luo Feng even though he was chained.
