characters.title: Yin Tuo
characters.introText: A fiery-red figure that looks like a human child. He has sparse, messy, fiery-red hair and one eye.
characters.appearance: A fiery-red figure that looks like a human child. He has sparse, messy, fiery-red hair and one eye.
characters.history:
Yin Tuo is a great being from the First Reincarnation Era's Ancestral God Sect, a Special Lifeform who looks like a child. He follows the path of the Golden Beast God, and is proficient in both close-range combat and Spirit Weapons, similar to Luo Feng. The primary spirit weapon he uses is the Pinnacle Arcana armor Golden Sulfone Armor. He is a Level 4 Universe Master, rivaling Ice Mountain Master and Void Gold Master, and with his unique Divine Body, it was almost impossible to kill him. He is considered more difficult to deal with than An Yong Master.

When Luo Feng was exploring the God-Destroying Mountain Stream, while using Golden Country to sense his surroundings, he discovered Yin Tuo. Yin Tuo had noticed Luo Feng within the area and sought to obtain his Shi Wu Wings, which the great beings in Universe Ocean knew was a powerful Arcana. When Luo Feng refused to surrender the Arcana, the two began to battle, with Yin Tuo using his Golden Sulfone Armor to create a 100,000 kilometer long Golden Beast God and attacking Luo Feng, who used the Shi Wu Wings to defend.

As the two continued their battle, traversing the dangerous region, Luo Feng determined that it was better for him to escape than to use his full strength to attempt to kill Yin Tuo. Using the combination of Flame Sand Cup and Golden Country, he attempted to force Yin Tuo to give up, but he continued to chase. During the chase, a magma whirlpool appeared, but since both were aware of the dangers, neither fell into its center, the Annihilation Whirlwind. Shortly after revealing his knowledge of the Annihilation Whirlwind, an Arcana appeared from the rocky ground, and since it could survive the dangerous region, they each knew it had to be at least a Top Arcana, so they both attempted to retrieve it.

As Luo Feng obtained the Arcana through his use of Golden Country, two great beings of the Divine Eye Race arrived seeking the Arcana: Ultimate Arrow Master and Five Chaos Master. The two taunted Yin Tuo for his failure to obtain the unknown Arcana, to which Yin Tuo responded that if they tried, they would also fail. Thinking that they held the upper hand and that Luo Feng would not choose to fight them, they dismissively advised Luo Feng to give up the unknown Arcana and the Shi Wu Wings to avoid being killed in battle. Unfortunately for those involved, Luo Feng refused to surrender, kicking off their battle. Out of curiosity, Yin Tuo remained in the area, wanting to see the outcome of the battle, but unfortunately for him, this meant he was caught up in what came next: the emergence of the Lava Devil God.

As the Lava Devil God emerged from the Magma Sea, Yin Tuo, Five Chaos Master, and Ultimate Arrow Master all sought to escape, but Luo Feng used the combination of Golden Country, I Am the Universe, and Flame Sand Cup to trap everyone in the area, repeatedly cancelling out Five Chaos Master's attempts to escape. As the two sides clashed, Yin Tuo pleaded with Luo Feng to allow him to escape, but Luo Feng was unreceptive. Lamenting that he didn't escape when he could, Yin Tuo could only either offer his Golden Sulfone Armor to Luo Feng to escape, or face the Lava Devil God. Unfortunately, the choice was taken from him as the Lava Devil God arrived.

Yin Tuo was the closest to the Lava Devil God, so he had to immediately defend himself, which he did by using the Golden Sulfone Armor, enlarging his Golden Beast God form to almost 1 billion kilometers in length. To his dismay, the Lava Devil God's power was truly incredible, a single attack was able to damage his armor, with fragments of its body flying in all directions. Detecting that Yin Tuo was still alive, it stomped the ground and annihilated 90% of Yin Tuo's body.

Realizing that he could have been killed if he left his Golden Sulfone Armor intact and attempted to take on the Lava Devil God's attack, Yin Tuo made the decision to dismantle his armor, and allow his Divine Body to take the attack. This resulted in him only having 11.2% of his Divine Body remaining and his armor only being able to wield 10% of its power. This infuriated Yin Tuo, who decided to enact vengeance on both Five Chaos Master, who couldn't kill Luo Feng, and Luo Feng, who decided to prevent them all from escaping. Yin Tuo spread the news that the Shi Wu Wings were possibly a Pinnacle Arcana as valuable as the Extermination Godly Armor, and shared that Five Chaos Master and Ultimate Arrow Master might die in the encounter.

The news he brought eventually spread throughout Purple Moon Holy Land, East Emperor Holy Land, and the 3 Reincarnation Eras, shocking everyone who heard it.

characters.title: Yin Zhe
characters.introText: Yin Zhe is an enigmatic figure in the Eternal Land. He is the only being in the Chaotic Origin Dimension whose true body cannot be found by anyone, making him uniquely elusive. His strength is unknown, adding to his mysterious reputation. As one of the five unaffiliated existences, Yin Zhe thrives without joining any faction, observing events like the potential war between the Cultivator Camp and Ice Peak Faction from the sidelines.
characters.history: Yin Zhe is an enigmatic figure in the Eternal Land. He is the only being in the Chaotic Origin Dimension whose true body cannot be found by anyone, making him uniquely elusive. His strength is unknown, adding to his mysterious reputation. As one of the five unaffiliated existences, Yin Zhe thrives without joining any faction, observing events like the potential war between the Cultivator Camp and Ice Peak Faction from the sidelines.
characters.trivia:
Despite possessing unparalleled future sight, even Lord Xing Mang—who can observe the best possible outcomes, the future and alternative timelines across the entire Chaotic Origin Dimension—cannot see Yin Zhes future.This inability is not necessarily due to Yin Zhe being stronger than Xing Mang; rather, it suggests that Yin Zhe is either exceptionally adept at concealing his fate or is protected by an even higher-tier force. This phenomenon is rare, shared only with a few beings such as Luo Feng, whose future became completely hidden after coming into contact with the core power of the Abyss of Destruction.

The fact that even top-tier foresight users like Xing Mang cannot observe Yin Zhe’s timeline underscores the Hermit’s mysteriousness.

characters.title: Ying Cang
characters.introText: Ying Cang acted wantonly, killing the weak if they angered him, and traveling from city to city to complete assassination missions.
characters.appearance: A gray-robed figure.
characters.personality: Ying Cang acted wantonly, killing the weak if they angered him, and traveling from city to city to complete assassination missions.
characters.history:
Ying Cang was an extremely powerful Eternal True God who frequently took assassination missions. Since he followed the Bloodline Cultivation Method, he sought resources to help him break through to Primal Chaos Sovereign. In the past, he killed the child of a Primal Chaos Sovereign from the Food Kingdom, but successfully escaped the team sent to hunt him down, increasing his reputation.

He took on the mission to assassinate Luo Feng after Luo Feng killed Mu Yang, hoping to acquire his Mechanical Treasures. He was aware of the Chaotic Golden Wings, recognizing them in the image of Luo Feng in his battle with Mu Yang. When he arrived in Hu Yang City, he killed a group of young members from wealthy families who were flying without concern for their surroundings.

He was swallowed and killed by Morosa when attempting to escape after his failed assassination attempt on Luo Feng. The treasures and money on his body were worth about 3.5 million Universe Sands, and he had 829,200 Universe Sands in his Dark Hall account.

characters.title: Yinjiu City Guardian
characters.introText: Yinjiu City Guardian is a Primal Chaos Sovereign Guest Official of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. As such, he is a core member of one of the Imperial Families. He has been tasked with guarding the border city, Yinjiu City. He has two sons; while his eldest son is a disciple of a God King, his youngest son, General Yu, is kept by his side in the city. The city guardian paid a considerable price to obtain a Primal Chaos Realm Alien Beast, Uncle Han, who has been enslaved and serves as his son's mount and protector.

characters.title: Yong Hu
characters.introText: Yong Hu is an extremely powerful Eternal True God who commands an army in the ancient capital of the Yu Kingdom. A disciple of Yu Shui Kingdom Master, he is much stronger than Moli Xiao, and was sent to assist Hu Yang City in their opposition to the Food Kingdom forces in the city. If not for the conflict with the Food Kingdom, he would like to test his strength against Luo Feng.
characters.appearance: A one-horned man.
characters.history:
Yong Hu is an extremely powerful Eternal True God who commands an army in the ancient capital of the Yu Kingdom. A disciple of Yu Shui Kingdom Master, he is much stronger than Moli Xiao, and was sent to assist Hu Yang City in their opposition to the Food Kingdom forces in the city. If not for the conflict with the Food Kingdom, he would like to test his strength against Luo Feng.

During the battle between the forces of Hu Yang City and the Food Kingdom, Yong Hu clashed with Blood Cloud, but was only able to suppress him with the use of the Hu Yang City Formation. Blood Cloud then essentially took the residents of the city hostage, forcing Yong Hu to allow him to escape. While Yong Hu was initially quite confident upon his arrival in Hu Yang City, after clashing with Blood Cloud and then learning of his defeat at the hands of Luo Feng, he was more restrained, and tried to befriend Luo Feng.

Later, he returned to Hu Yang City alongside his junior brother Yue Wu to serve in Lord Jiu Jiang's army against the Heart Shadow Sect. When Yong Hu, Yue Wu, Morosa, and Luo Feng joined forces to battle the Heart Shadow Sect, Yong Hu was relied on to entangle some tough opponents, and it cost Lord Jiu Jiang 20 million Universe Sands to hire him!

characters.introText: A graceful and fair woman of the Purple Moon Race. She had three faces (a demonic face, a holy face, and a misty face), eight arms, and wore a close-fitting black battle suit.
characters.appearance: A graceful and fair woman of the Purple Moon Race. She had three faces (a demonic face, a holy face, and a misty face), eight arms, and wore a close-fitting black battle suit.
characters.history:
You Ya Master was a Universe Master Level 4 of the Purple Moon Race, one of their 3rd-highest quality bloodline. After hearing about the power of the Shi Wu Wings, she joined Pan Ke Master and Feng Long Master in attempting to obtain them from Luo Feng. She was the first of the three to begin attacking him. Despite the three of them working together, they could not suppress Luo Feng, due to the power of Golden Country.

Five Chaos Master arrived during the chase, further pressuring Luo Feng, forcing him to resort to flee into the Twelve Abysses. The three Universe Masters of the Purple Moon Race then gave up their pursuit.

Like the other members of the Purple Moon Race (other than Purple Moon Ancestor), she died when Morosa devoured the origin of Purple Moon Ancestor's Miniature Universe.

characters.title: You Yan Ta
characters.introText: A skinny man dressed in blood-red armor, carrying two dark red blades.
characters.appearance: A skinny man dressed in blood-red armor, carrying two dark red blades.
characters.history:
You Yan Ta was a powerful Stellar Level 9 warrior of the You Family. Nicknamed 'Dripping Blood Blade,' he was one of their 3 strongest warriors, and guarded You Fang in the group's mission outside of Swallow Mound City. When their group encountered Na Ke's group, his presence alone made Lei Dong fear that their group would be decimated. Fortunately, before Yan Ta could attack, Luo Feng scared their group off with his Consciousness pressure.

While the group retreated to rejoin their larger group, Yan Ta noted that the warrior who scared them off must be at least a Domain Master, and he reported this thought to his boss. About 800km outside of the city, You Yan Ta and their group were stopped by the Thirteen Axes, who sought the Genetic Armor they acquired in the Ancient God Ruins. Remembering the Domain Master who scared off Yan Ta's team, his boss ordered him to flee to Na Ke's group in hopes of assistance. Unfortunately, the group was hunted and killed, with Yan Ta being killed by Thirteen Axes Leader in front of Na Ke's team.

characters.title: Young Ancestral God
characters.introText: Looking nothing older than a youth, he has delicate features and a red-scaled tail. He wears red armor and a white cape, and speaks with a clear voice. He is the most handsome of the Ancestral Gods.
characters.appearance: Looking nothing older than a youth, he has delicate features and a red-scaled tail. He wears red armor and a white cape, and speaks with a clear voice. He is the most handsome of the Ancestral Gods.
characters.history:
Young Ancestral God is the non-canon name given to the Ancestral God who appears the youngest. He is one of the 3 Ancestral Gods, along with Old Ancestral God and Two-Faced Ancestral God.

He is highly gifted, which is why he was selected as one of the Ancestral Gods, and as one of the Ancestral Gods, he was favored by the Origin Will, allowed to wield True God-level power while within the Original Universe, despite being a Universe Master. As an Ancestral God, he may live in the Ancestral God Palace within the Five-Color Aurora Lake. He joined the other Ancestral Gods in fighting alongside the Human Race during the Human Race Survival War.

As the body of the Jin God King appeared in Universe Ocean, the Origin Will of the Original Universe contacted the Ancestral Gods, informing them of the arrival of the 4th Most Dangerous Land and giving them an order to leave the Original Universe and enter Universe Ocean for the first time.

Many powerful beings lost a body when trying to enter the body of the Jin God King, including Luo Feng. No one in Universe Ocean was able to enter the World of Jin within the body; there was a 100% death rate! When the powers of Universe Ocean began to feel there was no way to enter, they received news that the Ancestral Gods were summoning the great powers of Universe Ocean and would pass on a message from the Origin Will. Glowing with power stronger than any True God, Young Ancestral God and the other Ancestral Gods passed on information on the World of Jin, including how to enter it, what it contained, what could be gained from entering it, and its level of danger.

In the third era after great beings began entering the World of Jin, the Origin Will of the Original Universe contacted the Ancestral Gods, informing them of the appearance of the Sector Beasts. Young Ancestral God explained the purpose of the Sector Beasts, and shared their name with the great beings of Universe Ocean. He also explained their periods of incubation and growth, detailing their growth process, and their location. Through the Origin Will, the Ancestral Gods also explained the benefits from killing the Sector Beasts. After impressing upon the powers of Universe Ocean the danger of the Sector Beasts and the importance of killing them all, the Ancestral Gods flew away.

Despite the Ancestral Gods telling the powers of Universe Ocean that only True Gods could fight the Sector Beasts, Young Ancestral God informed Luo Feng that he was the exception, due to being the strongest being in Universe Ocean. He also enticed Luo Feng and Primal Chaos City Leader by stating that if they made enough contributions, it was even possible to have the Origin Will release Ancestor Yuan. After providing this information, he told Luo Feng and Primal Chaos City Leader that they can always come to the Ancestral God Secret Region and ask the Ancestral Gods to contact the Original Will to provide additional clarity.

After Luo Feng failed to prevent Morosa from escaping in their first encounter, Young Ancestral God discussed with Froth Flower True God the difficulty of killing a Sector Beast. After receiving another message from the Origin Will, he scoffed when talking about the True Gods who were considering siding with the Sector Beasts, and was concerned that it was taking too long for Luo Feng to break through to True God. When the remaining Sector Beasts began to move into Universe Ocean, he told Luo Feng and Primal Chaos City Leader that the Origin Will would stop suppressing the Willpower of Ancestor Yuan, allowing him to defend his Miniature Universe, but added that there was no way Ancestor Yuan would be released before the Sector Beast threat was eliminated.

After Luo Feng defeated Mo He, thus ending the Sector Beast War, Young Ancestral God informed Luo Feng and Primal Chaos City Leader that the Origin Will was in the process of releasing Ancestor Yuan, noting that he should soon appear in Ancestral God Palace. After the release of Ancestor Yuan, he noted that both Luo Feng and Ancestor Yuan could easily become Void True Gods, meaning there would be two more Holy Lands in Universe Ocean.

He and the other Ancestral Gods waited in Ancestral God Palace for the arrival of Luo Feng at the end of the current Reincarnation Era, and left after he arrived.

characters.title: Youzan Master
characters.introText: Youzan Master was a Universe Master from the East Emperor Holy Land Universe who took part in the Duan Dong River Inheritance Test. Youzan solved 1,200 Rhinoceros Emperor Game puzzles relatively quickly, but did not meet the requirements of the first bottleneck, which informed East Emperor Ancestor that there were different requirements for different cultivation realms.
characters.history:
Youzan Master was a Universe Master from the East Emperor Holy Land Universe who took part in the Duan Dong River Inheritance Test. Youzan solved 1,200 Rhinoceros Emperor Game puzzles relatively quickly, but did not meet the requirements of the first bottleneck, which informed East Emperor Ancestor that there were different requirements for different cultivation realms.

Youzan was the sixth to break through the second bottleneck, and was thus one of the final 299 candidates, but died when Luo Feng successfully became the heir of Duan Dong River.

characters.title: Yu Feng
characters.introText: A man dressed in a black robe, with only his incredibly calm eyes visible.
characters.appearance: A man dressed in a black robe, with only his incredibly calm eyes visible.
characters.personality: Yu Feng is naturally taciturn and a loner, similar to other Chemists. He was fooled into thinking that Mo Luo was a good person, and was surprised when Luo Feng attacked him. He is extremely hard-working and constantly looks forward rather than showing regret.
characters.history:
Yu Feng is one of the 5 strongest of the Universe Level seniors of the Absolute Beginning Secret Realm, along with Ke Luo Fu, Ni Nan, Ge, and Sa Jin. He is considered the second-strongest, only behind Ke Luo Fu. He passed the 7th level of the Tong Tian Bridge at least 300 years ago, as Ge passed it latest and he passed it over 300 years prior.

As a Chemist, he primarily fights using drug concoctions, but as he is also a Spirit Master, using a Spirit Weapon to fly and another to form a net to trap his opponents. He is limited in the competitions in the Virtual Universe holds, since he needed specific materials to create the drugs he needed.

Prior to Ke Luo Fu's ascent after discovering the huge secret of his Dangerous mission, he and Yu Feng were on a similar level. Ke Luo Fu was the only one of the 4 other seniors that he was concerned with beating, and even Ke Luo Fu felt that Yu Feng gave him the most trouble.

During Luo Feng's Universe Level Qualification Battle, he first lost to Luo Feng and Ke Luo Fu, then lost to Mo Luo, Luo Feng, and Ke Luo Fu in the final elimination battles, but defeated Long Yun and Bolan.
characters.trivia: While Yu Feng is not shown on screen, his name is shown when the Secret Realm Qualification Battle resumes.

characters.title: Yu Fu God King

infobox.affiliation_rank: Second in command of the Life Mother River

characters.introText: Yu Fu God King is one of the foremost figures within the Life Mother River, renowned as the second most powerful existence in the faction, surpassed only by the Owner of Mother River (God-King Zong Fu). In terms of direct combat ability, Yu Fu God King is considered equal to the Owner of Mother River, though the latter’s methods are described as more profound and unfathomable. His strength and status make him one of the central pillars of the Life Mother River’s power structure, forming the faction’s core leadership together with Zong Fu.
characters.appearance:
Yu Fu God King is one of the foremost figures within the Life Mother River, renowned as the second most powerful existence in the faction, surpassed only by the Owner of Mother River (God-King Zong Fu). In terms of direct combat ability, Yu Fu God King is considered equal to the Owner of Mother River, though the latter’s methods are described as more profound and unfathomable. His strength and status make him one of the central pillars of the Life Mother River’s power structure, forming the faction’s core leadership together with Zong Fu.

Within the hierarchy of the Continent of Origin, Yu Fu God King commands great influence and respect. When Luo Feng opposed the Life Mother River’s mass recruitment of Eternal True Gods across his twenty Chaos States, it was Yu Fu God King who stepped forward, declaring his intent to personally test Luo Feng’s resilience and strength. His decision to act underscored both his confidence in his unparalleled strength and the seriousness with which the Life Mother River regarded Luo Feng’s rising threat.

Despite the protests of other God Kings, who wished to handle the matter themselves, Yu Fu’s stature allowed him to act independently. His relationship with Zong Fu is also notable: the two are lifelong allies and close friends, having risen together step by step to their current prominence. This bond cements their joint dominance over the Life Mother River and explains why Yu Fu God King is trusted to represent its authority in matters of conflict.

In essence, Yu Fu God King embodies the martial might of the Life Mother River an entity whose power is acknowledged even by the Two Great Ancient Kingdoms. His readiness to confront Luo Feng reflects his decisive nature and his role as a guardian of the faction’s prestige.

characters.title: Yu Jiu Fang
characters.introText: Yu Jiu Fang is a Top Primal Chaos Sovereign who specializes in cooking. A Guest Official of the Emperor Chu Family, he is the best chef in Chu Capital City. Due to his skill, he has high standards and is often invited by God Kings to cook at their gatherings; he might even turn down First-Class Lords!
characters.history:
Yu Jiu Fang is a Top Primal Chaos Sovereign who specializes in cooking. A Guest Official of the Emperor Chu Family, he is the best chef in Chu Capital City. Due to his skill, he has high standards and is often invited by God Kings to cook at their gatherings; he might even turn down First-Class Lords!

He was personally invited by Lord Chu Feng to cook at Mansion Master Yuan Xiu's banquet to entertain Luo Feng. While he is arrogant toward some Lords from the Imperial Family, he was very humble in front of the Transcendent Chaos Realms Luo Feng and Mansion Master Yuan Xiu. Luo Feng (along with Morosa, Ancestor Yuan, and Moyu Qingyan) continued to patronize his restaurant during his time in Chu Capital City.

characters.title: Yu Ke
characters.introText: Yu Ke is a World Master from Blood River World, working for the Immortal Temple. He is given the task of bringing 20 Blood River Medals to Ba Qi at his request. On the way to complete this task, he meets with Ku Yan and brings him along to meet Ba Qi.
characters.appearance: A white-clothed man.
characters.history:
Yu Ke is a World Master from Blood River World, working for the Immortal Temple. He is given the task of bringing 20 Blood River Medals to Ba Qi at his request. On the way to complete this task, he meets with Ku Yan and brings him along to meet Ba Qi.

After handing the 20 medals over to Ba Qi, Ku Yan shows everyone present the Beast God Statue that he found in the river, which causes Luo Feng to desire it. To satisfy his desire, Luo Feng uses the Star Annihilator Cannon on his Earth Automaton Ship to kill Yu Ke, Ku Yan, and the other envoys, and retrieves the undamaged statue.

characters.title: Yu Ke Nuolanshan
characters.introText: He's an imposing and strong-looking man with the pointed ears and red eyes characteristic of the Nuolan Shan clan.
characters.appearance: He's an imposing and strong-looking man with the pointed ears and red eyes characteristic of the Nuolan Shan clan.
characters.personality:
Yu Ke Nuolanshan is the current Head Patriarch of the Nuolan Shan family and Pula's grandfather. He is brash and a hothead, showing off his power more than the previous generation of heads. He aggressively pushed for Pula to collect Earth's data and apply to buy it from the Black Dragon Mountain Empire. When he learned of Luo Feng's preparations to defend the Earthlings, he ordered Pula to work faster to buy Earth, obtain Hu Yan Bo's treasures, find a way to control the Earthlings, and begin taming and communicating with the beasts on Earth (to aid in locating the treasures). He was incredibly excited to learn of the Earth Automaton Ship and the Golden Horned Beast that hatched on Earth, and incredibly angry when Luo Feng announced his ownership of Earth and showed the proof. In the end, he gave in to De Wen's order for the family to retreat from Earth.

Later, he and De Wen where there to hear Nuolan Shan's orders to leave a small team on Earth to find the Golden Horned Beast's body and avoid the sleeping bug clan nest.

characters.title: Yu Ke Qi
characters.introText: Yu Ke Qi was the highest-ranked counselor who advised Chun Yu Chong. As such, he had an extremely high position in the Chun Yu Family. Luo Feng used a hypnotizing soul technique to force him to facilitate a meeting between he and Chun Yu Chong. When the pair arrived at Chong's palace, the guards attempted to turn them aside, but under Luo Feng's control, he ordered them to let them in. Chun Yu Chong, who had been with a woman, exited the palace with over 300 guards, but Luo Feng forced them to kill themselves, leaving Yu Ke Qi standing stupidly.
characters.appearance: A pale, skinny man in a white robe.
characters.history:
Yu Ke Qi was the highest-ranked counselor who advised Chun Yu Chong. As such, he had an extremely high position in the Chun Yu Family. Luo Feng used a hypnotizing soul technique to force him to facilitate a meeting between he and Chun Yu Chong. When the pair arrived at Chong's palace, the guards attempted to turn them aside, but under Luo Feng's control, he ordered them to let them in. Chun Yu Chong, who had been with a woman, exited the palace with over 300 guards, but Luo Feng forced them to kill themselves, leaving Yu Ke Qi standing stupidly.

When Chun Yu Tao began his investigation of the event, he learned that Yu Ke Qi brought Luo Feng to the palace, but when he looked to ask him what happened, his body exploded, presumably due to Luo Feng's hypnosis.

characters.title: Yu Lan Master
characters.introText: Yu Lan Master was a Universe Master from the Purple Moon Race, of their second-weakest bloodline. While awaiting the birth of an Arcana in Flowing Overlapping Mountains, he was captured by Luo Feng in hopes of exchanging him and other captured Universe Masters for the final component of the Chaotic Golden Wings. Yu Lan let Luo Feng know that they knew that the final set of wings was a component of an exceptional Arcana from the ancient civilization, so Purple Moon Ancestor would never give it to him.
characters.appearance: Two-faced and four-armed
characters.history:
Yu Lan Master was a Universe Master from the Purple Moon Race, of their second-weakest bloodline. While awaiting the birth of an Arcana in Flowing Overlapping Mountains, he was captured by Luo Feng in hopes of exchanging him and other captured Universe Masters for the final component of the Chaotic Golden Wings. Yu Lan let Luo Feng know that they knew that the final set of wings was a component of an exceptional Arcana from the ancient civilization, so Purple Moon Ancestor would never give it to him.

As he was captured by Luo Feng, it is unclear whether he died at Luo Feng's hands or at the hands of Morosa when it devoured the origin of Purple Moon Ancestor's Miniature Universe.

infobox.occupation: Sergeant of the Sixth Squadron of the First Battalion

characters.introText: The whole body is dark green, with eighteen hooves and claws.
characters.appearance: The whole body is dark green, with eighteen hooves and claws.

characters.title: Yu Luo (Waitress)
characters.introText: Yu Luo is one of the waitresses at Dream Flower Tower. She attends to Luo Feng when he visits the establishment, including when he attended the Hundred Flowers Banquet.
characters.appearance: A green-clothed figure.
characters.history: Yu Luo is one of the waitresses at Dream Flower Tower. She attends to Luo Feng when he visits the establishment, including when he attended the Hundred Flowers Banquet.
characters.trivia: While her cultivation realm has not yet been specified, her interactions with the musicians imply that she is at least a Void True God.

characters.title: Yu Sen
characters.introText: A skinny man wearing a white collared shirt. He is the shortest of the three Chiefs of Jiangnan City.
characters.appearance: A skinny man wearing a white collared shirt. He is the shortest of the three Chiefs of Jiangnan City.
characters.history:
Yu Sun is one of the three Chiefs of the Jiangnan City's Extreme Martial Club. He was introduced along with the other chiefs (Zhuge Tao and Wang Ke Fan) to Luo Feng when Luo Feng took up his post as Examiner of Jiangnan City.

As a Chief, he is at least Apprentice Level 6.

characters.title: Yu Shui Kingdom Master
characters.introText: Yu Shui Kingdom Master is the lead God King of the Yu Kingdom, and the only one among the five God Kings who the Primal Chaos Sovereigns of the kingdom call Yu Kingdom Master. As a Second Level God King, his strength is sufficient to prevent the Food Kingdom from starting a God King-level confrontation.
characters.appearance: A towering figure covered in hair.
characters.history:
Yu Shui Kingdom Master is the lead God King of the Yu Kingdom, and the only one among the five God Kings who the Primal Chaos Sovereigns of the kingdom call Yu Kingdom Master. As a Second Level God King, his strength is sufficient to prevent the Food Kingdom from starting a God King-level confrontation.

He keeps track of extremely talented Eternal True Gods to take on as disciples, and is the master of Yong Hu and Yue Wu. When Luo Feng showed strength superior to Yong Hu by killing Blood Cloud, Yu Shui sent his daughter, Yu Shui Tianyu, with a Xu Yan Mother Tree Leaf as a gift for him. He also had her offer Luo Feng the chance to become his disciple, which he politely refused.

Below the level of Emperor or Monarch, Yu Shui is the strongest cultivator of the water-attributed Chaotic Origin Bloodline. As a result, Tian Kun had to assemble 5 other Second Level God Kings to attempt to subdue his real body within the Heavenly River. The attack was successful in forcing him deeper into the river, but he was able to hide and avoid death. With his true body under siege, he eventually asked Luo Feng for assistance, resulting in Luo Feng's aid in exchange for 10 Chaos States and the relocation of Lord Jiu Jiang.

Yu Shui is also a Guest Official of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. The combined value of all of his weapons and secret treasures is about 100 million Merits.

characters.title: Yu Shui Tianxin
characters.introText: Yu Shui Tianxin is a Primal Chaos Sovereign, and the daughter of Yu Shui God King. Since she followed the Bloodline Cultivation Method to reach Primal Chaos Sovereign, she has no hope of reaching God King. With her status, she was responsible for managing many affairs for the Yu Kingdom, during which time she met Moyu Qingyan. The pair had many things in common and chose to have a child, Moyu Xiu, and eventually got married.
characters.appearance: A tall and beautiful woman.

characters.title: Yu Shui Tianyu
characters.introText: Yu Shui Tianyu is an Eternal True God daughter of Yu Shui Kingdom Master. She was sent by her father to meet with Luo Feng to provide him an opportunity to be his disciple. Her status is comparable to some of the top leaders of the big clans in the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom; even some Primal Chaos Sovereigns would not neglect her.
characters.appearance: An armored woman with hundreds of braids.
characters.history:
Yu Shui Tianyu is an Eternal True God daughter of Yu Shui Kingdom Master. She was sent by her father to meet with Luo Feng to provide him an opportunity to be his disciple. Her status is comparable to some of the top leaders of the big clans in the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom; even some Primal Chaos Sovereigns would not neglect her.

During her visit to Hu Yang City, she ate Black Butcher's cooking and chose to take him on as her chef. Representing her father, she gave Luo Feng a Xu Yan Mother Tree Leaf for his efforts killing Blood Cloud, Yu Tian Hu, and Yu Tian Yi. She did not force the issue when Luo Feng respectfully declined the opportunity to be her father's disciple.

Due to being an acquaintance of Luo Feng, Tianyu was chosen to accompany her father on his visit to Luo Feng.

characters.title: Yu Tian Hu
characters.introText: Yu Tian Hu was an extremely powerful Eternal True God of the Food Kingdom, the strongest of the Five Gods of Yu Tian. He and his sister Yu Tian Yi were sent by Lord Liu Yin to assist Blood Cloud in recording the complete formation diagram of Hu Yang City. The trio led the Food Kingdom's forces in abducting and interrogating 8 of the 9 Eternal True Gods responsible for the maintenance of the formation of Hu Yang City.
characters.appearance: A big and tall figure.
characters.history:
Yu Tian Hu was an extremely powerful Eternal True God of the Food Kingdom, the strongest of the Five Gods of Yu Tian. He and his sister Yu Tian Yi were sent by Lord Liu Yin to assist Blood Cloud in recording the complete formation diagram of Hu Yang City. The trio led the Food Kingdom's forces in abducting and interrogating 8 of the 9 Eternal True Gods responsible for the maintenance of the formation of Hu Yang City.

When he and his sister arrived in Hu Yang City, he challenged Blood Cloud for leadership of their small group, but was defeated. After being defeated, he complimented Blood Cloud's strength and willingly followed his plans. During the trio's attack on Hu Yang City, Yu Tian Hu fought with Moli Xiao, but was ordered by Blood Cloud to retreat after Yu Tian Yi was defeated by Luo Feng. After the battle, Lord Jiu Jiang increased his bounty to 2 million Universe Sands in hopes of enticing extremely powerful Eternal True Gods to come to the city to kill him.

Due to Blood Cloud killing Entropy Sky Flame after the latter realized the former's true identity, Luo Feng used Morosa to attempt to hunt down Blood Cloud. When that failed, the pair settled for Yu Tian Yi, who Morosa had sensed when searching for Blood Cloud. Luo Feng's arrival prompted a battle between him and the siblings, and despite the siblings' confidence, Tian Yi was easily killed. Tian Hu, on the other hand, was battered and forced to flee, splitting into 9 clones. While fleeing from Luo Feng, Yu Tian Hu finally died due to being swallowed by Morosa.

characters.title: Yu Tian Yi
characters.introText: A woman with a body condensed of ice. She naturally exuded coldness, reducing the temperature around her.
characters.appearance: A woman with a body condensed of ice. She naturally exuded coldness, reducing the temperature around her.
characters.history:
Yu Tian Yi was an extremely powerful Eternal True God of the Food Kingdom, and one of the Five Gods of Yu Tian. While powerful, she was one of the weakest two of the Five Gods. She had a bounty of 500,000 Universe Sands in the Flame Wind Guild Hall's Dark Hall.

Upon arriving in Hu Yang City, she was confident that her brother, Yu Tian Hu, would be more powerful than Blood Cloud, and was surprised that he lost in their competition. After the competition, the trio led the Food Kingdom's forces in abducting and interrogating 8 of the 9 Eternal True Gods responsible for the maintenance of the Hu Yang City Formation.

When they began their overt attack against the city, Yu Tian Yi's team of 5 attacked one of the three forbidden areas of the city, facing off against the Golden Roar Legion and two Hu Yang Guard teams. She then was the first of her group to directly face Luo Feng. The two had a short battle, during which Luo Feng countered her blade technique with his Ten-Direction Unlimited Blade technique. In response, Yu Tian Yi attempted to escape, but Luo Feng easily caught up, using the speed of the Order of Escape from All Realms, ultimately destroying her body, but learning that it was just a body condensed by her power of ice, rather than her real body.

Lord Jiu Jiang increased her bounty to 1 million Universe Sands in hopes of enticing extremely powerful Eternal True Gods to come to the city to kill her, but she ultimately met her demise at Luo Feng's hand when he sought to avenge Entropy Sky Flame.

characters.title: Yu Yang
characters.introText: Yu Yang was a God of War who lived in Jiangnan City. His arms were useless since his birth, but he relied on his two legs to gain a reputation as a 'giant axe'. His legs are as good as a giant axe.
characters.history: Yu Yang was a God of War who lived in Jiangnan City. His arms were useless since his birth, but he relied on his two legs to gain a reputation as a 'giant axe'. His legs are as good as a giant axe.

characters.title: Yu You Yi
characters.introText: Yu You Yi is an Eternal True God from a small town in the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom who moved to Chu Capital City. Despite living a very comfortable life in her hometown as one of the relatively few Eternal True Gods there, she had greater goals for her future. She hoped to obtain an inheritance that would enable her to break through to Primal Chaos Sovereign. During her time in the city, she established Qian Yu Building, carefully cultivating her strength and friendships, including with Lord Chu Le.
characters.appearance: A green-clothed woman.
characters.history:
Yu You Yi is an Eternal True God from a small town in the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom who moved to Chu Capital City. Despite living a very comfortable life in her hometown as one of the relatively few Eternal True Gods there, she had greater goals for her future. She hoped to obtain an inheritance that would enable her to break through to Primal Chaos Sovereign. During her time in the city, she established Qian Yu Building, carefully cultivating her strength and friendships, including with Lord Chu Le.

While in Chu Capital City, she successfully obtained a suitable inheritance in a short period of time, and even obtained other resources. With that inheritance and her resources, she mastered several Primal Chaos Sovereign Techniques, reaching the ultimate strength of an Eternal True God, with hope for breaking through. Despite being careful in her time in the city, she still ran afoul of General Xue Chi, and was only able to live somewhat comfortably due to her relationship with Chu Le.

Chu Le enabled her to attend Mansion Master Yuan Xiu's banquet, where she performed musical Illusion Techniques for the guests, including Luo Feng. Having learned of Yu You Yi's dilemma, he chose to patronize her (out of the 3 musical masters at Yuan Xiu's banquet), personally going to Qian Yu Building with Morosa and experiencing her music while using the Seven Emotions Heart-Refining Method.

When Di Chu Yu learned of Luo Feng's visit, he sent his subordinate to give her a token of the Lord Chu Yu Mansion, which she could use if she encountered any trouble. With the combination of the token and the news of Luo Feng's visit, Xue Chi no longer considered taking any actions against her.

characters.title: Yuan Ao Master
characters.introText: A towering figure, 1 million kilometers tall, he was like a giant sculpted out of a gigantic mountain. His head was squarish and he only had 1 large eye and a mouth. He wore gray armor covered with a layer of mercury-like liquid set in continuous motion.
characters.appearance: A towering figure, 1 million kilometers tall, he was like a giant sculpted out of a gigantic mountain. His head was squarish and he only had 1 large eye and a mouth. He wore gray armor covered with a layer of mercury-like liquid set in continuous motion.
characters.history:
Born during the first era of the Original Universe, Yuan Ao Master is a Special Lifeform Universe Master who roamed the universe alone, never joining a universe power. He ruled over the Yuan Ao Secret Region, seizing hundreds of millions of individuals from different races and making them live and cultivate there. He was worshiped as 'Yuan Ao Supreme God' within that region, and he manipulated wars between the Immortal fighters in the region, birthing dozens of Universe Venerables and thousands of Immortal Kings, Immortal Marquises, and Immortal Army Lords. At some point in the past he became the King Zhen Jia's soul slave and acquired the Divine Wood left behind by Great Thunder Star Master, making him the enemy of the Origin Will of the Original Universe.

As a result of him attaining the divine wood, he became the enemy of the Ancestral God Sect, who sent Luo Feng to investigate the region. After killing multiple soul slaves of soul slaves of Yuan Ao Master, as well as soul slaves of Yuan Ao Master, Luo Feng encountered Yuan Ao Master and they fought, with the divine wood forcing Luo Feng to retreat as he could do no real damage to him. After their battle, the Ancestral God Sect sent Nine Remoteness Master, Outstanding Difficulty Master, and Anaconda Master to assist in eliminating Yuan Ao Master. As he had used the divine wood, the True Gods who were present in the Original Universe could sense his presence, and they sent Universe Masters to eliminate him as well, hoping to receive rewards from the Origin Will.

The struggle eventually attracted a lone True God, Black Universe Creator, and all parties involved fought a tough battle, made more chaotic by Yuan Ao Master presenting a Pulling Traces Diagram and offering it in exchange for being allowed to live. Eventually, Black Universe Creator used Ice Mountain Master's Seal-type Pinnacle Arcana Bingshan Palace to attempt to seal Yuan Ao Master, forcing him to self-destruct rather than be captured. It's implied that he was forced to self-destruct by King Zhen Jia.

In the end, this conflict could be considered the first battle of the Sector Beast War, as he was the Soul Slave for one of the 3 True Gods (Great Thunder Star Master, King Zhen Jia, and Qiu Yan Ancestral God) who themselves were subordinates to the Sector Beasts. He is also considered as the reason behind the Human Race Survival War.

characters.title: Yuan Chen Country Master
characters.introText: A tall and majestic man in simple training clothes.  Looking at this man was like looking at a black hole within space, giving off a natural form of awe and respect, with a gaze that seemed to pierce through space itself. His eyes were deep and profound, as if they contained the universe space within. Considered an ancient eternal being.
characters.appearance: A tall and majestic man in simple training clothes.  Looking at this man was like looking at a black hole within space, giving off a natural form of awe and respect, with a gaze that seemed to pierce through space itself. His eyes were deep and profound, as if they contained the universe space within. Considered an ancient eternal being.
characters.history: Leader of the Yuan Chen Universe Country, he accepted Rong Jun as his disciple within Primal Chaos City after the Stellar Level Pinnacle Battles. Considered to be one of the Universe Country Masters who have lived the longest, he understood Rong Jun's ancestry and thus fought to have him as his disciple.

characters.title: Yue Wu
characters.introText: Yue Wu is the strongest Eternal True God in the Yu Kingdom (according to what power has been revealed) and a general in their military. He is a direct disciple of Yu Shui Kingdom Master, and is highly valued, given life-saving treasures and resources to aid in his cultivation. It cost Lord Jiu Jiang 60 million Universe Sands to hire him to help defend Hu Yang City. Over the years, his senior brother General Yong has worked by his side, showing humility and doing many things for him. As a result, the two are close, with Yue Wu promising to assist Yong Hu after breaking through to Primal Chaos Sovereign.
characters.appearance: A thin man in loose robes.
characters.history:
Yue Wu is the strongest Eternal True God in the Yu Kingdom (according to what power has been revealed) and a general in their military. He is a direct disciple of Yu Shui Kingdom Master, and is highly valued, given life-saving treasures and resources to aid in his cultivation. It cost Lord Jiu Jiang 60 million Universe Sands to hire him to help defend Hu Yang City. Over the years, his senior brother General Yong has worked by his side, showing humility and doing many things for him. As a result, the two are close, with Yue Wu promising to assist Yong Hu after breaking through to Primal Chaos Sovereign.

When he arrived outside of Hu Yang City, he quickly got to work coordinating a formation with General Yong, Luo Feng, and Morosa, along with over 3,000 other Eternal True Gods. After a few days of practice, the army began their operation to retake the city, and his formation easily tore apart the Heart Shadow Sect's formation that covered the city. With Luo Feng at the head, his formation successfully countered the Heart Shadow Sect's Dark Prison World Formation and Great Destruction Matchless Formation, and outmaneuvered the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom Military Warship they brought to the battle, allowing Lord Jiu Jiang's army to successfully reach the City Lord's Mansion.

Once within the city, Yue Wu began comprehending the Hu Yang City Formation, stabilizing it and increasing the army's ability to defend the city. Ultimately, he activated 139 formations within the city, breaking the stranglehold that the Heart Shadow Sect had on the city, as well as restraining and imprisoning the disciples the sect scattered throughout the city. As the two sides re-engaged in combat, he was shocked by the arrival of the Snow Realm Envoy, and he asked Luo Feng to intercept it, since he could not stop it, even with his formations. After Luo Feng successfully intercepted the Snow Realm Envoy, Lord Jiu Jiang ordered his forces to retreat, which Yue Wu facilitated through his formation.

At Lord Jiu Jiang's banquet for the core members of his army, Yue Wu was one of the over 100 Eternal True Gods gathered. He sat at his right hand, signifying his importance, and listened as Jiu Jiang declared that he would find a way to invite more help.

characters.title: Yun Mu Ancestor
characters.introText: Yun Mu Ancestor is a solitary female Primogenitor who has not joined any faction and rarely participates in conflicts. She focuses on protecting her own race, which consists of only one known Primogenitor herself. Due to this, her people have often faced bullying and were once nearly wiped out, losing about two-thirds of their population. She originally specialized in the highest level of life-based power, granting her exceptional healing and vitality abilities. However, this left her with weak offensive capabilities. In response to her race’s suffering, she secretly cultivated destruction power over a long period, eventually mastering both life and destruction, two of the highest-level powers in existence. This dual mastery allows her to possess both immense recovery and killing potential, though she remains low-profile. During Luo Feng’s battle in the 29th layer of the Abyss Of Destruction, she observed from afar and noted his strength in both life and destruction was greater than hers. She recognized their similarity in having pursued both powers, though the outside world still believed she only controlled life. Her mastery of dual forces places her roughly at the edge of the top ten Primogenitors in strength.

characters.title: Yun Tian God King
characters.introText: Yun Tian God King is known for reaching the invincible First Level God King on her own. Due to unable to advance further, she decided to cultivate the Chaotic Origin Bloodline, which turned out to be a perfect fit for her. This greatly boosted her strength, but the remaining will of the Chaotic Origin Bloodline is also unleashed a dangerous power that affected her consciousness, causing her to lose control. In this state, she accidentally killed a God King from the Thunder Ancient Kingdom and destroying all of his clones.
characters.history:
Yun Tian God King is known for reaching the invincible First Level God King on her own. Due to unable to advance further, she decided to cultivate the Chaotic Origin Bloodline, which turned out to be a perfect fit for her. This greatly boosted her strength, but the remaining will of the Chaotic Origin Bloodline is also unleashed a dangerous power that affected her consciousness, causing her to lose control. In this state, she accidentally killed a God King from the Thunder Ancient Kingdom and destroying all of his clones.

This incident gained a lot of attention. Normally, if a God King is killed, they can come back with some effort. However, her Chaotic Origin Bloodline carries a soul-targeting poison that prevents resurrection. Even a second-level God King would struggle against her poison. According to Luo Feng, she ranks among the top three poison users in the entire origin continent.

characters.title: Zan Yun
characters.introText: Zan Yun is an Eternal True God of the Food Kingdom, the president of the Zan Yun Chamber of Commerce in Hu Yang City. He contacted Hei Duo Mo to inquire why he had almost missed the deadline of arrival in Hu Yang City, and was the first ally of Hei Duo Mo to realize that he died.

Zan Yun is an Eternal True God of the Food Kingdom, the president of the Zan Yun Chamber of Commerce in Hu Yang City. He contacted Hei Duo Mo to inquire why he had almost missed the deadline of arrival in Hu Yang City, and was the first ally of Hei Duo Mo to realize that he died.

characters.history:
Zha Wei Seigneur is a Universe Overlord member of the Nine Territory Alliance. With a large Divine Body and a Life Gene Level of 100, he was a formidable opponent. When the High Divine Hammer emerged on Original Star 02933, he joined forces with Venerable Thousand Shadow to battle Venerable Sky Flower for it. When Luo Feng revealed his identity through the use of Nine Roars River, he immediately fled the domain, due to the fame Luo Feng obtained from killing Universe Overlords.

He remained close by and observed the battle between Luo Feng and Venerable Sky Flower, noting that due to the strength of Sky Flower's Divine Body, Luo Feng would only have a slight advantage. He was surprised when Luo Feng used Golden Light to immediately destroy 11% of Sky Flower's Divine Body.

infobox.title: Zhang Haobai
infobox.affiliation: Zhang Family of Jiangnan City Tiger Fang Squad Extreme Martial Club

characters.introText: Zhang Haobai is Luo Feng's first known (small) enemy on Earth when the latter is in high school.
characters.personality:
Zhang Haobai was imprisoned for attempting to attack Luo Feng. He brided the prisoners to attack and break one of Luo Feng's arms and legs when he was in the Yi'an detention center. This was his retaliation for (his perspective) Luo Feng earlier publicly attacking Zhang Haobai and his guards, but (reality) Luo Feng was just protecting his father and his father's coworkers from Zhang Haobai's group's assault.

His current fate is unknown after he was taken away by the Jiangnan City Security Bureau. His narrowminded actions caused the fall of his Zhang family in Jiangnan City.

Learning of Luo Feng's later advanced cultivation, he regrets his actions and hopes Luo Feng will not take revenge. When seeing Luo Feng's published obituary, he is extremely happy. He was still in prison though at that time.

It is probable, but not yet absolute, that Zhang Haobai choose suicide upon knowing that Luo Feng become the champion of Earth and can easily kill anyone on the planet.
characters.history:
Zhang Haobai is the son of decently rich, but corrupted, Zhang Zelong and the nephew of Tiger Fang Squad member Zhang Zehu. He was a senior student at the Extreme Martial Club. He liked Xu Xin and would always try to show off using his wealth and status to her without knowing that Xu Xin was the young lady of the Xu Family, a member of the HR Alliance.

During his time as a student at Yi'an No.3 High School, he forms a one-side rivalry with Luo Feng. He is the son of a rich and powerful family, precisely, the most powerful family in Jiangnan City. Therefore, he has an arrogant, cold and merciless character. He envies Luo Feng for being better than him in studies and martial arts. He contends Xu Xin in a love rivalry with Luo Feng, but knows Xu Xin's love for Luo Feng. As a result, he uses his familial influence to create problems to ruin Luo Feng's future.
characters.trivia: Zhang Haobai is a mere filler in the plot hole and does not posses any significance toward the storyline whatsoever. His only worth was to be a source of small troubles that motivated Luo Feng to work harder during his Student Level and Apprentice Level 1 cultivation periods.

characters.appearance:
She is an Eternal True God from Zhang Family and one of the descendant of Feng Zhang God King, a first-level God King existence. Although she comes from a branch of the main lineage of the royal family, she is several generations away from the Feng Zhang God King and didn't have a high status.

First time she met Moyu Qingyan when she was handling her royal family's affairs in Xiang Jie City. At that time, Moyu Qingyan was highly respected and flattered by many. As they spent more time together, she discovered that Moyu Qingyan was very genuine, and finally she fell in love with him. They later married each other but separated as she wanted to focus on her cultivation and did not want to be distracted by emotions.

Both she and Moyu Qingyan reached the level of Eternal True God before choosing a life partner, which shows their dedication to their cultivation and their preference for finding a partner only when they were. The two of them hold a celebration and officially declare their relationship in the Feng Zhang city where the Zhang Family is located.

characters.introText: A very large and muscular man. He wields a large two-handed machete.
characters.appearance: A very large and muscular man. He wields a large two-handed machete.
characters.history:
Zhang Zehu is an Apprentice Level 3 Warrior member of the Tiger Fang Squad. The younger brother of Zhang Zelong, he was asked to help Zhang Haobai with his quarrels with Luo Feng. He and his team did not agree to terms with the Extreme Martial Club (in the donghua, that included Haobai getting on his knees and apologizing to Luo Feng, while in the novel, Luo Feng asked for 50 million Chinese dollars). In the donghua, he left the egg of a Golden Eagle at the training grounds of the Warrior Field Test, in hopes that it would kill Luo Feng.

After Luo Feng killed the eagle and became an official Warrior, Zhang Zehu and the Tiger Fang Squad antagonized him and the Fire Hammer Squad, resulting in Zhang Ke losing his arm. With enmity between the two teams solidified, Luo Feng eventually killed Zhang Zehu in the novel, while in the donghua he injured him and left him to die at the hands of Mutant Beasts.

characters.history:
Zhen Kan Wu is the 192nd generation inheritor of Duan Dong River, and is also known as Duan Dong River Zhen Kan Wu. He was an Eternal True God, given the title 'Wu' to signify his status within the Wu Kingdom.

A large number of Reincarnation Eras in the past, he accompanied his general on the Universe Boat, traveling into Universe Ocean to enslave immature Sector Beasts. However, the original mind of the Original Universe used the supreme laws to manipulate Universe Ocean into killing all who were onboard, including Zhen Kan Wu, and heavily damaged Universe Boat. Knowing that his chance of survival was slim, he remodeled the Boat of Mausoleum and left it and a virtual consciousness behind in hopes of finding the next inheritor of Duan Dong River.

After Luo Feng revived him, he received special favor from Lord Luo as a senior member of the Duan Donghe Lineage, being granted a Chaos State as his fiefdom along with a respectable amount of resources.

Zhu Gu is the leader of the Zhu Family, the strongest of the Local Major Families of Hu Yang City. One of the handful in the city capable of killing Mu Yang, Zhu Gu has a bounty of 530,000 Universe Sands, the third-highest bounty in the Flame Wind Guild Hall for residents of Hu Yang City. His reputation is no lower than that of Moli Xiao or Blood Cloud.

He personally met Luo Feng when his family purchased the World Sword from him for Divine Lord Wei.

characters.appearance: A burly man whose body is covered with deep purple scales.
characters.history:
Zhu Huo is a late stage World Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Among the three appointed Inspectors, he is the least powerful in terms of raw strength—but what he lacks in power, he makes up for with experience and performance.

He had previously served as an Inspector under Overlord Yuan and did exceptionally well in that role. Because of his strong work ethic, discipline, and trustworthy actions, Luo Feng chose him once again to serve as the Second Region Inspector.

Zhu Huo was both surprised and relieved to be chosen. Even though his strength was not the highest, his reliability and past record stood out to the Overlords. He came to understand that Luo Feng valued capability and loyalty over raw power.

characters.appearance: In the novel, he is a skinny man with an aquiline nose.
characters.history:
Zhu Xi, as one of the five Inspectors of the Extreme Martial Club, his power and influence in Extreme Martial Club is only second to that of the founder of the Extreme Martial Club, Hong, the strongest man in the world and one of the big five Extreme Martial Club inspectors. He is the one who discovered that Luo Feng was a Spirit Master.
He is so powerful that he can easily defeat a War God. Although his strength surpasses a War God, he was unable to defeat Li Yao who barely stepped into Planetary Level. We can see in Episode 52 that he can fly without his weapon, confirming he has reached the Planetary Level.
Zhu Xi is the War God who appeared in the 1st episode of the Donghua and saved Luo Feng and Xu Xin.
characters.trivia:
It appears that in the donghua Zhu Xi has been combined with Inspector Liu He. Both are Planetary Level existences, and thus representatives in the Palace of Gods of War

In the novel, Zhu Xi appears to be a subordinate of Jia Yi, rather than a member of the Extreme Martial Club

characters.title: Zhu You
characters.introText: His hair is like little snakes, and he has green secret engravings on his face.
characters.appearance: His hair is like little snakes, and he has green secret engravings on his face.
characters.history:
Zhu You is an Eternal True God of the Zhu Family, and the best in the family in terms of saving his life and hiding his aura. After Luo Feng killed Mu Yang, Zhu You visited Luo Feng's residence, but was ignored since Luo Feng was in seclusion. Seeking to befriend Luo Feng, he took on Moyu Liefeng, the eldest son of Moyu Hu, as a disciple.

Zhu You met Luo Feng at Dream Flower Tower after sending him a message through Moyu Qingyan. In their meeting, he suggested to Luo Feng that he avoid working with the City Lord's Mansion or the Food Kingdom's forces for any serious tasks, but simply use both to his benefit. Zhu You also witnessed Gao Wu Shui's attempt to arrest Mei Wu Qi. He was shocked by Luo Feng's subsequent attack and killing of both Mei Wu Qi and Qian Yu Chong, but continued to drink with him after his actions. Afterwards, when discussing Luo Feng's actions, he expressed admiration but warned him to be careful in offending the Five Major Families. When Luo Feng explained that the powers behind the Five Major Families would actually appreciate his actions, he showed admiration for his understanding of the minds of God Kings and Primal Chaos Sovereigns.

Later, when Luo Feng killed Ying Cang, he contacted Zhu You when attempting to sell the World Sword. While sitting alongside Divine Lord Wei, he presented the price that the Zhu Family was willing to pay for the treasure, eventually winning the bidding war.

Zhu You also informed Luo Feng about the aftermath of the battle between Blood Cloud and Yong Hu, sending him the details collected by the Flame Wind Guild Hall.

During the Heart Shadow Sect's invasion of Hu Yang City, Zhu You and Zhu Fuqing were the only Zhu Family members to remain in the city. Through Zhu You's position as Moyu Liefeng's master, the Zhu Family served as a backing power for Moyu Hu, allowing him to be a counterbalance to Moli Meng.

characters.appearance: A burly man with green scaly wings and heavy armor.
characters.history:
Zuo Shan Jin is the reincarnated Sitting Mountain Guest, having cultivated to the Primal Chaos Sovereign realm. This is revealed during Luo Feng's first period in the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. He is a Guest Official of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom and the lord of a city in the kingdom. He seeks to increase his strength by cultivating in the Chaotic Origin Bloodline inheritance in which the Thunder Ancient Kingdom specializes.

With his status as a Guest Official, he is able to monitor Luo Feng's progress from afar, and is pleasantly surprised when he breaks through to Primal Chaos Sovereign in around 30 periods. Continuing to work toward his goal of vengeance against the Food Kingdom, he is patient and decides not to meet Luo Feng on the Continent of Origin, preferring to avoid pressuring him.

He eventually meets Blazing Fire God King and completely joins the Thunder Ancient Kingdom for the opportunity to cultivate in the Chaotic Origin Bloodline, due to having a lack of merits to do so. He then follows Blazing Fire God King to choose an inheritance and bloodline.

After hearing that Luo Feng broke through to Second Level God King, he broke through God King himself. He was then contacted by Luo Feng, who informed him that he was now ready to kill the God Kings of the Food Kingdom. He accompanied Luo Feng as he easily killed the three founding God Kings of the Food Kingdom, and after their deaths he decided to live a peaceful life studying tool-refining and the Chaotic Origin Bloodline.

cultivation.personality:
This section lists all of the techniques used or created by Luo Feng.

Creator: Blood Garment Marquis

A technique created for comprehending the first three pictures of 9 Universe Primal Chaos Tablet.

Techniques used by Luo Feng's Golden Horned Beast body.

Arc Light: The moment it is used, Golden Horned Beast's movement would cause the Space to warp, creating a Second Body

1,000 Forms: The moment it is used, Golden Horned Beast would create 1,000 to 10,000 bodies within an area.

Teleportation: The moment it is used, it will allow the Golden Horned Beast to Teleport.

A technique that focuses on melee attacks, with Tearing Sky referring to claw attacks while Splitting Land referred to tail attacks. Through Luo Feng's study of this technique, his Law of Gold  comprehension improved at a staggering rate.

The melee technique 8 Level Hunt focuses on body movement in relation to close-combat. It is one of the techniques within the inherited memory of the Golden Horned Beast.

Gold Horn is a technique contained in the inherited memories of a Golden Horned Beast. It focuses on killing the opponent in 1 blow.

Strikeout Through the Universe is one of the techniques contained in the inherited memories of the Golden Horned Beast, created by one of the Golden Horned Beast ancestors. It is an escape technique that also facilitates the beast's wing attacks. Through this technique, a Golden Horned Beast could move at terrifying speeds, leaving 3 incredibly realistic images around themselves.

Sky Tearing Claw is a melee claw technique used by Luo Feng in both his Earthling and Golden Horned Beast bodies. During his time in the Huge Pit, studying the images of the Beast God, Luo Feng began training in this technique while studying Tearing Sky Splitting Land. After using the Blood River Crystals to amplify the strength of the Golden Horned Beast's right claw by nearly 9 times, Luo Feng focused primarily on this technique as a way to leverage that increased strength. While studying this technique, he realized that it contained both Law of Gold  and Law of Space , so studying this technique greatly increased his comprehension of both. Once he obtained the Beast God Statue, he further learned that the Sky Tearing Claw was the correct path to follow for his claw techniques, so he stopped studying Tearing Sky Splitting Land and focused on Sky Tearing Claw.

cultivation.appearance:
High level practitioners in low level countries of 'aboriginal' planets. In this stage, the practitioner strengthens their body and consciousness to the utmost level with genetic energy.
Battle Ability Amplifier (BAA) is a cultivator's ‘fist strength level’ multiplied by their ‘tower of trials level’, and the levels of BAA are described in Chapter 119.
Due to a spirit reader's body fitness usually limiting the amount of spiritual force they can wield, a Spirit Master prowess tends to be 2 levels above their body fitness level. This is only the case during the Apprentice Level.

On Earth, the level's nine stages is further divided into sub-realms, with the peak at the Wargod/God of War sub-realm.The Quasi-Warrior (准武者 Zhǔn wǔzhě) sub-realm is part of the pre-Warrior cultivation realm classification since the webnovel's 2022. With 2024 webnovel data, Quasi-Warrior is classified the bottom sub-realm of the Apprentice Level.

Neural reaction is no long tested at this level.

cultivation.title: Artistic Conception of the Beast God
cultivation.introText: The Artistic Conception of the Beast God (兽神意境(Shòu shén yìjìng), fan-translated as Beast God Presence or Beast God Conception) can be considered part of the base of Beast God-related techniques. Unlike comprehending the Original Laws, comprehending the Artistic Conception of the Beast God does not require complete understanding; one can memorize it through repeated copying and simulation, provided they have an adequate guide, such as the Beast God Statue. Law comprehension and the artistic conception are mutually reinforcing; stronger law comprehension enables one to copy and master the artistic conception, while a higher level of artistic conception can fuel stronger law comprehension.

cultivation.title: Beast God
cultivation.introText: Beast God is a term that is applied to two different sets of creatures. One is the group of Natural Beast Gods (天生兽神(tiānshēng shòu shén)) while the other is the group of Cultivated Beast Gods (后天兽神(hòutiān shòu shén), lit. Nurtured Beast Gods). Each Beast God corresponds to a combination of Upper and Lower Original Laws that were fused to create a Way of the Beast God. While there are only ever 8 beings with the title of Beast God within the Original Universe (the Eight Beast Gods of the Ancestral God Sect), other beings within the Original Universe follow the Ways of the Beast God and may be called Beast Gods if they reach Universe Master along those ways.

cultivation.title: Beast God Blood
cultivation.introText: Beast God Blood is the essence of the Natural Beast God of Law of Gold  and Law of Space , extracted from the Blood River Crystal. One must extract the essence of 100 Blood River Crystals to create 1 drop of Beast God Blood. This meant that to create 100 drops, one would require 10,000 Blood River Crystals. However, using Beast God Blood instead of Blood River Crystals has the benefit of lessening the evil energy and pain that must be endured during the absorption process. For this reason, Beast God Blood is highly desired and strictly managed by the Virtual Universe Company.

cultivation.title: Book of Wisdom

It is made from the some of the body material of a Hunyuan Ancestor, and its value far exceeds that of The Eye of Life and Death. It can analyze everything, including Chaotic Origin Bloodlines, study the Great Daos, and assist in self-cultivation.

cultivation.title: Calamity Beast Diagram
cultivation.introText: The Calamity Beast Diagram is a rare treasure used by Primal Chaos Sovereigns to cultivate their Willpower. It was personally drawn by Emperor Ming. It is the cheapest of the three most cost-effective treasures for this purpose. If someone attempts a glimpse of a corner of the diagram with willpower below Primal Chaos Sovereign level, they will go completely insane. The diagram sold by the Flame Wind Guild Hall has a price of 15 million Universe Sands per copy, which can be paid at any Dark Hall branch. The diagram will be delivered within 10 days.

cultivation.title: Chaos Space
cultivation.introText: When a cultivator breaks through to Primal Chaos Sovereign, their True God's Heart will evolve into a Chaos Space (混沌空间(Hùndùn kōngjiān)). A steady stream of chaotic Divine Power pours into the heart, gradually expanding and forming the space known as the Chaos Space. It essentially serves the same function for a Primal Chaos Sovereign as the True God's Heart does for True Gods, Void True Gods, and Eternal True Gods, channeling energy from the cultivator's Miniature Universe to their body. It must also be protected from damage, similar to the True God's Heart. Chaos Spaces vary in size, with cultivators with stronger foundations (for example, those with the Infinite or Perfect Divine Body) having larger Chaos Spaces.

cultivation.title: Chaotic Origin Bloodline
cultivation.introText: Chaotic Origin Bloodline (浑源血脉(Hún yuán xuèmài)) comprises various bloodlines of creatures bred in the space outside the Caged World of Swallowed Star. These bloodlines are extremely powerful and terrifying; if a God King touched it directly, they would be completely contaminated and lose control.
cultivation.appearance:
Chaotic Origin Bloodline (浑源血脉(Hún yuán xuèmài)) comprises various bloodlines of creatures bred in the space outside the Caged World of Swallowed Star. These bloodlines are extremely powerful and terrifying; if a God King touched it directly, they would be completely contaminated and lose control.

As a cultivation path, it is sometimes referred to as the Chaotic Origin Bloodline System (浑源血脉体系(Hún yuán xuèmài tǐxì)). To enable the Chaotic Origin Bloodline to be used as a cultivation path, First Ancestor Flame Wind and First Ancestor Thunder cultivated special creatures (such as the Golden Scale Beetle and Camel Mountain Beast), diluting the bloodline through the natural reproduction of those creatures. The creatures created possess rare bloodlines useful for cultivation. Cultivators who follow this path are typically stronger, and their inheritances and resources are very expensive. Their Divine Bodies are also considered extremely strong for their level. First Level God Kings who have mastered multiple Major Branches of a Great Dao can cultivate using this method to gain strength equivalent to a Second Level God King. The Thunder Lineage is considered the strongest Chaotic Origin Bloodline in the Caged World of Swallowed Star.

Following this path is dangerous as the bloodline contaminates both the Divine Body, soul, and Willpower, which can cause the cultivator to lose control. Even if they maintain control, their tempers are violent, as seen with Lord Chu Yuan. It is said that following this path has even more flaws when one surpasses Ultimate God King, which could be why Emperor Fu decided to reincarnate and follow a different path. As a result, the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom restricts cultivation through this path, generally prohibiting Primal Chaos Sovereigns from following it, and only allowing God Kings to follow it after a strict review. Within the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, the practice of this cultivation method is very cautious, so none of their members have lost control.

The Thunder Ancient Kingdom, on the other hand, fully embraces this path and specializes in cultivating through this path. Most of the high-ranking members of the Imperial Families of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom rely on this cultivation path. They also allow Primal Chaos Sovereigns to follow this path despite the danger, but those cultivators must have sufficient merits or fully join the ancient kingdom. If a cultivator completely loses control when following this method, they are imprisoned for 10,000 periods to give them a chance to recover; if they cannot regain control within this timeframe, they are executed.

cultivation.title: Chaotic Origin Crystal Spirit Fruit
cultivation.introText: Chaotic Origin Crystal Spirit Fruit is the fruit of tree that is cultivated and grown with Chaotic Origin Crystal Jade. This fruit has miraculous effects on nourishing the soul; after taking it, one will become more in tune with the Supreme Operation Laws, and one's comprehension will greatly increase. When Luo Feng ate his first fruit, his thinking speed multiplied by more than 20 times, despite him having a Perfect Divine Body and Second Level God King Willpower, and this lasted for a little longer than 1 Period.
cultivation.appearance: A light-red fruit.
