cultivation.title: Chaotic Origin Power
cultivation.introText: Chaotic Origin Power is a mysterious power that flows in the area outside the Caged World of Swallowed Star. This power can be used as part of extraordinary inheritances and techniques, but these are generally only found in the Ancient Kingdoms, and they require an extraordinary amount of merits.
cultivation.appearance:
Chaotic Origin Power is a mysterious power that flows in the area outside the Caged World of Swallowed Star. This power can be used as part of extraordinary inheritances and techniques, but these are generally only found in the Ancient Kingdoms, and they require an extraordinary amount of merits.

Primal Chaos Sovereigns can only utilize this power through special methods, and most Transcendent Chaos Realms reach this level using inheritances relying on either this power or Chaotic Origin Material. Inheritances utilizing Chaotic Origin Power are capable of reaching Transcendent Chaos Realm even at the initial entry point. God Kings using these inheritances are also capable of more powerful and unpredictable methods than ordinary God Kings.

Using Chaotic Origin Power is less dangerous than using Chaotic Origin Bloodline, but is generally less powerful.

cultivation.title: Chemist
cultivation.introText: Chemist (药剂师, Yàojì shī, lit. Chemist or Pharmacist) is a rare cultivation path within the world of Swallowed Star. Called the 'universe researchers,' chemists study the many peculiar and rare materials in the universe, determine their special properties, then later, using their own methods, create drugs that suit their attack style. For example, a chemist Warrior may construct a blade that administers their drugs, while a chemist Spirit Master may use powders or projectiles.
cultivation.appearance:
Chemist (药剂师, Yàojì shī, lit. Chemist or Pharmacist) is a rare cultivation path within the world of Swallowed Star. Called the 'universe researchers,' chemists study the many peculiar and rare materials in the universe, determine their special properties, then later, using their own methods, create drugs that suit their attack style. For example, a chemist Warrior may construct a blade that administers their drugs, while a chemist Spirit Master may use powders or projectiles.

Their drugs are extremely peculiar and unpredictable, able to attack various weaknesses, and having varying strength, depending on the ability of the chemist. Simply beating a chemist once does not mean that if you fought them a week later, you would absolutely win, as they could use a completely different drug. A strong chemist is a very difficult opponent to defeat, as it is incredibly difficult to have resistance against every type of drug.

The chemist path is incredibly difficult to follow. The process of making drugs is very complex, to the point that a drug's creator may not be able to recreate the drug! The development path is much more narrow than those of a Warrior or Spirit Master, and there are much fewer examples to follow. Generally, they follow their path alone, and rarely find others who can empathize.

cultivation.title: Consciousness
cultivation.introText: Consciousness (意识, Yìshí, lit. Consciousness/Awareness/Mind, sometimes seen coupled with Willpower as 意志意识, Yìzhì yìshí, lit. Will Consciousness) is a mental component of a cultivator's strength. Consciousness is important to both Spirit Masters and Warriors. For Warriors, consciousness (along with willpower) helps them evolve and breakthrough, contributes to both their offense and defense, and is even a component of Domain and associated techniques. For Spirit Masters, consciousness is commanded by willpower, and it commands the cultivator's Spirit Energy.
cultivation.appearance:
Consciousness (意识, Yìshí, lit. Consciousness/Awareness/Mind, sometimes seen coupled with Willpower as 意志意识, Yìzhì yìshí, lit. Will Consciousness) is a mental component of a cultivator's strength. Consciousness is important to both Spirit Masters and Warriors. For Warriors, consciousness (along with willpower) helps them evolve and breakthrough, contributes to both their offense and defense, and is even a component of Domain and associated techniques. For Spirit Masters, consciousness is commanded by willpower, and it commands the cultivator's Spirit Energy.

Like Willpower, Consciousness can be expressed even in the Virtual Universe, as it is a mental and soul component. Consciousness is tied to a cultivator's Spirit Energy and thus grows with them. As one gets stronger, their consciousness strength increases, increasing their ability to utilize their Spirit Energy as well as their mental processing speed. To some extent, a stronger Consciousness also helps one's Willpower. Additionally, as one increases their comprehension of the Original Laws, their consciousness begins to be affected by the universe energies, giving them greater resistance to illusions.

If a cultivator has multiple bodies, they will share a consciousness and thus each body can increase its law comprehension, techniques, etc. from one body's training. This also meant that if one body had a stronger consciousness than another, the weaker body could use the consciousness strength of the stronger body. For example: Luo Feng's Golden Horned Beast Body had a stronger consciousness than his Earthling Body, but his Earthling body was able to use the Golden Horned Beast's consciousness strength (as well as innate talent techniques like Strengthen!) for battles both within the Virtual Universe and the real world. Cultivators with multiple bodies can also channel the shared consciousness into one of the bodies, increasing its consciousness strength.

When one breaks through to Immortal, their Consciousness fuses to help create their Immortal Energy. The nature of Immortal Energy meant that as long as their Immortal Energy was not burned or destroyed, it would return to their body when dispersed or emitted, since the energy, fused with their consciousness, belongs only to them. As Consciousness is an element of Immortal Energy, the increase of Divine Power as an Immortal got stronger resulted in their Consciousness strengthening. This meant that Special Lifeforms and those lifeforms with large Divine Bodies, such as Plant Lifeforms and Mountain Lifeforms, would have greater Consciousness strength than other lifeforms of their cultivation tier, due to the sheer volume of Divine Power. For example, Luo Feng, due to his Remote Ocean body's size and his Perfect Life Gene Level, had Divine Power on the Universe Overlord level immediately after breaking through to Immortal!

cultivation.title: Cultivation
cultivation.introText: Warriors are the most common, as Spiritual Power is relatively rare. Out of the Spirit Master Branches the Illusionist is considered the rarest.
cultivation.appearance: Starting from the Void True God cultivation, a beings Miniature Universe becomes a Holy Land. When their universe becomes holy land their Lifespan also becomes eternal as long as they don't die of unnatural causes.

cultivation.title: Cultivation/Technique
cultivation.introText: In Swallowed Star, techniques (also known as methods, skills, or ways) fall under levels. While techniques below the level of a World Master are rarely defined, those at the level of Immortal tend to be defined, with the lowest level being Low and the highest level seen being God King. While a technique may be of a certain level, there are other factors that can contribute to the effectiveness of the technique, including the underlying strength of the user, the strength of the medium used (generally a weapon, but also can be the body, etc.), law comprehension, etc. As such, in the story, a Universe Master-level technique may not easily kill a Universe Venerable, for example.
cultivation.appearance:
In Swallowed Star, techniques (also known as methods, skills, or ways) fall under levels. While techniques below the level of a World Master are rarely defined, those at the level of Immortal tend to be defined, with the lowest level being Low and the highest level seen being God King. While a technique may be of a certain level, there are other factors that can contribute to the effectiveness of the technique, including the underlying strength of the user, the strength of the medium used (generally a weapon, but also can be the body, etc.), law comprehension, etc. As such, in the story, a Universe Master-level technique may not easily kill a Universe Venerable, for example.

Secret Techniques (秘术) are different from Secret Methods (秘法) in that Secret Techniques are useful to more powerful beings than Secret Methods. Secret Methods are generally techniques at the Universe Venerable-level and thus are worthless to Universe Masters, while Secret Techniques are typically created by beings who have surpassed True Gods, making their techniques incredibly useful.
cultivation.personality:
Technique training usually requires a very solid understanding in the basics, which usually takes ten years of bitter work. And fighting with monsters for years drills the ways to dodge into your consciousness. Once you train enough, your reflexes will come in play no matter what the situation.

Solid understanding in the basics, tons of training, and reflexes!

These three levels are the basics of technique. Above these three is the Micro level!

The Ru Wei class means that you have virtually complete control over your strength and body and are able to use the smallest amount of energy and movement to  dodge the attack. All kinds of dodging, just like it has been calculated by a computer! The reason why the micro level technique is so hard is because when you are just barely dodging, any kind of mistake will lead to the attack from the monster striking you! Once you are hit by a monster, most people get heavily injured, if not killed.

When training in the micro class technique, it isn’t really that effective to train with monsters who are weaker than you.

It has level for the technique split into Basic, Expert, Perfect and Conception levels

The expert level uses the smallest amounts of movements to dodge an attack and therefore using the movements as efficiently as possible.

The perfect level requires one to be able to take the environment and become one with the environment. It allows one uses anything, like rocks, structures, etc. in the surrounding area to accurately dodge.  The Vigorous Bear "Li Kan" is at this level.

"The Shadow Blade" Wang Tong has reached an even higher level, the "Conception" level, which is the highest level of the Ru Wei body technique. It is the advanced version of the Perfection Level.

The state of a blade is split into the categories Basic–Expert–Perfect–Conception, these four levels.

Examples:

Hidden Shadow 7 Blades

Milky Way Suspended in the Vast Sky

cultivation.title: Destruction Fruit
cultivation.introText: Destruction Fruits are special items available to those who defeat one of the 7 statues on the Mountain of Destruction. These fruits are naturally condensed on the mountain, and when consumed by a Primogenitor, they can cause their Life Core to grow in the direction of Destruction. A single fruit is comparable to the blessing of an ordinary Mysterious Land, making them incredibly valuable.
cultivation.appearance:

These fruits are naturally condensed on the mountain, and when consumed by a Primogenitor, they can cause their Life Core to grow in the direction of Destruction. A single fruit is comparable to the blessing of an ordinary Mysterious Land, making them incredibly valuable.

For each statue one defeats on the Mountain of Destruction, they receive 1 Destruction Fruit, which, in addition to serving as a resource for Primogenitors, can also be exchanged for special treasures nurtured by the mountain. With 1 fruit, one can choose from 3,000 treasures, with 2 fruits one can choose from 100 treasures, with 3 fruits one can choose from 6 treasures, and with 4 fruits one can choose from 3 treasures.

In the entire Infinite Hunyuan Space, only Kafuxiu, Sha Zhou, and Luo Feng have obtained a Destruction Fruit. Kafuxiu obtained 1, obtaining the Kafuxiu Battle Armor, Sha Zhou obtained 2, which she consumed, evolving her Life Core, and Luo Feng obtained 6, 4 of which he exchanged for the Sharp Blade, and 2 for the Secret Treasure Robe.

cultivation.title: Diamond Body
cultivation.introText: Diamond Body (金刚身, Jīngāng shēn, lit. Diamond or Vajra Body) is a genetic energy special ability under the gold attribute.
cultivation.appearance:
Diamond Body (金刚身, Jīngāng shēn, lit. Diamond or Vajra Body) is a genetic energy special ability under the gold attribute.

When Apprentice Level cultivators break through to Planetary Level on their Warrior side, they acquire a special ability under one of the main categories of genetic energy: gold, wood, water, fire, earth, wind, lightning, and light. Each main category is split into multiple subcategories; for example, fire is split into categories including human torch, smelting flame, among others, and depending on the talents of the warrior, different beings at the same level may showcase differing levels of flame.

Diamond Body, as a subcategory of gold, provides more powerful bones and muscles than other warriors of the same level. Their attack, speed, and defense will all increase, especially their defense, particularly once their genetic energy merges with their skin. The most common special ability under gold is 'sharpness,' giving the user's attacks more piercing power.

Luo Feng acquired this ability when his Warrior side broke through to Planetary Level. As a result of this ability, his newly created Planetary Level 3 Earthling Body's sturdiness matched that of a Planetary Level 4 Warrior, enabling him to bear the power of a Planetary Level 6 Spirit Master.

cultivation.title: Divine Body
cultivation.introText: This is a section added primarily due to the difference between the English-fan translation of the Novel and the true Chinese meaning.
cultivation.appearance:
The Divine Body is the body of an Immortal. While the terms Divine Body and Immortal Body are used somewhat interchangeably in the fan-translated novel, technically the terms are different; Immortal Body is a class of Divine Body, generally reached by those at the Immortal Marquis level, whereas the Divine Body itself is literally any body of an Immortal, regardless of its strength or class. The Divine Body can be considered one of the 3 major aspects of a cultivator[१].

When a cultivator becomes Immortal, their body fundamentally changes. At that point, the cultivator's soul begins to meld with the body, with every bit of spirit imprint fusing with their cells[२]. This meant that it would be impossible to clearly see the cultivator's soul, so one would not be able to determine their original race. This also made it so that if an Immortal's body was destroyed once, they could reform their body[३].

This new body could be burned and converted to energy, allowing the user to exhibit much more power than their normal state; for example, a Low Immortal King could reach the level of a Pinnacle Immortal King by burning their body! However, the recovery cost is immense, making Immortals reluctant to use this ability; for example, it would take that Low Immortal King hundreds to thousands of years to recover[४]. It is stated[५] multiple[६] times[७] that burning one's Divine Body makes one 1,000 times stronger than if they did not burn their body[८].

When a cultivator beaks through to True God, their body once more fundamentally changes. Their body, which was a Divine Body formed with Immortal Energy, returns to its origin, i.e. becoming a flesh-and-blood body should that have been their original form. If the cultivator had multiple bodies, their other bodies completely disintegrate and transform into a core of formidable Divine Power, within which is the True God's Heart[९]. If the cultivator had only one body, they still have a core containing the True God's Heart. The soul of the cultivator is hidden within this heart. If their Miniature Universe Origin transformed and stored energy into a large amount of Divine Power, that could be transmitted directly to the heart. If the True God's Heart was destroyed, the True God would die. The strength of the heart corresponds to the strength of the Miniature Universe Origin, so the method of construction, as well as the power of the God Country are extremely important[९]. While this body could still be burned and converted to energy, it was indeed a flesh-and-blood body[१०]. Since their body and soul are once again separated, when a True God burns their Divine Body, it does not impact their soul's strength (so they won't fall into Deep Sleep if they burn too much of it).

cultivation.title: Divine Power
cultivation.introText: Divine Power (神力, Shénlì, lit. Divine/God Power/Energy/Strength), also referred to as Immortal God Power (不朽神力, Bùxiǔ shénlì, lit. Immortal Divine/God Power/Energy/Strength) is the power of all cultivators of Immortal-level or higher. Divine Power fuels attacks and serves as the foundation for any Immortal or higher cultivator. It can be used to create avatars and can be stored in valuables or locations (such as a Space of Chaos) to serve other functions. Divine Power can also be used to sense one's surroundings in a way superior to that of using one's eyes, and through this functionality, it can increase the range of Teleportation, as the user can sense space ripples further out if they have stronger Divine Power.
cultivation.appearance:

While Immortal Energy is the energy used to create the Divine Bodies of cultivators from Immortal through Universe Master, once a cultivator breaks through to True God, they still possess Divine Power! This makes it different from Immortal Energy, which is the fusion of one's soul with their body. In a sense, all Immortal Energy could be considered Divine Power, but all Divine Power cannot be considered Immortal Energy.

cultivation.title: Domain Master
cultivation.introText:
This is a section added primarily due to the difference between the English-fan translation of the Novel and the true Chinese meaning.
The characters used here are extremely similar to World Master.
Original Chinese characters: 域主级 (yù zhǔ jí).
cultivation.appearance:
This is a section added primarily due to the difference between the English-fan translation of the Novel and the true Chinese meaning.
The characters used here are extremely similar to World Master.
Original Chinese characters: 域主级 (yù zhǔ jí).

域 (yù) refers to a domain, region or territory.

主级 (zhǔ jí) refers to the master grade or master level.
级 (jí) refers to grade, level or rank.

As such, combining these, results in a Person of Domain Master Level. --> A Domain Master. 
The English fan Novel uses the term Domain Lord which is quite similar to Domain Master.
cultivation.personality:
Universe Level sea of consciousness breaking through to Domain Master

Domain Masters are known for their use and mastery of Domain. While ordinary Domain Masters struggle through the 9 levels of Domain, their domains are still dramatically different than the domains of Planetary Level warriors like Hong. If one cannot comprehend Domains, they will be unable to breakthrough to Domain Master. They are relatively rare; Babata felt that if one could meet a Domain Master in the Milky Way Galaxy, they should play the lottery. The best lineages of the Human Race can reach Domain Master at maturation, while the 2nd level Space Beasts can do the same.

When a Universe Level breaks through to Domain Master, their soul essence, in the form of a galaxy with 8 spiral arms and 9 black holes, will be fused in order to form a singular big black hole. The galaxy within oneself will then get completely swallowed by this big black hole and form a Life Core. The Life Core provides advantages to a Domain Master; they cannot be killed unless their Life Core was destroyed, enabling them to survive decapitations, provided their Life Core was not in their head! They can store their Life Core anywhere, so Domain Masters could not be enslaved via Microchip, since they could simply destroy the part of their brain where it was installed.

Domain Masters begin forming and nurturing an internal world as they progress from Level 1 to Level 9. After breaking through to World Master, the fully nurtured internal world would form a true World Master World!

A Domain Master can be considered the king of a region. Low-level Civilized Nations like the Silverblue Empire do not dare to offend Domain Masters, and they can build up their own powers and organizations. In a Medium-level Civilized Nation, Domain Masters are powerful members of the most powerful organizations. In the Original Universe, any civilized nation will fight over Domain Masters. They typically use D Grade Spaceships. To Domain Masters, 20 billion Universe Coins is a pretty large sum.

Within the Human Race, Domain Masters could take the examinations to become a 2 Star Universe Mercenary of the Universe Mercenary Alliance. Domain Master core members of the Virtual Universe Company would be sent to a Universe Country to serve as an envoy, with status similar to that of an Immortal! Even ordinary Domain Masters are considered among the strong within the Original Universe, and many travel to fight in the Extraterritorial Battlefield.

cultivation.title: Five Acupoints Skyward Practices
cultivation.introText: The Five Acupoints Skyward Practices (五心向天修炼法, lit. "Five Hearts to Heaven Cultivation Method") also known as Wu Xin Xiang Tian Technique is the only foundational technique for absorbing cosmic energy or Universe Energy (宇宙能量) on Earth. The technique was developed after the Great Nirvana with countless trials, errors and editions to allow talented Apprentice Level 1 further progress after their genes optimized to a certain extent. This foundational technique requires a dao yin technique to improve its absorption capacity, such as the hybrid technique, Nine Stage Thunder Blade.
cultivation.appearance:
When Universe Energy entered the cells, it was quickly absorbed by the mitochondria and at the same time. With the mitochondrial conversion, the cosmic energy will be turned into genetic energy. This genetic energy was then absorbed by the cell, which started evolving the cell. When Universe Energy entered the brain or the conscious realm or the mind, it will be transformed into spiritual energy by a dark gold ball for the Apprentice Level Spirit Master.

The reason why the fighters have such powerful bodies, why some of the top fighters can surpass mach speed! Why their knives can slice through thick steel is because they rely on genetic energy.

Back when humanity was infected by the RR virus in the Grand Nirvana period, our genes started evolving to fight against the virus. When the genes evolve to a certain point, it's able to absorb the faint energies of the cosmos. The energy envelops every cell of your body! During this process, your genes, bones, cells, blood, organs, and skin will all continue to evolve and become stronger. Your bones can become tens to hundreds of times harder than diamonds. Your organs will be powerful enough to hold your breath in water for half an hour, and longer. All of this relies on the energy you absorb and envelop your cells with. It becomes your power, in other words--genetic energy.

Normal people aren't able to train this because their genes weren't suitable. Once your fist strength reaches 900 kg, your speed reaches 25 m/s, and your reaction speed all pass the mark required for a prospective fighter, then your genes were ready for training. 90% of prospective fighters are able to start training.

Once someone reaches the body fitness level of a fighter, they usually are able to start their genetic energy training right away, the first step to feel the cosmic energy is the hardest. To absorb the cosmic energy, you need to be able to sense them first. This energy is spread around the earth. Even the stars in the universe has this energy. However most people can't detect the presence of the energy. As long as you can feel them, it'll be easy to absorb them. The talented people can sense the energies on their first day of training. The less talented fighters take up to one and a half years just to sense the energy.

This Technique is based on meditation and concentration, first adjusted the breathing and kept the position of the Wu Xin Xiang Tian technique. The Wu Xin (Five Hearts) refers to 'the two soles, the two palms, and the main artery in the head'. Relaxed and quiet, these were the two points that the Wu Xin Xiang Tian technique stressed the most in meditative state. According to the training guide, humans, starting from birth, were unable to absorb the energies. So in a state of starvation, when you absorb the energies for the first time, you absorb the highest amount. Which is also the time of the quickest strength boost. Once you pass the prospective fighter test, many people can start their genetic energy training. Even if you don't sense it consciously, your body slowly absorbs it unconsciously.

cultivation.title: Flesh And Blood Lifeform
cultivation.introText: Flesh and Blood Lifeform (血肉生命(Xiěròu shēngmìng) or 血肉类生命(Xiěròu lèi shēngmìng), lit. Flesh and Blood-type Lifeform) is one of the many types of lifeforms found in the Original Universe. It can be divided into many different types, such as Humans, Demons, and Space Beasts, and, according to Babata, is the strongest type of lifeform. All Flesh and Blood Lifeforms have a soul and Spirit Energy, and as they evolve, their physical body and their soul evolve at the same time. Flesh and Blood Lifeforms cannot house their life imprints within their bodies; their bodies and souls are separate until they become Immortal, at which point they fuse to form the Divine Body. Their intellect is far superior to that of Rock Lifeforms and Plant Lifeforms, but their bodies are inferior in terms of both exterior and interior body defense. The size of their Divine Bodies is normally related to their Life Gene Level.

cultivation.title: Genetic Energy
cultivation.introText: Genetic Energy (原力(yuán lì), lit. Original Power/Force, also referred to as 原能(yuán néng), lit. Original Energy, 基因原力(jīyīn yuán lì), lit. Genetic Original Power/Force, or 基因原能(jīyīn yuán néng), lit. Genetic Original Energy) is the original energy produced by the genes of a cultivator. When a cultivator's genes evolve to a certain level, they absorb Universe Energy, which becomes the cultivator's power, at which point it is called Genetic Energy.
cultivation.appearance:
Genetic Energy (原力(yuán lì), lit. Original Power/Force, also referred to as 原能(yuán néng), lit. Original Energy, 基因原力(jīyīn yuán lì), lit. Genetic Original Power/Force, or 基因原能(jīyīn yuán néng), lit. Genetic Original Energy) is the original energy produced by the genes of a cultivator. When a cultivator's genes evolve to a certain level, they absorb Universe Energy, which becomes the cultivator's power, at which point it is called Genetic Energy.

Genetic Energy is one of the sources of a Warrior's power; once they break through to Planetary Level, they can release their genetic energy outside their bodies (for example, Fa Er's flames). Additionally, this breakthrough physically changes their body, revealing their body's special ability (for example, Diamond Body). This is partially why a cultivator must break through to Planetary Level to be truly considered a Warrior. Genetic Energy is mainly split into the categories of metal (or gold), wood, water, fire, earth, wind, lightning, and light, each with subcategories. By training in Genetic Energy, one also increases the strength of their body, so Spirit Masters should also train in it, to create a powerful enough body to withstand their Spirit Energy.

Like Spirit Energy, Genetic Energy is flexible, and can be used to search areas, communicate, or even to block sound. In combat, Genetic Energy can be used to power Genetic Armor, can be maximized through Genetic Energy Weapons, and can even be shot out as an energy attack.

cultivation.appearance: A statue, over 10,000 kilometers long, of a sleeping beast god, with 90,729 scales. It exudes a terrifying pressure.

cultivation.title: God Country
cultivation.introText: When a World Master breaks through to Immortal, they fuse their Internal World with space fragments to transform it into a God Country, the lifeblood of an Immortal. It has a similar purpose to the Internal World of a World Master, but while World Masters will definitely die if their Internal World collapses, only the weaker Immortals would die if their God Country collapsed. However, even those that survive would have their powers greatly reduced, to the point here they would have no future; a God Country could be considered half of an Immortal's life! God Countries are integral to the strength of an Immortal, and as they get stronger, their God Countries also increase in strength. While within their God Country, an Immortal can exert even greater power, but it is dangerous to bring an enemy into one's God Country, as it gives them a chance to attack it.
cultivation.appearance:
When a World Master breaks through to Immortal, they fuse their Internal World with space fragments to transform it into a God Country, the lifeblood of an Immortal. It has a similar purpose to the Internal World of a World Master, but while World Masters will definitely die if their Internal World collapses, only the weaker Immortals would die if their God Country collapsed. However, even those that survive would have their powers greatly reduced, to the point here they would have no future; a God Country could be considered half of an Immortal's life! God Countries are integral to the strength of an Immortal, and as they get stronger, their God Countries also increase in strength. While within their God Country, an Immortal can exert even greater power, but it is dangerous to bring an enemy into one's God Country, as it gives them a chance to attack it.

God Countries are incredibly large; even the God Country of an ordinary Immortal like Black Dragon Immortal was capable of fitting a mountain range that exceeded 100,000 kilometers in height! Luo Feng's God Country was over 1 trillion kilometers in length, width, and height, rivaling many Universe Venerables!

God Countries also serve as the home of countless Humans. Most humans in the Original Universe actually live in God Countries, however, these humans have extremely limited potential due to the lack of Universe Energy within a God Country. Thus, the vast majority of humans within God Countries can only reach World Master. In the entire history of humanity, there have been 9,082 Immortals born in God Countries, but they all had miraculous encounters, without which they never would have broken through to Immortal.
cultivation.history:
The location of a God Country is dependent on the owner of the God Country, owners can build their God Countries anywhere in the Original Universe. Most of the time creators build their God Countries in their home Universe Country so that they can easily teleport to their Universe Country through God Country from anywhere in the Original Universe. God Country is built in the Space Slit, these slits are divided into tens of thousands of layers:

The first layer is the fragments.

The second layer is the God Country layer.

The third layer is the Space Current/Space Flood.

The space layers are terrifying space. The fragment layer was very close to the Origin Space, and its threat was small, World Masters normally could withstand this layer, The God Country level is more steady, and Immortals could normally survive within. The fragments in the God Country layer are much bigger, some have diameters of tens of thousands of km, some have 100 million km, etc. Even the powerful Immortals could die within the Space Current Layer, the deeper one went, the higher the threat is.

cultivation.title: God Emperor
cultivation.introText: God Emperor is the next cultivation realm after God King, but it is substantially different. While, regardless of one's strength, one can only be considered a God King after comprehending a Major Branch of a Great Dao, one can be considered a God Emperor if one has a God Emperor-level body or techniques. Unlike God Kings, who, upon breakthrough, use power from their newly transformed Miniature Universe to create a stronger Divine Body, a God Emperor must use their own methods to create a body stronger than their Ultimate God King body. As a result, it is normal for weaker God Emperors to have a body still at the Ultimate God King level.
cultivation.history:
Low-Level Hunyuan Lifeforms (低等浑源生命(Dī děng hún yuán shēngmìng)) are born to jump out of the cage, so their vitality and physical bodies are strong, generally superior to that of a cultivator at the same level. Like cultivators, they are split into different realms. Their bodies manifest multiple laws and mysteries surpassing the Complete Great Dao, making them good resources for cultivators, but some also have special talents, making them difficult prey. Since they have intelligence equivalent to True Gods of the Continent of Origin, they lack the ability to truly tap the potential of their bloodlines, capping their combat strength at the God Emperor-tier. The Cultivator Camp sends countless creatures at this level to the Billions of Cultivator Worlds in hopes of encouraging the emergence of new cultivators who can jump out of the cage. These lifeforms have a strict hierarchy with lower levels listening to the higher levels without hesitation, even if the highest levels do not care about the lower levels. Despite the obedience to the higher levels, the Early Stage and Middle Stage God Emperors are more willful and casual regarding the Perfect God Emperors, since they do not meet them often.

Early Stage God Emperor Low-Level Hunyuan Lifeforms (神帝前期低等浑源生命(Shén dì qiánqí dī děng hún yuán shēngmìng)) can survive battle with dozens of Bloodline Early Stage God Emperors and possibly kill some of them in the process. It is extremely difficult for Enlightened Early Stage God Emperors to defeat a creature at this level in a one-on-one battle, so they usually coordinate in groups of 3-5 to kill one. The corpses of creatures at this level are typically worth around 1 million Hunyuan Crystals and 1 Battle Merit, while those with special mysteries may cost millions of crystals. Small pieces cost hundreds of Hunyuan Crystals, a complete bloodlines or complete pieces costs tens of thousands of crystals, and an intact Life Core costs around 100,000 crystals. The vast majority of Low-Level Hunyuan Lifeforms near cultivator cities are at this level.

Middle Stage God Emperor Low-Level Hunyuan Lifeforms (神帝中期低等浑源生命(Shén dì zhōngqí dī děng hún yuán shēngmìng)) are difficult for Enlightened Middle Stage God Emperors to kill in a one-on-one battle. Generally, they would form a team with at least 3 experienced members, and at most 6 or 7, to hunt creatures at this level. Small pieces of their corpses cost thousands of Hunyuan Crystals, while their complete corpses are worth around 10 million crystals and 10 Battle Merits.

Late Stage God Emperor (神帝后期(Shén dì hòuqí)) Low-Level Hunyuan Lifeforms are valued by their tribe leaders. Small pieces of their corpses cost tens of thousands of Hunyuan Crystals, while their complete corpses are worth around 100 million crystals and 100 Battle Merits.

Perfect God Emperor (神帝圆满级(Shén dì yuánmǎn jí), lit. Perfect God Emperor-Level; also called Leaders (首领(Shǒulǐng))) only have to awaken one more step to break through to become a High-Level Hunyuan Lifeform. With their incredible physique and strong bloodlines, they are extremely difficult to kill - even for Enlightened Perfect God Emperor Cultivators - unless they have weapons and treasures refined by those who have jumped out of the cage. A bottle of ordinary blood at this level costs hundreds of thousands of Hunyuan Crystals, while their complete bloodlines cost tens of millions of crystals and are difficult to find in places like the Nine Rivers Holy World. A complete corpse of this level is worth around 1 billion hunyuan crystals and 1,000 Battle Merits. They serve as leaders of their lifeform's tribe and will join forces with each other to invade cultivator cities or fight against cultivators.

Super Limit Low-Level Hunyuan Lifeforms (超限级(Chāo xiàn jí), lit. Super/Over Limit Level; also called Kings (王(Wáng))) are those who lead groups of Perfect God Emperor lifeforms in their invasions of cultivator cities. They only have one chance to break into one of these cities, otherwise the stronger beings of related cultivator realms will be called to kill them. The destruction of cities like Yulan City is typically caused by the infiltration of creatures at this level. Super Limit-level creatures are considered the same level as Ultra Limit God Emperors and are equivalent to 20-30 Perfect God Emperors. Even Ultra Limit God Emperors require sufficient accumulation of comprehension and a suitable secret treasure to hunt creatures at this level in a one-on-one situation. Some creatures at this level may change their lifeforms and have innate abilities that Perfect God Emperor creatures do not have. A complete corpse of their level is worth about 10 billion Hunyuan Crystals or 10,000 Battle Merits, their bloodlines cost about 500 million crystals, and even scraps of their corpse materials are worth at least several million crystals each.

cultivation.title: God King
cultivation.introText: God King is the next tier of cultivation beyond Primal Chaos Sovereign, and is reached when a cultivator completely masters at least 1 Major Branch of a Great Dao. While a Chaos Sovereign can exhibit God King-level strength through extraordinary techniques, treasures, etc., they cannot be considered a God King until they have completely mastered at least 1 Major Branch.
cultivation.trivia: A strike from a First Level God King is equivalent to over 80,000 Intermediate Primal Chaos Sovereigns burning their Divine Power to their limits!

cultivation.title: Gold Soul Fruit
cultivation.introText: Gold Soul Fruit, a mysterious fruit that forms only once every 3,000 Eras, this fruit has a special quality that can change the Soul, making it able to accept more inheritance at Devil Mountain.
cultivation.appearance: Gold Soul Fruit, a mysterious fruit that forms only once every 3,000 Eras, this fruit has a special quality that can change the Soul, making it able to accept more inheritance at Devil Mountain.

cultivation.title: Grading System
cultivation.introText: In Swallowed Star, Items fall under grades, the lowest grade being A and the highest being Xeon Arcana. Each grade will be effective against a particular Cultivation level. Effective Level signifies the effective limit of an item against a character or an item, e.g. if a weapon is graded as B6 than it can hurt items and characters up to Stellar Level 6. Characters usually start using Treasures during Universe Venerable-level and above.
cultivation.appearance: Unlike the humans who used the metals and alloys in a more distinct way, which was easier to tell what sort of metals or alloys were used, humans had no way at all to tell just what the automaton construct was made of. Automaton Grading is different from Human Race grading. For example, a D1-9 Grade Automaton Ship will be regarded as a D9 ship by humans.

cultivation.title: Great Dao Diagram
cultivation.introText: The Great Dao Diagram is a treasure available for redemption in Infinite Space for 20,000 Reward Points. It can be used to deduce suitable secret methods and can analyze the Great Dao to assist in cultivation, greatly improving the efficiency of understanding the Great Dao. The weaker one is, the better the auxiliary effect of this treasure. It is relatively easy to use this to reach Pinnacle Second Level God King.
cultivation.appearance:
The Great Dao Diagram is a treasure available for redemption in Infinite Space for 20,000 Reward Points. It can be used to deduce suitable secret methods and can analyze the Great Dao to assist in cultivation, greatly improving the efficiency of understanding the Great Dao. The weaker one is, the better the auxiliary effect of this treasure. It is relatively easy to use this to reach Pinnacle Second Level God King.

This treasure comes with a dangerous reminder: The Great Dao Diagram cannot help one to master a Complete Great Dao, and if one uses it in the early stages of comprehending the Great Dao, the difficulty of comprehending the Complete Great Dao will become extremely high. If one only used this to deduce suitable secret methods, there will be no future troubles.

cultivation.title: Great Dao of Birth and Death
cultivation.introText: The Great Dao of Birth and Death (生灭大道(Shēng miè dàdào)) is an original Great Dao created by Luo Feng, using the Great Dao of the Life Origin and the Great Dao of the Destruction Origin as its foundation. Luo Feng's Complete Great Dao of Birth and Death comprises 9 Major Branches.
cultivation.appearance:
The Great Dao of Birth and Death (生灭大道(Shēng miè dàdào)) is an original Great Dao created by Luo Feng, using the Great Dao of the Life Origin and the Great Dao of the Destruction Origin as its foundation. Luo Feng's Complete Great Dao of Birth and Death comprises 9 Major Branches.

As a fusion Great Dao, it is far more powerful than an ordinary Great Dao. It has the benefits of both the Great Dao of Life and the Great Dao of Destruction, while using each Great Dao's strengths to make up for the other's weaknesses. Simply by comprehending 1 Major Branch of this Great Dao, one can be considered an extremely powerful First Level God King. A six-branch Second Level God King Technique of this Great Dao is comparable to an Ultimate God King Technique of an ordinary Great Dao, while a seven-branch technique surpasses even that!

The power of the Complete Great Dao of Birth and Death is comparable to that of an Early Stage God Emperor of an ordinary path, while the power of the Early Stage God Emperor of this path is comparable to that of a Late Stage God Emperor of an ordinary path! The power of a Middle Stage God Emperor of this path is comparable to that of a Perfect God Emperor of an ordinary path, while the power of a Late-Stage God Emperor of this path is superior to that of one who reaches Perfect God Emperor in two ordinary paths but does not fuse them. A Late-Stage God Emperor of this path can - after increasing their strength further - eventually be considered comparable to an Invincible God Emperor, even before reaching Perfect God Emperor in this path. Finally, the power of a Perfect God Emperor of this path is capable of killing a High-Level Hunyuan Lifeform who utilizes a trace of high-level Chaotic Origin Power!

cultivation.title: Great Dao of Hunyuan Rule Operation
cultivation.introText: The Hunyuan Rule Operation Dao (混源规则运转之道(Hùnyuán guīzé yùn zhuǎn zhī dào)) is an original Great Dao created by Overlord Yuan (元领主(Yuán Lǐngzhǔ)). It was formed through the systematic mastery and fusion of many complete Great Daos. Yuan first fully comprehended 9 Great Daos within his Source World. By the time he became an Overlord, he had fully comprehended 11 Great Daos. At the time of Luo Feng's rise as an Overlord, Yuan had comprehended 25 Complete Great Daos.
cultivation.appearance:
The Hunyuan Rule Operation Dao (混源规则运转之道(Hùnyuán guīzé yùn zhuǎn zhī dào)) is an original Great Dao created by Overlord Yuan (元领主(Yuán Lǐngzhǔ)). It was formed through the systematic mastery and fusion of many complete Great Daos. Yuan first fully comprehended 9 Great Daos within his Source World. By the time he became an Overlord, he had fully comprehended 11 Great Daos. At the time of Luo Feng's rise as an Overlord, Yuan had comprehended 25 Complete Great Daos.

The Hunyuan Rule Operation Dao represents a unique cultivation path centered on the mastery and synergistic integration of multiple "Great Daos." Rather than focusing on perfecting a single specialized concept, practitioners of this Dao achieve breakthroughs by flawlessly orchestrating a diverse array of distinct Daos, forming a comprehensive operational system. Thus, it is also called Hunyuan Rule Circulation Path.

The core principle of this path is its capacity for continuous growth: as a practitioner comprehends and incorporates additional Daos into their established system, their overall power and effectiveness are perpetually enhanced, allowing for a consistent escalation of strength. The Hunyuan  Rule Operation Dao is a unique and powerful cultivation path defined by its focus on the mastery and synergistic integration of numerous individual Daos, rather than specializing in a single one. Practitioners of this Dao achieve their higher states by perfectly orchestrating a multitude of lesser Daos, forming a comprehensive "Hunyuan Rule Operating System." The fundamental strength of this path lies in its capacity for continuous growth: as more Daos are comprehended and seamlessly woven into the existing system, the practitioner's overall power and effectiveness are perpetually enhanced.

After enlightened by Overlord Luo Feng comprehension in Origin System of Life and Death Hunyuan Dao, he too was delving into the Origin System of this Dao as the fundamental of breakthrough in his comprehensive methods and techniques. He admitted that he is about to breakthrough in his Dao before the territory expanse begins.

cultivation.title: Great Dao of the Blade
cultivation.introText: Chaotic Origin Blade Dao is a Great Dao pioneered by Luo Feng considering the importance of powerful and destructive capability he should have to complement the Great Dao of Birth and Death flaws and weaknesses. It appears that he has been inspired since comprehending Void-Severing Blade that contains another way of merging Great Dao of Life and Great Dao of Destruction into one Dao with Destruction as a core and Life as supplement.

cultivation.title: Great Dao of the Causality Origin
cultivation.introText: The Great Dao of the Causality Origin (因果本源大道(Yīnguǒ běnyuán dàdào)) is one of the Great Daos that can be followed to become a God King. Those who follow this Great Dao have mysterious techniques, and with enough ability, one can use causality to determine the location or other details of others. Along with the Great Dao of the Extreme Origin and Great Dao of the Unlimited Origin, it is relatively difficult to start cultivating, and relatively few God Kings do so.

A Sector Beast King naturally masters this Great Dao when they grow to their limit. This Great Dao is the most commonly cultivated of the 9 in the Caged World of Swallowed Star.

cultivation.title: Great Dao of the Illusory and Real Worlds
cultivation.introText: The Great Dao of the Illusory and Real Worlds (虚幻和真实世界大道(Xūhuàn hé zhēnshí shìjiè dàdào)) is a prospective Great Dao that can be followed to become a God King. Ancestor Yuan is attempting to create this Great Dao through the fusion of the Great Dao of the World Origin and the Great Dao of the Virtual Realm. The Caged World of Swallowed Star does not have the Great Dao of the Virtual Realm in its Supreme Operation Laws, making it difficult to cultivate in that Great Dao, so one can imagine the difficulty of creating this entirely new Great Dao in the world of Swallowed Star.

cultivation.title: Great Dao of the Life Origin
cultivation.introText: The Great Dao of the Life Origin (生命本源大道(Shēngmìng běnyuán dàdào)) is one of the Great Daos that can be followed to become a God King. It has 6 major branches, each closely related to each other, and is incredibly powerful. The Complete Great Dao of Life is also the true core of the Original Universe. God Kings who master one of these branches typically have incredible life-saving abilities, but slightly inferior combat strength. This is the best Great Dao to use to cultivate one's physical body and thus change the foundation of one's Divine Body.
cultivation.appearance:
The Great Dao of the Life Origin (生命本源大道(Shēngmìng běnyuán dàdào)) is one of the Great Daos that can be followed to become a God King. It has 6 major branches, each closely related to each other, and is incredibly powerful. The Complete Great Dao of Life is also the true core of the Original Universe. God Kings who master one of these branches typically have incredible life-saving abilities, but slightly inferior combat strength. This is the best Great Dao to use to cultivate one's physical body and thus change the foundation of one's Divine Body.

Cultivators who reach a sufficient level of comprehension in this Great Dao can master clone techniques, but they are not at the same level as those who practice the Great Dao of the Space Origin or the Great Dao of the Time Origin. Clone techniques from this Great Dao can create an unlimited number of clones, but these clones are each split off from the original self.

cultivation.title: Great Dao of the Matter Origin
cultivation.introText: The Great Dao of the Matter Origin (物质本源大道(Wùzhí běnyuán dàdào)) is one of the Great Daos that can be followed to become a God King. A cultivator who masters this dao could combine it with comprehension of the Great Dao of the Life Origin to create Body-Refining Techniques similar to Luo Feng's Transformation Methods. This Great Dao has 8 Major Branches. Cultivators of this dao can have bodies with incredible resilience, seeming to be indestructible.

cultivation.title: Great Dao of the Space Origin
cultivation.introText: The Great Dao of the Space Origin (空间本源大道(Kōngjiān běnyuán dàdào)) is one of the Great Daos that can be followed to become a God King. Powerful cultivators who follow this Great Dao are even able to teleport in the heavily suppressed space of the Continent of Origin, and are known for their speed. There are 9 Major Branches of this Great Dao.
cultivation.appearance:
The Great Dao of the Space Origin (空间本源大道(Kōngjiān běnyuán dàdào)) is one of the Great Daos that can be followed to become a God King. Powerful cultivators who follow this Great Dao are even able to teleport in the heavily suppressed space of the Continent of Origin, and are known for their speed. There are 9 Major Branches of this Great Dao.

Cultivators who reach a sufficient level of comprehension in this Great Dao can master clone techniques that surpass those of masters of the Great Dao of the Life Origin. They can break through some limitations of the Caged World, allowing them to create multiple complete clones that are equivalent to the main body, with a complete body and soul. However, the number of clones they can cultivate is limited.

With sufficient comprehension of this Great Dao, one can detect fluctuations within the void (including the locations of items and lifeforms), become ethereal (heavily reducing incoming damage), and some utilize formations for various purposes, including refining their body and performing attacks.

There are a number of similarities between this Great Dao and the Great Dao of the Void Origin, including cloning, spatial abilities, and merging/hiding within the void.

cultivation.title: Great Dao of the Thunder Origin
cultivation.introText: The Great Dao of the Thunder Origin (雷霆本源大道(Léitíng běnyuán dàdào)) is one of the Great Daos that can be followed to become a God King. Unfortunately for those of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom, this Great Dao does not exist in the Supreme Operation Laws of the Caged World of Swallowed Star. This makes it very difficult for its cultivators to follow the Chaotic Origin Bloodline of the Thunder Lineage.

cultivation.title: Great Dao of the Time Origin
cultivation.introText: The Great Dao of the Time Origin (时间本源大道(Shíjiān běnyuán dàdào)) is one of the Great Daos that can be followed to become a God King. There are 3 Major Branches of this Great Dao.
cultivation.appearance:
The Great Dao of the Time Origin (时间本源大道(Shíjiān běnyuán dàdào)) is one of the Great Daos that can be followed to become a God King. There are 3 Major Branches of this Great Dao.

Cultivators who reach a sufficient level of comprehension in this Great Dao can master powerful clone techniques surpassing those who master the Great Dao of the Life Origin, creating clones that can exist in the past, present, and future. Including the original body, cultivators who master clone techniques through this Great Dao can only have 3 bodies in total, but each is a complete body and soul, each at their peak strength, and can exist in different timelines.

This Great Dao has the fewest God King practitioners of any Great Dao in the Caged World of Swallowed Star. Those who reach Second Level God King in this dao are able to simultaneously travel through the past, present, and future.

cultivation.title: Great Dao of the Unlimited Origin
cultivation.introText: The Great Dao of the Unlimited Origin (无量本源大道(Wúliàng běnyuán dàdào)) is one of the Great Daos that can be followed to become a God King. Those who practice this Great Dao can acquire an ability known as the Body of the Unlimited (无量之躯(Wúliàng zhī qū)), which appears to be different than the Infinite Divine Body (无限神体(Wúxiàn shéntǐ)). Cultivators in this Great Dao can also learn clone techniques, capable of creating an unlimited number of clones.
cultivation.appearance:

Cultivators in this Great Dao can also learn clone techniques, capable of creating an unlimited number of clones.

In a head-on confrontation, this Great Dao is superior to the Great Dao of the Life Origin. Like the Great Dao of the Matter Origin, one can use this Great Dao to achieve the artistic conception of being indestructible and endless. It includes the use of many energies, including thunder, fire, wind, and earth, and can even convert matter to energy. Along with the Great Dao of the Causality Origin and the Great Dao of the Extreme Origin, it is relatively difficult to start cultivating, and relatively few God Kings do so.

cultivation.title: Great Dao of the Virtual Realm
cultivation.introText: The Great Dao of the Virtual Realm (虚界大道(Xū jiè dàdào)) is one of the Great Daos that can be followed to become a God King. The Caged World of Swallowed Star does not have this Great Dao in its Supreme Operation Laws, making it difficult to cultivate in inheritances of this Great Dao. Cultivators following this Great Dao can create clone techniques, making this a good Great Dao for life-preservation. Cultivating in this Great Dao can extend toward the path of the soul and can also provide a path to comprehending the Great Dao of the World Origin.

cultivation.title: Great Dao of the World Origin
cultivation.introText: The Great Dao of the World Origin (世界本源大道(Shìjiè běnyuán dàdào)) is one of the Great Daos that can be followed to become a God King, and is one of the 9 in the Caged World of Swallowed Star. Powerful cultivators in this path have strong life-preservation abilities. Some also have the ability to change their body into a world form, allowing them to form an avatar body anywhere within that world, gathering the power of the world. Cultivators in this Great Dao generally cannot create clone techniques.

As a Fusion Dao, it is incredibly powerful, but much more difficult to cultivate than other Great Daos. Xing Mang has created two Hunyuan Dao versions of this path, one comprising 9 parts Space and 1 part Time, and the other comprising 7 parts time and 3 parts Space.

cultivation.title: Great Daos
cultivation.introText: The Great Daos (大道(Dàdào)) are paths that cultivators can follow to become God Kings, and they serve as the foundation for their respective Caged Worlds. In the Caged World of Swallowed Star, there are 9 Great Daos. The Great Daos are also connected, and many have overlapping components. Before one breaks through to God King, the Great Daos are invisible and intangible, so they can only be seen through indirect methods. Some God Kings personally show the Great Dao to their disciples, the Ancient Kingdoms provide opportunities to their elites to view the Great Daos, some rare treasures can manifest part of the Great Dao, and if one is able to control the Original Universe, they can view the Great Dao of the Life Origin.
cultivation.appearance:
The Great Daos (大道(Dàdào)) are paths that cultivators can follow to become God Kings, and they serve as the foundation for their respective Caged Worlds. In the Caged World of Swallowed Star, there are 9 Great Daos. The Great Daos are also connected, and many have overlapping components. Before one breaks through to God King, the Great Daos are invisible and intangible, so they can only be seen through indirect methods. Some God Kings personally show the Great Dao to their disciples, the Ancient Kingdoms provide opportunities to their elites to view the Great Daos, some rare treasures can manifest part of the Great Dao, and if one is able to control the Original Universe, they can view the Great Dao of the Life Origin.

Each Great Dao comprises multiple Major Branches (大分支(Dà fēnzhī)). The Major Branches are connected to each other, and have their own sub-components and mysteries. When a cultivator has completely comprehended and merged those sub-components and mysteries into one Major Branch, they break through to God King, and are considered First Level God Kings. First Level God Kings are able to glimpse part of that Great Dao, allowing them to work on comprehending other Major Branches.

Once one can completely merge 2 or more Major Branches, they are qualified to be a Second Level God King. Merely mastering all Major Branches of a Great Dao is not sufficient for one to be considered a Second Level God King. Second Level God Kings are able to glimpse the Complete Great Dao, allowing them to mobilize the power of the Great Dao to a certain extent.

By mastering and completely merging all Major Branches of a Great Dao, a cultivator can recreate the Complete Great Dao (完整的大道(Wánzhěng de dàdào)). A cultivator who completes this is considered an Ultimate God King (or Third Level God King), capable of becoming an Emperor of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom or a Monarch of the Thunder Ancient Kingdom.

God Kings who complete this step are stronger than those who become Ultimate God King lifeforms through external resources (such as Hunyuan Bloodline). They are not affected by causality, and their actions leave no trace. With their Complete Great Dao, they can weaken all attacks, including Willpower attacks! Every Origin World master of a Complete Great Dao is considered a promising talent, and is met by Overlord Yuan.

Fusion Great Daos (大道融合(Dàdào rónghé), lit. Great Dao Fusion) do not exist in the Supreme Operation Laws of a Caged World. They are manually created by cultivators in the path of creating the Dao most suited for themselves. Fusion Great Daos are incredibly powerful, as they take components of individual Great Daos and combine them, similar to how the fusion of Original Laws results in much greater power than an individual law. The power of a Fusion Great Dao can vary, but starts out by being one level higher than a standard Great Dao (i.e. a First Level God King technique in a Fusion Great Dao would be the equivalent of a Second Level God King technique of an ordinary Great Dao). Eventually, the power of a Fusion Dao can cross cultivation realms; Luo Feng's Ultimate God King-level Great Dao of Birth and Death had the strength of an Enlightened Early Stage God Emperor!

Due to the complexities in fusing daos, if one's foundations are not sound or one follows the wrong path along the way, a Fusion Dao can reach a dead end, resulting in the cultivator having to start over or attempt another method. Fusion Dao practitioners who reach Perfect God Emperor in their Fusion Dao have incredible value in the Cultivator Camp; when Luo Feng did so, he became only the 93rd in the history of the cultivators!

cultivation.title: Heart of Evolution
cultivation.introText: The Heart of Evolution is a special resource used to evolve an Intelligent Life, allowing it to fully integrate with a metal body under its control. Through this integration, the Intelligent Life then becomes a member of the Automaton Race, capable of Original Laws comprehension comparable to a Human Race powerhouse.
cultivation.appearance:
The Heart of Evolution is a special resource used to evolve an Intelligent Life, allowing it to fully integrate with a metal body under its control. Through this integration, the Intelligent Life then becomes a member of the Automaton Race, capable of Original Laws comprehension comparable to a Human Race powerhouse.

Without a Heart of Evolution, an Intelligent Life can never breakthrough to Immortal, but even with it, while reaching World Master is easy, it is still difficult to breakthrough to Immortal. Through further training, the automaton's body would continue to strengthen, increasing in flexibility, toughness, and other aspects, similar to a true flesh body.

The Heart of Evolution can be considered the most important treasure of the Automaton Race, and thus was extremely difficult for other races to acquire. Control of these items is very strict; the race is forbidden from selling it, and that rule is deeply embedded in their cores.

cultivation.title: Heart of Stars
cultivation.introText: The heart of stars, is a legendary item. In the vast universe, several Planets that have the ability to produce and sustain life, for example plant life, beasts, humans, life planets. These life planets all have a limited life span, when one life planet grows old, its core would gather all of its remaining life energy into a crystal forming the heart of stars.

cultivation.introText: Breaking out of the cage is both massive qualitative and quantitative change. No matter how many of Low-Level Chaotic Origin Lifeforms or God Emperors there are, they are powerless to fight back when facing a true High Level Chaotic Origin Lifeform that isn't imprisoned.
cultivation.appearance: High-grade Chaotic Origin Lifeform (高等浑源生命)
cultivation.trivia:
The only way to become High Chaotic Origin Lifeform is to rely on Ultimate Awakening of the potential of High-Level Chaotic Origin Bloodline (as the other 2 method to break out of cage will directly bring Cultivator to the level above High-grade Chaotic Origin Lifeform).

Cultivator can either directly refine High-Level Chaotic Origin Bloodline into their body then slowly tap into the potential of bloodline or first try to comprehend mystery of the bloodline then refine it into their body.

According to the experience of the predecessors, if Cultivator can comprehend 70% of the Chaotic Origin Bloodline, then refine it into the body to directly breakthrough, the memory pollution and spiritual will pollution can be suppressed to a relatively low level. It could also ensure one to reach Perfect-Stage High Chaotic Origin Lifeform.

If Cultivator can comprehend 50% of the Chaotic Origin Bloodline, one can try to refine it into their body then spend time trying to tap into potential of the bloodline. Thus, one will have a good chance of achieving Ultimate Awakening of Bloodline.

cultivation.title: Highest-Level Powers
cultivation.introText: Highest-Level Power (最高层次力量(Zuìgāo céngcì lìliàng))
cultivation.appearance: The Highest-Level Powers serves the same role for Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms as the Hunyuan Daos for Overlords, but with a key difference: these powers are innately bestowed and woven to their very existence, whereas Overlords must comprehend and construct their Dao from the scratch through arduous cultivation. Different clans or species of Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms are born with unique innate abilities. Those who refine their powers to the extreme can ascend to become Hunyuan Ancestors. Rare beings are even born as Ancestors, possessing the Highest-Level Powers from birth—they need only learn to fully control it. Ancestors cannot comprehend or cultivate any Dao; instead, they can only grow stronger by deepening their mastery over their innate power. If perfected, some can reach an undying state—becoming truly immortal and nearly impossible to destroy, even by Overlords.

cultivation.title: Immortal
cultivation.introText:
This is a section added primarily due to the difference between the English-fan translation of the Novel and the true Chinese meaning.
Original Chinese characters: 不朽 (bùxiǔ) could be translated as either Immortal or less common Undying. Most importantly these characters are present in all its 3 major sub-tiers.
The main gimmick of this Cultivation Realm is its lifespan and in such cases Immortal is more commonly used. However this is just a preference the following translations are the real problem.
cultivation.appearance:
This is a section added primarily due to the difference between the English-fan translation of the Novel and the true Chinese meaning.
Original Chinese characters: 不朽 (bùxiǔ) could be translated as either Immortal or less common Undying. Most importantly these characters are present in all its 3 major sub-tiers.
The main gimmick of this Cultivation Realm is its lifespan and in such cases Immortal is more commonly used. However this is just a preference the following translations are the real problem.

Immortal Army Lord: 不朽军主(bùxiǔ jūn zhǔ). Now 军主 means either Army Lord or Military Lord and refers to the chief general of an army. So it could also be called General. So this term is actually consistent with the English Novel.

Immortal Marquis: 封侯不朽(fēng hóu bùxiǔ). Now 封侯 looking at each character individually it refers to either being granted a noble title or a marquis title. Together these two characters refer to a Marquis or a any Feudal Vassal, not just a Marquis. The English fan translation called this tier "Official". An Official is someone employed by the Imperial Court and does jobs for them, whereas a Feudal Vassal is a Vassal and as such land owner. In the case of a Marquis he is even tasked with defending a border region.

Immortal King: 封王不朽(fēng wáng bùxiǔ). Now 封王 refers to being granted the title of king. (wáng)王 is unique to Kings. The title of Emperor 皇帝 (huángdì) was created by the first Emperor in China, Qin Shi Huang, and served as a differentiation to the normal title of King. Furthermore Emperors can have Kings as Vassals, whereas Kings cannot. As such there is a vast difference between King and Emperor which the fan-translation ignored.

The English Fan-Translation Novel terms:

Undying Official

As both Official and Emperor are wrong, we chose to completely adapt the Chinese (Both Army Lord and General are fine). Between Immortal and Undying it's just a preference to go for the more commonly used word and the more commonly translated word from 不朽. Nonetheless they are quite similar.
cultivation.personality:
King Zhenyan - Immortal King

Immortal can be considered the lowest tier of a true great being. As the name implies, those who reach Immortal level do not die of natural causes; if they are not killed, they will not die until the universe in which they dwell is destroyed. Immortals are fundamentally different from World Masters, with bodies naturally capable of light-speed travel, and formed of Immortal Energy that allows them to manipulate their size at will. If a normal Immortal focuses all of their strength in a single attack, they can completely destroy a planet!

As their breakthrough is contingent on mastery of at least one of the Original Laws, their bodies literally contain law energy. Every Immortal can be considered a master of at least the law they used to breakthrough. They are granted the ability to use a Law Domain corresponding to the law they used to breakthrough. As they increase their comprehension of the associated Upper Law, they can also infuse that law in their law domain, but this requires comprehension at least the equivalent of the 13th level of the Tong Tian Bridge.

Due to their Immortal Energy containing both their Genetic Energy and Spirit Energy, all Immortals can perform and have an innate defense to Soul Attacks, making it incredibly difficult for a World Master to damage them through Soul Attacks. Additionally, the fusion of life and soul imprints meant that if an Immortal lost part of their body, they could distinctly sense that body part, even if it was taken tens of light-years away! Their bodies, formed by Immortal Energy, could also be burned to amplify their strength a thousandfold, aiding them in attacking or escaping. However, since the Immortal Energy contains their soul imprints, this was used only when necessary, otherwise they would weaken themselves too much.

When a World Master becomes an Immortal their World Master World transforms into a God Country. A God Country serves as part of the foundation of an Immortal's strength, and their evolution results in the evolution of their God Country. Obtaining a God Country grants one the use of God Country Transmission to locations at which they have left imprints of their Immortal Energy.

Immortals are much wealthier than World Masters, with even the weakest of them having around 10,000 Mixed Yuan Units of wealth on average. Ordinary Human Immortals are typically 4 star clients of Universe Star River Bank and/or Universe First Bank, while stronger ones would be 5 star clients. Immortal Army Lords and Marquises typically use F Grade spaceships, while Immortal Kings may have G Grade spaceships, spaceships merged with living creatures (like Metal Lifeforms), or even Palace Treasures if they are particularly powerful or lucky.

Rather than having galaxies as their territory, they typically have their own Starfield and run their own medium-sized civilized nation! If they lack ambition, they can simply live as the absolute ruler of their starfield, only respecting the authority of high-ranking members of high-level civilized nations and great powers, such as the Virtual Universe Company (VUC).

As they increase in strength, they may become high-ranking members of Universe Countries and their equivalents for other races, or join great powers. Even an Immortal Marquis like Hu Yan Bo had some level of fame within the Ganwu Universe Country, and those Immortal Marquises with adequate ties to Universe Venerables may call themselves Kings (despite not being Immortal Kings).

Immortal Kings typically belong to only the most powerful of organizations, such as the VUC, but some may choose to reign as solo powers, beholden only to those organizations with relatively loose conditions, such as the Hongmeng or battlefield alliance groups; for example, King Blood Devil and King Black Razor. They are able to build reputations that spread beyond a single Universe Country, and the strongest among them have a bit of status even among the greatest powers in the Original Universe.
cultivation.trivia:
There are two ways to kill an Immortal:

Soul Destruction: This way is achieved by destroying all the Soul Imprints in an Immortal's Body. While their Divine Power will not be lost in this way, after having destroyed (almost) all Soul Imprints, the body will die naturally after a while, similar to being poisoned. To be able to achieve this step, first of all, there must be a large gap in strength, and secondly, the Killer must be extremely proficient in soul attack methods. As such typically only Spirit Masters are able to perform this. Furthermore the User could also enslave the opponent instead of killing him by turning him into a loyal Soul Slave.

Energy Annihilation: This way is achieved by continuously annihilating the opponents body and Divine Power. Pure energy consumption, which continuously annihilates the opponent's immortal power into nothingness. When an immortal is completely annihilated, without a trace of energy left, a natural death is no longer possible, they will simply vanish with no trace remaining. To be able to achieve this method, first of all, the User must have an overwhelming advantage in Strength, and secondly, he himself needs to consume an astonishing amount of divine power.

cultivation.title: Immortal Body
cultivation.introText: Immortal Body (不死之身, Bùsǐ zhī shēn, lit. Undying or Immortal Body) is a level of body generally reached by those who reach the Immortal Marquis level. When one breaks through to Immortal, they acquire a Divine Body. At that point, the cultivator's soul begins to meld with the body, with every bit of spirit imprint fusing with their cells. This meant that it would be impossible to clearly see the cultivator's soul, so one would not be able to determine their original race. This also made it so that if an Immortal's body was destroyed once, they could reform their body. However, most Immortals below Immortal Marquis do not have the true level of Immortal Body; their spirit imprints and cell formation are not yet perfect, so if one repeatedly killed their body or launched a powerful enough attack to completely annihilate them, they cannot reform their body.
cultivation.appearance:
Immortal Body (不死之身, Bùsǐ zhī shēn, lit. Undying or Immortal Body) is a level of body generally reached by those who reach the Immortal Marquis level. When one breaks through to Immortal, they acquire a Divine Body. At that point, the cultivator's soul begins to meld with the body, with every bit of spirit imprint fusing with their cells. This meant that it would be impossible to clearly see the cultivator's soul, so one would not be able to determine their original race. This also made it so that if an Immortal's body was destroyed once, they could reform their body. However, most Immortals below Immortal Marquis do not have the true level of Immortal Body; their spirit imprints and cell formation are not yet perfect, so if one repeatedly killed their body or launched a powerful enough attack to completely annihilate them, they cannot reform their body.

This is different for those Immortals who have reached the true level of Immortal Body. At this level, every cell of their body has been infused with their Immortal Energy, so even if their bodies are destroyed, as long as one cell remains, they can absorb energy to reform their body. To kill an Immortal with the true Immortal Body, one would have to use a soul attack (such as how Hu Yan Bo was killed) or complete annihilation, caused by an absolute power gap and done through the expenditure of a large amount of energy (such as how Si Fan Qi killed Yao Hai). Certain special treasures (such as the Shi Wu Wings) could destroy part of a true Immortal Body if they were triggered, even by a user who was not an Immortal.

cultivation.title: Immortal Energy
cultivation.introText: Immortal Energy (不朽之力, Bùxiǔ zhī lì, lit. Immortal Power/Energy/Force) is the foundation of an Immortal's Divine Body, the fusion of their soul with their body. Immortals' Immortal energy also contains the law energies of the Original Law they used to break through, which makes it extremely difficult for Immortals to study laws by which they were not recognized. As a result of their energy form, Immortals can change the size of their bodies at will, although this has a dramatic impact on their power. Immortals use Immortal Energy to reform their Divine Bodies when they are damaged, and they can use Immortal Energy to launch material or soul attacks. Immortal Energy has unique qualities, it can only be stopped by special materials, and it can be used to scan areas, or condensed to create items like Fire God Origin Crystals. Immortals can burn their Divine Bodies, using the Immortal Energy as fuel, to instantly increase their power, but this is equivalent to burning some of one's soul, so they rarely do so.

cultivation.title: Infinite Divine Body
cultivation.introText: Infinite Divine Body (无限神体(wúxiàn shéntǐ), lit. Unlimited/Infinite/Boundless Divine Body) is a stage of Divine Body reached by those who break through to True God through the Divine Power Path and reach a Life Gene Level of 90,000. While the body is theoretically infinite, in the Original Universe/Universe Ocean, True Gods are limited to a Divine Body of 12 light-years. On the Continent of Origin, Eternal True Gods with an Infinite Divine Body can reach a maximum height of 3.6 billion kilometers, while God Kings can reach a max height of 36 trillion kilometers. It is implied that Primal Chaos Sovereigns with an Infinite Divine Body can reach 360 billion kilometers in height.
cultivation.appearance:

Unlimited/Infinite/Boundless Divine Body) is a stage of Divine Body reached by those who break through to True God through the Divine Power Path and reach a Life Gene Level of 90,000. While the body is theoretically infinite, in the Original Universe/Universe Ocean, True Gods are limited to a Divine Body of 12 light-years. On the Continent of Origin, Eternal True Gods with an Infinite Divine Body can reach a maximum height of 3.6 billion kilometers, while God Kings can reach a max height of 36 trillion kilometers. It is implied that Primal Chaos Sovereigns with an Infinite Divine Body can reach 360 billion kilometers in height.

While their true bodies are limited to those heights (and thus their Divine Power is limited to the volume contained in those heights), cultivators with an Infinite Divine Body can make their bodies smaller or larger (as long as they can handle the environment's suppression) without any change in their actual strength, unlike those with ordinary Divine Bodies. Cultivators following the Bloodline Cultivation Method can develop bodies with similar strength if they have sufficient talent, while those who follow the Chaotic Origin Bloodline path or have exceptional body-refining techniques may be able to match or exceed the power of the Infinite Divine Body.

This was the goal of Jin God King's creation of the Flame God Race. He would have the most talented born in this Human Race develop the Infinite Divine Body and be an assistant for his revenge. He also planned to reincarnate and break through to True God with this level of Divine Body.

cultivation.title: Intelligent Life
cultivation.introText: Intelligent Life (智能生命, Zhìnéng shēngmìng, lit. Intelligent/Smart Life, also called Living AI in the fan translation) is one of the many types of lifeforms in Swallowed Star. Intelligent Life is an evolution of Artificial Intelligence (AI), capable of feeling emotions and cultivating, the product of an already intelligent AI experiencing many things and existing for a long time. As such, they are relatively rare. As an artificial intelligence, it has no Spirit Energy, and can thus neither perform nor be harmed by Soul Attacks. Intelligent Life can live forever, even if their bodies are destroyed, but they require a physical body (or other entity, like a spaceship) to perform physical actions.

As Intelligent Life is an evolution of AI, it can perform all actions that AI can, such as connecting to the Virtual Universe, operating Spaceships, connect to the internet, etc. Since they are essentially incredibly powerful computer programs, they are very stubborn in sticking to their programming. Their mental calculation capacity far exceeds that of other forms of life; other species have to become Immortal to reach the calculation speed of lower-level Intelligent Life.

Every member of the Automaton Race is an Intelligent Life, which is why their technology far exceeds that of any other race.
