cultivation.title: Law Domain
cultivation.introText: Law Domain is a technique that Immortals obtain after breaking through to Immortal. To break through to Immortal, one generally has to fully comprehend one of the Original Laws; the Law Domain they obtain corresponds to that Original Law. It is unclear if lifeforms that breakthrough without law comprehension (such as the Cloud Vine) obtain a Law Domain corresponding to the law with which they are infused.
cultivation.appearance:
Law Domain is a technique that Immortals obtain after breaking through to Immortal. To break through to Immortal, one generally has to fully comprehend one of the Original Laws; the Law Domain they obtain corresponds to that Original Law. It is unclear if lifeforms that breakthrough without law comprehension (such as the Cloud Vine) obtain a Law Domain corresponding to the law with which they are infused.

The initial Law Domain of an Immortal is stronger than the World Projection of a normal Pinnacle World Master; if the two clashed, typically the World Projection would instantly crumble. Certain World Masters (such as Golden Horned Beasts) have a stronger World Projection due to their abilities or Life Gene Level, but generally even these can only barely withstand Law Domain. The Law Domain of Immortals below Universe Venerable appears to be about 10,000 kilometers in diameter, while a Universe Venerable's is about 100 million kilometers in diameter.

Law Domain is a versatile technique, it can be used to simply weaken an opponent and strengthen oneself, to scan areas at a higher level than a Scanning Device, or combined with domain-type Heavy Treasures or Arcana to augment their abilities.

While the initial Law Domain of an Immortal consists solely of the Original Law they fully comprehended to break through to Immortal, as an Immortal's Law of Time  or Law of Space  increased, they could add time law or space law to their Law Domain, or they could use a domain of just time or space law. In order to begin using time law or space law in their Law Domain, Immortals needed time or space law comprehension at the 12th level of the Tong Tian Bridge.

Since (presumably) all Immortals possess Law Domain, they generally do not use it in battles against Immortals of the same tier. However, as it is far superior to World Projection, which is far superior to Domain, Immortals can generally use it to easily handle World Masters, and can absolutely use it to easily handle Domain Master or lower cultivators. Immortals who are on a higher tier than their opponent may also use it against them (i.e. a Universe Venerable fighting an Immortal King or an Immortal Marquis fighting an Immortal).

cultivation.title: Life Gene
cultivation.introText: Life Gene Level (生命基因层次, Shēngmìng jīyīn céngcì, lit. Life Gene Level, also seen as 基因方面, Jīyīn Fāngmiàn, lit. Gene Aspect, or 生命层次, Shēngmìng céngcì, lit. Life Level, or 基因进化, Jīyīn jìnhuà, lit. Gene Evolution, or 基因层次, Jīyīn céngcì, lit. Gene Level) can be considered the summation of the foundation of an organism. Within each race there are differing levels of genetic quality; when Luo Feng, Hong, and Lei Shen meet Ming Yu, he explains that the tens of millions of races within the Human Race are sorted into 10 large groups, with the highest-quality group reaching Domain Master at maturity and the lowest grade (such as Earthling) reaching nothing at maturity. While using things like bloodline catalysts to evolve the quality of one's Bloodline is possible, this is still different from the Life Gene Level of an individual. As an individual cultivates to World Master, their cells grow and evolve, and in the end, without any means of augmentation or evolution, all of the Human Race reaches the same foundation level at the pinnacle World Master.
cultivation.appearance:
Life Gene Level (生命基因层次, Shēngmìng jīyīn céngcì, lit. Life Gene Level, also seen as 基因方面, Jīyīn Fāngmiàn, lit. Gene Aspect, or 生命层次, Shēngmìng céngcì, lit. Life Level, or 基因进化, Jīyīn jìnhuà, lit. Gene Evolution, or 基因层次, Jīyīn céngcì, lit. Gene Level) can be considered the summation of the foundation of an organism. Within each race there are differing levels of genetic quality; when Luo Feng, Hong, and Lei Shen meet Ming Yu, he explains that the tens of millions of races within the Human Race are sorted into 10 large groups, with the highest-quality group reaching Domain Master at maturity and the lowest grade (such as Earthling) reaching nothing at maturity. While using things like bloodline catalysts to evolve the quality of one's Bloodline is possible, this is still different from the Life Gene Level of an individual. As an individual cultivates to World Master, their cells grow and evolve, and in the end, without any means of augmentation or evolution, all of the Human Race reaches the same foundation level at the pinnacle World Master.

However, across races, species, etc. this limit is different. The story treats the human race's Life Gene Level as the standard, essentially you can say that a human pinnacle World Master without any encounters, augmentation, etc., has a Life Gene Level of 1. Different species have a Life Gene Level equal or higher than this (we never see anyone with a Life Gene Level lower than 1); the Golden Horned Beast race has a Life Gene Level of 10, so 10 times that of a human. Life Gene Level may also be related to the Lifespan; for example, the Golden Horned Beast can live 10 times longer than a human. The Imperial Clans of the Demon Race also exceed that of humans; we explicitly learn that the Sky Wolf race has a Life Gene Level of 6. Generally speaking, the higher the Life Gene Level, the larger the body. Individuals can work to increase their Life Gene Level, but without something that breaks the Universe Operation Rules, there are still limits. For example, ordinary lifeforms can only reach a Life Gene Level of 100, but Special Lifeforms have a limit of 10,081 times. If one could perform Possession on a Special Lifeform, they could increase their limit from 100 to 10,081. According to Primal Chaos City Leader, many Universe Venerables only improve their Life Gene Level to 10, so one can imagine how difficult it is.

cultivation.title: Lifespan
cultivation.introText: In Swallowed Star living beings can live from ages as low as 0 to as high as being Eternal, depending on their Cultivation. Still, there are universal limitations for a lifespan that Original Laws placed on each cultivation rank. Lifespan is not the same for every species but instead, some species might have higher lifespan and some lower compared to humans. It is stated that Space Beast has 10 times the life span of a human world master, so we can conclude that different races/species have a different lifespan but there is one constant and that is Non-Special Lifeforms are not immortal, and they can Die Pre-Immortal cultivation level.

cultivation.title: Lotus Heart Seed
cultivation.introText: Lotus Heart Seed is a treasure available for redemption in Infinite Space for 18,000 Reward Points. When used, it can grow a Lotus of Life within the user's internal world, making it more stable, and greatly improving the strength and vitality of the user's body. The user will also become akin to the darling of the Great Dao of Life , increasing their affinity with and cultivation efficiency of that Great Dao. The larger the user's inner world, the better the Lotus of Life can grow.
cultivation.appearance: A colorful seed.

cultivation.title: Lotus of Life
cultivation.introText: The Lotus of Life is a rare and extraordinary treasure that serves as the core enhancer of Luo Feng’s secret technique, the River of Life. When Luo Feng’s World Lifeform clone, carrying energy reserves equivalent to 56 times a Perfect Divine Body, activated the eight-branch fusion secret technique, the Life-Lotus within his inner world manifested as the nucleus of the blood-colored river. This transformation elevated the River of Life into a self-contained world with immense destructive and suppressive properties. The Lotus of Life amplified the move’s might to the extent that it nearly touched the Supreme Operation Laws’ upper limit, despite Luo Feng still being only a God King Second Realm without relying on external treasures. In value, the Lotus of Life was regarded as comparable to a Beyond God King level secret treasure, enabling Luo Feng’s River of Life to surpass the strength of ordinary eight-branch techniques and rival the highest limits of the Continent of Origin. Its integration turned each strand of the blood river into a force capable of suppression, annihilation, and imprisonment, making the Life-Lotus one of the most vital factors in Luo Feng’s rise to peak combat power.

cultivation.title: Metal Lifeform
cultivation.introText: Metal Lifeform (金属生命, Jīnshǔ shēngmìng, lit. Metal Life) is one of the many types of lifeforms in Swallowed Star. As implied in the name, they are not Flesh and Blood Lifeforms, but are instead made of metal, making their bodies incredibly durable. They can be divided into tens of millions of types. Metal Lifeforms typically do not have souls, and thus do not fear Soul Attacks, however it may be possible for them to have souls (the Devil's Voice God General Inheritance notes that whether the creature is a Flesh and Blood Lifeform, Energy Lifeform, Metal Lifeform, etc., as long as they have a soul, they can use that inheritance to become a Devil's Voice God General). Some species in this race can be used as auxiliary lifeforms, capable of serving as armor, weapons, or even fuse with spaceships, similar to some Plant Lifeforms. The Automaton Race is a race of Intelligent Life that uses metal bodies, so they qualify as metal lifeforms.

The first volume's inscribed Flame God Race language feels quite like some ancient characters in ancient Chinese, but contrary, the manual existed 600 million years ago before Luo Feng acquired it. The five boards contain the nine volumes:

Volume 1 (Donghua, Flame God Race Metal Board)

Volume 1, and incomplete 2 to 9

Volume 2, 5, and incomplete 7
cultivation.personality:
The Nine Volume Manual (Nine Calamities Secret Tome) is a set of cultivation guides/training manual created by Sitting Mountain Guest with the purpose of increasing the Life Gene Level of the cultivator. It will also increase the power of their soul and bring out an absolute change in one's talent in the area of cultivation.

The manual allows its practitioner to break the Life Gene Level limit set by the universe law, which caused it to be rejected by the universe laws themselves. When Sitting Mountain Guest passed the manual's knowledge onto any Earthling, the universe laws would erase the memory of that user. Sitting Mountain Guest was unaffected by the memory loss due to his strength, but it made it impossible to pass the guides down as they existed at the time.

To circumvent this, he used some special treasures he discovered, the Heavenly Soul Crystals, to house the Nine Volume Manual. With their natural power, as long as a human from Earth was able to pass the illusions within the crystals, they could acquire the techniques. Sitting Mountain Guest understood that the universe laws are fair, and there was always a chance, if one could find it. Even with the strength of the Nine Volume Manual, there would be a way to pass the techniques on to someone else.

Despite this circumvention, the techniques can still only be passed onto one individual at a time; as long as the cultivator who began training in the Nine Volume Manual was alive, no one else could attempt to learn those techniques. Additionally, if the cultivator died, even upon resurrection they would never remember the techniques of the manual.

cultivation.title: Nutrition Cabin
cultivation.introText: The Nutrition Cabin is used for the recovery, healing, and evolution of a being. The price of it is dependent on a Grade of the cabin. Using an E Grade cabin can directly make the body of a normal being into a Universe Level, however, Any further breakthroughs will be dependent on a being's own comprehension of Domain and so on, just relying on the cabin alone is futile. Also, relying on the cabin to break through might result in one’s foundations not being solid.
cultivation.appearance: The entire nutrition cabin is 21.6 meters long and 8.3 meters wide. The main body of it is dark blue. At the same time, on the metallic surface, there were a lot of complicated flower markings and a few simple buttons. The dark blue metal on the surface is an F8 grade metal comparable to the Hybrid Mother Copper, the blue metal is known as BlueStone Essence which is an extremely expensive metal. Because of the BlueStone Essence, even an Immortal being will need a lot of time to break this Nutrition Cabin.

cultivation.title: Origin Mysteries
cultivation.introText: Origin Mysteries (本源奥妙(Běnyuán àomiào), also referred to as 法则之源(Fǎzé zhī yuán), lit. Origin/Source of Law) are fundamental parts of a universe. By fully comprehending an Origin Mystery, one can break through to Eternal True God. There are a number of Origin Mysteries specified, but neither Swallowed Star nor Swallowed Star 2 provide a full list of Origin Mysteries.
cultivation.appearance:

By fully comprehending an Origin Mystery, one can break through to Eternal True God. There are a number of Origin Mysteries specified, but neither Swallowed Star nor Swallowed Star 2 provide a full list of Origin Mysteries.

It is very difficult to comprehend Origin Mysteries; Jie Fanzi inadvertently attempted to do so and not only failed, but as a result of the detour, failed to break through to Void True God. Even Luo Feng, with all of his talent, cultivated in the Original Universe for over 7 trillion eras, repeatedly studied Destruction, and directly observed the destruction and rebirth of the Original Universe before comprehending the Origin of Birth and Death.

cultivation.title: Original Universe
cultivation.introText: The Original Universe (原始宇宙(yuánshǐ yǔzhòu), lit. Original Universe, also referred to as 原宇宙(yuán yǔzhòu), lit. Original Universe) is the dwelling place of all within the current Reincarnation Era (the Third Reincarnation Era at the beginning of Swallowed Star), except for those who live in Miniature Universes. It is 10 trillion light-years in diameter; no one has lived long enough to explore it in its entirety. The Original Universe exists in Universe Ocean and is by far the largest celestial body in Universe Ocean. Its universe structure law is even more complex than Luo Feng's Miniature Universe, but it was similar, as if Beginning of the Origin and 100,000 Heavens became an endless space. The Original Universe consumes no energy, and can absorb chaos airflow.
cultivation.appearance:
The Original Universe (原始宇宙(yuánshǐ yǔzhòu), lit. Original Universe, also referred to as 原宇宙(yuán yǔzhòu), lit. Original Universe) is the dwelling place of all within the current Reincarnation Era (the Third Reincarnation Era at the beginning of Swallowed Star), except for those who live in Miniature Universes. It is 10 trillion light-years in diameter; no one has lived long enough to explore it in its entirety. The Original Universe exists in Universe Ocean and is by far the largest celestial body in Universe Ocean. Its universe structure law is even more complex than Luo Feng's Miniature Universe, but it was similar, as if Beginning of the Origin and 100,000 Heavens became an endless space. The Original Universe consumes no energy, and can absorb chaos airflow.

The Original Universe is off-limits to those whose Original Universes have gone through reincarnation, so those in Universe Ocean whose life imprints are tied to Miniature Universes or Holy Lands are unable to enter the Original Universe. Each Universe Ocean has one Original Universe.

The Original Universe experiences five phases before going through reincarnation:

The lifespan of a particular incarnation of the Original Universe is 1 Reincarnation Era, however the Original Universe is essentially eternal. At the end of the destruction phase, the Original Universe is destroyed and reverts to the Original Universe Origin, from which a new incarnation of the Original Universe is born. The new incarnation of the Original Universe then goes through the five phases again.

The Original Universe has a unique structure that allows one to confirm their coordinates wherever they are. This differs from Universe Ocean, where great beings require a map (except for Sector Beasts, who can innately sense each other and thus always return to the Land of Darkness). It contains an incredible number of celestial bodies and special locations, such as Secret Regions, black holes, and wormholes, and encompasses all of the Space Interlayers that house God Countries. It gives birth to billions of races, numerous types of lifeforms, and countless great beings. Any lifeform can be born within the Original Universe, provided there is a suitable environment.

Original Universe Hierarchy

Within the Original Universe, the speed limit for lifeforms and objects containing lifeforms is the speed of light. Once one reaches lightspeed (unless they are a True God and thus able to resist the pull), they are pulled into the Dark Universe, a parallel space with coordinates matching those of the Original Universe. Traveling through the Dark Universe is referred to as Universe Travel (宇宙穿梭(yǔzhòu chuānsuō)).

cultivation.title: Overlord
cultivation.introText: Are capable of making Supreme Laws. One can become an Overlord by comprehending a higher level of Original Laws, which is extremely difficult.
cultivation.appearance:
Original Chinese characters: 领主

领主 (Lǐngzhǔ) is a compound word that historically refers to a feudal lord, a ruler who was granted political power and land ownership in a region. In Swallowed Star, this is a title used by some characters (Black Sky Seigneur, Flourishing Light Seigneur, and even Milky Way Seigneur, for example). In Swallowed Star 2, this is the ultimate realm for a cultivator, and refers to the fact that these beings are responsible for large swaths of territory in the Infinite Hunyuan Space.
cultivation.personality:
Are capable of making Supreme Laws. One can become an Overlord by comprehending a higher level of Original Laws, which is extremely difficult.

Overlord is the highest level of the Chaotic Origin Lifeform Class. Chaotic Origin Lifeform is a higher-dimensional being that exists outside the entire Origin World. Anyone below this level would be considered lower dimensional being, like a painting.

In terms of power—particularly offensive strength—the Overlords consistently rank among the top 20 in the Chaotic Origin Dimension, even the weakest of them. And if an Overlord manages to cultivate two Hunyuan Daos, they are certain to become one of pinnacle beings in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. A prime example is Luo Feng, after cultivating two Hunyuan Daos, he became the strongest being in the entire Chaotic Origin Dimension.

Cultivators in this realm can casually refine treasures that can weaken all attacks below their level (including Soul Attacks and other types) by 90%.

cultivation.title: Perfect Divine Body
cultivation.introText: Perfect Divine Body (完美神体(wánměi shéntǐ)) is a stage of Divine Body reached by those who break through to True God through the Divine Power Path and reach the Ultimate Life Gene Level of 100,000. Sector Beasts who become Sector Beast King also acquire this level of Divine Body. In addition to being theoretically infinite in size, the Perfect Divine Body has the ability of Intangible and Formless, can completely mask its aura, can retain 100% of its strength regardless of its size, and can be reborn from a single drop of blood. While the body is theoretically infinite, while in the Original Universe, True Gods are limited to a Divine Body of 12 light-years. On the Continent of Origin, Eternal True Gods with the Perfect Divine Body can reach a height of 18 billion kilometers. It is implied by Sitting Mountain Guest that the range is between 15 and 20 billion kilometers. Primal Chaos Sovereigns with the Perfect Divine Body can reach a height exceeding 1 trillion kilometers (going by the trends, should be 1.8 trillion kilometers) on the Continent of Origin, while God Kings can reach a height of 180 trillion kilometers!

cultivation.title: Planetary Level
cultivation.introText:
This is a section added primarily due to the difference between the English-fan translation of the Novel and the true Chinese meaning.
Original Chinese characters: 行星级 (xíng xīng jí)
The first two Characters 行星 (xíngxīng) refer to a planet or something planetary.
The last Character 级 (jí) can also be found in Stellar Level, Universe Level and so on. It refers to grade, level or rank.
As such Planet and Planetary Level/Grade would be valid translations. Whether Grade or Level should be used can be debated.
As for the translation "Star Traveller" it does not fit the Chinese Origin nor can they survive in space. As such they couldn't even travel across Stars. So even its literal meaning does not fit the Cultivation Realm.
Edit: I have figured out how "Star Traveller" came into being. If 行星 is separated and evaluated individually you'd get the verb walk/travel (xíng 行) and Star (xīng 星). --> Star Traveller. However 行星 (xíngxīng) is a compound word. Just look at this Chinese Wikipedia page Chinese Wikipedia 行星. This compound word refers to Planets and not to the ability to walk across Stars.
cultivation.personality:
In order to achieve a Breakthrough and enter the Planetary Level, one must condense the energy within their own body into a Miniature Planet. This is either done in the Dantian in the abdomen for Warriors or in the Sea of Consciousness for Spirit Masters. A depiction of this can be seen in the slideshow on the right.
The essence is first suppressing and shrinking the energy and then, by condensing that energy, creating a core for the future planet. After the core is formed, the rest of the Energy can be injected to transform the core into a Planet (The Planet resembles a Fireball or a Sun). 
For every subsequent breakthrough, another tiny Planet is created orbiting around the main planet. (Like how the moon (=tiny planet) revolves around the earth (=initial Planet/Fireball) = Planetary System).
A Cultivator will realize their Original Law affinity during the Planetary Level stage. They will either discover it while breaking through or shortly after.
Often times, the Miniature Planet already contains the essence of an Original Law.
cultivation.trivia:
In the universe you can obtain citizenship and are qualified to earn food and clothing. In terms of occupations you can be a thug, servant or cannon fodder.
You will barely be considered as a basic cultivator in the universe.
A Planet Level Tier 8 Slave costs 20k Black Dragon Coins while a planet level tier 9 slave costs 100k Black Dragon coins

cultivation.title: Primal Chaos Sovereign

Once a cultivator has mastered Chaos Law, they can turn their True God's Heart into a Chaos Space. cultivation.title: Primal Chaos Tablets

Each chance will give the comprehender seven days to comprehend the tablet. Completing one level of Tong Tian Bridge will grant the being one extra chance to continue to comprehend the tablet. Chances can be stacked and saved up to be used later on.

cultivation.title: Purple Heart Realm Flower
cultivation.introText: The Purple Heart World Flower is a rare and highly valuable treasure found within the Dream Realm, notable for its radiant purple blossoms that emit fine specks of glowing light. Each flower holds immense attraction for cultivators due to its unique energy, with an assessed value of three million Merits under the evaluation systems of the Two Great Ancient Kingdoms. While considered one of the more common treasures of the Dream Realm, its worth remains significant, and its rarity ensures it is sought after by powerful cultivators.

The Purple Heart World Flower is a rare and highly valuable treasure found within the Dream Realm, notable for its radiant purple blossoms that emit fine specks of glowing light. Each flower holds immense attraction for cultivators due to its unique energy, with an assessed value of three million Merits under the evaluation systems of the Two Great Ancient Kingdoms. While considered one of the more common treasures of the Dream Realm, its worth remains significant, and its rarity ensures it is sought after by powerful cultivators.

These flowers are often heavily guarded by Dream Realm plant lifeforms, camouflaged as ordinary trees. In one recorded encounter, Luo Feng, alongside Wu Xin God King, Gui Xu Emperor, and Yun Tian God King, faced nine such Lifeforms three of which possessed might exceeding Tian Kun. Due to the Dream Realm’s unique operating rules, concealment techniques fail upon approaching treasures, forcing intruders to fight directly. The team employed a coordinated strategy: Yun Tian’s Chaotic Origin Bloodline–based poison weakened the enemies, Gui Xu Emperor’s eight-armed techniques and Wu Xin’s sword strikes destroyed them, while Luo Feng safeguarded the flowers from collateral damage.

Ultimately, seven Purple Heart World Flowers of high quality were successfully retrieved. Their acquisition highlighted not only the immense risk tied to Dream Realm treasures but also the delicate balance between offensive combat and careful preservation, as even minor damage could greatly reduce their value. The flowers were later distributed according to prearranged shares, reinforcing their importance as a measure of power and resource within the Continent of Origin’s cultivation hierarchy.

cultivation.title: Realm
cultivation.introText: Realm (境界(Jìngjiè)) can be considered one of the 3 major aspects of a cultivator, and is the most important of the 3. In essence, Realm refers to one's level of comprehension. Similar to Willpower and Divine Body (or the Life Gene Level of someone below Immortal), if one is able to fully utilize their realm (typically through weapons or techniques), they can fight opponents who may seem stronger than themselves (for example: Luo Feng using the Soaring Shuttle to kill Li Yao while still a God of War, or Luo Feng using Golden Light to kill Flourishing Light Seigneur). Realm is typically expressed through either utilizing the techniques inherent to a weapon (through engravings, etc.), the comprehension and utilization of someone else's techniques, or the creation and execution of self-made techniques. It is always more important than willpower and life gene since, regardless of the life gene or willpower of a cultivator, they cannot break through to the next cultivation realm without the required level of comprehension.
cultivation.appearance:
Realm (境界(Jìngjiè)) can be considered one of the 3 major aspects of a cultivator, and is the most important of the 3. In essence, Realm refers to one's level of comprehension. Similar to Willpower and Divine Body (or the Life Gene Level of someone below Immortal), if one is able to fully utilize their realm (typically through weapons or techniques), they can fight opponents who may seem stronger than themselves (for example: Luo Feng using the Soaring Shuttle to kill Li Yao while still a God of War, or Luo Feng using Golden Light to kill Flourishing Light Seigneur). Realm is typically expressed through either utilizing the techniques inherent to a weapon (through engravings, etc.), the comprehension and utilization of someone else's techniques, or the creation and execution of self-made techniques. It is always more important than willpower and life gene since, regardless of the life gene or willpower of a cultivator, they cannot break through to the next cultivation realm without the required level of comprehension.

Consider a World Master with a life gene of 1000; while they will have a body comparable in strength to an Immortal Army Lord, they will not actually be an Immortal. They will lack an Immortal Body, Law Domain, Divine Power, etc., despite having a comparable body. Only when they reach the adequate level of comprehension will they break through to that next cultivation realm. Similar bottlenecks can be seen in Invincible Immortal Kings and Top Universe Overlords; while the strongest among them can even kill Universe Venerables and Universe Masters, respectively, they cannot actually be considered Universe Venerables or Universe Masters. Similarly, while one can use superior Willpower to defeat those of a higher level, particularly once one is powerful enough to use Willpower techniques, this will not enable them to break through to the next cultivation realm.

This bottleneck maintains its importance as one progresses through the cultivation realms; a World Master only has to completely comprehend an Original Law to break through to Immortal, an Immortal has to completely comprehend an Upper Original Law to break through to Universe Venerable, and some version of a fusion law to break through to Universe Master. The law comprehension component of breaking through to True God is never fully detailed (since Luo Feng uses the Divine Power Path), but no matter how powerful a True God is due to treasures, life gene, and Burning Divine Power Secret Techniques, they must be able to create a top-tier Level 10 ability before breaking through to Void True God (and thus survive past 3 Reincarnation Eras). Similarly, a Void True God must fully comprehend a mystery of the universe before breaking through to Eternal True God. Even if an Eternal True God follows the Bloodline Cultivation Method, they must create Primal Chaos Sovereign Techniques and then comprehend the Law of Chaos to become a Primal Chaos Sovereign. Primal Chaos Sovereigns with exceptional abilities can become Transcendent Chaos Realms and fight against God Kings, but they will be limited to the PCS realm until they fully comprehend a Major Branch of a Great Dao and break through to God King.

It is noted that while the 13 Emperors of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom are all Ultimate God Kings in terms of life level, only Emperor Qing has successfully merged all Major Branches of a Great Dao, and as a result, his methods and strength are superior to his contemporaries.

cultivation.title: Rock Lifeform

They are a large group, so the races within have many differences. Some have souls, while some do not, making them immune to soul attacks. Some look just like rocks, some like mountains, and others even look like humans or other Flesh And Blood Lifeforms! Similar to Plant Lifeforms, they can be ordinary lifeforms or Special Lifeforms. They are naturally less intelligent than humans and other flesh and blood lifeforms, but, like other lifeforms, they do get more intelligent as they increase in fundamental strength. Rock lifeforms are naturally strong and sturdy.

cultivation.introText: The Secret Engraving Path (秘纹图修炼(mì wén tú xiūliàn), lit. Secret Line Map Meditation) is a cultivation path on which no one in the Third Reincarnation Era succeeded, until Luo Feng. Sitting Mountain Guest, as a being who reincarnated from a long-extinguished Reincarnation Era, was aware of this path. He knew that since Luo Feng was granted the I Am the Universe technique by the Original Universe, there was a chance that he could follow this path to extraordinary accomplishments.
cultivation.appearance:
The Secret Engraving Path (秘纹图修炼(mì wén tú xiūliàn), lit. Secret Line Map Meditation) is a cultivation path on which no one in the Third Reincarnation Era succeeded, until Luo Feng. He knew that since Luo Feng was granted the I Am the Universe technique by the Original Universe, there was a chance that he could follow this path to extraordinary accomplishments.

Through following this path, Luo Feng was able to create a Universe Master Ultimate Technique (Golden Light) while being an Invincible Immortal King, and eventually a True God Technique (Nirvana Rebirth) while being a Top Universe Overlord.

cultivation.title: Sector Beast Blood Talisman
cultivation.introText: Sector Beast Blood Talisman is a cultivation resource created by a Sector Beast that surpassed God King, using its own blood. It is a resource known to very few on the Continent of Origin; Emperor Chu, as an Emperor who cultivates in the Great Dao of the Destruction Origin, has used one in the past and can exchange for another one. Exchanging for one talisman requires 100 million Merits, but Emperors who do not cultivate the Great Dao of Destruction may not be able to exchange for one, and Guest Officials aren't even qualified to see them!
cultivation.appearance:

Exchanging for one talisman requires 100 million Merits, but Emperors who do not cultivate the Great Dao of Destruction may not be able to exchange for one, and Guest Officials aren't even qualified to see them!

Once used, it will temporarily condense into a Complete Great Dao of the Destruction Origin in the user's body for about 3 Periods. It is the best auxiliary treasure for comprehending the Great Dao of Destruction known to Emperor Chu.

cultivation.title: Shadow of the Calamity Beast
cultivation.introText: Shadow of the Calamity Beast is a cultivation resource used for training one's Willpower. One viewing is available to Guest Officials of the Emperor Chu Family for 100,000 Merits. To watch it, one must have God King-level willpower just to barely stay awake; with this level of will, one will not remember much after watching it. Thus, it is best to have Second Level God King-level willpower before watching it.

The actual Shadow of the Calamity Beast is a spacetime image of a Calamity Beast, recorded as it grew from a weak and inconspicuous beast to when it was captured. Part of this recording had a profound impact on Emperor Ming, leading to him repeatedly painting the Calamity Beast as he trained his willpower.

cultivation.title: Shadowless Treasure Medicine
cultivation.introText: Shadowless Treasure Medicine is a precious treasure available on the Continent of Origin. The Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom allows Guest Officials to exchange 800,000 Merits for one portion of this medicine. When taken, the user becomes favored by the Great Dao of Unlimited , increasing their affinity with that Great Dao. The duration of the effect is related to the user's soul strength.

cultivation.title: Space Heart
cultivation.introText: Space Heart is in the shape of a crystal ball and it could only be formed after an eternity within Five-Colored Abyss Flower. It has 10,081 facets when it becomes spherical and requires a long time for it to become solid When it is becoming solid, there would be an evolution of the five elements on its surface. Only after it became a solid and stable crystal without any space cracks would the crystal be completely matured. The Space Heart is only useful after that.

It not only is an important ingredient for making treasures but it also is extremely useful for the Mosha Clan beings as both of them resonate well with Space Laws. After Luo Feng absorbed the energy from the Space Heart his Mosha Body went through the evolution of the Life Gene causing it to evolve into a Special Lifeform. It also granted his Mosha Body a new talent technique called Domain.

cultivation.title: Space Time Mirror
cultivation.introText:
The Space-Time Mirror is a Precious Artifact available for redemption in Infinite Space for 180,000 Reward Points. This unique mirror is refined from the rare treasures of the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Its primary function is to allow its user to reincarnate into any Origin World while retaining their memories, providing immense advantages for cultivation.
The Space-Time Mirror is not bound by the Supreme Operation Laws of any origin world, enabling practitioners to practice under different supreme rules without restriction.

This treasure must not be taken out of the origin world.

cultivation.title: Special Life Remains
cultivation.introText: Special Life Remains are the remains of World-Class Chaotic Origin Lifeform. On the Continent of Origin, these can only be found in the Dark Area of the Dream Realm and the deepest parts of the Heavenly Pillar Realm. These treasures are heavily desired by powerful God Emperors such as Great Emperor of Time and Space, Owner of Wanfa Tower, First Ancestor Flame Wind, First Ancestor Thunder, and Two Worlds Palace Master. As such, they recruit lower-level cultivators to aid them in procuring those treasures.
cultivation.appearance:
Special Life Remains are the remains of World-Class Chaotic Origin Lifeform. On the Continent of Origin, these can only be found in the Dark Area of the Dream Realm and the deepest parts of the Heavenly Pillar Realm. These treasures are heavily desired by powerful God Emperors such as Great Emperor of Time and Space, Owner of Wanfa Tower, First Ancestor Flame Wind, First Ancestor Thunder, and Two Worlds Palace Master. As such, they recruit lower-level cultivators to aid them in procuring those treasures.

These remains contain mysteries at the World-Class Hunyuan Life-level, and provide guidance to those who seek to jump out of the cage and become a Hunyuan Lifeform. The remains of a World-Class Hunyuan Lifeform can be broken down into billions of pieces, so Overlord Yuan and his allies can easily make it so any Ultimate God King in every Origin World can get at least 1 piece. The remains of an Primogenitor-level are extremely rare and much more difficult to obtain.

cultivation.title: Special Lifeform
cultivation.introText: One of the many Life Forms in the Universe. Special Lifeforms (特殊生命(Tèshū shēngmìng), lit. Special Life) are creatures within the Original Universe that have no way of reproducing or passing down techniques, etc. Their numbers are incredibly low; some are completely unique, the only one of their type in the Original Universe! They are born in special environments or special circumstances in the universe. They can be found in Universe Ocean as well, as they were created in their Original Universe and made it to Universe Ocean either through becoming a True God (and thus being able to survive the destruction of their Original Universe for up to 3 Reincarnation Eras) or living in the Miniature Universe of a True God or Void True God.
cultivation.appearance:
One of the many Life Forms in the Universe. Special Lifeforms (特殊生命(Tèshū shēngmìng), lit. Special Life) are creatures within the Original Universe that have no way of reproducing or passing down techniques, etc. Their numbers are incredibly low; some are completely unique, the only one of their type in the Original Universe! They are born in special environments or special circumstances in the universe. They can be found in Universe Ocean as well, as they were created in their Original Universe and made it to Universe Ocean either through becoming a True God (and thus being able to survive the destruction of their Original Universe for up to 3 Reincarnation Eras) or living in the Miniature Universe of a True God or Void True God.

Special Lifeforms generally have a Life Gene Level of 100, but even the weakest have one of 10. There is a small number who have a Life Gene Level of 500, and a rare number have one of 1,000 or higher. There are many different types of Special Lifeforms, and generally the stronger they are and the higher their Life Gene Level, the fewer of them that exist. For example, Nine Remoteness Master is a Special Lifeform who was unique in the universe until he created his children; his Life Gene Level is 10,000! The number of Earthlings alone was in the billions, the number humans across the Original Universe was basically immeasurable. The same could be said for the Demon Race. Creatures like the Golden Horned Beast are considered rare, but are still able to reproduce, albeit at the cost of their life. Their memories are also passed down to future generations, so newborn Golden Horned Beasts receive information related to inherited techniques. Special Lifeforms are even fewer in number than even a Golden Horned Beast!

Due to their innate abilities, Life Gene Level, and potential strength, they are often targets of Possession, or murdered for their bodies. Their Life Gene Level can exceed the universe limit of 100 even before reaching Universe Master. While ordinary lifeforms with powerful bloodlines have increasing difficulty in breaking through to Immortal (for example the Zerg Race or Golden Horned Beasts), Special Lifeforms easily break through to Immortal, with some even being born Immortal, like the Natural Beast Gods!

cultivation.title: Spirit Energy
cultivation.introText: Spirit Energy (精神念力(Jīngshén niànlì), lit. Spirit Telekinesis, also referred to as 念力(niànlì), lit. Telekinesis, or 精神念能(Jīngshén niàn néng), lit. Spirit Mental Power/Spirit Power) is a particular type of energy produced by a cultivator's Consciousness. Spirit Energy and Soul Energy can be considered the same thing. Spirit Energy builds as a cultivator's Consciousness strengthens, which can cause headaches and even comas until their body gets strong enough to withstand it. The stronger the body, the more spirit energy it can withstand.
cultivation.appearance:
Spirit Energy (精神念力(Jīngshén niànlì), lit. Spirit Telekinesis, also referred to as 念力(niànlì), lit. Telekinesis, or 精神念能(Jīngshén niàn néng), lit. Spirit Mental Power/Spirit Power) is a particular type of energy produced by a cultivator's Consciousness. Spirit Energy and Soul Energy can be considered the same thing. Spirit Energy builds as a cultivator's Consciousness strengthens, which can cause headaches and even comas until their body gets strong enough to withstand it. The stronger the body, the more spirit energy it can withstand.

Spirit Energy can be trained in many ways, but the strong in the Original Universe have developed optimal methods of training. Aboriginals who have not been integrated into Universe Culture tend to have primitive methods of training. For Spirit Masters, Spirit Energy is considered the soldier guided by the general, Consciousness, which is ordered by the commander-in-chief, Willpower.

Spirit Energy is formless, but can be used to move inanimate objects (Controllers follow this method), for Soul Attacks and Illusion Attacks, to establish or break Spirit Imprints, to scan areas, and even to block sound. It also aids in their flight after they break through to Planetary Level. Weak levels of spirit energy can be stopped by normal metals, but as the strength of the energy increases, few materials are able to block it. It is rare to find materials that can block the spirit energy of an Immortal.

cultivation.title: Spirit Imprint
cultivation.introText: Spirit Imprint (精神印记(jīngshén yìnjì)) is a method used to establish ownership of an item or living creature. For example, both a Space Ring and a Cloud Vine use spirit imprint to remember its owner. When one acquires a treasure owned by someone else, they must shatter all spirit imprints attached to the treasure in order to take ownership of it. It is implied that Spirit Imprints are established using Spirit Energy.
cultivation.appearance:
Spirit Imprint (精神印记(jīngshén yìnjì)) is a method used to establish ownership of an item or living creature. For example, both a Space Ring and a Cloud Vine use spirit imprint to remember its owner. When one acquires a treasure owned by someone else, they must shatter all spirit imprints attached to the treasure in order to take ownership of it. It is implied that Spirit Imprints are established using Spirit Energy.

The Immortal Energy used to form a Divine Body is filled with their Spirit Imprints, allowing them to reform their body from Immortal Energy or transform their body into Immortal Energy. When they lose part of their Divine Body, they also lose spirit imprints, and have to reform them once they have repaired their body.

cultivation.title: Spirit Master
cultivation.introText:
A Spiritual Master (精神念师, lit. "Spiritual Mind Master") is a special type of Warrior who is able to control the Spiritual Energy. This type of warrior is stronger than the common warrior, who focuses on Genetic Energy, but only a few warriors can become Spiritual Masters, because spirituality is an innate gift. Only warriors with highly evolved spiritual abilities are able to become Spiritual Masters. 
Spiritual Masters are two tiers stronger than a Warrior at the Apprentice Level. So an Apprentice Level 5 Spiritual Master is comparable to an Apprentice Level 7 Warrior. This advantage is only really prevalent at the Apprentice Stage.
Due to a Spiritual Master having to train both their Genetic and Spiritual Energy, they are generally superior to Warriors of the same rank, as Warriors can ascend Ranks much quicker. Spiritual Masters take longer to ascend but can master a lot more skills at the same level.
Illusionists are considered a warrior's worst enemy unless they have sufficient Soul Defense.
There are three types of Spiritual Masters:

cultivation.title: Stellar Level
cultivation.introText:
This is a section added primarily due to the difference between the English-fan translation of the Novel and the true Chinese meaning.
Original Chinese characters: 恒星级 (héng xīng jí)
The first two Characters 恒星 (héngxīng) refer to a star or something stellar. Sometimes also translated as Astral.
The last Character 级 (jí) can also be found in Planetary Level, Universe Level and so on. It refers to grade, level or rank.
As such Star, Stellar and Astral Level/Grade would be valid translations. Whether Grade or Level should be used can be debated. As some Donghua translations choose to translate Planetary Level as Star Traveler we felt it would be best to not have two adjacent Realms share a major part of the name, Star.
cultivation.appearance:
They cannot survive in space for a long time, but can fly short distances.
Tens of thousands Stellar Level can be found in a galaxy. On ordinary life planets they can be kings and overlords but in the entire galaxy they are ordinary soldiers, cannon fodder or bodyguards. Having 10 billion Ganwu Coins would make one one of the absolute richest at this level.

cultivation.trivia:
The Planetary System within oneself is transformed into a Star System. With every subsequent breakthrough another Planetary System is added to the Star System.*
Stepping into the Stellar Level is no less difficult than rising from the Planetary Level 1 to Planetary Level 9.
*A Planet (e.g. Earth) with a singular Moon is a basic Planetary System. A Planet with 9 Moons is a completed Planetary System.
A Planet like that revolving around a larger celestial body like the sun would be considered a Star System.

cultivation.introText: Forms the population of low level 'aboriginal' planets which don't have their own standings. In this stage, practitioners strengthen their body to endure genetic energy and spiritual energy.

Elite students can also enroll in Military academies on earth as officers

cultivation.title: Supreme Operation Laws
cultivation.introText: The Supreme Operation Laws (至高运转法则, Zhìgāo yùnzhuǎn fǎzé, lit. Supreme Operation Law, also 至高无上的宇宙海运转规则, Zhìgāowúshàng de yǔzhòu hǎi yùnzhuǎn guīzé, lit. Supreme Operation Rules of Universe Sea) are a series of laws/rules that rule over all of Universe Ocean. Even the Original Laws and the Origin Will of the Original Universe have to bow in its presence. It has no ability of thought or will, but it must be strictly followed, else one would be punished. It was Ancestor Yuan's breaking of the Supreme Operation Laws that caused his suppression by the Origin Will! Only the Supreme Operation Laws can give orders to True God and higher cultivators.
cultivation.appearance:
The Supreme Operation Laws (至高运转法则, Zhìgāo yùnzhuǎn fǎzé, lit. Supreme Operation Law, also 至高无上的宇宙海运转规则, Zhìgāowúshàng de yǔzhòu hǎi yùnzhuǎn guīzé, lit. Supreme Operation Rules of Universe Sea) are a series of laws/rules that rule over all of Universe Ocean. Even the Original Laws and the Origin Will of the Original Universe have to bow in its presence. It has no ability of thought or will, but it must be strictly followed, else one would be punished. It was Ancestor Yuan's breaking of the Supreme Operation Laws that caused his suppression by the Origin Will! Only the Supreme Operation Laws can give orders to True God and higher cultivators.

It is the Supreme Operation Law that dictates everything within Universe Ocean, including the reincarnation of the Original Universes, the birth of the Sector Beasts, why Sector Beasts were forced to fight each other until the birth of a Sector Beast King, why True Gods were forced to either transcend reincarnation within 3 Reincarnation Eras or perish, why no one could speak of anything surpassing True God in Universe Ocean, and even why the great beings and Divine Power of the World of Jin cannot enter Universe Ocean! The supreme laws guide those who break through to Void True God to transcend incarnation, allow reincarnation of great beings, and even allowed Sitting Mountain Guest to keep his memories from being a God King, but it restricts him due to his knowledge and Willpower. Even Sitting Mountain Guest, with all of his memories, only had a patchy understanding of the supreme laws.

When Luo Feng reached the Ultimate Life Gene Level of 100,000, the Supreme Operation Laws descended to congratulate him, forcing everyone in the Original Universe to kneel, except for Sitting Mountain Guest, who avoided it by traveling to his Miniature Universe. When Luo Feng begins to have success in the Sector Beast War by enslaving Morosa and other Sector Beasts, the supreme laws express their disapproval by first emitting a powerful force through his Miniature Universe (when he enslaved Morosa), and then by adding an additional Iron Rule of Fate, preventing Luo Feng from forestalling his battle with the final Sector Beast. Sitting Mountain Guest posited that when Duan Dong River Zhen Kan Wu and his forces used Universe Boat to attempt to enslave weak Sector Beasts, the Supreme Operation Laws worked with the Origin Will to use the power of the Original Universe Origin to kill them and damage Universe Boat.

Legend says that when one surpasses the God King level (becoming an Overlord), the Supreme Operation Laws can no longer restrict them, and they can even make Supreme Operation Laws!

cultivation.title: Ten-Directions World Form
cultivation.introText: Ten-Directions World Form (十方世界形态(Shí fāng shìjiè xíngtài)) is an advanced body structure, more advanced than the Trinity Form. The Golden Scale Beetle has this body structure, enabling it to fight God Kings while being a Primal Chaos Sovereign. At Emperor Chu's direction, Luo Feng studied this body structure in hopes of comprehending the Trinity Form.
cultivation.appearance:
Ten-Directions World Form (十方世界形态(Shí fāng shìjiè xíngtài)) is an advanced body structure, more advanced than the Trinity Form. The Golden Scale Beetle has this body structure, enabling it to fight God Kings while being a Primal Chaos Sovereign. At Emperor Chu's direction, Luo Feng studied this body structure in hopes of comprehending the Trinity Form.

A description of this structure is recorded in the first calamity of the Eight Calamities Lifeform inheritance, under the Body of Life lineage. In this structure, a large particle contains 9 small particles, with 3 small particles merging into one pile, and the 3 piles rotating around each other without touching. These 3 piles are each an example of a Trinity Form.

The overall structure can be considered a relatively complete small world form, much simpler than the 'sector' within the body of a Sector Beast King. This structure is somewhat similar to the goal of the World Lifeform inheritance. It contains the mysteries of the 6 Major Branches of the Great Dao of the Life Origin, so even if one became a God King and mastered multiple Major Branches, it is difficult to comprehend this structure. Only by comprehending all 6 Major Branches can one more easily comprehend this structure.

Luo Feng eventually completely comprehended this life structure, using it in combination with Intangible and Formless to change his body into the Silver Mountain Beast King form. When comprehended, the structure is a world in itself, without any restrictions on the number of particles, with the only limit being the Consciousness and Willpower of the cultivator. Unlike the previous Transformation Methods he used, Luo Feng could burn the power within, giving it incredible bursts of strength, however it requires even more Willpower.

cultivation.title: Thousand Dreams Fruit
cultivation.introText: Thousand Dreams Fruit is a rare treasure priced at 1.5 billion Merits by the two Ancient Kingdoms. As a treasure priced at over 1 billion merits, its actual value is much higher, since First Ancestor Flame Wind, First Ancestor Thunder, and the ancestors of the alien races need it! After eating it, the cultivator can experience 1,000 reincarnations in their dreams, cultivate in the world in their dreams, accumulate insights, and hone their mind. It is best when taken for the first time; subsequent consumptions will have a lesser effect.
cultivation.appearance: A black fruit with a faint purple luster.

cultivation.title: Tianqu Stone Essence
cultivation.introText: Tianqu Stone Essence is an extremely important cultivation resource for the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. Almost all of the essence is used by God Kings, and each complete piece of essence costs either 1,000 Merits or around 300 million Universe Sands! These complete pieces are refined from countless extremely tiny particles that even True Gods have to examine carefully to discover.
cultivation.appearance:
Tianqu Stone Essence is an extremely important cultivation resource for the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom. Almost all of the essence is used by God Kings, and each complete piece of essence costs either 1,000 Merits or around 300 million Universe Sands! These complete pieces are refined from countless extremely tiny particles that even True Gods have to examine carefully to discover.

Tianqu City was built specifically for the mining of this essence, and is defended by a Top Primal Chaos Sovereign. When large amounts of this essence were stolen, the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom released a task for someone to uncover the identity of the illegal miners, which Luo Feng received from Di Chu Yu.

cultivation.title: Time Palace
cultivation.introText: Time Palaces are special Heavy Treasures that provide a place for cultivation with an accelerated time velocity. They can be created by anyone who has completed comprehension of both Law of Space  and Law of Time  (so Universe Masters and above).
cultivation.appearance:
Time Palaces are special Heavy Treasures that provide a place for cultivation with an accelerated time velocity. They can be created by anyone who has completed comprehension of both Law of Space  and Law of Time  (so Universe Masters and above).

Ordinary Time Palaces accelerate time velocity by 10 to 100 times, while those with 1,000 times acceleration are considered remarkable and incredibly expensive. The Human Race did not possess a Time Palace capable of 10,000 times acceleration.

While incredibly useful to those races lacking a True God, the Pinnacle Races have locations within their True God's Miniature Universe capable of 10,081 times acceleration, limiting their value for those talents highly valued by their race.

cultivation.title: Trinity Form
cultivation.introText: Trinity Form (三位一体(Sānwèiyītǐ) or 三位一体形态(Sānwèiyītǐ xíngtài)) is a more complex body structure than the Yin-Yang Combination Form, with higher requirements on the Major Branches of Body of Life and Life Spirituality. Even after studying multiple Perfect Chaos Layer Organisms and reaching Pinnacle Chaos Realm comprehension of Life Spirituality and Body of Life, Luo Feng could not completely comprehend the Trinity Form. If one comprehends the 6 Major Branches of the Great Dao of the Life Origin (becoming a God King), they can easily create the Trinity Form.
cultivation.appearance:
Trinity Form (三位一体(Sānwèiyītǐ) or 三位一体形态(Sānwèiyītǐ xíngtài)) is a more complex body structure than the Yin-Yang Combination Form, with higher requirements on the Major Branches of Body of Life and Life Spirituality. Even after studying multiple Perfect Chaos Layer Organisms and reaching Pinnacle Chaos Realm comprehension of Life Spirituality and Body of Life, Luo Feng could not completely comprehend the Trinity Form. If one comprehends the 6 Major Branches of the Great Dao of the Life Origin (becoming a God King), they can easily create the Trinity Form.

There are many types of Trinity Forms. Perfect Chaos Layer Organisms are all large particles containing yin and yang particles, with the three forming a Trinity Form. Within the Ten-Directions World Form, every three particles are fused into a Trinity Form.

After one million days observing Morosa's God King 'sector,' Luo Feng mastered the Trinity Form, combining part of the Ten-Directions World Form from the Golden Scale Beetle corpse, the essence of Morosa's sector, and the guidance of the Body of Life chapter in the first calamity of the Eight Calamities Lifeform inheritance. With this, he created the Black River Form. Under the guidance of the World Lifeform inheritance, Luo Feng realized 5 new Trinity Forms.

cultivation.title: Twenty-Four Phase Form
cultivation.introText: Twenty-Four Phase Form (二十四相形态(Èrshísì xiāng xíngtài)) is the most perfect physical body, according to the World Lifeform inheritance. The 24 phases are also presented in the complete Great Dao of the Life Origin, seen as 24 claws on a winding dragon body. Each claw is a phase of the Great Dao of the Origin of Life, and each phase is a combination of the 6 Major Branches of that Great Dao. It is much more complex and mysterious than the Ten-Directions World Form. While each life unit for the Ten-Directions World Form requires 10 particles to form a miniature world, the Twenty-Four Phase Form life units require 240 particles. These form a perfect combination of 24 spaces, increasing the stability a number of times, making a complete qualitative change.

There are very few Chaotic Origin Bloodline creatures at Second Level God King with this life structure. After Luo Feng mastered it, he understood that it is easier to control than the Ten-Directions World Form. About 100 periods after mastering this form, Luo Feng's World Lifeform body in this form had more than 100 times the energy of the Perfect Divine Body.

cultivation.title: Undying Heart
cultivation.introText: The Undying Heart (不死之心(Bùsǐ zhī xīn), lit. Undying/Immortal Heart) is a spiritual path that is naturally followed by Calamity Beasts. It can be comprehended by studying Calamity Beasts at a high level. Calamity Beasts must cultivate an Undying Heart to survive the numerous calamities and be completely reborn.
cultivation.appearance:
The Undying Heart (不死之心(Bùsǐ zhī xīn), lit. Undying/Immortal Heart) is a spiritual path that is naturally followed by Calamity Beasts. It can be comprehended by studying Calamity Beasts at a high level. Calamity Beasts must cultivate an Undying Heart to survive the numerous calamities and be completely reborn.

With an Undying Heart, one's Willpower has the quality of 'Willpower can be gathered to be as powerful as heaven and earth, can be divided into billions, and its survivability is endless.' Luo Feng cultivated an Undying Heart through his comprehension of the Three Thousand Void Calamity Beast Diagram.

At this level, the cultivator's physical body affects heaven and earth, causing the Supreme Operation Laws to begin to retreat. The cultivator's physical body is like a complete universe.

cultivation.title: Universe Energy
cultivation.introText: Universe Energy (宇宙能量(yǔzhòu néngliàng), also referred to as 原始宇宙能量(yuánshǐ yǔzhòu néngliàng), lit. Original Universe Energy) is the innate energy that exists all over the Original Universe. When cultivators reach Apprentice Level 1, they can begin to sense this energy and use it to train their Genetic Energy. This energy seems to be unevenly distributed throughout the Original Universe, resulting in some territories being more highly prized than others; these most valuable territories are controlled by the Human Race, Demon Race, Automaton Race, and the Zerg Race. God Countries, which exist in the Space Interlayer region of the universe, receive less Universe Energy than the regions outside of those interlayers.

cultivation.title: Universe Master
cultivation.introText:
This is a section added primarily due to the difference between the English-fan translation of the Novel and the true Chinese meaning.
Original Chinese characters: 宇宙之主 (yǔzhòu zhī zhǔ)
cultivation.appearance:
This is a section added primarily due to the difference between the English-fan translation of the Novel and the true Chinese meaning.
Original Chinese characters: 宇宙之主 (yǔzhòu zhī zhǔ)

The first two Characters 宇宙 (yǔzhòu) just refer to the Universe or Cosmos. In fact they can be found quite commonly in this novel. The English Novel also translated them as Universe, so here no issue can be found.

The last two Characters 之主 (zhī zhǔ) could be translated as Master of ... or Lord of ....

Looking at the work Swallowed Star, Characters of this Cultivation Rank will get an honorific title such as "Void Gold Master" or "Star River Master". The novel and the wiki have chosen to use "Master" however Lord would not be wrong either. Furthermore when reaching this rank the cultivator will have mastered a portion of Time & Space and even the Original Universe will retreat when they are using their abilities. As such they have mastered a small portion of the Universe. This makes the title Universe Master even more fitting.

In the World of Jin 法则之主 (fǎzé zhī zhǔ) is used to refer to Universe Masters. It essentially means Law Master but refers to the same cultivation rank.
cultivation.personality:
Universe Master is the next tier of cultivation beyond Universe Venerable. While Universe Venerables can be sorted into Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced Venerables, as well as Universe Overlord and Top Universe Overlord, these are differences in power rather than tier. As a result, while an Immortal who breaks through to Universe Venerable can immediately become a Universe Overlord or Top Universe Overlord, they CANNOT become a Universe Master, even if they have reached the Perfect Life Gene Level.

With the additional increases in law comprehension and Consciousness, they are on a completely different level than Universe Venerables under Universe Overlord, and are generally able to easily defeat even Universe Overlords and Top Universe Overlords. The strongest Top Universe Overlords can survive a fight with a Universe Master if they have adequate Arcana, but defeating a Universe Master is close to impossible. Their law comprehension allows them to create incredible techniques (even ordinary Universe Masters have at least created a Universe Master Ultimate Technique), and even utilize Xeon Arcana. With their incredible Divine Bodies, Divine Power and their souls being integrated with the universe, their Willpower is also extraordinary; it is impossible for an ordinary being to have Willpower that could rival a Universe Master. Within a certain space around them, the Origin Will of the Original Universe allows them to stop the operation of the Origin Laws, however as powerful as they are, they still cannot detect their Operation. A singular blow from a Universe Master can make a Top Universe Overlord lose 10% of their Divine Body, and Common Arcana Armor would be fortunate to weaken their attacks by 50%.

As Universe Masters have mastered Law of Time  and Law of Space , they exist outside of time and space, granting them several benefits. They can exceed the Life Gene limits placed on ordinary lifeforms, allowing even non-Special Lifeform Universe Masters to exceed the Life Gene Level of 100. After surpassing this limit, they gradually increase in size as their Life Gene Level increases. Due to their mastery of time and space, they can create Time Palaces, cultivation resources where time travels faster, allowing weaker beings to decrease their cultivation time by a factor of dozens or hundreds of times.

The presence of a Universe Master can alone make a race a Powerful Race, while the Pinnacle Races have multiple Universe Masters. Universe Masters serve as the backbone for the Nine Superpowers and are the leaders of the Twelve Top Powers. With their mastery of time and space, they are able to perform Time and Space Reversal to resurrect the dead, and can even see possible futures, making them invaluable to their organizations. If they wish it, they can make themselves undetectable by those below Universe Master, and they can seize control of the time and space of an area. Despite this power, Universe Masters rarely use their strength to slaughter those of lower tiers.

With their power and importance to their race, their weakest equipment is generally at least High Arcana, and they own large amounts of their race's wealth. They typically have more than 1 body, but if even one of their bodies dies, the restoration of that body is typically a terrifying cost for their race. They traverse Universe Ocean for valuables and to increase their combat experience, and their disciples are typically Universe Venerables. The strongest among them can even garner some fame in Universe Ocean, despite the presence of multiple True Gods, and in the Original Universe, those same Universe Masters are generally able to move without fear of True Gods. The most powerful Universe Masters may even have Xeon Arcana, giving them explosive power comparable to True Gods while in the Original Universe.
cultivation.trivia:
Interact with Space and Time

Can see some past and future possibilities

Easily obtain messages from hundreds of millions of light-years away

Teleport up to 1 million light-years away

Sense all Space Fluctuations within a 10 Million Light-Year Area.

Easily expand and shrink their Divine Body

Increase their Life Gene Level past the normal limit of 100, with to a limit of 10,081. The Perfect Life Gene Level of 10,081 represents the limit within the Original Universe, but with sufficient ability, one can surpass it, following the Divine Power Path to True God.

Can maintain consciousness even when their Divine Body is reduced to 1%

Universe Power/Force, or 宇宙本源之力(yǔzhòu běnyuán zhī lì) lit. Universe Origin Power) is energy from the Original Universe Origin. It is different from Universe Energy, and from the Primal Chaos Energy present in the Beginning Universe. This energy is available to World Masters, who connect to the Original Universe Origin, and can be condensed into Universe Crystals. Universe Origin Energy is readily available in World Master Worlds, which use Universe Crystals as their foundation, in Universe Crystals themselves, and in Secret Regions.
cultivation.appearance:
Universe Origin Energy (宇宙本源能量(yǔzhòu běnyuán néngliàng), lit. Universe Origin Energy, also referred to as 宇宙之力(yǔzhòu zhī lì), lit. Universe Power/Force, or 宇宙本源之力(yǔzhòu běnyuán zhī lì) lit. Universe Origin Power) is energy from the Original Universe Origin. It is different from Universe Energy, and from the Primal Chaos Energy present in the Beginning Universe. This energy is available to World Masters, who connect to the Original Universe Origin, and can be condensed into Universe Crystals. Universe Origin Energy is readily available in World Master Worlds, which use Universe Crystals as their foundation, in Universe Crystals themselves, and in Secret Regions.

Objects and lifeforms infused with Universe Origin Energy are much more durable than their ordinary counterparts; for example, the sands of the World of Thunder were at least 100 times the density of Earth iron, and the weeds were comparable to A Grade alloys, much tougher than diamond. The ability of all lifeforms to absorb Universe Origin Energy is a reason that superpowers allow their geniuses to train in excavated Secret Regions, which have no dangers, but still have incredible amounts of Universe Origin Energy. This richness of energy also allows cultivators to more clearly sense the fluctuations of the Original Laws.

The presence of incredible amounts of Universe Origin Energy contributes to the different evolution of Secret Regions, including the Special Lifeforms and celestial bodies. Miniature Universes absorb Primal Chaos Airflow and convert it to Universe Origin Energy to power True Gods.

cultivation.title: Universe Venerable
cultivation.introText:
This is a section added primarily due to the difference between the English-fan translation of the Novel and the true Chinese meaning.
Original Chinese characters: 宇宙尊者(yǔzhòu zūn zhě)
cultivation.appearance:
This is a section added primarily due to the difference between the English-fan translation of the Novel and the true Chinese meaning.
Original Chinese characters: 宇宙尊者(yǔzhòu zūn zhě)

The first two Characters 宇宙(yǔzhòu) just refer to the Universe or Cosmos. In fact they can be found quite commonly in this novel. The English Novel also translated them as Universe, so here no issue can be found. The real issue are the last two Characters.

The last two Characters 尊者(zūn zhě) can first be split into their own origin. 尊 (zun) means respect or honor, 者 (zhe) means person. As such it would either be translated as "Venerable One", "His/Her Holiness" or "Venerable Sir". It's a title of honor and they are accorded a great deal of respect, especially because of their age, wisdom, or character. In the work Swallowed Star Universe Venerable are the high-level of any ethnic group and as such a title like this is understandable. In weaker ethnic groups they are the main pillars, whereas in strong/peak ethnic groups they may not be the main pillar but definitely are still pillars of that group.

The English Novel translation however chose the term "Knight" instead. Seeing that there are also Knights in the army this title doesn't represent nearly the same idea. Neither is it a translation of the Chinese characters. 
As such we chose the use the term Universe Venerable instead. It may be inconvenient to Novel readers who are used to "Universe Knight" however we want to focus on the correct terms. To take novel readers into account we still left a redirect from Universe Knight, should one search for that term.

In the World of Jin, Universe Venerables are referred to as Law Venerables (法则尊者(fǎzé zūn zhě))

In the Original Universe, they are sometimes separated into Space Venerables (空间尊者(kōngjiān zūn zhě)) and Time Venerables (时间尊者(shíjiān zūn zhě))
cultivation.personality:
Universe Venerable is the next tier of cultivation beyond Immortal. While Immortals can be sorted into Immortal Army Lord, Immortal Marquis, and Immortal King, these are differences in power rather than in tier. As a result, a World Master who breaks through to Immortal can immediately become either an Immortal Army Lord, Immortal Marquis, or an Immortal King, but they CANNOT become a Universe Venerable, even if they have a Life Gene Level high enough to match the power of a Universe Venerable.

Some at this level can reach a Spirit Energy amplitude of 10,000; it is implied that the Devil's Voice God General inheritance would enable one who completed it to reach 10,000. Their attacks cause space maelstroms and are capable destroying the fabric of space itself. Even the weakest Universe Venerables can completely destroy an area 10 million kilometers in diameter!

Their understanding of the Original Laws is much higher than that of even Invincible Immortal Kings; King Zhenyan was able to escape Universe Venerables in battle but still could not defeat the 21st guardian of the Tong Tian Bridge, even after hundreds of millions of years of training, due to this difference in law comprehension. Universe Venerables can easily defeat Immortal Army Lords and Immortal Marquises, and unless the Immortal King has significant amplification techniques or a high Life Gene Level, they cannot escape a Universe Venerable. Universe Venerables typically create Pinnacle Techniques and Ultimate Techniques, and are far superior with their use of the major techniques of the Upper Laws than Immortals.

A Universe Venerable can be considered a true great being, important even within a Pinnacle Race, and are the strongest members of a Weak Race. They are extremely rare: even within the Hongmeng, they only number in the tens of thousands. Even with the guidance of the Duan Dong River Inheritance and the World of Jin, there were only over 50,000 Universe Venerables within the Human Race! With their power and importance to their race, they would generally own Heavy Treasures and some may possess even Common Arcana. Counting their wealth with currency is essentially impossible; any Universe Venerable could easily give away 200 billion Mixed Yuan Units, and unlike Immortal Kings, they could afford to build Spaceships out of G Grade metals. As a result, they typically barter with treasures instead of using currency. They are able to own a huge Starfield and create a Universe Country, managing and accumulating additional resources through it. They are incredibly discerning regarding choosing a disciple, as they have typically lived for hundreds of millions of years and have seen many young geniuses rise and fall; even the number 1 genius of a Pinnacle Genius Battle may not be chosen as their disciple.

Due to their power and authority, they typically have many Immortals as subordinates, and may even have Immortal Kings. Their own masters are typically Universe Masters or True Gods, and they are privy to knowledge that very few in the Original Universe possess; they are able to participate in grand events and battles, such as the opening of an Original Star. Within the Human Race, they have the right to create their own spaces within the Virtual Universe, and the right to live on the mountainside of Thunder Island. If they aren't serving in official capacities under the most powerful organizations in the Original Universe or their masters, they generally spend their time exploring Secret Regions for treasures, training to improve their strength, or competing with others at their level in various ways.
cultivation.trivia:
Universe Overlords (宇宙霸主(yǔzhòu bàzhǔ), lit. Universe Overlord) differ from Advanced Universe Venerables in their incredible talents. While their Divine Bodies are no different from Advanced Universe Venerables, their amplification techniques, attacking techniques, Willpower, and law comprehension match the weakest Universe Masters, making them far superior to Advanced Universe Venerables. They wield Common Arcana and even High Arcana, through which they can fully perform their techniques. Only True Gods and truly powerful Universe Masters with large Divine Bodies are able to use Time and Space Reversal on Universe Overlords.

cultivation.title: Willpower
cultivation.introText: Willpower or Will (意志(Yìzhì), lit. Will, sometimes seen coupled with Consciousness as 意志意识(Yìzhì yìshí), lit. Will Consciousness, as 精神意志(Jīngshén yìzhì), lit. Spiritual Will, or 心灵意志(Xīnlíng yìzhì), lit. Mind/Soul Will), is a mental component of a cultivator's strength. Willpower is important to both Spirit Masters and Warriors. For Warriors, willpower (along with Consciousness strength) helps them evolve and breakthrough, contributes to both their offense and defense, and is even a component of Domain and associated techniques. For Spirit Masters, willpower commands their consciousness, and consciousness condenses and strengthens the cultivator's Spirit Energy. Willpower helps any cultivator defend against Soul Attacks and Illusion Attacks, but if a cultivator has strong hatred, that will prevent their willpower from properly defending them from illusions.
cultivation.appearance:
Willpower or Will (意志(Yìzhì), lit. Will, sometimes seen coupled with Consciousness as 意志意识(Yìzhì yìshí), lit. Will Consciousness, as 精神意志(Jīngshén yìzhì), lit. Spiritual Will, or 心灵意志(Xīnlíng yìzhì), lit. Mind/Soul Will), is a mental component of a cultivator's strength. Willpower is important to both Spirit Masters and Warriors. For Warriors, willpower (along with Consciousness strength) helps them evolve and breakthrough, contributes to both their offense and defense, and is even a component of Domain and associated techniques. For Spirit Masters, willpower commands their consciousness, and consciousness condenses and strengthens the cultivator's Spirit Energy. Willpower helps any cultivator defend against Soul Attacks and Illusion Attacks, but if a cultivator has strong hatred, that will prevent their willpower from properly defending them from illusions.

Willpower can be considered one of the 3 major aspects of a cultivator.
cultivation.history:
Willpower, unlike Consciousness, is not directly tied to soul strength, and thus is not necessarily trained when one is training their soul. Since willpower is tied to one's mental and internal strength, persevering through painful and difficult times strengthens one's will, albeit in a primitive way. Fighting through life-or-death situations is another method, as is mental state training. Certain methods of training one's soul (such as the Devil's Voice God General Inheritance) can train willpower due to their constant testing of the cultivator's ability to endure pain. Another very effective method is enduring direct willpower attacks; through this method, great beings in Universe Ocean train their willpower at the Black-Striped Stone Pillars.

Although willpower is immaterial, and thus most can only use willpower in primitive, basic ways, if one had sufficient willpower they could train in willpower techniques.

cultivation.title: World Chaotic Origin Lifeform
cultivation.introText: World-Class Hunyuan Lifeforms are the next level of lifeform that has jumped out of the cage. The power gap between the major levels of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms is also very large; even tens of thousands of High-level Chaotic Origin Lifeforms together would be unable to withstand a single blow from a World-Class Hunyuan Lifeform. They are incredibly large, reaching about 1% of the physical size of an Origin World!
