cultivation.title: World Energy
cultivation.introText: World Energy (世界之力, Shìjiè zhī lì, lit. Power of World) is a new source of energy that a cultivator acquires when they break through to World Master. When a cultivator breaks through to World Master, their spirit energy and their genetic energy come together, fusing the cultivator's consciousness and will, resulting in the birth of World Energy.
cultivation.appearance:
World Energy (世界之力, Shìjiè zhī lì, lit. Power of World) is a new source of energy that a cultivator acquires when they break through to World Master. When a cultivator breaks through to World Master, their spirit energy and their genetic energy come together, fusing the cultivator's consciousness and will, resulting in the birth of World Energy.

World Energy is incredibly versatile. It is used to create their World Master World, it can be used to connect to the Law Ocean, used for both Soul Attacks and material attacks in the actual world, and can create material within their World Master World. It can be used to detect within a range equal to the size of their World Master World, and World Masters can project their World Master World by using World Energy.

Once a World Master breaks through to Immortal, they lose access to this energy, as their energy is converted to Immortal Energy.

cultivation.title: World Master
cultivation.introText:
This is a section added primarily due to the difference between the English-fan translation of the Novel and the true Chinese meaning.
The characters used here are extremely similar to Domain Master. 
Original Chinese characters: 界主级 (jiè zhǔ jí)
cultivation.appearance:
This is a section added primarily due to the difference between the English-fan translation of the Novel and the true Chinese meaning.
The characters used here are extremely similar to Domain Master. 
Original Chinese characters: 界主级 (jiè zhǔ jí)

界 (jiè) refers to a world or boundary. The English Novel used Sector as its translation. While sector could be seen as a synonym for boundary, it is a more common synonym for territory which would be the translation of Domain Master. A Sector and a Territory/Domain are too close in terms of meaning whereas the other translation, World, does not cause this confusion. Furthermore in this stage a cultivator transforms their life core into a miniature world. As such the term World is more fitting, to a) avoid confusion and b) represent the realm itself.

主级 (zhǔ jí) refers to the master grade or master level.
级 (jí) refers to grade, level or rank.

As such combining these results in a Person of World Master Level. --> A World Master. 
It may be inconvenient to Novel readers who are used to "Sector Lord" however we want to focus on the correct terms. To take novel readers into account we still left a redirect from Sector Lord, should one search for that term.
cultivation.personality:
World Master is the final stage of cultivation for a non-Immortal cultivator. If developed normally, without the assistance of powerful inheritances, around 1,000 galaxies will eventually give birth to one World Master, and even with the guidance of an absolute being, the probability would only increase tenfold! At this level, the body's genetics are evolved to their limits; without having a breakthrough in Life Gene Level, a cultivator's body will reach its size limit when they reach the pinnacle of World Master. Their soul also condenses into a crystal, becoming as strong as it can be before combining with the body when the cultivator breaks through to Immortal.

Jiang Tian Chen - World Master Pinnacle

When a Domain Master breaks through to World Master, their life core undergoes a fundamental change, with their spirit and genetic energies fusing with their Consciousness and Willpower, resulting in the formation of World Energy. This World Energy allows the cultivator's consciousness to connect to the Original Universe Origin, the true source of energy. That endless space was an endless space of world energy! Any grain of sand had countless universe crystals.

Using this energy, World Masters create their Internal World; a normal Pinnacle World Masters' Internal World has a diameter of 10,000 kilometers, however Luo Feng's had one of over 10 million kilometers upon his breakthrough. This world is a true world, able to house life and store items, and can be evolved and changed through the use of Universe Crystals. World Masters can create more than one world, and can even create a world within their world! While it is not cheap to create an Internal World, it is not overly expensive either, so World Masters tend to not buy World Rings, instead choosing to use their internal world. These worlds could be shrunk to the size of a grain of rice, and could be kept even after breaking through to Immortal!

World Masters are fairly wealthy, generally using E Grade Spaceships worth about 1 Mixed Yuan Unit.  World Masters typically have about 10 Mixed Yuan Units of assets, and powerful ones are capable of becoming 3 star clients of either the Universe Star River Bank or the Universe First Bank. World Masters can easily receive an entire Galaxy as their territory when they join an empire, and, through some work, could receive more galaxies. In ordinary Starfields and Medium-Level Civilized Nations, a World Master can be considered the pinnacle of strength and power. They can lead powerful organizations and their families are of higher importance than any non-imperial family; a World Master prince could immediately take the throne of a medium-level civilized nation! A typical Medium-Level Civilized Nation has too few World Masters for them to meet within the Virtual Universe, but they can meet others by moving to a high-level civilized nation's Virtual Continent. If necessary, a World Master could easily gather tens of thousands of Stellar Level cultivators for a mission, and they may be relied upon by Immortals to train starfield-level geniuses.

Pinnacle World Masters can garner fame outside of a starfield, and may become members of organizations like the 5 Leviathans of Humanity, with some serving in bodyguard armies. Core members of those organizations at this level have strength comparable to Immortals, and even Universe Venerables and Universe Masters compete to have them as disciples. Ordinary Universe Country armies have relatively few Pinnacle World Masters recognized by the Original Laws.

Using their ability to connect to the Original Universe Origin, the source of all energy, World Masters can resonate with the Original Laws, the source of which is also kept in the Original Universe Origin. Powerful World Masters may even be recognized by the Original Laws, noting their future potential as well as their present strength. With their ability, they can create imitations of Level 3 Spirit Weapons. Laws that the cultivator could not comprehend at Domain Master suddenly become as clear as the laws they could already comprehend, and the laws they could already comprehend, they comprehended even more deeply! Due to this increase in comprehension, World Master is considered the most critical training period, and the teacher of a talented World Master would make sure to give them a gift to aid in their training. Their comprehension of original laws is much greater than that of a Domain Master; one day of comprehending original laws as a World Master is the equivalent of doing the same for a year as a Domain Master. Accordingly, World Masters tend to stay at this level, training to reach the level of law recognition in multiple laws (which increases their comprehension speed for those laws), building a stronger foundation and allowing them to immediately reach Immortal Marquis or Immortal King level when they broke through to Immortal.

Hargrave - World Master Pinnacle

At World Master level, some absolute geniuses only train for tens of thousands of years and their comprehension can compare to that of an Immortal King. However, for a normal Immortal that breaks through, even a hundred million years wouldn’t be enough for them to reach the level of an Immortal King. This is due to the nature of an Immortal; upon breaking through, their World Energy is converted to Immortal Energy, and thus they can no longer resonate with the source of the Original Laws. While they completely comprehend the law(s) they used to break through to Immortal, increasing their comprehension of other laws is incredibly difficult, unless the law they used to break through was that of space or time (but that likely would not be a normal Immortal).

When training at this level, World Masters are expected to begin to create techniques that suit their abilities. Ordinary World Masters normally create Low Techniques, while genius World Masters can create Normal Techniques. Absolute genius World Masters create Top Techniques, while those few World Masters capable of killing Immortal Marquises create Pinnacle Techniques. Only the greatest World Master geniuses can create Ultimate Techniques.

Even ordinary World Masters could kill all life on a planet with a wave of their hand. When fighting, a World Master can project their Internal World into the outer world; this is known as World Projection. The strongest World Masters may be able to counter the Law Domain of an ordinary Immortal with their world projection. This is incredible when you consider that when World Masters break through to Immortal, their strength is immediately increased at least hundredfold! If their body is strong enough (or they have proper equipment), they can reach lightspeed; the unnamed World Master from Three Axe Mountain was casually able to reach 1/10th lightspeed! Despite their strength, due to the fundamental difference in the Spirit Energy of a World Master and of an Immortal, normal Pinnacle World Masters cannot withstand Soul Attacks from an Immortal, requiring special equipment to defend themselves from the Immortal Energy.

Normal Pinnacle World Masters have no chance of defeating Immortals due to their inability to withstand their soul attacks and inability to destroy Immortal Energy. However, truly powerful Pinnacle World Masters with Immortal Marquis or Immortal King-level law comprehension, treasures that can defend against Immortal soul attacks, treasures that can allow them to maximize their law comprehension, and either high Life Gene Level or other ways to strengthen their body can indeed kill Immortals. Human World Masters very rarely get this strong as their bodies tend to have lower Life Gene Levels and lack truly special inherited techniques, but examples exist, such as Kedi and Luo Feng.

cultivation.title: Yin-Yang Combination Form
cultivation.introText: Yin-Yang Combination Form (阴阳结合(Yīnyáng jiéhé), 阴阳结合形态(Yīnyáng jiéhé xíngtài), or 阴阳粒子形态(Yīnyáng lìzǐ xíngtài), lit. Yin-Yang Particle Form) is a relatively basic life structure. The basic components of perfect-level Chaos Layer Organisms, when broken down, contain a larger particle that envelops two smaller particles. Those two smaller particles, which are partially-fused, are the Yin-Yang Combination Form, and contain many mysteries. The Yin-Yang Combination Form can be divided into pure yin, pure yang, and yin and yang fusion. Yin and yang are states and can be represented differently, such as matter and energy or life and death, and in the Yin-Yang Combination Form, those different states from the same origin are blended perfectly. This life structure is recorded in the Body of Life chapter of the first calamity of the Eight Calamities Lifeform inheritance.

War/Battle Armor, or 铠甲(kǎijiǎ), lit. Body Armor). Armor treasures are generally used by those at or above the Immortal King level to replace (or assist) their Alloy Armors and Genetic Armors.

The battles between powerful Immortals could destroy armor made of the strongest alloys and through attack techniques, Genetic Armor would cease to be effective. Armor Treasures, through their incorporation of the owner's Original Law comprehension and the precious materials used to create them, provide effective defense for the most powerful Immortals.

As implied by the name, Armor Treasures are incredibly durable, resistant to material attacks as well as able to weaken the force from material attacks. This makes them invaluable to all cultivators, as even Spirit Masters need to be able to defend themselves from material attacks. The vast majority of cultivators do not have techniques that amplify their defense, unlike their attacks, making armor the only means to effectively defend their Divine Bodies from material attacks. Despite this value, the average Armor Treasure in the Original Universe and Universe Ocean has value equal to an average Weapon Treasure. Since they merge with the user's body, a user cannot wear more than 1 armor treasure at once (unlike how they could wear alloy and genetic armors simultaneously).

artifacts.title: Automaton Puppet
artifacts.introText: Automaton Puppets are robots that are controlled by the Automaton Race cultivators. The strength of an Automaton cultivator can be measured through the types and number of puppets they use, in addition to their formations, Original Law comprehension, calculation speed, and weapons.
artifacts.appearance:
Automaton Puppets are robots that are controlled by the Automaton Race cultivators. The strength of an Automaton cultivator can be measured through the types and number of puppets they use, in addition to their formations, Original Law comprehension, calculation speed, and weapons.

As the Automaton Race typically uses the group attack method, these puppets can be considered their most important soldiers. The strength of the puppets vary depending on the material used, quality of their energy cores, the techniques used to control them, etc. Since they are lifeless puppets, they are unaffected by Soul Attacks or substances that harm Divine Bodies, such as the Fei Mo Poison.

Automaton Puppets have advantages and disadvantages when compared to Zerg Race soldiers, who serve similar purposes for Zerg Race Queens. Puppets of a similar level are cheaper and easier to produce than Zerg Race soldiers; over 1,000 puppets made with E9 Grade alloys would have a production cost similar to a 100 meter E9 Grade Spaceship, while 1 Pinnacle World Master Zerg Race soldier may even exceed that cost. This also means that puppets at the same level of a Zerg Race soldier are less durable and have weaker attacks. However, unlike Zerg Race soldiers, they are not restricted to the level of their user. If they have the resources, Automaton Race soldiers can use puppets that exceed their nominal level (for example, an automaton Immortal Marquis can use G Grade puppets), unlike Zerg Race Queens, whose strongest soldiers would still be of their cultivation realm.

While a Zerg Race Queen's control of over 1,000,000 soldiers was imprecise, an Automaton can use millions of puppets to fuel powerful formations. Like Zerg Race soldiers, Automaton Puppets can use Original Law-infused attacks with exquisite coordination. Once a puppet has had its internal machinery damaged, it can be captured by an enemy, however, depending on the quality of the puppets, hacking them might only be possible by powerful organizations like the Virtual Universe Company.

The most powerful puppets seen in the Original Universe, the 10,081 puppet army used by Father God, are made of material used to craft Pinnacle Arcana, and together can be considered comparable to a Xeon Arcana!

Automaton Ships are not controlled by AIs instead they control the ship themselves. They are typically shaped like pyramids. One of the Automaton Ships crashed on the Earth and later Luo Feng took ownership of that ship.

As the material used to construct them is unique to the Automaton Race, an Automaton Ship is regarded as the pinnacle of its grade (i.e. a D Grade Automaton Ship is regarded as D9 Grade). Its price is extremely expensive, far more than the price of a Human Race-constructed ship of the same grade. With the control ability of an Automaton used to control the ship, the combination is incredible, as they represent the most technologically advanced race in the Original Universe. Using the abilities of the Automaton Race, these special ships of this type could be used to create unique formations and combat techniques, such as Nine Absolute God Country.

For the undying automatons, operating a ship requires only a fraction of their processing power to perfectly control a universe ship, Babata explained. Therefore, undying automatons typically don't require a dedicated AI to control the ships; they can effortlessly manage it on their own.

artifacts.title: Beast God 7 Kills
artifacts.introText: The first 3 volumes are dark gold metal books, with each cover only having the character indicating the number of the volume (1 for 1st, etc.). Each volume was 1 meter wide and half a meter thick, and the first volume alone was close to 10,000 pages long.

artifacts.personality:
Beast God 7 Kills, also referred to as Yan Shen 7 Forms, is a set of training manuals developed by Xi Luo Duo to facilitate the transformation of the cultivator to a Beast God. Since Xi Luo Duo was a Controller, the techniques are Controller techniques rather than close-combat techniques.

If one was able to complete the first 3 levels, they would be invincible against anything below Universe Venerable. If one was able to complete the first 6 levels, they would be invincible against anything below Universe Master. If one could complete the 7th level, which was essentially theoretical, as Xi Luo Duo was unable to do so, they would become a true Beast God, matching a Universe Master.

Xi Luo Duo was renowned across the universe due to his strength, and the Beast God's power was known throughout the universe. These two reasons made the Beast God 7 Kills known as an extremely valuable manual upon the upper echelon of the Human Race. Many strong human Universe Venerables exchanged for and trained in it. However, due to the difficulty, none had succeeded in completing all 7 levels.

Completing the first level proved that one had talent in the fusion of Law of Gold  and Law of Space . The first volume contains two basic sets of information. The first 1/3 of the volume was information related to studying the laws, while the final 2/3 of the volume was information on 4 special techniques: Beast God Transformation, Beast God Soldier, Beast God Roar, and Beast God Escape. It took Luo Feng 800 years to complete the first level, Scale Armor. Being able to comprehend this volume requires law comprehension the equivalent of the 15th level of the Tong Tian Bridge.

The second level, also known as Muscle (筋肉), is much harder to comprehend than the first. After 300 years of World Master level training, Luo Feng considered himself as having barely scratched its surface. After the 6,000 years spent passing the inheritance of Star Tower, Luo Feng finished this level. Its power is akin to the 18th level of the Tong Tian Bridge.

The third level can be considered an important threshold, as mastery of this would make one invincible versus anyone below a Universe Venerable, and thus its power is akin to the 20th level of the Tong Tian Bridge. Completion of this level would allow Luo Feng to use the second form of the one-pair Shi Wu Wings to disrupt space. Luo Feng was bequeathed the Beast God Inheritance corresponding to this level upon arrival on Bauhinia Island.

The fourth level, also known as Beast God's Claw, took Luo Feng about half a month to complete, through the use of his Beast God Inheritance opportunities earned in the World of Glory.

The fifth level, also known as Beast God's Lone Horn, is much more intricate than the fourth level. Mastery of this level would allow Luo Feng to use the 3rd form of the one-pair Shi Wu Wings. Utilizing his Beast God Inheritance chances once every two or three months, it still took Luo Feng about 63 years to finish this level.

This is the final level of the Beast God 7 Kills that was actually practiced by its creator, Xi Luo Duo. Completion of this level would make the practitioner invincible versus anyone below Universe Master; that is, it would make them a Universe Overlord. By the time Luo Feng had his clash with Five Chaos Master, dragging him into the 9th Abyss, he had almost completed this level.

While Xi Luo Duo was unable to reach this level, he knew that a 7th level should exist in theory, and he was correct. Those who joined the Ancestral God Sect or followed the Beast God path under Space Beast Ancestor could encounter those at the pinnacle of the 7th level, the Beast Gods and those who successfully merged an Upper and Lower law to become Universe Masters. As Luo Feng wanted to remain a Universe Venerable to increase his chances of obtaining the White Wings, he held off on comprehending this level to prevent himself from accidentally becoming a Universe Master. When Luo Feng fought Great Thunder Star Master, it was confirmed that he had completed this level, which meant he could transform into a Beast God.

artifacts.title: Beast God Blood
artifacts.introText: Beast God Blood is the essence of the Natural Beast God of Law of Gold  and Law of Space , extracted from the Blood River Crystal. One must extract the essence of 100 Blood River Crystals to create 1 drop of Beast God Blood. This meant that to create 100 drops, one would require 10,000 Blood River Crystals. However, using Beast God Blood instead of Blood River Crystals has the benefit of lessening the evil energy and pain that must be endured during the absorption process. For this reason, Beast God Blood is highly desired and strictly managed by the Virtual Universe Company.

artifacts.title: Bio-Ship
artifacts.introText: A Bio-Ship is a type of ship that is commonly seen in the Original Universe, but generally within specific groups, such as the Demon Race. Bio-Ships can fuse with Special Lifeforms, allowing them to evolve. Depending on the abilities of the lifeform with which it fused, the ship acquires different abilities. Luo Feng's Bio-Ship, which would normally be owned by a Limit Immortal King, could fly at 80 times light-speed, had defensive abilities over 100 times stronger than the upgraded Yun Mo Spaceship, and could regenerate!

She acquired it in her time in the World of Jin, and used it in the Sector Beast War, especially against Morosa in its first appearance in Universe Ocean.
artifacts.appearance: A machine of flowing black light.

artifacts.title: Blood Orchid Palace
artifacts.introText: Blood Orchid Palace is the non-canon name given to the Xeon Arcana Palace used by Blood Orchid Ancestor. As a Xeon Arcana Palace, it had incredible defense against both material and soul attacks, making it invaluable to Blood Orchid Ancestor as she traveled Universe Ocean and battled with the Sector Beasts.
artifacts.appearance: A black triangular tower.

artifacts.title: Blood River Crystal
artifacts.introText: It was a long triangular crystal, transparent and blood-red, glowing slightly, with a formless ripple about it, it gave off a faint feeling of a heart beating, ripples that beat after another.
artifacts.appearance: It was a long triangular crystal, transparent and blood-red, glowing slightly, with a formless ripple about it, it gave off a faint feeling of a heart beating, ripples that beat after another.

artifacts.title: Blood River Medal
artifacts.introText: A medal, palm-sized and dark red in color. Its surface was covered in engravings that formed an ancient palace.
artifacts.appearance: A medal, palm-sized and dark red in color. Its surface was covered in engravings that formed an ancient palace.

artifacts.title: Blood Sea Devil Armor
artifacts.introText: Blood Sea Devil Armor is an armor-type Void True God-level Xeon Arcana that was owned by Rampaging Devil God. It has the ability to generate a domain filled with the impact of a high level of Willpower where one seemed to have fallen into 'Hell of Blood Sea.' The outburst of willpower released can slightly affect True Gods, but can instantly overwhelm those with only Universe Master-level willpower. The armor could negate any attack below True God Level 8.
artifacts.appearance:
Blood Sea Devil Armor is an armor-type Void True God-level Xeon Arcana that was owned by Rampaging Devil God. It has the ability to generate a domain filled with the impact of a high level of Willpower where one seemed to have fallen into 'Hell of Blood Sea.' The outburst of willpower released can slightly affect True Gods, but can instantly overwhelm those with only Universe Master-level willpower. The armor could negate any attack below True God Level 8.

Originally, it radiated an endless blood-red light, but Rampaging Devil God made it so the armor was golden and emitted a golden hue, creating a dazzling effect. When he successfully joined the standard military in the World of Jin, he exchanged it for other Xeon Arcana.

artifacts.title: Blood Shadow Blade (Meta-Embryo)
artifacts.introText: An enormous stone blade, as tall as the entire mountain of treasures in which it was stuck. After Luo Feng touched it, Luo Feng's life mark was branded on the blade, and it also had Chinese characters on it.
artifacts.appearance: An enormous stone blade, as tall as the entire mountain of treasures in which it was stuck. After Luo Feng touched it, Luo Feng's life mark was branded on the blade, and it also had Chinese characters on it.
artifacts.personality:
Blood Shadow Blade is the name Luo Feng gave to the meta-embryo he chose in the Duan Dong River Space of Inheritance to serve as his final blade. Created with a lot of precious materials, its user has to imprint their techniques into the blade for it to become a true weapon, but even without using any Divine Power, its power could rival that of a top-tier Level 5 Universe Master! It was superior to Xeon Arcana despite only having one level of engraving on it. When analyzed by the virtual consciousness of Jin God King, it was stated to be a God King-level weapon!

After accepting Luo Feng as his disciple, Emperor Chu increased the upper bound of this treasure to Ultimate God King-level.

artifacts.title: Blood Shadow Sword
artifacts.introText: Blood Shadow Sword/Blood Shadow War Blade/Ghost Blade is an Earth ´´Blood Shadow´´ weapon series of the one-handed blade type available up to SS grade. It has the advantage of being a light combat blade with a fast swing and sharp tip for stabbing. It exists as a true and imitation product. It became the inspiration for Luo Feng's meta-embryo, Blood Shadow Blade.

artifacts.title: Blood Spirit Golden Pearl
artifacts.introText: Blood Spirit Golden Pearl is a treasure that is only produced at the Blood Spirit Star, on the border between the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom and the Thunder Ancient Kingdom. Twice or thrice every period, the Blood Spirit Star erupts, ejecting these pearls. Fights over this treasure are usually limited to Primal Chaos Sovereign-level conflicts.
artifacts.appearance: A blood-colored golden pearl.

artifacts.title: Blood Spirit Wine
artifacts.introText: Blood Spirit Wine is a high-quality wine available on the Continent of Origin. Two of the Perfect-level Chaos Layer Organism prisoners of the Wan Jie Kingdom agreed to sell some of their body materials for a supply of 1.5 cubic meters of this wine per Period, for 10,000 periods.

artifacts.title: Blood Tomb Blade
artifacts.introText: The Blood Tomb Blade is a presumed Heavy Treasure used by King Black Tomb. He built his reputation by massacring many, using brute force and this blade.
artifacts.appearance: A large, blood-colored blade.

artifacts.title: Bloodline Evolution Agent
artifacts.introText:
Why does Hu Yan Bo use Possession on other creatures? It is because races with strong bloodlines can evolve faster and cultivate more easily.
If you become a 1st grade bloodline, even if you don't practice much, you can reach the Domain Master level when you are mature.

artifacts.title: Blue Stone Token
artifacts.introText: Blue Stone Token is the non-canon name given to the Common Arcana communication device that Sitting Mountain Guest gives to Luo Feng. Specially made by Sitting Mountain Guest, Luo Feng uses this to instantly communicate with him when necessary.
artifacts.appearance: A token that looks like a blue stone.

artifacts.title: Blue-Purple Blood Crystal Flower

One flower is worth at least 100,000 Universe Sand, making it more valuable than the belongings of a powerful Eternal True God like Hei Duo Mo. This treasure can help one train in the Bloodline Cultivation Method.

artifacts.title: Bluestone Essence

artifacts.title: Book of Wisdom

It is made from the some of the body material of a Hunyuan Ancestor, and its value far exceeds that of The Eye of Life and Death. It can analyze everything, including Chaotic Origin Bloodlines, study the Great Daos, and assist in self-cultivation.

artifacts.title: C2 Grade Laser Gun

artifacts.title: Calamity Beast Diagram
artifacts.introText: The Calamity Beast Diagram is a rare treasure used by Primal Chaos Sovereigns to cultivate their Willpower. It was personally drawn by Emperor Ming. It is the cheapest of the three most cost-effective treasures for this purpose. If someone attempts a glimpse of a corner of the diagram with willpower below Primal Chaos Sovereign level, they will go completely insane. The diagram sold by the Flame Wind Guild Hall has a price of 15 million Universe Sands per copy, which can be paid at any Dark Hall branch. The diagram will be delivered within 10 days.

They were originally made for one of Canyue's disciples. Luo Feng purchased this as his first treasure weapon for his fights around Yulan City.

artifacts.title: Carriage
artifacts.introText: A Carriage is a flying horse-drawn means of transportation used in the Virtual Universe. Due to the restrictions on everyone's bodies in the Virtual Universe, Carriages are used by the wealthy to travel short distances, particularly those that require flight.

artifacts.title: Causality Communication Order
artifacts.introText: The Causality Communication Order is a device used to convey information. It is much more expensive than ordinary communication orders, and is even able to transmit information from inside a Miniature Universe to outside of it. The device targets causality, making it dangerous to use; those with adequate resources can use those to lock the location of anyone who uses one. Cultivators concerned with staying low-key would likely not use a Causality Communication Order, but those who think no powerful beings are looking for them may take full advantage of the device.

He hoped the forces of the Yu Kingdom could locate Sang Shui Yun if it turned out that he was indeed Blood Cloud.

artifacts.title: Chaotic Golden Wings
artifacts.introText: The first pair of wings was a large set of exquisite silver wings, 80 meters tall. Each feather was clearly visible, extremely sharp, and made of special metals.
artifacts.appearance:
The first pair of wings was a large set of exquisite silver wings, 80 meters tall. Each feather was clearly visible, extremely sharp, and made of special metals.

The second pair were an equally beautiful pair of silver wings; when they were first seen on Venerable Tian Yang, they were black, as a treasure of this level can easily change its color. This pair of wings was known as the Flowing Light Wings (流光羽翼(Liúguāng yǔyì)).

The third and fourth pairs were also equally beautiful pairs of silver wings, however Pei Xing Master wore them as black wings. This pair of wings was known as the Five-Color Cloud Wings (五色云翼(Wǔsè yún yì)).

The fifth pair was another equally beautiful pair of silver wings. As they remained within the Purple Moon Holy Land Universe, we do not know if they were ever another color.

The sixth pair of wings were a pair of white wings 100 meters tall. They looked white because they were covered with white light and the material was white, but they were actually covered with dust and had 3 bloodstains on them. Their edges were extremely sharp. Luo Feng calls this pair the White Wings (白色羽翼(Báisè yǔyì)).

artifacts.title: Chaotic Origin Crystal Spirit Fruit
artifacts.introText: Chaotic Origin Crystal Spirit Fruit is the fruit of tree that is cultivated and grown with Chaotic Origin Crystal Jade. This fruit has miraculous effects on nourishing the soul; after taking it, one will become more in tune with the Supreme Operation Laws, and one's comprehension will greatly increase. When Luo Feng ate his first fruit, his thinking speed multiplied by more than 20 times, despite him having a Perfect Divine Body and Second Level God King Willpower, and this lasted for a little longer than 1 Period.
artifacts.appearance: A light-red fruit.

artifacts.title: Chaotic Origin Heart
artifacts.introText: Chaotic Origin Heart is the first-ranked treasure available to those in Infinite Space with around 100,000 Reward Points, and costs 100,081 reward points. By integrating it into the body, one can obtain a Chaotic Origin Body and a high degree of compatibility with all of the Great Daos.
artifacts.appearance:
Chaotic Origin Heart is the first-ranked treasure available to those in Infinite Space with around 100,000 Reward Points, and costs 100,081 reward points. By integrating it into the body, one can obtain a Chaotic Origin Body and a high degree of compatibility with all of the Great Daos.

It is suggested that one exchanges for this only if they have comprehended the Major Branches of at least 5 Great Daos. It also comes with a reminder that once one had mastered more than half the Great Daos in the Supreme Operation Laws, having reached Second Level God King in each, they will have hope of mastering the Supreme Operation Laws and becoming master of the Origin World.

Suitable for those practicing the Great Dao of the Life Origin, it is recommended for use studying the Chaotic Origin Bloodline. This is helpful for the ultimate awakening of the Chaotic Origin Bloodline and jumping out of the Caged World.

artifacts.title: Chaotic Origin Power
artifacts.introText: Chaotic Origin Power is a mysterious power that flows in the area outside the Caged World of Swallowed Star. This power can be used as part of extraordinary inheritances and techniques, but these are generally only found in the Ancient Kingdoms, and they require an extraordinary amount of merits.
artifacts.appearance:
Chaotic Origin Power is a mysterious power that flows in the area outside the Caged World of Swallowed Star. This power can be used as part of extraordinary inheritances and techniques, but these are generally only found in the Ancient Kingdoms, and they require an extraordinary amount of merits.

Primal Chaos Sovereigns can only utilize this power through special methods, and most Transcendent Chaos Realms reach this level using inheritances relying on either this power or Chaotic Origin Material. Inheritances utilizing Chaotic Origin Power are capable of reaching Transcendent Chaos Realm even at the initial entry point. God Kings using these inheritances are also capable of more powerful and unpredictable methods than ordinary God Kings.

Using Chaotic Origin Power is less dangerous than using Chaotic Origin Bloodline, but is generally less powerful.

artifacts.title: Chaotic Origin Sword

artifacts.appearance:
Chaotic Origin Sword is the non-canon name given to the Sword Treasure made from body of a Chaotic Origin Lifeform found in the Infinite Space.

The sword is first-ranked treasure available to those in Infinite Space which requires 180,000 reward points to redeem, is crafted from the body of the Hunyuan Ancestor, Chaotic Origin Lifeform. This sword is suitable for practitioners of the three paths: Great Dao of the Thunder Origin, Great Dao of the Destruction Origin and Great Dao of the Matter Origin. If you comprehend these paths, it may aid in escaping from the Caged World.

It comes with a Reminder:

These treasures are best suited for remaining within the Source World for proper understanding. They must not be removed from the Source World, as doing so may lead to countless troubles.

artifacts.title: Common Arcana
artifacts.introText: Common Arcana (普通至宝(Pǔtōng zhìbǎo), lit. Common/Ordinary Most Valuable/Precious Treasure/Asset, also referred to simply as 至宝(Zhìbǎo); these are called True Treasures in the fan translation) are normally wielded by ordinary Universe Overlords, but may also be provided to lower-realm geniuses valued by their clans, organizations, etc.
artifacts.appearance:
Common Arcana (普通至宝(Pǔtōng zhìbǎo), lit. Common/Ordinary Most Valuable/Precious Treasure/Asset, also referred to simply as 至宝(Zhìbǎo); these are called True Treasures in the fan translation) are normally wielded by ordinary Universe Overlords, but may also be provided to lower-realm geniuses valued by their clans, organizations, etc.

Treasures meet the threshold of Arcana by having at least 3 levels or forms (unlike Top Heavy Treasures, which only have 2). These forms are activated through Original Law comprehension or Divine Power, depending on the treasure. The ability of Universe Overlords to fully utilize Common Arcana is one of the aspects that set them apart from Advanced Universe Venerables, who generally do not have that level of comprehension. When lower-realm cultivators with sufficiently strong techniques execute their techniques through Common Arcana, the power is substantially increased; for example, Luo Feng, as a World Master, was able to use his Pinnacle Techniques to fight with Limit Immortal Kings once he had Star Map. Arcana can also camouflage the aura of lower-realm cultivators, allowing World Masters to emit the aura of an Immortal, for example.

Some Common Arcana may also be used by Top Universe Overlords or the weakest Universe Masters (particularly Palace-type, Soul-type, or Domain-type). Common Arcana can be generally be destroyed by average Universe Masters and are thus worthless to them or those superior to them.

In the Human Race exchange, Common Arcana are generally worth about 1 Arcana Point, but those of more valuable types (such as Domain-type, Palace-type, and Soul-type) are worth considerably more, being exchanged for up to 120 Arcana Points.

artifacts.title: Currency
artifacts.introText: Currency is used to exchange goods, services, and treasures in Swallowed Star. Currencies used on Earth (块(Kuài): dollar/yuan) are useless in the universe.
artifacts.appearance:
Black Dragon Coin

Black Dragon Coins (黑龙币(Hēilóng bì), also called Black Dragon Dollars in the fan translation) are used in the Black Dragon Mountain Empire. They can also be used in the empire's subordinate empires, but cannot be used in higher level empires.
artifacts.quotes:
At the government remittance, 1 Black Dragon dollar could be exchanged for 1000 Silverblue dollars, indicating that this ship was worth 9 trillion Silver Blue dollars.

At the Black Dragon Empire government remittance, 1 Ganwu dollar could be exchanged for 1000 Black Dragon dollars, but the reverse exchange was impossible! Although it was feasible through the black market, typically, it required over 1000, nearly 2000 Black Dragon dollars to exchange for 1 Ganwu dollar. Additionally, ordinary citizens were unaware of the black market's location.

In regulated areas, Ganwu currency can be converted into Black Dragon currency, while Black Dragon currency is readily exchangeable for Silverblue currency, Babata explained. However, it's important to note that the reverse process isn't possible: Silverblue currency can't be converted into Black Dragon currency through official channels. Similarly, Black Dragon currency can't be traded for Ganwu currency.

artifacts.appearance:
Destruction Fruits are special items available to those who defeat one of the 7 statues on the Mountain of Destruction. These fruits are naturally condensed on the mountain, and when consumed by a Primogenitor, they can cause their Life Core to grow in the direction of Destruction. A single fruit is comparable to the blessing of an ordinary Mysterious Land, making them incredibly valuable.

For each statue one defeats on the Mountain of Destruction, they receive 1 Destruction Fruit, which, in addition to serving as a resource for Primogenitors, can also be exchanged for special treasures nurtured by the mountain. With 1 fruit, one can choose from 3,000 treasures, with 2 fruits one can choose from 100 treasures, with 3 fruits one can choose from 6 treasures, and with 4 fruits one can choose from 3 treasures.

In the entire Infinite Hunyuan Space, only Kafuxiu, Sha Zhou, and Luo Feng have obtained a Destruction Fruit. Kafuxiu obtained 1, obtaining the Kafuxiu Battle Armor, Sha Zhou obtained 2, which she consumed, evolving her Life Core, and Luo Feng obtained 6, 4 of which he exchanged for the Sharp Blade, and 2 for the Secret Treasure Robe.

artifacts.appearance:
The Emperor Armor was created by Sitting Mountain Guest for the Flame God Race and whoever else grew up on Earth. It is the next level up from the King Armor and General Armor, and as such it was produced by the Robbery Armor. Despite the Human Race's efforts, they were never able to reproduce this or any of the other Flame God race armors. Additionally, as it was created specifically for creatures from the remodeled Earth, if one who was not from Earth wore it, they would have to adjust their body to fit it, and would be unable to fully use its power.

The Emperor Armor is never seen in the story, as Luo Feng was made aware of it at a point when his next improvement in Life Gene Level (through the Nine Volume Manual) would enable him to become an Immortal with a Divine Body the equivalent of a strong Universe Venerable, and thus would be able to use the Robbery Armor.

While never seen, going by the trend from the King Armor, General Armor, and Soldier Armor, one can presume that when first worn, it would have the Flame God Race word for 'Emperor' on its chest. The user would have needed strength equal to at least 1,000,000 Pinnacle World Masters (effectively a powerful Limit Immortal King) to fully utilize it. Once fully utilized, it would have increased its user's strength by that of 10,000,000 Pinnacle World Masters (effectively 1 Universe Venerable) and would have blocked any attacks with that level of strength or below, whether material or soul. Attacks stronger than that would have been reduced by over 90% until the limit of the armor was reached. While the armor's limit is not explicitly stated, Sitting Mountain Guest states that this armor is to be used by those below Universe Venerable, so it is likely that Universe Overlords could exceed the limit.

artifacts.title: Equipment
artifacts.introText: Equipment can be placed in multiple categories: Genetic Weapons, Spirit Weapons, Treasures, Mechanical Weapons, Arcana, etc.
artifacts.appearance:
Equipment can be placed in multiple categories: Genetic Weapons, Spirit Weapons, Treasures, Mechanical Weapons, Arcana, etc.

Equipment of a certain level tends to have law engravings (there are exceptions like the Force Armor), as in order to drive their full capabilities, you have to have a certain understanding of the universe's origin laws.

Weapons can be used by multiple levels of cultivators, but generally have an optimal user level. Weapons that are more easily used are generally considered of higher quality and thus cost more. That being said, the highest quality weapons can only be used by the truly strong, regardless of the tier.

Genetic Weapons can be used by any cultivator while Spirit Weapons can only be truly used by Spirit Masters (Controllers, Hypnotists, Soul Attackers).

Spirit Weapons are generally more valuable than Fighter Weapons. Their construction is extremely complex, making them very expensive.

Defense armors can be used to defend against material and/or soul attacks. Depending on the level of armor, this can help cultivators survive fights above their level and escape.

Escape valuables such as wings, boots, etc. are used, as the name implies, to escape situations, whether combat or environmental. These can obviously be life-saving!

Arcana can be divided into multiple tiers and multiple types. There are sealing types, flying palace types, soul types, attack types, armor types, and even domain types. The most valuable are soul types and flying palace types, as they can weaken soul and material attacks (respectively) by a great deal! Flying palace types are also incredibly sturdy, and generally large enough to defend multiple cultivators and give them a path of escape. Domain types are equally valuable as they control the entire area they touched! This meant that users could easily eliminate opponents weaker than them, could suppress opponents who were their equals, and restrict opponents who were stronger than them, allowing them to escape.  When traveling through the Universe and the Universe Ocean, the ability to survive and escape is paramount!

Mechanical weapons include things like the automaton lasers that can do incredible damage to those under Immortal level, as well as extremely powerful tools that can raise the attack or defense capabilities of existences surpassing True God!

artifacts.personality:
General Armor is the second-lowest level of armor produced by the Robbery Armor, created by Sitting Mountain Guest for Immortals to fight against pinnacle Immortal Marquises. Only the Flame God Race and those with souls born on the Earth remodeled by Sitting Mountain Guest can utilize this armor, as with the other armors in this lineage. Luo Feng was able to finish it by gathering 113 silver fragments in one of the rubbish mountains of Wu Long Starfield. It took him 21 years to gather the fragments necessary for his first General Armor, and another 39 years to complete the second, giving him one armor each for his Earthling Body and Golden Horned Beast body. Once one has fully fused with the armor, it can adjust its size to match the user and conceal their race and identity.

In order to fully activate the General Armor, the user must have the strength of at least 100 times that of a pinnacle World Master, equivalent to an ordinary Immortal. Once activated, it provides the user with the strength of 10,000 pinnacle World Masters, equivalent to a pinnacle Immortal Marquis! Additionally, it could fully block material attacks with strength under that of 10,000 pinnacle World Masters. It could also reduce material attacks stronger than 10,000 pinnacle World Masters to 1/10th of their strength, up until the limit of the armor. Due to its special material, it blocked 99% of soul attacks.

artifacts.title: Genetic Energy Weapon
artifacts.introText: Genetic Energy Weapons (原力兵器(yuán lì bīngqì), lit. Origin/Source Energy/Power Weapon) are weapons used by Warriors and those using their Warrior capabilities to battle. Unlike ordinary weapons, which have power due their material (influencing sharpness, mass, etc.), Genetic Energy Weapons, in addition to having power due to those physical attributes, also allow cultivators to channel their body's Genetic Energy. Similar to how true Spirit Weapons allow Spirit Masters to maximize their Spirit Energy, Genetic Energy Weapons allow Warriors to maximize their Genetic Energy. Depending on their quality, a Genetic Energy Weapon may be easier or more difficult to use, which also dictates their value and cost.
artifacts.appearance:
Genetic Energy Weapons (原力兵器(yuán lì bīngqì), lit. Origin/Source Energy/Power Weapon) are weapons used by Warriors and those using their Warrior capabilities to battle. Unlike ordinary weapons, which have power due their material (influencing sharpness, mass, etc.), Genetic Energy Weapons, in addition to having power due to those physical attributes, also allow cultivators to channel their body's Genetic Energy. Similar to how true Spirit Weapons allow Spirit Masters to maximize their Spirit Energy, Genetic Energy Weapons allow Warriors to maximize their Genetic Energy. Depending on their quality, a Genetic Energy Weapon may be easier or more difficult to use, which also dictates their value and cost.

As Genetic Energy Weapons increase in strength and quality, they will begin to have Original Law engravings carved on them, making it easier for the user to utilize those Original Laws. This means that even if a user has a relatively lower level of comprehension of a law, the weapon can assist them in executing attacks using that law (Unnamed Three Axe Mountain General mentions this when acquiring the Air Cutter Blade).

The term Genetic Energy Weapon ceases to be used when dealing with weapons used by Immortals and stronger cultivators. This may be due to Immortals having bodies of Immortal Energy, which contains Original Law energy of the law they used to break through. Additionally, they require weapons that can withstand Immortal battles, which can easily destroy planets, stars, and later star systems and galaxies. Original Law engravings are present on Heavy Treasures and Arcana, but the physical weapons used are no longer referred to as Genetic Energy Weapons.

Ordinary Level 3 Genetic Energy Weapons (suitable for use through Universe Level) sell for 20 to 30 billion Black Dragon Coins. Level 4 weapons (suitable for use through Domain Master) sell for close to 100 billion Ganwu Coins. The average price of Level 5 weapons (suitable for use through World Master) sell for close to 100 billion Universe Coins!

artifacts.title: Grading System
artifacts.introText: In Swallowed Star, Items fall under grades, the lowest grade being A and the highest being Xeon Arcana. Each grade will be effective against a particular Cultivation level. Effective Level signifies the effective limit of an item against a character or an item, e.g. if a weapon is graded as B6 than it can hurt items and characters up to Stellar Level 6. Characters usually start using Treasures during Universe Venerable-level and above.
artifacts.appearance: Unlike the humans who used the metals and alloys in a more distinct way, which was easier to tell what sort of metals or alloys were used, humans had no way at all to tell just what the automaton construct was made of. Automaton Grading is different from Human Race grading. For example, a D1-9 Grade Automaton Ship will be regarded as a D9 ship by humans.

artifacts.title: Gray Armor
artifacts.introText: Gray Armor is a Pinnacle Arcana Armor Treasure worn by Yuan Ao Master. With this armor and the Divine Wood, he had no fear of attacks in the Original Universe, even from True Gods. This armor was blasted into the void space of the Yuan Ao Secret Region after he self-destructed.
artifacts.appearance: A gray set of armor that flows like mercury.

artifacts.title: Great Dao Diagram

It can be used to deduce suitable secret methods and can analyze the Great Dao to assist in cultivation, greatly improving the efficiency of understanding the Great Dao. The weaker one is, the better the auxiliary effect of this treasure. It is relatively easy to use this to reach Pinnacle Second Level God King.
artifacts.appearance:
The Great Dao Diagram is a treasure available for redemption in Infinite Space for 20,000 Reward Points. It can be used to deduce suitable secret methods and can analyze the Great Dao to assist in cultivation, greatly improving the efficiency of understanding the Great Dao. The weaker one is, the better the auxiliary effect of this treasure. It is relatively easy to use this to reach Pinnacle Second Level God King.

This treasure comes with a dangerous reminder: The Great Dao Diagram cannot help one to master a Complete Great Dao, and if one uses it in the early stages of comprehending the Great Dao, the difficulty of comprehending the Complete Great Dao will become extremely high. If one only used this to deduce suitable secret methods, there will be no future troubles.

artifacts.title: Heart of Evolution
artifacts.introText: The Heart of Evolution is a special resource used to evolve an Intelligent Life, allowing it to fully integrate with a metal body under its control. Through this integration, the Intelligent Life then becomes a member of the Automaton Race, capable of Original Laws comprehension comparable to a Human Race powerhouse.
artifacts.appearance:
The Heart of Evolution is a special resource used to evolve an Intelligent Life, allowing it to fully integrate with a metal body under its control. Through this integration, the Intelligent Life then becomes a member of the Automaton Race, capable of Original Laws comprehension comparable to a Human Race powerhouse.

Without a Heart of Evolution, an Intelligent Life can never breakthrough to Immortal, but even with it, while reaching World Master is easy, it is still difficult to breakthrough to Immortal. Through further training, the automaton's body would continue to strengthen, increasing in flexibility, toughness, and other aspects, similar to a true flesh body.

The Heart of Evolution can be considered the most important treasure of the Automaton Race, and thus was extremely difficult for other races to acquire. Control of these items is very strict; the race is forbidden from selling it, and that rule is deeply embedded in their cores.

artifacts.title: Heart of Stars
artifacts.introText: The heart of stars, is a legendary item. In the vast universe, several Planets that have the ability to produce and sustain life, for example plant life, beasts, humans, life planets. These life planets all have a limited life span, when one life planet grows old, its core would gather all of its remaining life energy into a crystal forming the heart of stars.

artifacts.title: Heavy Treasure

Heavy Treasures can be activated with Original Law comprehension or Divine Power, depending on the item, and they may have lower-level techniques that can be performed by Immortal Kings, and higher-level techniques that can be performed by Universe Venerables. Higher/Advanced Most Valuable/Precious Treasure/Asset, called Senior True Treasure in the fan translation) are normally wielded by Top Universe Overlords and poorer Universe Masters, but may also be provided to lower-realm geniuses valued by their clans, organizations, etc. Those of higher value, such as Palace-type, Domain-type, or Soul-type, may be used by Tier 3 Universe Masters, and would make Universe Masters jealous.

artifacts.title: Hunyuan Life Core
artifacts.introText: Hunyuan Life Core is the non-canon name given to the Life Core of Natural Hunyuan Lifeforms to differentiate them from the Life Cores of Domain Masters and World Masters.
artifacts.appearance:
Hunyuan Life Core is the non-canon name given to the Life Core of Natural Hunyuan Lifeforms to differentiate them from the Life Cores of Domain Masters and World Masters.

Similar to how a Source World has a Land of Origin, the Life Core serves as the Origin Core of Natural Hunyuan Lifeforms, and is the most valuable part of their body. These lifeforms are born with the Life Core, which continuously grows through various opportunities, and can eventually reach a level comparable to the Origin of the Source World, making them a Hunyuan Ancestor. Destroying the Life Core will kill the lifeform, so it is very difficult to kill them and preserve the core for sale, refinement, etc. Natural Hunyuan Lifeforms, understanding this vulnerability, hide their cores and typically have abilities to protect them.

The Life Core contains all of the Hunyuan Lifeform's mysteries, so it is also an invaluable resource to the Cultivator Camp, which studies them for guidance in how to jump out of the cage. When capturing territory owned by the Natural Hunyuan Lifeform Camp, the Overlords refine the Life Cores of the High-Level Hunyuan Lifeforms and World-Class Hunyuan Lifeforms, making them members of the Cultivator Camp for eternity.

While the Life Core is a weak point for the Natural Hunyuan Lifeforms, it can also continuously accumulate power and maintain a large physical body. As a result, Hunyuan Ancestors generally have much larger bodies than Overlords. The mysteries of life core formation are primarily based on the mysteries of life, so the mysteries of life make up at least 10% of the mysteries of any Hunyuan Ancestor.

artifacts.title: Illusory Realm Maze
artifacts.introText: The Illusory Realm Maze is a high-grade spatial-type secret treasure used for storage. It is a dazzling polyhedral object that radiates various strange colors. This treasure allows its owner to store valuable items securely and is highly sought after among powerful beings. While it is relatively affordable at 100,000 Chaotic Origin Crystals, its rarity and usefulness make it a common target for theft. Despite this, only a few individuals in the Nine Rivers Holy World possess the ability to steal it. Most God Emperors own one, as it provides a reliable way to safeguard their treasures. Even though its craftsmanship reaches the Half-Chaotic Origin level, its simple materials and singular function keep its price lower than other high-grade treasure.

The Life and Death Calamity Diagram was a powerful secret treasure that Luo Feng had acquired at great cost. It contained the deep mysteries of the Great Dao of Life  and the Great Dao of Destruction  at the Late Stage God Emperor. Its main function was to enhance Luo Feng’s Indestructible Blood Sea Body, turning his blood sea into an overwhelming domain filled with both life force and destructive power.

When activated, the Life and Death Calamity Diagram transformed the surrounding space into an endless blood sea. Within this domain, the blood sea surged like a living entity, resisting enemy attacks, eroding opponent's forces, and continuously regenerating. Luo Feng’s connection to the blood sea was absolute, his body and the blood sea were one, allowing him to shift seamlessly between solid form and liquid form. Any damage inflicted was instantly regenerated, making him nearly impossible to kill through conventional means.

As he reached Early-Stage God Emperor in Great Dao of Birth and Death, he replaced The Palm World with this formation diagram secret treasure as the core to defend Hu Yang City.

artifacts.title: Life Core
artifacts.introText: The Life Core is the consolidation of a Domain Master's sea of Consciousness, containing their soul. One's Life Core can be stored in any part of their body.
artifacts.appearance:
The Life Core is the consolidation of a Domain Master's sea of Consciousness, containing their soul. One's Life Core can be stored in any part of their body.

Due to the Life Core containing their soul, Domain Masters can survive injuries that would result in certain death for lower level cultivators, such as decapitation, as long as their Life Core was not contained in their head. This is also why Domain Masters cannot be enslaved with Microchips.

Life Cores differ in strength between different lifeforms; for example, the Life Core of a Golden Horned Beast is much more powerful than that of a Human, since the Golden Horned Beast's Life Core also has to support its Internal World.

artifacts.title: Life Fruit

As a result, it is also known as a World Master's second life, and countless World Masters would be willing to exchange an entire Galaxy for one.

As a result, it is also known as a World Master's second life, and countless World Masters would be willing to exchange an entire Galaxy for one.

Luo Feng used this item on his Cloud Vine at Cang Lan Star's World Within a World to push it from Stellar Level 4 to Universe Level 2. Later, when he attended the Ganwu Auction, he saw one sell for 2.8609 trillion Universe Coins, and he was later able to buy two from the Virtual Universe Company for 100 VUC Points total. He used one of these Life Fruits to help his Cloud Vine break through from Universe Level 9 to Domain Master.

artifacts.title: Lotus Heart Seed

When used, it can grow a Lotus of Life within the user's internal world, making it more stable, and greatly improving the strength and vitality of the user's body. The user will also become akin to the darling of the Great Dao of Life , increasing their affinity with and cultivation efficiency of that Great Dao. artifacts.title: Lotus of Life
artifacts.introText: The Lotus of Life is a rare and extraordinary treasure that serves as the core enhancer of Luo Feng’s secret technique, the River of Life. When Luo Feng’s World Lifeform clone, carrying energy reserves equivalent to 56 times a Perfect Divine Body, activated the eight-branch fusion secret technique, the Life-Lotus within his inner world manifested as the nucleus of the blood-colored river. This transformation elevated the River of Life into a self-contained world with immense destructive and suppressive properties. The Lotus of Life amplified the move’s might to the extent that it nearly touched the Supreme Operation Laws’ upper limit, despite Luo Feng still being only a God King Second Realm without relying on external treasures. In value, the Lotus of Life was regarded as comparable to a Beyond God King level secret treasure, enabling Luo Feng’s River of Life to surpass the strength of ordinary eight-branch techniques and rival the highest limits of the Continent of Origin. Its integration turned each strand of the blood river into a force capable of suppression, annihilation, and imprisonment, making the Life-Lotus one of the most vital factors in Luo Feng’s rise to peak combat power.

artifacts.title: Mechanical Treasure
artifacts.introText: Mechanical Treasures (机械流宝(Jīxiè liú bǎo), lit. Machine-class/grade Treasure, or 机械类宝物(Jīxiè lèi bǎowù), lit. Machine-class/type Treasure, also called Machine-type or Automaton-type Treasure in the fan translation) is a class of Treasure normally wielded by True Gods and stronger cultivators, but high-valued geniuses of lower realms may also have them.
artifacts.appearance:
Mechanical Treasures can be divided into multiple groups, with the main ones being single-body treasures, group-type treasures, and legion-type treasures.

Single-Body Treasures are the most common Mechanical Treasures. As the name implies, they are meant to be used by a single individual, substantially raising their power. The highest-quality single-body treasures allow the user to exhibit power from cultivation realms exceeding their own; for example, the Chaotic Golden Wings allow Eternal True Gods to access some of the power of a Primal Chaos Sovereign.

Black Cloud Wings

Chaotic Golden Wings

Life Blood River

Order of Escape from All Realms

Primal Chaos Machine

Qi Wen Flying Armor

Group-Type Treasures are typically used by relatively small units of cultivators. They are seen in the World of Jin and may be considered lower-tier examples of Legion-Type Treasures, but this isn't explicitly stated. By gathering and condensing the power of hundreds of True Gods, a True God-level group-type mechanical treasure could be used to kill a Void True God.

Chi Winged Dragon

Jin Luo Sky and Land

Legion-Type Treasures are only explicitly seen on the Continent of Origin. They are used by important official forces (city guards, military units) and, depending on their quality, may be piloted by large numbers of True Gods (with a Void True God leader), or Void True Gods (with an Eternal True God leader). The most powerful of these treasures were forged by God Kings, and can be piloted by multiple Eternal True Gods!

Black Fire Beast

Heart Devil Hawk

Heart Shadow Devil General

Six-Armed Divine Owl

Snow Realm Envoy

artifacts.title: Memory Stone
artifacts.introText: Memory Stones, also known as Inheritance Stones, are information storage units used by great beings of the Wu Kingdom to store large quantities of memories. The Duan Dong River Inheritance is contained within memory stones, with the 3 root inheritances (Duan Mie, Dong Hua, and Undying River) stored in one stone each, the core inheritance stored in 12,002 stones, and the remaining basic inheritance stored in hundreds of millions of other stones. The information contained within them is shocking; it took a Universe Venerable Luo Feng an entire day (in a 10,000 times accelerated space, so around 27 years) to absorb the information within the 3 root stones, 15 days (over 410 years) to memorize the core inheritance, and close to 30 years (300,000 years) to memorize the basic inheritance!
artifacts.appearance: A smooth, crystal-like black stone.

artifacts.title: Meta-Embryo
artifacts.introText: Meta-Embryo is a class of unique treasure that was available within the Duan Dong River Space of Inheritance. Within the space were 322 meta-embryos, including the Blood Shadow Blade that Luo Feng selected as his. These treasures were accumulated by the 192 generations of Duan Dong River, and left behind for their heirs to choose from. Before the heir passed, they had to return their selection; some particularly strong ones left additional ones behind. Meta-Embryos came in multiple categories, including spiritual force weapons, close-combat weapons, mechanical weapons, and even treasures that could be used to manufacture other treasures!
artifacts.appearance:
Meta-Embryo is a class of unique treasure that was available within the Duan Dong River Space of Inheritance. Within the space were 322 meta-embryos, including the Blood Shadow Blade that Luo Feng selected as his. These treasures were accumulated by the 192 generations of Duan Dong River, and left behind for their heirs to choose from. Before the heir passed, they had to return their selection; some particularly strong ones left additional ones behind. Meta-Embryos came in multiple categories, including spiritual force weapons, close-combat weapons, mechanical weapons, and even treasures that could be used to manufacture other treasures!

A Meta-Embryo is unique in that it is a treasure that had yet to be fully formed, which meant that even Immortals under Universe Venerable could start to use it. This was important, as Immortal fighters typically could not use Arcana, since they could not comprehend the engravings. Despite this, the Meta-Embryos were incredibly powerful; the Blood Shadow Blade that Luo Feng used had Top-Tier Universe Master Level 5 power, even without any godly power used. This was more powerful than even Xeon Arcana, if their engravings weren't activated. The meta-embryos initially had no layers of secret engravings, yet matched the power of Xeon Arcana with multiple levels of engravings!

The additional unique aspect of the Meta-Embryo is its ability to be infused with secret techniques, adding engravings to it. This meant that if a user had a momentary burst of inspiration and created a technique that would be incredibly difficult to replicate, if they infused that technique into the Meta-Embryo, they would be able to use that technique merely by activating the Meta-Embryo. The strength of the Meta-Embryo would also increase the power of the technique used! Furthermore, a user could infuse multiple techniques into it, so as a user grew, they could add stronger and stronger techniques to the treasure. As they were all God King-level treasures, they could be used as the user reached the pinnacle of the ancient civilization.

artifacts.title: Microchip
artifacts.introText: An item used to control organisms. Organisms sold at Slave Market all have this chip installed in their brains/soul. They have a low cost of production but are extremely advance. It is said that it was a piece of technology acquired by the Human Race battling the Automaton Race. The moment it melded with a living organism, that organism would be totally controlled. He would still have all his past memories, but a deep sense of loyalty towards his new owner would develop! Any smallest sense of disrespect would result in the microchip reacting adversely. In the vast universe, even after countless years, with the living microchips controlling the slaves, there hasn’t been a case of a slave betraying his owner. The microchip is only effective up to Universe Level warriors. Being who have chips installed will get headaches when they first recognize a master.

artifacts.personality:
The Nine Volume Manual (Nine Calamities Secret Tome) is a set of cultivation guides/training manual created by Sitting Mountain Guest with the purpose of increasing the Life Gene Level of the cultivator. It will also increase the power of their soul and bring out an absolute change in one's talent in the area of cultivation.

The manual allows its practitioner to break the Life Gene Level limit set by the universe law, which caused it to be rejected by the universe laws themselves. When Sitting Mountain Guest passed the manual's knowledge onto any Earthling, the universe laws would erase the memory of that user. Sitting Mountain Guest was unaffected by the memory loss due to his strength, but it made it impossible to pass the guides down as they existed at the time.

To circumvent this, he used some special treasures he discovered, the Heavenly Soul Crystals, to house the Nine Volume Manual. With their natural power, as long as a human from Earth was able to pass the illusions within the crystals, they could acquire the techniques. Sitting Mountain Guest understood that the universe laws are fair, and there was always a chance, if one could find it. Even with the strength of the Nine Volume Manual, there would be a way to pass the techniques on to someone else.

Despite this circumvention, the techniques can still only be passed onto one individual at a time; as long as the cultivator who began training in the Nine Volume Manual was alive, no one else could attempt to learn those techniques. Additionally, if the cultivator died, even upon resurrection they would never remember the techniques of the manual.

artifacts.title: Nine Divine Armaments
artifacts.introText: The Nine Divine Armaments are Spirit Weapons for Controllers. Each of them are the embodiment of Original Laws; 8 of them are each the embodiment of one of the 8 lower Original Laws, mixed with an upper Original Law (for example, Law of Gold  and Law of Space ), while the remaining weapon is the embodiment of the mixing of the two upper Original Laws. While these weapons utilize a mixing of Original Laws, they do not utilize a fusion of the Original Laws, so the guardians of the Tong Tian Bridge are able to use them. This makes them different from something like the Beast God Armament, which relies on the fusion law of gold and space.

artifacts.personality:
The Nine-Segment Black Bone is a majestic, long skeletal structure divided naturally into nine distinct segments. It possesses several unique attributes:

Mystery of Indestructibility: Upon close inspection, the bone reveals the fundamental laws of indestructibility. It provides a blueprint for how a life form's physical composition can become virtually eternal and resistant to all forms of decay or destruction.

Massive Weight and Aura: The bone emits a terrifying aura that commands respect. Even for a powerful cultivator like Luo Feng, the object is incredibly heavy, requiring specialized high-level secret treasures (such as the Water Drop Flying Boat) to transport.

The Rule of One: Similar to the treasures in the Dream Realm, an invisible message is transmitted to anyone who touches the bone: a seeker can only take one segment. Once a segment is removed, the individual is permanently barred from obtaining any other special life remains from the Heavenly Pillar Realm.

artifacts.title: Pinnacle Arcana
artifacts.introText: Pinnacle Arcana (巅峰至宝(Diānfēng zhìbǎo), lit. Pinnacle/Peak Most Valuable/Precious Treasure/Asset, called Pinnacle True Treasure in the fan translation) are normally wielded by Tier 4 or 5 Universe Masters and by poorer True Gods. They may also be provided to lower-realm geniuses valued by their clans, organizations, etc. Universe Masters with Pinnacle Arcana are generally able to roam the Original Universe and Universe Ocean without much concern for others. Pinnacle Arcana are among the rarest treasures in the Original Universe, and can be considered once-in-a-lifetime treasures. Pinnacle Arcana (巅峰至宝(Diānfēng zhìbǎo), lit. Pinnacle/Peak Most Valuable/Precious Treasure/Asset, called Pinnacle True Treasure in the fan translation) are normally wielded by Tier 4 or 5 Universe Masters and by poorer True Gods. They may also be provided to lower-realm geniuses valued by their clans, organizations, etc. Universe Masters with Pinnacle Arcana are generally able to roam the Original Universe and Universe Ocean without much concern for others. Pinnacle Arcana are among the rarest treasures in the Original Universe, and can be considered once-in-a-lifetime treasures. They are easier to find in Universe Ocean, but are still mostly found in the Three Dangerous Lands. While poorer True Gods and those who lead races will value Pinnacle Arcana, they generally have little worth to lone True Gods or True Gods able to acquire multiple Xeon Arcana.

As Arcana, they have 3 levels or forms that are activated through Original Law comprehension or Divine Power. Universe Masters capable of fully utilizing the third form of a Pinnacle Arcana are typically Tier 5 Universe Masters. High-level Pinnacle Arcana have multiple functions; for example, the Robbery Armor, in addition to defending against material attacks, provided defense against Soul Attacks and granted the user additional strength. Considering the rarity of Xeon Arcana (some of the Nine Superpowers didn't have one!), Pinnacle Arcana would send numerous races into a frenzy, causing incredible battles on the Original Stars and in Universe Ocean, and they could be considered part of the foundation of a Powerful Race. The most valuable Pinnacle Arcana (typically Domain-type, Flying Palace-type, or Soul-type) are incredible treasures that are considered comparable to Strange Objects.

In the Human Race exchange, an ordinary attack-type is worth about 1,200 Arcana points, making them over 10 times as expensive as their Top Arcana counterparts, while Zerg Empress explicitly stated that providing 9 Top Arcana to a True God to kill Luo Feng was the equivalent of paying 1 Pinnacle Arcana. In the World of Jin, even if you exchanged hundreds or thousands of Pinnacle Arcana, you wouldn't receive a Xeon Arcana. Even for someone as talented as Sitting Mountain Guest, refining a Pinnacle Arcana took significant effort, and the materials for a Domain-type Pinnacle Arcana were so scarce that he felt even the Human Race may not be able to gather them. The most dangerous parts of the Three Dangerous Lands can destroy Pinnacle Arcana.

artifacts.introText: The Purple Heart World Flower is a rare and highly valuable treasure found within the Dream Realm, notable for its radiant purple blossoms that emit fine specks of glowing light. artifacts.appearance:
The Purple Heart World Flower is a rare and highly valuable treasure found within the Dream Realm, notable for its radiant purple blossoms that emit fine specks of glowing light. Each flower holds immense attraction for cultivators due to its unique energy, with an assessed value of three million Merits under the evaluation systems of the Two Great Ancient Kingdoms. While considered one of the more common treasures of the Dream Realm, its worth remains significant, and its rarity ensures it is sought after by powerful cultivators.

These flowers are often heavily guarded by Dream Realm plant lifeforms, camouflaged as ordinary trees. In one recorded encounter, Luo Feng, alongside Wu Xin God King, Gui Xu Emperor, and Yun Tian God King, faced nine such Lifeforms three of which possessed might exceeding Tian Kun. Due to the Dream Realm’s unique operating rules, concealment techniques fail upon approaching treasures, forcing intruders to fight directly. The team employed a coordinated strategy: Yun Tian’s Chaotic Origin Bloodline–based poison weakened the enemies, Gui Xu Emperor’s eight-armed techniques and Wu Xin’s sword strikes destroyed them, while Luo Feng safeguarded the flowers from collateral damage.

Ultimately, seven Purple Heart World Flowers of high quality were successfully retrieved. Their acquisition highlighted not only the immense risk tied to Dream Realm treasures but also the delicate balance between offensive combat and careful preservation, as even minor damage could greatly reduce their value. The flowers were later distributed according to prearranged shares, reinforcing their importance as a measure of power and resource within the Continent of Origin’s cultivation hierarchy.

artifacts.title: S9 Flycutter
artifacts.introText: The S9 Flycutter is a throwing knife, meant to be used by Spirit Masters. As a 9th series weapon, even Advanced Beast Seigneurs (equivalent to Apprentice Level 9) would find it difficult to destroy. Since they are throwing knives, they are light and use much less material than a blade or armor, so they are affordable for weaker fighters.
artifacts.appearance:
The S9 Flycutter is a throwing knife, meant to be used by Spirit Masters. As a 9th series weapon, even Advanced Beast Seigneurs (equivalent to Apprentice Level 9) would find it difficult to destroy. Since they are throwing knives, they are light and use much less material than a blade or armor, so they are affordable for weaker fighters.

Spirit Masters use their telekinesis to use them to attack Mutant Beasts or other opponents. A Warrior could use these as a sort of distraction, but would be unable to completely control their trajectory, retrieve them mid-battle, or throw them at the same speed as a Spirit Master (who can launch them at speeds exceeding a bullet!).

While a weapon used by Spirit Masters, technically it would not be considered a Spirit Weapon since it does not maximize their abilities, and even requires more Spirit Energy to be moved at greater distances. It would be more akin to a hidden weapon.

artifacts.title: Sacred Tablet
artifacts.introText: A tablet 300 meters tall, 100 meters wide, and 50 meters thick, made of a completely dark green crystal. There is a cone-shaped hole at its center, about 30 centimeters in diameter and 1 meter deep. The entire tablet only has one picture, one of a roaring human-shaped devil. The devil has 2 curved horns, feathered wings, and fiery eyes, and every aspect of it is unbelievably mysterious.

Its construction combines ancient technology, powerful laws, and advanced AI, making it one of the most secure and secretive sanctuaries in the battlefield.
