artifacts.title: Scanning Device
artifacts.introText: Scanning Devices are used to scan large or small areas (depending on the device). They can detect the energy of lifeforms or inanimate objects that emit energy, and, depending on their quality, even determine the level of lifeforms. Scanning Devices also have blocking capabilities, enabling one to scan while blocking incoming scans, further protecting the owner of the better device.
artifacts.appearance:
Scanning Devices are used to scan large or small areas (depending on the device). They can detect the energy of lifeforms or inanimate objects that emit energy, and, depending on their quality, even determine the level of lifeforms. Scanning Devices also have blocking capabilities, enabling one to scan while blocking incoming scans, further protecting the owner of the better device.

The use of good Scanning Devices in battles like the Extraterritorial Battlefield could determine whether one would live or die. If someone has a better Scanning Device than the other being then they could observe others without being discovered. For example when Ci Wei Ka ambushed Luo Feng, Ci Wei Ka was able to observe Luo Feng with his scanning device without Luo Feng ever finding out his location, because he had a better Scanning Device. The army system in the Extraterritorial Battlefield uses Scanning Devices to monitor the battles, determining if soldiers are betraying their alliance, etc., but they are limited. For example, the devices could not detect when King Tian Zhen attempted to kill Luo Feng.

While Scanning Devices are used in certain battlefields, high-quality devices are designed for exploration of Secret Regions rather than battlefields. For the truly strong, their talent techniques, law domains, and other techniques suffice for analyzing regions. Secret Regions, on the other hand, due to their unique nature, are dangerous and may have objects whose dangers cannot be accurately ascertained without careful analysis. To explore these regions, the strong use Scanning Devices.

Despite these abilities, Scanning Devices can be circumvented by certain techniques, such as King Bark Mirror's Universe Mirror. It is implied that, like other technological devices, the highest-quality Scanning Devices are those of the Automaton Race.

artifacts.title: Secret Treasure Robe
artifacts.introText: The Secret Treasure Robe, an artifact imbued with a destructive aura, is a high-level defensive treasure obtained by Luo Feng from the Mountain of Destruction in exchange for two Destruction Fruits. This mystical land lies within the Abyss Of Destruction.
artifacts.appearance:
The Secret Treasure Robe, an artifact imbued with a destructive aura, is a high-level defensive treasure obtained by Luo Feng from the Mountain of Destruction in exchange for two Destruction Fruits. This mystical land lies within the Abyss Of Destruction.

The robe's primary function is to provide an unparalleled level of defense against destructive forces. Its efficacy was demonstrated during Luo Feng's trial against the seventh and final Sculpture, which summoned the destructive avatars of twenty-eight powerful beings who each control a layer of the Chaos Destruction Realm. Without the robe, Luo Feng's protective abilities were insufficient, resulting in a fifty percent loss of energy reserves after a single volley. With the robe, this loss was dramatically reduced to only one percent, allowing his personal energy domain and other defenses to absorb the remaining force.

The acquisition of the Secret Treasure Robe fundamentally changed Luo Feng's defensive capabilities, elevating his body’s durability to a level comparable to that of a Lord-level entity like Wu Lan. This artifact is a crucial component of his combat strategy, providing the resilience necessary to withstand overwhelming attacks and enabling him to engage in prolonged battles against opponents with superior destructive power. The robe, alongside his Bloodshadow Blade, forms the core of Luo Feng's two main treasures, making him a formidable opponent and providing the foundational defense required to challenge the most difficult trials.

artifacts.title: Sector Beast Blood Talisman

It is a resource known to very few on the Continent of Origin; Emperor Chu, as an Emperor who cultivates in the Great Dao of the Destruction Origin, has used one in the past and can exchange for another one. Exchanging for one talisman requires 100 million Merits, but Emperors who do not cultivate the Great Dao of Destruction may not be able to exchange for one, and Guest Officials aren't even qualified to see them!
artifacts.appearance:

One viewing is available to Guest Officials of the Emperor Chu Family for 100,000 Merits. To watch it, one must have God King-level willpower just to barely stay awake; with this level of will, one will not remember much after watching it. Thus, it is best to have Second Level God King-level willpower before watching it.

artifacts.title: Silverium Guards
artifacts.introText: Silverium Guards are a special type of product made mainly of Silverium. They are used as bodyguards and have a built-in AI, allowing them to behave like humans, even able to talk and run errands. Because of the water-like nature of their body structure, they mitigate impact force used against them, and they can alter their size and shape to deal with opponents of different sizes and numbers. Their attacks are weak, but even Universe Level opponents would have to use quite a bit of time to break free from their restraint. They differ from robots in that they only listen to orders from their master and use a C Grade power source to maintain their lives. They have a maximum speed of 10,000 m/s.

Soul Treasure (灵魂类(Línghún lèi), lit. Soul-type or Soul-class) is a class of Treasure found in the world of Swallowed Star. Soul Treasures are generally used by those at the Universe Overlord level or above, but are sometimes granted to talented geniuses of lower realms by powerful organizations and races.

All Immortals with souls can perform Soul Attacks, but those Immortals also have innate defense against those low-level soul attacks. However, those Immortals who specialize in soul attacks are incredibly dangerous, with Pinnacle Immortal Kings being comparable to Limit Immortal Kings in danger. Most Armor Treasures and Palace Treasures lack the ability to protect souls. Soul Treasures, as objects that significantly weaken soul attacks and protect the soul, thus have incredible value, comparable to Domain Treasures and Palace Treasures.

Soul Treasures can be combined with soul defense techniques (like Beast God Roar), significantly increasing the user's soul defense. Some Soul Treasures can also strengthen the cultivator's soul, allowing them to perform stronger soul attacks, making them valuable offensive tools as well. Soul Treasures are rare and extremely attractive to great beings, but most are fragile and will shatter when facing soul attacks that exceed their limit. They are often seen with Zerg Race cultivators, who all specialize in soul techniques.

Only after it became a solid and stable crystal without any space cracks would the crystal be completely matured. The Space Heart is only useful after that.

After Luo Feng absorbed the energy from the Space Heart his Mosha Body went through the evolution of the Life Gene causing it to evolve into a Special Lifeform. It also granted his Mosha Body a new talent technique called Domain.

artifacts.title: Spirit Weapon
artifacts.introText: Spirit Weapons (念力兵器, Niànlì bīngqì, lit. Telekinesis Weapon) are weapons used by Spirit Masters to take full advantage of their special abilities. Their construction is extremely complex, so their prices are very expensive. Depending on the quality, a Spirit Weapon may be easier or more difficult to use; for example, the Soaring Shuttle is a low-quality Spirit Weapon due to its high requirements of its users, while the Arc Blade is a medium-quality Spirit Weapon due to having lower requirements of its users. Attacks using Spirit Weapons are typically much faster than those from Genetic Energy Weapons. Additionally, using Spirit Weapons allows Spirit Masters to attack from long-range, avoiding melee combat. For these reasons among others, Spirit Masters are especially difficult for fighters to handle.
artifacts.appearance:
Spirit Weapons (念力兵器, Niànlì bīngqì, lit. Telekinesis Weapon) are weapons used by Spirit Masters to take full advantage of their special abilities. Their construction is extremely complex, so their prices are very expensive. Depending on the quality, a Spirit Weapon may be easier or more difficult to use; for example, the Soaring Shuttle is a low-quality Spirit Weapon due to its high requirements of its users, while the Arc Blade is a medium-quality Spirit Weapon due to having lower requirements of its users. Attacks using Spirit Weapons are typically much faster than those from Genetic Energy Weapons. Additionally, using Spirit Weapons allows Spirit Masters to attack from long-range, avoiding melee combat. For these reasons among others, Spirit Masters are especially difficult for fighters to handle.

As Spirit Weapons increase in strength and quality, they will begin to have Original Law engravings carved on them, making it easier for the user to utilize those Original Laws. Through their abilities, Spirit Masters could trigger the law engravings, allowing them to perform more advanced formations and techniques. Spirit Weapons without those engravings are tens to hundreds of times more difficult to use; for example: Luo Feng was able to use the 9th level technique of the Yan Shen Armament, with its engravings of Law of Space  and Law of Gold , but when using a Spirit Weapon without law engravings, it was incredibly difficult for him to even use the 8th level technique of the Yan Shen Armament.

At lower cultivation levels, use of a Spirit Weapon is driven by Original Law comprehension, Willpower, and Consciousness. Those with higher law comprehension, Willpower, or Consciousness can compensate for weaknesses in the other attributes. At higher cultivation levels, there are two ways to utilize Spirit Weapon Arcana. One is with deep law comprehension, allowing a user to amplify the use of their Divine Power tenfold. The other is for those with poor law comprehension to use incredible amounts of Divine Power, hundreds to thousands of times that used by others to achieve the same effect. Inadequate law comprehension or Divine Power significantly slows the speed of Spirit Weapon attacks.

artifacts.history:
Star Tower contains endless space within. Within were the Forbidden Spaces, which made up less than 1% of the area, endless pillars that reached the sky, ranging from a few light-seconds to over one light-year long, some other weirdly-shaped treasures, and the Sealed Stars.

The pillars have endless, extremely complicated secret patterns and emit a hazy golden light. They are connected to each other and serve as the tower's support. The treasures each had a huge aura and could be considered the tiles and bricks of the tower. The countless Sealed Stars were akin to a bicycle's steel ball bearings, surrounding one area after another, each covered with Original Law engravings.

artifacts.personality:
Thunderstorm Wine is an extremely expensive wine, with one bottle costing 32 Mixed Yuan Units in the Virtual Universe! Even those like King Zhenyan wouldn't drink it casually in the Original Universe. Drinking it felt more wonderful than the evolution of life that occurred when one broke through to Universe Level.

Wu Ka purchased a bottle and shared it with Luo Feng and Rong Jun to celebrate Luo Feng passing the 7th level of the Tong Tian Bridge.

artifacts.title: Tian Liu Fan

artifacts.title: Tianqu Stone Essence

These complete pieces are refined from countless extremely tiny particles that even True Gods have to examine carefully to discover.

The Emperor Chu Family is willing to pay 10,000 Merits for each fruit obtained from the Thunder Ancient Kingdom, who has arranged a powerful formation and a Transcendent Chaos Realm to defend them.

artifacts.title: Time Palace
artifacts.introText: Time Palaces are special Heavy Treasures that provide a place for cultivation with an accelerated time velocity. They can be created by anyone who has completed comprehension of both Law of Space  and Law of Time  (so Universe Masters and above).
artifacts.appearance:
Time Palaces are special Heavy Treasures that provide a place for cultivation with an accelerated time velocity. They can be created by anyone who has completed comprehension of both Law of Space  and Law of Time  (so Universe Masters and above).

Ordinary Time Palaces accelerate time velocity by 10 to 100 times, while those with 1,000 times acceleration are considered remarkable and incredibly expensive. The Human Race did not possess a Time Palace capable of 10,000 times acceleration.

While incredibly useful to those races lacking a True God, the Pinnacle Races have locations within their True God's Miniature Universe capable of 10,081 times acceleration, limiting their value for those talents highly valued by their race.

artifacts.title: Time-Space Teleportation Talisman

artifacts.title: Top Arcana
artifacts.introText: Top Arcana (顶级至宝(Dǐngjí zhìbǎo), lit. Top/First-Class Most Valuable/Precious Treasure/Asset, called Top-Tier or Top True Treasure in the fan translation) are normally wielded by Universe Masters, and are sometimes owned by Top Universe Overlords. They may also be provided to lower-realm geniuses valued by their clans, organizations, etc. Those of higher value, such as Palace-type, Domain-type, or Soul-type, are comparable in value to Pinnacle Arcana and may be used by Tier 4 or 5 Universe Masters, but most Universe Masters cannot obtain them. Those higher value Top Arcana drive Universe Masters mad, resulting in massive battles in places like the Original Stars and Universe Ocean.
artifacts.appearance:
Top Arcana (顶级至宝(Dǐngjí zhìbǎo), lit. Top/First-Class Most Valuable/Precious Treasure/Asset, called Top-Tier or Top True Treasure in the fan translation) are normally wielded by Universe Masters, and are sometimes owned by Top Universe Overlords. They may also be provided to lower-realm geniuses valued by their clans, organizations, etc. Those of higher value, such as Palace-type, Domain-type, or Soul-type, are comparable in value to Pinnacle Arcana and may be used by Tier 4 or 5 Universe Masters, but most Universe Masters cannot obtain them. Those higher value Top Arcana drive Universe Masters mad, resulting in massive battles in places like the Original Stars and Universe Ocean.

As Arcana, they have 3 levels or forms that are activated through Original Law comprehension or Divine Power. Top Universe Overlords capable of using Top Arcana weapons are easily able to easily defeat Universe Overlords who only have High Arcana armor. Universe Masters who acquire Top Arcana are able to execute their Universe Master Strongest Techniques through them, making even ordinary Top Arcana desirable to Universe Masters capable of traversing Universe Ocean.

Depending on the type, Top Arcana are worth between at least around 80 Arcana Points in the Human Race exchange (with Domain treasures costing at least 2,000), and are generally 10 times more expensive than High Arcana of the same type. The Human Race also grants a valuable as precious as a Top Arcana to new Universe Masters of the race.

artifacts.title: Top Heavy Treasure
artifacts.introText: Top Heavy Treasures (顶级重宝(Dǐngjí zhòngbǎo), lit. Top-Tier/Top Heavy/Important Treasure) are normally wielded by Intermediate or Advanced Universe Venerables, but powerful Immortal Kings and lower-realm geniuses valued by their clans, organizations, etc. may also have them. Typically, Top Heavy Treasures are either Heavy Treasure sets (multiple Heavy Treasures) or palace-type, soul-type, or domain-type Heavy Treasures.
artifacts.appearance:
Top Heavy Treasures (顶级重宝(Dǐngjí zhòngbǎo), lit. Top-Tier/Top Heavy/Important Treasure) are normally wielded by Intermediate or Advanced Universe Venerables, but powerful Immortal Kings and lower-realm geniuses valued by their clans, organizations, etc. may also have them. Typically, Top Heavy Treasures are either Heavy Treasure sets (multiple Heavy Treasures) or palace-type, soul-type, or domain-type Heavy Treasures.

Top Heavy Treasures differ from Heavy Treasures in that they have a second form that can be activated with sufficient Original Law comprehension or Divine Power, depending on the item. Depending on the type of Top Heavy Treasure, even Universe Venerables will fight to the death over one.

In the Human Race exchange, Top Heavy Treasures are generally worth thousands of Heavy Treasure Points, and the most valuable among them can rival ordinary Common Arcana in cost.

artifacts.title: Tower Pearl
artifacts.introText: Appearing to be a normal crystal without any special energy or pressure, the Tower Pearl is a special Arcana that serves as the control center for Star Tower. As it is the core of Star Tower, no one knew about it other than Pu Ti and Sitting Mountain Guest. The user must fuse their soul with the Tower Pearl, a process that took Luo Feng 6,092 years to accomplish, to became the owner of Star Tower.
artifacts.appearance:
Appearing to be a normal crystal without any special energy or pressure, the Tower Pearl is a special Arcana that serves as the control center for Star Tower. As it is the core of Star Tower, no one knew about it other than Pu Ti and Sitting Mountain Guest. The user must fuse their soul with the Tower Pearl, a process that took Luo Feng 6,092 years to accomplish, to became the owner of Star Tower.

The Tower Pearl controls the forbidden spaces within the tower and can be used to defend the user's soul. In terms of defense, it matches up with a soul-type Common Arcana, but due to its connection to Star Tower, even soul-type Xeon Arcana couldn't break it. Unlike most Arcana, once it recognizes its owner, it cannot be lent to another; if someone else tried to merge with it to control Star Tower, Tower Pearl would kill that individual.

When Luo Feng began to be attacked by Universe Masters, he returned Tower Pearl to Star Tower and used Star Tower itself to defend his soul.

artifacts.title: Universe Crystal
artifacts.introText: Luo Feng picked up a handful of sand, the sand grains were a dark blue color, at first glance it looked black! Every grain was very heavy, it’s density was definitely at least a hundred times that of Earth’s iron, the grains even had a faint sense of magnetism, causing them to all stick together. When they fell earlier, all they left were little dents in the sand. - I Eat Tomatoes
artifacts.appearance:
the Universe Crystals are crystals, generated by the World Masters, which are able to generate energy fields so powerful that the energy masses are solidified, turning into crystals, crystals that are used as currency throughout the universe and as money in major civilizations and space empires,

these crystals come from planets created directly by the World Masters, through the manipulation of universal energy, the Crystals are created by solidified universal energy, the energy of the universe, which being used by the World Masters, to create entire planets, spread in the ground, solidifying in the sand and rocks of a planet ...

This isn’t like the Silverblue dollars, the Black Dragon dollars or the Ganwu Dollars and even the currencies from other empires, but the universe energies solidifying to form!

Hence, it was usable in any universe country, between any race!

artifacts.title: Universe Pathway
artifacts.introText: Universe Pathways are manually constructed pathways between the Original Universe and a Miniature Universe. Unlike God Country Transmission or Space Transmission, Universe Pathways are not instantaneous; they are transmission channels! Their cost is quite substantial since they're linking one universe to another, but True Gods can easily pay the cost. The flow of time within a Universe Pathway is different than in the Original Universe, causing discomfort to weak individuals who travel through them.
artifacts.appearance:
Universe Pathways are manually constructed pathways between the Original Universe and a Miniature Universe. Unlike God Country Transmission or Space Transmission, Universe Pathways are not instantaneous; they are transmission channels! Their cost is quite substantial since they're linking one universe to another, but True Gods can easily pay the cost. The flow of time within a Universe Pathway is different than in the Original Universe, causing discomfort to weak individuals who travel through them.

Initially, True Gods would only connect their Miniature Universe to key locations for their race or organization, but during the Sector Beast War, many non-human True Gods created pathways to Milky Way Holy Land to facilitate their defense. The presence of Universe Pathways also made it much easier for those of the Third Reincarnation Era to defend their Miniature Universes from the Sector Beasts than it was for those of the First or Second Reincarnation Era.

artifacts.title: World Ring
artifacts.introText: A World Ring is a storage accessory that houses a world created by a World Master. They are the most expensive of the world-type storage devices due to materials necessary to compress a world into an object the size of a ring. Since the worlds within these rings are not restricted by the creator's main core, they could be much larger than ordinary World Master Worlds. World Rings are much more expensive than Space Rings, which many Universe Levels and even Stellar Levels may have. The world within a World Ring is like any other world, meaning that it could house living creatures. One must use their personal abilities, whether Spirit Energy, World Energy, Immortal Energy, etc. to scan the contents of a World Ring, and the larger the world, the stronger its gravity, increasing the difficulty of scanning it. A world ring an internal world 100 million kilometers in diameter could only be scanned in its entirety by a Universe Venerable or stronger being!

A World Ring is a storage accessory that houses a world created by a World Master. While World Rings can also be used to house inanimate objects like Arcana, they must be specially forged to hold Xeon Arcana. If a World Ring is sufficiently damaged, its internal world will collapse.

clans.title: 5 Leviathans of Humanity
clans.introText: These are the organizations that control and lead the entire Human Race.
clans.appearance: These are the organizations that control and lead the entire Human Race.

clans.title: Alliance
clans.introText: In the Original Universe, an Alliance is an organization formed by members with a shared interest. The strongest alliances in the Original Universe are led by True Gods; these alliances form the Nine Superpowers and have incredible power and influence. The six Pinnacle Races also have incredibly large areas of territory, within which they live and cultivate future members. While the six Pinnacle Races each have their own alliance, these alliances also contain members of other subsidiary races.
clans.appearance:
In the Original Universe, an Alliance is an organization formed by members with a shared interest. The strongest alliances in the Original Universe are led by True Gods; these alliances form the Nine Superpowers and have incredible power and influence. The six Pinnacle Races also have incredibly large areas of territory, within which they live and cultivate future members. While the six Pinnacle Races each have their own alliance, these alliances also contain members of other subsidiary races.

The second-tier of alliances are led by Universe Masters and are able to maintain power and influence second only to the Nine Superpowers through their sheer number of Universe Venerables and Universe Masters. During the Human Race Survival War, the Freedom Alliance, led by Shi Hua Island Leader, was formed, comprising many smaller races and becoming the largest alliance by number of Universe Masters.

clans.title: Allied Armies Military Faction
clans.introText: The Allied Armies Military Faction was an alliance of seven of the Nine Superpowers to fight against the Human Race in the Human Race Survival War. It comprised the Demon Race, Automaton Race, and Zerg Race (from the Three-Race Coalition Army), as well as the Prison Race, Crystal Race, Northern Territory Alliance, and the Space Beast Alliance.
clans.appearance:
The Allied Armies Military Faction was an alliance of seven of the Nine Superpowers to fight against the Human Race in the Human Race Survival War. It comprised the Demon Race, Automaton Race, and Zerg Race (from the Three-Race Coalition Army), as well as the Prison Race, Crystal Race, Northern Territory Alliance, and the Space Beast Alliance.

After the Human Race defeated the Three-Race Coalition Army, the three races realized how threatening the humans were. They then contacted the other superpowers in hopes of gathering enough power to defeat the humans. Initially, the 5 remaining Pinnacle Races agreed to fight together, then met with the Northern Territory Alliance Universe Master leaders, since each of these superpowers occupied large, important territories.

clans.title: Ancestral God Sect
clans.introText: The Ancestral God Sect was considered the strongest of the Nine Superpowers of the Original Universe. Created at the beginning of each Reincarnation Era by the Origin Will of the Original Universe, the Ancestral God Sect represents the Origin Will. It is responsible for maintaining the operation of the Universe Operation Rules, and is protected by the laws. Their existence is a top secret in the universe, only those directly related or the very strongest beings in the universe are aware of its existence.
clans.appearance:
The Ancestral God Sect was considered the strongest of the Nine Superpowers of the Original Universe. Created at the beginning of each Reincarnation Era by the Origin Will of the Original Universe, the Ancestral God Sect represents the Origin Will. It is responsible for maintaining the operation of the Universe Operation Rules, and is protected by the laws. Their existence is a top secret in the universe, only those directly related or the very strongest beings in the universe are aware of its existence.

Its strongest members are typically Special Lifeforms, and through the strategy of openness to all creatures in the Original Universe combined with selecting only the most elite to join it, it gained the reputation of the strongest power in the Original Universe. In its role of representing the Origin Will, it passes important messages to both residents of the Original Universe and those of Universe Ocean if necessary.

As it has a small number of official members, it does not require large territory, meaning it can remain neutral in the vast majority of conflicts in the Original Universe between the other superpowers, most of which seek territory. With this neutrality, it is arguably the freest power in the Original Universe, to the point that their members can also be members of other superpowers! Additionally, because they did not compete with the other superpowers for territory or influence, those superpowers had no problem sending their talented members to the Ancestral God Sect for training, further strengthening it.

Since their strength and privileges are tied to the Origin Will of the Original Universe, they are very powerful and united until the end of their Reincarnation Era. However, once their Reincarnation Era ends, they had to either move to someone else's Miniature Universe or live in their own, which meant they no longer had the protection of the Original Universe Origin. They lose all of their privileges (which are granted to the Ancestral God Sect of the newly created Reincarnation Era), and thus also lose their unity. As a result, within Universe Ocean they are typically not the most powerful force of their Reincarnation Era.

During the Human Race Survival War, the Allied Armies Military Faction, Human Race Alliance, and Freedom Alliance each surpassed the Ancestral God Sect in power. The Ancestral God Sect eventually allied with the Human Race in exchange for information on how to become True Gods, and their Xeon Arcana Five-Color Aurora Lake was of great use in the war. After the arrival of the body of Jin God King and the exploration of the World of Jin, many Universe Masters and True Gods emerged, and the Ancestral God Sect, as a superpower that allied with the Human Race, benefited greatly, becoming the second-strongest power in the Original Universe.
clans.trivia:
The Guardian God Masters (护教神主, Hù jiào shénzhǔ, lit. [To] Protect Teach God Master, also referred to as Guarding Godly Master) are leaders of the sub-organizations of the Ancestral God Sect. They are exceptional Universe Masters, Universe Master Level 5, and handle issues that the Ancestral Gods and Eight Beast Gods cannot handle due to their restrictions. Only Universe Masters comparable to Primal Chaos City Leader are eligible to be bestowed the title of Guardian God Master. They are considered the peers of the Eight Beast Gods, and have a few Universe Masters under their command.

The Guardian Honorable Masters (护教尊主, Hù jiàozūn zhǔ, lit. [To] Protect Teach Honored Master) are the Universe Masters who serve under the Guardian God Masters. It is implied that they are average Universe Masters, between Universe Master Level 2 and Universe Master Level 4. They assist the Guardian God Masters with their duties, and are allowed to be members of other organizations, including other superpowers!

The Guardian Venerables (护教尊者, Hù jiàozūn zhě, lit. [To] Protect Teach Honored One) are implied to be the God General Candidates and those Beast God heirs who have completed at least the 5th level of the Beast God Inheritance. They are all very strong, and many of them are Universe Overlords! They perform lower-level duties for the Ancestral God Sect, and are allowed to be members of other organizations, including superpowers.

The Guardian Envoys (护教使者, Hù jiào shǐzhě, lit. [To] Protect Teach Envoy/Herald/Messenger) are implied to be the God Envoy candidates, and are thus very powerful Immortal Kings. Special Immortal King talents who are not pursuing God Envoy Inheritances, such as King Zhu Chong, can also be Guardian Envoys. The Guardian God Masters compete with each other for these special talents.

clans.title: Apeman Race Holy Temple
clans.introText: The Apeman Race Holy Temple is an organization that manages the affairs of the Apeman species of the Human Race. Its leader is the Apeman Holy Master, but since the Holy Master no longer meddles in the affairs of the temple, everything is decided by the 18 Temple Masters.
clans.appearance:
The Apeman Race Holy Temple is an organization that manages the affairs of the Apeman species of the Human Race. Its leader is the Apeman Holy Master, but since the Holy Master no longer meddles in the affairs of the temple, everything is decided by the 18 Temple Masters.

The organization has a majestic shrine in the Virtual Universe, with many Apeman guards and at least 18 thrones, 1 for each of the Temple Masters.

The Temple Masters are the 18 leaders of the Apeman Race Holy Temple. It is implied that there is one leader for each of the major clans of the Apeman race. Given that there are tens of thousands of clans of the Apeman race, those who could be part of the holy temple are considered the upper echelon of these clans.

clans.appearance:
Black Dragon Mountain is one of the two God Countries of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire (the other being Holy Sea of Frost). These are the most powerful Organizations under the empire.

Black Dragon Mountain is the God Country created by Black Dragon Immortal when he broke through to Immortal. As such, it could be considered the true power of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire, and sent close to 1,000 Stellar Level youths to compete in the Ganwu Universe Country selection portion of the Pinnacle Genius Battle.

The God Country contains a star that Black Dragon Immortal brought from the external world using his power, as well as an enormous black mountain range that exceeded 100,000 kilometers, floating above an ocean. There are luxurious palaces for the high-ranking World Masters who dwell within.

clans.title: Black Fire Sect
clans.introText: The Black Fire Sect is a powerful resistance organization that opposes the Thunder Ancient Kingdom. It is led by Black Fire Devil Master, who gathered a large number of God Kings who had grudges against the Thunder Ancient Kingdom. While it is weaker than Life Mother River in terms of power and influence, it is still difficult to deal with, since its leader can bring out Earth God King as a reinforcement when necessary! One reason the organization has survived is Black Fire Devil Master's ability to befriend many God Kings, even those from the Thunder Ancient Kingdom.

clans.title: Blade River Sect
clans.introText: Blade River Sect is a sect and a Second-Class God-Kingdom compromising of 155 Chaos States, created to cultivate practitioners in Luo Feng's territory, in anticipation of when he acquires his own First-Class God-Kingdom. After being enlightened by Ancestor Yuan, Luo Feng provided the name and gave the order to establish the sect. Ancestor Yuan is responsible for the sect's rules, recruitment of disciples, and other aspects, since, as the founder of the Virtual Universe Company and creator of the Virtual Universe, he has an extremely thorough understanding of the world's operation and plenty of experience in this path. Yuan also expects the strongest of the Human Race to join the sect after reaching the Continent of Origin.

Luo Feng wrote up 15 inheritances to further attract talent, with 6 for the Great Dao of the Life Origin, 6 for the Great Dao of the Destruction Origin, and 3 without complete references in the Supreme Operation Laws.

After breaking through to Primal Chaos Sovereign, one becomes an elder in this sect.

Since Luo Feng killed the three founding God Kings of the Food Kingdom, the Blade River Sect commands 155 Chaos States, 135 from the Food Kingdom and the 20 Chaos States Luo Feng was granted earlier. Additionally, Liu Yu God King was accepted as a guest official.

clans.title: Blazing Fire Sect
clans.introText: The Blazing Fire Sect is a powerful and mysterious organization operating under the banner of the Life Mother River. The sect specializes in the cultivation and selection of elite individuals, particularly Eternal True Gods, with a rigorous and competitive recruitment process. Historically, the Blazing Fire Sect has maintained a presence within various territories to scout for new talent, including the twenty Chaos States under the command of Luo City Lord. It is known for its strict selection criteria, where only a small percentage of invited candidates are accepted. The sect provides its members with a legacy and opportunities for advancement, fostering a competitive environment among the various forces under the Life Mother River. However, in a significant and unexpected turn of events, the Blazing Fire Sect received a direct order from the highest leadership of the Life Mother River to completely withdraw from the twenty Chaos States. This decision, made without any room for objection, was a direct consequence of a confrontation with the formidable Luo City Lord, whose power and influence were deemed insurmountable. The sudden departure left hundreds of aspiring Eternal True Gods, who had traveled great distances to attend the selection, without a path to join the sect.

clans.introText: The Blood Ocher Army is one of the Special Legions of the East Army in the World of Jin. As a Special Legion, it is likely extremely selective, as less than 1% of the Jin Military joins a Special Legion. It was established by a Void True God and its current commander would be a powerful Void True God, possibly its founder.

clans.title: Blood Python Guild
clans.introText: The Blood Python Guild is one of the 19 Dark Forces that run Hu Yang City. Led by Mu Yang, its territory is coveted by many forces, and they have battled the Five Major Families multiple times. In these battles, Mu Yang emerged victorious, killing several other Eternal True Gods. The location of its headquarters is far from comparable to the Chaos Zone A region of the city, but the headquarters itself is very large, with a length and with of 1 billion kilometers.
clans.appearance:
The Blood Python Guild is one of the 19 Dark Forces that run Hu Yang City. Led by Mu Yang, its territory is coveted by many forces, and they have battled the Five Major Families multiple times. In these battles, Mu Yang emerged victorious, killing several other Eternal True Gods. The location of its headquarters is far from comparable to the Chaos Zone A region of the city, but the headquarters itself is very large, with a length and with of 1 billion kilometers.

The true background of Mu Yang appears to be related to the Food Kingdom, and the strength of the Blood Python Guild is derived from his incredible strength. The two Vice Presidents are nowhere near his strength, and he alone holds true power within the organization.

Unfortunately for the Blood Python Guild, one of their Vice Presidents, Lai Mo, ran afoul of Luo Feng. As a Dark Force, the guild is known for committing crimes and bullying those weaker than it, making them an ideal target for Luo Feng's attempts to earn more Universe Sand and battle stronger cultivators. Luo Feng eventually killed Lai Mo and Mu Yang, and forced Mu Lin to abandon Hu Yang City, essentially collapsing the guild. Only 10-20% of the members (still millions of members, albeit weaker ones) survived the battle, which also destroyed their headquarters.

clans.title: Chun Yu Family
clans.introText: The Chun Yu Family was the number 1 business family in Swallow Mound City. While on the surface, it was led by Chun Yu Chong, the actual leader of the family was Chun Yu Tao, a Domain Level 6 warrior who was the strongest person in Swallow Mound City. Their roots within the city were far deeper than the Rock Wind Family's.
clans.appearance:

While on the surface, it was led by Chun Yu Chong, the actual leader of the family was Chun Yu Tao, a Domain Level 6 warrior who was the strongest person in Swallow Mound City. Their roots within the city were far deeper than the Rock Wind Family's.

The family collapsed after Luo Feng killed both Chun Yu Chong and Chun Yu Tao with no justifiable reason.

clans.title: City Lord's Mansion
clans.introText: The City Lord's Mansion is one of the Official Forces of Hu Yang City, and is arguably the most powerful. Their building is the tallest building in the city. All True Gods who live in the city must pay the mansion 1 Chaos Crystal every period. The fees collected by the mansion are used to maintain the operation of the city, including running the ten Hu Yang Legions, the Hu Yang Guard, officials, formations, etc. They also pay Lord Jiu Jiang and the leaders of the Yu Kingdom. The Dark Forces must also pay 50,000 Universe Sands to the mansion every period for the territory they control, or else disband and surrender the territory.
clans.appearance:
The City Lord's Mansion is one of the Official Forces of Hu Yang City, and is arguably the most powerful. Their building is the tallest building in the city. All True Gods who live in the city must pay the mansion 1 Chaos Crystal every period. The fees collected by the mansion are used to maintain the operation of the city, including running the ten Hu Yang Legions, the Hu Yang Guard, officials, formations, etc. They also pay Lord Jiu Jiang and the leaders of the Yu Kingdom. The Dark Forces must also pay 50,000 Universe Sands to the mansion every period for the territory they control, or else disband and surrender the territory.

The City Lord's Mansion receives reports for every new Eternal True God who purchases a residence in the city, and assigns them a rating from D (the weakest level) to A (those that even a Hu Yang Legion would be unable to deal with). When they receive new information, they will change those ratings. While powerful, the mansion avoids interfering with the strongest Eternal True Gods in the city, including the leaders of the Dark Forces.

Even though the City Lord's Mansion has suffered losses at the hands of powerful Eternal True Gods like Mu Yang, if they are truly challenged, they are able to get assistance from Lord Jiu Jiang, so those without extremely strong backings know to be careful. They have about 100 Eternal True Gods at their disposal, when counting the members of the Five Major Families and their vassals. The City Lord's Mansion has established rules for the other powers of the city, including a limit to how many they can kill each period.

clans.title: Cloud Treasure Tower
clans.introText: Cloud Treasure Tower is a large commercial power based in the Yu Kingdom. They have branches in many Large Cities of the kingdom, and mainly sell mid-to-low-end secret treasure weapons. Since they mainly sell to True Gods and Void True Gods, they have accumulated terrifying levels of wealth and since they are backed by Lord Sky Treasure, a Primal Chaos Sovereign, even the major forces of a Large City will give them face and avoid provoking them.

clans.title: Cultivator Camp
clans.introText:
Cultivator Camp is one of major faction in the entire Infinite Hunyuan Space, currently led by 9 Overlords. These Overlords have mastered the Hunyuan Daos and comprehended the true essence of force within the Infinite Hunyuan Space. Each Overlord controls a vast territory and prevents Chaotic Origin Lifeforms from devouring Source Worlds.
The territories they control are divided into World Groups, containing many Source Worlds and training grounds for cultivators who have reached God Emperor. Each Overlord has billions of clones across their territories, serving as the guardian of the Source Worlds within it until a new Overlord arises from that territory.

Each Overlord has billions of clones across their territories, serving as the guardian of the Source Worlds within it until a new Overlord arises from that territory.
clans.history: The Cultivator Alliance (修行者阵营) or "Cultivator Camp" represents the unified front of all cultivators within the vast Infinite Chaos Space, established to resist the existential threat posed by the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Its history began in a dark era where source worlds were mere sustenance for the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, until the emergence of the first Overlord, 'Yuan,' who mastered the highest levels of power, providing the initial shield for cultivators. Over countless ages, more Overlords arose, expanding their territory and leading to escalating conflicts and multiple wars against the Innate-Chaotic Lifeforms, including engagements where they even managed to slay several Chaotic Origin Lifeform Ancestors. Currently, the Cultivator Camp is embroiled in the largest and most desperate war in its history, facing overwhelming numerical superiority from the Innate-Chaotic Lifeforms. Its primary purpose is the survival and defense of its members, territories, and countless sentient beings from eradication, with its efforts now focused on maintaining resistance and consolidating its most powerful members within the hidden sanctuary of the "Origin Land," which serves as their final bastion and hope for future resurgence.

clans.title: Dan Building
clans.introText: The Dan Building (丹楼), also known as the Pill Tower, is one of the top-tier alchemy factions in Yulan City, specializing in the refinement and distribution of powerful cultivation pills and elixirs. The faction is renowned for its high-quality products and advanced alchemical techniques, making it a key player in the city's pharmaceutical industry.
clans.appearance:
The Dan Building (丹楼), also known as the Pill Tower, is one of the top-tier alchemy factions in Yulan City, specializing in the refinement and distribution of powerful cultivation pills and elixirs. The faction is renowned for its high-quality products and advanced alchemical techniques, making it a key player in the city's pharmaceutical industry.

Dan Building holds great influence within the Nine Rivers Holy World, though it frequently faces pressure from its primary rival, the Insect Nest, a faction known for more sinister and unconventional alchemy practices. Despite the competitive landscape, Dan Building has maintained its status through both political alliances and formidable members.

Its current leader is God Emperor Chang Qing, one of the founding elders of the city and a veteran alchemist. After the recruitment of Luo Feng—Dan Building’s strength and influence significantly increased. Luo Feng now serves as the **Deputy Tower Master**, bringing with him trusted allies such as Emperor Qing, Emperor Ming and Emperor Fu.

The faction headquarters is a towering structure filled with training chambers, alchemy labs, and defensive formations, enabling it to fend off threats and function as a major strategic stronghold.

clans.title: Destruction Legion
clans.introText: The Destruction Legion is a powerful organization from the Heavenly Wood Kingdom, created by Heavenly Wood Sector Beast King. Its God King-level combat forces comprise 6 Honorable Masters, 18 Generals, and 36 Commanders. The weakest Commander within the legion can be regarded as a Limit First Level God King, while each Honorable Master is comparable to Gui Xu Emperor or Wu Xin God King.

clans.title: Diao Rong Family

clans.title: East Army
clans.introText: The East Army is one of the 4 armies of the Jin Military. Its general is Xue Yong, an Eternal True God. Since a quarter of the tribesmen and strange beasts in the World of Jin join the East Army, there are warriors joining every day, forming long lines of prospective members. When Luo Feng and Bei Feng reached the camp, there were 800,000 waiting in line, so it took about half a month just to get to the initial screening process.
clans.appearance:
The East Army is one of the 4 armies of the Jin Military. Its general is Xue Yong, an Eternal True God. Since a quarter of the tribesmen and strange beasts in the World of Jin join the East Army, there are warriors joining every day, forming long lines of prospective members. When Luo Feng and Bei Feng reached the camp, there were 800,000 waiting in line, so it took about half a month just to get to the initial screening process.

As befitting of the World of Jin, the screening process is incredibly dangerous; generally speaking, about 2/3 of applicants die in the screening process! Life within the East Army is even more dangerous than the screening process; Bei Yan noted that from his batch of 800, only 21 returned alive, and only 3 of them (including himself) became True Gods!

The East Army has many Special Legions, including the Python River Army, Sleeping Dragon Army, and the Swan Queen Army. It has extensive resources with which it can provide the Special Legions, incredible amounts of territory, and truly powerful Mechanical Treasures to use in battles outside of the World of Jin, like Jin Luo Sky and Land.

More great beings from Universe Ocean joined the East Army than any of the other armies of the World of Jin, so when Luo Feng ordered the 4 generals to kill the Universe Masters who had joined the Allied Forces Military Camp or were from the Purple Moon Holy Land Universe, 201 were in the East Army.

clans.title: Eight Great Overlords of Universe Ocean
clans.introText: The Eight Great Overlords of Universe Ocean were the eight strongest cultivators in Universe Ocean during the Third Reincarnation Era. To combat the Sector Beasts, everyone in Universe Ocean knew that True Gods were necessary, and outside of Luo Feng, the Eight Great Overlords had the strongest True Gods.
clans.appearance:
The Eight Great Overlords of Universe Ocean were the eight strongest cultivators in Universe Ocean during the Third Reincarnation Era. To combat the Sector Beasts, everyone in Universe Ocean knew that True Gods were necessary, and outside of Luo Feng, the Eight Great Overlords had the strongest True Gods.

Luo Feng, as the strongest being in Universe Ocean, led this team, which worked to defend the Miniature Universes of the First Reincarnation Era and Second Reincarnation Era, as well as attempted to stop Morosa, the first Sector Beast to leave the Land of Darkness. Even races with as much enmity as the Divine Eye Race and the Skeleton Race set aside their differences to work together against this threat.

As the Sector Beast War worsened, this organization was impacted by defections. Nine-Headed Devil Master first swore loyalty to the Sector Beasts, then was captured by Luo Feng. When the Sector Beasts attacked the Miniature Universes of the first two reincarnation eras en masse, Skeleton Master swore loyalty to the Sector Beasts to save those who lived in his Miniature Universe, then Divine Eye True Master, unaware that the Sector Beasts had Skeleton Master as their newest slave, attempted to defect, but was killed.

clans.title: Emperor Chu Family
clans.introText: The Emperor Chu Family is one of the thirteen branches of the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom Imperial Family, and is led by Emperor Chu. As such, it is one of the families qualified to seize the throne of the ancient kingdom. Di Chu Yu is an Eternal True God of this family, and was temporarily stationed in Hu Yang City.
clans.appearance:

The Primal Chaos Sovereigns of this lineage technically include the imperial family members, Emperor Chu's direct disciples, the Guest Officials, and free members. There are two Transcendent Chaos Realms in the entire lineage. The important members of the lineage reside in Chu Capital City, while those who are considered wastes live in other Miniature Universes.

The family has around 100 members who have reached the level of Infinite Divine Body. There are 3 God Kings in this branch, and due to their status, they do not deal with trivial matters. Instead, many of those matters are handled by the First-Class Lords, of which there are 7, including Di Chu Yu. There are 29 Lords in total in the Emperor Chu lineage.

clans.title: Extreme Martial Club
clans.introText: The Extreme Martial Club, also known as the Limit Dojo, is the most prominent martial arts institution in Jiangnan City. It was founded by Hong, the strongest man in the world and the top martial expert in the nation of Hanxia (China). This dojo holds the highest rank among all martial clubs in Jiangnan City.
clans.appearance:
The Extreme Martial Club, also known as the Limit Dojo, is the most prominent martial arts institution in Jiangnan City. It was founded by Hong, the strongest man in the world and the top martial expert in the nation of Hanxia (China). This dojo holds the highest rank among all martial clubs in Jiangnan City.

The majority of martial fighters, soldiers, and warriors in Jiangnan City are trained at the Extreme Martial Club. Luo Feng, a prominent figure, became a member of this prestigious institution.

The House of Extremes, where the club's martial fighters reside, also becomes one of Luo Feng's homes.

The Extreme Martial Club has its own marketplace, known as the Extreme Mall, where warriors can buy or sell weapons, clothing, supplies, and techniques.

Over time, the Extreme Martial Club has grown into a wealthy and powerful martial organization, maintaining a constant rivalry with other martial organizations in Jiangnan City.

Initially, the club had five Inspectors, but with Luo Feng’s arrival, the number increased to six.

Within the dojo, the facilities are divided into three levels: one for beginner members, one for intermediate members, and one for elite members. The elite member building's first and second floors house large teaching halls, capable of accommodating several thousand people at a time. The dojo has approximately 30,000 to 40,000 members.

Membership in the dojo is open only to individuals aged 16 and above. After reaching the age of 30, members are no longer permitted to return to the dojo, as it is believed they would be consuming valuable teaching resources.
clans.personality:
The three royal guards below him are all existences surpassing the wargod level. And each of the royal guards, under Hong's teachings, have extraordinary strength.

Inspector (巡察使(xúnchá shǐ), lit. Inspector) is the next level of authority below the founder. This position is second only to the founder Hong in the Extreme Martial Club. Only those who are stronger than God of War can get this position. There are five inspectors now who are in charge of the round table meeting, the highest standard meeting of the Extreme Martial Club.

Zhu Xi (donghua only)

Liu He (novel only)

2 more unnamed Inspectors (Donghua only)

Examiner (监察使(jiānchá shǐ), lit. Supervisor/Monitor) is the next level of authority below Inspectors. Examiners are able to fire Chiefs directly, and can work with the organization to fire a Chairman. They take direct orders from the highest level of the organization; one Investigator did not have the right to fire an Examiner, they would have to go through a round table conference to do so.

Luo Feng (former Examiner of Jiangnan City, promoted to Inspector)

Examiner Liu (former Examiner of Jiangnan City, novel only)

Bao Zheng (former Examiner of Jiangnan City, novel only)

At least 3 other examiners (novel only)

The number of examiners in the Dojo of Limits of each headquarter city can be counted on one hand! Usually, one must receive the title of "Advanced Wargod" and be quite famous to have the right to become an examiner.

Chairman (会长(huì zhǎng), lit. Chairman or Chairperson) is the position with the highest authority in the Extreme Martial Club HQ of a city. The Chairman and the 3 Chiefs manage the HQ. Chairmen have enough authority that even an Examiner cannot fire them without consulting with the organization.

Zhou Zhengyong (Chairman of Jiangnan Main City Branch Headquarters)

To become a chairman, beginner wargod and intermediate wargod would be enough. The minimum requirement is 'beginner wargod'.

Chief Instructor (主管(zhǔguǎn), lit. Chief) is one of the highest positions within the Extreme Martial Club HQ of a city, second to the Chairman. As a result, each Chief holds a lot of power. However, they can be directly fired by an Examiner, so they try their best to not get on the bad side of their Examiner.

Zhuge Tao (Jiangnan main city branch headquarters chief instructor)

Yu Sen (Jiangnan main city branch headquarters chief instructor, novel only)

Wang Ke Fan (Jiangnan main city branch headquarters chief instructor, novel only)

To become a chief instructor, the minimum requirement is 'advanced warlord'

Wu Tong (Yang Zhou sub-city branch Head instructor)

Jiang Nian (Yang Zhou sub-city, Zhi-An District branch instructor)

Only 7 executives are mentioned in the novel in detail.

It represents the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom and was established by powerful forces within the ancient kingdom. clans.title: Four Commanders of God King Valley
clans.introText: The Four Commanders of God King Valley are four sealed beings (three Void True Gods and one Eternal True God), tasked with overseeing the selections of Wu Qi Tower and find someone who could reach the ninth floor of Wu Qi Tower. They have followed this order for countless Reincarnation Eras, finally succeeding when Luo Feng passed the sealed task and reached the ninth floor. The group's leader is Burly Commander, the sole Eternal True God, and the three Void True Gods are Black Mist Commander, Silver-Armored Woman Commander, and Strange Beast Commander.
clans.appearance:
The Four Commanders of God King Valley are four sealed beings (three Void True Gods and one Eternal True God), tasked with overseeing the selections of Wu Qi Tower and find someone who could reach the ninth floor of Wu Qi Tower. They have followed this order for countless Reincarnation Eras, finally succeeding when Luo Feng passed the sealed task and reached the ninth floor. The group's leader is Burly Commander, the sole Eternal True God, and the three Void True Gods are Black Mist Commander, Silver-Armored Woman Commander, and Strange Beast Commander.

Since they do not have many responsibilities, they usually assign one commander to preside over the general situation of God King Valley and oversee all general matters of the entire God King Realm Continent. When unique circumstances arise, the other three commanders are summoned.

As sealed beings, they are incredibly powerful; even the Void True Gods could easily kill a limit Void True God like Northern True Sea Master. They have all received 6 of the 9 volumes of Divine Eye Secret Technique, and thus have powerful Willpower and the means to use it in an attack.

clans.title: Freedom Alliance
clans.introText: An Alliance formed between the smaller Races and Special Lifeforms in the Original Universe during the Human Race Survival War. It instantly became the Super Alliance because it had more than 400 Universe Masters. Initially, they allied themselves with the Human Race during the War in return they would get some of the teachings in the Duan Dong River Inheritance but after the Purple Moon Ancestor shared the inheritance to transcend Reincarnation Era in the Original Universe they changed their alliance from the Human Race to the United Force Alliance.

clans.title: Gao Wu Family

clans.appearance:
The Gao Wu Family is one of the stronger families in Hu Yang City. Initially led by the Eternal True God Gao Wu Wei, they got an additional Eternal True God when Gao Wu Shui broke through.

Gao Wu Shui instead arrested Gao Wu Wei and the senior members of the family, and the family leader was executed, making Gao Wu Shui the new family leader, as the only Eternal True God of the family.

clans.introText: The Golden Jade Legion is one of the 10 Major Legions that defend Hu Yang City. It has a double configuration, with 2 Eternal True Gods, more than 20,000 Void True Gods, and more than 20 million True Gods, which are divided into two separate groups that alternate shifts.
clans.appearance:
The Golden Jade Legion is one of the 10 Major Legions that defend Hu Yang City. It has a double configuration, with 2 Eternal True Gods, more than 20,000 Void True Gods, and more than 20 million True Gods, which are divided into two separate groups that alternate shifts.

The Golden Jade Legion controls Golden Jade, a Legion-type Mechanical Treasure shaped like a gigantic golden octahedron. This Mechanical Treasure unites the power of the legion soldiers and gives the legion part of the power of a Primal Chaos Sovereign.

clans.introText: Guile Workshop is, along with Insect Nest and Wanying Building, one of the three major looting forces in Yulan City. Led by Master of Guifang, it also has the backing of Palace Master Weiyang, giving it carte blanche to attack weaker cultivators and even end their employment elsewhere.
clans.appearance:
Guile Workshop is, along with Insect Nest and Wanying Building, one of the three major looting forces in Yulan City. Led by Master of Guifang, it also has the backing of Palace Master Weiyang, giving it carte blanche to attack weaker cultivators and even end their employment elsewhere.

Its members are known for their ruthlessness, which they share with their leader, and they do not have a deep friendship. They are the last of the three looting forces to attack Luo Feng, and one of their members, God Emperor Kumo, died at his hands, becoming the first God Emperor that he killed.

clans.title: Heart Shadow Sect
clans.introText: The Heart Shadow Sect was a normal sect founded by Heart Shadow Sect Founder, a God King who comprehended the Great Dao of the Destruction Origin. As such, its God King-level inheritances all contain the Great Dao of Destruction. At its peak it was a major force with countless disciples. Even after the founding God King died, the sect had 3 Primal Chaos Sovereigns. Before its decline, it had over 10,000 Eternal True Gods.
clans.appearance:
The Heart Shadow Sect was a normal sect founded by Heart Shadow Sect Founder, a God King who comprehended the Great Dao of the Destruction Origin. As such, its God King-level inheritances all contain the Great Dao of Destruction. At its peak it was a major force with countless disciples. Even after the founding God King died, the sect had 3 Primal Chaos Sovereigns. Before its decline, it had over 10,000 Eternal True Gods.

The sect offended Great Sage Jiu Yuan, resulting in the death of one Primal Chaos Sovereign and the escape of the other two. After this, they were recruited by Lord Liu Yin, who protected them. The sect was then based in Liu Yin City, a Large City in the Food Kingdom.

After unsuccessfully acquiring a location to station the sect, the sect was ordered by Lord Liu Yin to help him capture Hu Yang City and Xu Yin City. If successful, they would take ownership of Hu Yang City, from which they would take 60% of the earnings each period. With no Primal Chaos Sovereigns or God Kings present, the sect is now led by Feng Yu Qi, a powerful Eternal True God, and 18 other elders, some of whom are stronger than the leader. Since they lack a foundation, they seek a Large City they can take ownership of, with Ruins of Chaos nearby for the Eternal True God disciples to have a chance to breakthrough. As of Luo Feng's arrival on the Continent of Origin, the sect had fewer than 20% of the disciples it had at its peak, but after 5 periods of gathering the scattered disciples, they reached at least 40% of their peak strength.

Even after their decline, they possessed 139 super-large Legion-Type Mechanical Treasures, each controlled by at least 10 Eternal True Gods and over 10,000 Void True Gods. They also have a large number of disciples in thousands of flying boats.

After repelling Lord Liu Yin from Hu Yang City, Luo Feng seized the property of the sect's Eternal True God members, obtaining more than 2.9 billion Universe Sands, along with weapons and treasures worth about 3.7 billion Universe Sands. Additionally, he seized 122 types of Primal Chaos Sovereign-level inheritances and 5 God King-level inheritances, although the God King inheritances only had the part to cultivate to Primal Chaos Sovereign. At Luo Feng's command, the Eternal True Gods of the sect who committed unnecessary slaughter were executed, while those who did not were set free.

More than 80% of the Eternal True Gods of the sect who were released left Hu Yang City, but most of the middle and lower levels of the sect remained, greatly increasing the number of strong people in the city.

clans.title: Hei Ming Legion
clans.introText: The Hei Ming Legion is one of the 10 Major Legions of the Hu Yang Legion that defend Hu Yang City. Its general is Qiu Yi.
clans.appearance:
The Hei Ming Legion is one of the 10 Major Legions of the Hu Yang Legion that defend Hu Yang City. Its general is Qiu Yi.

It has a double configuration, with 2 Eternal True Gods, more than 20,000 Void True Gods, and more than 20 million True Gods, which are divided into two separate groups that alternate shifts.

The Hei Ming Legion controls a Legion-type Mechanical Treasure in the form of a huge spherical fortress. This fortress is like a black hole, absorbing energy and light, and it has terrifying power. This Mechanical Treasure unites the power of the legion soldiers and gives the legion part of the power of a Primal Chaos Sovereign.

As one of the Hu Yang major legions, its most ordinary soldiers are at least True God Level 9, and it has the authority to travel through void space.

clans.title: Hongmeng
clans.introText: Also known as Human Alliance or Hong Alliance is one of the peak alliances in the Original Universe formed by Human Race and their allies, Human Race is the head of the entire alliance. Supreme Council on the other hand only allows Human Race beings. The official members of the Hongmeng are at least Immortal Kings, the humans have close to 100,000 Kings, and with the other races together, the number of Kings exceeds 3 Million. The rarest and most valuable items of Humanity are normally dealt with within the Hong Alliance Auction, These treasures are only circulated among a large number of powerful fighters in this alliance. The smallest amount of deals in Hongmeng starts at 1 Billion Mixed Units.

clans.title: HR Alliance
clans.introText: The HR Alliance is the Alliance of the nine strongest and most powerful super-Clans in the World, the HR Alliance is a global alliance, which includes nine clans.
clans.appearance:
The HR Alliance is the Alliance of the nine strongest and most powerful super-Clans in the World, the HR Alliance is a global alliance, which includes nine clans.

The HR Alliance is supported by a dozen secondary clans scattered and spread in five states of the world.

In the nation of Huaxia, there are a total of 12 clans and among the clans of Huaxia, there is the Xu Family etc.

The HR Alliance is the largest and most important organization in the world, the richest organization in the world, the HR Alliance controls the majority of the Warriors of the world that originate or belong to the HR Alliance, whose families are made up of high-level Warriors.

The HR Alliance, also known as "The Underground Alliance", is in control of vast and immense wealth, the members of the HR Alliance are both rich and powerful families, as well as important billionaires, alone the HR Alliance has an economy larger than a whole country government, the HR Alliance has established itself as a real world power, controlling a large economy and gaining weight and influence within the major world governments, playing an important role in the formation of the Warriors and in the war against the mutant Beasts. They control half of the entire world's economy.

The HR Alliance was founded shortly after the end of Great Nirvana, when the majority of the small nations and states of the world were completely wiped out by the mutant beasts, only the larger nations managed to survive.

Post-Nirvana states have increased the influence of governments in society.

It was then that the oldest and the strongest Households around the world, decided to make a common front, creating a united front, for fear of being absorbed or suppressed by nation states or government institutions, this set of clans and families, merged together sharing their wealth and resources and thus, they founded the HR Alliance.

HR Alliance means "Humans Right Alliance".

clans.title: Hu Yang Guard
clans.introText: The Hu Yang Guard is an organization responsible for the general defense of Hu Yang City. It is one of the Official Powers of the city, along with the 10 Major Legions and the City Lord's Mansion. They investigate crimes and maintain order within the city, handling conflicts between Dark Forces and other ordinary issues. The Hu Yang Guard has multiple Eternal True Gods, but are not capable of handling the leaders of the Dark Forces or other extremely powerful Eternal True Gods.
clans.appearance:
The Hu Yang Guard is an organization responsible for the general defense of Hu Yang City. It is one of the Official Powers of the city, along with the 10 Major Legions and the City Lord's Mansion. They investigate crimes and maintain order within the city, handling conflicts between Dark Forces and other ordinary issues. The Hu Yang Guard has multiple Eternal True Gods, but are not capable of handling the leaders of the Dark Forces or other extremely powerful Eternal True Gods.

While significantly weaker than the Major Legions, they are, like the Major Legions, able to travel through the void space, making it extremely difficult for city residents to escape them after committing a crime. The Hu Yang Guard has 10 top commanders, each of whom commands a legion-type Mechanical Treasure operated by 1 Eternal True God and 3,000 Void True Gods.

The 10 top commander positions of the Hu Yang Guard are among the 19 highly desired positions for Eternal True Gods in Hu Yang City, along with 9 of the Major Legion generals.

clans.title: Hu Yang Legion
clans.introText: The Hu Yang Legion is group of legions that defends Hu Yang City. Its supreme commander is Moli Xiao, who also commands one of the 10 Major Legions. It has elite units that control group-type Mechanical Treasures. As one of the official forces of the city, its members are not restricted by the city's formations, and can travel through the void space, allowing them to quickly respond to situations.
clans.appearance: The Hu Yang Legion is group of legions that defends Hu Yang City. Its supreme commander is Moli Xiao, who also commands one of the 10 Major Legions. It has elite units that control group-type Mechanical Treasures. As one of the official forces of the city, its members are not restricted by the city's formations, and can travel through the void space, allowing them to quickly respond to situations.

clans.title: Huge Axe Dojo
clans.introText: One of the five Leviathans of Humanity, it was founded by Huge Axe Creator. It hosts fights among contestants called fighters of the arena, all of the matches hosted by the Dojo are possible life-death battles. After winning ten matches, one would acquire the 'Warrior' title, after winning one hundred matches, one would acquire the title 'Warrior King', and after winning one thousand matches one would acquire the title of 'Huge Axe Warrior'. Huge Axe Dojo and Virtual Universe Company host the Virtual Universe tests.

clans.title: Hundred Tigers Building
clans.introText: Hundred Tigers Building is one of the four large organizations of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire. As one of the four large organizations, it, along with North Dragon City, Three Axe Mountain, and Black Cloud Guild, represents the people of the empire, rather than its government. Its power spreads across many galaxies, and it has a group of World Master fighters, giving it comparable fighting strength to each of the other large organizations, as well as the two sacred lands, Black Dragon Mountain and Ice Sea God Country. Despite being one of the four large organizations, the loss of a Level 3, Level 2, or Level 1 Elite would be painful, and acquiring a Special Elite was extremely rare.
clans.appearance:
Hundred Tigers Building is one of the four large organizations of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire. As one of the four large organizations, it, along with North Dragon City, Three Axe Mountain, and Black Cloud Guild, represents the people of the empire, rather than its government. Its power spreads across many galaxies, and it has a group of World Master fighters, giving it comparable fighting strength to each of the other large organizations, as well as the two sacred lands, Black Dragon Mountain and Ice Sea God Country. Despite being one of the four large organizations, the loss of a Level 3, Level 2, or Level 1 Elite would be painful, and acquiring a Special Elite was extremely rare.

The Hundred Tigers Building headquarters is the Black Tiger Star, essentially a huge planet fortress that used to be a very normal mineral planet. Within their headquarters, a blue robe meant Universe Level or an important member with some status, a white robe meant Domain Master or lesser upper echelon members, and a black robe meant a World Master. While they had produced Immortals in their history, they all moved on to the Ganwu Universe Country or other places suitable for Immortals.

During the Universe Mercenary Alliance trainee exam, they ordered their young elites to send a daily message to their supervisor explaining the events of the day. This also served to confirm they were still alive.

As one of the four large organizations, they had the right to send 200,000 Stellar Level explorers to the World Within a World on Cang Lan Star. One of their members was the first killed by Brolin's bodyguards with their C2 Grade Laser Cannons.

Nuolan Shan is a member, treated as an elite due to his Huge Axe Warrior status, and he arranged for Bai Kaluo to be nurtured as a Special Elite within the organization.

clans.title: Ice Peak Faction
clans.introText: The Ice Peak Faction is a powerful and influential force in the Chaotic Origin Dimension and it's as powerful as Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction. It is led by the Ice Peak Ancestor, a nearly indestructible being who commands terrifying ice powers. The faction is mostly formed by Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform that survive by devouring the origin energy of Source Worlds. It includes over a dozen Eternal-level existences some extremely strong and others notorious for causing trouble, like the Three Emperors of Wind, Thunder, and Sea. Though the Ice Peak Faction once had friendly ties with the Cultivator Camp, its loose internal structure allows its members to act independently. Among its strongest members is Sha Zhou, a solitary and mysterious woman, known for being one of the two strongest lifeform in all the Chaotic Origin Dimension. She joined the faction due to her deep bond with the Ice Peak Ancestor, further strengthening their power.

clans.title: Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction
clans.introText: The Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction is the largest and most dominant power within the Chaotic Origin Dimension. This faction is composed entirely of Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, entities that are considered natural enemies of Cultivator Camp and rival for resources by the Ice Peak Faction.
clans.appearance:
The Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction is the largest and most dominant power within the Chaotic Origin Dimension. This faction is composed entirely of Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, entities that are considered natural enemies of Cultivator Camp and rival for resources by the Ice Peak Faction.

The faction mostly consists of weak Hunyuan Ancestors who rely on the devouring of Source Worlds to accelerate the growth of their Life Core and attain greater power. In contrast, cultivators are born and climbing to the top by the nurturing of these very Source Worlds, inherently aligned with their protection. This fundamental opposition of interest places the two factions in direct and irreconcilable conflict known as Cultivator-Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform War.

clans.title: Insect Nest
clans.introText: The Insect Nest is a notorious pharmaceutical faction within Yulan City in the Nine Rivers Holy World. Known for its dark and unorthodox methods, the Insect Nest specializes in creating potions, elixirs, and other alchemical substances by using insects, toxins, and other creatures in their alchemy. These substances are often potent but come at a great moral cost, as their creation involves using bloodthirsty and parasitic creatures, as well as the exploitation of living beings for the production of potions.
clans.appearance:
The Insect Nest is a notorious pharmaceutical faction within Yulan City in the Nine Rivers Holy World. Known for its dark and unorthodox methods, the Insect Nest specializes in creating potions, elixirs, and other alchemical substances by using insects, toxins, and other creatures in their alchemy. These substances are often potent but come at a great moral cost, as their creation involves using bloodthirsty and parasitic creatures, as well as the exploitation of living beings for the production of potions.

The Insect Nest is a rival faction to the more established and respected Dan Building. While Dan Building maintains a reputation for its high-quality, ethically sourced products, the Insect Nest is viewed with suspicion and fear. Its operations are not bound by the moral standards that govern other factions, allowing it to produce powerful, sometimes dangerous, elixirs that attract those seeking forbidden power.

The Insect Nest has a less transparent organizational structure, and little is known about its members. However, it is widely believed that the faction is led by the Insect Nest Master, a shadowy figure whose true identity remains a mystery. This leader is rumored to be a cultivator with a vast knowledge of insect-based alchemy, combining the arts of cultivation and insect-based techniques to create both powerful and terrifying results.

clans.title: Ji Family
clans.introText: One of the 300 aristocratic families of the Ganwu Universe Country. Their territory is the Snow Border Starfield
clans.appearance: One of the 300 aristocratic families of the Ganwu Universe Country. Their territory is the Snow Border Starfield

clans.title: Jiang Family
clans.introText: The Jiang Family is one of the Primal Chaos Clans of the Yu Kingdom, led by Lord Jiu Jiang. They have branches in multiple cities in the kingdom. Jiu Jiang Chaos State, as the fiefdom of Lord Jiu Jiang, can be considered the core of the clan. With the backing of Lord Jiu Jiang, the branch of the family in Hu Yang City is one of the Five Major Families of the city. This branch owns Cave Number 4 in Hu Yang City's Chaos Area A, one of the most expensive caves in the city.
