clans.title: Jin Military
clans.introText: The Jin Military is the core and most powerful force in the World of Jin. The primary purpose of the World of Jin is to cultivate great beings for the Jin Military; once those beings broke through to Eternal True God, they could be selected to serve Jin God King in battles outside of the World of Jin. The Jin Military contains 99% of the great beings in the World of Jin, including Void True Gods and Eternal True Gods.
clans.appearance:
The Jin Military is the core and most powerful force in the World of Jin. The primary purpose of the World of Jin is to cultivate great beings for the Jin Military; once those beings broke through to Eternal True God, they could be selected to serve Jin God King in battles outside of the World of Jin. The Jin Military contains 99% of the great beings in the World of Jin, including Void True Gods and Eternal True Gods.

The Jin Military is divided into 4 armies: East Army, South Army, West Army, and North Army, each of which are led by an Eternal True God. The 4 armies constantly compete with each other, sharpening them. As the most powerful force in the World of Jin, the Jin Military has unimaginable resources, including Mechanical Treasures, special inheritances, and powerful Xeon Arcana. The military is the only source for powerful inheritances in the World of Jin.

While many creatures in the World of Jin attempt to join the military, it is incredibly dangerous; even the initial screening process kills about 2/3 of prospects, and once one joins the military, fewer than 5% survive! Despite this horrific mortality rate, everyone within the World of Jin hopes to join the military, in order to access the benefits within.

clans.title: Legion of Shadow
clans.introText: The No. 1 Ninja Mercenary Group on Earth. They are able to conceal their aura to the point where an Advanced God of War equipped with a Black God Suit, Li Yao, was not able to notice them. A lot of their members were killed by Luo Feng.
clans.appearance: The No. 1 Ninja Mercenary Group on Earth. They are able to conceal their aura to the point where an Advanced God of War equipped with a Black God Suit, Li Yao, was not able to notice them. A lot of their members were killed by Luo Feng.

clans.title: Life Mother River
clans.introText: The Mother River of Life is a powerful, semi-sovereign organization spread across the Continent of Origin, focused on nurturing life and recruiting elites from diverse regions. Its members range from Eternal True Gods to Primal Chaos Sovereign and God King level practitioners. Governed by the enigmatic and immensely powerful Zongfu God King, its influence spans multiple territories, often clashing with kingdoms like Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom.
clans.appearance:

Its members range from Eternal True Gods to Primal Chaos Sovereign and God King level practitioners. Starting with 6th generation the number of wives a male had started to increase exponentially, earlier generations including Ping and Hai all had 1 wife, 4th and 5th generations had at most 3 wives.

clans.title: Luo Si Family
clans.introText: A Super Family in the Gold Mist Universe Country headed by King Jian Ta. When Luo Feng was going through his Life and Death Inheritance of Star Tower, Luo Si Family purposefully created an issue with Luo Royal Family to find out whether Luo Feng died or not. When Luo Feng came back, as a punishment, Luo Feng gave King Jian Ta a list that had three orders.
clans.appearance:
A Super Family in the Gold Mist Universe Country headed by King Jian Ta. When Luo Feng was going through his Life and Death Inheritance of Star Tower, Luo Si Family purposefully created an issue with Luo Royal Family to find out whether Luo Feng died or not. When Luo Feng came back, as a punishment, Luo Feng gave King Jian Ta a list that had three orders.

“Tell him!” The silver armored youth looked coldly at the leader of the family. “Anyone who dares bully my family, his guts must be huge. I really wonder…who gives him such guts. Has he been bribed by the other races? Tell him, without a proper answer, I don’t mind…in killing him and wiping out the entire Luo Si family!” - Luo Feng

clans.title: Mei Wu Family
clans.introText: The Mei Wu Family is a prestigious Primal Chaos Clan in the Yu Kingdom. There are two Primal Chaos Sovereigns in the family, giving them a large amount of power. They have branches in multiple cities in the Yu Kingdom.
clans.appearance:
The Mei Wu Family is a prestigious Primal Chaos Clan in the Yu Kingdom. There are two Primal Chaos Sovereigns in the family, giving them a large amount of power. They have branches in multiple cities in the Yu Kingdom.

The branch in Hu Yang City is considered one of the five Major Families of the city, and had 9 Eternal True Gods before Luo Feng killed Mei Wu Qi. Despite this, it is still a very marginal branch of the family, which has nearly 10,000 Eternal True Gods. This branch owns Chaos A No. 5 in Hu Yang City's Chaos Area A, one of the most expensive caves in the city.

clans.title: Milky Way Kingdom
clans.introText: Milky Way Kingdom is one of the three strongest powers in the Human Race by the end of Swallowed Star. It centers around the Earthlings, lifeforms born from the Remote Ocean, and the other great beings who decided to join it. While Luo Feng is the supreme leader of the kingdom, it is mainly led by Xi Mo.
clans.appearance:
Milky Way Kingdom is one of the three strongest powers in the Human Race by the end of Swallowed Star. It centers around the Earthlings, lifeforms born from the Remote Ocean, and the other great beings who decided to join it. While Luo Feng is the supreme leader of the kingdom, it is mainly led by Xi Mo.

Due to Luo Feng's importance to the Human Race, he did not need to have separate powers, however Xi Mo felt that the Earthlings and those born from the Remote Ocean did not have enough say in the senior meetings of the Human Race. To rectify this problem, Luo Feng gave permission for the creation of the Milky Way Kingdom.

The Earthlings were destined to be powerful due to the modifications by Sitting Mountain Guest and the power accumulated by Luo Feng. Many talents were born on Earth and many more would be born in the future. Those born from the Remote Ocean were created in Luo Feng's pursuit of the Ultimate Life Gene Level and also had great potential.

The True Gods on Luo Feng's side comprised Hong, Fire Dome, and himself. However, Luo Feng was actually too powerful, Hong too indifferent to power struggles, and Fire Dome was neither an Earthling nor born from Remote Ocean, decreasing his influence on those parties. This meant that the Earthlings and Remote Ocean line did not have adequate representation. This changed after Xi Mo became a True God, at which point many Universe Masters gathered under him, increasing their status in the Human Race.

clans.title: Misty Peak Alliance
clans.introText: The Misty Peak Alliance is one of the 12 Top Powers of the Original Universe, on the second tier of organizations due to its lack of a True God. It has 19 Universe Masters in total.
clans.appearance:
The Misty Peak Alliance is one of the 12 Top Powers of the Original Universe, on the second tier of organizations due to its lack of a True God. It has 19 Universe Masters in total.

During the Human Race Survival War, the Misty Peak Alliance decided to ally with the Human Race, since they could get gratitude and space to live in a future Holy Land. From their perspective, if they joined the Allied Forces Coalition Camp, they would not be able to get the inheritance, even if the Allied Forces won, and that it was useless to align with the Human Race when they were thriving, since they would receive nothing in return.

clans.title: Moli Family
clans.introText: Members of this family have four purple, curved horns on their head.
clans.appearance: Members of this family have four purple, curved horns on their head.

clans.title: Moyu Family
clans.introText: The Moyu Family is a powerful family in Hu Yang City. Initially, it was an ordinary family, comprising Moyu Hu and his three children, Moyu Liefeng, Moyu Qingyan, and Moyu Liuxing, but their destiny changed after Moyu Hu's encounter with Luo Feng.
clans.appearance:
The Moyu Family is a powerful family in Hu Yang City. Initially, it was an ordinary family, comprising Moyu Hu and his three children, Moyu Liefeng, Moyu Qingyan, and Moyu Liuxing, but their destiny changed after Moyu Hu's encounter with Luo Feng.

Due to Moyu Hu's relationship with Luo Feng, Liefeng became a disciple of the Zhu Family, the most powerful local family in Hu Yang City. Qingyan became Luo Feng's servant, eventually becoming his first direct disciple on the Continent of Origin. Liuxing became a member of the Sky Flame Sect, eventually becoming a disciple of Entropy Sky Flame. Moyu Hu himself became a member of the City Lord's Mansion, eventually becoming an assistant to the Deputy City Lord, Moli Meng. In this way, the family was connected to the most powerful entities in the city, and continued to build a foundation in the city.

After the resolution of the conflict between Lord Liu Yin and Lord Jiu Jiang, the Moyu Family's stature increased further when Luo Feng became the owner of Hu Yang City. Luo Feng named Moyu Hu co-Deputy City Lord (along with Moli Meng), and the Five Major Families were removed from power in the city. Due to Liefeng's status in the Zhu Family, the two families were linked and became one of the two great powers in the city. Qingyan's status increased (as the direct disciple of a Pinnacle Primal Chaos Sovereign), and the children of Moyu Hu began to have children, so the family continued to grow in size.

As the family of one of the Deputy City Lords of Hu Yang City, the Moyu Family also changed their cultivation guidelines, requiring their children to follow the law path in their early stages. By the time Luo Feng broke through to God King, the family's influence had spread to the 20 Chaos States under Luo Feng's control.

clans.title: Moyu Tool-Refining Shop
clans.introText: The Moyu Tool-Refining Shop is one of the Nine Tool-Refining Shops, the nine largest tool-refining shops established by the disciples of the slain Entropy Sky Flame. Established by Moyu Liuxing and his wife, Mo You Shang, it covered an area of ten million kilometers and was considered quite impressive. Due to the status of the Moyu Family in Hu Yang City, many of the disciples of the Sky Flame Sect followed Liuxing and You Shang.
clans.appearance:
The Moyu Tool-Refining Shop is one of the Nine Tool-Refining Shops, the nine largest tool-refining shops established by the disciples of the slain Entropy Sky Flame. Established by Moyu Liuxing and his wife, Mo You Shang, it covered an area of ten million kilometers and was considered quite impressive. Due to the status of the Moyu Family in Hu Yang City, many of the disciples of the Sky Flame Sect followed Liuxing and You Shang.

The Heart Shadow Sect attacked this shop during their looting of the city, killing Moyu Liuxing in the process. This led to Luo Feng killing multiple Eternal True Gods of the sect, including Chan Wu Qi, and directly opposing them. After killing Chan Wu Qi, Luo Feng rescued all of the beings in the shop at the time and destroyed one of the sect's super-large Mechanical Treasures, forcing the others to retreat.

The status of the shop after the conclusion of the battle over Hu Yang City is unclear.

clans.title: Myriad Laws Tower
clans.appearance: One of the alien forces on Continent of Origin

clans.title: Na Family
clans.introText: The Na Family is a merchant family located on the Blood River Continent. Originally, they were one of the more powerful families in Swallow Mound City, considered a middle-level power. Due to their connection to Luo Feng, they incurred the ire of Si Yong's forces and were destroyed, with the exception of the family leader, Na Bu.
clans.appearance:
The Na Family is a merchant family located on the Blood River Continent. Originally, they were one of the more powerful families in Swallow Mound City, considered a middle-level power. Due to their connection to Luo Feng, they incurred the ire of Si Yong's forces and were destroyed, with the exception of the family leader, Na Bu.

Before leaving to fight Si Yong, Luo Feng left Na Ke the riches he had accumulated during his time there, thousands or millions of times more than the family had previously possessed, so Na Bu had great hopes of raising the family to greater heights.

clans.title: Nine Great Tool-Refining Shops
clans.introText: The Nine Great Tool-Refining Shops are the largest tool-refining shops established by the disciples of the disbanded Sky Flame Sect. Luo Feng and Morosa worked to save as many employees of these shops as possible during the Heart Shadow Sect's looting of Hu Yang City.
clans.appearance: The Nine Great Tool-Refining Shops are the largest tool-refining shops established by the disciples of the disbanded Sky Flame Sect. Luo Feng and Morosa worked to save as many employees of these shops as possible during the Heart Shadow Sect's looting of Hu Yang City.

clans.title: Nine Territory Alliance
clans.introText: One of the Twelve Top Powers of the Original Universe, the Nine Territory Alliance comprises over 100,000 races. Its numbers far exceed that of Hongmeng and the Zerg Race Alliance. They have over 10 Universe Masters, over 100,000 Universe Venerables, and over 50 million Immortal Kings! The only thing distinguishing them from the Nine Superpowers is the lack of a True God.
clans.appearance:
One of the Twelve Top Powers of the Original Universe, the Nine Territory Alliance comprises over 100,000 races. Its numbers far exceed that of Hongmeng and the Zerg Race Alliance. They have over 10 Universe Masters, over 100,000 Universe Venerables, and over 50 million Immortal Kings! The only thing distinguishing them from the Nine Superpowers is the lack of a True God.

As the alliance lacks a True God, if they have to resurrect one of their Universe Overlords, they would have to ask for assistance from another power or a lone True God, which would be costly. Through Flame Emperor, the alliance has a relationship with Sitting Mountain Guest, and they have asked him to lead them so they would have a True God, but he refused.

clans.title: North Army
clans.introText: The North Army is one of the 4 armies of the Jin Military. Its general is North Army General, an Eternal True God. Since a quarter of the tribesmen and strange beasts in the World of Jin join the North Army, there are warriors joining everyday, forming long lines of prospective members.
clans.appearance:
The North Army is one of the 4 armies of the Jin Military. Its general is North Army General, an Eternal True God. Since a quarter of the tribesmen and strange beasts in the World of Jin join the North Army, there are warriors joining everyday, forming long lines of prospective members.

Like the East Army, it can be presumed that its screening process is incredibly dangerous, with about 2/3 of applicants dying in the screening process. Life within the army is likely even more dangerous. Like the East Army, it likely has many Special Legions. It has extensive resources with which it can provide the Special Legions incredible amounts of territory and truly powerful Mechanical Treasures to use in battles outside of the World of Jin, like Jin Luo Sky and Land.

When Luo Feng ordered the 4 generals to kill the specified Universe Masters who had joined the Allied Forces Military Camp or were from the Purple Moon Holy Land Universe, 60 were in the North Army.

clans.title: North Dragon City
clans.introText: North Dragon City is one of the four large organizations of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire. As one of the four large organizations, it, along with Hundred Tigers Building, Three Axe Mountain, and Black Cloud Guild, represents the people of the empire, rather than its government. Its power spreads across many galaxies, and it has a group of World Master fighters, giving it comparable fighting strength to each of the other large organizations, as well as the two sacred lands, Black Dragon Mountain and Ice Sea God Country.
clans.appearance:
North Dragon City is one of the four large organizations of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire. As one of the four large organizations, it, along with Hundred Tigers Building, Three Axe Mountain, and Black Cloud Guild, represents the people of the empire, rather than its government. Its power spreads across many galaxies, and it has a group of World Master fighters, giving it comparable fighting strength to each of the other large organizations, as well as the two sacred lands, Black Dragon Mountain and Ice Sea God Country.

At the beginning of the excavation of the World Within a World on Cang Lan Star, their faction contained about 2,100 people, but as one of the four large organizations of the empire, it was allowed up to 200,000 Stellar Level explorers. At the conclusion of the excavation, their faction was smaller than the nearly 80,000 person contingent of Three Axe Mountain.

clans.title: Northern Territory Alliance
clans.introText: The Northern Territory Alliance is one of the Nine Superpowers in the Original Universe. It contains the largest number of races among all of the alliances prior to the United Forces Alliance, with tens of thousands of heirs training at the Ancestral God Sect, and 100 times the number of Universe Venerables of the Hongmeng. The alliance has around 100 Universe Masters!
clans.appearance:
The Northern Territory Alliance is one of the Nine Superpowers in the Original Universe. It contains the largest number of races among all of the alliances prior to the United Forces Alliance, with tens of thousands of heirs training at the Ancestral God Sect, and 100 times the number of Universe Venerables of the Hongmeng. The alliance has around 100 Universe Masters!

Since the alliance represented many races, it was rather loose compared to those alliances serving one of the pinnacle races. Their leader, Northern Territory Alliance Master, couldn't be bothered to assist them, even if the alliance was in danger. To take on major tasks, the three Universe Masters Star River Master, Black Lotus Master, and Liu Lan Star Master, who together represent about 95% of the members of the alliance, work to an agreement.

After the Human Race defeats the Demon Race, the Northern Territory Alliance joins the United Forces Alliance, with even their leader contributing to the fight in a major way. When the United Forces Alliance was defeated, their leader abandoned the Northern Territory Alliance, which, when combined with how many Universe Masters died, reduced the alliance to a very weak state.

After the war, over 90 Universe Masters from the alliance were killed in the World of Jin on the orders of Luo Feng.

It seems that Northern True Sea refers to both the organization and the territory it controls.

clans.title: Palace of Gods of War

All of the War Gods and above War Gods on Earth are members of the Palace of Gods of War; when Luo Feng joined, he was the 3,516th member. The Palace of Gods of War is considered a "Temple" for all warriors, a sacred and a very important place for all the "Warriors" on Earth. The purpose of the Palace of Gods is to try to find the limits of the human body and try to go beyond it. The goal of the Palace of Gods is also to wipe out all mutant beasts from the Earth. Any Planetary warrior is eligible for the title of Elder.

clans.title: Ping Hai Company
clans.introText: Ping Hai Company is a Virtual business from Earth that deals with Earth based tea and spices, Real Estate, Investments, and Restaurants. It is a company under the Luo Family and their main source of income. The company is headquartered in Meng Ka City.
clans.appearance:
Ping Hai Company is a Virtual business from Earth that deals with Earth based tea and spices, Real Estate, Investments, and Restaurants. It is a company under the Luo Family and their main source of income. The company is headquartered in Meng Ka City.

“Disciple, this tea from your home earth is not bad. It’s comparable to the drinks from many other places, and the more I taste it the more I like it. I’ve added this tea to my collection, also it’s price is very reasonable.” - King Zhenyan
clans.history: Xu Xin was originally very good at business. Opening a business on Earth didn’t give her much accomplishment, she wanted to expand to the Universe. Xu Xin created Ping Hai Company inside Virtual Universe after Luo Feng provided her with the helmet which allowed her to access Virtual Universe Network. Ping Hai Company is named after Xu Xin and Luo Feng's twin sons Luo Ping and Luo Hai. With Luo Feng’s financial support, Xu Xin had enough capital, the company grew very quickly. Xu Xin felt that Luo Feng's growth was too fast and he was leaving her behind, she wanted to stand by his side, the only way she could do that was to become a core member of the Virtual Universe Company (VUC). In order to become a core member of the VUC and meet her husband regularly and have access to enter Yu Xiang Mountain and Primal Chaos City, Xu Xin sold 51% of the ownership of Ping Hai Company to VUC for 32,882 Mixed Units (10.2 times the original per share price). Xu Xin became a core member of the VUC when Ping Hai Company's capital reached 100,012 Mixed Units.
clans.trivia: Even Universe First Bank wanted to buy shares of Ping Hai Company but Xu Xin immediately rejected them.

clans.title: Python River Army
clans.introText: The Python River Army is one of the Special Legions of the East Army in the World of Jin. It is extremely selective; more than 99% of the East Army are in the ordinary forces, with less than 1% remaining for all of the special legions! When Luo Feng's 3,000 candidate group competed to join the East Army, only he and Wu He were selected to join the Python River Army! As a special legion, it was established by a Void True God, and its current commander is a powerful Void True God, Huo Zhuowu. The Void True God that founded the Python River Army would have to be an exceptional Void True God!
clans.appearance:
The Python River Army is one of the Special Legions of the East Army in the World of Jin. It is extremely selective; more than 99% of the East Army are in the ordinary forces, with less than 1% remaining for all of the special legions! When Luo Feng's 3,000 candidate group competed to join the East Army, only he and Wu He were selected to join the Python River Army! As a special legion, it was established by a Void True God, and its current commander is a powerful Void True God, Huo Zhuowu. The Void True God that founded the Python River Army would have to be an exceptional Void True God!

The Python River Army is divided into 3 battalions, and the first battalion has 9 squadrons.

The Python River Army identifies extraordinary talents through the initial screening of army candidates. The candidate group is split in two and forced to fight each other to the death! New members typically have to join forces to survive within the special legion, since the old members of the special legion were obviously extraordinary talents, but also had the benefit of additional experience from the life-and-death situations they encountered in the special legion.

As a special legion, the Python River Army undertakes much more difficult tasks than the ordinary forces. Their ordinary tasks are the equivalent of the incarnation-level of the ordinary army, while the catastrophe-level tasks are true catastrophes for new members. The incarnation-level tasks are so difficult that half of the experienced members are likely to die when undertaking them! Additionally, the difficulty of their missions meant that old members of the special legion did not have time to nurture new members, helping to contribute to the extremely high death rate.

Universe Master members of the Python River Army receive a suit of Python River Armor (a True God-level armor) when they join, and they are required to wear it. This is only the beginning of the benefits they receive! Members receive their own island (with a diameter exceeding 100,000 kilometers), from which others are banned. Special legion members are prohibited from killing each other within the camp, making it safer (when not on missions/tasks) and more disciplined than the ordinary forces. They can receive many more Military Credits (and thus better benefits) than the ordinary forces, and are able to exchange those credits for Mechanical Treasures, unlike the ordinary forces.

Members also get free access to a fundamental inheritance; while not on the level of the full Duan Dong River inheritance, it was still a top-notch inheritance, contained within around 100 crystal balls. It contained information on Arcana-making, Mechanical Treasure-making, melee combat, illusions, combinations, Divine Power burning techniques, and other skills! The ordinary forces could only access this in exchange for Military Credits.

Many weapons, valuables, and inheritances that the special legion can access in exchange for credits are inaccessible to the ordinary forces, even if they somehow acquired enough credits. The ones that can be acquired by the ordinary forces are still available to the special legion for much lower prices than the ordinary forces had to pay.

clans.title: Reincarnation Building
clans.introText: Reincarnation Building is an organization founded by Empress of Wind City, one of the 12 aboriginal God Emperors of the Continent of Origin. Her hope is that its members can support each other as companions and survive the end of the continent's reincarnation era.
clans.appearance:
Reincarnation Building is an organization founded by Empress of Wind City, one of the 12 aboriginal God Emperors of the Continent of Origin. Her hope is that its members can support each other as companions and survive the end of the continent's reincarnation era.

It is very small in size, with only 8 official members before the acceptance of Luo Feng, but its reputed strength is comparable to that of Two Worlds Palace, Wan Fa Tower, and Lonely Boat of Time and Space. The organization also has a positive reputation on the continent, and as it was established by an aboriginal, there is no fear of being tied to races from outside the Caged World. Members have access to excellent resources, including top-notch inheritances and various rare treasures.

While it was founded by Empress of Wind City, and every member was personally selected and invited by her, all members of the organization are equal and know each other's true identities. Each member is extraordinary, with the weakest member being a special Invincible First Level God King, while the other 7 are Second Level God Kings.

There are two core rules of the Reincarnation Building: 1. The identities of other members cannot be disclosed, and 2. If a member initiates an action, the participants cannot betray it, and those who refuse to participate cannot disclose the action. If one violates these rules, they will violate causality and become the enemy of all the other members.

Once one joins, they receive a token that can be used to enter the building and to contact the other members.

After Luo Feng reveals is identity as the Leader of Milky Way God Kingdom most of the members of this pavilion join the kingdom to live openly without the fear of the two ancient kingdoms

clans.title: Shadow Heaven Realm
clans.introText: Shadow Heaven Realm is a highly mysterious and powerful assassination organization on the Continent of Origin. It is described as the "number one assassination force on the Continent of Origin." The group's internal members are unknown to outsiders, and their identity is a closely guarded secret. The Shadow Heaven Realm is known for its ability to carry out assassinations on various targets, regardless of their cultivation level. It is so formidable that it once dispatched a being with "Emperor-level combat power," which shocked the entire Continent of Origin, as such overt powerhouses were believed to exist only within the two Ancient Kingdoms. This event solidified the Shadow Heaven Realm's status and reputation.
clans.appearance:
Shadow Heaven Realm is a highly mysterious and powerful assassination organization on the Continent of Origin. It is described as the "number one assassination force on the Continent of Origin." The group's internal members are unknown to outsiders, and their identity is a closely guarded secret. The Shadow Heaven Realm is known for its ability to carry out assassinations on various targets, regardless of their cultivation level. It is so formidable that it once dispatched a being with "Emperor-level combat power," which shocked the entire Continent of Origin, as such overt powerhouses were believed to exist only within the two Ancient Kingdoms. This event solidified the Shadow Heaven Realm's status and reputation.

The organization operates on a fee-for-service model. Clients, such as the Wu Xiang Ancestor, can request assassinations and are given a price based on the target's strength. For example, assassinating a Primal Chaos Sovereign costs a significant amount of Universe Sands and killing an Eternal True God is also priced accordingly. The Shadow Heaven Realm is upfront about the risks, stating that all assassinations may fail and that fees are non-refundable. Despite this, the organization is known for its trustworthiness and for always keeping its word, ensuring that once the payment is received, they will act immediately and send sufficient power to carry out the task. They are willing to undertake any "dirty or arduous work" that other powerful individuals might consider beneath them.

clans.title: Sky Flame Sect
clans.introText: The Sky Flame Sect is an organization for training tool-refining skills. It was established and led by Entropy Sky Flame, an Eternal True God who was reputed to be one of the best tool-refiners in Hu Yang City, and has a good reputation. After he befriended Luo Feng, the Sky Flame Sect increased in reputation and safety, particularly when Luo Feng temporarily stayed there.
clans.appearance:
The Sky Flame Sect is an organization for training tool-refining skills. It was established and led by Entropy Sky Flame, an Eternal True God who was reputed to be one of the best tool-refiners in Hu Yang City, and has a good reputation. After he befriended Luo Feng, the Sky Flame Sect increased in reputation and safety, particularly when Luo Feng temporarily stayed there.

Its requirements for its members were quite high, and it focused on teaching step-by-step from the basics. Entropy Sky Flame gave weak True Gods a chance to join the sect, regardless of their nobility or status, and after passing his tests, they could become his personal disciples. He treated all of his disciples equally.

During the battle between General Yong and Blood Cloud, 8,039 died as a result of Blood Cloud's actions in retreating. After Entropy Sky Flame's death at the hands of Blood Cloud, the sect was disbanded. At the time of its dissolution, Entropy Sky Flame had over 300 personal disciples within this sect.

The survivors of the sect split into different organizations after it dissolved.

The Demon Race always wanted to merge with the Space Beast Alliance, but due in part to the many disputes between the two species (and the Space Beasts disliking the Demons), this did not happen.

Led by Space Beast Ancestor, the Space Beast Alliance is seen as one of the Nine Superpowers of the Original Universe, along with the six alliances of the Pinnacle Races, the Ancestral God Sect, and the Northern Territory Alliance. With his Remote Ocean and Golden Horned Beast Bodies, it was easy for Luo Feng to masquerade as a member of the alliance, although his disguise was easily uncovered by Space Beast Ancestor.

Although Space Beasts are lonely in general, those strong enough to join the alliance find strong bonds and a group of Space Beasts willing to fight for one another. Despite this camaraderie, they generally do not care about Space Beasts who have not become Immortals.

Safely located in the Space Beast Ancestor Miniature Universe, they are rarely seen, avoid confrontations, and the land of their alliance was a secret in the universe. The Space Beast Alliance owns the Beast God Sector, where time can be accelerated by 10,000 times, as well as many inheritances and countless valuables. Those with sufficient talent can be provided with God Envoy Inheritance Crystals, God General Inheritance Orders, or even Beast God Inheritance Orders!

clans.title: Special Legion
clans.introText: A Special Legion is a select military force in the Jin Military. The commanders of these forces are all powerful Void True Gods who only fear the army generals.
clans.appearance:
A Special Legion is a select military force in the Jin Military. The commanders of these forces are all powerful Void True Gods who only fear the army generals.

These military forces have a very stringent selection process; out of 3,000 combatants in Luo Feng's military selection battle, only he and Wu He qualified to join the Python River Army Special Legion. About 1% of the Jin Military's forces are members of Special Legions. Since they are recognized for both their current strength and future potential, they have a number of benefits that the ordinary forces do not.

Members of Special Legions are able to exchange Military Credits for Mechanical Treasures, unlike the ordinary forces, and are allowed to purchase special inheritances that the regular forces cannot. Upon joining a Special Legion, one receives a basic inheritance with information on Arcana-crafting, Mechanical Treasure-crafting, melee combat, illusion techniques, combination techniques, Divine Power burning techniques, and others. Additionally, due to their value, they are prohibited from killing each other while in the military camp, unlike the ordinary forces. They are allowed to choose islands on which they can live privately; even other great beings are banned from entering without permission.

Despite these benefits, life in a Special Legion is not easy. The tasks they are given are much more difficult than those given to the ordinary forces; their ordinary tasks equal the Incarnation-level tasks of the ordinary forces. The Incarnation-level tasks of the Special Legions are so difficult that half of the experienced members die attempting to accomplish them!

The most powerful beings in the World of Jin were all members of Special Legions at some point.

clans.title: Supreme Council
clans.introText: Unlike Hongmeng, Supreme Council only consists of the Supreme Beings (Universe Venerable and above) of the Human Race, no other Race beings are allowed to join the Supreme Council. Supreme Council meetings are rarely held in Pantheon Mountain, every time it is held, the council discusses matters that are vital to humans. A Supreme Council Meeting is convened every time a vital matter major enough to affect the entire race occurs. Normally only Universe Venerable and above are able to become members of the Supreme Council, but in special cases, if a Lower Cultivation Stage Human can kill a Universe Venerable or has strength comparable to the Universe Venerable they can join the Council.

It takes a long time for an issue to come up that actually affects humans. More than half of the Supreme Council meetings involve no discussions, and only Universe Masters need to know. Only those that require voting take a long time. After all, the Universe Masters don’t have time to elaborate on the issue.

clans.appearance:
The Greatest Faction of the Future is a prophesied organization led by the Lord of Blades, Luo Feng, and composed of 108 of the most powerful Chaotic Origin Primogenitors and Overlords from across the Chaotic Origin Dimension. This faction's emergence is a future event repeatedly glimpsed by Lord Xingmang through the Altar Phantom within the Mysterious Land known as the Corridor of Records.

This faction represents a major shift in power dynamics, as its members span multiple existing factions, including the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Faction, the Cultivator Camp, and others. Key figures prophesied to be members include the Chaotic Origin Primogenitor Mo Xu, the Endless Ancestor and the Kafuxiu as well as Overlord such as Jin. The faction's existence suggests a future of unparalleled dominance, with its combined strength capable of making the entire Chaotic Origin Dimension "tremble."

The repeated manifestation of this specific future vision in the Corridor of Records’ Altar Phantom suggests a high probability of its occurrence, indicating a significant and transformative event in the history of the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Its formation and purpose remain a subject of great speculation, but it is clear that its rise is a monumental future event centered around Luo Feng’s leadership.

clans.history:
Three Axe Mountain was founded by three cultivators, Lament, Luo, and Molly, who received the Domain Master Huge Axe Warrior title when they were young. Despite coming from different starfields, they became life-and-death friends, deciding to form the organization Three Axe Mountain, named after their status as Huge Axe Warriors. In the beginning, Luo was the leader, with Lament and Molly assisting him.

Of the three founders, Lament and Molly became Immortals while Luo remained a pinnacle World Master, seeking to master Law of Time  before breaking through to Immortal. Around 100,000 years prior to the start of the series, he vanished from the Black Dragon Mountain Starfield, so his status was unknown. Presumably, Lament and Molly established Three Axe Mountain locations in their respective starfields.

At the directive of Man Luo, Ming Yu observed Luo Feng, Hong, and Lei Shen as they fought in the Killing Fields. After sending two of the young elites of the Virtual Universe Company to fight the three in individual battles, he met them and opened their eyes to the benefits of true life-or-death battles. The three joined the Virtual Universe Company as external members and decided to participate in the Universe Trainee Mercenary Exam, which takes place in the World Master's World on Cang Lan Star.

As one of the four large organizations of the Black Dragon Mountain Empire, Three Axe Mountain played a large part during the excavation of the World Within a World on Cang Lan Planet, despite having no official members who were Stellar Level. The subordinates of their official members participated in the excavation, including Luo Feng, Hong, and Lei Shen, who were subordinates of Ming Yu.

By the end of the excavation, the Three Axe Mountain faction had 78,503 people, including 2 Universe Level fighters, Chakra and Bendi. Despite the sneak attack from Brolin's elite forces that killed 11 of the 12 targets they deemed important (including Chakra and Bendi), Luo Feng survived and was able to exchange the Air Cutter Blade with Ming Yu.

During the Ganwu Universe Country elimination battle, Head General Luo, along with General Jiang Tian Chen, observed Hong's final battle, where he was eliminated by a female warrior who had some comprehension of Law of Water . Noting that Hong, like him, had a domain as a Planetary Level and a one syllable name, he offered to be Hong's official teacher. Hong accepted and became his student.

When Luo Feng proved his might by killing dozens of Universe Venerables, including Universe Overlords like Flourishing Light Seigneur and Venerable Zhong Zhan, the Zerg Race, Automaton Race, and Demon Race focused their efforts to kill him before he became a Universe Master.

After breaking through to Universe Venerable, Luo Feng spent 62 years cultivating on Bauhinia Island, causing Father God, Dream Demon Ancestor, and Zerg Empress to meet and discuss how to kill him. Following some discussion, they decided to enlist an independent True God, with each of the races providing 3 Top Arcana in exchange for their services. (军主(Jūn zhǔ), lit. Army Lord)

The Universe Army participates in two types of battles: Army Battles and Elite Team Battles. Army Battles are battles between huge armies, each led by an Immortal, with World Masters leading large amounts of Domain Master and Universe Level soldiers fighting against each other. Elite Team Battles are between small groups of World Master Generals led by powerful Immortals. Due to their small size, they can easily avoid battles in empty spaces, so they fight in special regions on the battlefields.

World Masters are divided into three groups: 1. Normal World Master Soldier (普通界主战士(Pǔtōng jiè zhǔ zhànshì)), 2. Elite World Master Soldier (精英界主战士(Jīngyīng jiè zhǔ zhànshì)), and 3. World Master General (界主战将(Jiè zhǔ zhàn jiāng)). World Master Soldiers are most normal World Masters. Elite World Master Soldiers are World Masters who have at least been recognized by an Original Law. World Master Generals make up less than 1 of an ordinary group of 100 Elite World Masters. About 30% of new World Master soldiers are Elite World Masters, and 0.3% of them are World Master Generals. After being sorted, the World Masters join a group and begin working to fulfill their requirements.

Soldiers earn Contribution Points by killing opponents. The point rewards are below:

Killing a Normal World Master Soldier rewards 100,000 Contribution Points.

Killing an Elite World Master Fighter rewards 1 million Contribution Points.

Killing a World Master General rewards 10 million Contribution Points.

Killing a Lower Level Immortal Army Lord rewards 100 million Contribution Points.

Killing a Higher Level Immortal Army Lord rewards 1 billion Contribution Points.

Killing a Low Immortal Marquis rewards 10 billion Contribution Points.

Killing a High Immortal Marquis rewards 100 billion Contribution Points.

Killing a Pinnacle Immortal Marquis rewards 1 trillion Contribution Points.

Killing a Low Immortal King rewards 10 trillion Contribution Points.

Killing a High Immortal King rewards 100 trillion Contribution Points.

Killing a Pinnacle Immortal King rewards 1 quadrillion Contribution Points.

World Master soldiers have Contribution Point quotas they must reach before they are allowed to leave the Extraterritorial Battlefield. After reaching their quota, they can choose to retire, exchange for treasure, continue fighting for the army, or leave the army and continue fighting on their own.

The quotas range from 1 to 10 million points for Normal World Master Soldiers, from 10 million to 100 million for Elite World Master Soldiers, and from 100 million to 1 billion for World Master Generals.

The Zhang Clan is a Royal Family affiliated with the Flame Wind Ancient Kingdom, led by Feng Zhang God King. The clan's ancestral land, also where its leader lives, is Fengzhang City. They can be considered powerful, with 2 Primal Chaos Sovereigns and over 10,000 Eternal True Gods in addition to their leading God King.

Zhang Yun Ge was an obscure Eternal True God member of this clan until she married Moyu Qingyan, substantially raising her status. After she decided to separate from him, her and her lineage's status declined significantly, with Father Zhang applying to leave Fengzhang City.

clans.appearance:
The Zhu Family is the strongest of the Local Major Families of Hu Yang City, with over 20 Eternal True Gods. Led by Zhu Gu, an incredibly powerful Eternal True God, they do business in an upright manner and do not get involved with the Dark Forces. Members of the family are part of the city's major powers, including the Hu Yang Guard and even the Hu Yang Legion, so their information network is likely superior to the City Lord's Mansion, Food Kingdom forces, and even the Flame Wind Guild Hall.

In terms of actual strength located in the city, none of the Five Major Families are stronger than the Zhu Family, and their foundation is deep, having been rooted in the city for more than 1 million periods. The Five Major Families are only more powerful when their backing (Primal Chaos Sovereigns or God Kings) are taken into account.

After Luo Feng showed his strength by killing Mu Yang, the Zhu Family attempted to befriend him, with Zhu You taking on Moyu Liefeng as his disciple and later meeting Luo Feng personally.

While they were forced from their dwelling place during the Heart Shadow Sect's invasion of the city, they returned at the conclusion of the conflict between Lord Liu Yin's and Lord Jiu Jiang's forces.
